SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_RPT_SALES_REGISTER]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@uid                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',

@PRODUCT                 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@prod                   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@CUSTNAME               NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@ACCOUNT                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''


as
Begin 


	
IF @AA = 'GETALL'
BEGIN 
---------------------------------For Branch
declare @branch1 as nvarchar(max);
    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid)

	print @branch1;
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname from SM1002 

	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch1,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7;

	

--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
--	 UNION ALL 
--	  	SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
--		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;

---------------------------------------FOR GRID
 SELECT * FROM (
          --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
          --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
			--, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @BRANCH  +'%' 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
        ) AS AA
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;
--------------------------------------FOR CATEGORY

	   -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN

		  DECLARE @CUSTTYPE NVARCHAR(MAX)
        SET @CUSTTYPE= (SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63_13 WHERE SM63_5=@uid)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN  (select data from dbo.split  (@CUSTTYPE,',')) AND SM44_12='CUST'
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

-----------------------------------------For Product
select sm206_2 as UNQID, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by Dname;

-----------------------------------------For Product Category 

        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;

end

  



IF @AA = 'GETPRO'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
        --    UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))  
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;

     
    END

IF @AA = 'GETACC'
    BEGIN

	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
		
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' AND 
			SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@ACCOUNT,',')) 
			and SM19_63  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
    
        ORDER BY Dname ;
     
    END

IF @AA = 'DATA'
BEGIN
--  ALL PRODUCTS WITH ALL CUSTOMERS VALUES
	if(@prod = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @CUSTNAME = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	begin
	 
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;


		SELECT (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM1011_41)+ DBO.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0)  AS [Invoice No],FORMAT(sm1011_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],SM1011_42 AS PRODNETQTY, SM1011_42 AS PRODQTY,
		sm209_7 as Unit,sm1011_22 AS RATE,SM1011_37 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_26 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm1011_26,sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS [GSTPER]
		,sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 ELSE  sm1011_24 END AS [Taxable Amount],
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		sm1011_34 as [ROFF],
		sm1011_35 as [TOTAL],
	   CASE WHEN  SM1011_62  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))-SM1011_37  
	   END AS [CRAMT],sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT], sm1011_74 as SALETYPE FROM SM1011 
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41
	   where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	  ORDER BY 
		sm1011_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;

		SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		sm209_7 AS UNIT,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS QTY,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS PRODQTY,
		sum(sm1011_24) AS [TAMT],
		sum(sm1011_27) AS [IGST],
		sum(sm1011_29) AS [CGST],
		sum(sm1011_31) AS [SGST],
		sum(sm1011_35) AS [NETAMT]
	FROM  SM1011 INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm209_7 order by sm206_7 asc;

	

	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)

	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXGRP FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10  
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA)

	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(BRANCH TRANSER ONLY)
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXGRPBT FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 where 
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA)


	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXURP FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	AND
	SM19_23 = NULL


	------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT OF (OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	--------taxable amt and total amt of branch transfer
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	-----taxable and total of branch transfer
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	-----igst sales
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	and sm1011_26<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	
	-------cgst+sgst sales
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	and sm1011_26='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 
	end

--  SELECTED PRODUCT WITH ALL CUSTOMERS VALUES
	else if(@prod != '' and @CUSTNAME = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	begin
	     SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;


		SELECT (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM1011_41)+ DBO.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0)  AS [Invoice No],FORMAT(sm1011_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],SM1011_42 AS PRODNETQTY, SM1011_42 AS PRODQTY,
		sm209_7 as Unit,sm1011_22 AS RATE,SM1011_37 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_26 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm1011_26,sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS [GSTPER]
		,sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 ELSE  sm1011_24 END AS [Taxable Amount],
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		sm1011_34 as [ROFF],
		sm1011_35 as [TOTAL],
	   CASE WHEN  SM1011_62  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))-SM1011_37  
	   END AS [CRAMT],

		sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT], sm1011_74 as SALETYPE
		FROM SM1011 
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41
	   where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	
	And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	  ORDER BY 
		sm1011_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;

		SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		sm209_7 AS UNIT,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS QTY,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS PRODQTY,
		sum(sm1011_24) AS [TAMT],
		sum(sm1011_27) AS [IGST],
		sum(sm1011_29) AS [CGST],
		sum(sm1011_31) AS [SGST],
		sum(sm1011_35) AS [NETAMT]
	FROM  SM1011 
	INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
	INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm209_7 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)

	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXGRP FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13  
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA)

	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(BRANCH TRANSER ONLY)
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXGRPBT FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13  where 
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA)


	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TXURP FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23 = NULL


	------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT OF (OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	--------taxable amt and total amt of branch transfer
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	-----taxable and total of branch transfer
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) AND
	SM19_23=(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 

	-----igst sales
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	and sm1011_26<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 


	-------cgst+sgst sales
	select sum(sm1011_24)as taxable,sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34)as totalamt
	FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	and sm1011_26='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) 
	end


--  ALL PRODUCTS WITH SELECT CUSTOMER VALUES
	else if(@prod = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and @CUSTNAME != '')
	begin
	     SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;


		SELECT (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM1011_41)+ DBO.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0)  AS [Invoice No],FORMAT(sm1011_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],SM1011_42 AS PRODNETQTY, SM1011_42 AS PRODQTY,
		sm209_7 as Unit,sm1011_22 AS RATE,SM1011_37 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		--CASE WHEN sm1011_26 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],

		,sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 ELSE  sm1011_24 END AS [Taxable Amount],
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		sm1011_34 as [ROFF],
		sm1011_35 as [TOTAL],
	   CASE WHEN  SM1011_62  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))-SM1011_37  
	   END AS [CRAMT],

		sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT], sm1011_74 as SALETYPE
		FROM SM1011

		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41

	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))

	inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
	inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
	inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41
	--where SM1011_41 = @BRANCH
    where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	and SM1011_41 in(select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))----------------------------------------
    ORDER BY 
	sm1011_41,
    sm1011_6 ASC, 
    CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
END

	 SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC 
		end 
		else 
	 begin 
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 where sm1002_5= @BRANCH
        ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC;
		end
     
    END

--B2B,SEZ, DE
SELECT *
FROM (
    /* -------- SM1011 BLOCK -------- */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],
        sm1002.sm1002_16 
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],
        sm1011.sm1011_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm1011.sm1011_35 AS [Invoice Value],
        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],
        '' AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],
        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Rate],
        CASE 
            WHEN sm1011.sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales'
            THEN 0.00
            ELSE sm1011.sm1011_24
        END AS [Taxable Value],
        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]
    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206   ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN sm19    ON sm19.unqid    = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm209   ON sm209.unqid   = sm1011.sm1011_23
    INNER JOIN sm1002  ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
    LEFT  JOIN sm210   ON sm210.unqid IN (sm1011.sm1011_26, sm1011.sm1011_28, sm1011.sm1011_30)
    LEFT  JOIN sm205   ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24
	WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                   AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND (
    @BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    OR SM1011_41 = @BRANCH
)


    UNION ALL

    /* -------- SM213 BLOCK -------- */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],
        sm1002.sm1002_16
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar), 4)
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],
        sm213.sm213_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm213.sm213_23 AS [Invoice Value],
        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],
        '' AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],
        SUM(sm210.sm210_7) AS [Rate],
        sm213.sm213_17 AS [Taxable Value],
        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]
    FROM sm213
    LEFT JOIN sm213_c  ON sm213_c.sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
    LEFT JOIN sm19     ON sm19.unqid = sm213.sm213_10
    LEFT JOIN sm205    ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24
    LEFT JOIN sm206    ON sm206.SM206_2 = sm213_c.SM213_C5
    LEFT JOIN sm210    ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15
    LEFT JOIN sm1002   ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm213.sm213_64
	WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                  AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND (
    @BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    OR sm213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
)

    GROUP BY
        sm19.sm19_23,
        sm19.sm19_5,
        sm1002.sm1002_16,
        sm213.sm213_8,
        sm213.sm213_9,
        sm213.sm213_6,
        sm213.sm213_23,
        sm205.SM205_7,
        sm19.SM19_24,
        sm213.sm213_17
) x
ORDER BY [Invoice Date], [Invoice Number];


-------------------------------------
	--for gst unregistered party
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,
	SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	
	where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)  AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) AND  SM19_23 = '' -- AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],

-------cdnr
	SELECT  
    sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
    sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],

    sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1018.sm1018_20 AS [Note Number],
    FORMAT(sm1018.sm1018_2, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') AS [Note Date],

    'C' AS [Note Type],   -- Credit Note

    (SELECT SM205_7 
     FROM SM205 
     WHERE SM205_5 = sm19.sm19_24) + '-' + sm19.sm19_24 
     AS [Place Of Supply],

    'N' AS [Reverse Charge],

    'Regular B2B' AS [Note Supply Type],

    sm1018.SM1018_18 AS [Note Value],

    (SELECT sm210_7 
     FROM sm210 
     WHERE unqid IN (sm1018.sm1018_12, sm1018.sm1018_13, sm1018.sm1018_14)) 
     AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_10 AS [Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_11 AS [Taxable Value],

    0.00 AS [Cess Amount]

FROM sm1018
INNER JOIN sm19   ON sm1018.sm1018_6  = sm19.unqid
INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1018.sm1018_19 = sm1002.sm1002_5

WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                          AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1002.sm1002_5 = @branch)
AND sm1018.sm1018_24 IS NOT NULL   -- only valid credit notes

ORDER BY 
    sm1002.sm1002_7,
    sm1018.sm1018_2;
-------------------------------hsn(b2b)
	SELECT
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    SUM([Total Quantity])              AS [Total Quantity],
    SUM([Total Value])                 AS [Total Value],
    [Rate],
    SUM([Taxable Value])               AS [Taxable Value],
    SUM([Integrated Tax Amount])       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
    SUM([Central Tax Amount])          AS [Central Tax Amount],
    SUM([State/UT Tax Amount])         AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
    SUM([Cess Amount])                 AS [Cess Amount]
FROM
(
    /* ================= SALES (SM1011) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15          AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6             AS [Description],
        sm209.sm209_7           AS UQC,

        SUM(sm1011_42)          AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm1011_35)          AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7           AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm1011_24)          AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm1011_27)          AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_29)          AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_31)          AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_26
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR SM1011_41 = @branch)
      AND sm1011_24 > 0 ---and sm19_23=''

    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm209.sm209_7,
        sm210.sm210_7

    UNION ALL

    /* ================= CREDIT / DEBIT NOTES (SM213) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15        AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6           AS [Description],
        sm213_c.sm213_c8      AS UQC,

        SUM(sm213_c9)         AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm213_c19)        AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7         AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm213_c14)        AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm213_c18)        AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c16)        AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c17)        AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm213_c22,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM213_c
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15
    LEFT  JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM213.sm213_10

    WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                      AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)   AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm213_64 = @branch)
					 ----- and sm19_23=''
    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm213_c.sm213_c8,
        sm210.sm210_7  
) A
GROUP BY
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    [Rate]
ORDER BY
    HSN,
    [Rate];

    [Rate],

    SUM([Integrated Tax Amount])       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
    SUM([Central Tax Amount])          AS [Central Tax Amount],

(
    /* ================= SALES (SM1011) ================= */

        sm206.sm206_15          AS HSN,

        sm210.sm210_7           AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm1011_27)          AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_29)          AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_31)          AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_26
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10

SELECT
    [Nature of Document],
    [Sr.No.From],
    [Sr.No.To],
    [Total Number],
    [Cancelled]
FROM
(
    /* ===============================
       OUTWARD INVOICES – SM1011
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1011.sm1011_41 = @branch)

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18
	  UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
        – SM213
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar) 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],

        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar) 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(DISTINCT sm213.unqid) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM sm213
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm213.sm213_64

    WHERE sm213.sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                            AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm213.sm213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch, ',')))

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       CREDIT NOTES – SM1018
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Credit Note' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + CAST(sm1018.sm1018_20 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + CAST(sm1018.sm1018_20 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1018
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1018.sm1018_19

    WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                              AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1018.sm1018_19 = @branch)

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

  

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       INWARD FROM UNREGISTERED (RCM)
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for inward supply from unregistered person'
            AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm19    ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1011.sm1011_41 = @branch)
      AND ISNULL(sm19.sm19_23,'') = ''   -- unregistered

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18
) D
ORDER BY
    [Nature of Document],
    [Sr.No.From];
	end

 end
GO

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_RPT_SALES_REGISTER_GST]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@uid                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',

@PRODUCT                 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@prod                   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@CUSTNAME               NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@ACCOUNT                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''


as
Begin 


	
IF @AA = 'GETALL'
BEGIN 
---------------------------------For Branch
declare @branch1 as nvarchar(max);
    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid)

	print @branch1;
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname from SM1002 

	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch1,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7;

	

--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
--	 UNION ALL 
--	  	SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
--		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;

---------------------------------------FOR GRID
 SELECT * FROM (
          --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
          --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
			--, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @BRANCH  +'%' 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
        ) AS AA
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;
--------------------------------------FOR CATEGORY

	   -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN

		  DECLARE @CUSTTYPE NVARCHAR(MAX)
        SET @CUSTTYPE= (SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63_13 WHERE SM63_5=@uid)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN  (select data from dbo.split  (@CUSTTYPE,',')) AND SM44_12='CUST'
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

-----------------------------------------For Product
select sm206_2 as UNQID, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by Dname;

-----------------------------------------For Product Category 

        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;

end

  



IF @AA = 'GETPRO'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
        --    UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))  
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;

     
    END

IF @AA = 'GETACC'
    BEGIN

	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
		
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' AND 
			SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@ACCOUNT,',')) 
			and SM19_63  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
    
        ORDER BY Dname ;
     
    END



IF @AA = 'GETBRANCH'
    BEGIN

	if @BRANCH ='All' 
	begin 
	 SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC 
		end 
		else 
	 begin 
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 where sm1002_5= @BRANCH
        ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC;
		end
     
    END

IF @AA = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
    AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;
END
 

  if @aa= 'gridgst'
  begin


--B2B,SEZ, DE
SELECT *
FROM (
    /* -------- SM1011 BLOCK -------- */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],
        sm1002.sm1002_16 
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],
        sm1011.sm1011_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm1011.sm1011_35 AS [Invoice Value],
        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],
        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],
        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Rate],
        CASE 
            WHEN sm1011.sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales'
            THEN 0.00
            ELSE sm1011.sm1011_24
        END AS [Taxable Value],
        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]
    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206   ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN sm19    ON sm19.unqid    = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm209   ON sm209.unqid   = sm1011.sm1011_23
    INNER JOIN sm1002  ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
    LEFT  JOIN sm210   ON sm210.unqid IN (sm1011.sm1011_26, sm1011.sm1011_28, sm1011.sm1011_30)
    LEFT  JOIN sm205   ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24
	WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                   AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND (
    @BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    OR SM1011_41 = @BRANCH
)


    UNION ALL

    /* -------- SM213 BLOCK -------- */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],
        sm1002.sm1002_16
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar), 4)
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],
        sm213.sm213_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm213.sm213_23 AS [Invoice Value],
        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],
        SUM(sm210.sm210_7) AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],
        SUM(sm210.sm210_7) AS [Rate],
        sm213.sm213_17 AS [Taxable Value],
        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]
    FROM sm213
    LEFT JOIN sm213_c  ON sm213_c.sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
    LEFT JOIN sm19     ON sm19.unqid = sm213.sm213_10
    LEFT JOIN sm205    ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24
    LEFT JOIN sm206    ON sm206.SM206_2 = sm213_c.SM213_C5
    LEFT JOIN sm210    ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15
    LEFT JOIN sm1002   ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm213.sm213_64
	WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                  AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND (
    @BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    OR sm213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
)

    GROUP BY
        sm19.sm19_23,
        sm19.sm19_5,
        sm1002.sm1002_16,
        sm213.sm213_8,
        sm213.sm213_9,
        sm213.sm213_6,
        sm213.sm213_23,
        sm205.SM205_7,
        sm19.SM19_24,
        sm213.sm213_17
) x
ORDER BY [Invoice Date], [Invoice Number];
  



	--for gst unregistered partiesy
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,
	SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	
	where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)  AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) AND  SM19_23 = '' -- AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],

-------cdnr

	SELECT  
    sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
    sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],

    sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1018.sm1018_20 AS [Note Number],
    FORMAT(sm1018.sm1018_2, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') AS [Note Date],

    'C' AS [Note Type],   -- Credit Note

    (SELECT SM205_7 
     FROM SM205 
     WHERE SM205_5 = sm19.sm19_24) + '-' + sm19.sm19_24 
     AS [Place Of Supply],

    'N' AS [Reverse Charge],

    'Regular B2B' AS [Note Supply Type],

    sm1018.SM1018_18 AS [Note Value],

    (SELECT sm210_7 
     FROM sm210 
     WHERE unqid IN (sm1018.sm1018_12, sm1018.sm1018_13, sm1018.sm1018_14)) 
     AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_10 AS [Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_11 AS [Taxable Value],

    0.00 AS [Cess Amount]

FROM sm1018
INNER JOIN sm19   ON sm1018.sm1018_6  = sm19.unqid
INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1018.sm1018_19 = sm1002.sm1002_5

WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                          AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1002.sm1002_5 = @branch)
AND sm1018.sm1018_24 IS NOT NULL   -- only valid credit notes

ORDER BY 
    sm1002.sm1002_7,
    sm1018.sm1018_2;



-------------------------------hsn(b2b)
	SELECT
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    SUM([Total Quantity])              AS [Total Quantity],
    SUM([Total Value])                 AS [Total Value],
    [Rate],
    SUM([Taxable Value])               AS [Taxable Value],
    SUM([Integrated Tax Amount])       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
    SUM([Central Tax Amount])          AS [Central Tax Amount],
    SUM([State/UT Tax Amount])         AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
    SUM([Cess Amount])                 AS [Cess Amount]
FROM
(
    /* ================= SALES (SM1011) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15          AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6             AS [Description],
        sm209.sm209_7           AS UQC,

        SUM(sm1011_42)          AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm1011_35)          AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7           AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm1011_24)          AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm1011_27)          AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_29)          AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_31)          AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_26
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR SM1011_41 = @branch)
      AND sm1011_24 > 0 ---and sm19_23=''

    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm209.sm209_7,
        sm210.sm210_7

    UNION ALL

    /* ================= CREDIT / DEBIT NOTES (SM213) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15        AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6           AS [Description],
        sm213_c.sm213_c8      AS UQC,

        SUM(sm213_c9)         AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm213_c19)        AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7         AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm213_c14)        AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm213_c18)        AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c16)        AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c17)        AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm213_c22,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM213_c
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15
    LEFT  JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM213.sm213_10

    WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                      AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)   AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm213_64 = @branch)
					 ----- and sm19_23=''
    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm213_c.sm213_c8,
        sm210.sm210_7  
) A
GROUP BY
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    [Rate]
ORDER BY
    HSN,
    [Rate];
---------------------------------------
	SELECT
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    SUM([Total Quantity])              AS [Total Quantity],
    SUM([Total Value])                 AS [Total Value],
    [Rate],
    SUM([Taxable Value])               AS [Taxable Value],
    SUM([Integrated Tax Amount])       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
    SUM([Central Tax Amount])          AS [Central Tax Amount],
    SUM([State/UT Tax Amount])         AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
    SUM([Cess Amount])                 AS [Cess Amount]
FROM
(
    /* ================= SALES (SM1011) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15          AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6             AS [Description],
        sm209.sm209_7           AS UQC,

        SUM(sm1011_42)          AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm1011_35)          AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7           AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm1011_24)          AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm1011_27)          AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_29)          AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm1011_31)          AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_26
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR SM1011_41 = @branch)
      AND sm1011_24 > 0 and sm19_23=''

    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm209.sm209_7,
        sm210.sm210_7

    UNION ALL

    /* ================= CREDIT / DEBIT NOTES (SM213) ================= */
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_15        AS HSN,
        sm17.SM17_6           AS [Description],
        sm213_c.sm213_c8      AS UQC,
	
        SUM(sm213_c9)         AS [Total Quantity],
        SUM(sm213_c19)        AS [Total Value],

        sm210.sm210_7         AS [Rate],

        SUM(sm213_c14)        AS [Taxable Value],
        SUM(sm213_c18)        AS [Integrated Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c16)        AS [Central Tax Amount],
        SUM(sm213_c17)        AS [State/UT Tax Amount],
        SUM(ISNULL(sm213_c22,0)) AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM213_c
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5
    INNER JOIN SM17  ON SM17.UNQID = sm206.sm206_13
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15
    LEFT  JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
	INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM213.sm213_10

    WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                      AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
					  and sm19_23=''   AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR SM213_64 = @branch)
    GROUP BY
        sm206.sm206_15,
        sm17.SM17_6,
        sm213_c.sm213_c8,
        sm210.sm210_7
) A
GROUP BY
    HSN,
    [Description],
    UQC,
    [Rate]
ORDER BY
    HSN,
    [Rate];




	
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],

         0   AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE
        sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                     AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       CREDIT NOTES
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Credit Note' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + sm1018.sm1018_20) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + sm1018.sm1018_20) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],

                0   AS [Cancelled]


    FROM SM1018
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1018.sm1018_19

    WHERE
        sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                            AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1018.sm1018_19 = @branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       RCM – INWARD FROM UNREGISTERED
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for inward supply from unregistered person'
            AS [Nature of Document],

         MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
         0   AS [Cancelled]


    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41


    WHERE
        sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                     AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)
        -- unregistered party
        AND ISNULL(sm19.sm19_23,'') = ''

        -- RCM flag
       -- AND sm1011.sm1011_75 = 'RCM'

    GROUP BY sm1011.sm1011_41

    ORDER BY
        [Nature of Document],
        [Sr.No.From];


  end


  IF @aa = 'gridgstt'
BEGIN

SELECT *
FROM
(
    /* ================= SALES – SM1011 ================= */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],

        sm1002.sm1002_16 
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],

        sm1011.sm1011_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm1011.sm1011_35 AS [Invoice Value],

        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],

        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],

        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Rate],

        CASE 
            WHEN sm1011.sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales'
            THEN 0.00
            ELSE sm1011.sm1011_24
        END AS [Taxable Value],

        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm19   ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
    INNER JOIN sm205  ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24

    /* SAFE rate join */
    LEFT JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid =
        COALESCE(sm1011.sm1011_26, sm1011.sm1011_28, sm1011.sm1011_30)

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR SM1011_41 = @BRANCH)

    UNION ALL

    /* ================= CREDIT / DEBIT NOTES – SM213 ================= */
    SELECT  
        sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
        sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],

        sm1002.sm1002_16
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar), 4)
        + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar), 4)
        AS [Invoice Number],

        sm213.sm213_6 AS [Invoice Date],
        sm213.sm213_23 AS [Invoice Value],

        sm205.SM205_7 + '-' + sm19.SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
        'N' AS [Reverse Charge],

        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
        'Regular B2B' AS [Invoice Type],
        '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],

        sm210.sm210_7 AS [Rate],
        sm213.sm213_17 AS [Taxable Value],
        0.00 AS [Cess Amount]

    FROM sm213
    INNER JOIN sm213_c ON sm213_c.sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm19    ON sm19.unqid = sm213.sm213_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002  ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm213.sm213_64
    INNER JOIN sm205   ON sm205.SM205_5 = sm19.SM19_24

    LEFT JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c15

    WHERE sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                      AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@BRANCH = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ',')))
) X
ORDER BY [Invoice Date], [Invoice Number];


SELECT
    [Nature of Document],
    [Sr.No.From],
    [Sr.No.To],
    [Total Number],
    [Cancelled]
FROM
(
    /* ===============================
       OUTWARD INVOICES – SM1011
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1011.sm1011_41 = @branch)

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18
	  UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       CREDIT / DEBIT NOTES – SM213
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar) 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],

        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_8 AS varchar) 
            + CAST(sm213.sm213_9 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(DISTINCT sm213.unqid) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM sm213
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm213.sm213_64

    WHERE sm213.sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                            AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm213.sm213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch, ',')))

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       CREDIT NOTES – SM1018
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Credit Note' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + CAST(sm1018.sm1018_20 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + CAST(sm1018.sm1018_20 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1018
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1018.sm1018_19

    WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                              AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1018.sm1018_19 = @branch)

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

  

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       INWARD FROM UNREGISTERED (RCM)
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for inward supply from unregistered person'
            AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + CAST(sm1011.sm1011_7 AS varchar)) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
        0 AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm19    ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                       AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
      AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
           OR sm1011.sm1011_41 = @branch)
      AND ISNULL(sm19.sm19_23,'') = ''   -- unregistered

    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18
) D
ORDER BY
    [Nature of Document],
    [Sr.No.From];

END




  if @aa= 'gridgstnew'
  begin


--B2B,SEZ, DE
SELECT  
       --ISNULL(sm19_23,'')  AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
      sm19_23  AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
	       sm19_5 AS [Receiver Name],
    (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM1011_41)+ dbo.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0) AS [Invoice Number],
        FORMAT(sm1011_6, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') AS [Invoice Date],
		    sm1011_35  AS [Invoice Value],
    (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5 = SM19_24) + '-' + SM19_24 AS [Place Of Supply],
    'N' AS [Reverse Charge],
    '' AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],
	   'Regular B2B'  AS [Invoice Type],
    '' AS [E-Commerce GSTIN],
				(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm1011_26,sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS [Rate],
    CASE 
        WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' 
        THEN 0.00 
        ELSE sm1011_24 
    END 
        AS [Taxable Value],
    -- Cess Amount
    0.00 AS [Cess Amount]
FROM SM1011 
INNER JOIN sm206  ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13 
INNER JOIN sm19   ON sm19.unqid    = sm1011.sm1011_10 
INNER JOIN sm209  ON sm209.unqid   = sm1011.sm1011_23
INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) 
                   AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)

ORDER BY 
    sm1011_41,
    sm1011_6 ASC, 
    CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;



	--for gst unregistered partiesy
	SELECT SUM(SM1011_24) AS TAXABLE,
	SUM(SM1011_27) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(SM1011_29)AS CGSTAMT,SUM(SM1011_31)AS SGSTAMT,
	SUM(SM1011_29 + SM1011_31 + SM1011_27) AS TGSTAMT,
	sum(sm1011_35-sm1011_34) as total
	 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
	
	where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)  AND
	SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA) AND  SM19_23 = '' -- AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],



	SELECT  
    sm19.sm19_23 AS [GSTIN/UIN of Recipient],
    sm19.sm19_5  AS [Receiver Name],

    sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1018.sm1018_20 AS [Note Number],
    FORMAT(sm1018.sm1018_2, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') AS [Note Date],

    'C' AS [Note Type],   -- Credit Note

    (SELECT SM205_7 
     FROM SM205 
     WHERE SM205_5 = sm19.sm19_24) + '-' + sm19.sm19_24 
     AS [Place Of Supply],

    'N' AS [Reverse Charge],

    'Regular B2B' AS [Note Supply Type],

    sm1018.SM1018_18 AS [Note Value],

    (SELECT sm210_7 
     FROM sm210 
     WHERE unqid IN (sm1018.sm1018_12, sm1018.sm1018_13, sm1018.sm1018_14)) 
     AS [Applicable % of Tax Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_10 AS [Rate],

    sm1018.sm1018_11 AS [Taxable Value],

    0.00 AS [Cess Amount]

FROM sm1018
INNER JOIN sm19   ON sm1018.sm1018_6  = sm19.unqid
INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1018.sm1018_19 = sm1002.sm1002_5

WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                          AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1002.sm1002_5 = @branch)
AND sm1018.sm1018_24 IS NOT NULL   -- only valid credit notes

ORDER BY 
    sm1002.sm1002_7,
    sm1018.sm1018_2;



		SELECT
    sm206.sm206_15                        AS [HSN],          -- HSN / SAC
  sm17.SM17_6 AS [Description],  -- Item description
--CASE 
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('pcs','piece','pieces','pc') THEN 'PCS-PIECES'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('nos','no','number','numbers') THEN 'NOS-NUMBERS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('kg','kgs','kilogram','kilograms') THEN 'KGS-KILOGRAMS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('gm','gms','gram','grams') THEN 'GMS-GRAMS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('ltr','liter','litre','liters','litres') THEN 'LTR-LITRES'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('ml','mlt','millilitre','milliliter') THEN 'MLT-MILLILITRE'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('meter','mtr','mtrs') THEN 'MTR-METER'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('sqm','sq meter','square meter') THEN 'SQM'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('hour','hours','hr','hrs') THEN 'HRS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('day','days') THEN 'DAY'

--    -- Services or undefined
--    WHEN sm209.sm209_7= 'S' THEN 'OTH'   -- Service flag if you have it

--    ELSE 'OTH'
--END AS [UQC],
     sm209.sm209_7 as [UQC],
    SUM(sm1011_42)                       AS [Total Quantity],

    SUM(sm1011_35)                       AS [Total Value],  -- Invoice value

   -- CAST(sm1011_22 AS NUMERIC(5,2))      AS [Rate],
	 CAST((SELECT sm210_7 FROM sm210  WHERE unqid IN (sm1011_26, sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS 
	 [Rate],

    SUM(sm1011_24)                       AS [Taxable Value],

    SUM(sm1011_27)                       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],

    SUM(sm1011_29)                       AS [Central Tax Amount],

    SUM(sm1011_31)                       AS [State/UT Tax Amount],

    SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0))             AS [Cess Amount]

FROM SM1011
INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
INNER JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID =  sm206.sm206_13
INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
	--INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
WHERE
    sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
             AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
  AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)
    AND sm1011_24 > 0

GROUP BY
  sm17.SM17_6 ,  -- Item description
    sm209.sm209_7,
    sm206.sm206_15,
  --  CAST(sm1011_22 AS NUMERIC(5,2)),
	SM1011_26, SM1011_28, SM1011_30

ORDER BY
    [HSN],
    [Rate];


	
		SELECT
    sm206.sm206_15                        AS [HSN],          -- HSN / SAC
    sm17.SM17_6 AS [Description],  -- Item description

--CASE 
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('pcs','piece','pieces','pc') THEN 'PCS-PIECES'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('nos','no','number','numbers') THEN 'NOS-NUMBERS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('kg','kgs','kilogram','kilograms') THEN 'KGS-KILOGRAMS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('gm','gms','gram','grams') THEN 'GMS-GRAMS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('ltr','liter','litre','liters','litres') THEN 'LTR-LITRES'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('ml','mlt','millilitre','milliliter') THEN 'MLT-MILLILITRE'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('meter','mtr','mtrs') THEN 'MTR-METER'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('sqm','sq meter','square meter') THEN 'SQM'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('hour','hours','hr','hrs') THEN 'HRS'
--    WHEN LOWER(sm209.sm209_7) IN ('day','days') THEN 'DAY'

--    -- Services or undefined
--    WHEN sm209.sm209_7= 'S' THEN 'OTH'   -- Service flag if you have it

--    ELSE 'OTH'
--END AS [UQC],
sm209.sm209_7 as [UQC],
    SUM(sm1011_42)                       AS [Total Quantity],

    SUM(sm1011_35)                       AS [Total Value],  -- Invoice value

   -- CAST(sm1011_22 AS NUMERIC(5,2))      AS [Rate],
	 CAST((SELECT sm210_7 FROM sm210  WHERE unqid IN (sm1011_26, sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS 
	 [Rate],

    SUM(sm1011_24)                       AS [Taxable Value],

    SUM(sm1011_27)                       AS [Integrated Tax Amount],

    SUM(sm1011_29)                       AS [Central Tax Amount],

    SUM(sm1011_31)                       AS [State/UT Tax Amount],

    SUM(ISNULL(sm1011_33,0))             AS [Cess Amount]

FROM SM1011
INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
INNER JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID =  sm206.sm206_13
INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1011.SM1011_10 
WHERE
    sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
             AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)    AND sm1011_24 > 0
	AND SM19_23= ''

GROUP BY
  sm17.SM17_6 ,  -- Item description
    sm209.sm209_7,
    sm206.sm206_15,
    --CAST(sm1011_22 AS NUMERIC(5,2)),
	SM1011_26, SM1011_28, SM1011_30

ORDER BY
    [HSN],
    [Rate];





	
    SELECT
        'Invoices for outward supply' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],

         0   AS [Cancelled]

    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41

    WHERE
        sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                     AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       CREDIT NOTES
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Credit Note' AS [Nature of Document],

        MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + sm1018.sm1018_20) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + 'CN/' + sm1018.sm1018_20) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],

                0   AS [Cancelled]


    FROM SM1018
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1018.sm1018_19

    WHERE
        sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                            AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1018.sm1018_19 = @branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_18

    UNION ALL

    /* ===============================
       RCM – INWARD FROM UNREGISTERED
       =============================== */
    SELECT
        'Invoices for inward supply from unregistered person'
            AS [Nature of Document],

         MIN(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.From],
        MAX(sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1011.sm1011_7) AS [Sr.No.To],

        COUNT(*) AS [Total Number],
         0   AS [Cancelled]


    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41


    WHERE
        sm1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE)
                     AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
AND  (@branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or SM1011_41 = @branch)
        -- unregistered party
        AND ISNULL(sm19.sm19_23,'') = ''

        -- RCM flag
       -- AND sm1011.sm1011_75 = 'RCM'

    GROUP BY sm1011.sm1011_41

    ORDER BY
        [Nature of Document],
        [Sr.No.From];


  end

 end
GO

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

create procedure [dbo].[A_RPT_SALES_REGISTER_new]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',

@PRODUCT                 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@prod                   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@CUSTNAME               NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@ACCOUNT                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@uid        nvarchar(50)  =''
AS
Begin 


	
IF @AA = 'GETALL'
BEGIN 
---------------------------------For Branch
declare @branch1 as nvarchar(max);
    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid)

	print @branch1;
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname from SM1002 

	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch1,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7;

	

--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
--	 UNION ALL 
--	  	SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
--		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;

---------------------------------------FOR GRID
 SELECT * FROM (
          --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
          --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
			--, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @BRANCH  +'%' 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
        ) AS AA
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;
--------------------------------------FOR CATEGORY

	   -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN

		  DECLARE @CUSTTYPE NVARCHAR(MAX)
        SET @CUSTTYPE= (SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63_13 WHERE SM63_5=@uid)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN  (select data from dbo.split  (@CUSTTYPE,',')) AND SM44_12='CUST'
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

-----------------------------------------For Product
select sm206_2 as UNQID, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by Dname;

-----------------------------------------For Product Category 

        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;

end

  



IF @AA = 'GETPRO'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
        --    UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))  
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;

     
    END

IF @AA = 'GETACC'
    BEGIN

	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
		
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' AND 
			SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@ACCOUNT,',')) 
			and SM19_63  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
    
        ORDER BY Dname ;
     
    END

IF @AA = 'DATA'
BEGIN
--  ALL PRODUCTS WITH ALL CUSTOMERS VALUES
	if(@prod = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @CUSTNAME = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	begin
	 
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;


		SELECT (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM1011_41)+ DBO.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0)  AS [Invoice No],FORMAT(sm1011_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],SM206_15 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],SM1011_42 AS PRODNETQTY, SM1011_42 AS PRODQTY,
		sm209_7 as Unit,sm1011_22 AS RATE,SM1011_37 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_26 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm1011_26,sm1011_28, sm1011_30)) AS [GSTPER]
		,sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 ELSE  sm1011_24 END AS [Taxable Amount],
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		sm1011_34 as [ROFF],
		sm1011_35 as [TOTAL],
	   CASE WHEN  SM1011_62  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))-SM1011_37  
	   END AS [CRAMT],sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT], sm1011_74 as SALETYPE FROM SM1011 
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41
	   where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	 -- ORDER BY 
		--sm1011_6 ASC, 
		--CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC

	union all
		SELECT 
		(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = sm213_64)+ DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) AS [Invoice No],
		FORMAT(SM213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, 
		isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],
		sm213_c9 AS PRODNETQTY,
		sm213_c9 AS PRODQTY,
		sm213_c8 as Unit,
		sm213_c10 AS RATE,
		0 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, 
		CAST(sm213_c9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN SM213_14 <> 'IGST' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm213_c15)) AS [GSTPER],

		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		sm1011_34 as [ROFF],
		sm1011_35 as [TOTAL],
	   CASE WHEN  SM1011_62  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM1011_42*cast(sm1011_22 as numeric(18,2))-SM1011_37  
	   END AS [CRAMT],

		sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT], sm1011_74 as SALETYPE
		FROM SM1011 
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41
	   where
	SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) 
	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	And SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	 -- ORDER BY 
		--sm1011_6 ASC, 
		--CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
			union all
		SELECT 
		(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = sm213_64)+ DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) AS [Invoice No],
		FORMAT(SM213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, 
		isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],
		sm213_c9 AS PRODNETQTY,
		sm213_c9 AS PRODQTY,
		sm213_c8 as Unit,
		sm213_c10 AS RATE,
		0 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, 
		CAST(sm213_c9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN SM213_14 <> 'IGST' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid in (sm213_c15)) AS [GSTPER],
		sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		sm213_c14  AS [Taxable Amount],
		0.00   AS [Taxable Amount BT],
		SM213_22 as [ROFF],
		SM213_21 as [TOTAL],
	   (sm213_c9*cast(sm213_c10 as numeric(18,2))) AS [CRAMT],
	   SM213_20 as [IGST]
	   ,SM213_18 as [CGST],
	   SM213_19 as [SGST], 
	   SM213_23 as [NETAMT] ,
	  'SALES' as SALETYPE
	   FROM SM213 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=SM213.SM213_10  
		inner join SM213_c on SM213_c.SM213_c4 =SM213.unqid
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5 
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=SM213.SM213_64
where
SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
And SM213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) 
	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ',')) 
and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	 ORDER BY 
		[Invoice Date] ASC, 
		[Invoice No] ASC;

		SELECT

		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		sm209_7 AS UNIT,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS QTY,
		SUM(SM1011_42) AS PRODQTY,

		sum(sm1011_29) AS [CGST],

	FROM  SM1011 INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13

	INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10

	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm209_7 
--order by sm206_7 asc;
union all
	SELECT 
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,

		SUM(sm213_c9) AS QTY,

    inner join SM213_c on SM213_c.SM213_c4 =SM213.unqid
    inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5

	where sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)

	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	GROUP BY SM213_c6, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)

	and sm1011_26<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and SM19_23<>(SELECT PA_17 FROM PA)

		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5

	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and  SM213_c15 <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and  SM213_c15 ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
And SM213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))  AND

		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 ELSE  sm1011_24 END AS [Taxable Amount],
		CASE WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN sm1011_24 ELSE 0.00  END AS [BRANCH],

	sm1011_27 as [IGST],sm1011_29 as [CGST],sm1011_31 as [SGST],sm1011_34 as [ROFF], sm1011_35 as [NETAMT]
    FROM SM1011 
	inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 
	inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_10 
	inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23
	inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=sm1011.sm1011_41

    where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) And SM1011_41 = @BRANCH
 --   ORDER BY 
	--sm1011_41,
 --   sm1011_6 ASC, 
 --   CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
  union all
		SELECT 
		(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = sm213_64)+ DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) AS [Invoice No],
		FORMAT(SM213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy')as [Invoice Date],
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,
		sm19_5 as Name, 
		isnull((sm19_23),'') as GSTIN,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205_5=SM19_24)AS STATECODE,
		SM19_24 AS [STATE],
		sm213_c9 AS PRODNETQTY,
	
		sm213_c8 as Unit,
		sm213_c10 AS RATE,
		0 AS FREIGHTAMOUNT,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME, 
		CAST(sm213_c9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN SM213_14 <> 'IGST' THEN '18.00%' ELSE '9.00%'END AS [GST],
		  (sm213_c9*cast(sm213_c10 as numeric(18,2))) AS [CRAMT],
	
		sm213_c14  AS [Taxable Amount],
			--sm1002_7 as BRANCH,
		0.00   AS BRANCH, --------------------CHECK agin 
			   SM213_20 as [IGST]
	   ,SM213_18 as [CGST],
	   SM213_19 as [SGST], 
		SM213_22 as [ROFF],
    SM213_23 as [NETAMT] 
	 

	   FROM SM213 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=SM213.SM213_10  
		inner join SM213_c on SM213_c.SM213_c4 =SM213.unqid
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5 
		inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=SM213.SM213_64
where
SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)   And sm213_64 = @BRANCH

	 ORDER BY 
		[Invoice Date] ASC, 
		[Invoice No] ASC;







END

IF @AA = 'GRID2'
BEGIN
         SELECT 
    SM206_15 AS HSN,
	sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
    sm209_7 AS UNIT,
    SUM(SM1011_20) AS QTY,
    SUM(SM1011_42) AS PRODQTY,
    sum(sm1011_24) AS [TAMT],
    sum(sm1011_27) AS [IGST],
    sum(sm1011_29) AS [CGST],
    sum(sm1011_31) AS [SGST],
    sum(sm1011_35) AS [NETAMT]
FROM  SM1011 INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)  And SM1011_41 = @BRANCH
GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm209_7
---order by sm206_7 asc;
union all 
	
	SELECT 
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		sm213_c8 AS UNIT,
		SUM(sm213_c9) AS QTY,
		SUM(sm213_c9) AS PRODQTY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMT],
		sum(SM213_20) AS [IGST],
		sum(SM213_18) AS [CGST],
		sum(SM213_19) AS [SGST],
		sum(SM213_23) AS [NETAMT]
	FROM  sm213 
	inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=SM213.SM213_10  
    inner join SM213_c on SM213_c.SM213_c4 =SM213.unqid
    inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5 
    inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=SM213.SM213_64
	where sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 = @BRANCH
	GROUP BY SM213_c6, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;
END

IF @AA = 'GRID4'
BEGIN
         SELECT 
    SM206_15 AS HSN,
	sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
    sm209_7 AS UNIT,
    SUM(SM1011_20) AS QTY,
    SUM(SM1011_42) AS PRODQTY,
    sum(sm1011_24) AS [TAMT],
    sum(sm1011_27) AS [IGST],
    sum(sm1011_29) AS [CGST],
    sum(sm1011_31) AS [SGST],
    sum(sm1011_35) AS [NETAMT]
FROM  SM1011 INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
where SM1011_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm209_7 
--order by sm206_7 asc;
union all 
	
	SELECT 
		SM213_c6 AS HSN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		sm213_c8 AS UNIT,
		SUM(sm213_c9) AS QTY,
		SUM(sm213_c9) AS PRODQTY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMT],
		sum(SM213_20) AS [IGST],
		sum(SM213_18) AS [CGST],
		sum(SM213_19) AS [SGST],
		sum(SM213_23) AS [NETAMT]
	FROM  sm213 
	inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=SM213.SM213_10  
    inner join SM213_c on SM213_c.SM213_c4 =SM213.unqid
    inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=SM213_c.SM213_c5 
    inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5=SM213.SM213_64
	where sm213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	
	GROUP BY SM213_c6, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;
END

IF @AA = 'GETBRANCH'
    BEGIN

	if @BRANCH ='All' 
	begin 
	 SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC 
		end 
		else 
	 begin 
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT sm1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH 
        FROM SM1002 where sm1002_5= @BRANCH
        ORDER BY sm1002_5 ASC;
		end
     
    END

IF @AA = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
    AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;
END
 
 
 
 end

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
