CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_RPT_SALES_REGISTER_SW]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',

@PRODUCT                 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@prod                   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@CUSTNAME               NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@ACCOUNT                NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@uid        nvarchar(50)  =''
AS
begin
IF @AA = 'GETALL'
BEGIN 
---------------------------------For Branch
declare @branch1 as nvarchar(max);
    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid)

	print @branch1;
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname from SM1002 

	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch1,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7;

	

--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
--	 UNION ALL 
--	  	SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
--		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;

---------------------------------------FOR GRID
 SELECT * FROM (
          --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
          --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
			--, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @BRANCH  +'%' 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
        ) AS AA
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;
--------------------------------------FOR CATEGORY

	   -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN

		  DECLARE @CUSTTYPE NVARCHAR(MAX)
        SET @CUSTTYPE= (SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63_13 WHERE SM63_5=@uid)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN  (select data from dbo.split  (@CUSTTYPE,',')) AND SM44_12='CUST'
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

-----------------------------------------For Product
select sm206_2 as UNQID, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by Dname;

-----------------------------------------For Product Category 

        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;

end

  



IF @AA = 'GETPRO'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
        --    UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))  
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;

     
    END

IF @AA = 'GETACC'
    BEGIN

	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
		
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' AND 
			SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@ACCOUNT,',')) 
			and SM19_63  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
    
        ORDER BY Dname ;
     
    END

if @AA = 'Data'
begin
if(@prod = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @CUSTNAME = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	begin
	 
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

	SELECT 
		sm213_8 + sm213_9 AS INVOICENO,
		FORMAT(sm213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS INVOICEDATE,
		sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
		isnull((sm19_23),'') AS GSTIN,
		sm205_7 AS STATECODE,
		sm19_24 AS STATENAME,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c9), '') AS QTY,
		sm213_c8 as UNIT,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c10), '') AS RATE,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE 0.00
	    END AS CARTAGEAMT,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM213_15 + cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM213_15 
	    END AS AMOUNT,
		(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SM210_7), '') FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = sm213_c15) AS GST,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c13), '') AS DISCAMT,
		sm213_17 AS TAXABLEAMT,
		sm213_20 AS IGST,
		sm213_18 AS CGST,
		sm213_19 AS SGST,
		sm213_22 AS ROUNDOFF,
		sm213_23 AS NETAMT

	FROM sm213
	LEFT JOIN sm213_c ON sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm213_10
	LEFT JOIN sm205 ON SM205_5=SM19_24
	LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2=SM213_C5
	where
	SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	  
	GROUP BY 
		sm213.unqid,
		sm213_8, sm213_9, sm213_6, sm19_5, sm19_23, sm205_7, sm19_24, sm213_c8, sm213_c15, sm213_22, 
		sm213_23, sm213_69, SM213_70, sm213_20, sm213_18, sm213_19, sm213_17, SM213_15
	ORDER BY 
		sm213_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm213_9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
	
	
SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSNN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAMEE,
		sm213_c8 AS UNITT,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS QTYY,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS PRODQTYY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMTT],
		sum(sm213_c18) AS [IGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c16) AS [CGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c17) AS [SGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c19) AS [NETAMTT]
	FROM  SM213_c INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5 left join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM213.SM213_10
	where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	  
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)

		SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXGRP
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where 
			SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
			and sm19_23 <> '' or sm19_23 <> NULL
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
		) t;
	
	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
	SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXURP
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where 
			SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
			and sm19_23 = '' or sm19_23 = NULL
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
		) t;


		------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT
		SELECT SUM(t.TAXABLEE) AS TAXABLEE, SUM(t.IGSTAMOUNT) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(t.CGSTAMT) AS CGSTAMT,SUM(t.SGSTAMT) AS SGSTAMT,SUM(t.TGSTAMT) AS TGSTAMT,SUM(t.TOTAL) AS TOTAL
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLEE,
				SM213.SM213_20 AS IGSTAMOUNT,
				SM213.SM213_18 AS CGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_19 AS SGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_18 + SM213.SM213_19 + SM213.SM213_20 AS TGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS TOTAL
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))	and SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL      -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, SM213_17, SM213_20, SM213_18, SM213_19, SM213_20, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;


		-----igst sales
			SELECT 
			SUM(t.TAXABLE) AS taxable,
			SUM(t.TOTALAMT) AS totalamt
			FROM (
				SELECT 
					SM213.UNQID,
					SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLE,
					SM213.SM213_23 AS TOTALAMT
				FROM SM213
				LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
				LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
				LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
				where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
				And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))	and 
				SM213_20 <> 0.00
				AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)   -- proper null check
				GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_23
			) t;


		-------cgst+sgst sales
		SELECT 
		SUM(t.taxable1) AS taxable1,
		SUM(t.totalamt1) AS totalamt1
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS taxable1,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS totalamt1
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
			  AND SM213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
			  AND SM213_20 = 0.00
			  AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)  -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;
	end

	--  SELECTED PRODUCT WITH ALL CUSTOMERS VALUES
	else if(@prod != '' and @CUSTNAME = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	begin
	     SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

		SELECT 
		sm213_8 + sm213_9 AS INVOICENO,
		FORMAT(sm213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS INVOICEDATE,
		sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
		isnull((sm19_23),'') AS GSTIN,
		sm205_7 AS STATECODE,
		sm19_24 AS STATENAME,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c9), '') AS QTY,
		sm213_c8 as UNIT,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c10), '') AS RATE,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE 0 
	    END AS CARTAGEAMT,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM213_15 + cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM213_15 
	    END AS AMOUNT,
		(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SM210_7), '') FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = sm213_c15) AS GST,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c13), '') AS DISCAMT,
		sm213_17 AS TAXABLEAMT,
		sm213_20 AS IGST,
		sm213_18 AS CGST,
		sm213_19 AS SGST,
		sm213_22 AS ROUNDOFF,
		sm213_23 AS NETAMT

	FROM sm213
	LEFT JOIN sm213_c ON sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm213_10
	LEFT JOIN sm205 ON SM205_5=SM19_24
	LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2=SM213_C5
	where
	SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	 and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	  
	GROUP BY 
		sm213.unqid,
		sm213_8, sm213_9, sm213_6, sm19_5, sm19_23, sm205_7, sm19_24, sm213_c8, sm213_c15, sm213_22, 
		sm213_23, sm213_69, SM213_70, sm213_20, sm213_18, sm213_19, sm213_17, SM213_15
	ORDER BY 
		sm213_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm213_9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
	
	
		SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSNN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAMEE,
		sm213_c8 AS UNITT,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS QTYY,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS PRODQTYY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMTT],
		sum(sm213_c18) AS [IGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c16) AS [CGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c17) AS [SGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c19) AS [NETAMTT]
	FROM  SM213_c INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5 left join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
	where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)
			SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXGRP
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where 
			SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
			and sm19_23 <> '' or sm19_23 <> NULL
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
		) t;

	
	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
	SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXURP
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			SM213.UNQID,
			SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
		FROM SM213
		LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
		LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
		LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
		where 
		SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
		And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))	and 
		sm19_23 = '' or sm19_23 = NULL
		GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
	) t;


		------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT
	SELECT SUM(t.TAXABLEE) AS TAXABLEE, SUM(t.IGSTAMOUNT) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(t.CGSTAMT) AS CGSTAMT,SUM(t.SGSTAMT) AS SGSTAMT,SUM(t.TGSTAMT) AS TGSTAMT,SUM(t.TOTAL) AS TOTAL
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLEE,
				SM213.SM213_20 AS IGSTAMOUNT,
				SM213.SM213_18 AS CGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_19 AS SGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_18 + SM213.SM213_19 + SM213.SM213_20 AS TGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS TOTAL
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))	and 
			SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL      -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, SM213_17, SM213_20, SM213_18, SM213_19, SM213_20, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;


		-----igst sales
		SELECT 
			SUM(t.TAXABLE) AS taxable,
			SUM(t.TOTALAMT) AS totalamt
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLE,
				SM213.SM213_23 AS TOTALAMT
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))	and 
			SM213_20 <> 0.00
			AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)   -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_23
		) t;


		-------cgst+sgst sales
		SELECT 
		SUM(t.taxable1) AS taxable1,
		SUM(t.totalamt1) AS totalamt1
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS taxable1,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS totalamt1
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))	and  SM213_20 = 0.00
			AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)  -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;
	end

	--  ALL PRODUCTS WITH SELECT CUSTOMER VALUES
	else if(@prod = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and @CUSTNAME != '')
	begin
	     SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

		SELECT 
		sm213_8 + sm213_9 AS INVOICENO,
		FORMAT(sm213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS INVOICEDATE,
		sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
		isnull((sm19_23),'') AS GSTIN,
		sm205_7 AS STATECODE,
		sm19_24 AS STATENAME,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c9), '') AS QTY,
		sm213_c8 as UNIT,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c10), '') AS RATE,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE 0
	    END AS CARTAGEAMT,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM213_15 + cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM213_15 
	    END AS AMOUNT,
		(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SM210_7), '') FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = sm213_c15) AS GST,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c13), '') AS DISCAMT,
		sm213_17 AS TAXABLEAMT,
		sm213_20 AS IGST,
		sm213_18 AS CGST,
		sm213_19 AS SGST,
		sm213_22 AS ROUNDOFF,
		sm213_23 AS NETAMT

	FROM sm213
	LEFT JOIN sm213_c ON sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm213_10
	LEFT JOIN sm205 ON SM205_5=SM19_24
	LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2=SM213_C5
	where
	SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	  and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	GROUP BY 
		sm213.unqid,
		sm213_8, sm213_9, sm213_6, sm19_5, sm19_23, sm205_7, sm19_24, sm213_c8, sm213_c15, sm213_22, 
		sm213_23, sm213_69, SM213_70, sm213_20, sm213_18, sm213_19, sm213_17, SM213_15
	ORDER BY 
		sm213_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm213_9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
	
	
		SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSNN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAMEE,
		sm213_c8 AS UNITT,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS QTYY,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS PRODQTYY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMTT],
		sum(sm213_c18) AS [IGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c16) AS [CGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c17) AS [SGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c19) AS [NETAMTT]
	FROM  SM213_c INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5 left join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213_10
	where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	  and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)
		SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXGRP
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where 
			SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
			and sm19_23 <> '' or sm19_23 <> NULL
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
		) t;

	
	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
		SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXURP
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			SM213.UNQID,
			SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
		FROM SM213
		LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
		LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
		LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
		where 
		SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
		And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and 
		sm19_23 = '' or sm19_23 = NULL
		GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
	) t;


		------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT
		SELECT SUM(t.TAXABLEE) AS TAXABLEE, SUM(t.IGSTAMOUNT) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(t.CGSTAMT) AS CGSTAMT,SUM(t.SGSTAMT) AS SGSTAMT,SUM(t.TGSTAMT) AS TGSTAMT,SUM(t.TOTAL) AS TOTAL
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLEE,
				SM213.SM213_20 AS IGSTAMOUNT,
				SM213.SM213_18 AS CGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_19 AS SGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_18 + SM213.SM213_19 + SM213.SM213_20 AS TGSTAMT,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS TOTAL
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and 
			SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL      -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, SM213_17, SM213_20, SM213_18, SM213_19, SM213_20, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;


		-----igst sales
		SELECT 
			SUM(t.TAXABLE) AS taxable,
			SUM(t.TOTALAMT) AS totalamt
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLE,
				SM213.SM213_23 AS TOTALAMT
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
			AND sm213_20<>0.00 and (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)   -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_23
		) t;

		-------cgst+sgst sales
		SELECT 
		SUM(t.taxable1) AS taxable1,
		SUM(t.totalamt1) AS totalamt1
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS taxable1,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS totalamt1
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and   SM213_20 = 0.00
			AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)  -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;
	END

	--  SELECTED PRODUCTS WITH SELECTED CUSTOMERS VALUES
    ELSE if(@prod != '' AND @CUSTNAME != '')
	begin
	     SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

		SELECT 
		sm213_8 + sm213_9 AS INVOICENO,
		FORMAT(sm213_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS INVOICEDATE,
		sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
		isnull((sm19_23),'') AS GSTIN,
		sm205_7 AS STATECODE,
		sm19_24 AS STATENAME,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c9), '') AS QTY,
		sm213_c8 as UNIT,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c10), '') AS RATE,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE 0 
	    END AS CARTAGEAMT,
		CASE WHEN  SM213_70  = 'FALSE' THEN (SM213_15 + cast(sm213_69 as numeric(18,2))) ELSE SM213_15 
	    END AS AMOUNT,
		(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SM210_7), '') FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = sm213_c15) AS GST,
		COALESCE(SUM(sm213_c13), '') AS DISCAMT,
		sm213_17 AS TAXABLEAMT,
		sm213_20 AS IGST,
		sm213_18 AS CGST,
		sm213_19 AS SGST,
		sm213_22 AS ROUNDOFF,
		sm213_23 AS NETAMT

	FROM sm213
	LEFT JOIN sm213_c ON sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid
	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm213_10
	LEFT JOIN sm205 ON SM205_5=SM19_24
	LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2=SM213_C5
	where
	SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	 and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	  
	GROUP BY 
		sm213.unqid,
		sm213_8, sm213_9, sm213_6, sm19_5, sm19_23, sm205_7, sm19_24, sm213_c8, sm213_c15, sm213_22, 
		sm213_23, sm213_69, SM213_70, sm213_20, sm213_18, sm213_19, sm213_17, SM213_15
	ORDER BY 
		sm213_6 ASC, 
		CAST(sm213_9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;
	
	
		SELECT 
		SM206_15 AS HSNN,
		sm206_7 AS PRODNAMEE,
		sm213_c8 AS UNITT,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS QTYY,
		SUM(SM213_c9) AS PRODQTYY,
		sum(sm213_c14) AS [TAMTT],
		sum(sm213_c18) AS [IGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c16) AS [CGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c17) AS [SGSTT],
		sum(sm213_c19) AS [NETAMTT]
	FROM  SM213_c INNER JOIN  sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5 left join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
	where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
	And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))------------- = @BRANCH
	and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,','))
	and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
	GROUP BY SM206_15, sm206_7, sm213_c8 order by sm206_7 asc;



	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF GST REGISTERED PARTIES(OTHER THAN BRANCH TRANSER)
			SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXGRP
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where 
			SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))
			and sm19_23 <> '' or sm19_23 <> NULL
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
		) t;

	
	-----------TAXABLE AMOUNT OF  UNREGISTERED PARTIES
			SELECT SUM(t.TXGRP) AS TXURP
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			SM213.UNQID,
			SM213.SM213_17 AS TXGRP
		FROM SM213
		LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
		LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
		LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
		where 
		SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
		And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and 
		sm19_23 = '' or sm19_23 = NULL
		GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17
	) t;


		------TAXABLE AMOUNT AND TOTAL AMOUNT
		SELECT SUM(t.TAXABLEE) AS TAXABLEE, SUM(t.IGSTAMOUNT) AS IGSTAMOUNT,SUM(t.CGSTAMT) AS CGSTAMT,SUM(t.SGSTAMT) AS SGSTAMT,SUM(t.TGSTAMT) AS TGSTAMT,SUM(t.TOTAL) AS TOTAL
		FROM (
			SELECT SM213.UNQID, SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLEE, SM213.SM213_20 AS IGSTAMOUNT, SM213.SM213_18 AS CGSTAMT, SM213.SM213_19 AS SGSTAMT,	SM213.SM213_18 + SM213.SM213_19 + SM213.SM213_20 AS TGSTAMT, SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS TOTAL
			FROM SM213 LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10 LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5 where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and
			SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL      -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, SM213_17, SM213_20, SM213_18, SM213_19, SM213_20, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;


		-----igst sales
		SELECT 
			SUM(t.TAXABLE) AS taxable,
			SUM(t.TOTALAMT) AS totalamt
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS TAXABLE,
				SM213.SM213_23 AS TOTALAMT
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
			  AND SM213_64 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
			  AND SM206.SM206_2 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@prod, ','))
			  AND SM19.UNQID IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ',')) AND 
			  SM213_20 <> 0.00
			  AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)   -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_23
		) t;

		-------cgst+sgst sales
		SELECT 
		SUM(t.taxable1) AS taxable1,
		SUM(t.totalamt1) AS totalamt1
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				SM213.UNQID,
				SM213.SM213_17 AS taxable1,
				SM213.SM213_23 - SM213.SM213_22 AS totalamt1
			FROM SM213
			LEFT JOIN SM213_C ON SM213_C4 = SM213.UNQID
			LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10
			LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM213_C5
			where SM213_6 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE) 
			And sm213_64 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,',')) and sm206.sm206_2 in (select data from dbo.split(@prod ,',')) and sm19.unqid in (select data from dbo.split(@CUSTNAME, ','))	and   SM213_20 = 0.00
			AND (SM19_23 <> '' AND SM19_23 IS NOT NULL)  -- proper null check
			GROUP BY SM213.UNQID, sm213_17, sm213_22, sm213_23
		) t;
	end

end
end

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_RPT_SW_PURCHASE_REGISTER]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@unqid               NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCT   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@uid        nvarchar(50) =''

	
AS

begin 
	
	IF @AA = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN

	    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH, 1 as ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7
END

	IF @AA = 'DATA'
    BEGIN

	--TABLE 0
	
	   if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;

	   --end;
		

        -- TABLE 1:

--select sm206_7 as Product, sm227_25 as [GRNO],sm227_7 as [Invoice No],FORMAT(SM227_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') as [Inv Date],sm19_5 as [Supplier Name],
--SUBSTRING((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32)),  CHARINDEX(',', (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = 
--(SELECT sm1002_15  FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32))) + 2,  LEN((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19  WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32)))
--) AS [Destination],sm227_c6 as [Quantity],sm227_c5 as Unit,
--isnull((select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid=sm227_8),'') as GSTIN,
--SM206_15 AS HSN,sm227_c12 as [Taxable Amount],
--sm210_7 as GST,
--sm227_c29 as IGSTAMT,
--SM227_C14 as CGSTAMT , 
--SM227_C16 as SGSTAMT,
--sm227_c19 as TAMT
--from sm227
--inner join sm227_c on sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid
--inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm227_c4
--inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm227_8
----inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54
--left join sm210 on sm210.unqid=sm227_c.sm227_c26
--WHERE SM227_25 IS NOT NULL
--AND sm227_6 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) and  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
----AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_21 = @Branch)
--AND sm227_32 in(select data from dbo.split(@Branch,','))
--ORDER BY CAST(sm227_25 AS NUMERIC(18,0))ASC



SELECT 
    sm206_7 AS Product, 
    sm227_25 AS [GRNO],
    sm227_7 AS [Invoice No],
    FORMAT(SM227_6,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [Inv Date],
    sm19_5 AS [Supplier Name],
    SUBSTRING(
        (SELECT sm19_5 
         FROM sm19 
         WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32)),  
         CHARINDEX(',', (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = 
             (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32))) + 2,  
         LEN((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19  
              WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm227_32)))
    ) AS [Destination],
    agg.TotalQty AS [Quantity],
    agg.Unit AS [Unit],
    ISNULL((SELECT sm19_23 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm227_8),'') AS GSTIN,
    SM206_15 AS HSN,
    agg.TotalTaxable AS [Taxable Amount],
    sm210_7 AS GST,
    agg.TotalIGST AS IGSTAMT,
    agg.TotalCGST AS CGSTAMT,
    agg.TotalSGST AS SGSTAMT,
    agg.TotalAmt AS TAMT
FROM sm227
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sm227_c3, 
        MAX(sm227_c5) AS Unit,
        SUM(sm227_c6) AS TotalQty,
        SUM(sm227_c12) AS TotalTaxable,
        SUM(sm227_c29) AS TotalIGST,
        SUM(sm227_c14) AS TotalCGST,
        SUM(sm227_c16) AS TotalSGST,
        SUM(sm227_c19) AS TotalAmt
    FROM sm227_c
    GROUP BY sm227_c3
) agg ON agg.sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = (
    SELECT TOP 1 sm227_c4 FROM sm227_c WHERE sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid
)
INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm227_8
LEFT JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = (
    SELECT TOP 1 sm227_c26 FROM sm227_c WHERE sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid
)
WHERE SM227_25 IS NOT NULL
AND sm227_6 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) and  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
AND sm227_32 in(select data from dbo.split(@Branch,','))
ORDER BY CAST(sm227_25 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC;



        -- TABLE 2:

		SELECT 
 --   (SELECT TOP 1 SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 IN (SELECT SM1005_7 FROM SM1005)) AS BRANCH_TRANSFER,
	--(select sm210_6 from sm210 where sm210.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_32) as descrp,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    sm206.SM206_15 AS HSN,
    sm227_c5 AS Unit,
	SUM(sm227_c6) AS TQTY,
    -- If IGSTAMT, CGSTAMT, and SGSTAMT are all zero, show 0 in Qty; otherwise, show the sum of Qty
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sm227_c14) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c16) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c29) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(sm227_c6)
    END AS [QTY],
    SUM(sm227_c29) AS IGSTAMT1,
    SUM(sm227_c14) AS CGSTAMT1,
    SUM(sm227_c16) AS SGSTAMT1,
	CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sm227_c14) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c16) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c29) = 0 THEN SUM(sm227_c18)
        ELSE 0
    END AS TAMT,
	--SUM(sm1005.sm1005_36) AS TAMT,
	SUM(sm227_c12) AS TAXABLEAMT,
	
    -- If IGSTAMT, CGSTAMT, and SGSTAMT are all zero, show the Qty in BranchTransferQty
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sm227_c14) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c16) = 0 AND SUM(sm227_c29) = 0 THEN SUM(sm227_c6)
        ELSE 0
    END AS BTQTY
FROM sm227_c
inner join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm227_c4
WHERE SM227_25 IS NOT NULL
AND sm227_6 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) and  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
AND sm227_32 in(select data from dbo.split(@Branch,','))
GROUP BY sm206.sm206_7, sm206.SM206_15, sm227_c5




SELECT   
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm227_c29 != 0  AND sm227_c14 = 0 AND sm227_c16 = 0 THEN sm227_c12
        ELSE 0
    END) AS IGSTTAXABLEAMT,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm227_c16 != 0 THEN sm227_c12/2
        ELSE 0
    END) AS CGSTTAXABLEAMT,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm227_c14 != 0 THEN sm227_c12/2
        ELSE 0
    END) AS SGSTTAXABLEAMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm227_c29), 0) AS IGSTAMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm227_c14), 0) AS CGSTAMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm227_c16), 0) AS SGSTAMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm227_c12), 0) AS TTTAMT,

    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm227_c14 = 0 AND sm227_c16 = 0 AND sm227_c29 = 0 THEN sm227_c12
        ELSE 0
    END) AS BTAX,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN sm227_c14 = 0 AND sm227_c16 = 0 AND sm227_c29 = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE sm227_c12
        END) AS TWBT,
    SUM(sm227_c12) AS TTAX,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN sm227_c14 = 0 AND sm227_c16 = 0 AND sm227_c29 = 0 THEN sm227_c12
            ELSE 0
        END) AS BTAX,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN sm227_c14 = 0 AND sm227_c16 = 0 AND sm227_c29 = 0 THEN (sm227_c14 + sm227_c16 + sm227_c29)
            ELSE 0
        END) AS BTGSTAMT,
    SUM(sm227_c14 + sm227_c16 + sm227_c29) AS TGSTAMT,
		(select sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=sm210.sm210_9) AS SGST_AC,
        (select sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=sm210.sm210_13) AS CGST_AC,
        (select sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=sm210.sm210_17) AS IGST_AC
FROM sm227_c
inner join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
inner join sm210 ON sm210.unqid=sm227_c26
WHERE sm227_25 IS NOT NULL
AND sm227_32 in(select data from dbo.split(@Branch,','))
AND sm227_6 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) and  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
group by sm210.sm210_9,sm210.sm210_13,sm210.sm210_17;



    END
    END




GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_contribution]
	
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdatee    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@todatee   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(max) = '',
@branchunq as nvarchar(max) = '',
@BRANCH_STOCK       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
AS
BEGIN

if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN






DECLARE @FromDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdatee, 103);
DECLARE @ToDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @todatee, 103);



DECLARE @columns NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX);


-- Temporary table to hold sales data with initial cost
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SalesDataWithCost') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SalesDataWithCost;
SELECT
    t.unqid,
    sm206_7 AS PRODUCT_NAME,
    CAST(sm1011_6 AS DATE) AS INVDATE,
    CAST(sm1011_42 / 1000.00 AS NUMERIC(18, 3)) AS SELLQTY,
    sm1011_19 * 1000.00 AS SELLINGRATE,
    CAST(0.00 AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS cost, -- Initial cost
    sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
    sm1011_13 AS PRODUCT_UNQ
INTO #SalesDataWithCost
FROM sm1011 t
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206_2 = t.sm1011_13
WHERE t.sm1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
  AND t.sm1011_41 = @Branchid;

-- Cursor variables
DECLARE @PRODUCTUNQ UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
DECLARE @unqid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @salesqty NUMERIC(18, 3);
DECLARE @recieptDATE DATE, @RECEIPTQTY NUMERIC(18, 3), @STOCKCOST NUMERIC(18, 3);
DECLARE @tqty NUMERIC(18, 3);

-- Cursor to loop products
DECLARE PRODUCT_cursor CURSOR FOR
    SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_UNQ FROM #SalesDataWithCost;

OPEN PRODUCT_cursor;
FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO @PRODUCTUNQ;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

    -- Cursor to loop sales for current product
    DECLARE sales_cursor CURSOR FOR
    SELECT
        s.unqid,
        s.SELLQTY
    FROM #SalesDataWithCost s
    WHERE s.PRODUCT_UNQ = @PRODUCTUNQ
    ORDER BY s.INVDATE;

    OPEN sales_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor INTO @unqid, @salesqty;

    -- Cursor to loop receipts for current product
    DECLARE stock_cursor CURSOR FOR
    SELECT
        SM1005_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1005_10 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1005_6 AS [recieptDATE],
        sm1005_57 AS RECEIPTQTY,
        (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28) AS COST
    FROM sm1005
    LEFT JOIN sm1008 ON sm1005.sm1005_4 = sm1008.sm1008_30
    WHERE SM1005_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
      AND sm1005_7 = @Branchid
      AND sm1008_30 IS NULL
      AND SM1005_10 = @PRODUCTUNQ

    UNION ALL

    --SELECT
    --    sm1014_7 AS branch,
    --    sm1014_10 AS product,
    --    sm1014_6 AS [recieptDATE],
    --    CAST(SUM(
    --        CASE
    --            WHEN sm1014_17 = 'GS' THEN sm1014_14 * -1 * ISNULL(NULLIF(TRY_CAST(sm1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2)), 0) / 100, 1)
    --            WHEN sm1014_17 = 'GE' THEN sm1014_14 * ISNULL(NULLIF(TRY_CAST(sm1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2)), 0) / 100, 1)
    --            ELSE 0
    --        END
    --    ) AS NUMERIC(15,3)) / 1000 AS RECEIPTQTY,
    --    0 AS COST
    --FROM sm1014
    --INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
    --WHERE sm1014_6 = '2025-03-31'
    --  AND sm1014_7 = @Branchid
    --  AND sm1014_10 = @PRODUCTUNQ
    --GROUP BY sm1014_7, sm1014_10, sm1014_6
    --ORDER BY [recieptDATE];

	SELECT 
    sm1023.sm1023_4 AS branch,
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
    sm1023.sm1023_5 AS [recieptDATE],
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c8 AS RECEIPTQTY,
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c14 AS COST
FROM sm1023
INNER JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
WHERE
    sm1023.sm1023_5 = '2025-03-31' AND 
    sm1023.sm1023_4 = @Branchid AND 
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 = @PRODUCTUNQ
GROUP BY 
    sm1023.sm1023_4, 
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6,
    sm1023.sm1023_5,
	sm1023_c.sm1023_c8,
	sm1023_c.sm1023_c14
ORDER BY 
  Product,    [recieptDATE];

    OPEN stock_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor INTO @Branchid, @PRODUCTUNQ, @recieptDATE, @RECEIPTQTY, @STOCKCOST;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @tqty = @RECEIPTQTY;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @tqty > 0 AND @salesqty > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @costToAllocate NUMERIC(18, 2);
            IF @tqty >= @salesqty
            BEGIN
                SET @costToAllocate = CAST((@STOCKCOST / @RECEIPTQTY) * @salesqty AS NUMERIC(18, 2));
                UPDATE #SalesDataWithCost
                SET cost = cost + @costToAllocate
                WHERE unqid = @unqid;

                SET @tqty = @tqty - @salesqty;
                SET @salesqty = 0;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SET @costToAllocate = CAST((@STOCKCOST / @RECEIPTQTY) * @tqty AS NUMERIC(18, 2));
                UPDATE #SalesDataWithCost
                SET cost = cost + @costToAllocate
                WHERE unqid = @unqid;

                SET @salesqty = @salesqty - @tqty;
                SET @tqty = 0;
            END

            IF @salesqty = 0
                FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor INTO @unqid, @salesqty;
        END

        FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor INTO @Branchid, @PRODUCTUNQ, @recieptDATE, @RECEIPTQTY, @STOCKCOST;
    END

    CLOSE stock_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE stock_cursor;

    CLOSE sales_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE sales_cursor;

    FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO @PRODUCTUNQ;
END

CLOSE PRODUCT_cursor;
DEALLOCATE PRODUCT_cursor;

-- Aggregate data for pivoting
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedData') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;
SELECT
    s.INVDATE,
    s.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT,
    SUM(s.SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    AVG(s.SELLINGRATE) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
    SUM(s.cost) AS COST, -- Use the calculated cost
    SUM(s.SALEAMT) AS [SELL_VALUE],
    CAST(SUM(s.SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(s.SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [SELL_PR],
    CAST(SUM(s.SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(s.SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) - CAST(SUM(s.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(s.SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS CONT_PR,
    (
        CAST(SUM(s.SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(s.SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) -
        CAST(SUM(s.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(s.SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2))
    ) * SUM(s.SELLQTY) AS CONTRIBUTION
INTO #AggregatedData
FROM #SalesDataWithCost s -- Use the table with calculated cost
GROUP BY s.INVDATE, s.PRODUCT_NAME
ORDER BY s.INVDATE, s.PRODUCT_NAME;

-- Construct pivot columns string manually
SET @pivotColumns = '';

SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_Qty') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_AVGSELLRATE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_COST') + ','+
     QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLVALUE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTRIBUTION') + ','

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT FROM #AggregatedData) AS Products;

-- Remove trailing comma
IF RIGHT(@pivotColumns, 1) = ','
    SET @pivotColumns = LEFT(@pivotColumns, LEN(@pivotColumns) - 1);

-- Build dynamic pivot query
SET @sql = '
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumns + '
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_Qty'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.QTY, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_AVGSELLRATE'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.AVG_SELL_RATE, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_COST'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.COST, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

     UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLVALUE'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.[SELL_VALUE], 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

     UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLPR'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.[SELL_PR], 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

     UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTPR'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.CONT_PR, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

     UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ds.Day,
        ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTRIBUTION'' AS ProductMeasure,
        ISNULL(ad.CONTRIBUTION, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;
';

EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

-- Cleanup
DROP TABLE #SalesDataWithCost;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;
DROP TABLE #DateSeries;

END

   FETCH NEXT FROM branch_cursor INTO  @branchunq
   print @branchunq
     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	  BEGIN

	   OPEN PRODUCT_cursor

	    FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO  @PRODUCTUNQ
		   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

   BEGIN

    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as[VALUE], SM1002_7 as [BRANCH]  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY branch ASC;
	
	--SELECT * fROM #T1 WHERE sm1011_13='3CF013DE-3F66-437E-BD50-25F4A7104994' AND sm1011_6='2025-04-03' ORDER BY sm1011_41
	


SELECT 
    PRODUCT,
    INVDATE,
    SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    AVG(sellINGrate) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
    CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS COST,
    SUM(SALEAMT) AS [SELL_VALUE],
    CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [SELL_PR],
	  (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) 
     - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)))as [cont_pr],
   CAST( (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) 
     - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)))
    * SUM(SELLQTY) AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS CONTRIBUTION into #yyy

 FROM
(
select SM1011_41 AS BRANCH,sm19_5 as custname,sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,sm1011_6 as INVdate ,sm1011_7 AS INVNO,CAST(sm1011_42 /1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3))AS SELLQTY,
sm1011_19*1000 as sellINGrate,(cost)as cost,sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
from #t1 left join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=#t1.sm1011_13
left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
where sm1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
and sm1008_30='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
UNION ALL
select SM1011_41 AS BRANCH, sm19_5 as custname,sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,sm1011_6 as INVdate ,sm1011_7 AS INVNO,CAST(sm1011_42 /1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3))AS SELLQTY,
sm1011_19*1000 as sellINGrate, (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28+SM1005_27)as cost,sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
from sm1011 left join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011_13
left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
where sm1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
and sm1008_30<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

)AS AA
 


GROUP BY INVDATE, PRODUCT
ORDER BY INVDATE, PRODUCt;

-- Create date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);
DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @FromDate;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @ToDate
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END






-- Construct pivot columns string manually
SET @pivotColumns = '';

SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_QTY') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_AVGSELLRATE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_COST') + ','+
     QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_SELLVALUE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_SELLPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CONTPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CONTRIBUTION') + ','

FROM (SELECT  DISTINCT sm206_7 FROM sm206) AS Products;

-- Remove trailing comma
--SET @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns + 'TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION';
-- print @pivotColumns;
 print '1';
IF RIGHT(@pivotColumns, 1) = ','
 SET @pivotColumns = LEFT(@pivotColumns, LEN(@pivotColumns) - 1);

 print @pivotColumns;
  print '11';

  -- Calculate daily total contribution
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DailyTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DailyTotals;
SELECT
    INVDATE AS Day,
    SUM(CONTRIBUTION) AS CONTRIBUTION_TOTAL
INTO #DailyTotals
FROM #yyy
GROUP BY INVDATE;
--select * from #DailyTotals;

-- Build dynamic pivot query
  SET @sql = '
    SELECT
        PivotTable.Day, ' + @pivotColumns + ', -- Specify PivotTable.Day to avoid ambiguity
        ISNULL(dt.CONTRIBUTION_TOTAL, 0) AS CONTRIBUTION_TOTAL
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_QTY'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.QTY, 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_AVGSELLRATE'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.AVG_SELL_RATE, 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_COST'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.COST, 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLVALUE'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.[SELL_VALUE], 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLPR'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.[SELL_PR], 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTPR'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.CONT_PR, 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ds.Day,
            ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTRIBUTION'' AS ProductMeasure,
            ISNULL(ad.CONTRIBUTION, 0) AS Value
        FROM #DateSeriess ds
        LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE

        -- REMOVED THIS UNION ALL:
        -- UNION ALL
        -- SELECT
        -- ds.Day,
        -- ''TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION'' AS ProductMeasure,
        -- SUM(ad.CONTRIBUTION) AS Value
        -- FROM #DateSeriess ds
        -- LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
        -- GROUP BY ds.Day
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT
    (
        SUM(Value)
        FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
    ) AS PivotTable
    LEFT JOIN #DailyTotals dt ON PivotTable.Day = dt.Day
    ORDER BY PivotTable.Day;
    ';
    -- PRINT @sql; -- Use this for debugging the generated SQL
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_discount_report]
		
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@sp      AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@Fd      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@Td      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURE    AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@fromdatee    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@todatee   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(max) = '',
@unqidPro as nvarchar(max) = '',
@branchunq as nvarchar(max) = '',
@BRANCH_STOCK       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@detail       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='1'
AS
BEGIN

  IF @AA = 'BIND'
    BEGIN
	if @uid in ('001','shi','adm','ami')
	 begin 
	 print '1'
        -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
      	--SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
       --     UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY Dname ASC,ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname , 1 as  ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC, ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

        SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname , 0 AS ord
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY Dname;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

	select  unqid as unqid, sm113_6 as Dname from sm113  ORDER BY Dname;

    END
	
	IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
    BEGIN
 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split( @unqidPro ,',')) 
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
    END
	end
	

	IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCTSALES'
    BEGIN
	--declare @Fd   AS NVARCHAR(50)='';
	--declare @Td   AS NVARCHAR(50)='';

-- declare @FromDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)  = CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103);
--declare @ToDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)  = CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103);

        --SELECT distinct SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        --FROM sm1011  inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13
        --WHERE  sm1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103) AND CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103)
        --ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;


		IF (@Fd <> '' AND @Td <> '' and @BRANCH <>'')
			BEGIN
				 SELECT distinct SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM sm1011  inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13
        WHERE  sm1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103) AND CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103) AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
			END
		
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname 
				FROM SM206 
				ORDER BY Dname ASC;
			END



    END


	if @AA = 'BINDMANU'
begin 

select SM206.sm206_2 as unqid, SM206.sm206_7 AS Dname  from sm206 
 inner join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
inner join sm113 on sm206_c7 = sm113.unqid 
where sm113.unqid  in (select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURE,','))

	end 




IF @AA = 'GRIDS'


BEGIN

DECLARE @FromDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);
DECLARE @ToDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDatee, 103);
set @FromDate = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);
set @ToDate = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDatee, 103);
   
 -- 2️⃣ Monthly Discount
    -------------------------------------------------------------------
  DECLARE @cols NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @selectCols NVARCHAR(MAX), @sumCols NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @query NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- Step 1️⃣: Create the temp source
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DiscountCTE') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #DiscountCTE;

SELECT  
    SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
   -- SM206.SM206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
    FORMAT(SM_401.SM_401_6, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS FROM_PERIOD,
    FORMAT(SM_401.SM_401_7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS TO_PERIOD,
    SM19.SM19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
    TRY_CAST(SM_401_C.SM_401_C_8 AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS DiscountByMonth,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY SM206.SM206_2, SM19.SM19_5, SM_401.SM_401_6, SM_401.SM_401_7
        ORDER BY SM_401_C.SM_401_C_8 DESC
    ) AS DiscountNo
INTO #DiscountCTE
FROM SM_401_C
JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_7
LEFT JOIN SM_401 ON SM_401.SM_401_5 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_6
 left JOIN SM19  ON SM19.UNQID = SM_401.SM_401_11
    WHERE SM_401_C_7 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))  and (sm_401_6 <= @ToDate AND sm_401_7 >= @FromDate)  

-- Step 2️⃣: Build dynamic column list
SELECT @cols = STUFF((
    SELECT DISTINCT ',' + QUOTENAME(DiscountNo)
    FROM #DiscountCTE
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '');

SELECT @selectCols = STUFF((
    SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(DiscountNo) + ', 0) AS Discount' + CAST(DiscountNo AS VARCHAR(10))
    FROM #DiscountCTE
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '');

-- Step 4️⃣: Build dynamic SUM expression for TotalDiscount
SELECT @sumCols = STUFF((
    SELECT DISTINCT ' + ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(DiscountNo) + ', 0)'
    FROM #DiscountCTE
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, '');

-- Step 5️⃣: Final dynamic pivot query
SET @query = '
SELECT 
    PRODUCT,
    --PRODUCTUNQ,
    FROM_PERIOD,
    TO_PERIOD,
    CUSTNAME,' + CHAR(13) + 
    @selectCols + ',
    (' + @sumCols + ') AS TotalDiscount
FROM #DiscountCTE
PIVOT (
    MAX(DiscountByMonth)
    FOR DiscountNo IN (' + @cols + ')
) AS PVT
ORDER BY PRODUCT, CUSTNAME;';

-- Step 6️⃣: Execute
EXEC sp_executesql @query;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1️⃣ Quantity Range Discount
    -------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        distinct(SM206.SM206_7) AS PRODUCT,
        FORMAT(sm_402_4, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS FROM_PERIOD,
        FORMAT(sm_402_5, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS TO_PERIOD,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME, 
        CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AS FromQty,
        CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT) AS ToQty,
        CAST(sm_402_c7 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS DiscountByQuantityRange,
        ---NULL AS DiscountByMonth,
        'Quantity Wise Discount' AS DiscountType
    FROM sm_402
    LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM_402.SM_402_7 = SM206.SM206_2
    LEFT JOIN SM_402_C ON SM_402_C.SM_402_C4 = SM_402.unqid
    LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = SM_402.SM_402_8
    WHERE SM206.SM206_2 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
    and (sm_402_4 <= @ToDate AND sm_402_5 >= @FromDate)  

   

    


END

end

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_ACCOUNT_MASTER_CHILD_Q]
@a					NVARCHAR(20) = '',	
@unqid				NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@punqid				NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@name				NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@date				NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@amount				NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@lrc				NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@sm19_c8			NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--REMARK
@SM19_C9			NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--Installation Type
@SM19_C10			NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--Subscription Amount
@SM19_C11			NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--Subscription Period
@SM19_C12			NVARCHAR(50) = ''		--Status

AS

IF @a = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN
set @unqid = NEWID()
insert into SM19_C(SM19_C1,SM19_C2,SM19_C3,SM19_C4,SM19_C5,SM19_C6,SM19_C7,SM19_C8,SM19_C9,SM19_C10,SM19_C11,SM19_C12)
values(@unqid,@punqid,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM19_C3)+1,1) FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = @Punqid),@name,dbo.getformatteddate(@date),@amount,@lrc,@SM19_C8,@SM19_C9,@SM19_C10,@SM19_C11,@SM19_C12)
END

IF @a = 'DELETE_CHILD'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C1 = @unqid

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY sm19_c4)AS ROWNUMBER, (SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID =SM19_C4 )AS [SOFTWARE NAME],
		dbo.getformatteddate(sm19_c5) as [INSTALLATION DATE],sm19_c6 as [INSTALLATION AMOUNT],sm19_c7 as [LRC AMOUNT],sm19_c8 as [REMARK],SM19_C.sm19_c1 AS UNQID, SM19_C4 AS [SOFTWARE UNQ] 
		FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = @punqid ORDER BY ROWNUMBER 
END


IF @a = 'UPDATE_CHILD'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = @punqid
		--insert into SM19_C(SM19_C1,SM19_C2,SM19_C3,SM19_C4,SM19_C5,SM19_C6,SM19_C7,SM19_C8,SM19_C9,SM19_C10,SM19_C11,SM19_C12)
		--values(NEWID(),@punqid,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM19_C3)+1,1) FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = @Punqid),@name,dbo.getformatteddate(@date),@amount,@lrc,@SM19_C8,@SM19_C9,@SM19_C10,@SM19_C11,@SM19_C12)
  
  --END
  --ELSE
  --BEGIN
  --SELECT 'AMITESH' AS ERR
  --END

--update sm19_c set sm19_c3 = (SELECT SM19_C3  FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = @Punqid),sm19_c4 = @name,sm19_c5 = dbo.getformatteddate(@date),sm19_c6 = @amount,sm19_c7 = @lrc where sm19_c2 = @punqid
END

IF @a = 'BIND_DDL'
BEGIN
		 --TABLE 0 [SOFTWARE NAME]
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID], SM208_5 AS [SOFTWARE NAME] FROM SM208 ORDER BY SM208_5

		--TABLE 1 [INSTALLATION TYPE]
		SELECT '1' AS UNQID, 'AMC' AS [TYPE] INTO #TYPE
		UNION ALL
		SELECT '2' AS UNQID, 'Subscription' AS [TYPE]

		SELECT * FROM #TYPE ORDER BY [TYPE]

		--TABLE 2 [SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD]
		SELECT '1' AS UNQID, 'Monthly' AS [PERIOD] INTO #PERIOD
		UNION ALL
		SELECT '2' AS UNQID, 'Quarterly' AS [PERIOD]
		UNION ALL
		SELECT '3' AS UNQID, 'Yearly' AS [PERIOD]

		SELECT * FROM #PERIOD ORDER BY [PERIOD]

		SELECT * INTO #T FROM (
		SELECT '1' AS UNQID,'Active' AS [STATUS]
		UNION ALL
		SELECT '2' AS UNQID,'Inactive' AS [STATUS]) AS A

		SELECT * FROM #T ORDER BY [STATUS]
END

 

GO

IF @a = 'DISPLAYGRID'
BEGIN
	 DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT
--declare @pageno as int
SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
SET @RowspPage = 10
SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS NAME,SM19_54 AS MOBNO,SM19_8 AS OPENINGBAL,SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT FROM SM19 
where sm19_63  LIKE '%'+ @SM19_63 + '%'  ORDER BY SM19_5
 OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;
END

IF @a = 'SEARCHGRID'
BEGIN
		begin
 --DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT
--declare @pageno as int
SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
SET @RowspPage = 10

		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS NAME,SM19_54 AS MOBNO,SM19_8 AS OPENINGBAL,SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT FROM SM19 
		WHERE sm19_5 LIKE '%'+ @AccountName + '%' and sm19_63  LIKE '%'+ @SM19_63 + '%'  ORDER BY SM19_5

 OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;
end
END

BEGIN
		--SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS NAME,SM19_54 AS MOBNO,SM19_8 AS OPENINGBAL,SM19_27 AS ACCNUM FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5

IF @what = 'PageCount'
BEGIN
CREATE table #TM ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from sm19),@Page float = 10;
DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]
set @A =1
declare @PageValue int 
set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
while (@A <=@PageValue)
BEGIN
insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
SET @A = @A + 1;
END 
select * from #TM
END

IF @what = 'PageCountLIKE'
BEGIN

CREATE table #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
			
DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from sm19 where sm19_5 LIKE '%'+ @AccountName + '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
declare @A_LIKE int 
set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]
set @A_LIKE =1
declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
BEGIN
insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
END
select * from #TM_LIKE
end

IF @what = 'GRID1'
BEGIN
 SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT unqid, UPPER(sm221_7) as [Account Name],UPPER(sm221_8) as [Account Name Printed],
 ((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=SM221_15) + ',' + (SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=SM221_14) + ',' + (SELECT SM2_5 FROM SM02 WHERE UNQID=SM221_13)) AS [Address],
 (SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID=SM221_26) AS [Software],(CASE WHEN CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),SM221_27,103) ='01/01/1900' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),SM221_27,103) END) AS [Installaltion Date], 
 (CASE WHEN CONVERT (nvarchar(20),sm221_31,103)='01/01/1900' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),sm221_31,103) END) as [Demo Date],SM221_28 AS [Installaltion Amount],
 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 M3_6 FROM M3 WHERE M3_4 = (SELECT SM19.UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_61 = SM221.unqid) AND M3_6 > 0 AND M3_11 = 'BR' ORDER BY M3_19 DESC),0) AS [Received Amount],
 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 FORMAT(M3_19,'dd/MM/yyyy') FROM M3 WHERE M3_4 = (SELECT SM19.UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_61 = SM221.unqid) AND M3_6 > 0 AND M3_11 = 'BR' ORDER BY M3_19 DESC),'') AS [Received Date],
 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8  + '/' +  SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10 = (SELECT SM19.UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_61 = SM221.unqid) 
 --ORDER BY CAST(SM213_9 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) DESC			-- Error converting data type nvarchar to numeric on 20210901
 ),'') AS [Invoice No],
 (SELECT (CASE WHEN SM19_62 = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN SM19_62 = 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN SM19_62 = 3 THEN 'Hold' END ) FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.SM19_61 = SM221.UNQID) AS [Account Status],
 (CASE WHEN sm221_33='PAPPROVAL' THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Approved' END) AS [Status] FROM SM221
 --ORDER BY [Status] DESC,SM221_31 DESC, SM221_27 DESC
 ) AS A WHERE [Received Amount] = 0  ORDER BY [Status] DESC,dbo.getformatteddate([Demo Date]) DESC, dbo.getformatteddate([Installaltion Date]) DESC
 --RECEIVED AMOUNT NOT SHOW(ONLY DUE AMOUNT IS SHOW) CHANGE ON 20211005 AS TOLD BY NILESH SIR

		SELECT DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'ADM',@PUNQID,@SM221_36,@SM221_37,(SELECT SM44_5 FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_7 = 'CUSTOMERS(DEALER)'),'0.00',
		'','Dr',(SELECT SM44_12 FROM SM44 WHERE UNQID=sm221_9),'',@SM221_39,'',@SM221_40,@SM221_43,@SM221_46,'','',@SM221_44,@SM221_45,@SM221_38,'SERVER',@SM221_49,
		(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = @SM221_41),@SM221_41,'','','','','','','','','',@SM221_55,'','','','','','','','',@SM221_53,'','','','','',@SM221_51,'',
		@SM221_52,'',@SM221_44,'','','','',@PUNQID,'1' FROM SM221 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID

		SELECT @GROUPID = @PUNQID;
		SELECT @PUNQID = NEWID();
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm19]([sm19_1],[sm19_2],[sm19_3],[unqid],[sm19_5],[sm19_6],[sm19_7],[sm19_8],[sm19_9],[sm19_10],[sm19_11],[sm19_12],[sm19_13],
		[sm19_14],[sm19_15],[sm19_16],[sm19_17],[sm19_18],[sm19_19],[sm19_20],[sm19_21],[sm19_22],[sm19_100],[sm19_23],[sm19_24],[sm19_25],[sm19_26],
		[sm19_27],[sm19_28],[sm19_29],[sm19_30],[sm19_31],[sm19_32],[sm19_33],[sm19_34],[sm19_35],[sm19_36],[sm19_37],[sm19_38],[sm19_39],[sm19_40],
		[sm19_41],[sm19_42],[sm19_43],[sm19_44],[sm19_45],[sm19_46],[sm19_47],[sm19_48],[sm19_49],[sm19_50],[sm19_51],[sm19_52],[sm19_53],[sm19_54],
		[sm19_55],[sm19_56],[sm19_57],[sm19_58],[sm19_61],[sm19_62])
	
		select GETDATE(),GETDATE(),'ADM',@punqid,sm221_7,sm221_8,(SELECT SM44_5 FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_7 = 'CUSTOMERS (DEBTORS A)'),'0.00','','Dr',(SELECT SM44_12 FROM SM44 WHERE UNQID=sm221_9),
		'',sm221_12,'',sm221_15,'',sm221_20,sm221_18,'',sm221_19,'','','',sm221_22,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = sm221_14),sm221_14,'','','',
		'','','','','','','','','','','','','','','',sm221_14,'',sm221_23,'','','','','',sm221_15,'','','','0',sm221_24, @GROUPID,@PUNQID,'1' from sm221 
		where unqid=@unqid
	
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[SM19_C](SM19_C1,SM19_C2,SM19_C3,SM19_C4,SM19_C5,SM19_C6,SM19_C7,SM19_C8,SM19_C9,SM19_C10,SM19_C11)
		select newid(),@punqid,'1',sm221_26,sm221_27,sm221_28,sm221_29,sm221_59,sm221_56,sm221_57,sm221_58 from sm221 where unqid=@unqid
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @PUNQID = NEWID();
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm19]([sm19_1],[sm19_2],[sm19_3],[unqid],[sm19_5],[sm19_6],[sm19_7],[sm19_8],[sm19_9],[sm19_10],[sm19_11],[sm19_12],[sm19_13],
		[sm19_14],[sm19_15],[sm19_16],[sm19_17],[sm19_18],[sm19_19],[sm19_20],[sm19_21],[sm19_22],[sm19_100],[sm19_23],[sm19_24],[sm19_25],[sm19_26],
		[sm19_27],[sm19_28],[sm19_29],[sm19_30],[sm19_31],[sm19_32],[sm19_33],[sm19_34],[sm19_35],[sm19_36],[sm19_37],[sm19_38],[sm19_39],[sm19_40],
		[sm19_41],[sm19_42],[sm19_43],[sm19_44],[sm19_45],[sm19_46],[sm19_47],[sm19_48],[sm19_49],[sm19_50],[sm19_51],[sm19_52],[sm19_53],[sm19_54],
		[sm19_55],[sm19_56],[sm19_57],[sm19_58],[sm19_61],[sm19_62])
	
		select GETDATE(),GETDATE(),'ADM',@punqid,sm221_7,sm221_8,(SELECT SM44_5 FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_7 = 'CUSTOMERS (DEBTORS A)'),'0.00','','Dr',(SELECT SM44_12 FROM SM44 WHERE UNQID=sm221_9),
		'',sm221_12,'',sm221_15,'',sm221_20,sm221_18,'',sm221_19,'','','',sm221_22,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = sm221_14),sm221_14,'','','',
		'','','','','','','','','','','','','','','',sm221_14,'',sm221_23,'','','','','',sm221_15,'','','','0',sm221_24, @punqid,@punqid,'1' from sm221 
		where unqid=@unqid
	
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[SM19_C](SM19_C1,SM19_C2,SM19_C3,SM19_C4,SM19_C5,SM19_C6,SM19_C7,SM19_C8,SM19_C9,SM19_C10,SM19_C11)
		select newid(),@punqid,'1',sm221_26,sm221_27,sm221_28,sm221_29,sm221_59,sm221_56,sm221_57,sm221_58 FROM SM221 WHERE UNQID=@unqid
	END
END
