CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_ADVANCE_ADJUSTMENT_Q]
@WHAT NVARCHAR(20)='',
@USERID NVARCHAR(3)='',
@SYSTEMNAME NVARCHAR(100)='',
@PAR1 NVARCHAR(36)='',--ACCOUNT UNQID
@PAR2 NVARCHAR(50)='',--ADJUSTEDAMOUNT
@PAR3 NVARCHAR(36)='',--INVN UNQID
@PAR4 NVARCHAR(36)='', --COSR UNQID


@CO_1		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--ENTRY DATE
@CO_2		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--POSTING DATE
@CO_3		NVARCHAR(3)   = '',--USER ID
@CO_4		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--SYSTEM NAME
@INVN_UNQID	NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--UNQID
@CO_5		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--INVN UNQID
@CO_6		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--SM202_C UNQID(BANKBOOK CHILD UNQID)
@CO_7		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--ADJUSTED AMOUNT
@CO_8		NVARCHAR(50)   = '',--NET AMOUNT
@CO_9		NVARCHAR(5)    = '',--BK
@CO_10		NVARCHAR(50)   = '',--BALANCE AMOUNT
@CO_11		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--ACCOUNT UNQID(BANKBOOK SM202_C9)
@SALES_UNQID NVARCHAR(36)  = ''

AS
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'ADVANCED'
	BEGIN
			SELECT UNQID, FORMAT(IN_8,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [VOUCHERDATE],(SELECT SM202_6A FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = IN_5) AS [VOUCHERNO],
			(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = IN_7) AS [BOOKNAME],
			FORMAT((SELECT SM202_7 FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = IN_5),'dd/MM/yyyy')  AS [VOUCHER DATE],(IN_9*(-1)) AS [TOTALAMOUNT],
			(IN_11*(-1)) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT] FROM INVN WHERE  IN_12 = @PAR1 AND IN_9 < 0 AND IN_11 < 0 

			SELECT UNQID, FORMAT(IN_8,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [INVOICEDATE],(SELECT SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID = IN_5) AS [INVOICENO],
			(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = IN_7) AS [BOOKNAME],
			FORMAT((SELECT SM202_7 FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = IN_5),'dd/MM/yyyy')  AS [VOUCHER DATE],(IN_9*(-1)) AS [TOTALAMOUNT],
			IN_11 AS [BALANCEAMOUNT] FROM INVN WHERE  IN_12 = @PAR1 AND IN_9 > 0 AND IN_11 > 0 

	END

	IF @WHAT = 'SELECT'
	BEGIN
		------------------------GRID 1
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM202_7) FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = CO_6) AS [VOUCHERDATE],
		(SELECT SM202_6A FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = CO_6) AS [VOUCHERNO],(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = CO_9) AS [BOOKNAME],
		CO_8 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],CO_10 AS [BALANCEAMOUNT] FROM COSR 
		WHERE CO_5 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND CO_6 IN (SELECT SM202_C6 FROM SM202_C WHERE SM202_C9 = @PAR1) 

		UNION ALL

		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM201_7) FROM SM201 WHERE SM201_4 = CO_6) AS [VOUCHERDATE],
		(SELECT SM201_6A FROM SM201 WHERE SM201_4 = CO_6) AS [VOUCHERNO],(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = CO_9) AS [BOOKNAME],
		CO_8 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],CO_10 AS [BALANCEAMOUNT] FROM COSR 
		WHERE CO_5 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND CO_6 IN (SELECT SM201_C6 FROM SM201_C WHERE SM201_C9 = @PAR1) 

		------------------------GRID 2
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = IN_7) AS [BOOKNAME],(SELECT SM213_8+'/'+SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = IN_5) AS [INVOICENO],
		(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = IN_5) AS [DATE],IN_11 AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT] FROM INVN 
		WHERE IN_11 != 0.00 AND IN_5 IN (SELECT SM213.UNQID FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10 = @PAR1) AND IN_12 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

		UNION ALL

		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = IN_7) AS [BOOKNAME],(SELECT SM203_13 FROM SM203 WHERE SM203_4 = IN_5) AS [INVOICENO],
		(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM203_7) FROM SM203 WHERE SM203_4 = IN_5) AS [DATE],IN_11 AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT] FROM INVN 
		WHERE IN_11 != 0.00 AND IN_5 IN (SELECT SM203_C6 FROM SM203_C WHERE SM203_C9 = @PAR1) AND IN_12 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'ACCOUNT'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM19_6 AS [ACCOUNTNAME] FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_6;
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
	BEGIN
			DECLARE @AccountID AS NVARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE @VoucherID AS NVARCHAR(36);

			SET @AccountID = (SELECT TOP 1 INVN.IN_12 FROM INVN WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVN_UNQID)		--HOLD ACCOUNT UNQID(OO)
			
			SET @VoucherID = (SELECT TOP 1 INVN.IN_5 FROM INVN WHERE INVN.UNQID = @CO_6)			--HOLD VOUCHER UNQID(B1) 

			SET @CO_2 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM202.SM202_7 FROM SM202 WHERE SM202.SM202_4 = @VoucherID)	--HOLD VOUCHER DATE(SM202_7) 

			INSERT INTO COSR VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),@CO_2,@USERID,@SYSTEMNAME,NEWID(),
			@INVN_UNQID,@VoucherID,convert(numeric(18,2),@CO_7),convert(numeric(18,2),@CO_8),
			(SELECT TOP 1 BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM202_20 FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 = @VoucherID)),
			convert(numeric(18,2),@CO_10),@AccountID)

			UPDATE INVN SET IN_11 = convert(numeric(18,2),IN_11) - convert(numeric(18,2),@CO_7) WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVN_UNQID			--UPDATE GRATER THAN 0 INVOICE AMOUNT
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE_VOUCHERAMT'
	BEGIN
			UPDATE INVN SET IN_11 = convert(numeric(18,2),IN_11) + convert(numeric(18,2),@CO_7) WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVN_UNQID			--UPDATE LESS THAN 0 VOUCHER AMOUNT 
	END

	--ELSE IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
	--BEGIN
	--if(@PAR4 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--begin
	--	UPDATE INVN SET IN_11 = IN_9 - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR2) WHERE UNQID = @PAR3
	--end
	--if(@PAR3 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--begin
	--	--INSERT INTO COSR SELECT IN_1,IN_2,IN_3,IN_4,NEWID(),@PAR3,INVN.IN_5,@PAR2,@PAR2,'BR',IN_9,IN_12 FROM INVN WHERE IN_5 = @PAR3
	--	UPDATE COSR SET CO_5 = @PAR3, CO_10 = CO_8 - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR2),CO_7 = CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR2) WHERE UNQID = @PAR4
	--end
	--END
END


--IMPLEMENT
--SELECT FORMAT(IN_8,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [VOUCHER DATE],(SELECT SM202_6A FROM SM202 WHERE SM202_4 ='384C80D9-F3B8-4196-9E20-07BBD8834533') AS [VOUCHER NO],
--(IN_9*(-1)) AS [TOTAL AMOUNT],(IN_11*(-1)) AS [BALANCE AMOUNT] FROM INVN WHERE IN_12 ='384C80D9-F3B8-4196-9E20-07BBD8834533'
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_ALL_VOUCHERS_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_ALL_VOUCHERS_Q]
@What nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid nvarchar(max) = '',
@uid nvarchar(max) = '',

@branch nvarchar(100) = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = ''

AS
begin 
if @What = 'getall'
BEGIN
   

	SELECT 
    ba_14 AS IDD,
    ba_5 AS BANK,
    ba_2 AS TYPE,
    unqid AS UNQID,
    ba_1 AS BK,
    CAST(ba_2 + ' - ' + ba_5 AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS TYPEBANK
FROM 
    BA
WHERE 
    ba_2 IN ('JOURNAL', 'BANK BOOK')
ORDER BY 
    TYPE;


	select 'BANKBOOK PAYMENT' as T, 1 as UNQID
	union all 
	select 'BANKBOOK RECEIPT' as T, 2 as UNQID
	union all 
	select 'JOURNAL' as T, 3 as UNQID
	--union all 
	--select 'IBTM' as T, 4 as UNQID

END

IF @what='DATAR'
BEGIN    

   -- Create a table to store all final results
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalResult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalResult

CREATE TABLE #FinalResult (
    UNQID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    [FORMAT] NVARCHAR(50),
    FORMATNAME NVARCHAR(100),
    BRANCH NVARCHAR(100),
    ACDRCR NVARCHAR(100),
    [TYPE] NVARCHAR(50),
    POSTEDNO NVARCHAR(100),
    POSTEDDATE DATETIME,
    ACCOUNT UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    AMOUNT NUMERIC(18,2),
    NARRATION NVARCHAR(MAX),
    ACCOUNTNAME NVARCHAR(100),
     createdby NVARCHAR(50),
     postedby NVARCHAR(50)
)



DECLARE @mode NUMERIC(18,2);

DECLARE unqid_cursor CURSOR FOR
SELECT SM202_4
FROM SM202 
WHERE  
    SM202_101 = @BRANCH 
    AND (SELECT TOP 1 SM202_C10 FROM SM202_C WHERE SM202_C6 = SM202_4) > 0
    AND SM202_13 <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM202_13 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
ORDER BY 
   CASE WHEN SM202_13 = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
   CAST(CASE WHEN SM202_6A = '' THEN 0 ELSE SM202_6A END AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) DESC

OPEN unqid_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursor INTO @unqid

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    SELECT @mode = SUM(sm202_c10)
    FROM SM202_C 
    INNER JOIN SM202 ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid

    IF @mode > 0
    BEGIN
        -- Insert final two rows per UNQID into the temp table
       INSERT INTO #FinalResult
(
    UNQID,
    [FORMAT],
    FORMATNAME,
    BRANCH,
    ACDRCR,
    [TYPE],
    POSTEDNO,
    POSTEDDATE,
    ACCOUNT,
    AMOUNT,
    NARRATION,
    ACCOUNTNAME,
    createdby,
    postedby
)
SELECT
    AA.UNQID,
    AA.[FORMAT],
    AA.FORMATNAME,
    AA.BRANCH,
    AA.ACDRCR,
    AA.[TYPE],
    AA.POSTEDNO,
    AA.POSTEDDATE,
    AA.ACCOUNT,
    AA.AMOUNT,
    AA.NARRATION,
    SM19.SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,
    AA.createdby,
    AA.postedby
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        SM202_4 AS UNQID, 
        'BANK VOUCHER ' AS [FORMAT],
        CASE WHEN SM202_19 = 'IBTM' THEN 'IBTM' + '/' + SM202_6A ELSE '' END AS FORMATNAME,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm202_101) AS [BRANCH],
        (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm202_22) AS [ACDRCR],
        'RECEIPT NO.' AS [TYPE],
        SM202_6A AS [POSTEDNO],
        SM202_13 AS [POSTEDDATE],
        SM202_c9 AS [ACCOUNT],
        SM202_C10 AS AMOUNT,
        SM202_12 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM202_4) AS [NARRATION],
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm202_3) AS createdby,
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = SM202_14) AS postedby
    FROM SM202
    INNER JOIN SM202_C ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6  
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid

    UNION ALL

    SELECT TOP 1 
        SM202_4, 
        'BANK VOUCHER ',
        CASE WHEN SM202_19 = 'IBTM' THEN 'IBTM' + '/' + SM202_6A ELSE '' END,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm202_101),
        (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm202_22),
        'RECEIPT NO.',
        SM202_6A,
        SM202_13,
        SM202_20,
        @mode * -1, 
        SM202_12 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM202_4),
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm202_3),
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = SM202_14)
    FROM SM202
    INNER JOIN SM202_C ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid
) AA
INNER JOIN SM19 ON AA.ACCOUNT = SM19.UNQID

    END

    FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursor INTO @unqid
END

CLOSE unqid_cursor
DEALLOCATE unqid_cursor;


WITH RankedResult AS (
    SELECT 
    f.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.UNQID ORDER BY f.AMOUNT DESC) AS RowInPair,
    --DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.UNQID) AS ResultNo,
	DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.UNQID, f.[POSTEDDATE],CAST([POSTEDNO] AS  NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC) AS ResultNo,
    dbo.fnNumberToWords(
        CASE 
            WHEN f.Amount > 0 THEN f.Amount
            ELSE p.Amount
        END
    ) AS balance
FROM #FinalResult f
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 Amount 
    FROM #FinalResult 
    WHERE UNQID = f.UNQID AND Amount > 0
    ORDER BY Amount DESC
) p

)
SELECT *,CAST([POSTEDNO] AS  NUMERIC(18,0))
FROM RankedResult
ORDER BY [POSTEDDATE],CAST([POSTEDNO] AS  NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC,UNQID,Amount ASC



end 


IF @what='DATAP'
BEGIN    

   -- Create a table to store all final results
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalResultp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalResultp

CREATE TABLE #FinalResultp (
    UNQID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    [FORMAT] NVARCHAR(50),
    FORMATNAME NVARCHAR(100),
    BRANCH NVARCHAR(100),
    ACDRCR NVARCHAR(100),
    [TYPE] NVARCHAR(50),
    POSTEDNO NVARCHAR(100),
    POSTEDDATE DATETIME,
    ACCOUNT UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    AMOUNT NUMERIC(18,2),
    NARRATION NVARCHAR(MAX),
    ACCOUNTNAME NVARCHAR(100),
	createdby NVARCHAR(50),
    postedby  NVARCHAR(50)
)


--DECLARE @mode NUMERIC(18,2);

DECLARE unqid_cursoorr CURSOR FOR
SELECT SM202_4
FROM SM202 
WHERE  
    SM202_101 = @BRANCH 
    AND (SELECT TOP 1 SM202_C10 FROM SM202_C WHERE SM202_C6 = SM202_4) < 0
    AND SM202_13 <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM202_13 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
ORDER BY 
   CASE WHEN SM202_13 = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
   CAST(CASE WHEN SM202_6A = '' THEN 0 ELSE SM202_6A END AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) ASC

OPEN unqid_cursoorr
FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursoorr INTO @unqid

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    SELECT @mode = SUM(sm202_c10)
    FROM SM202_C 
    INNER JOIN SM202 ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid

    IF @mode < 0
    BEGIN
        -- Insert final two rows per UNQID into the temp table
      INSERT INTO #FinalResultp
(
    UNQID,
    [FORMAT],
    FORMATNAME,
    BRANCH,
    ACDRCR,
    [TYPE],
    POSTEDNO,
    POSTEDDATE,
    ACCOUNT,
    AMOUNT,
    NARRATION,
    ACCOUNTNAME,
    createdby,
    postedby
)
SELECT
    AA.UNQID,
    AA.[FORMAT],
    AA.FORMATNAME,
    AA.BRANCH,
    AA.ACDRCR,
    AA.[TYPE],
    AA.POSTEDNO,
    AA.POSTEDDATE,
    AA.ACCOUNT,
    AA.AMOUNT,
    AA.NARRATION,
    SM19.SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,
    AA.createdby,
    AA.postedby
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        SM202_4 AS UNQID, 
        'BANK VOUCHER ' AS [FORMAT],
        CASE WHEN SM202_19 = 'IBTM' THEN 'IBTM' + '/' + SM202_6A ELSE '' END AS FORMATNAME,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm202_101) AS [BRANCH],
        (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm202_22) AS [ACDRCR],
        'PAYMENT NO.' AS [TYPE],
        SM202_6A AS [POSTEDNO],
        SM202_13 AS [POSTEDDATE],
        SM202_c9 AS [ACCOUNT],
        SM202_C10 AS AMOUNT,
        SM202_12 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM202_4) AS [NARRATION],
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm202_3) AS createdby,
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = SM202_14) AS postedby
    FROM SM202
    INNER JOIN SM202_C ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6  
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid

    UNION ALL

    SELECT TOP 1 
        SM202_4, 
        'BANK VOUCHER ',
        CASE WHEN SM202_19 = 'IBTM' THEN 'IBTM' + '/' + SM202_6A ELSE '' END,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm202_101),
        (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm202_22),
        'PAYMENT NO.',
        SM202_6A,
        SM202_13,
        SM202_20,
        @mode * -1,
        SM202_12 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM202_4),
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm202_3),
        (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = SM202_14)
    FROM SM202
    INNER JOIN SM202_C ON SM202_4 = sm202_c6
    WHERE SM202_4 = @unqid
) AA
INNER JOIN SM19 ON AA.ACCOUNT = SM19.UNQID

	
       
    END

    FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursoorr INTO @unqid
END

CLOSE unqid_cursoorr
DEALLOCATE unqid_cursoorr;


WITH RankedResultp AS (
    SELECT 
    f.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.UNQID ORDER BY f.AMOUNT DESC) AS RowInPair,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.UNQID) AS ResultNo,
    dbo.fnNumberToWords(
        CASE 
            WHEN f.Amount > 0 THEN f.Amount
            ELSE p.Amount
        END
    ) AS balance
FROM #FinalResultp f
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 Amount 
    FROM #FinalResultp 
    WHERE UNQID = f.UNQID AND Amount > 0
    ORDER BY Amount DESC
) p

)
SELECT *
FROM RankedResultp
--ORDER BY ResultNo, RowInPair
ORDER BY [POSTEDDATE],CAST([POSTEDNO] AS  NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC,UNQID,Amount ASC

end 



IF @what = 'jv'
BEGIN

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalResultpp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalResultpp

    CREATE TABLE #FinalResultpp (
        UNQID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        [FORMAT] NVARCHAR(50),
        FORMATNAME NVARCHAR(100),
        POSTEDNO NVARCHAR(100),
        POSTEDDATE DATETIME,
        BRANCH NVARCHAR(100),
        ACDRCR NVARCHAR(100),
        [TYPE] NVARCHAR(50),
        [DEBITAC] NVARCHAR(100),
        [CREDITAC] NVARCHAR(100),
        [CREDITAMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [DEBITAMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2),
        NARRATION NVARCHAR(MAX),
        ACCOUNTNAME NVARCHAR(100), createdby NVARCHAR(50), postedby NVARCHAR(50),  PTYPE NVARCHAR(50)
    );

   -- DECLARE @unqid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

    DECLARE unqid_cursor CURSOR FOR
    SELECT SM203_4
    FROM SM203 
    WHERE  SM203_101 = @BRANCH AND
	SM203_11 <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM203_11 
	BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@FROMDATE) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@TODATE)
    ORDER BY SM203_1 DESC, CAST(SM203_6A AS NUMERIC(18)) DESC;

    OPEN unqid_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursor INTO @unqid;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
	  -- 🔹 Update / Insert Print Audit
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM printAudit WHERE DocumentID = @unqid)
BEGIN
    UPDATE printAudit
    SET PrintNumber = ISNULL(PrintNumber,0) + 1,
        Printedon = GETDATE()
    WHERE DocumentID = @unqid 
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    DECLARE @PrintCount INT

-- Get next print number for this document
SELECT @PrintCount = ISNULL(MAX(PrintNumber), 0) + 1
 FROM PrintAudit WHERE DocumentID = @unqid  ; -- your UNQID column

-- Insert new record
INSERT INTO [dbo].[PrintAudit]
(
    
    DocumentType,
    DocumentID,
    
	PrintedBy,
    PrintedOn,
    PrintNumber
)
VALUES
(
    'jj',
    @unqid,
    @uid,
    GETDATE(),
    @PrintCount
)
END





        INSERT INTO #FinalResultpp (
            UNQID, [FORMAT], FORMATNAME, POSTEDNO, POSTEDDATE, BRANCH, ACDRCR, [TYPE],
            DEBITAC, CREDITAC, DEBITAMOUNT, CREDITAMOUNT, NARRATION,ACCOUNTNAME,Createdby,postedby,PTYPE
        )
        SELECT 
            SM203.SM203_4,
            'JOURNAL VOUCHER',
            CASE 
                WHEN SM203.SM203_5 = 'JL' THEN 'IBTM/JV/' + SM203.SM203_6A
                WHEN SM203.SM203_5 = 'JJ' THEN 'JV/' + SM203.SM203_6A
                ELSE 'JOURNAL VOUCHER' + SM203.SM203_6A
            END,
            SM203.SM203_6A,
            SM203.SM203_11,
            SM1002.SM1002_7,
            SM19_ACDRCR.SM19_5,
            'NO.',
			ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00), ''),
           ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 > 0.00), '') ,
           (CASE WHEN SM203_C10 < 0.00 THEN (SM203_C10 * (-1)) ELSE 0.00 END),
           (CASE WHEN SM203_C10 > 0.00 THEN SM203_C10 ELSE 0.00 END),
            --CASE WHEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 < 0 THEN SM19_ACC.SM19_6 ELSE '' END,
            --CASE WHEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 > 0 THEN SM19_ACC.SM19_6 ELSE '' END,
            --CASE WHEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 > 0 THEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 ELSE 0.00 END,
            --CASE WHEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 < 0 THEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 * -1 ELSE 0.00 END,

            SM203.SM203_8 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM203.SM203_4),
            SM19_ACC.SM19_5
			,
			 CR.sm63_6,
            PO.sm63_6, 
			case when isnull(printnumber,0) > 0 then 'Duplicate' else 'Original' end
        FROM SM203
        INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203.SM203_4 = SM203_C.SM203_C6 AND SM203.SM203_6 = SM203_C.SM203_C7
        LEFT JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM203.SM203_101
        LEFT JOIN SM19 AS SM19_ACC ON SM19_ACC.UNQID = SM203_C.SM203_C9
        full JOIN SM19 AS SM19_ACDRCR ON SM19_ACDRCR.UNQID = SM203.SM203_14
		LEFT JOIN sm63 CR
    ON CR.sm63_5 = Sm203.sm203_3
LEFT JOIN sm63 PO
    ON PO.sm63_5 = Sm203.SM203_12

	left join  printAudit  on printAudit.DocumentID = sm203.sm203_4
        WHERE SM203.SM203_4 = @unqid  AND SM203_C10<>0
        ORDER BY 
		CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00), '') != '' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    SM203_C.SM203_C13;
            --CASE WHEN SM203_C.SM203_C10 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
            --SM203_C.SM203_C13;

        FETCH NEXT FROM unqid_cursor INTO @unqid;
    END

    CLOSE unqid_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE unqid_cursor;

   WITH RankedResultpp AS (
        SELECT 
            f.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.UNQID ORDER BY f.DEBITAMOUNT DESC, f.CREDITAMOUNT DESC) AS RowInPair,
            DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.UNQID) AS ResultNo
        FROM #FinalResultpp f
    ),
    Totals AS (
        SELECT UNQID, SUM(DEBITAMOUNT) AS TotalAmount
        FROM #FinalResultpp
        GROUP BY UNQID
    )
    SELECT 
        r.*,
        dbo.fnNumberToWords(t.TotalAmount) AS BalanceInWords
    FROM RankedResultpp r
    LEFT JOIN Totals t ON r.UNQID = t.UNQID
    ORDER  BY 
	POSTEDDATE,CAST([POSTEDNO] AS  NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC, ResultNo, RowInPair
	;

end

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BALANCES_OUTSTANDING]
@What nvarchar(100) = '',

@user nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid nvarchar(100) = ''
AS
BEGIN
if @What = 'Outstanding'
BEGIN
     select sm1002_7 as branchname,sm1002_5 as value,sm1002_4 as USERID from sm1002 where sm1002_5=@unqid order by sm1002_7 asc

     select partyname, sum(ledgeramt),sum(debit)as debit,sum(credit) as credit,sum(osamt) as osamt, 
     ABS(CASE 
             WHEN SUM(debit) > 0 THEN SUM(osamt) - SUM(debit)
             WHEN SUM(credit) > 0 THEN SUM(osamt) - SUM(credit)
             ELSE SUM(osamt) 
         END) AS debitdifferenceamt from
     (
     select sm19_5 as partyname, sum(m3_6)as ledgeramt,0.00 as OSamt,
     CASE WHEN SUM(m3_6) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(m3_6)) ELSE 0  END AS [Debit], 
     CASE WHEN SUM(m3_6) > 0 THEN SUM(m3_6) ELSE 0 END AS [Credit]
     from m3 inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=m3.m3_4 
     left JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_5=M3.M3_14
     where sm19_11='cust' and sm19_63 like @unqid
     group by sm19_5
     union all
     select sm19_5 as partyname, 0.00 as ledgeramt,sum (in_11)as OSamt,
     0.00 AS [Debit], 
     0.00 AS [Credit]
     from invn inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=invn.in_12
     where sm19_11='cust' and sm19_63 like @unqid and in_7='OO'
     group by sm19_5
     
     )as a
     group by partyname
     order by partyname 
END

	if @WHAT='branch_master'
begin
declare  @branchid nvarchar(max) = '';
 
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@USER)


	 
	select SM1002_5 as value, SM1002_7 as branchname  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY  branchname ASC;

	end 
--select * from sm19 9C9E1E38-DF30-4CFA-8311-8432D8F3B700
end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BANK_REGISTER_Q] 
@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@BRANCH  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',

@CHNO  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',

@BANK  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@groupunqid  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@USER NVARCHAR(50) = ''

AS 
--INSERT INTO BRViewLog( LogID , LogDate ,AccountName ,FromDate ,ToDate ,Userid ,Branch )
--VALUES (NEWID(),GETDATE(),'',DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE),DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE),@USER ,@branch)


IF @what = 'BANK_REGISTERNew'
BEGIN
	  --TABLE 0
	   select CASE 
        WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
        ELSE sm1002_7 
    END  as [COMPANYNAME],
 (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = @BRANCH;
	  
	  
	  --TABLE 1
	  SELECT y.date1 as [DATE],y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],  y.description AS [PARTY NAME],y.Narration AS [NARRATION],
	  y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPTS @DR],y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS @CR] FROM 
	  (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20) 
	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance B/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName  FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND M3_4 =@BANK --And m3_5 like '%' + @CHNO + '%'
		
	   
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_19) AS date1, M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  --sm19.sm19_5  AS Description,
	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then 
	  (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE  M3_4 != @BANK AND  m3_23  LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'  AND   
	  m3_5 like '%' + @CHNO + '%' And
	  M3.M3_19 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	  AND (M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'CASH BOOK' or BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK')
	    or m3.m3_11 IN (SELECT Ba_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @BANK) )
	  
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then 
	  ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,'' as bk,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as BookName
	  FROM M3 WHERE m3_23  LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'  
	  --AND m3_5 like '%' + @CHNO + '%'
	   And  M3.M3_19 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  AND M3_4 = @BANK) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))

	 
END

IF @what = 'BANKWISE'
BEGIN
	  --TABLE 0
	    select CASE 
        WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
        ELSE sm1002_7 
    END  as [COMPANYNAME],
 (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = @BRANCH

	  SELECT y.date1 as [DATE],y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],  y.description AS [PARTY NAME],y.Narration AS [NARRATION],

	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (

	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE M3_4 !=@BANK   
	 AND 
	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	  AND
	  M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'CASH BOOK' or BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK') 
	  or m3.m3_11 IN (SELECT Ba_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @BANK) 
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then 
	  ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,'' as bk,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as BookName
	  FROM M3 WHERE M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AND M3_4 =@BANK    ) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))

	 
END

	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)

	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,

	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then 
	  ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,'' as bk,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as BookName
	  FROM M3 WHERE M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  ) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))

	 
END

declare @ba1_1 nvarchar(20);
declare @ba14_1 nvarchar(max);
select @ba1_1=ba_1,@ba14_1=ba_14 from (
select row_number()over (order by ba_1) as abc,ba_1 as ba_1,ba_14 as ba_14 from ba where ba_2 in ('bank book','CASHBOOK/JODHPUR')
)as a where abc=1


declare @ba1_2 nvarchar(20);
declare @ba14_2 nvarchar(max);
select @ba1_2=ba_1,@ba14_2=ba_14 from (
select row_number()over (order by ba_1) as abc,ba_1 as ba_1,ba_14 as ba_14 from ba where ba_2 in ('bank book','CASHBOOK/JODHPUR')
)as a where abc=2

declare @ba1_3 nvarchar(20);
declare @ba14_3 nvarchar(max);

select row_number()over (order by ba_1) as abc,ba_1 as ba_1,ba_14 as ba_14 from ba where ba_2 in ('bank book','CASHBOOK/JODHPUR')
)as a where abc=3
SELECT DATE1,VOUCHERNO,DESCRIPTION,NARRATION,SUM(RECEIPTS1) AS RECEIPTS1,SUM(Payments1)AS Payments1,

 ---------------------OPENING

	  UNION ALL
	 
 select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance B/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
      0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS2 ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments2,
	  0.00 as RECEIPTS3,0.00 AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName, 1 AS RowType  FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND M3_4 =@ba14_2
	  UNION ALL
	   
 select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance B/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
      0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,0.00 as RECEIPTS2,0.00 AS Payments2,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS3 ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments3,CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName, 1 AS RowType FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND M3_4 =@ba14_3   
	  UNION ALL
	  ------TRANSACTION
	   Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_19) AS date1, M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  --sm19.sm19_5  AS Description,
	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then 
	  (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS1,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments1,
	  0.00 as RECEIPTS2,0.00 AS Payments2,0.00 as RECEIPTS3,0.00 AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName  , 2 AS RowType
	  FROM M3 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE  M3_4 != @ba14_1 AND  m3_23   LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'  AND   

	  M3.M3_19 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	  AND (M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK' and BA_14 = @ba14_1)
	    or m3.m3_11 IN (SELECT Ba_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @ba14_1) )

UNION ALL

  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_19) AS date1, M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  --sm19.sm19_5  AS Description,
	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then 
	  (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) as Narration,
	   0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS2,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments2,
	   0.00 as RECEIPTS3,0.00 AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   , 2 AS RowType 
	  FROM M3 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE  M3_4 != @ba14_2 AND  m3_23   LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'  AND   
	
	  M3.M3_19 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	  AND (M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK' and BA_14 = @ba14_2)
	    or m3.m3_11 IN (SELECT Ba_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @ba14_2) )
UNION ALL
  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_19) AS date1, M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  --sm19.sm19_5  AS Description,
	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then 
	  (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) as Narration,
	  0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,0.00 as RECEIPTS2,0.00 AS Payments2,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS3,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName , 2 AS RowType   
	  FROM M3 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE  M3_4 != @ba14_3 AND  m3_23  LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'  AND   
	  M3.M3_19 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	  AND (M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'CASHBOOK/JODHPUR')
	  or m3.m3_11 IN (SELECT Ba_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @ba14_3) )

	  UNION ALL
	  ----CLOSING
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance C/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>= 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS1 ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS Payments1,
	    0.00 as RECEIPTS2,0.00 AS Payments2,0.00 as RECEIPTS3,0.00 AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName , 3 AS RowType  FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AND M3_4 =@ba14_1
	  UNION ALL
	 
 select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance C/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
      0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>= 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS2 ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS Payments2,
	  0.00 as RECEIPTS3,0.00 AS Payments3,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName , 3 AS RowType  FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AND M3_4 =@ba14_2
	  UNION ALL
	   
 select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,'BB/0' AS voucherno,  'Balance C/F' AS Description, '' as Narration,
      0.00 as RECEIPTS1,0.00 AS Payments1,0.00 as RECEIPTS2,0.00 AS Payments2,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>= 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS3 ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS Payments3,CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName, 3 AS RowType   FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' AND M3.M3_19<=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AND M3_4 =@ba14_3   

	  )AS A GROUP BY DATE1,VOUCHERNO,DESCRIPTION,NARRATION,RowType
	  
	 ORDER BY RowType, Dt, CD, Vno, CAST(RIGHT(VOUCHERNO, CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(VOUCHERNO)) - 1) AS NUMERIC(18,0));

--    FROM M3
--    WHERE

--        AND M3.M3_19 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) 
--        AND M3_4 = @ba14_3
--) AS Absc




SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS Total_Label,
    SUM(RECEIPTS1) AS T_R1,
    SUM(Payments1) AS T_P1,
    SUM(RECEIPTS2) AS T_R2,
    SUM(Payments2) AS T_P2,
    SUM(RECEIPTS3) AS T_R3,
    SUM(Payments3) AS T_P3
FROM (
    ----CLOSING
    SELECT 
        DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
        'BB/0' AS voucherno,  
        'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
        '' as Narration,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) >= 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS RECEIPTS1,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS Payments1,
        0.00 as RECEIPTS2, 
        0.00 AS Payments2, 
        0.00 as RECEIPTS3, 
        0.00 AS Payments3,
        CHAR(48) as Dt,
        CHAR(48) as Vno,
        '' as CD, 
        '' as BookName, 
        3 AS RowType
    FROM M3
    WHERE  
        m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' 
        AND M3.M3_19 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) 
        AND M3_4 = @ba14_1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
        'BB/0' AS voucherno,  
        'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
        '' as Narration,
        0.00 as RECEIPTS1,
        0.00 AS Payments1,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) >= 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS RECEIPTS2,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS Payments2,
        0.00 as RECEIPTS3, 
        0.00 AS Payments3,
        CHAR(48) as Dt,
        CHAR(48) as Vno,
        '' as CD, 
        '' as BookName, 
        3 AS RowType
    FROM M3
    WHERE  
        m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' 
        AND M3.M3_19 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) 
        AND M3_4 = @ba14_2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
        'BB/0' AS voucherno,  
        'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
        '' as Narration,
        0.00 as RECEIPTS1,
        0.00 AS Payments1,
        0.00 as RECEIPTS2, 
        0.00 AS Payments2,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) >= 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS RECEIPTS3,
        CASE WHEN SUM(M3.M3_6) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) ELSE 0 END AS Payments3,
        CHAR(48) as Dt,
        CHAR(48) as Vno,
        '' as CD, 
        '' as BookName, 
        3 AS RowType
    FROM M3
    WHERE  
        m3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%' 
        AND M3.M3_19 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) 
        AND M3_4 = @ba14_3
) AS Absc
END

-- =============================================

-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BANKBOOK_PARENT_Q]
@a				   nvarchar(200)='',
@sm202_1		  nvarchar(50)='',     ----entrydate
@sm202_2	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----modifydate
@sm202_3	      nvarchar(30)='',     ----id
@sm202_4	      nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----unqid
@sm202_100	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----ip
@sm202_101	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----branchid
@sm202_5	      nvarchar(100)='',     ----bk
@sm202_6	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----VoucherNo
@sm202_6A	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Posted_VoucherNo
@sm202_7	      NVARCHAR(30)	  ='',     ----voucherdate
@sm202_8	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----acUnqid
@sm202_9	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Paymode
@sm202_10	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----GstNature
@sm202_11	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Ammount
@sm202_12	      nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----Narration
@sm202_13	      nvarchar(30)='',     ----PostDate
@sm202_14	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----UserId
@sm202_15	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----transaction type
@sm202_16	      NVARCHAR(30) ='',     ----Cheque Date
@sm202_17	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Drawee Bank
@sm202_18	      NVARCHAR(30)='',      ----Bank Reconciliation Date
@AGAINST		  NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@ZM36_2			  NVARCHAR(50)  = '',		---BANK NAME
@sm202_20	      NVARCHAR(100)	  ='',      ----OWN BANK UNQID
@FROMDATE	      NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@sm202_21	      NVARCHAR(max)  = '', ------cheque no/ transaction id
@sm202_22	      NVARCHAR(max)  = '', ------account cr/dr
 @SM202_23       NVARCHAR(max)  = '', 
 @SM202_24       NVARCHAR(max)  = '', 

	   
@TODATE			  NVARCHAR(50)  = '',

@postdate  NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@BRANCH   NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@pageno as int = ''
AS

Begin
DECLARE @Offset INT;
DECLARE @PageNumber INT;DECLARE @PageSize INT;
IF @a = 'INSERT_P'
BEGIN 
	   SET  @SM202_4 = NEWID()
	   SET @SM202_8  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM202_10 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM202_11 = '0.00'
	  
	   INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm202] VALUES
	   (dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),UPPER(@sm202_3),@SM202_4,@SM202_100,@SM202_101,(select ba_6 from ba where ba_14 = @sm202_20),@SM202_6,@SM202_6A,DBO.getformatteddate(@SM202_7),@SM202_8,@SM202_9,
	   @SM202_10,@SM202_11,@SM202_12,dbo.getformatteddate(@SM202_13),@SM202_14,@SM202_15,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM202_16),@SM202_17,DBO.getformatteddate(@SM202_18),@AGAINST,@sm202_20, @sm202_21,@sm202_22, @SM202_23,@SM202_24 )
	   
	   SELECT @SM202_4 AS [PUNQID] 
END

IF @a = 'UPDATE_P'
BEGIN 
	   SET @SM202_8  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM202_10 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM202_11 = '0.00'

	   UPDATE SM202 SET SM202_3=@SM202_3,SM202_100=@SM202_100,SM202_6 = @SM202_6,SM202_7 = DBO.getformatteddate(@SM202_7),SM202_12 = @SM202_12,SM202_13 = dbo.getformatteddate(@SM202_13),
	   SM202_14=@SM202_14,SM202_15 = @SM202_15,SM202_16 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM202_16),SM202_17 = @SM202_17,SM202_19=@AGAINST,[sm202_20] = @sm202_20, [sm202_21] = @sm202_21 , [sm202_22] = @sm202_22  WHERE SM202_4 = @SM202_4

END

	IF @A = 'INSERT1'
	BEGIN
		SET  @SM202_4 = NEWID()
		INSERT INTO SM202 VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'',UPPER(@SM202_3),@SM202_4,@SM202_100,@SM202_101,@SM202_5,@SM202_6,@SM202_6A,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM202_7),
		@SM202_8,@SM202_9,@SM202_10,@SM202_11,'RECEIVED FROM ' + (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @SM202_8),@SM202_13,@SM202_14,@SM202_15,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM202_16),
		@SM202_17,@SM202_18,@AGAINST,@sm202_20, @sm202_21, @sm202_22,@SM202_23,@SM202_24 )	
		SELECT @SM202_4 AS [UNQID]
	END
	IF @a = 'voucher_receipt'
	Begin
	select isnull(max(Cast([sm202_6] as numeric(18,0))),0)+1 as mx from [sm202] where isnumeric([sm202_6])='1' and sm202_5 = 'BR'
	end

	IF @a = 'voucher_payment'
	Begin

IF @a ='REMAININGAMT'
BEGIN

--drop table #t
--drop table #t1 

 SELECT 
   (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = c.co_11) as accountname,
    c.co_11 AS account, 
    SUM(ABS(c.co_7)) AS amt_cosr, 
    ABS(sm202_c10) AS amt, 
    (ABS(sm202_c.sm202_c10) - SUM(ABS(c.co_7))) AS amt_difference,  
    sm202_c.sm202_c101 AS branch 
	into #t 
FROM  
    cosr c
right JOIN 
   sm202_c 
ON 
    c.co_11 = sm202_c.sm202_c9 
WHERE  
 abs(sm202_c.sm202_c10) >= 0 
   AND 
	sm202_c.sm202_c101 = @BRANCH
    AND co_6 in (SELECT sm202_c4 FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @sm202_4)
    AND sm202_c.sm202_c6 = @sm202_4
GROUP BY  
    c.co_11, 
    sm202_c.sm202_c10, 
    sm202_c.sm202_c101, 
   sm202_c.sm202_c1
--HAVING    (ABS(sm202_c.sm202_c10) - SUM(ABS(c.co_7))) >0  
ORDER BY  
    sm202_c.sm202_c1 DESC;
if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 

begin
SELECT 
        (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm202_c9 FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @sm202_4)) AS accountname, 
        (SELECT sm202_c9 FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @sm202_4) AS account,  
        0.00 AS amt_cosr, 
        (SELECT ABS(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @sm202_4) AS amt, 
   --0.00 AS amt_difference,
        (SELECT ABS(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @sm202_4) AS amt_difference,
        @BRANCH AS branch 
    INTO #t1  
    FROM PA --- for single record

end

if (select COUNT(*) from #t)>0
begin
select * from #t 
end
else
begin
select * from #t1 
end

END

    END AS [POSTEDVOUCHER],
    CASE 
        WHEN SM202.SM202_13 = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN '' 
        ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM202.SM202_13, 103) 
    END AS [VOUCHERPOSTDATE],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM202.SM202_7, 103) AS [VOUCHERDATE],
    SM19.SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
    ABS(SM202_C.SM202_C10) AS [DEBITAMT],
    SUM(ISNULL(COSR.CO_7, 0)) AS [Adjusted],
	(ABS(SM202_C.SM202_C10) - SUM(ISNULL(COSR.CO_7, 0))) as [REMVOUCHER],
    SM202.SM202_13 AS [DO],
    SM1002.SM1002_7 AS [BRANCH],
    BA.BA_7 AS [BANK],
    CASE 
        WHEN SM202.SM202_13 ='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 'Unpost' 
        ELSE 'Posted' 
    END AS [post_staus]

FROM 
    SM202
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SM202_C6 ORDER BY SM202_C1) AS rn
        FROM SM202_C
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
) AS SM202_C ON SM202_C.SM202_C6 = SM202.SM202_4


LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM202_C.SM202_C9
LEFT JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM202.SM202_101
LEFT JOIN BA ON BA.BA_14 = SM202.SM202_20
LEFT JOIN COSR ON COSR.CO_11 = SM202_C.SM202_C9 AND COSR.CO_6 = SM202_C.SM202_C4

WHERE 
    SM202.SM202_101 = @sm202_101
   -- AND SM202_C.SM202_C10 > 0 
	AND sm202_23 = 'BR'
	AND (SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM202_C9)
	   FROM SM202_C WHERE SM202_C6=SM202_4 ORDER BY SM202_C1 ) LIKE @SM202_6 + '%'  AND   
	  SM202_13 BETWEEN [dbo].[getformatteddate](@FROMDATE)  AND  [dbo].[getformatteddate](@TODATE)
GROUP BY 
    SM202.SM202_4,
    SM202.SM202_6A,
    SM202.SM202_13,
    SM202.SM202_7,
    SM19.SM19_5,
    SM202_C.SM202_C10,
    SM1002.SM1002_7,
    BA.BA_7

)

SELECT *
FROM BaseData
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN DO = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 
        ELSE 1 
    END,
    DO DESC,
    CAST(CASE WHEN POSTEDVOUCHER = '' THEN 0 ELSE POSTEDVOUCHER END AS NUMERIC(18,0)) DESC
OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
													--No Record Found  Table 1 FOR BANKBOOKRECEIPT
	   SELECT '' AS [UNQID], 'No Record Found' AS [POSTEDVOUCHER],'' AS [VOUCHERPOSTDATE], '' AS [VOUCHERDATE],'' AS [ACCOUNTNAME],'' AS [DEBITAMT] ;

IF @a = 'PageCount'
BEGIN
    -- Temporary table for storing page numbers
    CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount] NVARCHAR(50));

    -- Declare variables
    DECLARE 
        @tot INT,                     -- Total rows
        @Page INT = 10,              -- Rows per page
        @totvalue FLOAT,             -- Total pages (before CEILING)
        @Aa INT = 1,                 -- Loop counter
        @PageValue INT;              -- Final page count (after CEILING)

    -- Get total row count matching condition
    SET @tot = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM202 WHERE sm202_23 = 'BR');

    -- Calculate total pages
    SET @totvalue = 1.0 * @tot / @Page;  -- Cast to float to avoid integer division
    SET @PageValue = CEILING(@totvalue); -- Round up to get total number of pages

    -- Insert each page number into temp table
    WHILE (@Aa <= @PageValue)
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #TM VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR, @Aa));
        SET @Aa = @Aa + 1;
    END

    -- Return list of page numbers
    SELECT * FROM #TM;
END

WHILE (@CurrentPage <= @TotalPages)
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #TM_LIKE VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR, @CurrentPage));
    SET @CurrentPage = @CurrentPage + 1;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BASIC_ADJUSTMENT_Q]
@WHAT		NVARCHAR(40)  ='',
@USERID		NVARCHAR(3)   ='',
@SYSTEMNAME NVARCHAR(100) ='',
@IN_1       NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--ENTRY DATE
@IN_2		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--MODIFY DATE
@IN_3		NVARCHAR(30)  ='',--USER ID	
@IN_4		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--SYSTEM NAME
--@UNQID		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--UNQID(NEWID)  -- 
@IN_5		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--SM213 UNQID (IN CASE OF ADVANCED ADJUSMENT SM202 UNQID)
@IN_6		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--DR/CR
@IN_7		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--BK(BP,JJ,OO ETC.)
@IN_8		NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--SM213 DATE(SM213_6)
@IN_9		NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--INVOICE AMOUNT
@IN_10		NVARCHAR(50)  ='', --TRUE/FALSE
@IN_11		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--DUE AMOUNT
@IN_12		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--ACCOUNT UNQID(BANKBOOK SM202_C9)

@CO_1		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--ENTRY DATE
@CO_2		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--POSTING DATE
@CO_3		NVARCHAR(3)   = '',--USER ID
@CO_4		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--SYSTEM NAME
@UNQID		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--UNQID
@CO_5		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--INVN UNQID
@CO_6		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--SM202_C UNQID(BANKBOOK CHILD UNQID)
@CO_7		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--ADJUSTED AMOUNT
@CO_8		NVARCHAR(50)   = '',--NET AMOUNT
@CO_9		NVARCHAR(5)    = '',--BK
@CO_10		NVARCHAR(50)   = '',--BALANCE AMOUNT
@CO_11		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',--ACCOUNT UNQID(BANKBOOK SM202_C9)
@CO_12		NVARCHAR(36)  = '',  ---date receipt
@SALES_UNQID NVARCHAR(36)  = '',

@PURCHASE_UNQID NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@SM202_C9   NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@branch     NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
AS
BEGIN
		DECLARE  @SM202C_UNQID  AS NVARCHAR(36)		
		DECLARE @AccountID AS NVARCHAR(50),@Amount AS NUMERIC(18,2);
		DECLARE @INVN_UNQID AS NVARCHAR(36);

	


	IF @WHAT = 'ADJUSTED'
	BEGIN
			 IF EXISTS (
        SELECT sm202_c9
        FROM sm202_c 
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm202_c.sm202_c9 = sm19.unqid
        WHERE (sm202_c.sm202_c10 < 0 
          AND sm202_c6 = @CO_6
          AND sm19.sm19_11 = 'cust' 
         ) or  (sm202_c.sm202_c10 > 0 
          AND sm202_c6 = @CO_6
          AND sm19.sm19_11 in ('suppl', 'trans') 
         )
    )
    BEGIN 
        PRINT '1'
        SELECT 'ERROR' AS error
    END
    ELSE 
	begin

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BRANCHWISE_FREIGHT] 
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdate    AS NVARCHAR(50)='' ,
@todate   AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@year as nvarchar(50) =''
	
AS
BEGIN



if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN
---------------------BRANCH----------------------------
select sm1002_7 as branch, sm1002_5 as value from sm1002 ;
---------------------GDATA----------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @columns NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @columnsSum NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @columnsTotalSum NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

SET @columns = '';
SET @columnsSum = '';
SET @columnsTotalSum = '';

SELECT @columns = @columns + QUOTENAME(sm1_5) + ',' 
FROM sm01 
WHERE unqid IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1002_11 FROM sm1002);
SET @columns = LEFT(@columns, LEN(@columns) - 1);
PRINT @columns;

SELECT 
    @columnsSum = @columnsSum + 'SUM(ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(city) + ', 0.00)) AS ' + QUOTENAME(city) + ',',
    @columnsTotalSum = @columnsTotalSum + 'SUM(ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(city) + ', 0.00)) + '
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm1_5 AS city
    FROM sm01
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_11 = sm01.unqid
) AS Headers;

SET @columnsSum = LEFT(@columnsSum, LEN(@columnsSum) - 1);
SET @columnsTotalSum = LEFT(@columnsTotalSum, LEN(@columnsTotalSum) - 3);

SET @sql = '
WITH FreightData AS (
    SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_2 AS ProductID, 
        sm206.sm206_6 AS Product,
        (SELECT sm1_5 FROM sm01 WHERE unqid = sm1002.sm1002_11) AS city, 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BranchName,
        ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_56), 0) AS TotalSales,
        SUM(sm1005.sm1005_56) AS FreightAmt
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1005.sm1005_7
    WHERE 
     sm1005.sm1005_7 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1002.sm1002_5 FROM sm1002)
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_2, 
        sm206.sm206_6, 
        sm1002.sm1002_7, 
        sm1002.sm1002_11
)
SELECT
    Product,
    ProductID, 
    ' + @columns + ',
    (' + REPLACE(@columns, ',', ' + ') + ') as RowTotal
INTO #TempTable
FROM 
    FreightData
PIVOT (
    SUM(FreightAmt) FOR city IN (' + @columns + ')
) AS PivotTotalSales; 

SELECT Product, ' + @columns + ', RowTotal
FROM #TempTable 
GROUP BY Product, ' + @columns + ', RowTotal
ORDER BY Product;

SELECT   
    Product, 
    ' + @columnsSum + ',
    (' + @columnsTotalSum + ')) AS RowTotal
FROM #TempTable  
GROUP BY Product 
UNION ALL
SELECT   
  '''+ 'Grand Total'+ ''' as Product, 
	' + @columnsSum + ',
    (' + @columnsTotalSum + ')) AS RowTotal
FROM #TempTable   
';

PRINT 'Generated SQL: ' + @sql;
EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

END


if @aa='ALL_DDD'


begin
DECLARE @columns1 NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @columnsSum1 NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @columnsTotalSum1 NVARCHAR(MAX), 
        @sql1 NVARCHAR(MAX); 

SET @columns1 = ''; 
SET @columnsSum1 = ''; 
SET @columnsTotalSum1 = ''; 

-- Generate dynamic columns for city names (sm1_5)
SELECT @columns1 = @columns1 + QUOTENAME(sm1_5) + ',' 
FROM sm01 
WHERE unqid IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1002_11 FROM sm1002); 

SET @columns1 = LEFT(@columns1, LEN(@columns1) - 1); 
PRINT @columns1;

-- Generate dynamic columns for summed values (SUM of ISNULL(city, 0))
SELECT 
    @columnsSum1 = @columnsSum1 + 'SUM(ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(city) + ', 0.00)) AS ' + QUOTENAME(city) + ',', 
    @columnsTotalSum1 = @columnsTotalSum1 + 'SUM(ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(city) + ', 0.00)) + ' 
FROM ( 
    SELECT DISTINCT sm1_5 AS city 
    FROM sm01 
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_11 = sm01.unqid 
) AS Headers; 

SET @columnsSum1 = LEFT(@columnsSum1, LEN(@columnsSum1) - 1); 
SET @columnsTotalSum1 = LEFT(@columnsTotalSum1, LEN(@columnsTotalSum1) - 3); 



SET @sql1 = '
WITH FreightData AS (
    SELECT 
	sm1005_6 as datef,
        sm206.sm206_2 AS ProductID, 
        sm206.sm206_6 AS Product,
        (SELECT sm1_5 FROM sm01 WHERE unqid = sm1002.sm1002_11) AS city, 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BranchName,
        ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_56), 0) AS TotalSales,
        SUM(sm1005.sm1005_56) AS FreightAmt
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1005.sm1005_7
    WHERE 
	 sm1005.sm1005_7 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1002.sm1002_5 FROM sm1002)
    AND sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN ''' + @fromdate + ''' AND ''' + @todate + ''' 
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_2, 
        sm206.sm206_6, 
        sm1002.sm1002_7, 
        sm1002.sm1002_11, sm1005_6
)

SELECT
    Product,
    ProductID, 
    ' + @columns1 + ',
    (' + REPLACE(@columns1, ',', ' + ') + ') as RowTotal
INTO #TempTable
FROM 
    FreightData
PIVOT (
    SUM(FreightAmt) FOR city IN (' + @columns1 + ')
) AS PivotTotalSales; 

SELECT Product, ' + @columns1 + ', RowTotal
FROM #TempTable 
GROUP BY Product, ' + @columns1 + ', RowTotal
ORDER BY Product;

SELECT   
    Product, 
    ' + @columnsSum1 + ',
    (' + @columnsTotalSum1 + ')) AS RowTotal
FROM #TempTable  
GROUP BY Product 
UNION ALL
SELECT   
  '''+ 'Grand Total'+ ''' as Product, 
	' + @columnsSum1 + ',
    (' + @columnsTotalSum1 + ')) AS RowTotal
FROM #TempTable   
';

PRINT 'Generated SQL: ' + @sql1;

EXEC sp_executesql @sql1;

end


END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BRANCHWISE_UPLFT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BRANCHWISE_UPLFT]
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUCT        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@MANUFACTURE AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdate    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@ids    AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@unqid AS NVARCHAR(max)='',



@todate   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) =''
	
AS
BEGIN

if @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
begin 
	

	
SELECT 
    SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname 
        FROM SM206 
 
WHERE CAST(SM206_13 AS VARCHAR) IN (
    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) FROM dbo.split(@unqid,
 ','
    )
)
ORDER BY Dname;

			
			
end
if @AA = 'BINDMANU'
begin 

select SM206.sm206_2 as unqid, SM206.sm206_7 AS Dname  from sm206 
 inner join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
inner join sm113 on sm206_c7 = sm113.unqid 
where sm113.unqid  in (select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURE,','))

	end 




if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN

declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)



	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname   from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY Dname  ASC;

		-- for product
	select sm206_2 as unqid, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by sm206_7

	--for product Category
	SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6;

		--for Manufacture
		select  unqid as unqid, sm113_6 as Dname from sm113  ORDER BY Dname;
--grid
DECLARE @fromdate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columnss NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- Create date series table
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);

DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @fromdate_converted;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @todate_converted
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END;

-- Create aggregated data table
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedData') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;

SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_57), 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_41), 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_25), 0) AS CashDisc,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_26), 0) AS CustDisc,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_28), 0) AS Freight,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_24 *sm1005_57 )/ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_57), 0), 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_36), 0) AS TotalAmount
INTO #AggregatedData
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_converted AND @todate_converted
  AND sm1005.sm1005_7 = @branch
GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7;

-- Preview report before pivoting
SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Veh, 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.CashDisc, 0) AS CashDisc,
    ISNULL(ad.CustDisc, 0) AS CustDisc,
    ISNULL(ad.Freight, 0) AS Freight,
    ISNULL(ad.BasicAmount, 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
FROM #DateSeriess ds
LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad 
    ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
ORDER BY ds.Day;

-- Prepare dynamic pivot columns
SET @pivotColumnss = '';
SELECT @pivotColumnss = @pivotColumnss + 
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Veh') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CashDisc') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CustDisc') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Freight') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_BasicAmount') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalAmount')
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
    FROM sm206 
    WHERE sm206_7 IS NOT NULL 
      AND sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)
) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumnss = STUFF(@pivotColumnss, 1, 1, '');

-- Build dynamic pivot SQL
SET @sql1 = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumnss + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Qty''        AS ProductMeasure, ad.Qty         AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Veh''        AS ProductMeasure, ad.Veh         AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_CashDisc''   AS ProductMeasure, ad.CashDisc    AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_CustDisc''   AS ProductMeasure, ad.CustDisc    AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Freight''    AS ProductMeasure, ad.Freight     AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_BasicAmount''AS ProductMeasure, ad.BasicAmount AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_TotalAmount''AS ProductMeasure, ad.TotalAmount AS Value FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumnss + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';

-- Optional: print the dynamic SQL for debugging
-- PRINT @sql1;

-- Execute the dynamic SQL
EXEC sp_executesql @sql1;

-- Clean up
DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;










END


if @aa='ALL_DDD'
BEGIN

--grid

DECLARE @fromdate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columnsss NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql11 NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumnsss NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- Create date series table
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriesss') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriesss;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriesss (Day DATE);

DECLARE @CurrentDateee DATE = @fromdate_convertedd;
WHILE @CurrentDateee <= @todate_convertedd
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriesss (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDateee);
    SET @CurrentDateee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDateee);
END;

-- Create aggregated data table
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedDataa') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedDataa;

SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_57), 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_41), 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_25), 0) AS CashDisc,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_26), 0) AS CustDisc,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_28), 0) AS Freight,
     ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_24 *sm1005_57 )/ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_57), 0), 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_36), 0) AS TotalAmount
INTO #AggregatedDataa
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_convertedd AND @todate_convertedd
  AND sm1005.sm1005_7 IN (select data from dbo.split(@branch,',')) 
  and sm1005_10 IN (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))
GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7;

-- Preview report before pivoting
SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Veh, 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.CashDisc, 0) AS CashDisc,
    ISNULL(ad.CustDisc, 0) AS CustDisc,
    ISNULL(ad.Freight, 0) AS Freight,
    ISNULL(ad.BasicAmount, 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
FROM #DateSeriesss ds
LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad 
    ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
ORDER BY ds.Day;

-- Prepare dynamic pivot columns
SET @pivotColumnsss = '';
SELECT @pivotColumnsss = @pivotColumnsss + 
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Veh') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CashDisc') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CustDisc') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Freight') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_BasicAmount') +
    ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalAmount')
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
    FROM sm206 
    WHERE sm206_7 IS NOT NULL 
      AND sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005 where
	  sm1005_10 IN (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,',')))
) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumnsss = STUFF(@pivotColumnsss, 1, 1, '');

-- Build dynamic pivot SQL
SET @sql11 = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumnsss + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Qty''        AS ProductMeasure, ad.Qty         AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Veh''        AS ProductMeasure, ad.Veh         AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_CashDisc''   AS ProductMeasure, ad.CashDisc    AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_CustDisc''   AS ProductMeasure, ad.CustDisc    AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_Freight''    AS ProductMeasure, ad.Freight     AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_BasicAmount''AS ProductMeasure, ad.BasicAmount AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.Product + ''_TotalAmount''AS ProductMeasure, ad.TotalAmount AS Value FROM #DateSeriesss ds LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = ad.Dateee
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumnsss + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';

-- Optional: print the dynamic SQL for debugging
-- PRINT @sql1;

-- Execute the dynamic SQL
EXEC sp_executesql @sql11;

-- Clean up
DROP TABLE #DateSeriesss;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedDataa;

END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BRANCHWISE_UPLFT_OF_FREIGHT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BRANCHWISE_UPLFT_OF_FREIGHT]
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PRODUCT        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@fromdate    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@todate   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@unqid AS NVARCHAR(max)=''
	
AS
BEGIN
if @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
begin 
print @unqid

	SELECT 
    SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname 
        FROM SM206 
 
WHERE CAST(SM206_13 AS VARCHAR) IN (
    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) FROM dbo.split(@unqid,
 ','
    )
)
ORDER BY Dname;

			
			
end
if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN




declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)



	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY Dname ASC;

		-- for product
	select sm206_2 as unqid, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by sm206_7

	--for product Category
	SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6;

-- Declare date variables and convert them
DECLARE @fromdate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columnss NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- Create a temporary table to store the date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);

-- Populate the date series
DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @fromdate_converted;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @todate_converted
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END;

-- Create temporary table for aggregated data
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedData') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;
SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(TRY_CAST(sm1005.sm1005_57 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS Qty,  -- Safely casting to numeric
    ISNULL((sm1005.sm1005_28),0) AS FreightMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(TRY_CAST(sm1005.sm1005_70 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS TotalFreight,  -- Safely casting to numeric
    sm1005.sm1005_23 AS Remarks
INTO #AggregatedData
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_converted AND @todate_converted 
AND sm1005_7 =@BRANCH 
  --AND sm1005_7 in  (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@BRANCH, ',')) 

GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7, sm1005.sm1005_23,SM1005_28

-- First result set
SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Remarks, '') AS Remarks,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.FreightMT, 0) AS FreightMT,
    ISNULL(ad.TotalFreight, 0) AS TotalFreight
FROM #DateSeriess ds
FULL JOIN #AggregatedData ad 
    ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
ORDER BY ds.Day;

-- Generate dynamic columns for products
SET @columnss = '';
SELECT @columnss = @columnss + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @columnss = STUFF(@columnss, 1, 1, '');

-- Generate pivot columns for all measures (numeric only)
SET @pivotColumnss = '';
SELECT @pivotColumnss = @pivotColumnss + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_FreightMT')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalFreight')
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumnss = STUFF(@pivotColumnss, 1, 1, '');

-- Construct and execute the dynamic pivot query for numeric fields
SET @sql1 = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumnss + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Qty'' as ProductMeasure,
        ad.Qty as Value
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_FreightMT'',
        ad.FreightMT
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_TotalFreight'',
        ad.TotalFreight
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumnss + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';

-- Execute the dynamic SQL query for numeric measures
EXEC sp_executesql @sql1;

---- Handle Remarks separately in a different query or as a string field
---- Now fetch remarks in a non-aggregated way
--SET @sql1 = N'
--SELECT Day, ' + @columnss + '
--FROM 
--(
--    SELECT 
--        ds.Day,
--        ad.Product + ''_Remarks'' as ProductMeasure,
--        ad.Remarks as Value
--    FROM #DateSeriess ds
--    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
--) AS SourceTable
--PIVOT
--(
--    MAX(Value)  -- Remarks are non-numeric, so use MAX to avoid aggregation errors
--    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @columnss + ')
--) AS PivotTable
--ORDER BY Day;';

---- Execute the dynamic SQL query for Remarks
--EXEC sp_executesql @sql1;

-- Clean up temporary tables
DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;

END



if @aa='ALL_DDD'
BEGIN



DECLARE @fromdate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columns NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX);


PRINT @fromdate_convertedd;
PRINT @todate_convertedd;


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeries') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeries;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeries (Day DATE);


DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = @fromdate_convertedd;
WHILE @CurrentDate <= @todate_convertedd
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeries (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDate);
    SET @CurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate);
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedDataa') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedDataa;
SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(TRY_CAST(sm1005.sm1005_57 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS Qty,  -- Safely casting to numeric
    ISNULL((sm1005.sm1005_28), 0) AS FreightMT,
    ISNULL(SUM(TRY_CAST(sm1005.sm1005_70 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS TotalFreight,  -- Safely casting to numeric
    sm1005.sm1005_23 AS Remarks
INTO #AggregatedDataa
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_convertedd AND @todate_convertedd 
 and sm1005_7 in  (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@BRANCH, ','))
 --and sm1005_10 IN (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))            --..............
-- and sm1005_30 > 0
GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7,sm1005.sm1005_23,sm1005_28;



SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Remarks, '') AS Remarks,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.FreightMT, 0) AS FreightMT,
    ISNULL(ad.TotalFreight, 0) AS TotalFreight
FROM #DateSeries ds
FULL JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad 
    ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
ORDER BY ds.Day;


SET @columns = '';
SELECT @columns = @columns + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
     WHERE sm206_7 IS NOT NULL 
      AND sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005 where
	  sm1005_10 IN (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))
	  and sm1005_7 in  (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@BRANCH, ',')))
) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;


SET @columns = STUFF(@columns, 1, 1, '');
print @columns;

SET @pivotColumns = '';
SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_FreightMT')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalFreight')
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_7 IS NOT NULL 
      AND sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005 where
	  sm1005_10 IN (select data from dbo.split(@PRODUCT,','))
	  and sm1005_7 in  (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@BRANCH, ',')))
) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumns = STUFF(@pivotColumns, 1, 1, '');
print @pivotColumns;

SET @sql = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumns + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Qty'' as ProductMeasure,
        ad.Qty as Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
   
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_FreightMT'',
        ad.FreightMT
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_TotalFreight'',
        ad.TotalFreight
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';


EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

DROP TABLE #DateSeries;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedDataa;

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_BROKERMASTER]
@WHAT NVARCHAR(15) = '',
@sm406_3 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --USER ID
@sm406_4 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --SYSTEM
@UNQID AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',      --UNIQUE ID
@sm406_6 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --BROKER NAME
@sm406_7 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --ADDRESS 1
@sm406_8 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --ADDRESS 2
@sm406_9 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --CITY
@sm406_10 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',   --STATE
@sm406_11 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',   --MOBILE 1
@sm406_12 AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --MOBILE 2
@SEARCH AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@CITY AS NVARCHAR(50) = ''

AS
BEGIN
IF @WHAT = 'BIND_DD'
BEGIN
	select unqid as unqid, sm1_5 as city from sm01 order by sm1_5

	select unqid as unqid, sm205_5 as [state] from sm205 order by sm205_5

END

IF @WHAT = 'BIND_STATE'
BEGIN
	SELECT unqid as unqid, sm205_5 as [state] from sm205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1_7 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = @CITY) order by sm205_5
END

IF @WHAT = 'INSERT'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO sm406 VALUES(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @sm406_3, @sm406_4, NEWID(), @sm406_6, @sm406_7, @sm406_8, @sm406_9, @sm406_10, @sm406_11, @sm406_12)
END

IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
BEGIN
	UPDATE sm406 SET sm406_6 = @sm406_6, sm406_7 = @sm406_7, sm406_8 = @sm406_8, sm406_9 = @sm406_9, sm406_10 = @sm406_10, sm406_11 = @sm406_11, sm406_12 = @sm406_12 WHERE unqid = @UNQID
END

IF @WHAT = 'BIND_GRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, sm406_6 AS BROKERNAME, sm406_7+''+sm406_8 AS ADDRESS1, (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = sm406_9) AS CITY, (SELECT sm205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = sm406_10) AS [STATE] FROM sm406 ORDER BY sm406_6
END

IF @WHAT = 'SEARCH_GRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, sm406_6 AS BROKERNAME, sm406_7+''+sm406_8 AS ADDRESS1, (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = sm406_9) AS CITY, (SELECT sm205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = sm406_10) AS [STATE] FROM sm406 where sm406_6 like '%'+@SEARCH+'%' ORDER BY sm406_6
END

IF @WHAT = 'delete'
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM sm406 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
END

IF @WHAT = 'BIND_TEXTBOX'
BEGIN
	SELECT ISNULL(sm406_6, '') AS BROKERNAME, ISNULL(sm406_7, '') AS ADDRESS1, ISNULL(sm406_8, '') AS ADDRESS2, sm406_9 AS CITY, sm406_10 AS [STATE], ISNULL(sm406_11, '') AS MOBILE1, ISNULL(sm406_12, '') AS MOBILE2 FROM sm406 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
END
END

--create table sm406(sm406_1 datetime, sm406_2 datetime, sm406_3 nvarchar(50), sm406_4 nvarchar(50), unqid uniqueidentifier, sm406_6 nvarchar(50), sm406_7 nvarchar(max), sm406_8 nvarchar(max), sm406_9 nvarchar(50), sm406_10 nvarchar(50), sm406_11 NVARCHAR(50), sm406_12 NVARCHAR(50))
GO

,[sm201_c10],[sm201_c11]

 --select sm202_c9 ,sm202_c10 ,sm202_c12 from sm202_c where sm202_c6 = @sm202_c6
 update sm201_c set sm201_c9 = @sm201_c9,sm201_c10 = @sm201_c10,sm201_c11 = @sm201_c11 where sm201_c6 = @sm201_c6

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CASHBOOK_PARENT_Q]
@a				  nvarchar(20)='',
@sm201_1		  nvarchar(50)='',     ----entrydate
@sm201_2	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----modifydate
@sm201_3	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----id
@sm201_4	      nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----unqid
@sm201_100	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----ip
@sm201_101	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----branchid
@sm201_5	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----bk
@sm201_6	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----VoucherNo
@sm201_6A	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----PostedVoucherNo
@sm201_7	      nvarchar(20)='',     ----voucherdate
@sm201_8	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----acUnqid
@sm201_9	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Paymode
@sm201_10	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----GstNature
@sm201_11	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Ammount
@sm201_12	      nvarchar(50)='',     ----Narration
@sm201_13	      datetime    ='' ,     ----posteddate
@sm201_14         nvarchar(2) = '',  ---
@sm201_16         nvarchar(100) = '',  ---cashbook 
@AGAINST		  NVARCHAR(100)='',
@FROMDATE	      NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TODATE			  NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@BRANCH			  NVARCHAR(100)  = ''  ----bind branch

AS
BEGIN

IF @a = 'INSERT_P'
BEGIN 
       SET @sm201_4 = NEWID()
       SET @sm201_8 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
       SET @sm201_10 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM201_11 = '0.00'

      INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm201]
      VALUES
	  (dbo.entrydate(),'',@sm201_3,@sm201_4,@sm201_100,@sm201_101,@sm201_5,@sm201_6,@sm201_6A,dbo.getformatteddate(@sm201_7),@sm201_8,@sm201_9,@sm201_10,@sm201_11,@sm201_12,@sm201_13,@sm201_14,@AGAINST,@sm201_16)
	  SELECT @SM201_4 AS [PUNQID]
END

IF @a = 'UPDATE_P'
BEGIN 
       SET @sm201_8 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
       SET @sm201_10 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   SET @SM201_11 = '0.00'

	   UPDATE SM201 SET SM201_2=DBO.GETENTRYDATE(), SM201_3=@SM201_3,SM201_100=@SM201_100,sm201_101=@sm201_101,SM201_6 = @SM201_6,SM201_7 = DBO.getformatteddate(@SM201_7),SM201_12 = @SM201_12
	   ,SM201_15 = @AGAINST,sm201_16=@sm201_16
	   WHERE SM201_4 = @SM201_4

END

if @a = 'delete'
BEGIN 

DELETE FROM [dbo].[sm201]
WHERE sm201_4 = convert(uniqueidentifier,@sm201_4) AND NOT Exists(select sm201_c6,sm201_4 from sm201,sm201_c 
where sm201_4 = @sm201_4 and (sm201_4 = sm201_c6 ))
End

if @a = 'edit'
BEGIN 
UPDATE [dbo].[sm201]
   SET [sm201_2] = dbo.entrydate(),[sm201_3] = @sm201_3,[sm201_100] = @sm201_100,[sm201_101] = @sm201_101,
   [sm201_5] = @sm201_5,[sm201_6] = @sm201_6
   ,[sm201_7] = @sm201_7,[sm201_8] = @sm201_8,[sm201_9] = @sm201_9,[sm201_10] = @sm201_10,[sm201_11] = @sm201_11,
   [sm201_12] = @sm201_12,[SM201_15] = @AGAINST
    WHERE sm201_4 = convert(uniqueidentifier,@sm201_4)
End

if @a = 'select'
BEGIN
