CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CASHBOOK_PRINTQ]
@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@BRANCH  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@CHNO  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@BANK  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@CASHBOOK  AS	NVARCHAR(100) = ''



AS
set @FROMDATE =[dbo].[getformatteddate](@FROMDATE)
set @TODATE =[dbo].[getformatteddate](@TODATE)
BEGIN



IF @what = 'GETALL'
BEGIN
 



---table1
 SELECT y.date1 as [DATE], y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],   y.description AS [PARTYNAME], y.Narration AS [NARRATION], y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPTS@DR], y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS@CR]
	  FROM (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20)  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1, 'CBJ/0' AS voucherno,   'Balance B/F' AS Description,'' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD, '' as BookName  
      FROM M3 
	  WHERE 
           M3.M3_2 < DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) 
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_2) AS date1,
	  M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  ---(select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) as description,
	 case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3
	  LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
	  WHERE   
	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	 
	  AND M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'CBJ')
	  
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as BookName
	  FROM M3
	  WHERE M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  ) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))
END


IF @what = 'CASH_REGISTER'
BEGIN
	  --TABLE 0
	  SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,
	  LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))  + ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA
	  
	  --TABLE 1
	  SELECT y.date1 as [DATE],y.voucherno as [VOUCHER NO],  y.description AS [PARTY NAME],y.Narration AS [NARRATION],
	  y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPTS @DR],y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS @CR] FROM 
	  (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20) 
	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,
	  'BB/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance B/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,CHAR(48) as Dt,CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as CD,'' as BookName  FROM M3
	  WHERE  m3_23 = @BRANCH AND M3.M3_2<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND M3_4 = @BANK 
		
	   
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_2) AS date1,
	  M3_3 AS voucherno, 

	  case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,'' as bk,CHAR(48) as Vno,(case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3 
	  Left JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE  m3_23 = @BRANCH AND   
	   M3_1  = 'CC' AND M3_4 = @BANK  And M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)

	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
	  'BB/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration, 
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then 
	  ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS, Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,'' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,'' as BookName
	  FROM M3
	  WHERE m3_23 = @BRANCH  And  M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  AND M3_4 = @BANK) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))

	
END

IF @what = 'BANK'
BEGIN
 --SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BANKNAME] ,0 as ord  
	-- UNION ALL 
	--  SELECT BA_14 AS [BANKUNQID],BA_7 AS [BANKNAME] , 1 as ord FROM BA
	--  WHERE BA_6 ='cbj')  AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BANKNAME] ASC;

	SELECT BA_14 AS [BANKUNQID],BA_7 AS [BANKNAME] FROM BA WHERE BA_6 ='cbj'


END



IF @what = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN


 SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	  	SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH], 1 as ord FROM SM1002
		)  AS AA ORDER BY ord , [BRANCH] ;
		
END



IF @what = 'DISPLAYRECORDBYBRANCH'
BEGIN

---------------------------------------------------------------table1-------------------------------------------------------------
	  SELECT y.date1 as [DATE], y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],  y.description AS [PARTYNAME],  y.Narration AS [NARRATION],  y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPTS@DR], y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS@CR]
	  FROM 
	  (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20) 
	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,'CBJ/0' AS voucherno,    'Balance B/F' AS Description,  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt, CHAR(48) as Vno, '' as CD, '' as BookName  
	  FROM M3 
	  WHERE m3_23 = @BRANCH AND 
           M3.M3_2 < DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND 
           M3_4 = @BANK 
		  
	   
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_2) AS date1,
	  M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  ---(select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) as description,
	 case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3
	  LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
	  WHERE  M3_4 = @BANK AND  m3_23 = @BRANCH AND   
	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	 
	  AND M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'CBJ')
	  
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as BookName
	  FROM M3
	  WHERE m3_23 = @BRANCH AND  M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  AND M3_4 = @BANK) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))
END



IF @what = 'DISPLAYRECORD'
BEGIN
  

    SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,
	  LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))  + ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA

 SELECT y.date1 as [DATE],
	  y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],  
	  y.description AS [PARTY NAME],
	  y.Narration AS [NARRATION],
	  y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPTS @DR],
	  y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS @CR]
	  FROM 
	  (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20) 
	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno,  
	  'Balance B/F' AS Description,
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as CD,
	  '' as BookName  
	  FROM M3 
	  WHERE 
           M3.M3_2 < DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) 
          
		  
	   
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_2) AS date1,
	  M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  ---(select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) as description,
	 case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3
	  LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
	  WHERE   
	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
	 
	  AND M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'CBJ')
	  
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as BookName
	  FROM M3
	  WHERE M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)  ) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))
   
END

IF @what = 'BANKWISE'
BEGIN
  SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,
	  LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))  + ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA
	  

 SELECT y.date1 as [DATE],
	  y.voucherno as [VOUCHERNO],  
	  y.description AS [PARTY NAME],
	  y.Narration AS [NARRATION],
	  y.RECEIPTS AS [RECEIPT @DR],
	  y.Payments AS [PAYMENTS @CR]
	  FROM 
	  (select top 100 percent z.*,space(20) 
	  as balance,'VB6-PC_ABC' as z_0 from (
	  
	  select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno,  
	  'Balance B/F' AS Description,
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)< 0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 end AS RECEIPTS ,
	  Case When Sum(M3.M3_6)>0 then Sum(M3.M3_6) else 0 end AS Payments,
	  CHAR(48) as Dt,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as CD,
	  '' as BookName  
	  FROM M3 
	  WHERE 
           M3.M3_2 < DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND M3_4 = @BANK
          
		  
	   
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(M3_2) AS date1,
	  M3_3 AS voucherno, 
	  ---(select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) as description,
	 case when (select  count(*) from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) = 0 then (select ba_5 from ba where ba_14 = m3_4) else (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = m3_4) end as description, 
	  [m3].[m3_5] as Narration,
	  Case When m3.m3_6>0 then m3.m3_6 else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case When m3.m3_6<0 Then ABS(m3.m3_6) else 0 End AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  (case when m3_1 In (Select ba_1 from ba) then (Select ba_4 from ba where ba_1=m3_1) else m3_1 end ) AS BookName   
	  FROM M3
	  LEFT JOIN SM19 ON M3.M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
	  WHERE   
	  M3.M3_2 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AND M3_4 = @BANK
	 
	  AND M3.M3_1 IN (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'CBJ')
	  
	  
	  UNION ALL  
	  
	  Select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) AS date1,
	  'CBJ/0' AS voucherno, 
	  'Balance C/F' AS Description, 
	  '' as Narration,
	  Case When Sum(m3.m3_6)>0 then ABS(Sum(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End AS RECEIPTS,
	  Case when Sum(M3.M3_6)<0 THEN ABS(SUM(M3.M3_6)) else 0 End  AS Payments,
	  CHAR(255)+CHAR(255)+CHAR(255) as Dt,
	  '' as bk,
	  CHAR(48) as Vno,
	  '' as BookName
	  FROM M3
	  WHERE M3.M3_2 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)AND M3_4 = @BANK  ) 
	  AS Z ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno) AS Y ORDER BY dt,CD,Vno,[DATE],CAST(RIGHT([VOUCHERNO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([VOUCHERNO]))-1)  AS NUMERIC(18,0))
   
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CITYMASTER_Q]
@what     nvarchar(15)='', 
@sm1_3	  nvarchar(50)='', ----usrid
@unqid	  nvarchar(50)='', ----unqid
@sm1_5	  nvarchar(50)='', ----city
@sm1_6	  nvarchar(50)='', ----citycode
@sm1_7	  nvarchar(36)='', ----state unqid
@sm1_100  nvarchar(50)='',  ----ip
@sm1_8	  nvarchar(50)='',  ----zipcode
@sm1_9    nvarchar(50)='',  ----longitude
@sm1_10   nvarchar(50)='',   ----latitude
@country  nvarchar(50)='',	---country
@name     nvarchar(50)='', ---Satename
@GCode   nvarchar(50)='',	---Gst Code	
@user   nvarchar(50)=''		---user 
AS	
BEGIN

IF @what = 'INSERT'
BEGIN 
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm01] 
	(	[sm1_1],
		[sm1_2],
		[sm1_3],
		[unqid],
		[sm1_5],
		[sm1_6],
		[sm1_7],
		[sm1_100],
		[SM1_8],
		[sm1_9],
		[sm1_10])
				
		Values
		(
		dbo.entrydate(),
		dbo.entrydate(),		
		@sm1_3,
		newid(),
		@sm1_5,
		@sm1_6,
		@sm1_7,
		@sm1_100,
		@sm1_8,
		@sm1_9,
		@sm1_10)

		end


  if @what = 'Update'
BEGIN
Update sm01 set sm1_2=getutcdate()
               ,sm1_5=@sm1_5	
               ,sm1_6=@sm1_6	
               ,sm1_7=@sm1_7
			   ,sm1_8=@sm1_8
			   ,sm1_9=@sm1_9
			   ,sm1_10=@sm1_10 from sm01 where unqid=@unqid;
			   end
			   
 if @what = 'Delete'
BEGIN
Delete From sm01 where unqid=@unqid;
END
 if @what = 'SelectById'
BEGIN
select unqid as unq
       ,sm1_5 as city
       ,sm1_7 as statecode
       ,sm1_6 as citycode
	   ,SM1_8 as zipcode
	   ,sm1_9 as longitude
	   ,sm1_10 as latitude from sm01 where unqid=@unqid;
	   end


if @what = 'SelectAll'
BEGIN
Select * from sm01 order by sm1_1; 
END

		
IF @what = 'StateDrop'
Begin
select * from sm205 order by sm205_5 ;
end

		
IF @what = 'DisplayRecords'
Begin
select unqid, sm1_6, sm1_5 from sm01
end


 if @what = 'CityCode'
BEGIN 
select MAX (CAST( sm1_6 as INT)) from sm01
 end
end	

if @what='Table_Bind'
BEGIN
select unqid , sm2_5 as country_name from sm02
END

if @what='Insert_Data'

if(select count(*) from sm205 where sm205_5=@name) = 0
BEGIN
insert into sm205 (sm205_1, sm205_2, sm205_3, unqid, sm205_100, sm205_5, sm205_7, sm205_8) Values (GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @user, newid(), @sm1_100, @name, @GCode, @country)
select 'Save Successfully' as err
END
else
BEGIN
select 'State Already Exist!' as err
END

if @what='Update_Data'
BEGIN
update sm205 set sm205_5 =@name, sm205_7 =@GCode, sm205_8 =@country where unqid=@unqid
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_For_Consignee]
@WHAT NVARCHAR(20)='',   
@ENTRYDATE datetime  = '',  
@MODIFYDATE   datetime = '',
@USERID NVARCHAR(20) ='',
@unqid nvarchar(50) = '',
@NAME nvarchar(200) = '',
@PRINTNAME  nvarchar(200) = '',
@ADDRESS  nvarchar(MAX) = '',
@CITY nvarchar(50) = '',
@PINCODE nvarchar(50)='',
@STATE nvarchar(50) = '',
@COUNTRY  nvarchar(50) = '',
@GSTIN  NVARCHAR(16) = '',       
@IP  NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@BRANCHID     NVARCHAR(max) = '',   
@CUSTID     NVARCHAR(max) = ''    ---sm19 customer/account name---
	
	
AS
BEGIN
	 IF @WHAT='COUNTRY'
	 
	 BEGIN
     SELECT UNQID as UNQID, sm2_5 as Country from sm02 order by  Country
	 END

	
     IF @WHAT = 'CITY'
     BEGIN
	 select UNQID AS UNQID, sm1_5 as city  from sm01 order by SM1_5 
     END

     IF @WHAT = 'CUSTOMERNAME'
     BEGIN
     SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNT NAME] FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11='cust' ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC
     END


	 IF @what='ALL_DD'
BEGIN
---TABLE 1
SELECT SM2_5 AS COUNTRY,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM02 ORDER BY COUNTRY

----TABLE2
SELECT SM205_5 AS STATENAME ,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM205 ORDER BY sm205_5

---TABLE3
SELECT SM1_5 AS CITY,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM01  ORDER BY SM1_5 

----TABLE4
SELECT SM19_5 AS [SUPPNAME],UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC
END


IF @what='getstate'
begin
SELECT SM205_5 AS STATENAME,UNQID AS VALUE from sm205 WHERE SM205_8=@unqid ORDER BY SM205_5
end

if @what='getcity'
begin
SELECT SM1_5 AS CITY,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM01 where sm1_7=@unqid ORDER BY SM1_5
end


   IF @WHAT = 'SAVE'
   BEGIN
   INSERT INTO sm1003 (sm1003_1, sm1003_2, sm1003_3, sm1003_4, sm1003_5, sm1003_6, sm1003_7, sm1003_8, sm1003_9, sm1003_10, sm1003_11, sm1003_12,sm1003_13, sm1003_14,sm1003_15,sm1003_17)
   VALUES(GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @USERID, NEWID(),'', @NAME, @PRINTNAME, @ADDRESS, @CITY, @STATE, @COUNTRY,  @GSTIN, @IP, @BRANCHID,  @CUSTID, @PINCODE);
   END

     IF @WHAT = 'FETCH'
   BEGIN
           SELECT sm1003_4 As UNQID, upper(sm1003_6) AS [NAME],  upper(sm1003_7) as [PRINTNAME] , sm1003_8 as [ADDRESS] , sm01.sm1_5   as CITY,   sm1003_10   as STATE, sm1003_11   as COUNTRY, sm1003_12   as GSTIN , sm19.sm19_5  as [CUSTOMERNAME]  FROM sm1003
          INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1003.sm1003_15 
	      INNER JOIN sm01 ON sm01.unqid = sm1003.sm1003_9;
   END 

IF @what = 'GETONE'
BEGIN
	SELECT sm1003_4 AS UNQID, upper(sm1003_6) AS [NAME],  upper(sm1003_7) as [PRINTNAME] ,  sm1003_8 as [ADDRESS] , sm1003_9   as CITY, sm1003_10   as STATE, sm1003_11   as COUNTRY,  sm1003_12   as GSTIN , LOWER(sm1003_15) as CUSTOMERNAME ,sm1003_17 as PINCODE
	 FROM DBO.SM1003 WHERE sm1003_4 = @UNQID;

	
END


      IF @what='update'
   BEGIN
   UPDATE sm1003 
   SET  sm1003_6 = @NAME, sm1003_7 = @PRINTNAME, sm1003_8 = @ADDRESS, sm1003_9 = @CITY, sm1003_10 = @STATE, sm1003_11 = @COUNTRY, sm1003_12 = @GSTIN, sm1003_15 = @CUSTID, sm1003_17 = @PINCODE
   WHERE sm1003_4 = @unqid 
   END

   
     IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
   BEGIN
           DELETE FROM sm1003 WHERE sm1003_4 = @unqid
   END

   
	 IF @WHAT = 'edit'
	 BEGIN
     UPDATE sm1003
     SET sm1003_6 = @NAME, sm1003_7 = @PRINTNAME ,sm1003_8 = @ADDRESS, sm1003_9 = @CITY, sm1003_10 = @STATE, sm1003_11 = @COUNTRY, sm1003_12 = @GSTIN, sm1003_15 = @CUSTID, sm1003_17 = @PINCODE
     WHERE sm1003_4 = @unqid

     END


	 IF @what = 'SelectById'
    BEGIN
    SELECT sm1003_6  as [NAME]
	      ,sm1003_7 AS PRINTNAME
	      ,sm1003_8 AS [ADDRESS]
	      ,sm1003_9 AS CITY
	      ,sm1003_10 AS [STATE]
	      ,sm1003_11 AS COUNTRY
	      ,sm1003_12 AS GSTIN
	      , SM1003_15 as CUSTID
		  , SM1003_17 as PINCODE
	   FROM sm1003 where sm1003_4  = @unqid
	  END

END 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CONTRIBUTION_REPORT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CONTRIBUTION_REPORT]
AS
declare 
@BRANCH as nvarchar(max), 
@PRODUCT as nvarchar(max),
@PRODUCTUNQ as nvarchar(max),
@recieptDATE as nvarchar(50),
@RECEIPTQTY as Numeric(18,3),
@COST as Numeric(18,2),
@tqty as numeric(18,3),
@unqid as nvarchar(max),
@salesqty as numeric(18,3)

BEGIN 




set @branch = '9C9E1E38-DF30-4CFA-8311-8432D8F3B700';
select *,cast(0.00 as numeric(18,2))as cost into #t from sm1011
--left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
 where sm1011_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'  and
	  sm1011_41 = @branch 
	  --and sm1008_30='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	  --AND sm1011_13='3CF013DE-3F66-437E-BD50-25F4A7104994'

select * into #t1 from #t

	   DECLARE PRODUCT_cursor CURSOR FOR SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206
	   OPEN PRODUCT_cursor
	    FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO  @PRODUCTUNQ
		   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		   BEGIN 

	   DECLARE  sales_cursor CURSOR FOR SELECT 
	   #t.unqid,cast(sm1011_42/1000 as numeric(18,3))as salesqty from #t
	   left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30 
	       WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'  and
	  sm1011_41 = @branch
	  and sm1008_30='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	  AND sm1011_13=@PRODUCTUNQ
	  order by sm1011_6,cast(sm1011_7 as numeric(18,0))
	  BEGIN
   -- Open the cursor
   OPEN sales_cursor;
 

	 DECLARE stock_cursor CURSOR FOR 
	 SELECT 
	SM1005_7 AS BRANCH,
		SM1005_10 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1005_6 AS [recieptDATE], 
         sm1005_57  AS RECEIPTQTY, 
   (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28) AS COST
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10 
	left join sm1008 on sm1005.sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
    WHERE SM1005_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'  
	 and sm1005_7 = @branch
	 and sm1008_30 IS NULL
	 	 AND SM1005_10=@PRODUCTUNQ
	 
	 

	 union all
		SELECT 
    sm1023.sm1023_4 AS branch,
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
    sm1023.sm1023_5 AS [recieptDATE],
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c8 AS RECEIPTQTY,
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c13 AS COST
FROM sm1023
INNER JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
WHERE
    sm1023.sm1023_5 = '2025-03-31' AND 
    sm1023.sm1023_4 = @branch AND 
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 = @PRODUCTUNQ
GROUP BY 
    sm1023.sm1023_4, 
    sm1023_c.sm1023_c6,
    sm1023.sm1023_5,
	sm1023_c.sm1023_c8,
	sm1023_c.sm1023_c13
ORDER BY 
  Product,    [recieptDATE];

BEGIN
   -- Open the cursor
   OPEN stock_cursor;


   -- Fetch rows from the cursor
   FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor INTO @BRANCH, @PRODUCT,@recieptDATE,@RECEIPTQTY,@COST
   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
   BEGIN
     -- PRINT 'BRANCH: ' + @BRANCH + ', PRODUCT: ' + @PRODUCT ,'BRANCH: ' + @BRANCH + ','BRANCH: ' + @BRANCH + '
	 
	 
	 
	  set @tqty=@RECEIPTQTY
	  FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor INTO @unqid, @salesqty 

	  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 and @tqty>=0
	  begin
	 
	  
	  set @tqty=@tqty-@salesqty
	  if @tqty<=0
	  begin 
	 -- break 
	     FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor INTO @BRANCH, @PRODUCT,@recieptDATE,@RECEIPTQTY,@COST;
		 set @tqty=@RECEIPTQTY

	  end 
	   PRINT 'tqty: ' + cast(@tqty as nvarchar(50)) + ', COST: ' + cast(@COST as nvarchar(50)) + 'sqty: ' + cast(@salesqty as nvarchar(50)) 
	  update #t1 set cost=@COST where unqid=@unqid
	  
	  FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor INTO @unqid, @salesqty
	  end

      FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor INTO @BRANCH, @PRODUCT,@recieptDATE,@RECEIPTQTY,@COST;
   END;
   	  
   CLOSE sales_cursor;  
   DEALLOCATE sales_cursor;
     CLOSE stock_cursor;
   DEALLOCATE stock_cursor;
      FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO  @PRODUCTUNQ
   END 
   -- Close the cursor

END;

end






   -- Deallocate the cursor
CLOSE PRODUCT_cursor;
DEALLOCATE PRODUCT_cursor;


 
   
END

--FROM (

--) AS AA
--where  product='SODA ASH LIGHT- 50 KG BAG'
--GROUP BY INVDATE, PRODUCT
--ORDER BY INVDATE, PRODUCT

SELECT 
    PRODUCT,
    INVDATE,
    SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    AVG(sellINGrate) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
    CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS COST,
    SUM(SALEAMT) AS [SELL VALUE],
    CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [SELL PR],
	  (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) 
     - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)))as contpr,
    (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) 
     - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)))
    * SUM(SELLQTY) AS CONTRIBUTION

 FROM
(
select sm19_5 as custname,sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,sm1011_6 as INVdate ,sm1011_7 AS INVNO,CAST(sm1011_42 /1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3))AS SELLQTY,
sm1011_19*1000 as sellINGrate,(cost)as cost,sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
from #t1 left join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=#t1.sm1011_13
left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
where sm1011_41 = @branch 
and sm1008_30='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
UNION ALL
select sm19_5 as custname,sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,sm1011_6 as INVdate ,sm1011_7 AS INVNO,CAST(sm1011_42 /1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3))AS SELLQTY,
sm1011_19*1000 as sellINGrate, (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28)as cost,sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
from sm1011 left join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011_13
left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
where sm1011_41 = @branch 
and sm1008_30<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

)AS AA
where product = 'SULPHURIC ACID 98%' 


GROUP BY INVDATE, PRODUCT
ORDER BY INVDATE, PRODUCt

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CREDIT_WORTHINESS] 
@WHAT		NVARCHAR(40)  ='',
@USERID		NVARCHAR(3)   ='',
@SYSTEMNAME NVARCHAR(100) ='',
@CRLIMIT    NVARCHAR(50)  ='', ---creditlimit
@EXCR       NVARCHAR(50)  ='',   ----extended cr limit
@validupto  NVARCHAR(100)  ='',  ---------vaild upto date
@oddays     NVARCHAR(50)  ='',   ----All O/D Days
@prefix    NVARCHAR(50)  ='',     ---(ex/ od)
@WHO    NVARCHAR(50)  ='',     ---(H1/H2/MD)
@BRANCH  NVARCHAR(MAX)  ='', 
@IN_1       NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--ENTRY DATE
@IN_2		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--MODIFY DATE
@IN_3		NVARCHAR(30)  ='',--USER ID	
@IN_4		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--SYSTEM NAME
@IN_5		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--SALE INV ID
@IN_6		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--DR/CR
@IN_7		NVARCHAR(50)  ='',--BK(BP,JJ,OO ETC.)
@IN_8		NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--INVOICE DATE
@IN_9		NVARCHAR(36)  ='',--INVOICE AMOUNT
@IN_10		NVARCHAR(50)  ='', --TRUE/FALSE
@IN_11		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--DUE AMOUNT
@IN_12		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',--ACCOUNT UNQID
@IN_13		NVARCHAR(30)  = '', --CHALALN NO

@IN_14		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@unqid               NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@PARTY    NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@FROMAMOUNT          NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TOAMOUNT            NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@TIMEDIFF            INT           = 0,
@AGING            INT           = 0,
@AMTTYPE    NVARCHAR(20)  = '', -- 'Above', 'Equal', 'Below'
@AMOUNT      NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', -- Comparison amount--Due DATE
 @fetch nvarchar(50)=''

AS
BEGIN
	if @what ='ALL_DD'
	BEGIN

	---table1----

	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [VALUE], SM19_5 AS [PARTY]  FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' order by SM19_5
	 ---table2----
     SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [VALUE], SM19_5 AS [GROUP]  FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' order by SM19_5 -----group

     ----grid---
	 SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [VALUE], SM19_5 AS [GROUP]  FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'CUST' order by SM19_5  ---group
	END 

IF @what ='FetchDetails'
BEGIN


	---invn details---
	

SELECT 
        unqid AS INVUNQID,
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = IN_12) AS PARTYNAME,
        (SELECT SM19_57 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = IN_12) AS CRLIMIT,
        (SELECT SM19_56 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = IN_12) AS CRDAYS,
        IN_13 AS INVNO,  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_8), 120) AS INVDATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), 
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14), 120) AS DUEDATE, 
		datediff(DAY, in_8, in_14) as DDOUT,
		(SELECT SM206_6 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = INVN.IN_5)) AS [PROD],
		(case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()) end)  AS OD,
		(IN_9) AS INVAMT, (case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end) AS DUEAMT
     
    FROM INVN 
    WHERE IN_7 = 'OO' AND In_11 <> 0 AND IN_12 = @SELECTEDPARTIES

  


SELECT 
    SUM(OVERDUEDAYS) AS DELAYDAYS, 
    COUNT(*) AS INVOICES,  
    SUM(INVAMT) AS TOTALINVAMT,  
    SUM(DUEAMT) AS TOTALDUEAMT, 
    SUM(UNADJUSTAMT) AS TOTALUNADJUSTAMT,
    CUSTUNQID
FROM (
    SELECT 
        IN_12 AS CUSTUNQID,
        IN_9 AS INVAMT,
         (case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end) AS DUEAMT,
        (case when IN_11 < 0 then abs(IN_11) Else 0.00 end ) AS UNADJUSTAMT,
        (case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()) end)  AS OVERDUEDAYS
		 
    FROM INVN 
    WHERE IN_7 = 'OO'  and in_11<>0 AND IN_12 = @SELECTEDPARTIES
) a  
GROUP BY CUSTUNQID;
------------------------------------------------------CR Details --------------------------------

SELECT top 5 UNQID AS VALUE,  sm1021_12 AS [BY],CASE WHEN SM1021_11 = 'OD' THEN 'OD ' + CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days on ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)
ELSE 'Normal On ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)END AS [DESCRIPTION]FROM  sm1021 WHERE sm1021_5 = @SELECTEDPARTIES order by sm1021_8 desc;
------------------------------------------------MD-------------------------------------------
SELECT top 1 SM1021_7 as EXLIMIT,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM1021_9), 120) as VALIDUPTO, CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days' as ODDAY 
FROM sm1021 WHERE sm1021_12 = 'MD' and sm1021_5 =@SELECTEDPARTIES order by SM1021_8 desc;

------------------------------------------------H2-------------------------------------------
SELECT top 1 SM1021_7 as EXLIMIT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM1021_9), 120) as VALIDUPTO, CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days' as ODDAY 
FROM sm1021 WHERE sm1021_12 = 'H2' and sm1021_5 =@SELECTEDPARTIES order by SM1021_8 desc;
------------------------------------------------H1-------------------------------------------
SELECT top 1 SM1021_7 as EXLIMIT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM1021_9), 120) as VALIDUPTO, CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days' as ODDAY 
FROM sm1021 WHERE sm1021_12 = 'H1' and sm1021_5 =@SELECTEDPARTIES order by SM1021_8 desc;

END





IF @WHAT = 'INSERTONE'
BEGIN 
---------------------------------------Permanently updating sm19 cr limit by MD------------------------
set @fetch  = newid();
           INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1021]
           ([sm1021_1],[sm1021_2],[sm1021_3],[unqid],[sm1021_4],[sm1021_5],[sm1021_6],[sm1021_7],[sm1021_8],[sm1021_9],[sm1021_10],[sm1021_11],[sm1021_12],[sm1021_13] )
			VALUES(
			dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@USERID, @fetch,@SYSTEMNAME,@SELECTEDPARTIES, @CRLIMIT, 0.00, GETDATE(),GETDATE(),0, 'N', @who, @BRANCH) 
		----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

		   update sm19 set SM19_57 = @CRLIMIT where unqid = @SELECTEDPARTIES

           SELECT TOP 20 UNQID AS VALUE,  sm1021_12 AS [BY],CASE WHEN SM1021_11 = 'OD' THEN 'OD ' + CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days on ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)
           ELSE 'Normal On ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)END AS [DESCRIPTION]FROM  sm1021 WHERE  sm1021_5 = @SELECTEDPARTIES order by sm1021_8 desc;
		
END

IF @WHAT = 'INSERTWO'
BEGIN 
           INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1021]
           ([sm1021_1],[sm1021_2],[sm1021_3],[unqid],[sm1021_4],[sm1021_5],[sm1021_6],[sm1021_7],[sm1021_8],[sm1021_9],[sm1021_10],[sm1021_11],[sm1021_12],[sm1021_13])
			VALUES(
			dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@USERID,NEWID(),@SYSTEMNAME,@SELECTEDPARTIES, 0.00, @EXCR, GETDATE(),@validupto, 0, 'EX', @who, @BRANCH)
			----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
           SELECT TOP 20 UNQID AS VALUE,  sm1021_12 AS [BY],CASE WHEN SM1021_11 = 'OD' THEN 'OD ' + CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days on ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)
           ELSE 'Normal On ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)END AS [DESCRIPTION]FROM  sm1021 WHERE  sm1021_5 = @SELECTEDPARTIES order by sm1021_8 desc;
		
END

IF @WHAT = 'INSERTTHREE'
BEGIN 
           INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1021]
           ([sm1021_1],[sm1021_2],[sm1021_3],[unqid],[sm1021_4],[sm1021_5],[sm1021_6],[sm1021_7],[sm1021_8],[sm1021_9],[sm1021_10],[sm1021_11],[sm1021_12] ,[sm1021_13])
			VALUES(
			dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@USERID,NEWID(),@SYSTEMNAME,@SELECTEDPARTIES, 0.00, 0.00, GETDATE(),GETDATE(), @oddays, 'OD', @who , @BRANCH)

				----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
           SELECT TOP 20 UNQID AS VALUE,  sm1021_12 AS [BY],CASE WHEN SM1021_11 = 'OD' THEN 'OD ' + CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days on ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)
           ELSE 'Normal On ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)END AS [DESCRIPTION]FROM  sm1021 WHERE  sm1021_5 = @SELECTEDPARTIES order by sm1021_8 desc;
		
END


IF @WHAT = 'PSRL_EXCR'
BEGIN 
   --        INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1021]
   --        ([sm1021_1],[sm1021_2],[sm1021_3],[unqid],[sm1021_4],[sm1021_5],[sm1021_6],[sm1021_7],[sm1021_8],[sm1021_9],[sm1021_10],[sm1021_11],[sm1021_12],[sm1021_13])
			--VALUES(
			--dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@USERID,NEWID(),@SYSTEMNAME,(select data from dbo.split  (@SELECTEDPARTIES,',')), 0.00, (select data from dbo.split  (@EXCR,',')), GETDATE(),@validupto, 0, 'EX', @who, (select data from dbo.split  (@BRANCH,',')))
			------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
   --        SELECT TOP 20 UNQID AS VALUE,  sm1021_12 AS [BY],CASE WHEN SM1021_11 = 'OD' THEN 'OD ' + CAST(sm1021_10 AS VARCHAR) + ' Days on ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)
   --        ELSE 'Normal On ' + CAST(sm1021_8 AS VARCHAR)END AS [DESCRIPTION]FROM  sm1021 WHERE  sm1021_5 = @SELECTEDPARTIES order by sm1021_8 desc;






-- Splitting the values
DECLARE @PARTIES TABLE (ID NVARCHAR(50))
DECLARE @EXCR_VALUES TABLE (VALUE DECIMAL(18,2))
DECLARE @BRANCHES TABLE (ID NVARCHAR(50))
DECLARE @VALIDTILL_VALUES TABLE (ID nvarchar(100))

INSERT INTO @PARTIES (ID)
SELECT DATA FROM dbo.Split(@SELECTEDPARTIES, ',')

INSERT INTO @EXCR_VALUES (VALUE)
SELECT CAST(DATA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM dbo.Split(@EXCR, ',')

INSERT INTO @BRANCHES (ID)
SELECT DATA FROM dbo.Split(@BRANCH, ',')

INSERT INTO @VALIDTILL_VALUES (ID)
SELECT DATA FROM dbo.Split(@validupto, ',')

-- Loop through the split values and insert into the table
DECLARE @PARTY_ID NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @EXCR_VALUE DECIMAL(18,2)
DECLARE @BRANCH_ID NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @VALIDTILL_VALUE nvarchar(100)

DECLARE PARTY_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT ID FROM @PARTIES
DECLARE EXCR_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT VALUE FROM @EXCR_VALUES
DECLARE BRANCH_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT ID FROM @BRANCHES
DECLARE VALIDTILL_CURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT ID FROM @VALIDTILL_VALUES

OPEN PARTY_CURSOR
OPEN EXCR_CURSOR
OPEN BRANCH_CURSOR
OPEN VALIDTILL_CURSOR

FETCH NEXT FROM PARTY_CURSOR INTO @PARTY_ID
FETCH NEXT FROM EXCR_CURSOR INTO @EXCR_VALUE
FETCH NEXT FROM BRANCH_CURSOR INTO @BRANCH_ID
FETCH NEXT FROM VALIDTILL_CURSOR INTO @VALIDTILL_VALUE

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1021]
           ([sm1021_1],[sm1021_2],[sm1021_3],[unqid],[sm1021_4],[sm1021_5],[sm1021_6],[sm1021_7],[sm1021_8],[sm1021_9],[sm1021_10],[sm1021_11],[sm1021_12] ,[sm1021_13])
    VALUES
         	
			(dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@USERID,NEWID(),@SYSTEMNAME, @PARTY_ID, 0.00, @EXCR_VALUE, GETDATE(), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@VALIDTILL_VALUE), 0, 'EX', 'MD', @BRANCH_ID)

    FETCH NEXT FROM PARTY_CURSOR INTO @PARTY_ID
    FETCH NEXT FROM EXCR_CURSOR INTO @EXCR_VALUE
    FETCH NEXT FROM BRANCH_CURSOR INTO @BRANCH_ID
	 FETCH NEXT FROM VALIDTILL_CURSOR INTO @VALIDTILL_VALUE
END

CLOSE PARTY_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE PARTY_CURSOR
CLOSE EXCR_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE EXCR_CURSOR
CLOSE BRANCH_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE BRANCH_CURSOR
CLOSE VALIDTILL_CURSOR
DEALLOCATE VALIDTILL_CURSOR


		
END

END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CREDITNOTE_APPROVAL_Q]
@WHAT	 AS  NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@UNQID	 AS  NVARCHAR(36) = '' 

 AS 
 BEGIN

IF @WHAT = 'GRID'
BEGIN
		 SELECT  SM213.UNQID AS UNQID, FORMAT(SM213_34,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [CN DATE],SM213_33 AS [CN NO],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213.SM213_10) AS [CUST NAME],
		 SM213_23 AS [AMOUNT],SM213_24 AS [REMARK], (CASE WHEN SM213_25 <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 'APPROVE' WHEN SM213_36 = 'REJECTED'
		 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'UNAPPROVE' END) AS [STATUS] FROM SM213
		 WHERE SM213_35 ='C#' AND SM213_25 = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY SM213_34 DESC,RIGHT(SM213_33 , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE(SM213_33))-1) DESC

		 SELECT '' AS UNQID, 'No Records Found' AS [CN DATE],'' AS [CN NO],'' AS [CUST NAME],'' AS [AMOUNT],'' AS [REMARK],'' AS [STATUS]
END

IF @WHAT = 'APPROVED_OR_NOT'
BEGIN
		SELECT (CASE WHEN SM213_25 <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 'APPROVE' WHEN SM213_36 = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'UNAPPROVE' END) FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID = @UNQID
END

IF @WHAT = 'REJECT'
BEGIN
		UPDATE SM213 SET SM213_36 ='REJECTED' WHERE SM213.UNQID = @UNQID
END

 END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CREDITNOTE_REGISTER_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CREDITNOTE_REGISTER_Q]
@a			NVARCHAR(20) = '',	
@unqid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = ''

AS

IF @a = 'SALE_RETURN_REGISTER'
BEGIN
--set @fromdate = '01/01/2019'
--set @todate = '01/01/2020'

-----------------------------CREDIT NOTE REGISTER

SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))
+ ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA


SELECT * FROM(
SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),sm213_34,103) AS [RETURN DATE],sm213_33 AS [RETURN NO],
CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM213_6,103) AS [DATE],SM213_8 +'/'+SM213_9 AS [INVOICE_NO],'' AS [PRODUCT_CODE],SM213_C6 AS [PRODUCT_HSN],
(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) AS [NAME],
--sm213_31 AS [GSTIN],
(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [GSTIN],
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [STATE_CODE],
UPPER(LEFT(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))),2,LEN(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))))))AS [STATE],
SUM(SM213_C9) AS [PRODUCT_QUANTITY],SM213_17 AS [AMOUNT_CREDITED],'' AS [FRIEGHT_AMOUNT],(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM213_C15)
AS [GST@],SM213_17 AS [TAXABLE_AMOUNT],'' AS [TRANSFER/EXEMPLED],SM213_20 AS [IGST_AMOUNT],SM213_19 AS [SGST_AMOUNT],SM213_18 AS [CGST_AMOUNT],
SM213_23 AS [TOTAL_AMOUNT] FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM213_34) BETWEEN
DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM213_35 = 'C#' 
GROUP BY sm213_34,sm213_33,SM213_6,SM213_8 +'/'+SM213_9,SM213_C6,SM213_10,SM213_17,SM213_18,SM213_19,SM213_23,sm213_c15,sm213_20,SM213_31
) AS AA ORDER BY dbo.getformatteddate([RETURN DATE]),CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL([RETURN NO],'')='' then 0 else RIGHT([RETURN NO] , CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([RETURN NO]))-1) END AS NUMERIC(15)) ASC

END


GO

-- [A_SP_FOR_SALE_REPORT]   'SALEREPORT'
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_CURRENTPERFOMANCE_REPORT]  

@WHAT AS NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@branchid nvarchar(100)='',
@SM1002_5 nvarchar(100)='',
@groupid nvarchar(150)='',
@staffname nvarchar(150)='',
@top nvarchar(50)=''
AS
DECLARE @StartDate DATE =
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 
            THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4, 1)
        ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1, 4, 1)
    END;


	DECLARE @FYStart DATE =
    DATEFROMPARTS(
        CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 END,
        4, 1
    );

DECLARE @FYEnd DATE =
    DATEFROMPARTS(
        CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1 ELSE YEAR(GETDATE()) END,
        3, 31
    );

if @what='drop'
begin
--select Account_name from  AccountMas1308 INNER JOIN GroupMas  
--ON Account_GroupId=GROUP_ID  where group_name in ('Sundry Debtors A');
--select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff, '''' + REPLACE(LTRIM(sm502_18),',', ''',''') +'''' as sm502_18
--from  sm502 as b
--inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  
select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  order by staff

end



if @what='branchid'


begin
select sm1002_5 as branchid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  
 where sm502_4=@staffname 
end

if @what='groupname'



begin
SELECT STUFF(
    (
        SELECT ',' + sm44_7
        FROM SM44
        WHERE UNQID IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
, 1, 1, '') AS groupname;
end

if @what='getbranchid'


begin
SELECT sm502_21 as branchid from sm502 where sm502_4=@staffname
end


IF (@WHAT ='PRODUCTREPORT' and @top='0') 

BEGIN


WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        OP.sm206_7 AS Product,
        ID.sm1011_6 AS [Date],
        SUM(ID.sm1011_20) AS Total_Quantity,
        SUM(ID.sm1011_24) AS Total_Amount
    FROM sm1011 ID
    INNER JOIN sm19 A   ON ID.sm1011_10 = A.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm206 OP ON ID.sm1011_13 = OP.sm206_2
    RIGHT JOIN sm44 G   ON G.unqid = A.sm19_7
    WHERE 
        ID.sm1011_41 = @branchid
        AND G.sm44_7 IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        AND ID.sm1011_6 >= @StartDate
        AND ID.sm1011_6 <= GETDATE()
    GROUP BY OP.sm206_7, ID.sm1011_6
),

MonthData AS (
    SELECT
        Product,
        DATENAME(MONTH, [Date]) + ' ' + CAST(YEAR([Date]) AS VARCHAR) AS MonthLabel,
        SUM(Total_Quantity) AS Total_Quantity,
        SUM(Total_Amount) AS Total_Amount
    FROM BaseData
    GROUP BY 
        Product,
        YEAR([Date]),
        MONTH([Date]),
        DATENAME(MONTH, [Date])
),

PivotSource AS (
    SELECT Product, MonthLabel + '_Qty' AS ColName, Total_Quantity AS Val
    FROM MonthData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Product, MonthLabel + '_Amt', Total_Amount
    FROM MonthData
)

SELECT
    Product,

    ISNULL([April 2025_Qty], 0) AS [April 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([April 2025_Amt], 0) AS [April 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([May 2025_Qty], 0) AS [May 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([May 2025_Amt], 0) AS [May 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([June 2025_Qty], 0) AS [June 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([June 2025_Amt], 0) AS [June 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([July 2025_Qty], 0) AS [July 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([July 2025_Amt], 0) AS [July 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([August 2025_Qty], 0) AS [August 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([August 2025_Amt], 0) AS [August 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([September 2025_Qty], 0) AS [September 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([September 2025_Amt], 0) AS [September 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([October 2025_Qty], 0) AS [October 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([October 2025_Amt], 0) AS [October 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([November 2025_Qty], 0) AS [November 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([November 2025_Amt], 0) AS [November 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([December 2025_Qty], 0) AS [December 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([December 2025_Amt], 0) AS [December 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([January 2026_Qty], 0) AS [January 2026_Qty],
    ISNULL([January 2026_Amt], 0) AS [January 2026_Amt],

    ISNULL([February 2026_Qty], 0) AS [February 2026_Qty],
    ISNULL([February 2026_Amt], 0) AS [February 2026_Amt],

    ISNULL([March 2026_Qty], 0) AS [March 2026_Qty],
    ISNULL([March 2026_Amt], 0) AS [March 2026_Amt],
	 /* --------- COMPUTE TOTALS --------- */
    (
        ISNULL([April 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([May 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([June 2025_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([July 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([August 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([September 2025_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([October 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([November 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([December 2025_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([January 2026_Qty],0) + ISNULL([February 2026_Qty],0) + ISNULL([March 2026_Qty],0)
    ) AS Total_Qty,

    (
        ISNULL([April 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([May 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([June 2025_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([July 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([August 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([September 2025_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([October 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([November 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([December 2025_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([January 2026_Amt],0) + ISNULL([February 2026_Amt],0) + ISNULL([March 2026_Amt],0)
    ) AS Total_Amt

FROM PivotSource
PIVOT (
    SUM(Val)
    FOR ColName IN (
        [April 2025_Qty], [April 2025_Amt],
        [May 2025_Qty], [May 2025_Amt],
        [June 2025_Qty], [June 2025_Amt],
        [July 2025_Qty], [July 2025_Amt],
        [August 2025_Qty], [August 2025_Amt],
        [September 2025_Qty], [September 2025_Amt],
        [October 2025_Qty], [October 2025_Amt],
        [November 2025_Qty], [November 2025_Amt],
        [December 2025_Qty], [December 2025_Amt],
        [January 2026_Qty], [January 2026_Amt],
        [February 2026_Qty], [February 2026_Amt],
        [March 2026_Qty], [March 2026_Amt]
    )
) AS Pvt
 ORDER BY Total_Qty DESC;





END


IF (@WHAT ='PRODUCTREPORT' and @top='5') 
BEGIN

    ISNULL([November 2025_Qty], 0) AS [November 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([November 2025_Amt], 0) AS [November 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([December 2025_Qty], 0) AS [December 2025_Qty],
    ISNULL([December 2025_Amt], 0) AS [December 2025_Amt],

    ISNULL([February 2026_Qty], 0) AS [February 2026_Qty],
    ISNULL([February 2026_Amt], 0) AS [February 2026_Amt],

    ISNULL([March 2026_Qty], 0) AS [March 2026_Qty],
    ISNULL([March 2026_Amt], 0) AS [March 2026_Amt],
	 /* --------- COMPUTE TOTALS --------- */
    (
        ISNULL([April 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([May 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([June 2025_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([July 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([August 2025_Qty],0) + ISNULL([September 2025_Qty],0) +

        ISNULL([January 2026_Qty],0) + ISNULL([February 2026_Qty],0) + ISNULL([March 2026_Qty],0)
    ) AS Total_Qty,

        ISNULL([April 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([May 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([June 2025_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([July 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([August 2025_Amt],0) + ISNULL([September 2025_Amt],0) +

        ISNULL([January 2026_Amt],0) + ISNULL([February 2026_Amt],0) + ISNULL([March 2026_Amt],0)
    ) AS Total_Amt


FROM PivotSource
PIVOT (
    SUM(Val)
    FOR ColName IN (
        [April 2025_Qty], [April 2025_Amt],
        [May 2025_Qty], [May 2025_Amt],
        [June 2025_Qty], [June 2025_Amt],

BEGIN


WITH MonthData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.sm19_5 AS Account_Name,
        G.sm44_7 AS Group_Name,
        OP.sm206_7 AS Product,
        DATENAME(MONTH, ID.sm1011_6) AS Month_Name,
        MONTH(ID.sm1011_6) AS Month_No,
        SUM(ID.sm1011_20) AS Total_Quantity,
        SUM(ID.sm1011_24) AS Total_Amount
    FROM sm1011 ID
    INNER JOIN sm19 A   ON ID.sm1011_10 = A.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm206 OP ON ID.sm1011_13 = OP.sm206_2
    RIGHT JOIN sm44 G   ON G.unqid = A.sm19_7
    WHERE 
        ID.sm1011_41 =@branchid
        AND G.sm44_7 IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        AND ID.sm1011_6 BETWEEN @FYStart AND @FYEnd
    GROUP BY 
        A.sm19_5, G.sm44_7, OP.sm206_7,
        DATENAME(MONTH, ID.sm1011_6),
        MONTH(ID.sm1011_6)
)



SELECT 
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,

    ISNULL([April_Qty],0)   AS Apr_Qty,
    ISNULL([April_Amt],0)   AS Apr_Amt,
    ISNULL([May_Qty],0)     AS May_Qty,
    ISNULL([May_Amt],0)     AS May_Amt,
    ISNULL([June_Qty],0)    AS Jun_Qty,
    ISNULL([June_Amt],0)    AS Jun_Amt,
    ISNULL([July_Qty],0)    AS Jul_Qty,
    ISNULL([July_Amt],0)    AS Jul_Amt,
    ISNULL([August_Qty],0)  AS Aug_Qty,
    ISNULL([August_Amt],0)  AS Aug_Amt,
    ISNULL([September_Qty],0) AS Sep_Qty,
    ISNULL([September_Amt],0) AS Sep_Amt,
    ISNULL([October_Qty],0) AS Oct_Qty,
    ISNULL([October_Amt],0) AS Oct_Amt,
    ISNULL([November_Qty],0) AS Nov_Qty,
    ISNULL([November_Amt],0) AS Nov_Amt,
    ISNULL([December_Qty],0) AS Dec_Qty,
    ISNULL([December_Amt],0) AS Dec_Amt,
    ISNULL([January_Qty],0)  AS Jan_Qty,
    ISNULL([January_Amt],0)  AS Jan_Amt,
    ISNULL([February_Qty],0) AS Feb_Qty,
    ISNULL([February_Amt],0) AS Feb_Amt,
    ISNULL([March_Qty],0)    AS Mar_Qty,
    ISNULL([March_Amt],0)    AS Mar_Amt,
	(
        ISNULL([April_Qty],0) + ISNULL([May_Qty],0) + ISNULL([June_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([July_Qty],0)  + ISNULL([August_Qty],0) + ISNULL([September_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([October_Qty],0) + ISNULL([November_Qty],0) + ISNULL([December_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([January_Qty],0) + ISNULL([February_Qty],0) + ISNULL([March_Qty],0)
    ) AS Total_Qty,

    /* Total Amount for the full FY */
    (
        ISNULL([April_Amt],0) + ISNULL([May_Amt],0) + ISNULL([June_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([July_Amt],0)  + ISNULL([August_Amt],0) + ISNULL([September_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([October_Amt],0) + ISNULL([November_Amt],0) + ISNULL([December_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([January_Amt],0) + ISNULL([February_Amt],0) + ISNULL([March_Amt],0)
    ) AS Total_Amt


FROM (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        Month_Name + '_Qty' AS MonthType,
        Total_Quantity AS Value
    FROM MonthData

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        Month_Name + '_Amt' AS MonthType,
        Total_Amount AS Value
    FROM MonthData
) S
PIVOT (
    SUM(Value)
    FOR MonthType IN (
        [April_Qty],[April_Amt],
        [May_Qty],[May_Amt],
        [June_Qty],[June_Amt],
        [July_Qty],[July_Amt],
        [August_Qty],[August_Amt],
        [September_Qty],[September_Amt],
        [October_Qty],[October_Amt],
        [November_Qty],[November_Amt],
        [December_Qty],[December_Amt],
        [January_Qty],[January_Amt],
        [February_Qty],[February_Amt],
        [March_Qty],[March_Amt]
    )
) P
ORDER BY Total_Qty desc


END

        G.sm44_7 AS Group_Name,

        DATENAME(MONTH, ID.sm1011_6) AS Month_Name,
        MONTH(ID.sm1011_6) AS Month_No,
        SUM(ID.sm1011_20) AS Total_Quantity,
        SUM(ID.sm1011_24) AS Total_Amount
    FROM sm1011 ID
    INNER JOIN sm19 A   ON ID.sm1011_10 = A.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm206 OP ON ID.sm1011_13 = OP.sm206_2
    RIGHT JOIN sm44 G   ON G.unqid = A.sm19_7
    WHERE 
        ID.sm1011_41 =@branchid
        AND G.sm44_7 IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        AND ID.sm1011_6 BETWEEN @FYStart AND @FYEnd
    GROUP BY 
        A.sm19_5, G.sm44_7, OP.sm206_7,
        DATENAME(MONTH, ID.sm1011_6),
        MONTH(ID.sm1011_6)
)



SELECT Top 15
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,

    ISNULL([April_Qty],0)   AS Apr_Qty,
    ISNULL([April_Amt],0)   AS Apr_Amt,
    ISNULL([May_Qty],0)     AS May_Qty,
    ISNULL([May_Amt],0)     AS May_Amt,
    ISNULL([June_Qty],0)    AS Jun_Qty,
    ISNULL([June_Amt],0)    AS Jun_Amt,
    ISNULL([July_Qty],0)    AS Jul_Qty,
    ISNULL([July_Amt],0)    AS Jul_Amt,
    ISNULL([August_Qty],0)  AS Aug_Qty,
    ISNULL([August_Amt],0)  AS Aug_Amt,
    ISNULL([September_Qty],0) AS Sep_Qty,
    ISNULL([September_Amt],0) AS Sep_Amt,
    ISNULL([October_Qty],0) AS Oct_Qty,
    ISNULL([October_Amt],0) AS Oct_Amt,
    ISNULL([November_Qty],0) AS Nov_Qty,
    ISNULL([November_Amt],0) AS Nov_Amt,
    ISNULL([December_Qty],0) AS Dec_Qty,
    ISNULL([December_Amt],0) AS Dec_Amt,
    ISNULL([January_Qty],0)  AS Jan_Qty,
    ISNULL([January_Amt],0)  AS Jan_Amt,
    ISNULL([February_Qty],0) AS Feb_Qty,
    ISNULL([February_Amt],0) AS Feb_Amt,
    ISNULL([March_Qty],0)    AS Mar_Qty,
    ISNULL([March_Amt],0)    AS Mar_Amt,
	(
        ISNULL([April_Qty],0) + ISNULL([May_Qty],0) + ISNULL([June_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([July_Qty],0)  + ISNULL([August_Qty],0) + ISNULL([September_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([October_Qty],0) + ISNULL([November_Qty],0) + ISNULL([December_Qty],0) +
        ISNULL([January_Qty],0) + ISNULL([February_Qty],0) + ISNULL([March_Qty],0)
    ) AS Total_Qty,

    /* Total Amount for the full FY */
    (
        ISNULL([April_Amt],0) + ISNULL([May_Amt],0) + ISNULL([June_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([July_Amt],0)  + ISNULL([August_Amt],0) + ISNULL([September_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([October_Amt],0) + ISNULL([November_Amt],0) + ISNULL([December_Amt],0) +
        ISNULL([January_Amt],0) + ISNULL([February_Amt],0) + ISNULL([March_Amt],0)
    ) AS Total_Amt

FROM (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        Month_Name + '_Qty' AS MonthType,
        Total_Quantity AS Value
    FROM MonthData

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        Month_Name + '_Amt' AS MonthType,
        Total_Amount AS Value
    FROM MonthData
) S
PIVOT (
    SUM(Value)
    FOR MonthType IN (
        [April_Qty],[April_Amt],
        [May_Qty],[May_Amt],
        [June_Qty],[June_Amt],
        [July_Qty],[July_Amt],
        [August_Qty],[August_Amt],
        [September_Qty],[September_Amt],
        [October_Qty],[October_Amt],
        [November_Qty],[November_Amt],
        [December_Qty],[December_Amt],
        [January_Qty],[January_Amt],
        [February_Qty],[February_Amt],
        [March_Qty],[March_Amt]
    )
) P
ORDER BY Total_Qty desc

END

IF (@WHAT ='REPORT' and @top='20') 

BEGIN

WITH MonthData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.sm19_5 AS Account_Name,

SELECT Top 20

	(

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_For_CustomerPerfomanceReport]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_SP_For_CustomerPerfomanceReport]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1002_5 nvarchar(100)='',
@groupid nvarchar(150)='',
@staffname nvarchar(100)='',
@branchid nvarchar(50)='',
@top nvarchar(50)=''
as
if @what='drop'
begin
--select Account_name from  AccountMas1308 INNER JOIN GroupMas  
--ON Account_GroupId=GROUP_ID  where group_name in ('Sundry Debtors A');
--select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff, '''' + REPLACE(LTRIM(sm502_18),',', ''',''') +'''' as sm502_18
--from  sm502 as b
--inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  
select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  order by staff

end
if @what='groupname'



begin
SELECT STUFF(
    (
        SELECT ',' + sm44_7
        FROM SM44
        WHERE UNQID IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
, 1, 1, '') AS groupname;
end

if @what='getbranchid'


begin
SELECT sm502_21 as branchid from sm502 where sm502_4=@staffname
end




if (@what='Grid_Bind' and @top='0')
begin

WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.Account_Name,
        G.Group_Name,PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        -- Total Qty
        ID.InvDet_ProductQty

    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID with(nolock) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A  with(nolock) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM with(nolock)  ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP with(nolock) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP with(nolock) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G  with(nolock) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID

    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25') and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
)
)
        --AND A.Account_Name IN ('A One Dyeing (A)')


SELECT   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Product) AS unq,
Account_Name,
       Group_Name,
    Product,
    ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
FROM (
    SELECT 
	Account_Name,
       Group_Name,
        Product,
        Financial_Year,
       InvDet_ProductQty AS TotalQty   -- aggregate before pivot
    FROM BaseData 
	 
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT (
    SUM(TotalQty)
    FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Product,account_name;






end


if (@what='Grid_Bind' And @top='5')
begin

WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.Account_Name,
        G.Group_Name,
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25')
        and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
        )
)
, Pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
        ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
        ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
        ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            Account_Name,
            Group_Name,
            Product,
            Financial_Year,
            InvDet_ProductQty AS TotalQty
        FROM BaseData
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT (
        SUM(TotalQty)
        FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
    ) AS PivotTable
)
SELECT TOP 5
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ( [year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25] ) DESC) AS unq,
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,
    [year2021-22],
    [year2022-23],
    [year2023-24],
    [year2024-25],
    ([year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25]) AS Total_Qty
FROM Pivoted
ORDER BY Total_Qty DESC;






end



if (@what='Grid_Bind' And @top='10')
begin
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.Account_Name,
        G.Group_Name,
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25')
       and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
        )
)
, Pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
        ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
        ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
        ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            Account_Name,
            Group_Name,
            Product,
            Financial_Year,
            InvDet_ProductQty AS TotalQty
        FROM BaseData
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT (
        SUM(TotalQty)
        FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
    ) AS PivotTable
)
SELECT TOP 10
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ( [year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25] ) DESC) AS unq,
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,
    [year2021-22],
    [year2022-23],
    [year2023-24],
    [year2024-25],
    ([year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25]) AS Total_Qty
FROM Pivoted
ORDER BY Total_Qty DESC;

if (@what='Grid_Bind' And @top='15')

begin

WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.Account_Name,
        G.Group_Name,
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25')
       and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
        )
)
, Pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
        ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
        ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
        ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            Account_Name,
            Group_Name,
            Product,
            Financial_Year,
            InvDet_ProductQty AS TotalQty
        FROM BaseData
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT (
        SUM(TotalQty)
        FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
    ) AS PivotTable
)
SELECT TOP 15
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ( [year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25] ) DESC) AS unq,
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,
    [year2021-22],
    [year2022-23],
    [year2023-24],
    [year2024-25],
    ([year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25]) AS Total_Qty
FROM Pivoted
ORDER BY Total_Qty DESC;







end
if (@what='Grid_Bind' And @top='20')
begin

WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        A.Account_Name,
        G.Group_Name,
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25')
       and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
        )
)
, Pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        Account_Name,
        Group_Name,
        Product,
        ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
        ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
        ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
        ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            Account_Name,
            Group_Name,
            Product,
            Financial_Year,
            InvDet_ProductQty AS TotalQty
        FROM BaseData
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT (
        SUM(TotalQty)
        FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
    ) AS PivotTable
)
SELECT TOP 20
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ( [year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25] ) DESC) AS unq,
    Account_Name,
    Group_Name,
    Product,
    [year2021-22],
    [year2022-23],
    [year2023-24],
    [year2024-25],
    ([year2021-22] + [year2022-23] + [year2023-24] + [year2024-25]) AS Total_Qty
FROM Pivoted
ORDER BY Total_Qty DESC;







end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DASHBOARD]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@What nvarchar(50)='',
@product nvarchar(50)='',
@pname nvarchar(50)='',
@uid   nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1016_4 nvarchar(50)='',
@branch nvarchar(max)=''
	
AS


if @What='DashGrid'
begin
   
   --select (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=  sm1011_13) as ProductName, (select sum(sm1011_35) as sales from sm1011  where sm1011_6 between DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()) and getdate()) as CurrentSales,
   --'0' as LastMonthSales,'0' as LastQuater,'0' as LastYear,'0' as CurrentYear,'0' as LastyearCurrentMonth,'0' as LastYearTillDate from sm1011
	
	create table #t(unqid uniqueidentifier,ProductName nvarchar(max) ,CurrentSales numeric(18,2),LastMonthSales numeric(18,2),LastQuarterSales numeric(18,2),LastYearSales numeric(18,2),CurrentYearSales numeric(18,2),LastYearSameMonthSales numeric(18,2),LastYearTillDateSales numeric(18,2),DiffInLastMonths numeric(18,2),DiffInLastQuaters numeric(18,2))

	declare @CurrentSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @LastMonthSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @LastQuarterSales numeric(18,2);
    declare @LastYearSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @CurrentYearSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @LastYearSameMonthSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @LastYearTillDateSales numeric(18,2);
	declare @prevmonths numeric(18,2);
	declare @Currentmonths numeric(18,2);
	declare @DiffInLastMonths numeric(18,2);
	declare @DiffInLastQuaters numeric(18,2);
	
	
	
	
   declare cur1  cursor for
   SELECT distinct(sm1011_13) from sm1011  
   open cur1
   fetch next from cur1 into @product
   while  @@fetch_status = 0
   begin
   
    --print @product
    --select 

    set @pname=(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=@product)
    --Current Month Sales
    set @CurrentSales=isnull((SELECT top 1  SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
    FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()) 
    AND sm1011_6 < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()))
	and sm1011_13=@product  and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)
	
	
--    ---- Last Month Sales
    set @LastMonthSales=isnull((SELECT top 1 SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
    FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()))
    AND sm1011_6 < DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()) and sm1011_13=@product  and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)

--    ---- Last Quarter Sales
    set @LastQuarterSales=isnull((SELECT top 1 SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
     FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
     WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEADD(QUARTER, DATEDIFF(QUARTER, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)
       AND sm1011_6 < DATEADD(QUARTER, DATEDIFF(QUARTER, 0, GETDATE()), 0)
	   and sm1011_13=@product and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)

--    ------ Last Year Sales
    set @LastYearSales=isnull((SELECT top 1 SUM(sm1011_35) --over (partition by sm1011_13)
     FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
     WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1, 1, 1)
       AND sm1011_6 < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1)
	   and sm1011_13=@product and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)

--    ------ Current Year Sales
    set @CurrentYearSales=isnull((SELECT top 1 SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
     FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
     WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1)
       AND sm1011_6 <= GETDATE() and sm1011_13=@product and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)

--    ------ Same Month Last Year Sales
    set @LastYearSameMonthSales=isnull((SELECT top 1 SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
     FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
     WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()))
       AND sm1011_6 < DATEADD(YEAR, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE())))
	   and sm1011_13=@product and  sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)

--    ------ Last Year Till Date
    set @LastYearTillDateSales=isnull((SELECT SUM(sm1011_35) over (partition by sm1011_13)
     FROM sm1011  inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
     WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1, 1, 1)
       AND sm1011_6 <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETDATE()) and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) 
    ),0)
	
	--JEET
	      set @prevmonths=(SELECT  CAST(@LastMonthSales AS NUMERIC(18,2))/cast(DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -1)) as numeric(18,2)))
    print @prevmonths
	--set @DiffInLastMonth=
	set @DiffInLastMonths=(SELECT (@CurrentSales / DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())))-@prevmonths)
	print @DiffInLastMonths
        --print cast((@DiffInLastMonth/50)*100) as numeric(18)
   set @Currentmonths=(SELECT (@CurrentSales / DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))))
	SET @DiffInLastQuaters =@Currentmonths-(@LastQuarterSales/(DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -1))+DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -2))+DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -3))))
	--JEET
	--insert into #t values(@product,@pname,@CurrentSales,@LastMonthSales,@LastQuarterSales,@LastYearSales,@CurrentYearSales,@LastYearSameMonthSales,@LastYearTillDateSales)
	if(@CurrentSales !=0.00 or @LastMonthSales !=0.00 or @LastQuarterSales !=0.00 or @LastYearSales !=0.00 or @CurrentYearSales != 0.00 or @LastYearSameMonthSales !=0.00 or @LastYearTillDateSales !=0.00 or @DiffInLastMonths!=0.000 or @DiffInLastQuaters !=0.000)
	begin
	   insert into #t values(@product,@pname,@CurrentSales,@LastMonthSales,@LastQuarterSales,@LastYearSales,@CurrentYearSales,@LastYearSameMonthSales,@LastYearTillDateSales,@DiffInLastMonths,@DiffInLastQuaters)
	end

--FROM sm1011

--group by sm1011_13
  fetch next from cur1 into @product
end
  close cur1
  deallocate cur1
  select * from #t
  drop table #t

--    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

--(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1016_12) UNIT,(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=SM1016_4 )as BRANCHNAME,sm1016_34 as STRENGTH ,

--ORDER BY CAST(sm1016_6 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) asc ;  -- pending challan

if @What='DashGrid_Qty'
begin
   
   --select (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=  sm1011_13) as ProductName, (select sum(sm1011_35) as sales from sm1011  where sm1011_6 between DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()) and getdate()) as CurrentSales,
   --'0' as LastMonthSales,'0' as LastQuater,'0' as LastYear,'0' as CurrentYear,'0' as LastyearCurrentMonth,'0' as LastYearTillDate from sm1011
	
	create table #q(unqid uniqueidentifier,ProductName nvarchar(max) ,CurrentSalesQty numeric(18,3),LastMonthSalesQty numeric(18,3),LastQuarterSalesQty numeric(18,3),LastYearSalesQty numeric(18,3),CurrentYearSalesQty numeric(18,3),LastYearSameMonthSalesQty numeric(18,3),LastYearTillDateSalesQty numeric(18,3),DiffInLastMonth numeric(18,3),DiffInLastQuater numeric(18,3),DiffInLastMonthper numeric(18,3),DiffInLastQuaterper numeric(18,3))

	declare @CurrentSalesQty numeric(18,3);

   begin

	--print @CurrentSalesQty

    AND sm1011_6 < DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), GETDATE()) and sm1011_13=@product and sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

--    ---- Last Quarter Sales

    -- WHERE sm1011_6 >= DATEADD(QUARTER, DATEDIFF(QUARTER, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)

--    ------ Last Year Sales

-- Get total number of days in last 3 full months
DECLARE @DaysInLastQuarter INT = 
    DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -1)) + 
    DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -2)) + 
    DAY(EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -3));

-- Compute difference in average daily sales (in 1000s)
SET @DiffInLastQuater = (
    (@Currentmonth - (@LastQuarterSalesQty / CAST(@DaysInLastQuarter AS FLOAT))) / 1000.0
);


-- Compute percentage difference, protect against divide by zero
SET @DiffInLastQuaterper = 
    CASE 
        WHEN @Currentmonth IS NOT NULL AND @Currentmonth != 0 
        THEN (@DiffInLastQuater / (@Currentmonth / 1000.0)) * 100
        ELSE NULL
    END;

declare @products nvarchar(max);
  set @products=(select sm502_19 from sm502 inner join sm63 on  sm63_13 = sm502.unqid where sm63_5 = @uid);
WITH Sales_CTE AS (
    SELECT 
        sm19_5 AS Customer,
        sm206_7 AS Product,
        FORMAT(sm1011_6, 'yyyy-MM') AS SaleMonth,
        SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS TotalQty,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN sm1011_74 = 'Branch Transfer Sales' THEN 0.00 
            ELSE sm1011_24 
        END) AS TotalAmt
    FROM SM1011 
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10 
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13 
    WHERE 
        --sm206.sm206_2 in (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@products, ','))
        --AND
		SM1011_41 IN (
            SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch , ',')
        )
    GROUP BY 
        sm19_5, sm206_7, FORMAT(sm1011_6, 'yyyy-MM')
),
RankedSales AS (
    SELECT *,
        LAG(TotalQty) OVER (PARTITION BY Customer, Product ORDER BY SaleMonth) AS PrevQty,
        LAG(TotalAmt) OVER (PARTITION BY Customer, Product ORDER BY SaleMonth) AS PrevAmt
    FROM Sales_CTE
),
DroppedSales AS (
    SELECT
        Customer,
        Product,
        SaleMonth,
        TotalQty,
        PrevQty,
        TotalAmt,
        PrevAmt,
        CAST(
            CASE 
                WHEN PrevQty > 0 THEN ((PrevQty - TotalQty) * 100.0 / PrevQty)
                ELSE NULL
            END 
            AS DECIMAL(5,2)
        ) AS QtyDropPercent
    FROM RankedSales
    WHERE PrevQty IS NOT NULL
      AND TotalQty < PrevQty
)
SELECT top 5 *
from  DroppedSales
ORDER BY QtyDropPercent DESC;

 end
