		 set @Newcust=(select SUM(sm1011_42) custOfAugust from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and
		 sm1011_10 not in(select sm1011_10 from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and sm1011_6<@SecondMonth) and sm1011_6 between @SecondMonth and (SELECT   (CAST(EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) / 3) * 3) + 1, 0)) AS DATE))))  --new customers in july
		 if(@totalrevenue = '0')
		 begin
		 set @Newcustper=0;
		 end
		 else
		 begin
		 set @Newcustper=(@Newcust/@totalrevenue)*100;
		 end
		 end
		 else if(@number = '2')
		 begin
		 set @thirdMonth=(CAST(DATEADD(MONTH, ((DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) / 3) * 3) + 2, 0) AS DATE))
		 set @totalrevenue=isnull((SELECT SUM(sm1011_42) AS total_sales FROM sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and
		 sm1011_6 between @thirdMonth and (CAST(EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) / 3) * 3) + 2, 0)) AS DATE))),0)

		 set @Existingcust=isnull(((select SUM(sm1011_42) custOfAugust from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and
		 sm1011_10 in(select sm1011_10 from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and sm1011_6<@thirdMonth) and sm1011_6 between @thirdMonth and (SELECT   (CAST(EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) / 3) * 3) + 2, 0)) AS DATE))))),0)  --new customers in august 
		 if(@totalrevenue = '0')
		 begin
		 set @Existingcustper=0;
		 end
		 else
		 begin
		 set @Existingcustper=(@Existingcust/@totalrevenue)*100;
		 end
		 --set @Existingcustper=(@Existingcust/isnull(@totalrevenue,1))*100;
		 set @Newcust=isnull(((select SUM(sm1011_42) custOfAugust from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and
		 sm1011_10 not in(select sm1011_10 from sm1011 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8 where sm1008_36=(select sm63_13 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid) and sm1011_6<@thirdMonth) and sm1011_6 between @thirdMonth and (SELECT   (CAST(EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) / 3) * 3) + 2, 0)) AS DATE))))),0)  --new customers in august 
		 if(@totalrevenue = '0')
		 begin
		 set @Newcustper=0;
		 end
		 else
		 begin
		     set @Newcustper=(@Newcust/@totalrevenue)*100;
		 end
		 
	     end
		 else
		 begin
		     set @totalrevenue=@SumOfRevenue;
			 set @Existingcust=@SumExistingcust;
			 set @Newcust =@SumNewcust;
			 set @Newcustper=(@Newcust/@totalrevenue)*100;
			 set @Existingcustper=(@Existingcust/@totalrevenue)*100;
		 end
		 print @Existingcust
	    
	     insert into #Nq values(isnull(@totalrevenue,0),@Existingcust,@Existingcustper,isnull(@Newcust,0),isnull(@Newcustper,0))
	     set @number=@number+1;

	end
	select  totalrevenue, Existingcust, Existingcustper, Newcust, Newcustper from #Nq
	drop table #Nq
	

 end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DASHBOARD_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DASHBOARD_Q]
@FROMDATE NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE   NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TYPE     NVARCHAR(200) = '',
@PRODUCT  NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@WHAT	  NVARCHAR(10)  = '' 
AS
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'BIND'
	BEGIN
		SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),PA_1,103) AS [FROMDATE] FROM PA;
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SUMM AS NUMERIC(18,2);
		----------------------- SALES GRAPH (SOFTWARE + LRC + PRODUCT + CITY) -------------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT SM213_6 AS [DATE],SM213_23 AS [AMOUNT],(SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT TOP 1 SM19_C4 FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = SM213_10))
		AS [TYPE], (SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM213_C5) AS [PRODUCT],(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_15 FROM SM19 
		WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [CITY] INTO #SALES FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 
		WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND DBO.ONLYDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) 
		AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
		--SELECT * FROM #T
		IF @TYPE = 'ALL'
		BEGIN
			--SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #SALES GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) 
			--ORDER BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103)
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #SALES GROUP BY [DATE]
			ORDER BY DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([DATE])			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #SALES WHERE [PRODUCT] = @TYPE 
			--GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) ORDER BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103)
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #SALES WHERE [PRODUCT] = @TYPE 
			GROUP BY [DATE] ORDER BY DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([DATE])			
		END
		-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		----------------------- CREDIT NOTE GRAPH (SOFTWARE + LRC + PRODUCT + CITY) -------------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT SM213_6 AS [DATE],SM213_23 AS [AMOUNT],(SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT TOP 1 SM19_C4 FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = SM213_10))
		AS [TYPE], (SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM213_C5) AS [PRODUCT],(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_15 FROM SM19 
		WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [CITY] INTO #RETURN FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 
		WHERE SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND DBO.ONLYDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) 
		AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
		--SELECT * FROM #T
		IF @TYPE = 'ALL'
		BEGIN
			--SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #RETURN GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) 
			--ORDER BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103)
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #RETURN GROUP BY [DATE]
			ORDER BY DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([DATE])
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #RETURN WHERE [PRODUCT] = @TYPE 
			--GROUP BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) ORDER BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103)
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[DATE],103) AS [DATE], SUM([AMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #RETURN WHERE [PRODUCT] = @TYPE 
			GROUP BY [DATE] ORDER BY DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([DATE])
		END
		-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		----------------------- PENDING APPROVALS QUERIES ---------------------------------------------------------
		-------------- FOR SALES INSTALLTION INVOICE
		SELECT COUNT(SM217.UNQID) AS [PSIA] FROM SM217 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM217_15))) IN('TRUE','1') AND 
		SM217.UNQID IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM218_18 FROM SM218) AND SM217_7 = 'SOFTWARE'
		-------------- FOR SALES LRC INVOICE
		SELECT COUNT(SM217.UNQID) AS [PRIA] FROM SM217 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM217_15))) IN('TRUE','1') AND 
		SM217.UNQID IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM218_18 FROM SM218) AND SM217_7 != 'SOFTWARE'
		-------------- FOR SOFTWARE INSTALLTION CREDIT NOTES
		--SELECT COUNT(SM219.UNQID) AS [PCIA] FROM SM219 WHERE SM219.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT SM220_5 FROM SM220) AND
		--SM219_11 = 'SOFTWARE'
		SELECT COUNT(*) AS [PCIA] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_35 ='C#' AND SM213_25 = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM213_36 = 'UNAPPROVE'
		-------------- FOR RENEWAL CREDIT NOTES
		SELECT COUNT(SM219.UNQID) AS [PCRIA] FROM SM219 WHERE SM219.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT SM220_5 FROM SM220) AND
		SM219_11 != 'SOFTWARE'
		-------------- FOR REBATE AND DISCOUNT
		SELECT COUNT(SM215_11) AS [PRDA] FROM SM215 WHERE SM215_11 NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM216_5 FROM SM216)
		-------------- FOR JOURNAL
		SELECT '0' AS [PJVA]
		-------------- FOR NEW ACCOUNT OPPENING FOR INSTALLATION
		SELECT COUNT(UNQID) AS [PLIA] FROM SM221 WHERE SM221_28 > 0.00 AND sm221_33='PAPPROVAL'
		-------------- FOR DEMO INSTALLATION
		SELECT COUNT(UNQID) AS [PDIA] FROM SM221 WHERE SM221_28 <= 0.00 AND sm221_33='PAPPROVAL'
		-------------- FOR PURCHASE
		SELECT '0' AS [PPRA]
		-------------- FOR PURCHASE RETURN
		SELECT '0' AS [PPRRA]
		-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		----------------------- OUTSTANDING QUERIES ---------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT MAX(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_6 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
		(SELECT UPPER(SM208_5) FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_C4 FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = SM19.UNQID)) AS [SOFTWARE],
		(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = SM19_15) AS [CITY],
		SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
		(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT] INTO #T111 FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_11 = SM44_5 
		INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE SM44_5 IN ('579831_','579832_') GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_6,SM19_5 ,SM19.UNQID,SM19_15
		HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_6 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

		-------------- FOR TOP 15 HIGHEST AMOUNT DUE
		
		--SELECT TOP 15 'A' AS [SCHEDULE],'B' AS [ACCOUNT NAME],'C' AS [REGISTERED NAME],SUM(1+2) AS [DAMOUNT]
		SELECT TOP 15 [SCHEDULENAME] AS [SCHEDULE],[ACCOUNTCODE] AS [ACCOUNT NAME],[ACCOUNTNAME] AS [REGISTERED NAME],SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT] FROM #T111 
		WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE([M3_19]) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
		GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,ACCOUNTCODE,ACCOUNTNAME HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00 AND SUM([DAMOUNT]) != 0.00
		ORDER BY DAMOUNT DESC
		-------------- FOR TOP 15 OLDEST AMOUNT  DUE
		
		--SELECT TOP 15 'A' AS [SCHEDULE],CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),'01/06/2020',103) AS [DATE],'01' AS [ACCOUNT NAME],'MAYANK SINGH' AS [REGISTERED NAME], SUM(500+600) AS [DAMOUNT]  
		SELECT TOP 15 [SCHEDULENAME] AS [SCHEDULE],CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[M3_19],103) AS [DATE],[ACCOUNTCODE] AS [ACCOUNT NAME],[ACCOUNTNAME] AS [REGISTERED NAME],
		SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT] FROM #T111 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE([M3_19]) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
		GROUP BY M3_19,SCHEDULENAME,ACCOUNTCODE,ACCOUNTNAME HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00 AND SUM([DAMOUNT]) != 0.00
		ORDER BY M3_19 DESC
		-------------- FOR SOFTWARE WISE OUTSTANDING AMOUNT
		SELECT [SOFTWARE] AS [PRODUCT],SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #T111 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE([M3_19]) BETWEEN 
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) GROUP BY [SOFTWARE] 
		HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00 AND SUM([DAMOUNT]) != 0.00 ORDER BY [SOFTWARE]
		
		--SELECT 'Control 9' AS [PRODUCT],SUM(5000+6000.00) AS [AMOUNT] 
		-------------- FOR CITY WISE OUTSTANDING AMOUNT
		
		--SELECT 'Jodhpur' AS [CITY],SUM(5000+6000) AS [AMOUNT] 
		SELECT [CITY] AS [CITY],SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [AMOUNT] FROM #T111 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE([M3_19]) BETWEEN 
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) GROUP BY [CITY] 
		HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00 AND SUM([DAMOUNT]) != 0.00 ORDER BY [CITY]
		-------------- FOR SUNDRY CREDITORS	
		SELECT [ACCOUNTCODE] AS [ACCOUNT NAME],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT] FROM #T111 
		WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE([M3_19]) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
		GROUP BY ACCOUNTCODE HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00 AND SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
		ORDER BY [ACCOUNTCODE] ASC
		-------------- FOR LAST BANK STATEMENT UPDATED ON DATE
		SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),[M3_19],103)  AS [LASTDATE] FROM M3 WHERE M3_11 = 'BR' ORDER BY M3_19 DESC
		-------------- FOR BANK BALANCE AS PER UPDATED BANK STATEMENT

		--SELECT @SUMM = ISNULL((SUM(M3_6)),0.00) FROM M3 WHERE M3_4 = (SELECT SM19.UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_5 = 'CANARA BANK')   --CHANGE ON 20210813 REASON(BANK CHANGE CANARA TO KOTAK)
		SELECT @SUMM = ISNULL((SUM(M3_6)),0.00) FROM M3 WHERE M3_4 = (SELECT PA_35 FROM PA)
		IF @SUMM < 0.00
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SUMM = @SUMM*(-1);
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@SUMM) + ' Dr' AS [BANK BALANCE]
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@SUMM) + ' Cr' AS [BANK BALANCE]
		END
		-----------------------------  NO RECORD FOUND IN GRID DATA-----------------------------------------------
		------------------FOR TOP 15 HIGHEST AMOUNT DUE
		SELECT  'No Record Found' AS [SCHEDULE],'' AS [ACCOUNT NAME],'' AS [REGISTERED NAME], '' AS [DAMOUNT]		
		------------------FOR TOP 15 OLDEST AMOUNT  DUE
		SELECT  'No Record Found' AS [SCHEDULE],'' AS [DATE],'' AS [ACCOUNT NAME],'' AS [REGISTERED NAME], '' AS [DAMOUNT]		
		------------------FOR SOFTWARE WISE OUTSTANDING AMOUNT
		SELECT 'No Record Found' AS [PRODUCT],'' AS [AMOUNT]						
		------------------FOR CITY WISE OUTSTANDING AMOUNT
		SELECT 'No Record Found' AS [CITY], '' AS [AMOUNT]							
		------------------FOR SUNDRY CREDITORS
		SELECT 'No Record Found' AS [ACCOUNT NAME], '' AS [CAMOUNT]				
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DEALER_INVOICE_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--USE [ACCOUNTING]
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DEALER_INVOICE_Q] 
@WHAT  NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- IF CONDITIONS 
@PAR1  NVARCHAR(30)  = '', -- ENTRYDATE
@PAR2  NVARCHAR(30)  = '', -- MODIFYDATE
@PAR3  NVARCHAR(3)   = '', -- USERID
@PAR4  NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- UNQID
@PAR5  NVARCHAR(5)   = '', -- OUTLETCODE
@PAR6  NVARCHAR(100) = '', -- SERVERNAME
@PAR7  NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- DEALER UNQID
@PAR8  NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- ACCOUNT UNQID
@PAR9  NVARCHAR(30)  = '', -- INVOICE DATE
@PAR10 NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- PRODUCT TYPE
@PAR11 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', -- DESCRIPTION
@PAR12 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- QUANTITY
@PAR13 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- RATE
@PAR14 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- AMOUNT
@PAR15 NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- TAX UNQID
@PAR16 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- TAX AMOUNT
@PAR17 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- TOTAL AMOUNT
@PAR18 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- ROUND OFF
@PAR19 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', -- NET AMOUNT
@PAR20 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', -- REMARKS FOR SM223/ REASON FOR SM224
@PAR21 NVARCHAR(5)   = '', -- SELECT TRUE/FALSE
@PAR22 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', -- REMARKS FOR SM224
@PAR23 NVARCHAR(30)  = '', -- APPROVED/REJECTED DATE
@PAR24 NVARCHAR(36)  = '', -- SM223 UNQID
@PAR25 NVARCHAR(3)   = ''  -- APPROVED/REJECTED USER ID
AS 
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'GETDEALERLIST'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '1'
		--TABLE 0: DEALER LIST
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID,SM19_5 AS [DEALERNAME] FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_7 = (SELECT SM44_5 FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_7 = 'CUSTOMERS(DEALER)')
		ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC;

		--TABLE 1: TYPE
		SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID,SM206_9 AS [TYPE] FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_9 ASC;

		--TABLE 2: TAX PERCENTAGE
		SELECT TOP 1 UNQID AS [UNQID],SM210_7 AS [TAX %] FROM SM210 ORDER BY CONVERT(NUMERIC(10,0),SM210_5) DESC

	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'GETPARTYDETAILS'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '2'
		--TABLE 0: PARTY LIST WITH SOFTWARE INVOICE
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS [PARTYNAME],(SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = SM19_C4) + ' SOFTWARE' AS [DESCRIPTION],
		0.00 AS [QUANTITY],SM19_C6 AS [RATE],0.00 AS [AMOUNT],0.00 AS [TAX%],0.00 AS [TAXAMOUNT],0.00 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],0.00 AS [ROUNDOFF],
		0.00 AS [NETAMOUNT],'' AS [REMARKS],'FALSE' AS [SELECT] FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM19_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM19_C2 WHERE SM19_58 = @PAR7
		ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC

		--TABLE 1: PARTY LIST WITH LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES INVOICE
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS [PARTYNAME],'LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES FOR ' + (SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
		0.00 AS [QUANTITY],SM19_C7 AS [RATE],0.00 AS [AMOUNT],0.00 AS [TAX%],0.00 AS [TAXAMOUNT],0.00 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],0.00 AS [ROUNDOFF],
		0.00 AS [NETAMOUNT],'' AS [REMARKS],'FALSE' AS [SELECT] FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM19_C ON
		SM19.UNQID = SM19_C2 WHERE SM19_58 = @PAR7 ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC

		--TABLE 1: PARTY LIST WITH CLIENT INSTALLATION INVOICE / OTHERS
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS [PARTYNAME],'CLIENT INSTALLATION CHARGES FOR ' + (SELECT SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE UNQID = SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
		0.00 AS [QUANTITY],SM19_C7 AS [RATE],0.00 AS [AMOUNT],0.00 AS [TAX%],0.00 AS [TAXAMOUNT],0.00 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],0.00 AS [ROUNDOFF],
		0.00 AS [NETAMOUNT],'' AS [REMARKS],'FALSE' AS [SELECT] FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM19_C ON
		SM19.UNQID = SM19_C2 WHERE SM19_58 = @PAR7 ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC
	END
	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'INSERT223'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '3'
		SET @PAR1 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
		SET @PAR2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
		SET @PAR4 = NEWID();
		INSERT INTO SM223
		SELECT @PAR1,@PAR2,@PAR3,@PAR4,@PAR5,@PAR6,@PAR7,@PAR8,@PAR9,@PAR10,@PAR11,@PAR12,@PAR13,@PAR14,@PAR15,@PAR16,@PAR17,@PAR18,@PAR19,
		@PAR20,@PAR21
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'EDITBEFOREAPPROVAL'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '4'
		SELECT SM223_4 AS [UNQID],SM223_9 AS [DATE],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM223_7) AS [DEALER],
		(SELECT sm206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM223_10) AS [TYPE] FROM SM223 WHERE SM223_4 NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT
		SM224_24 FROM SM224) ORDER BY [DATE] ASC
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'GETDETAILSFOREDITING'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '5'
		--TABLE 0: FOR DEALER AND TYPE DROPDOWN, DATE
		SELECT (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM223_7) AS [DEALER],DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM223_9) AS [DATE],
		(SELECT sm206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM223_10) AS [TYPE] FROM SM223 WHERE SM223_4 = @PAR4;

		--TABLE1: FOR GRID DETAILS
		SELECT SM223_7 AS UNQID, (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM223_7) AS [PARTYNAME],SM223_11 AS [DESCRIPTION],
		SM223_12 AS [QUANTITY],SM223_13 AS [RATE],SM223_14 AS [AMOUNT],SM223_15 AS [TAX%],SM223_16 AS [TAXAMOUNT],SM223_17 AS 
		[TOTALAMOUNT],SM223_18 AS [ROUNDOFF],SM223_19 AS [NETAMOUNT],SM223_20 AS [REMARKS],'FALSE' AS [SELECT] FROM SM223 
		WHERE SM223_4 = @PAR4;
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'DELETESM223'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '6'
		DELETE FROM SM223 WHERE SM223_4 = @PAR4 AND SM223_4 NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM224_24 FROM SM224);
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'VIEWDATAFORAPPROVAL'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '7'
		SELECT SM223_4 AS [UNQID],SM223_9 AS [DATE],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM223_7) AS [DEALER],
		(SELECT sm206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM223_10) AS [TYPE],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM223_8)
		AS [PARTYNAME],SM223_11 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM223_12 AS [QUANTITY],SM223_13 AS [RATE],SM223_14 AS [AMOUNT],
		(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM223_15) AS [TAX%],SM223_16 AS [TAXAMOUNT],SM223_17 AS [TOTALAMOUNT],
		SM223_18 AS [ROUNDOFF],SM223_19 AS [NETAMOUNT],SM223_20 AS [REASON],'' AS [REMARKS],SM223_21 AS [SELECT] FROM 
		SM223 WHERE SM223_4 NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT	SM224_24 FROM SM224) ORDER BY [DATE] ASC
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'INSERT224'
	BEGIN
		PRINT '8'
		SET @PAR1 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
		SET @PAR2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
		INSERT INTO SM224
		SELECT @PAR1,@PAR2,@PAR3,NEWID(),@PAR5,@PAR6,SM223_7,SM223_8,SM223_9,SM223_10,SM223_11,SM223_12,SM223_13,SM223_14,SM223_15,
		SM223_16,SM223_17,SM223_18,SM223_19,SM223_20,@PAR21,@PAR22,DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM223_4,@PAR3 FROM SM223 WHERE SM223_4 = @PAR4

		------------------- AUTO INVOICE GENERATION -----------------------------------
		DECLARE @PAR26 AS NVARCHAR(36),@PAR27 AS NVARCHAR(5),@PAR28 AS NVARCHAR(1);
		DECLARE @AA NVARCHAR(30)='',@SM213_1	NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_2	NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_3	NVARCHAR(50)='',@UNQID		NVARCHAR(50)='',

		@SM213_29   NVARCHAR(36)='',@SM213_30   NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_33	NVARCHAR(30)='',@SM213_34	NVARCHAR(30)='',@RCUST		NVARCHAR(36)='';

		Declare @SM213_C1 NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_C2  NVARCHAR(50) ='',@UNQIDC    NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_C4  NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_C5   NVARCHAR(50)='',

		@SM213_C16		  NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_C17 NVARCHAR(50) ='',@SM213_C18 NVARCHAR(50)='',@SM213_C19 NVARCHAR(50)='';

		DECLARE @GSTNATURE AS NVARCHAR(36),@M3_19 AS NVARCHAR(30);

		SELECT @PAR26 = SM19_5,@PAR27 = SM19_20 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = @PAR7;
		SELECT @PAR28 = SM221_50 FROM SM221 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(UPPER(SM221_36))) = LTRIM(RTRIM(UPPER(@PAR26))) AND LTRIM(RTRIM(SM221_44)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@PAR27));

		IF @PAR28 = 'P'
		BEGIN
			-- FOR BILLING TO PARTY DIRECTLY
			IF @PAR21  = '1' OR @PAR21 = 'TRUE'
			BEGIN
				SELECT  @AA = 'SALE_PARENT',@SM213_1 = '',@SM213_2 = '',@SM213_3 = @PAR3,@UNQID= NEWID(),@SM213_5 = '',@SM213_100 = @PAR6,
				@SM213_6 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@PAR9),@SM213_7 = 'CREDIT',@SM213_8 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_9 = 
				(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST([SM213_9] AS NUMERIC(18,0))),0) FROM [SM213] WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
				@SM213_9 = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST([SM213_9] AS NUMERIC(18,0))),0) + 1 FROM [SM213] WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
				@SM213_10 = @PAR8,@SM213_11 = '',@SM213_12 = '',@SM213_13 = '',@SM213_14 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = 
				(SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN ('CGST + SGST') ELSE ('IGST') END),@SM213_15 = @PAR17,@SM213_16 = '0.00',
				@SM213_17 = @PAR17,@SM213_18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN
				('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_19 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 
				FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) -

				@SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@SM213_30 = CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR18),@SM213_33 = '',@SM213_34 = '',
				@RCUST = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

				sm213_14,sm213_15,sm213_16,sm213_17,sm213_18,sm213_19,sm213_20,sm213_21,sm213_22,sm213_23,sm213_24,sm213_25,sm213_26,sm213_27,sm213_28,
				sm213_29,sm213_30,sm213_31,sm213_32,sm213_33,sm213_34) 
				VALUES(dbo.getentrydate(),@SM213_2,@SM213_3,@unqid ,@SM213_5,@SM213_100,DBO.getformatteddate(@SM213_6),@SM213_7,@SM213_8,@SM213_9,@SM213_10,
				@SM213_11,@SM213_12,@SM213_13,@SM213_14,@SM213_15,@SM213_16,@SM213_17,@SM213_18,@SM213_19,@SM213_20,@SM213_21,@SM213_22,@SM213_23,@SM213_24,
				@SM213_25,@SM213_26,@SM213_27,@SM213_28,@SM213_29,@SM213_30,(select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = @SM213_10),'','',''); 

				SELECT @WHAT = 'SALE_CHILD',@SM213_C1 = '',@SM213_C2 = '',@UNQIDC = NEWID(),@SM213_C4 = @UNQID,@SM213_C5 = @PAR7,@SM213_C6 = (SELECT SM206_16
				FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = @PAR10),@SM213_C7 = @PAR11,@SM213_C8 = (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE SM209.UNQID = (SELECT SM206_14 FROM SM206 
				WHERE SM206_2 = @PAR10)),@SM213_C9 = @PAR12,@SM213_C10 = @PAR13,@SM213_C11 = @PAR14,@SM213_C12 = '0.00',@SM213_C13 = '0.00',@SM213_C14 = 
				@PAR14,@SM213_C15 = @PAR15,@SM213_C16 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = 
				@PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_C17 = (CASE WHEN 
				(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),
				@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_C18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT 
				SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17)) END),
				@SM213_C19 = @PAR19;
				
				INSERT INTO SM213_C(SM213_C1,SM213_C2,UNQID,SM213_C4,SM213_C5,SM213_C6,SM213_C7,SM213_C8,SM213_C9,SM213_C10,SM213_C11,SM213_C12,SM213_C13,
				SM213_C14,SM213_C15,SM213_C16,SM213_C17,SM213_C18,SM213_C19) 
				VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),@SM213_C2,NEWID(),@SM213_C4,@SM213_C5,@SM213_C6,@SM213_C7,@SM213_C8,@SM213_C9,@SM213_C10,@SM213_C11,@SM213_C12,
				@SM213_C13,@SM213_C14,@SM213_C15,@SM213_C16,@SM213_C17,@SM213_C18,@SM213_C19);
				-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				--AUTO POSTING
				SELECT @AA = 'SALES',@GSTNATURE = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@PAR5 = 'Q',@M3_19 = @PAR23;
				EXEC [DBO].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_POSTING_Q] 'SALES',@UNQID,@GSTNATURE,@PAR3,@PAR5,@PAR6,@M3_19
			END
		END
		ELSE IF @PAR28 = 'D'
		BEGIN
			-- FOR BILLING TO DEALER ITESELF
			PRINT '10'
			IF @PAR21  = '1' OR @PAR21 = 'TRUE'
			BEGIN
				SELECT  @AA = 'SALE_PARENT',@SM213_1 = '',@SM213_2 = '',@SM213_3 = @PAR3,@UNQID= NEWID(),@SM213_5 = '',@SM213_100 = @PAR6,
				@SM213_6 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@PAR9),@SM213_7 = 'CREDIT',@SM213_8 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_9 = 
				(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST([SM213_9] AS NUMERIC(18,0))),0) FROM [SM213] WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
				@SM213_9 = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST([SM213_9] AS NUMERIC(18,0))),0) + 1 FROM [SM213] WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
				@SM213_10 = @PAR7,@SM213_11 = '',@SM213_12 = '',@SM213_13 = '',@SM213_14 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = 
				(SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR7)) IN ('8','08') THEN ('CGST + SGST') ELSE ('IGST') END),@SM213_15 = @PAR17,@SM213_16 = '0.00',
				@SM213_17 = @PAR17,@SM213_18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR7)) IN
				('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_19 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 
				FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR7)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - 
				CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_20 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 
				FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR7)) IN ('8','08') THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17)) END),
				@SM213_21 = @PAR17,@SM213_22 = '0.00',@SM213_23 = @PAR19,@SM213_24 = '',@SM213_25 = '',@SM213_26 = '',@SM213_27 = '',@SM213_28 = '',
				@SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@SM213_30 = CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR18),@SM213_33 = '',@SM213_34 = '',
				@RCUST = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

				INSERT INTO sm213(sm213_1,sm213_2,sm213_3,unqid,sm213_5,sm213_100,sm213_6,sm213_7,sm213_8,sm213_9,sm213_10,sm213_11,sm213_12,sm213_13,
				sm213_14,sm213_15,sm213_16,sm213_17,sm213_18,sm213_19,sm213_20,sm213_21,sm213_22,sm213_23,sm213_24,sm213_25,sm213_26,sm213_27,sm213_28,
				sm213_29,sm213_30,sm213_31,sm213_32,sm213_33,sm213_34) 
				VALUES(dbo.getentrydate(),@SM213_2,@SM213_3,@unqid ,@SM213_5,@SM213_100,DBO.getformatteddate(@SM213_6),@SM213_7,@SM213_8,@SM213_9,@SM213_10,
				@SM213_11,@SM213_12,@SM213_13,@SM213_14,@SM213_15,@SM213_16,@SM213_17,@SM213_18,@SM213_19,@SM213_20,@SM213_21,@SM213_22,@SM213_23,@SM213_24,
				@SM213_25,@SM213_26,@SM213_27,@SM213_28,@SM213_29,@SM213_30,(select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = @SM213_10),'','',''); 

				SELECT @WHAT = 'SALE_CHILD',@SM213_C1 = '',@SM213_C2 = '',@UNQIDC = NEWID(),@SM213_C4 = @UNQID,@SM213_C5 = @PAR7,@SM213_C6 = (SELECT SM206_16
				FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = @PAR10),@SM213_C7 = @PAR11,@SM213_C8 = (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE SM209.UNQID = (SELECT SM206_14 FROM SM206 
				WHERE SM206_2 = @PAR10)),@SM213_C9 = @PAR12,@SM213_C10 = @PAR13,@SM213_C11 = @PAR14,@SM213_C12 = '0.00',@SM213_C13 = '0.00',@SM213_C14 = 
				@PAR14,@SM213_C15 = @PAR15,@SM213_C16 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = 
				@PAR7)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_C17 = (CASE WHEN 
				(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),
				@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),@SM213_C18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT 
				SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @PAR8)) IN ('8','08') THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR19) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@PAR17)) END),
				@SM213_C19 = @PAR19;
				
				INSERT INTO SM213_C(SM213_C1,SM213_C2,UNQID,SM213_C4,SM213_C5,SM213_C6,SM213_C7,SM213_C8,SM213_C9,SM213_C10,SM213_C11,SM213_C12,SM213_C13,
				SM213_C14,SM213_C15,SM213_C16,SM213_C17,SM213_C18,SM213_C19)

				@SM213_C13,@SM213_C14,@SM213_C15,@SM213_C16,@SM213_C17,@SM213_C18,@SM213_C19);

	END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_Debit_Note]

@what      NVARCHAR(max)='',
@branchid  NVARCHAR(max)='',
@unqid     NVARCHAR(max)='', 
--@SM403_4   NVARCHAR(max)='',
@SM403_4   DATETIME='',
@SM403_6   NVARCHAR(max)='', --branchid
@SM403_8   NUMERIC(18)=0,    --debit note no
@SM403_9   NVARCHAR(max)='', --customer
@SM403_10  NVARCHAR(max)='', --type
@SM403_11  NVARCHAR(max)='', --include gst or not 
@SM403_12  NVARCHAR(max)='',	
@SM403_13  NVARCHAR(max)='', --rate
@SM403_14  NVARCHAR(max)='', --invoice amt 
@SM403_15  NUMERIC(18,2)=0,  --taxable amt
@SM403_16  NVARCHAR(max)='', --gstper
@SM403_17  NVARCHAR(max)='', --igstamt
@SM403_18  NVARCHAR(max)='', --cgstamt
@SM403_19  NUMERIC(18,2)=0,  --sgstamt
@SM403_20  NUMERIC(18,2)=0,  --total
@sm403_21  NUMERIC(18)=0,    --delayed days
@sm403_22  NVARCHAR(max)='', --invoice no unqid
@CRNDATE   NVARCHAR(max)='',
@SM1018_25 NVARCHAR(max)='',
@punqid    NVARCHAR(max)='',
@SM1018_26 NVARCHAR(max)='',
@naration  NVARCHAR(max)='',
@SM1018_24 NVARCHAR(max)='',
@userid    NVARCHAR(max)='',
@serverip  NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PPUNQ     NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@BRANCH    NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@purchaseunqid NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@SM403_23  NVARCHAR(MAX)='', --PURCHASE UNQID
@SM403_24  NUMERIC(18,2)=0,  --QTY
@SM403_25  NVARCHAR(MAX)=''  --NARATION

AS

if @what='Debit_Note'
begin
      SELECT upper(unqid) as unqid, sm19_5 as Customer FROM sm19 where sm19_11 in('suppl') 
	  and sm19_63 like '%'+@branchid+'%' 
	  order by sm19_5

	  --date
	  select convert (nvarchar,GETDATE(),105) as unq
	  --IGST
	  select upper(unqid)as unqid, sm210_7 AS IGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7 
	  
	  select isnull(max(sm403_8),0)+1 as vno from sm403 where sm403_6=@branchid
	     
	  SELECT upper(SM1011.unqid) as unqid,
	  (SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@branchid)+sm1011_7 as Invno,
	  cast(sm1011_7 as numeric(18,0)) as Invoice 
	  FROM INVN left JOIN SM1011 ON SM1011.UNQID=INVN.IN_5
	  WHERE SM1011_41=@branchid AND 
	  IN_11 <>0.00 AND IN_7='OO'   order by Invoice


	  SELECT upper(unqid) as unqid, sm19_5 as Customer FROM sm19 where sm19_11 in('cust') 
	  and sm19_63 like '%'+@branchid+'%' 
	  order by sm19_5

	  SELECT upper(unqid) as unqid, sm19_5 as Customer FROM sm19 where sm19_11 in('TRANS') 
	  and sm19_63 like '%'+@branchid+'%' 
	  order by sm19_5

	  SELECT upper(unqid) as unqid, sm19_5 as Customer FROM sm19 where sm19_11 in('suppl','cust','TRANS') 
	  and sm19_63 like '%'+@branchid+'%' 
	  order by sm19_5

	  
	  --select case (in_5) when '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
	  --then (in_13) 
	  --else
	  --(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@branchid)+(in_13)
	  --end  as Invno,upper(in_5) as unqid
	  --from invn where  IN_11 <>0.00 AND IN_7='OO' and in_15=@branchid order by invno

	  --------PURCHASE INVOICE--------
	  SELECT SM1005_4 AS UNQID,SM1005_12 AS INVOICENO FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_7=@branchid and sm1005_81 is not null

end


if @what='check'
begin
    if(select pa_10 from PA)=(select unqid from sm205 where unqid=@unqid)
	begin
	     select 'gst' as err
	end
	else
	begin
		 select 'igst' as err
	end
end


IF @what='insert'
begin
    set @punqid=newid();
	set @CRNDATE=getdate();
	SET @PPUNQ=NEWID();
	SELECT @BRANCH=SM403_6 FROM SM403 WHERE UNQID=@punqid

	insert into sm403 values(getdate(),getdate(),@userid,@punqid,@serverip,dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4),dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4),@branchid,'',@SM403_8,@SM403_9,@SM403_10,@SM403_11,@SM403_12,@SM403_13,@SM403_14,ROUND(@SM403_15, 0),@SM403_16,@SM403_17,@SM403_18,@SM403_19,@SM403_20,@sm403_21,@sm403_22,@SM403_23,@SM403_24,@sm403_25)

	--insert into sm403 values(getdate(),getdate(),@userid,@punqid,@serverip,CAST(dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4) AS DATETIME),dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4),@branchid,'',@SM403_8,@SM403_9,@SM403_10,@SM403_11,@SM403_12,@SM403_13,@SM403_14,ROUND(@SM403_15, 0),@SM403_16,@SM403_17,@SM403_18,@SM403_19,@SM403_20,@sm403_21,@sm403_22,@SM403_23,@SM403_24,'')

	SET @naration =
    (
    SELECT 
        CASE UPPER(SM403_10)
            WHEN 'TDS' THEN
                'AMT OF TDS DEDUCTED AGAINST PURCHASE FOR THE TAXABLE VALUE RS. '
                + ISNULL(CAST(SM403_14 AS VARCHAR(50)), '0')
                + '/- TDS DEDUCTED @'
                + ISNULL(CAST(SM403_13 AS VARCHAR(50)), '0')
                + '% RS. '
                + ISNULL(CAST(SM403_20 AS VARCHAR(50)), '0')
        END
    FROM SM403
    WHERE UNQID = @punqid
    )
	 INSERT INTO SM203 VALUES (GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@userid,@PPUNQ,@serverip,@branchid,(SELECT TOP 1 BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'JOURNAL'),(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM203_6a AS NUMERIC(10))), 0) + 1 FROM SM203
     WHERE SM203_101 = @branchid AND SM203_11 = @CRNDATE),(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM203_6a AS NUMERIC(10))), 0) + 1 FROM SM203
     WHERE SM203_101 = @branchid AND SM203_11 = @CRNDATE),
	 --dbo.onlydate(getdate()),--dbo.onlydate(GETDATE()), 
	 dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4),--dbo.getentrydate(),
	 CASE 
    WHEN (select top 1SM403_10 from sm403 order by sm403_8 desc) = 'OTHER' 
        THEN @SM403_25 
    ELSE @naration 
END,
	 --case UPPER(SM403_10) when 'Other' then @SM403_25 else @naration,
	 '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',CONVERT(varchar(23), @SM403_4, 121)+' 00:00:00.000', dbo.onlydate(@SM403_4), --@CRNDATE,getdate(),
	 (SELECT TOP 1 BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'DEBIT NOTE'),'','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

IF @WHAT='GVBIND'
BEGIN
    SELECT SM403.UNQID,convert (nvarchar,sm403_4,105) AS DDATE,SM403_8 AS VNO,SM19_6 AS CUSTOMER,SM403_10 AS TIPE,SM403_20 AS TOTAL FROM SM403 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM403.SM403_9 order by SM403_8 desc
	
END

if @what= 'getdata'
begin
	select sm403_8 as vno,convert (nvarchar,sm403_4,105) as d_date,(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid= upper(sm403_9)) as acname,sm403_10 as types,sm403_11 as checkgst,SM403_13 as rate,SM403_14 as invamt,SM403_15 as taxable,
	upper(SM403_16) as gstper,SM403_17 as igstamt,SM403_18 as cgstamt,SM403_19 as sgstamt,SM403_20 as total,sm403_21 delaydays,upper(sm403_22) as invno,sm403_24 as Quantity, sm403_25 as narations from sm403 where unqid=@unqid
end

pa_28 as para1, pa_12 as para2, pa_30 as para3, PA_31 AS para4, pa_32 as para5, pa_5 as reg1, pa_7 as reg2, pa_4 as [signature], PA_20 AS PanNo,
pa_25 as CinNo FROM PA INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID=PA.PA_10


select in_12,sm1002_7 as branch,sm19_6 as customer , sum(invn) as os ,sum(m3)as ledger , sum(m3) -sum(invn)
as diff from (
select in_12 ,in_15 ,sum(in_11) as invn,0.00 as m3 from invn  group by in_12,in_15
union all
select  m3_4 ,m3_23, 0.00 as invn ,sum(m3_6)*-1 as m3  
from m3 
--where m3_4 in (select in_12 from invn )  
group by m3_4,m3_23 
) as a inner join sm19 on in_12=sm19.unqid 
inner join sm1002  on in_15=sm1002_5 where sm19_11='cust' 
group by in_12,in_15,sm19_6,sm1002_7 having sum(invn) <>sum(m3) 
order by sm1002_7,sm19_6

end

from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@purchaseunqid
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_CRYSTAL_Report] 

@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

---@group         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@unqid        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

@uid        AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@FromDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@ToDate AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearFrom AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearTo AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@FYStart AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@FYEnd AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@groupid NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCT        AS NVARCHAR(max)=''


AS

begin 






IF @AA = 'ALL_DDD'
BEGIN


  
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;



    -- Declare variables for dynamic SQL
    DECLARE @SQLL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @Columnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SelectColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @monthss NVARCHAR(30) = '';

    -- Set default dates if @FromDate or @ToDate are not provided
    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, -12, GETDATE());
    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = GETDATE();

    -- Ensure dates are DATE
    SET @FromDate = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate, 103);
    SET @ToDate = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate, 103);

    -- Fiscal Year logic
    IF MONTH(@FromDate) >= 4
    BEGIN
        SET @FYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate), 4, 1);
        SET @FYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) + 1, 3, 31);
        SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) - 1, 4, 1);
        SET @LastYearto   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate), 3, 31);
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @FYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) - 1, 4, 1);
        SET @FYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate), 3, 31);
        SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) - 2, 4, 1);
        SET @LastYearto   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) - 1, 3, 31);
    END;


	print @FYStart;
	print @FYEnd;
	print @LastYearFrom;
	print @LastYearto;


    -- Dynamically generate pivot column list
    ;WITH DateCTE AS (
        SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FYStart), MONTH(@FYStart), 1) AS MonthStart
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart)
        FROM DateCTE
        WHERE DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart) <= @FYEnd
    )
    SELECT
        @Columnss = @Columnss + ',[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + 
		+ ']',
        @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss
            + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) 
			+ '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '_AMT]'
            + ',ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM'))  
			+ '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM'))  + '_QTY]'
            + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) 
			+ '] / NULLIF(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) +
			+ '], 0), 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + 
			+ '_AVG]' 
   FROM DateCTE
   OPTION (MAXRECURSION 1000); 

    -- Remove leading commas
    SET @Columnss = STUFF(@Columnss, 1, 1, '');
    SET @SelectColumnss = STUFF(@SelectColumnss, 1, 1, '');

   print @Columnss;
   




	--declare @monthss as nvarchar(30) = '';
	set @monthss = 
 (NULLIF(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'yyyy-MM')) 
     FROM SM1011 
     WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FYStart AND @FYEnd  
    AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, ',')) 
    AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, ',')) 
     AND SM1011_24 > 0) ,1))
print @monthss;

    -- Add Total Column AVG logic for FY25-26
    SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + ',
    ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_AMT],
    ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_QTY],
    CASE WHEN (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)) / 
              (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0))
    END AS [TOTAL_AVG]';

	 print @SelectColumnss;


    -- Build the dynamic SQL
    SET @SQLL = N'
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 AS Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 AS a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) AS MonthYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount, 
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity 
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
       -- WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate

       WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FYSTART AND @FYEND
          AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
          AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5, sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM''))
    ),
    --LastYearData AS (
    --    SELECT
    --        sm206_7 AS Product,
    --        ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 AS a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
    --        sm19_5 AS custName,
    --        LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) AS MonthYear,
    --        SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount, 
    --        SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity 
    --    FROM SM1011
    --    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    --    INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
    --    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
    --    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @LastYearFrom AND @LastYearTo
    --      AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
    --      AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
    --    GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5, sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM''))
    --),
	LastYearData AS(
	
            SELECT
            ProductMas1308.Product_PrintName AS Product,
            (SELECT Group_Name FROM GroupMas AS a WHERE a.Group_Id = AccountMas1308.Account_GroupId) AS GroupName,
            AccountMas1308.Account_PrintName AS custName,
			LOWER(format(invoice_date, ''MMM'' )) AS MonthYear,
            SUM(invoice_grossAmt) AS Amount, 
            SUM(invdet_productqty * unitmas.Unit_ConvFactor) AS Quantity 
        FROM InvDet1308
        INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 ON ProductMas1308.Product_ID = InvDet1308.InvDet_ProductId
        INNER JOIN invoice1308 ON invoice1308.Invoice_Id = InvDet1308.InvDet_invoiceId
        INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 ON AccountMas1308.Account_Id = invoice1308.Invoice_PartyId
        INNER JOIN BranchInfo ON BranchInfo.Branch_id = invoice1308.Branchid
		inner join unitmas on unitmas.unit_id  = InvDet1308.InvDet_ProductUnitId
        WHERE invoice_date between ''2024-04-01'' and  ''2025-03-31''
        GROUP BY AccountMas1308.Account_PrintName,AccountMas1308.Account_GroupId,  ProductMas1308.Product_PrintName , invoice_date
),
 LastYearHighest AS (
SELECT
Product,
GroupName,
custName,
MAX(Amount) AS Max_AMT,
MAX(Quantity) AS Max_QTY,
CASE WHEN MAX(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(Amount) / MAX(Quantity) END AS Max_AVG
FROM LastYearData
GROUP BY Product, GroupName, custName
),

    AmtPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Amount FROM BaseData) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (SUM(Amount) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')) AS PivotTable
    ),
    QtyPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Quantity FROM BaseData) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (SUM(Quantity) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')) AS PivotTable
    ),
    YearlyAggregates AS (
        SELECT
            Product,
            GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS ThisYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS ThisYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount) / SUM(Quantity) END AS ThisYearAvgPrice
        FROM BaseData
        GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
    ),
    LastYearAggregates AS (
        SELECT
            Product,
            GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS LastYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS LastYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount) / SUM(Quantity) END AS LastYearAvgPrice
        FROM LastYearData
        GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
    )
    SELECT
        A.GroupName,
        A.custName,
        A.Product,
        -- This Year
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS ThisYear_AMT,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS ThisYear_QTY,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearAvgPrice, 0) AS ThisYear_AVG,
        -- Last Year
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS LastYear_AMT,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS LastYear_QTY,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearAvgPrice, 0) AS LastYear_AVG,
		------ADding highest
		ISNULL(H.Max_AMT, 0) AS LYH_AMT,
        ISNULL(H.Max_QTY, 0) AS LYH_QTY,
         ISNULL(H.Max_AVG, 0) AS LYH_AVG,
        -- Grand Totals (no extra query, just reuse yearly aggregates)
      --  ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS Total_AMT,
       -- ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS Total_QTY,
        ' + @SelectColumnss + '
    FROM AmtPivot A
    JOIN QtyPivot Q ON A.custName = Q.custName AND A.Product = Q.Product
    LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y ON A.custName = Y.custName AND A.Product = Y.Product
    LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L ON A.custName = L.custName AND A.Product = L.Product
	LEFT JOIN LastYearHighest H ON A.custName = H.custName AND A.Product = H.Product
    ORDER BY A.Product;
    ';

    EXEC sp_executesql @SQLL,
        N'@FromDate DATE, @ToDate DATE, @Branch VARCHAR(MAX), @product VARCHAR(MAX), @LastYearFrom DATE, @LastYearTo DATE, @FYStart DATE , @FYEnd DATE',
        @FromDate = @FromDate,
        @ToDate = @ToDate,
        @Branch = @Branch,
        @product = @product,
        @LastYearFrom = @LastYearFrom,
        @LastYearTo = @LastYearTo,
        @FYStart = @FYStart,
        @FYend = @FYend;
END



end

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_CRYSTAL_Reportt]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_CRYSTAL_Reportt] 
    @AA NVARCHAR(50),
    @BRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @unqid NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @uid NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @FromDate NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @ToDate NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @LastYearFrom NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @LastYearTo NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @FYStart NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @FYEnd NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @groupid NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @PRODUCT NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; -- 💡 Crucial for performance, especially with reporting tools

    -- Internal variables for safe date calculations
    DECLARE @DateFrom DATE;
    DECLARE @DateTo DATE;
    DECLARE @LYFrom DATE;
    DECLARE @LYTo DATE;
    DECLARE @FiscalStart DATE;
    DECLARE @FiscalEnd DATE;

    DECLARE @SQLL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @Columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SelectColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @MonthCount INT = 0; -- Use INT for month count

    IF @AA = 'ALL_DDD'
    BEGIN
        -- Initial report header data
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME],
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) AS [ADMOFFICE]
        FROM PA;

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Standardize and Calculate Date Range
        ----------------------------------------------------

        -- Use CONVERT, assuming input date format 103 (dd/mm/yyyy) is guaranteed or will fail gracefully
        SET @DateTo = CONVERT(DATE, ISNULL(@ToDate, GETDATE()), 103);
        SET @DateFrom = CONVERT(DATE, ISNULL(@FromDate, DATEADD(MONTH, -12, GETDATE())), 103);

        -- Fiscal Year logic
        IF MONTH(@DateTo) >= 4
        BEGIN
            SET @FiscalStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@DateTo), 4, 1);
            SET @FiscalEnd = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @FiscalStart));
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @FiscalStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@DateTo) - 1, 4, 1);
            SET @FiscalEnd = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @FiscalStart));
        END;

        -- Last Year's Fiscal Range
        SET @LYFrom = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @FiscalStart);
        SET @LYTo = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @FiscalEnd);

        -- Convert internal DATEs back to NVARCHAR(50) for dynamic SQL string concatenation (less efficient, but required by parameter constraints)
        SET @FromDate = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @DateFrom, 120);
        SET @ToDate = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @DateTo, 120);
        SET @FYStart = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @FiscalStart, 120);
        SET @FYEnd = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @FiscalEnd, 120);
        SET @LastYearFrom = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @LYFrom, 120);
        SET @LastYearTo = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @LYTo, 120);
        
        -- Calculate Month Count 💡 Faster than querying the table
        SET @MonthCount = DATEDIFF(MONTH, @FiscalStart, @FiscalEnd) + 1;


		print  @FYStart;
		print  @FYEnd;
		print  @LastYearFrom;
		print  @LastYearTo;
		print  @MonthCount;


        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Dynamic Pivot Column Generation
        ----------------------------------------------------

        ;WITH DateCTE AS (
            SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FiscalStart), MONTH(@FiscalStart), 1) AS MonthStart
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart)
            FROM DateCTE
            WHERE DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart) <= @FiscalEnd
        )
        SELECT
            @Columns = STUFF((
                SELECT ',[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + ']'
                FROM DateCTE
                ORDER BY MonthStart
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''),
            @SelectColumns = STUFF((
                SELECT
                    ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '_AMT]'
                    + ',ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '_QTY]'
                    + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '] / NULLIF(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '], 0), 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + '_AVG]'
                FROM DateCTE
                ORDER BY MonthStart
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '')
        OPTION (MAXRECURSION 36);

        -- Append Yearly Aggregates
        SET @SelectColumns = @SelectColumns + ',
        ROUND(ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt,0)/NULLIF(' + CAST(@MonthCount AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ',0),3) AS [TOTAL_AMT],
        ROUND(ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty,0)/NULLIF(' + CAST(@MonthCount AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ',0),3) AS [TOTAL_QTY],
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt,0)/NULLIF(Y.ThisYearTotalQty,0) END AS [TOTAL_AVG]';

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Dynamic SQL Execution (Improved Filtering)
        ----------------------------------------------------
		print  @Columns;
		print  @SelectColumns;



        SET @SQLL = N'
        -- 💡 Optimization: Use temporary tables for branch and product filtering
        -- This avoids running the multi-statement dbo.split function repeatedly for every row.
        SELECT data AS BranchId INTO #BranchFilter FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '','') WHERE data IS NOT NULL;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Branch ON #BranchFilter (BranchId);

        SELECT data AS ProductId INTO #ProductFilter FROM dbo.split(@Product, '','') WHERE data IS NOT NULL;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Product ON #ProductFilter (ProductId);


        WITH BaseData AS (
            SELECT
                sm206_7 AS Product,
                ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 a WHERE a.unqid = T2.sm19_58), T2.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
                T2.sm19_5 AS custName,
                LOWER(FORMAT(T1.SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) AS MonthYear,
                SUM(T1.SM1011_24) AS Amount,
                SUM(CAST(T1.SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity
            FROM SM1011 T1
            INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = T1.sm1011_13
            INNER JOIN sm19 T2 ON T2.unqid = T1.sm1011_10
            INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = T1.sm1011_41
            -- 💡 Use temp tables for efficient filtering
            INNER JOIN #ProductFilter PF ON T1.SM1011_13 = PF.ProductId
            INNER JOIN #BranchFilter BF ON T1.SM1011_41 = BF.BranchId
            WHERE T1.SM1011_6 BETWEEN ''' + @FYStart + ''' AND ''' + @FYEnd + '''
            GROUP BY T2.sm19_58, T2.sm19_5, sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(T1.SM1011_6, ''MMM''))
        ),
        LastYearData AS (
            SELECT
                ProductMas1308.Product_PrintName AS Product,
                (SELECT Group_Name FROM GroupMas a WHERE a.Group_Id = AccountMas1308.Account_GroupId) AS GroupName,
                AccountMas1308.Account_PrintName AS custName,
                LOWER(FORMAT(invoice_date,''MMM'')) AS MonthYear,
                SUM(invoice_grossAmt) AS Amount,
                SUM(invdet_productqty * unitmas.Unit_ConvFactor) AS Quantity
            FROM InvDet1308
            INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 ON ProductMas1308.Product_ID = InvDet1308.InvDet_ProductId
            INNER JOIN invoice1308 ON invoice1308.Invoice_Id = InvDet1308.InvDet_invoiceId
            INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 ON AccountMas1308.Account_Id = invoice1308.Invoice_PartyId
            INNER JOIN BranchInfo ON BranchInfo.Branch_id = invoice1308.Branchid
            INNER JOIN unitmas ON unitmas.unit_id = InvDet1308.InvDet_ProductUnitId
            WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN ''' + @LastYearFrom + ''' AND ''' + @LastYearTo + '''
            GROUP BY AccountMas1308.Account_PrintName, AccountMas1308.Account_GroupId, ProductMas1308.Product_PrintName, invoice_date
        ),
        LastYearHighest AS (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName,
                    MAX(Amount) AS Max_AMT,
                    MAX(Quantity) AS Max_QTY,
                    CASE WHEN MAX(Quantity)=0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(Amount)/MAX(Quantity) END AS Max_AVG
            FROM LastYearData
            GROUP BY Product, GroupName, custName
        ),
        AmtPivot AS (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columns + '
            FROM (SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Amount FROM BaseData) src
            PIVOT (SUM(Amount) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columns + ')) pvt
        ),
        QtyPivot AS (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columns + '
            FROM (SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Quantity FROM BaseData) src
            PIVOT (SUM(Quantity) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columns + ')) pvt
        ),
        YearlyAggregates AS (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName,
                    SUM(Amount) AS ThisYearTotalAmt,
                    SUM(Quantity) AS ThisYearTotalQty,
                    CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount)/SUM(Quantity) END AS ThisYearAvgPrice
            FROM BaseData
            GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
        ),
        LastYearAggregates AS (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName,
                    SUM(Amount) AS LastYearTotalAmt,
                    SUM(Quantity) AS LastYearTotalQty,
                    CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount)/SUM(Quantity) END AS LastYearAvgPrice
            FROM LastYearData
            GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
        )
        SELECT ISNULL(A.GroupName, Q.GroupName) AS GroupName, ISNULL(A.custName, Q.custName) AS custName, ISNULL(A.Product, Q.Product) AS Product,
                ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt,0) AS ThisYear_AMT,
                ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty,0) AS ThisYear_QTY,
                ISNULL(Y.ThisYearAvgPrice,0) AS ThisYear_AVG,
                ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt,0) AS LastYear_AMT,
                ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty,0) AS LastYear_QTY,
                ISNULL(L.LastYearAvgPrice,0) AS LastYear_AVG,
                ISNULL(H.Max_AMT,0) AS LYH_AMT,
                ISNULL(H.Max_QTY,0) AS LYH_QTY,
                ISNULL(H.Max_AVG,0) AS LYH_AVG,
                ' + @SelectColumns + '
        FROM AmtPivot A
        -- 💡 Use FULL OUTER JOIN to ensure all records from both pivots are included
        FULL OUTER JOIN QtyPivot Q ON A.custName = Q.custName AND A.Product = Q.Product AND A.GroupName = Q.GroupName
        -- Use ISNULL(A.col, Q.col) for LEFT JOINs to correctly join all records
        LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y ON ISNULL(A.custName, Q.custName) = Y.custName AND ISNULL(A.Product, Q.Product) = Y.Product
        LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L ON ISNULL(A.custName, Q.custName) = L.custName AND ISNULL(A.Product, Q.Product) = L.Product
        LEFT JOIN LastYearHighest H ON ISNULL(A.custName, Q.custName) = H.custName AND ISNULL(A.Product, Q.Product) = H.Product
        ORDER BY ISNULL(A.Product, Q.Product);

        DROP TABLE #BranchFilter;
        DROP TABLE #ProductFilter;'


		print @SQLL;
        -- Execute the dynamic SQL with strong parameter typing (best practice)
        EXEC sp_executesql @SQLL,
            N'@Branch NVARCHAR(MAX), @Product NVARCHAR(MAX), @LastYearFrom NVARCHAR(50), @LastYearTo NVARCHAR(50), @FYStart NVARCHAR(50), @FYEnd NVARCHAR(50)',
            @Branch=@BRANCH, @Product=@PRODUCT,
            @LastYearFrom=@LastYearFrom, @LastYearTo=@LastYearTo, @FYStart=@FYStart, @FYEnd=@FYEnd;
    END


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_Report] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

---@group         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@unqid        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

@uid        AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@FromDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@ToDate AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearFrom AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearTo AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@groupid NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCT        AS NVARCHAR(max)=''


AS

begin 


if @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
begin 
print @unqid

	SELECT 
    SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname 
        FROM SM206 
 
WHERE CAST(SM206_13 AS VARCHAR) IN (
    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) FROM dbo.split(@unqid,
 ','
    )
)
ORDER BY Dname;

			
			
end
if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN


    declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	---------------------table 0--------------------------
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY Dname ASC;

	---------------------table 1--------------------------

	select sm206_2 as unqid, sm206_7 as Dname from sm206 order by sm206_7;

    ---------------------table 2--------------------------

	SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 ;



	-----------------------table 3--------------------------
	
	SELECT  distinct a.unqid AS unqid,   a.sm19_5 AS Dname   FROM sm19 a
JOIN 
    sm19 b ON a.sm19_58 = b.unqid
	where a.sm19_58 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';

 -----------------------table 4--------------------------
  --select 'All' as Dname, 0 as unqid
 --union all
 select 'AMT' as Dname, 1 as unqid
 union all
 select 'QTY' as Dname, 2 as unqid

 union all
 select 'AVG PRICE' as Dname, 3 as unqid
 order by unqid;
END


IF @AA = 'ALL_DDD'

BEGIN
    -- Declare variables for dynamic SQL
    DECLARE @SQLL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @Columnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';          -- Stores pivoted column names
    DECLARE @WhereClausee NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';      -- Stores the dynamic WHERE clause
    DECLARE @SelectColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';    -- Stores the SELECT list for pivoted columns
    DECLARE @LastYearColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';   -- For last year's averages
    DECLARE @ThisYearColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';   -- For this year's averages


    -- Set default dates if @FromDate or @ToDate are not provided
    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, -12, GETDATE());
    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = GETDATE();

    -- Ensure dates are in correct format (assuming sm1011_6 is DATE or DATETIME)
    SET @FromDate = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate, 103);
    SET @ToDate = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate, 103);
	print @FromDate;
	print @ToDate;


   IF MONTH(@FromDate) >= 4
BEGIN
    SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 4, 1);
    SET @LastYearTo = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), 3, 31);
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 2, 4, 1);
    SET @LastYearTo = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 3, 31);
END

PRINT @LastYearFrom;
PRINT @LastYearTo;
    -- Dynamically generate column names for the PIVOT operation
    WITH DateCTE AS (
        SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), MONTH(@FromDate), 1) AS MonthStart
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart)
        FROM DateCTE
        WHERE DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart) <= @ToDate
    )
    SELECT
        @Columnss = @Columnss + ',[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + ']',
        @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss
            + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AMT]'
            + ',ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_QTY]'
            + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '] / NULLIF(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0), 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AVG]' -- Average price for the month (Amount / Quantity)
   FROM DateCTE
   OPTION (MAXRECURSION 1000); 

    -- Remove leading commas
    SET @Columnss = STUFF(@Columnss, 1, 1, '');
    SET @SelectColumnss = STUFF(@SelectColumnss, 1, 1, '');
	print @Columnss;
	print @SelectColumnss;


	declare @monthss as nvarchar(30) = '';
	set @monthss = 
 (NULLIF(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'yyyy-MM')) 
     FROM SM1011 
     WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' 
    AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, ',')) 
    AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, ',')) 
     AND SM1011_24 > 0) ,1))
print @monthss;
---- Add Total Column AVG logic for FY25-26
    SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + ',
    ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_AMT],
    ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_QTY],
    CASE WHEN (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0)) / (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(' + CAST(@monthss AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ', 0))
    END AS [TOTAL_AVG]';

	print '1';


    -- Build the dynamic SQL
SET @SQLL = N'
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT
        sm206_7 as Product,
		isnull((select sm19_5 from sm19 as a  where a.unqid =  sm19.sm19_58),sm19.sm19_5) as GroupName,
		
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2) AS MonthYear,
            YEAR(SM1011_6) AS Year,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount, 
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity 
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE 
        SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
        AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5,  sm206_7,LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2), YEAR(SM1011_6)
    ),
    LastYearData AS (
        SELECT
        sm206_7 as Product,
		isnull((select sm19_5 from sm19 as a  where a.unqid =  sm19.sm19_58),sm19.sm19_5) as GroupName,
	

            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2) AS MonthYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount, 
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity 
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE
        SM1011_6 BETWEEN @LastYearFrom AND @LastYearTo
        AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
        AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5,  sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2)
    ),

    AmtPivot AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
		GroupName,
            custName,
            ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (
            SELECT
            Product,
			GroupName,
                custName,
                MonthYear,
                Amount
            FROM BaseData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Amount)
            FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    ),
    QtyPivot AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
		GroupName,
            custName,
            ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (
            SELECT
            Product,
			GroupName,
                custName,
                MonthYear,
                Quantity
            FROM BaseData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Quantity)
            FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    ),
    LastYearAmtPivot AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
			GroupName,
            custName,
		
            ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (
            SELECT
            Product,
				GroupName,
                custName,
                MonthYear,
                Amount
            FROM LastYearData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Amount)
            FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    ),
    LastYearQtyPivot AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
			GroupName,
            custName,
            ' + @Columnss + '
        FROM (
            SELECT
            Product,
				GroupName,
                custName,
                MonthYear,
                Quantity
            FROM LastYearData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Quantity)
            FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    ),
    YearlyAggregates AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
			GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS ThisYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS ThisYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount) / SUM(Quantity) END AS ThisYearAvgPrice
        FROM BaseData
        GROUP BY GroupName,custName,Product
    ),
    LastYearAggregates AS (
        SELECT
        Product,
			GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS LastYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS LastYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount) / SUM(Quantity) END AS LastYearAvgPrice
        FROM LastYearData
        GROUP BY    	GroupName,custName,Product
    )
    SELECT
   	A.GroupName,
        A.custName,
		 A.Product,
         ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS ThisYear_AMT,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS ThisYear_QTY,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearAvgPrice, 0) AS ThisYear_AVG,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS LastYear_AMT,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS LastYear_QTY,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearAvgPrice, 0) AS LastYear_AVG,
        ' + @SelectColumnss + '
        
        
    FROM AmtPivot A
    JOIN QtyPivot Q ON A.custName = Q.custName AND A.Product = Q.Product
    LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y ON A.custName = Y.custName AND A.Product = Y.Product
    LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L ON A.custName = L.custName AND A.Product = L.Product
    ORDER BY A.GroupName, A.custName,A.Product 	;
    ';

    print @SQLL;
    -- Execute the dynamic SQL
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQLL,
        N'@FromDate DATE, @ToDate DATE, @Branch VARCHAR(MAX), @product VARCHAR(MAX), @LastYearFrom DATE, @LastYearTo DATE',
        @FromDate = @FromDate,
        @ToDate = @ToDate,
        @Branch = @Branch,
        @product = @product,
        @LastYearFrom = @LastYearFrom,
        @LastYearTo = @LastYearTo;
END



IF @AA = 'yearly'
BEGIN
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @Columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SelectColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
  


    IF @FromDate IS NULL SET @FromDate = DATEADD(YEAR, -5, GETDATE());
    IF @ToDate IS NULL SET @ToDate = GETDATE();

    SET @FromDate = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate, 103);
    SET @ToDate = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate, 103);

    -- Generate Financial Year Columns
    WITH FinYearCTE AS (
        SELECT CASE 
                 WHEN MONTH(@FromDate) >= 4 THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), 4, 1)
                 ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 4, 1)
               END AS StartDate
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)
        FROM FinYearCTE
        WHERE DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate) <= @ToDate
    )
    SELECT @Columns = STUFF((
        SELECT ',[FY' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' +
               RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + ']'
        FROM FinYearCTE
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') + ',[FY25-26_TOTAL]';

    -- Generate Select Columns
    WITH FinYearCTE AS (
        SELECT CASE 
                 WHEN MONTH(@FromDate) >= 4 THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), 4, 1)
                 ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 4, 1)
               END AS StartDate
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)
        FROM FinYearCTE
        WHERE DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate) <= @ToDate
    )
   -- Build SelectColumns including FY25-26_TOTAL logic
SELECT @SelectColumns = STUFF((

    SELECT
        ',ISNULL(A.[FY' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '], 0) AS [FY' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '_AMT]' +

        ',ISNULL(Q.[FY' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '], 0) AS [FY' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '_QTY]' +

        ',ISNULL(A.[FY' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '] / NULLIF(Q.[FY' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '], 0), 0) AS [FY' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '-' + 
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR, 1, StartDate)) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '_AVG]'
    FROM FinYearCTE
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '')
declare @months as nvarchar(30) = '';
	set @months = 
 (NULLIF(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'yyyy-MM')) 
     FROM SM1011 
     WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' 
    AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, ',')) 
    AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, ',')) 
     AND SM1011_24 > 0) ,1))
print @months;
-- Add Total Column AVG logic for FY25-26
SET @SelectColumns = @SelectColumns + ',
ROUND((ISNULL(A.[FY25-26_TOTAL], 0)  / '+ @months +'),3)  AS [FY25-26TOTAL_AMT],
ROUND((ISNULL(Q.[FY25-26_TOTAL], 0) / '+ @months +'),3)  AS [FY25-26TOTAL_QTY],
(ISNULL(A.[FY25-26_TOTAL] , 0) / '+ @months +') / (ISNULL(Q.[FY25-26_TOTAL], 0) / '+ @months +')   AS [FY25-26TOTAL_AVG]'

	



print @SelectColumns;

 -- Step 3: Construct and execute dynamic pivot query
    SET @SQL = '
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 AS Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(SM1011_6) >= 4 THEN ''FY'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) AS VARCHAR), 2) + ''-'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE ''FY'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) - 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) + ''-'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END AS FinYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18, 0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
            AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
            AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY sm206_7, sm19_5, sm19.sm19_58,
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(SM1011_6) >= 4 THEN ''FY'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) AS VARCHAR), 2) + ''-'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE ''FY'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) - 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) + ''-'' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(SM1011_6) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END

        UNION ALL

        -- Total Row for FY24-25
        SELECT
            sm206_7 AS Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            ''FY25-26_TOTAL'' AS FinYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18, 0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN ''2025-04-01'' AND ''2026-03-31''
            AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
            AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY sm206_7, sm19_5, sm19.sm19_58
    ),
    AmtPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columns + '
        FROM (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, FinYear, Amount FROM BaseData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Amount) FOR FinYear IN (' + @Columns + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    ),
    QtyPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @Columns + '
        FROM (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, FinYear, Quantity FROM BaseData
        ) AS SourceTable
        PIVOT (
            SUM(Quantity) FOR FinYear IN (' + @Columns + ')
        ) AS PivotTable
    )
    SELECT
        A.GroupName,
        A.custName,
        A.Product,
        ' + @SelectColumns + '
    FROM AmtPivot A
    JOIN QtyPivot Q 
        ON A.GroupName = Q.GroupName AND A.custName = Q.custName AND A.Product = Q.Product
    ORDER BY A.GroupName, A.custName, A.Product;
    ';

    -- Uncomment to debug
    PRINT @SQL;


    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL,
        N'@FromDate DATE, @ToDate DATE, @Branch VARCHAR(MAX), @product VARCHAR(MAX)',
        @FromDate = @FromDate,
        @ToDate = @ToDate,
        @Branch = @Branch,
        @product = @product;
END

end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_Report_CR]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
