CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_Report_CR]
    -- Parameters are NVARCHAR to handle string input, but we convert them to DATE immediately
    @AA AS NVARCHAR(50),
    @BRANCH AS NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @unqid AS NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @uid AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @FromDate AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @ToDate AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @groupid NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @PRODUCT AS NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Local variables for date ranges
    DECLARE @FromDate_Conv DATE;
    DECLARE @ToDate_Conv DATE;
    DECLARE @FYStart DATE, @FYEnd DATE, @LYStart DATE, @LYEnd DATE;

    -- Use CONVERT with style code 103 for DD/MM/YYYY format to prevent conversion errors
    -- This is the critical fix for the "Conversion failed" error
    SET @FromDate_Conv = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate, 103);
    SET @ToDate_Conv   = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate, 103);

    -- Calculate current and last fiscal year based on the converted @ToDate
    IF MONTH(@ToDate_Conv) >= 4
    BEGIN
        SET @FYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv), 4, 1);
        SET @FYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv) + 1, 3, 31);
        SET @LYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv) - 1, 4, 1);
        SET @LYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv), 3, 31);
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @FYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv) - 1, 4, 1);
        SET @FYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv), 3, 31);
        SET @LYStart = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv) - 2, 4, 1);
        SET @LYEnd   = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate_Conv) - 1, 3, 31);
    END;

    
    -- Declare variables for dynamic SQL
    DECLARE @DynamicSQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @PivotCols NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @PivotCols_FinalSelect NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- This is the key to making the report dynamic and not tied to a specific year.
    -- It generates the column list for the PIVOT query based on the calculated fiscal year range.
    SELECT @PivotCols = STUFF((
        SELECT ',[' + LOWER(FORMAT(DATEADD(month, n-1, @FYStart), 'MMMyy')) + ']'
        FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers
        WHERE n <= 12
        FOR XML PATH('')
    ), 1, 1, '');

    -- Build the final SELECT column list, removing the year from the alias
    SELECT @PivotCols_FinalSelect = STUFF((
        SELECT ', ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(DATEADD(month, n-1, @FYStart), 'MMMyy')) + '], 0) AS f' + LEFT(DATENAME(month, DATEADD(month, n-1, @FYStart)), 3)
              + ', ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(DATEADD(month, n-1, @FYStart), 'MMMyy')) + '], 0) AS f' + LEFT(DATENAME(month, DATEADD(month, n-1, @FYStart)), 3) + '1'
        FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers
        WHERE n <= 12
        FOR XML PATH('')
    ), 1, 1, '');

    -- Main dynamic SQL block with the generated pivot columns
    SET @DynamicSQL = N'
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 as Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) as GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMMyy'')) AS MonthYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate_Conv AND @ToDate_Conv
          AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
          AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY 
		
		sm206_7,sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMMyy''))
    ),
    LastYearData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 as Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) as GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @LYStart AND @LYEnd
          AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
          AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
        GROUP BY  sm206_7,sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5
    ),
    AmtPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @PivotCols + '
        FROM (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Amount FROM BaseData
        ) src
        PIVOT (SUM(Amount) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @PivotCols + ')) p
    ),
    QtyPivot AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, ' + @PivotCols + '
        FROM (
            SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Quantity FROM BaseData
        ) src
        PIVOT (SUM(Quantity) FOR MonthYear IN (' + @PivotCols + ')) p
    ),
    YearlyAggregates AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS ThisYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS ThisYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount)/SUM(Quantity) END AS ThisYearAvgPrice
        FROM BaseData
        GROUP BY Product, GroupName, custName
    ),
    LastYearAggregates AS (
        SELECT Product, GroupName, custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS LastYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS LastYearTotalQty,
            CASE WHEN SUM(Quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(Amount)/SUM(Quantity) END AS LastYearAvgPrice
        FROM LastYearData
        GROUP BY Product, GroupName, custName
    )

	SELECT
    A.Product AS Product_Name,
    A.custName AS Account_Name,
    A.GroupName AS Account_Id,
    ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS fLYA,
    ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS fLYT,

    ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS fCYA,
    ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS fCYT,
    ' + @PivotCols_FinalSelect + ',

    -- 👇 New Total Columns
    ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS fTotAmt,
    ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS fTotQty

FROM AmtPivot A
JOIN QtyPivot Q 
  ON A.custName = Q.custName 
 AND A.Product = Q.Product
 AND A.GroupName = Q.GroupName   -- safer join
LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y 
  ON A.custName = Y.custName 
 AND A.Product = Y.Product
 AND A.GroupName = Y.GroupName
LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L 
  ON A.custName = L.custName 
 AND A.Product = L.Product
 AND A.GroupName = L.GroupName
ORDER BY A.Product;



 --   SELECT
 --       A.Product AS Product_Name,
 --       A.custName AS Account_Name,
 --       A.GroupName AS Account_Id,
 --       ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS fLYA,
 --       ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS fLYT,

 --       ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS fCYA,
 --       ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS fCYT,
 --       ' + @PivotCols_FinalSelect + '
 --   FROM AmtPivot A
 --   JOIN QtyPivot Q ON A.custName = Q.custName AND A.Product = Q.Product
 --   LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y ON A.custName = Y.custName AND A.Product = Y.Product
 --   LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L ON A.custName = L.custName AND A.Product = L.Product
 --   ORDER BY 
	----A.GroupName, A.custName,
	--A.Product;
    ';

	print  @DynamicSQL;

    -- Execute the dynamic SQL, passing local variables as parameters
    EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicSQL,
        N'@FromDate_Conv DATE, @ToDate_Conv DATE, @LYStart DATE, @LYEnd DATE, @Branch NVARCHAR(MAX), @product NVARCHAR(MAX)',
        @FromDate_Conv, @ToDate_Conv, @LYStart, @LYEnd, @Branch, @product;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_Report_typewisee]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_sp_for_Distribution_Report_typewisee]
 @FromDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@ToDate AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearFrom AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LastYearTo AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
    @Branch VARCHAR(MAX),
    @product VARCHAR(MAX),
    @unqid VARCHAR(MAX),
    @AA VARCHAR(20),
    @ReportType VARCHAR(20) = 'ALL' -- Possible values: 'ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'QTY_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
AS
BEGIN

IF @aa = 'ADDD'
BEGIN
    DECLARE @SQLL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @Columnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''; -- Used for PIVOT IN clause (e.g., [jan25],[feb25])
    DECLARE @SelectColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''; -- Used for final SELECT list (e.g., ISNULL(A.[jan25],0) AS [jan25_AMT])

    DECLARE @CalculatedLastYearFrom DATE;
    DECLARE @CalculatedLastYearTo DATE;



    -- Set default dates if @FromDate or @ToDate are not provided
    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, -12, GETDATE());
    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = GETDATE();

    -- Ensure dates are in correct format (assuming sm1011_6 is DATE or DATETIME)
    SET @FromDate = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate, 103);
    SET @ToDate = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate, 103);
	print @FromDate;
	print @ToDate;


   IF MONTH(@FromDate) >= 4
BEGIN
    SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 4, 1);
    SET @LastYearTo = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), 3, 31);
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SET @LastYearFrom = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 2, 4, 1);
    SET @LastYearTo = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate) - 1, 3, 31);
END

PRINT @LastYearFrom;
PRINT @LastYearTo;
    
      WITH DateCTE AS (
        SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FromDate), MONTH(@FromDate), 1) AS MonthStart
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart)
        FROM DateCTE
        WHERE DATEADD(MONTH, 1, MonthStart) <= @ToDate
    )
    SELECT
        -- Build the column list for PIVOT IN clause
        @Columnss = @Columnss + ',[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + ']',
        
        @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss
            + CASE @ReportType
                WHEN 'QTY_ONLY' THEN
                    ',ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_QTY]'
                WHEN 'AMT_ONLY' THEN
                    ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AMT]'
                WHEN 'AVG_ONLY' THEN
                    ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '] / NULLIF(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0), 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AVG]'
                ELSE 
                    + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AMT]'
                    + ',ISNULL(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_QTY]'
                    + ',ISNULL(A.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '] / NULLIF(Q.[' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '], 0), 0) AS [' + LOWER(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'MMM')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(MonthStart, 'yy'), 2) + '_AVG]'
            END
    FROM DateCTE
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 366); -- Increased MAXRECURSION for potentially longer date ranges

    -- Remove the leading comma from @Columnss and @SelectColumnss
    SET @Columnss = STUFF(@Columnss, 1, 1, '');
    SET @SelectColumnss = STUFF(@SelectColumnss, 1, 1, '');
    PRINT 'Dynamic Pivot Columns: ' + @Columnss;
    PRINT 'Dynamic Select Columns for Monthly Data: ' + @SelectColumnss;

    -- Calculate @monthss (number of unique months in the period)
    -- Corrected the fixed date range to use parameters and changed NULLIF(..., 1) to NULLIF(..., 0)
 --   	declare @monthss as nvarchar(30) = '';
	--set @monthss = 
 --(NULLIF(
 --   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'yyyy-MM')) 
 --    FROM SM1011 
 --    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' 
 --   AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, ',')) 
 --   AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, ',')) 
 --    AND SM1011_24 > 0) ,1))

 DECLARE @FYStart DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) - CASE WHEN MONTH(@ToDate) < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 4, 1);
DECLARE @FYEnd   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate) + CASE WHEN MONTH(@ToDate) < 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 3, 31);

DECLARE @monthss AS NVARCHAR(30) = '';
SET @monthss = (
    NULLIF((
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'yyyy-MM'))
        FROM SM1011
        WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FYStart AND @FYEnd
          AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, ','))
          AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, ','))
          AND SM1011_24 > 0
    ), 0)
);
print @monthss;

    -- Append the TOTAL_ columns (Total Amount, Total Quantity, Total Average for the current period)
    -- Add a leading comma only if @SelectColumnss already has content
    IF LEN(@SelectColumnss) > 0
        SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + ','; 

    IF @ReportType = 'QTY_ONLY'
    BEGIN
        SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + N'
        ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_QTY]';
    END
    ELSE IF @ReportType = 'AMT_ONLY'
    BEGIN
        SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + N'
        ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_AMT]';
    END
    ELSE IF @ReportType = 'AVG_ONLY'
    BEGIN
        SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + N'
        CASE WHEN (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)) / (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0))
        END AS [TOTAL_AVG]';
    END
    ELSE -- 'ALL'
    BEGIN
        SET @SelectColumnss = @SelectColumnss + N'
        ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_AMT],
        ROUND((ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)), 3) AS [TOTAL_QTY],
        CASE WHEN (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0)) / (ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) / NULLIF(@monthss, 0))
        END AS [TOTAL_AVG]';
    END

    PRINT 'Final @SelectColumnss for Monthly & Total Data: ' + @SelectColumnss;

    -- Start building the main dynamic SQL query
    SET @SQLL = N'
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 AS Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 AS a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2) AS MonthYear,
            YEAR(SM1011_6) AS Year,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE
            SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
            AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
            AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
            AND SM1011_24 > 0 -- Only include rows with amount > 0
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5, sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2), YEAR(SM1011_6)
    ),
    LastYearData AS (
        SELECT
            sm206_7 AS Product,
            ISNULL((SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 AS a WHERE a.unqid = sm19.sm19_58), sm19.sm19_5) AS GroupName,
            sm19_5 AS custName,
            LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2) AS MonthYear,
            SUM(SM1011_24) AS Amount,
            SUM(CAST(SM1011_42 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) AS Quantity
        FROM SM1011
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = sm1011.sm1011_41
        WHERE
            SM1011_6 BETWEEN @LastYearFrom AND @LastYearTo
            AND SM1011_13 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@product, '',''))
            AND SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@Branch, '',''))
            AND SM1011_24 > 0 -- Only include rows with amount > 0
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_58, sm19_5, sm206_7, LOWER(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''MMM'')) + RIGHT(FORMAT(SM1011_6, ''yy''), 2)
    )';

    -- Conditionally add PIVOT CTEs based on ReportType
    -- AmtPivot is needed for 'ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
    IF @ReportType IN ('ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY')
    BEGIN
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N',
        AmtPivot AS (
            SELECT
                Product,
                GroupName,
                custName,
                ' + @Columnss + '
            FROM (
                SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Amount FROM BaseData
            ) AS SourceTable
            PIVOT (
                SUM(Amount)
                FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
            ) AS PivotTable
        )';
    END

    -- QtyPivot is needed for 'ALL', 'QTY_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
    IF @ReportType IN ('ALL', 'QTY_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY')
    BEGIN
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N',
        QtyPivot AS (
            SELECT
                Product,
                GroupName,
                custName,
                ' + @Columnss + '
            FROM (
                SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Quantity FROM BaseData
            ) AS SourceTable
            PIVOT (
                SUM(Quantity)
                FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
            ) AS PivotTable
        )';
    END

    -- LastYearAmtPivot is needed for 'ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
    IF @ReportType IN ('ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY')
    BEGIN
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N',
        LastYearAmtPivot AS (
            SELECT
                Product,
                GroupName,
                custName,
                ' + @Columnss + '
            FROM (
                SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Amount FROM LastYearData
            ) AS SourceTable
            PIVOT (
                SUM(Amount)
                FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
            ) AS PivotTable
        )';
    END

    -- LastYearQtyPivot is needed for 'ALL', 'QTY_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
    IF @ReportType IN ('ALL', 'QTY_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY')
    BEGIN
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N',
        LastYearQtyPivot AS (
            SELECT
                Product,
                GroupName,
                custName,
                ' + @Columnss + '
            FROM (
                SELECT Product, GroupName, custName, MonthYear, Quantity FROM LastYearData
            ) AS SourceTable
            PIVOT (
                SUM(Quantity)
                FOR MonthYear IN (' + @Columnss + ')
            ) AS PivotTable
        )';
    END

    -- YearlyAggregates (for current year totals)
    SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N',
    YearlyAggregates AS (
        SELECT
            Product,
            GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS ThisYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS ThisYearTotalQty
        FROM BaseData
        GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
    ),
    -- LastYearAggregates (for last year totals)
    LastYearAggregates AS (
        SELECT
            Product,
            GroupName,
            custName,
            SUM(Amount) AS LastYearTotalAmt,
            SUM(Quantity) AS LastYearTotalQty
        FROM LastYearData
        GROUP BY GroupName, custName, Product
    )';

    -- Determine the primary pivot table for the FROM clause and initial joins
    -- For 'AMT_ONLY' and 'ALL', AmtPivot will be primary. For 'QTY_ONLY', QtyPivot. For 'AVG_ONLY', AmtPivot (will join QtyPivot).
    DECLARE @PrimaryPivotTable NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @PrimaryPivotAlias NVARCHAR(1);

    IF @ReportType = 'QTY_ONLY'
    BEGIN
        SET @PrimaryPivotTable = 'QtyPivot';
        SET @PrimaryPivotAlias = 'Q';
    END
    ELSE -- 'ALL', 'AMT_ONLY', 'AVG_ONLY'
    BEGIN
        SET @PrimaryPivotTable = 'AmtPivot';
        SET @PrimaryPivotAlias = 'A';
    END

    SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
    SELECT
        ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.GroupName,
        ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.custName,
        ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.Product,';

    -- Add the ThisYear and LastYear aggregate columns explicitly
    IF @ReportType = 'QTY_ONLY'
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_QTY,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_QTY,';
    ELSE IF @ReportType = 'AMT_ONLY'
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_AMT,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_AMT,';
    ELSE IF @ReportType = 'AVG_ONLY'
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt / NULLIF(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0), 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_AVG,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt / NULLIF(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0), 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_AVG,';
    ELSE -- 'ALL'
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt, 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_AMT,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_QTY,
        ISNULL(Y.ThisYearTotalAmt / NULLIF(Y.ThisYearTotalQty, 0), 0) AS ThisYear_TOTAL_AVG,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt, 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_AMT,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_QTY,
        ISNULL(L.LastYearTotalAmt / NULLIF(L.LastYearTotalQty, 0), 0) AS LastYear_TOTAL_AVG,';

    -- Append the dynamically generated monthly pivoted columns and the overall TOTAL_ columns
    SET @SQLL = @SQLL + @SelectColumnss + N'
    FROM ' + @PrimaryPivotTable + ' ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias;

    -- Conditional JOINs for other pivot tables
    IF @ReportType IN ('ALL', 'AVG_ONLY')
    BEGIN
        SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
        LEFT JOIN QtyPivot Q ON ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.custName = Q.custName AND ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.Product = Q.Product';
    END

    -- If 'ALL' or 'AVG_ONLY', we need LastYearAmtPivot and LastYearQtyPivot aliases in scope for direct selection of monthly last year averages if needed
    -- However, the @SelectColumnss is currently only building for current year pivots (A and Q).
    -- If you want to see monthly LastYear_AMT, LastYear_QTY, LastYear_AVG, you'd need to extend @SelectColumnss generation to include those too.
    -- For now, the yearly LastYear_TOTAL_... is covered by the L alias from LastYearAggregates.

    SET @SQLL = @SQLL + N'
    LEFT JOIN YearlyAggregates Y ON ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.custName = Y.custName AND ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.Product = Y.Product
    LEFT JOIN LastYearAggregates L ON ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.custName = L.custName AND ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.Product = L.Product
    ORDER BY ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.GroupName, ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.custName, ' + @PrimaryPivotAlias + '.Product;';

    PRINT @SQLL; -- Print the final constructed query for debugging
    
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQLL,
        N'@FromDate DATE, @ToDate DATE, @Branch VARCHAR(MAX), @product VARCHAR(MAX), @LastYearFrom DATE, @LastYearTo DATE, @unqid VARCHAR(MAX), @AA VARCHAR(20), @ReportType VARCHAR(20), @monthss DECIMAL(18,3)',
        @FromDate = @FromDate,
        @ToDate = @ToDate,
        @Branch = @Branch,
        @product = @product,
        @LastYearFrom = @LastYearFrom,
        @LastYearTo = @LastYearTo,
        @unqid = @unqid,
        @AA = @AA,
        @ReportType = @ReportType,
        @monthss = @monthss; -- Pass @monthss as a parameter
END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DOCUMENTATION]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DOCUMENTATION]

AS 

BEGIN
		--DROP TABLE #Stat9_Table		

		SELECT TABLE_NAME as [Table Name],COLUMN_NAME AS Field_Name,DATA_TYPE as DataType,(CASE WHEN CAST(DATA_TYPE AS NVARCHAR(30)) = CAST('datetime' AS NVARCHAR(30))
		THEN CAST(DATETIME_PRECISION AS NVARCHAR(30)) WHEN CAST(DATA_TYPE AS NVARCHAR(30)) =CAST('numeric' AS NVARCHAR(30))  
		THEN CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS NVARCHAR(30)) + ','+ CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS NVARCHAR(30)) WHEN CAST(DATA_TYPE AS NVARCHAR(30)) =CAST('uniqueidentifier' AS NVARCHAR(30)) 
		THEN '' ELSE CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS NVARCHAR(30)) END) AS [DataLength] INTO #Accounting_Table  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS   order by table_name,
		ORDINAL_POSITION,Column_name 
		
		SELECT * FROM #Accounting_Table ORDER BY [Table Name]

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_DSSP]
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@Warehouse         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@LOC       AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@Wh        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@whl      AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdate    AS  NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS  NVARCHAR(50)='',
@des    as nvarchar(50) = '',

@todate   AS  NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@fdate    as date=''

AS
set @fdate= DATEADD(DAY,DATEPART(DAY,dbo.getformatteddate(@todate))*-1+1,dbo.getformatteddate(@todate))

print @fdate
	
BEGIN
if @aa='warehouse'
BEGIN

select  unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
order by Dname;
end 
if @aa='loc'
BEGIN

select sm1006_c.unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_c.sm1006_c7 as Dname from sm1006_c 
inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid  = sm1006_c.sm1006_c5
where sm1006_c5 in (select data from dbo.split(@warehouse,',')) and sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
order by Dname;
end 

if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN

declare @branchid as nvarchar(max);
set  @branchid = (select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT sm1002_7 AS Dname,SM1002_5 AS UNQID FROM SM1002 
where sm1002_5  in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
ORDER BY Dname;

select unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 order by Dname;

select unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_c7 as Dname from sm1006_c order by Dname;




end


if @aa='ALL_DDD'

begin


-- Declare date variables and convert them
-- Declare date variables and convert them
set @fromdate  = CONVERT(DATE, @todate, 103);  
set @todate = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);




WITH OpeningData AS (
    -- Opening: Purchase
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
		  SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
       --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Opening,
	  sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt ,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1005_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	  	   AND SM1005_38 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND SM1005_44 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Opening: Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
		 SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Opening,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )* -1 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
    WHERE SM1011_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1011_41  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	     AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
		   AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Opening:
    SELECT 
	SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
		--line added by garima
		(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as Opening,
		--line comment by garima
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1023
	join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
	    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7

    WHERE sm1023_5 < @FROMDATE
      AND sm1023_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	     AND sm1023_6 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1023_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7


	
	UNION ALL

    -- Opening: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
      CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
   JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1014_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND sm1014_9 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1014_8 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
TransactionData AS (
    -- Purchase
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,

		 	   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],   
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
       -- (CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Purchase,
	   sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1005_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	  	   AND SM1005_38 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND SM1005_44 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
	
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],   
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
     SUM(SM1011_42) AS Issue,
	   --SUM(
    --    CASE 
    --        WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
    --            THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
    --        ELSE SM1011_42 
    --    END
    --)AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
      AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))




    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1014_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND sm1014_9 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1014_8 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: Purchase
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
       --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Closing, 
	   sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Closing, 
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
		0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid= sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
   jOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1005_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	  	   AND SM1005_38 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))

    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
	   SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        --SUM(SM1011_20) * -1 AS Closing,
		SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Closing,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )* -1 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate,
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
	    cast(SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) / 
		case when SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end)=0 then 1 else  SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) end as numeric(18,2)) as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
    WHERE SM1011_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	     AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
   SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		   
	   SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1023
	join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
	    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6

    WHERE sm1023_5 <= @TODATE
      AND sm1023_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	     AND sm1023_6 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1023_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1023_C8, SM1023_C9, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

		UNION ALL
    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],   
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit

    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10

	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1014_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))

	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

todaysData AS (
    -- Today's sales data 
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,

        0.000 AS Issue,

        0.000 AS Closing,
        sum(SM1011_42) AS todaysqty,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )AS todaysqty,
		0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        SUM(SM1011_24) / SUM(SM1011_19) AS ProductRate, 
        SUM(SM1011_24) AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000  AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
 JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
  JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
    WHERE SM1011_6 = @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	     AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
)
   
-- Final combined result
SELECT 
    PRODUCT,BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION , Unit,'' as [Target],
    SUM(Opening) AS [Opening Qty],
    SUM(Purchase) AS [Receipt Qty],
    SUM(Issue) AS [Issue Qty],
	SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
	 CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [Closing Stock Qty],
	SUM(todaysqty) AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    SUM(Cumulativeqty) AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    --SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
    SUM(ProductRate) AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
	sum(avgperunit) as [Avg Per Unit],
	0 as ord
   
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
GROUP BY PRODUCT, unit ,BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION]

having not
(cast(SUM(Opening) as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Purchase)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Issue)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Adjustment) as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) as numeric(18,3)) = 0.00 and
cast(SUM(todaysqty)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Cumulativeqty)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM(ProductRate)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM([Today's Sale])as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(sum(avgperunit)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 )
UNION ALL


SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS PRODUCT,
	'' AS BRANCH, 
	'' AS WAREHOUSE,
	'' AS [LOCATION],
    '' AS Unit,
   '' AS [Target],
    NULL AS [Opening Qty],
    NULL AS [Receipt Qty],
    NULL AS [Issue Qty],
	null as Adjustment,
    NULL AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Closing Stock Qty],
    NULL AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
    NULL AS [Avg Per Unit],
	1 as ord
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
order by ord asc, product, BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION];




END

		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1014_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND sm1014_9 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1014_8 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: Purchase
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
       --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Closing, 
	   sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Closing, 
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
		0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid= sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
   jOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1005_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	  	   AND SM1005_38 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND SM1005_44 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],    
	   SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        --SUM(SM1011_20) * -1 AS Closing,
		SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Closing,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )* -1 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate,
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
	    cast(SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) / 
		case when SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end)=0 then 1 else  SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) end as numeric(18,2)) as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
    WHERE SM1011_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	     AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
   SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		   
	   SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1023
	join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
	    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7
    WHERE sm1023_5 <= @TODATE
      AND sm1023_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	     AND sm1023_6 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1023_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1023_C8, SM1023_C9, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

		UNION ALL
    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],   
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10

	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1014_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND sm1014_9 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	    AND sm1014_8 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
todaysData AS (
    -- Today's sales data 
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
			   SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,       
	   SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
        sum(SM1011_42) AS todaysqty,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )AS todaysqty,
		0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        SUM(SM1011_24) / SUM(SM1011_19) AS ProductRate, 
        SUM(SM1011_24) AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000  AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
 JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
  JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
    WHERE SM1011_6 = @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	   AND SM1011_39 in (select data from dbo.split(@wh,','))
	     AND SM1011_40 in (select data from dbo.split(@whl,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
)
   
-- Final combined result
SELECT 
    PRODUCT,BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, LOCATION , Unit,'' as [Target],
    SUM(Opening) AS [Opening Qty],
    SUM(Purchase) AS [Receipt Qty],
    SUM(Issue) AS [Issue Qty],
	SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
	 CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [Closing Stock Qty],
	SUM(todaysqty) AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    SUM(Cumulativeqty) AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    --SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
    SUM(ProductRate) AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
	sum(avgperunit) as [Avg Per Unit],
	0 as ord
   
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
GROUP BY PRODUCT, unit ,BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION]

UNION ALL


SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS PRODUCT,
	'' AS BRANCH, 
	'' AS WAREHOUSE,
	'' AS [LOCATION],
    '' AS Unit,
   '' AS [Target],
    NULL AS [Opening Qty],
    NULL AS [Receipt Qty],
    NULL AS [Issue Qty],
	null as Adjustment,
    NULL AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Closing Stock Qty],
    NULL AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
    NULL AS [Avg Per Unit],
	1 as ord
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
order by ord asc, product, BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION];



END

END

if @aa='ALL_DDD'

begin


-- Declare date variables and convert them
set @fromdate  = CONVERT(DATE, @todate, 103);  
set @todate = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);




WITH OpeningData AS (
    -- Opening: Purchase
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
       --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Opening,
	  sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt ,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1005_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Opening: Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		 SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Opening,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )* -1 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39
    WHERE SM1011_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1011_41  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Opening:
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
		--line added by garima
		(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as Opening,
		--line comment by garima
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1023
	join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
	    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7

    WHERE sm1023_5 < @FROMDATE
      AND sm1023_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7


	
	UNION ALL

    -- Opening: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
      CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
  
    WHERE SM1014_6 < @FROMDATE
      AND SM1014_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
TransactionData AS (
    -- Purchase
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
       -- (CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Purchase,
	   sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1005_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
     SUM(SM1011_42) AS Issue,
	   --SUM(
    --    CASE 
    --        WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
    --            THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
    --        ELSE SM1011_42 
    --    END
    --)AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39
    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1014_8
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE AND @TODATE
      AND SM1014_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: Purchase
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
       --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Closing, 
	   sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Closing, 
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
		0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid= sm1005_54
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1005_7  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7,SM1005_22, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: Issue
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        --SUM(SM1011_20) * -1 AS Closing,
		SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Closing,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )* -1 AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate,
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) AS CumulativeSaleAmt,
	    cast(SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_24 else 0.00 end) / 
		case when SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end)=0 then 1 else  SUM(case when sm1011_6 between @fdate and @todate then SM1011_42 else 0.00 end) end as numeric(18,2)) as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
    WHERE SM1011_6 <= @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41  in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
   SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1023
	join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
	    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7
    WHERE sm1023_5 <= @TODATE
      AND sm1023_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1023_C8, SM1023_C9, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7

		UNION ALL
    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing,
		0.000 as todaysqty,
        0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        0.000 AS ProductRate, 
        0.000 AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000 AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit

    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7

    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
),
todaysData AS (
    -- Today's sales data 
    SELECT 
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM209.SM209_7 as Unit,
		  '' as Target,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS Purchase,
        0.000 AS Issue,
        0.000 AS Adjustment,
        0.000 AS Closing,
        sum(SM1011_42) AS todaysqty,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )AS todaysqty,
		0.000 AS Cumulativeqty,
        SUM(SM1011_24) / SUM(SM1011_19) AS ProductRate, 
        SUM(SM1011_24) AS [Today's Sale],
        0.000  AS CumulativeSaleAmt,0.00 as avgperunit
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011_23
	 JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    --JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    --JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39
    WHERE SM1011_6 = @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
)
   
-- Final combined result
SELECT 
    PRODUCT, Unit,'' as [Target],
    SUM(Opening) AS [Opening Qty],
    SUM(Purchase) AS [Receipt Qty],
    SUM(Issue) AS [Issue Qty],
	SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
	 CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [Closing Stock Qty],
	SUM(todaysqty) AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    SUM(Cumulativeqty) AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    --SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
    SUM(ProductRate) AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
	sum(avgperunit) as [Avg Per Unit]
   
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
GROUP BY PRODUCT, unit 
having not
(cast(SUM(Opening) as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Purchase)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Issue)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Adjustment) as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) as numeric(18,3)) = 0.00 and
cast(SUM(todaysqty)as numeric(18,0))=0.00 and
cast(SUM(Cumulativeqty)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM(ProductRate)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM([Today's Sale])as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 and
cast(sum(avgperunit)as numeric(18,0)) =0.00 )
UNION ALL


SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS PRODUCT,
    '' AS Unit,
   '' AS [Target],
    NULL AS [Opening Qty],
    NULL AS [Receipt Qty],
    NULL AS [Issue Qty],
	null as Adjustment,
    NULL AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Closing Stock Qty],
    NULL AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
    NULL AS [Avg Per Unit]
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData;;



END

    WHERE SM1011_6 = @TODATE
      AND SM1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7,SM209.SM209_7, SM1002.SM1002_7
	--, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
)
   
-- Final combined result
SELECT 
    PRODUCT, Unit,'' as [Target],
    SUM(Opening) AS [Opening Qty],
    SUM(Purchase) AS [Receipt Qty],
    SUM(Issue) AS [Issue Qty],
	SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
	 CAST(SUM(Opening + Purchase - Issue + Adjustment) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [Closing Stock Qty],
	SUM(todaysqty) AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    SUM(Cumulativeqty) AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    --SUM(Adjustment) AS Adjustment,
    SUM(ProductRate) AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
	sum(avgperunit) as [Avg Per Unit]
   
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData
GROUP BY PRODUCT, unit 

UNION ALL


SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS PRODUCT,
    '' AS Unit,
   '' AS [Target],
    NULL AS [Opening Qty],
    NULL AS [Receipt Qty],
    NULL AS [Issue Qty],
	null as Adjustment,
    NULL AS [Today's Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Cumulative Sale Qty],
    NULL AS [Closing Stock Qty],
    NULL AS [Product Rate], 
    SUM([Today's Sale]) AS [Today's Sale Amt],
    SUM(CumulativeSaleAmt) AS [Cumulative Sale Amt],
    NULL AS [Avg Per Unit]
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM todaysData
) AS CombinedData;;



END

END
GO

	END

	else if(@pov = 'VISIT')
	BEGIN

		--inner join sm503 on enq_4_c.e_c_12 = sm503.unqid inner join sm113 on enq_4_c.e_c_10 = sm113.unqid inner join enq_3 on enq_4_c.e_c_8 = enq_3.unqid

end

begin
	SELECT 
		(SELECT cast((cast((cast(@CASH as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@SINGLE as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3)) * @MARGIN / 100) as decimal(10, 3))) AS MARGIN1,
    
		(SELECT cast((cast((cast(@CREDIT as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@SINGLE as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3)) * @MARGIN / 100) as decimal(10, 3))) AS MARGIN2--,
    
		--(SELECT cast((cast((cast(@CASH as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@MULTI as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3)) * @MARGIN / 100) as decimal(10, 3))) AS MARGIN3,

end

if @what= 'Totalrate'
begin
	select
		(SELECT cast((cast(@CASH as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@SINGLE as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@margin1 as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3))) AS Total1,

		(SELECT cast((cast(@CREDIT as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@SINGLE as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@margin2 as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3))) AS Total2--,

		--(SELECT cast((cast(@CASH as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@MULTI as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@margin3 as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3))) AS Total3,

		--(SELECT cast((cast(@CREDIT as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@MULTI as numeric(10,3)) + cast(@margin4 as numeric(10,3))) as decimal(10, 3))) AS Total4
end

if @what= 'msgdetails'
begin 
	select(select sm1_5 from sm01 inner join sm113 on sm01.unqid = sm113_10 inner join sm206_c on sm113.unqid = sm206_c.sm206_c7 inner join sm206 on sm206_c.sm206_c6 = sm206.sm206_2 inner join 
		enq_4_c on enq_4_c.e_c_8 = sm206.sm206_2 where e_c_8 = @e_c8 and enq_4_c.e_c_6 = @unq) as fromdestination,
		
		(select sm1_5 from sm01 inner join sm19_CUSTMAS on sm01.unqid = sm19_15 inner join enq_4 on enq_4.e_6 = sm19_CUSTMAS.unqid where enq_4.e_6 = @e_6 and enq_4.unqid = @unq) as todestination;

end

IF @WHAT = 'SHOWPRIVIOUS'
BEGIN
	select FORMAT(e_c_7, 'dd-MM-yyyy') as [DATE], e_c_3 as [USER], (SELECT E_7 FROM ENQ_3 WHERE UNQID = E_C_8) AS PRODUCT,
	STUFF((
		SELECT ', ' + sm503_inner.sm503_2
		FROM (
			-- Splitting inside subquery for XML method
			SELECT TRY_CAST(Split.a.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AS Value
			FROM (
				SELECT CAST('<x>' + REPLACE(enq_4_c.e_c_12, ',', '</x><x>') + '</x>' AS XML) AS Data
			) AS A
			CROSS APPLY Data.nodes('/x') AS Split(a)
		) AS SplitVals
		INNER JOIN sm503 AS sm503_inner ON sm503_inner.unqid = SplitVals.Value
		WHERE enq_4_c.unqid = enq_4_c.unqid
		FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
	, 1, 2, '') AS REMARK,
	E_C_18 AS COMMENT from enq_4 inner join enq_4_c on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6 where e_8 = 'VISIT' AND E_6 = @CUSTNAME

	select sm19_5 as custname from SM19_CUSTMAS where unqid = @CUSTNAME
END

if @what = 'tt_priviousdata'
begin
	select top 2 FORMAT(e_c_7, 'dd-MM-yyyy') as [DATE], e_c_3 as [USER], (SELECT E_7 FROM ENQ_3 WHERE UNQID = E_C_8) AS PRODUCT,
	STUFF((
		SELECT ', ' + sm503_inner.sm503_2
		FROM (
			-- Splitting inside subquery for XML method
			SELECT TRY_CAST(Split.a.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AS Value
			FROM (
				SELECT CAST('<x>' + REPLACE(enq_4_c.e_c_12, ',', '</x><x>') + '</x>' AS XML) AS Data
			) AS A
			CROSS APPLY Data.nodes('/x') AS Split(a)
		) AS SplitVals
		INNER JOIN sm503 AS sm503_inner ON sm503_inner.unqid = SplitVals.Value
		WHERE enq_4_c.unqid = enq_4_c.unqid
		FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
	, 1, 2, '') AS REMARK,
	E_C_18 AS COMMENT from enq_4 inner join enq_4_c on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6 where e_8 = 'VISIT' AND E_6 = @CUSTNAME order by e_c_1 desc
end

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_Export_Transcaton] 
@what	nvarchar(50)='',
@unqid  nvarchar(50)=''
 AS
 IF @what = 'PRINTPDF'
BEGIN
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT BA_7 FROM BA WHERE BA_14=M3_4) IS NOT NULL AND M3_6 <0 THEN 'RECEIPT' 
 ELSE CASE WHEN (SELECT BA_7 FROM BA WHERE BA_14=M3_4) IS NOT NULL AND M3_6 >0  THEN 'PAYMENT' END END AS M3_1
,CONVERT(varchar,M3_2,103) AS [DATE],M3_3 AS VOUCHERNUMBER,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=M3_4) AS LEDGERNAME,M3_5 AS NARRATION,M3_6 AS LEDGERAMOUNT,M3_9 AS [DR/CR]
FROM M3  ORDER BY M3_2,M3_3
END
GO
