-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_FREIGHT_ENTER]
@WHAT NVARCHAR(15) = '',
@enqno nvarchar(50) = '',
@customer nvarchar(50) = '',
@product nvarchar(50) = '',
@SEARCH NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@unq nvarchar(50) = '',
@USERID NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SYSTEM NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@sm404_6 nvarchar(50) = '',    --Enquiry no
@sm404_7 nvarchar(50) = '',    --Enquiry type
@sm404_8 nvarchar(50) = '',    --Customer

--child table
@sm404_c6 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Parent unqid
@sm404_c7 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Broker
@sm404_c8 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Product
@sm404_c9 nvarchar(50) = '',   --from destination
@sm404_c10 nvarchar(50) = '',   --to destination
@sm404_c11 nvarchar(50) = '',   --qty
@sm404_c12 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Total freight
@sm404_c13 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Add margin
@sm404_c14 nvarchar(50) = '',   --Net freight
@sm404_c15 nvarchar(50) = '',   --For
@sm404_c16 nvarchar(50) = ''   --Transporter

as 
begin
if @WHAT = 'INSERTPARENT'
BEGIN
declare @unqid nvarchar(50);
set @unqid = NEWID();
	INSERT INTO SM404 VALUES(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @USERID, @SYSTEM, @unqid, @sm404_6, @sm404_7, @sm404_8)

	select @unqid as PUNQID from sm404
END

if @WHAT = 'update'
begin
	update sm404 set sm404_6 = @sm404_6, sm404_7 = @sm404_7, sm404_8 = @sm404_8 where unqid = @unq
end

if @WHAT = 'INSERTCHILD'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO SM404_C VALUES(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @USERID, @SYSTEM, NEWID(), @sm404_C6, @sm404_C7, @sm404_C8, @SM404_C9, @SM404_C10, @SM404_C11, @SM404_C12, @SM404_C13, @SM404_C14, @SM404_C15, @SM404_C16)
END

if @WHAT = 'dropdownbind'
begin
	select unqid as unqid, sm406_6 as [broker] from sm406 order by sm406_6

	select e_10 as enqno from Enq_4 inner join enq_4_c on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6
		inner join sm113 on enq_4_c.e_c_10 = sm113.unqid inner join sm206 on enq_4_c.e_c_8 = sm206.sm206_2 where sm206.sm206_29 = 'Truck' and e_8 = 'RATE'

	select sm206_2 as unqid, sm206_7 as product from enq_4_c inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = e_c_8 inner join enq_4 on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6 where sm206.sm206_29 = 'Truck' and e_10 = @enqno

	select unqid as unqid, sm1_5 as destination from sm01 order by sm1_5

	select unqid as unqid, sm19_5 as supplier from SM19_CUSTMAS order by sm19_5
end

if @WHAT = 'BINDTEXTBOX'
BEGIN
	
	select (select unqid from SM19_CUSTMAS where unqid = e_6) as supplier, e_11 as enqtype from enq_4 where e_10 = @enqno

	select (select sm01.unqid from sm01 inner join sm113 on sm01.unqid = sm113_10 inner join sm206_c on sm113.unqid = sm206_c.sm206_c7 inner join sm206 on sm206_c.sm206_c6 = sm206.sm206_2 inner join 
		enq_4_c on enq_4_c.e_c_8 = sm206.sm206_2 inner join enq_4 on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6 where e_c_8 = @product and e_10 = @enqno) as fromdestination,
		
		(select sm01.unqid from sm01 inner join sm19_CUSTMAS on sm01.unqid = sm19_15 inner join enq_4 on enq_4.e_6 = sm19_CUSTMAS.unqid where e_10 = @enqno) as todestination, e_c_11 as qty from enq_4_c inner join enq_4 on enq_4.unqid = enq_4_c.e_c_6 where e_c_8 = @product and e_10 = @enqno

END

if @WHAT = 'BROKER'
begin
	select '' as BROKERUNQID, '' as [BROKER]
end

if @WHAT = 'BIND_GRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM404_6 AS ENQNO, SM404_7 AS ENQTYPE, (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19_CUSTMAS WHERE SM19_CUSTMAS.UNQID = SM404_8) AS SUPPLIER FROM SM404 ORDER BY SM404_6
END

IF @WHAT = 'SEARCH_GRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT SM404.UNQID AS UNQID, SM404_6 AS ENQNO, SM404_7 AS ENQTYPE, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER FROM SM404 INNER JOIN SM19_CUSTMAS ON SM19_CUSTMAS.UNQID = SM404_8 WHERE SM19_5 LIKE '%'+@SEARCH+'%' ORDER BY SM404_6
END

IF @WHAT = 'BIND_TB'
begin
	select sm404_6 as ENQNO, SM404_7 AS ENQTYPE, SM404_8 AS SUPPLIER, (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM404_C8) AS PRODUCT, SM404_C8 AS PRODUCTUNQ, SM404_C9 AS FROMDEST, SM404_C10 AS TODEST, SM404_C11 AS QTY, SM404_C15 AS [FOR], SM404_C16 AS TRANSPORTER FROM SM404 INNER JOIN SM404_C ON SM404.UNQID = SM404_C6 WHERE SM404.UNQID = @unq

	SELECT SM404_C7 AS BROKERUNQID, (SELECT SM406_6 FROM SM406 WHERE SM406.unqid = SM404_C7) as BROKER, SM404_C12 AS TOTFREIGHT, SM404_C13 AS ADDMARGIN, SM404_C14 AS NETFREIGHT FROM SM404_C WHERE SM404_C6 = @unq
end

IF @WHAT = 'delete'
begin
	delete from sm404 where unqid = @unq

	delete from sm404_c where sm404_c6 = @unq
end
end



--create table sm404(sm404_1 datetime, sm404_2 datetime, sm404_3 nvarchar(50), sm404_4 nvarchar(50), unqid uniqueidentifier, sm404_6 nvarchar(50), sm404_7 nvarchar(50), sm404_8 nvarchar(50))
--create table sm404_c(sm404_c1 datetime, sm404_c2 datetime, sm404_c3 nvarchar(50), sm404_c4 nvarchar(50), unqid uniqueidentifier, sm404_c6 nvarchar(50), sm404_c7 nvarchar(50), sm404_c8 nvarchar(50), sm404_c9 nvarchar(50), sm404_c10 nvarchar(50), sm404_c11 nvarchar(50), sm404_c12 nvarchar(50), sm404_c13 nvarchar(50), sm404_c14 nvarchar(50), sm404_c15 nvarchar(50), sm404_c16 nvarchar(50))
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GACL]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GACL]
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@SUPPLIER        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '', 
@PRODUCT         AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@FROMDATE        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@TODATE          AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@CR              AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@myval1          AS NVARCHAR(max)= '',
@USER            AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SYSTEM          AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@PUNQID          AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@UNQID           AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SEARCH          AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',

--Parent Table
@sm408_6         AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Entry date
@sm408_7         AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Supplier 
@sm408_8         AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Doc no
@sm408_9         AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --FromDate
@sm408_10        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --ToDate
@sm408_11        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Product
@sm408_12        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --CR(in %)
@sm408_13        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Child table Grand Total column's Total

--Child Table
@sm408_c6        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Parent unqid
@sm408_c7        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Invoice NO
@sm408_c8        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Invoice date
@sm408_c9        AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Product
@sm408_c10       AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Quantity
@sm408_c11       AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Taxable Amt
@sm408_c12       AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Net Amt
@sm408_c13       AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Grand Total
@sm408_c14       AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',    --Balance
@sm408_c15       AS NVARCHAR(50) = ''     --Receive

AS

IF @AA = 'ALL_DD'
BEGIN
	SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'SUPPL' ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC

	SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS PRODUCT FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC

	declare @myval as nvarchar(max)= (select ISNULL(MAX(CAST(sm408_8 as NUMERIC(18))),0) from sm408)
		set @myval=@myval+1;
	select @myval as DOCNO
END

IF @AA = 'INSERT'
BEGIN
SET @PUNQID = NEWID()
	INSERT INTO SM408(sm408_1, sm408_2, sm408_3, sm408_4, unqid, sm408_6, sm408_7, sm408_8, sm408_9, sm408_10,sm408_11,sm408_12, sm408_13)
	 VALUES(dbo.getentrydate(), dbo.getentrydate(), @USER, @SYSTEM, @PUNQID, DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_6), @SM408_7, @SM408_8, DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_9), DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_10), @SM408_11, @SM408_12, @SM408_13)

	SELECT @PUNQID AS PUNQID
END

IF @AA = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO SM408_C(sm408_c1, sm408_c2, sm408_c3, sm408_c4, unqid, sm408_c6, sm408_c7, sm408_c8, sm408_c9, sm408_c10, sm408_c11, sm408_c12, sm408_c13, sm408_c14, sm408_c15)
	VALUES(dbo.getentrydate(), dbo.getentrydate(), @USER, @SYSTEM, NEWID(),@sm408_c6, @sm408_c7, DBO.getformatteddate(@sm408_c8), @sm408_c9, @sm408_c10, @sm408_c11, @sm408_c12, @sm408_c13, @sm408_c14, @sm408_c15)
END

IF @AA = 'UPDATE'
BEGIN
	UPDATE SM408 SET 
	SM408_6 = DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_6),
	SM408_7 = @SM408_7,
	SM408_8 = @SM408_8,
	SM408_9 = DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_9),
	SM408_10 = DBO.getformatteddate(@SM408_10),
	SM408_11 = @SM408_11,
	SM408_12 = @SM408_12,
	SM408_13 = @SM408_13
	WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
END

IF @AA = 'BIND_GRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT SM1005_31 AS [INVNO],CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM1005_48, 103) AS [INVDATE], (SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM1005_10) AS PRODUCTUNQ, (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM1005_10) AS PRODUCT, SM1005_57 AS [QTY], SM1005_61 AS TAXABLE, 
	SM1005_70 AS NETAMT, CAST((SM1005_61 * @CR) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS GRANDTOTAL, '0.00' AS BAL, '0.00' AS RECEIVED FROM SM1005
	WHERE SM1005_11 = @SUPPLIER AND SM1005_10 = @PRODUCT AND sm1005_6 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) and  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) order by sm1005_31 asc

	SELECT 'No Record Found' AS [INVNO],'' AS [INVDATE], '' AS PRODUCT, '' AS [QTY], '' AS TAXABLE, 
	'' AS NETAMT, '' AS GRANDTOTAL, '' AS BAL, '' AS RECEIVED
END

IF @AA = 'VIEWGRID'
BEGIN
	SELECT SM408.UNQID AS UNQID, SM408_8 AS DOCNO, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_6, 103) AS [DATE], SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_9, 103) AS FDATE, 
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_10, 103) AS TDATE, SM206_9 AS PRODUCT, SM408_12 AS CR FROM SM408 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM408_7 LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM408_11 ORDER BY SM408_8 ASC
END

IF @AA = 'DELETE'
BEGIN
	DELETE SM408 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	DELETE SM408_C WHERE SM408_C6 = @UNQID
END

IF @AA = 'SEARCH'
BEGIN
	SELECT SM408.UNQID AS UNQID, SM408_8 AS DOCNO, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_6, 103) AS [DATE], SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_9, 103) AS FDATE, 
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_10, 103) AS TDATE, SM206_9 AS PRODUCT, SM408_12 AS CR FROM SM408 LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM408_7 LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206_2 = SM408_11 WHERE SM19_5 LIKE '%'+@SEARCH+'%' ORDER BY SM408_8 ASC
END

IF @AA = 'BINDTEXTBOXES'
BEGIN
	SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_6, 103) AS [DATE], SM408_7 AS SUPPLIER, SM408_8 AS DOCNO, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_9, 103) AS FDATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_10, 103) AS TDATE, SM408_11 AS PRODUCT, SM408_12 AS CR FROM SM408 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID

	SELECT SM408_C7 AS [INVNO],CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM408_C8, 103) AS [INVDATE], (SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM408_C9) AS PRODUCTUNQ, (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM408_C9) AS PRODUCT, SM408_C10 AS [QTY], SM408_C11 AS TAXABLE, 
	SM408_C12 AS NETAMT, SM408_C13 AS GRANDTOTAL, SM408_C14 AS BAL, SM408_C15 AS RECEIVED FROM SM408_C
	WHERE SM408_C6 = @UNQID order by SM408_C7 asc
	
END

--create table sm408(sm408_1 datetime, sm408_2 datetime, sm408_3 nvarchar(50), sm408_4 nvarchar(50), unqid uniqueidentifier, sm408_6 datetime, sm408_7 nvarchar(36), sm408_8 numeric, sm408_9 datetime, sm408_10 datetime, sm408_11 nvarchar(36), sm408_12 numeric(18,2), sm408_13 numeric(18,2))
--create table sm408_c(sm408_c1 datetime, sm408_c2 datetime, sm408_c3 nvarchar(50), sm408_c4 nvarchar(50), unqid uniqueidentifier, sm408_c6 nvarchar(36), sm408_c7 nvarchar(50), sm408_c8 datetime, sm408_c9 nvarchar(36), sm408_c10 numeric(18,2), sm408_c11 numeric(18,2), sm408_c12 numeric(18,2), sm408_c13 numeric(18,2), sm408_c14 numeric(18,2), sm408_c15 numeric(18,2))
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GOODS_EXCESS]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GOODS_EXCESS]
@what AS NVARCHAR(50),
@sm1014_1        datetime  = '',    --ENTRY DATE
@sm1014_2        datetime  = '',     --MODIFYDATE
@sm1014_3        NVARCHAR(20) ='',  --USER ID
@sm1014_4        nvarchar(50) = '',    --UNQID
@sm1014_5        nvarchar(50) = '',     --SERVER IP
@sm1014_6        date  = '',    --ENTRY DATE
@sm1014_7        nvarchar(50) = '',   --Branch
@sm1014_8        NVARCHAR(50) ='',  --Location
@sm1014_9        nvarchar(50) = '',    --Warehouse
@sm1014_10       nvarchar(50) = '',     --Product
@sm1014_11         nvarchar(50) = '',    --Unit
@sm1014_12         nvarchar(50) = '',    ---DepoRPT no
@sm1014_13        nvarchar(max) = '',--- GENO
@sm1014_14        NVARCHAR(50) ='',  --QTY
@sm1014_15        nvarchar(50) = '',    --strength
@sm1014_16      nvarchar(max) = ''  ,  --Remarks
@sm1014_17      nvarchar(max) = ''  ,  ----Excess/Shortage

@sm1014_18      nvarchar(max) = ''  ,  ---GOODS RECIEPT UNQID
@searchtext nvarchar(100) = '',
@sm1005_17  nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1008_24	nvarchar(max)=''   -- BRANCH ID


	
AS
BEGIN

	
IF @what='ALL_DD'
BEGIN
-----------TABLE 0
SELECT SM209_7 AS UNIT,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM209

-----------TABLE 1
SELECT SM1002_7 AS BRANCHNAME,SM1002_5 AS VALUE, 1 as ord FROM SM1002 where sm1002_5 = @sm1014_7 
union all 
SELECT SM1002_7 AS BRANCHNAME,SM1002_5 AS VALUE,  2 as ord  FROM SM1002
order by ord asc

-----------table 2
SELECT SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,UNQID as VALUE FROM SM1006 where sm1006_13=@sm1014_7

----------TABLE  3
SELECT SM1006_C7 AS LOCATION,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM1006_C

-----------TABLE 4
SELECT SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,SM206_2 AS VALUE FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_7
------Table 5/card


--TABLE 4
select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(sm1014.SM1014_13 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1 as GESNO from dbo.SM1014 where sm1014_7=@sm1014_7 
END

IF @what='GETWAREHOUSELOCATION'
BEGIN
SELECT SM1006_C7 AS LOCATION,UNQID AS VALUE FROM SM1006_C WHERE SM1006_C5=@sm1014_9
END


IF @what='GETSTRENGTH'
BEGIN
SELECT SM206_18 AS STRENGTH, sm206_7 as PRODUCT, (SELECT SM209_7 AS UNIT FROM SM209 where UNQID = sm206_11) as UNIT,
(SELECT unqid AS UNIT FROM SM209 where UNQID = sm206_11) as UNITUNQ, sm206_2 AS [VALUE] FROM SM206
WHERE SM206_2 = @sm1014_15



END


IF @what='GETGSTOCKQTY'
BEGIN
select sm1010_4 as QTY, (select sm209_7 from sm209 where  UNQID =  sm1010_5 ) as UNIT  from sm1010 where    sm1010_2 = @sm1014_7 and  sm1010_3 = @sm1014_10
END


  IF @WHAT = 'SAVEEXCESS'
BEGIN 

   

    INSERT INTO sm1014 (sm1014_1, sm1014_2, sm1014_3, sm1014_4, sm1014_5, sm1014_6, sm1014_7, sm1014_8, sm1014_9, sm1014_10, sm1014_11, sm1014_12, sm1014_13, sm1014_14, sm1014_15, sm1014_16, sm1014_17,sm1014_18)
    VALUES (GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @sm1014_3 , NEWID(), @sm1014_5, CONVERT(DATE, @sm1014_6, 103) , @sm1014_7, @sm1014_8, @sm1014_9, @sm1014_10, @sm1014_11, @sm1014_12, @sm1014_13, @sm1014_14, @sm1014_15, @sm1014_16, @sm1014_17,@sm1014_18);


	SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;

	exec dbo.A_SP_FOR_GSTOCK 'goodsexcess','',@sm1014_7, @sm1014_10, @sm1014_14, @sm1014_11, @sm1014_9, @sm1014_8,'','','','0.00'

END


  IF @WHAT = 'SAVESHORTAGE'
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO sm1014 (sm1014_1, sm1014_2, sm1014_3, sm1014_4, sm1014_5, sm1014_6, sm1014_7, sm1014_8, sm1014_9, sm1014_10, sm1014_11, sm1014_12, sm1014_13, sm1014_14, sm1014_15, sm1014_16, sm1014_17,sm1014_18)
    VALUES (GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @sm1014_3 , NEWID(), @sm1014_5,  CONVERT(DATE, @sm1014_6, 103) , @sm1014_7, @sm1014_8, @sm1014_9, @sm1014_10, @sm1014_11, @sm1014_12, @sm1014_13, @sm1014_14, @sm1014_15, @sm1014_16,@sm1014_17,@sm1014_18);



	SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;

	exec dbo.A_SP_FOR_GSTOCK 'goodsshortage','',@sm1014_7, @sm1014_10, @sm1014_14, @sm1014_11, @sm1014_9, @sm1014_8,'','','','0.00'

END

   IF @WHAT = 'FETCHEXCESS'
   BEGIN
      
 SELECT sm1014_4 As UNQID, 
		 (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2 = sm1014_10) AS [PRODUCT],
		 ( select SM1006_5  from SM1006 where unqid = sm1014_9) as [WAREHOUSE] ,
		 (select   SM1006_C7 from SM1006_C where unqid = sm1014_8) as [LOCATION] ,  
		 (select sm1002_7 from   SM1002  where SM1002_5 = sm1014_7 ) as [BRANCH] , 
		  (select sm209_7 from   SM209  where unqid = sm1014_11 ) as [UNIT] , 
		   sm1014_12 as [DEPORPTNO] ,
		   sm1014_15 as [STRENGTH] ,
		   sm1014_14 as QUANTITY
		  
		   FROM sm1014
		   where sm1014_17 = @sm1014_17   and   sm1014_7 = @sm1014_7 ORDER BY cast(SM1014_13 as numeric(18,0)) DESC


		   --select * from sm1014


   END 

   IF @WHAT = 'FETCHSHORTAGE'
   BEGIN
      
 SELECT sm1014_4 As UNQID, 
		 (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2 = sm1014_10) AS [PRODUCT],
		 ( select SM1006_5  from SM1006 where unqid = sm1014_9) as [WAREHOUSE] ,
		(select   SM1006_C7 from SM1006_C where unqid = sm1014_8) as [LOCATION] ,  
		 (select sm1002_7 from   SM1002  where SM1002_5 = sm1014_7 ) as [BRANCH] , 
		  (select sm209_7 from   SM209  where unqid = sm1014_11 ) as [UNIT] , 
		   sm1014_12 as [DEPORPTNO] ,
		   sm1014_15 as [STRENGTH] ,
		   sm1014_14 as QUANTITY
		  
		   
		   FROM sm1014
		   where  sm1014_17 = @sm1014_17 and sm1014_7 = @sm1014_7


		


   END 

   IF @what = 'GETONE'
BEGIN
	 SELECT sm1014_4 As UNQID, 
	     sm1014_6 As [ENTRYDATE],
		 lower(sm1014_10) AS [PRODUCT],
		 lower(sm1014_9)as [WAREHOUSE] ,
	     lower(sm1014_8) as [LOCATION] ,  
		 lower(sm1014_7) as [BRANCH] , 
		 lower(sm1014_11) as UNIT,
		   sm1014_12 as [DEPORPTNO] ,
		   sm1014_15 as [STRENGTH] ,
		   sm1014_13 as [GENO] ,
		   sm1014_14 as QUANTITY,
		   sm1014_16 as REMARKS
	 FROM DBO.SM1014
	 WHERE sm1014_4 = @sm1014_4;

	
END

     IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
   BEGIN
           DELETE FROM sm1014 WHERE sm1014_4 = @sm1014_4
   END


     IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
BEGIN
    UPDATE sm1014 
	SET 
	sm1014_6 = CONVERT(DATE, @sm1014_6, 103), 
	sm1014_7 = @sm1014_7, 
	sm1014_8 = @sm1014_8,
	sm1014_9 = @sm1014_9, 
	sm1014_10 = @sm1014_10,
	sm1014_11 = @sm1014_11, 
	sm1014_12 = @sm1014_12,
	sm1014_13 = @sm1014_13, 
	sm1014_14 = @sm1014_14, 
	sm1014_15 = @sm1014_15,
	sm1014_16 = @sm1014_16,
	sm1014_17 = @sm1014_17

	WHERE sm1014_4 = @sm1014_4
 
	
END


    IF @WHAT = 'SEARCHBYNAME'
BEGIN
Select sm1014.sm1014_4 AS UNQID,
SM1006.SM1006_5 AS [WAREHOUSE],
SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 as [LOCATION],
SM1002.sm1002_7 as [BRANCH],
sm1014_14 as [QUANTITY],
sm1014.sm1014_12 as [DEPORPTNO] , 
sm206.sm206_7 AS [PRODUCT] 
FROM sm1014 
INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.SM206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10 
INNER JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9 
INNER JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_8
INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = sm1014.sm1014_7
where  SM1014_7 = @sm1014_7 and SM1014_17 = @sm1014_17 and sm206.sm206_7 LIKE '%'+
@searchtext +  '%'  ORDER BY sm206.sm206_7


END

    if @what ='GrnoGV1'
	begin
	Select SM1005.sm1005_4 as unqid ,sm19_5,cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0)) as sm1005_19,sm206_7,SM1005_17,convert (varchar ,SM1005_6 ,105) as SM1005_18, 
	isnull(SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4),0) AS saleqty,isnull(cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0)) - SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4),cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0))) AS remaining_qty,
	SM1005_12 AS SUPPLINVNO
	from SM1005 inner join SM19 
	on SM1005.SM1005_11=SM19.unqid inner join sm206 on sm1005.sm1005_10=sm206.sm206_2 left JOIN 
    SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3
	where SM206_7 =@SM1005_17  and sm1005_7=@SM1008_24
	GROUP BY SM1005.SM1005_4,SM19.sm19_5,SM1005.sm1005_57,SM206.sm206_7, SM1005.SM1005_17,SM1005.SM1005_6,SM1005_12
	order by SM1005_6 asc

END

if @what ='GrnoGV'
	begin
    SELECT SM1005.SM1005_4 AS unqid, SM19.sm19_5,cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0)) as sm1005_19,SM206.sm206_7,SM1005.SM1005_17,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1005.SM1005_6, 105) AS SM1005_18,
	isnull(SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4),0) AS saleqty,isnull(cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0)) - SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4),cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0))) AS remaining_qty,
	SM1005_12 AS SUPPLINVNO
    FROM SM1005 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM1005.SM1005_11 = SM19.unqid INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM1005.SM1005_10 = SM206.SM206_2 left JOIN 
    SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3
    GROUP BY SM1005.SM1005_4,SM19.sm19_5,SM1005.sm1005_57,SM206.sm206_7, SM1005.SM1005_17,SM1005.SM1005_6,SM1005_12
	end
END





 
GO

		SELECT sm1005_4 AS [UNQID],(SELECT SM1004_7 FROM SM1004 WHERE UNQID=SM1005_39)AS [REQ NO.],DBO.ONLYDATE(SM1005_6) AS [RECEIPT DATE],SM1005_8 AS NUMBER,

		where SM1005_7=@SM1005_7
		ORDER BY SM1005_1 DESC,SM1005_6 DESC
		
		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;

BEGIN
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10
									--TABLE 0
		SELECT sm1005_4 AS [UNQID],(SELECT SM1004_7 FROM SM1004 WHERE UNQID=SM1005_39)AS [REQ NO.],DBO.ONLYDATE(SM1005_6) AS [RECEIPT DATE],SM1005_8 AS NUMBER,
		(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=sm1005_10)AS PRODUCT,sm1005_12 AS [CHALLAN NO.],SM1005_17 AS [GR NO.],sm1005_45 AS QTY,
		(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM1005_16) AS TRANSPORTER from sm1005 
		WHERE (SM1005_12 LIKE '%' + @likeclause + '%' OR SM1005_8 LIKE '%' + @likeclause + '%' OR SM1005_17 LIKE '%' + @likeclause + '%' OR (SELECT sm206_7 FROM sm206 WHERE sm206_2 = sm1005_10) LIKE '%' + @likeclause + '%' ) 
        AND SM1005_7 = @SM1005_7  ORDER BY SM1005_6

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;

IF @aa = 'PageCount'
BEGIN
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

 
			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1005),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TM VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
END

IF @aa = 'PageCountLIKE'
BEGIN

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_8 LIKE '' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
			SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
END

IF @aa = 'PageCount_freight'
BEGIN
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM1 ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

 
			DECLARE @tot1 NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1005),@Page1 float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue1 NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A1 int 
			set @totvalue1 = (select @tot1 / @Page1 )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A1 =1
			declare @PageValue1 int 
			set @PageValue1 =(select CEILING(@totvalue1) as [PageCount])
			while (@A1 <=@PageValue1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TM1 VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A1))
			SET @A1 = @A1 + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM1
END

IF @aa = 'PageCountLIKE_freight'
BEGIN

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE1 ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE1 NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_12 LIKE '' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE1 float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE1 NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE1 int 
		set @totvalueLIKE1 = (select @totLIKE1 / @PageLIKE1 )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE1 =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE1 int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE1 =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE1) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE1 <=@PageValue_LIKE1)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE1 values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE1))
				SET @A_LIKE1 = @A_LIKE1 + 1;
			END
			SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE1
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GST_CALCULATION_REVERSE_CHARGE]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GST_CALCULATION_REVERSE_CHARGE]
@WHAT       NVARCHAR(100)  = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@uid     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@fromdate        AS NVARCHAR(50)  = '',    
@todate       AS NVARCHAR(50)  = ''

AS
Begin 

IF @WHAT = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN
   --  select sm1002_5 as unqid, sm1002_7 as branch from sm1002
	 
   --declare @branch as nvarchar(max);
   set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
SELECT 
SM1002_5 AS UNQID,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH  FROM   SM1002 WHERE  sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
ORDER BY BRANCH desc;
END

IF @WHAT = 'GRID'
    BEGIN
       select SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,sm19_5 as [Name Of Party],sm19_24 as [Party State],CASE WHEN SM19_23='' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as GSTIN,
       (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=(select sm1015_6 from sm1015 where unqid=sm1005_55))as [Nature of Goods],
       (select sm1015_5 from sm1015 where unqid=sm1005_55)as [Freight Type],
       sm1005_17 as [GR No.] ,
       sm1005_8 as [VR No.],FORMAT(SM1005_18,'dd/MM/yyyy') as [Date of GR],sm1005_61 as [Amount/Taxable Value],
	   '' as [Reverse Charge],'' as [Reverse Charge Inv No-GIL],'' as [Date-Reverse Charge Inv],
	   CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' then cast((sm1005_61 * 0.06) as numeric(18,2)) else 0 end  as SGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' then cast((sm1005_61 * 0.06) as numeric(18,2)) else 0 end as CGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24<>'RAJASTHAN' then cast((sm1005_61 * 0.12) as numeric(18,2))else 0 end as IGST
       from sm1005
	   inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1005_16 
	   INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002_5=SM1005_7 
	   where sm1005_55='EE22C8A3-23BC-4616-BBF9-C7E8FEE32AB5' AND SM1005_61<>0 
       AND SM1005_7=@BRANCH AND 
	    sm1005_84 between  CONVERT(DATE, dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate), 103) 
	  and CONVERT(DATE, dbo.getformatteddate(@TOdate), 103)
  ORDER BY 
  sm19_5 ,SM1005_6   ;
  
   
SELECT SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       sm19_5 AS [Name Of Party],
       sm19_24 AS [Party State],
       CASE WHEN SM19_23='' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS GSTIN,
       (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid=(SELECT sm1015_6 FROM sm1015 WHERE unqid=sm1005_55)) AS [Nature of Goods],
       (SELECT sm1015_5 FROM sm1015 WHERE unqid=sm1005_55) AS [Freight Type],
       sm1005_17 AS [GR No.],
       sm1005_8 AS [VR No.],
       FORMAT(SM1005_18,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [Date of GR],
       sm1005_61 AS [Amount/Taxable Value],
       '' AS [Reverse Charge],
       '' AS [Reverse Charge Inv No-GIL],
       '' AS [Date-Reverse Charge Inv],
       CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.025) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS SGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.025) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS CGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24<>'RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.05) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS IGST,
       sm1005_6 AS SortColumn
FROM sm1005
INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=sm1005_16 
INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002_5=SM1005_7 
WHERE sm1005_55='EE22C8A3-23BC-4616-BBF9-C7E8FEE32AB5' 
  AND
  SM1005_61<>0 
  AND SM1005_7=@BRANCH 
  AND sm19_23 <>''
  AND sm1005_84 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate), 103) 
                    AND CONVERT(DATE, dbo.getformatteddate(@TOdate), 103)

UNION ALL

SELECT SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
       sm19_5 AS [Name Of Party],
       sm19_24 AS [Party State],
       CASE WHEN SM19_23='' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS GSTIN,
       (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid=(SELECT sm1015_6 FROM sm1015 WHERE unqid=sm1005_55)) AS [Nature of Goods],
       (SELECT sm1015_5 FROM sm1015 WHERE unqid=sm1005_55) AS [Freight Type],
       sm1005_17 AS [GR No.],
       sm1005_8 AS [VR No.],
       FORMAT(SM1005_18,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [Date of GR],
       sm1005_61 AS [Amount/Taxable Value],
       '' AS [Reverse Charge],
       '' AS [Reverse Charge Inv No-GIL],
       '' AS [Date-Reverse Charge Inv],
       CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.09) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS SGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24='RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.09) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS CGST,
       CASE WHEN SM19_24<>'RAJASTHAN' THEN CAST((sm1005_61 * 0.18) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ELSE 0 END AS IGST,
       sm1005_6 AS SortColumn
FROM sm1005
INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=sm1005_16 
INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002_5=SM1005_7 
WHERE

ORDER BY [Name Of Party], SortColumn;   
   
   END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GST_MASTER_Q]
@what		  nvarchar(15), 
@sm210_3	  nvarchar(50)='', ----usrid
@unqid		  nvarchar(50)='', ----unqid
@sm210_5	  nvarchar(50)='', ----Allocate Number
@sm210_6	  nvarchar(50)='', ----Description
@sm210_7	  nvarchar(50)='', ----Rate
@sm210_8	  nvarchar(50)='', ----SGST Purchase
@sm210_9	  nvarchar(50)='', ----SGST Pur. Tax A/c
@sm210_10	  nvarchar(50)='', ----SGST Sales A/c
@sm210_11	  nvarchar(50)='', ----SGST Sales Tax A/c
@sm210_12	  nvarchar(50)='', ----CGST Purchase
@sm210_13	  nvarchar(50)='', ----CGST Pur. Tax A/c
@sm210_14	  nvarchar(50)='', ----CGST Sales A/c
@sm210_15	  nvarchar(50)='', ----CGST Sales Tax A/c
@sm210_16	  nvarchar(50)='', ----IGST Purchase
@sm210_17	  nvarchar(50)='', ----IGST Pur. Tax A/c
@sm210_18	  nvarchar(50)='', ----IGST Sales A/c
@sm210_19	  nvarchar(50)='', ----IGST Sales Tax A/c
@sm210_100    nvarchar(50)=''  ----ip

AS
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'INSERT'
	BEGIN 
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm210]([sm210_1],[sm210_2],[sm210_3],[unqid],[sm210_5],[sm210_6],[sm210_7],[sm210_8],[sm210_9],[sm210_10],[sm210_11],[sm210_12],
		[sm210_13],[sm210_14],[sm210_15],[sm210_16],[sm210_17],[sm210_18],[sm210_19],[sm210_100])				
		Values(dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@sm210_3,newid(),@sm210_5,@sm210_6,@sm210_7,UPPER(@sm210_8),UPPER(@sm210_9),UPPER(@sm210_10)
		,UPPER(@sm210_11),UPPER(@sm210_12),UPPER(@sm210_13),UPPER(@sm210_14),UPPER(@sm210_15),UPPER(@sm210_16)
		,UPPER(@sm210_17),UPPER(@sm210_18),UPPER(@sm210_19),@sm210_100)
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'GST_PURCHASE'
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID,SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_7 NOT IN ('579831_','579832_') ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC; 
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_GSTOCK]
@aa				nvarchar(50),
@unqid          nvarchar(50)  = '',
@branch         nvarchar(50)  = '',
@pcode			nvarchar(50)  = '',
@qty			numeric(18,3) = 0.00,
@unit			nvarchar(50)  = '',
@warehouse		nvarchar(50)  = '',
@location		nvarchar(50)  = '',
@batch      	nvarchar(20)  = '',
@expiry         nvarchar(50)  = '',
@sno            nvarchar(50)  = '',
@productrate    numeric(18,3) = 0.00
AS

if @aa = 'goodsreceipt'

begin
		DECLARE @RowCountUpdate1 INT;
	Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 + @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1
      
	if @RowCountUpdate1<1
	
	begin
		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)

	end
	end
	
if @aa='goodsexcess'
begin
	
	Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 + @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1
      
	if @RowCountUpdate1<1
	
	begin
		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)

	end
end



if @aa='goodsshortage'
begin
	
	Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 - @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1
      
	if @RowCountUpdate1<1
	
	begin
		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)

	end
end

if @aa='salesinvoice'
begin
		--DECLARE @RowCountUpdate1 INT;
	Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 - @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1
      
	if @RowCountUpdate1<1
	
	begin
		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)

	end
	
	
end

if @aa='goodsreceiptfrombranch'

begin
Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 + @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1
      
	if @RowCountUpdate1<1
	
	begin
		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)
    end
end

if @aa='goodsissuetobranch'

begin
Update sm1010 set
	sm1010.sm1010_4 = sm1010.sm1010_4 - @qty
		where sm1010_2=@branch and sm1010_3 = @pcode and sm1010_5=@unit and sm1010_6=@warehouse and sm1010_7=@location
		--and sm1010_8=@batch and sm1010_9=@expiry and sm1010_10=@sno 
		and sm1010_11=@productrate

		SET @RowCountUpdate1 = @@ROWCOUNT;
		print @RowCountUpdate1

		insert into sm1010(unqid,sm1010_2,sm1010_3,sm1010_4,sm1010_5,sm1010_6,sm1010_7,sm1010_8,sm1010_9,sm1010_10,sm1010_11)
		values(newid(),@branch,@pcode,@qty,@unit,@warehouse,@location,@batch,dbo.getformatteddate(@expiry),@sno,@productrate)
    end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_IMS_REPORT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_IMS_REPORT]
    @WHAT NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @uid NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @branch NVARCHAR(max) = ''

AS
BEGIN
 

    if @what='IMS_REPORTTT'
   BEGIN
	-- select sm63_5 as userid, sm502_4 as staffmember, sm502_5 as staffbranch, sm502_16 as branchunqid  from sm502 inner join sm63 on sm63.sm63_13 = sm502.unqid   

WITH InventoryData AS (
    -- Inventory Data (SM1010)
    -- Provides current inventory quantity per product, branch, and warehouse location.
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM1006.SM1006_5 + ' - ' + SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS WAREHOUSE_LOCATION,
       
        CAST(SUM(SM1010_4)  AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS QTY
    FROM SM1010_v
    INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1010_3
    INNER JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1010_6
    INNER JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1010_6 -- Join for Location details
    INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1006.SM1006_13 = SM1002.SM1002_5 -- Join for Branch details (assuming SM1006.SM1006_13 is branch ID)
	--inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_8
    GROUP BY
        SM206.SM206_7,
        SM1002.SM1002_7,
        SM1006.SM1006_5,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 -- Group by LOCATION as well
),
OpeningData AS (
    -- Opening Data (SM1023)
    -- Contains master data for inventory levels, lead times, and sales period days.
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM1006.SM1006_5 + ' - ' + SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS WAREHOUSE_LOCATION,
        COALESCE(SM1023_C.SM1023_C14, 0) AS LEADING_TIME, -- Added COALESCE for safety
        COALESCE(SM1023_C.SM1023_C10, 0) AS MIN_LEVEL,
        COALESCE(SM1023_C.SM1023_C11, 0) AS MAX_LEVEL,
        COALESCE(SM1023_C.SM1023_C12, 0) AS REORDER_LEVEL,
        -- Added COALESCE for SALES_PERIOD_DAYS, defaulting to 1 to prevent division by zero downstream
        COALESCE(SM1023_C.SM1023_C15, 1) AS SALES_PERIOD_DAYS
    FROM SM1023
    JOIN SM1023_C ON SM1023_C.SM1023_C5 = SM1023.UNQID
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7 -- This join provides LOCATION for OpeningData
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1023_C.SM1023_C6
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
	--inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
),
SalesData AS (
    -- Average Sales Data (SM1011)
    -- Calculates sum of sales quantity and per-day average sales quantity for a dynamic period.
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION], -- Include LOCATION from SM1006_C
        SM1006.SM1006_5 + ' - ' + SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS WAREHOUSE_LOCATION, -- Include WAREHOUSE_LOCATION
      
        ISNULL(CAST(SUM(sm1011_42)  AS NUMERIC(18,2)), 0) AS sum_qty,
      
        ISNULL(CAST((SUM(sm1011_42) ) / NULLIF(MAX(od.sales_period_days), 0) AS NUMERIC(18,2)), 0) AS per_day_avg_qty
    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM1011.sm1011_13 = SM206.sm206_2
    INNER JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    INNER JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39 -- Join SM1006_C to get LOCATION for sales data
    INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    -- Join to OpeningData to dynamically determine the sales look-back period (sales_period_days).
    INNER JOIN OpeningData od ON SM206.SM206_7 = od.PRODUCT
                             AND SM1006.SM1006_5 = od.WAREHOUSE
                             AND SM1002.sm1002_7 = od.BRANCH
                             AND SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 = od.[LOCATION] -- Join on LOCATION as well
							 inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
    WHERE sm1011_6 >= dbo.onlydate(DATEADD(DAY, -CAST(ISNULL(od.sales_period_days, 1) AS INT), GETDATE()))
    GROUP BY
        SM206.SM206_7,
        SM1006.SM1006_5,
        SM1002.sm1002_7,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 -- Group by LOCATION
),
-- New CTE to find the last invoice date for each product, branch, warehouse, and location
LastInvoiceData AS (
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        MAX(sm1011_6) AS LastInvoiceDate
    FROM SM1011
    INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM1011.sm1011_13 = SM206.sm206_2
    INNER JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    INNER JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.SM1006_C5 = SM1011_39
    INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
	inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
    GROUP BY
        SM206.SM206_7,
        SM1002.SM1002_7,
        SM1006.SM1006_5,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7
)
SELECT
    inv.PRODUCT,
    inv.WAREHOUSE,
    inv.BRANCH, -- Select Branch from InventoryData (consistent across CTEs)
    inv.LOCATION,
    inv.WAREHOUSE_LOCATION,
    inv.QTY,
    -- Use COALESCE for main SELECT output for cleaner presentation of NULLs as 0
    COALESCE(sales.sum_qty, 0) AS sum_qty,
    COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) AS per_day_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0) AS LEADING_TIME,
    -- Projected consumption calculation
    COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty * od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0) AS projected_consumption,
    COALESCE(od_main.MIN_LEVEL, 0) AS MIN_LEVEL,
    COALESCE(od_main.MAX_LEVEL, 0) AS MAX_LEVEL,
    COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) AS REORDER_LEVEL,
    -- Needed quantity calculation
    COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL + COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty * od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0), 0) AS needed_qty,
	
	COALESCE(inv.QTY, 0) -COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) -( COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) * COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0))as neededstock,
        -- New field for aging
    COALESCE(DATEDIFF(day, last_invoice.LastInvoiceDate, GETDATE()), 0) AS [AGING],
	 -- New field for aging, now as a string
    CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, last_invoice.LastInvoiceDate, GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0'), ' days old') AS [DAYS],
    CASE
        -- Status color logic based on needed_qty relative to min/max levels.
        -- Ensure all levels and calculated values are non-NULL before comparison by using COALESCE
        WHEN COALESCE(inv.QTY, 0) -(COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) + COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) * COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0)) < COALESCE(od_main.MIN_LEVEL, 0) THEN N'red'
        WHEN COALESCE(inv.QTY, 0) -(COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) + COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) * COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0)) > COALESCE(od_main.MAX_LEVEL, 0) THEN N'blue'
		
        WHEN COALESCE(inv.QTY, 0) -((COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) + COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) * COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0))) >= COALESCE(od_main.MIN_LEVEL, 0)
             AND COALESCE(inv.QTY, 0)-((COALESCE(od_main.REORDER_LEVEL, 0) + COALESCE(sales.per_day_avg_qty, 0) * COALESCE(od_main.LEADING_TIME, 0))) <= COALESCE(od_main.MAX_LEVEL, 0) THEN  N'green'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS status_color
FROM InventoryData AS inv
LEFT JOIN OpeningData AS od_main
    ON inv.PRODUCT = od_main.PRODUCT
   AND inv.WAREHOUSE = od_main.WAREHOUSE
   AND inv.BRANCH = od_main.BRANCH
   AND inv.[LOCATION] = od_main.[LOCATION] 
   	--inner join sm1008  on sm1008.unqid=sm1011_8
LEFT JOIN SalesData AS sales
    ON inv.PRODUCT = sales.PRODUCT
   AND inv.WAREHOUSE = sales.WAREHOUSE
   AND inv.BRANCH = sales.BRANCH
   AND inv.[LOCATION] = sales.[LOCATION]
   LEFT JOIN LastInvoiceData AS last_invoice
    ON inv.PRODUCT = last_invoice.PRODUCT
   AND inv.WAREHOUSE = last_invoice.WAREHOUSE
   AND inv.BRANCH = last_invoice.BRANCH
   AND inv.[LOCATION] = last_invoice.[LOCATION]
   
  where inv.WAREHOUSE=(SELECT 
   -- SM1006.UNQID,  
    SM1006_5 AS sm1006_c6
FROM SM1006
INNER JOIN SM1006_c 
    ON SM1006_c.SM1006_c5 = SM1006.UNQID
WHERE SM1006.UNQID = (
    SELECT sm502_20  -- warehouse id
    FROM sm502
    INNER JOIN sm63 
        ON sm63.sm63_13 = sm502.unqid
    CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitString(sm502_16, ',') s
    WHERE sm63_5 = @uid
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) LIKE '%'+ @branch +'%'
))
 order by

    inv.BRANCH, inv.WAREHOUSE_LOCATION,  inv.PRODUCT   ; 

  END



end
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_INVN_COSR_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_INVN_COSR_Q]
AS 
BEGIN

declare @unqidc as nvarchar(36)
declare @ACUNQID as nvarchar(36)
declare @INVNUNQID as nvarchar(36)
declare @AMT as NUMERIC(18,2)
declare @TAMT as NUMERIC(18,2)

	declare cur1 cursor for
	SELECT UNQID,CO_11,CO_10 FROM COSR WHERE CO_9 ='BR'
open cur1
		fetch next from cur1 into @unqidc,@ACUNQID,@AMT
		while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
				
				SET @TAMT  =   @AMT
				WHILE @TAMT>0
				BEGIN
				SET @INVNUNQID = (SELECT TOP 1 INVN.UNQID FROM INVN WHERE IN_7='OO' AND   INVN.IN_12 = @ACUNQID AND INVN.IN_11 <> 0 ORDER BY IN_8 )
				PRINT @INVNUNQID 
				--UPDATE COSR SET CO_5 = @INVNUNQID WHERE COSR.UNQID = @unqidc

				IF (SELECT IN_11 - @TAMT FROM INVN WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVNUNQID AND IN_7='OO') < 0	
				begin			
						SET @TAMT  =   @TAMT - (SELECT IN_11 FROM INVN WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVNUNQID)
						UPDATE INVN SET INVN.IN_11 = 0 WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVNUNQID  AND IN_7='OO'
				end
				ELSE
				BEGIN
						UPDATE INVN SET INVN.IN_11 = IN_11 - @TAMT WHERE INVN.UNQID = @INVNUNQID AND IN_7='OO'
						SET @TAMT  =  0
				END
				END
		fetch next from cur1 into @unqidc,@ACUNQID,@AMT
		end
		close cur1
		deallocate cur1


		
SELECT [UNQID],[Party Name],[Invoice No],[Invoice Date],[Invoice Amt],[Software],[Invoice Type],[Due Amt],
DATEDIFF(DAY, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Invoice Date]),DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('22/07/2021')) AS [Due Days]
 FROM (
SELECT IN_12 AS [UNQID],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = IN_12 )AS [Party Name],
(SELECT SM213_8 +'/'+ SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID = INVN.IN_5 AND SM213.SM213_35 = 'OO') AS [Invoice No],
(SELECT SM213_6 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID = INVN.IN_5 AND SM213.SM213_35 = 'OO') AS [Invoice Date],
(SELECT SM213_23 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID = INVN.IN_5 AND SM213.SM213_35 = 'OO') AS [Invoice Amt],
(select sm208_5 from sm208 where unqid = (select TOP 1 sm19_c4 from sm19_c where sm19_c2 = INVN.IN_12)) AS [Software],
(SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_C5 FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = INVN.IN_5)) AS [Invoice Type],
IN_11 AS [Due Amt]
FROM INVN WHERE IN_7 = 'OO' AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_8) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('01/04/2020') AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('22/07/2021')
AND IN_11 <>0
) AS A ORDER BY [Party Name],[Invoice Date],[Invoice No]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_JOURNAL_CHILD_Q]
@a			 as nvarchar(20) = '',     
@sm203_c1    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --ENTRY DATE
@sm203_c2    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --MODIFY DATE
@sm203_c3    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --USER ID 
@sm203_c4    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --UNQID
@sm203_c100  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --IPADD
@sm203_c101  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --BRANCH ID
@sm203_c5    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --BK
@sm203_c6    as nvarchar(MAX) = '',     --PUNQID
@sm203_c7    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --VOUCHER NO
@sm203_c8    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --VOUCHER DATE
@sm203_c9    as nvarchar(50) = '',     --A/c NAME(UNQID)
@sm203_c10   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --AMOUNT
@sm203_c11   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --REF BK
@sm203_c12   as nvarchar(50) = '',	   --CURRENT BALACE
@sm203_c13   as nvarchar(50) = '',	   --ORDERING IN VIEW CASE


------TDS Table-----
@SM203_CT4   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --TDS UNQID
@SM203_CT5   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --UNQID SM203
@SM203_CT6   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --UNQID SM203_C
@SM203_CT7   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --PARTY
@SM203_CT8   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --TANKER
@SM203_CT9   as nvarchar(50) = '',     --TOTAL AMOUNT
@SM203_CT10  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --DATE
@SM203_CT11  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --RATE
@SM203_CT12  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --TDS AMOUNT
@SM203_CT13  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --NET AMOUNT
@SM203_CT14  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --DEPOSIT DATE
@SM203_CT15  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --CHEQUE NO.
@SM203_CT16  as nvarchar(50) = '',     --CHEQUE DATE
@SM203_CT17  as nvarchar(50) = ''      --BANK


AS
Declare @ac uniqueidentifier;
BEGIN

if @a = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN 
	IF @SM203_c4 = '' OR @SM203_c4 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sm203_c4 = NEWID()
	END
		SET @sm203_c13= (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM203_C13),0)+1 AS ORDERING FROM SM203_c WHERE SM203_C6=@SM203_C6)

		INSERT INTO [DBO].[SM203_C]([SM203_C1],[SM203_C2],[SM203_C3],[SM203_C4],[SM203_C100],[SM203_C101],[SM203_C5],[SM203_C6],[SM203_C7]
		,[SM203_C8],[SM203_C9],[SM203_C10],[SM203_C11],[SM203_C12],[SM203_C13])VALUES
	    (GETDATE(),'',@SM203_C3,@sm203_c4,@SM203_C100,@SM203_C101,@SM203_C5,@SM203_C6,@SM203_C7,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM203_C8),@SM203_C9,@SM203_C10,
		'0',@SM203_C12,@sm203_c13)

		if  @sm203_c9 ='9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'
		begin
			SELECT @sm203_c4 AS [CUNQID]
		end
		SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
END

if @a = 'UPDATE_CHILD'
BEGIN 
		DELETE FROM SM203_C WHERE sm203_C6=@sm203_C6;
		DELETE FROM M3 WHERE M3_14=@sm203_C6;
	 
	
END



if @a = 'delete'
BEGIN 

DELETE FROM [dbo].[sm203_c]
WHERE sm203_c4 = convert(uniqueidentifier,@sm203_c4)
--AND NOT Exists(select sm203_c6,sm203_4 from sm203,sm203_c where sm203_4 = @id and (sm203_4 = sm203_c6 ))
End

if @a = 'edit'
BEGIN 
UPDATE [dbo].[sm203_c]
   SET [sm203_c2] = dbo.entrydate(),[sm203_c3] = @sm203_c3,[sm203_c100] = @sm203_c100,[sm203_c101] = @sm203_c101,[sm203_c5] = @sm203_c5,[sm203_c6] = @sm203_c6
   ,[sm203_c7] = @sm203_c7,[sm203_c8] = @sm203_c8,[sm203_c9] = @sm203_c9,[sm203_c10] = @sm203_c10,[sm203_c11] = @sm203_c11,[sm203_c12] = @sm203_c12
 WHERE sm203_c4 = convert(uniqueidentifier,@sm203_c4)
End

if @a = 'select'
BEGIN 
SELECT [sm203_c1],[sm203_c2],[sm203_c3],[sm203_c4],[sm203_c100],[sm203_c101],[sm203_c5],[sm203_c6],[sm203_c7],[sm203_c8],[sm203_c9]
,[sm203_c10],[sm203_c11]
  FROM [dbo].[sm203_c]
End

IF @a = 'voucher'
Begin
select isnull(max(Cast([sm203_c7] as numeric(18,0))),0)+1 as mx from [sm203_c] where isnumeric([sm203_c7])='1'
end


if @a = 'upd_journal_c'
BEGIN 

 update sm203_c set sm203_c9 = @sm203_c9,sm203_c10 = @sm203_c10 where sm203_c4 = @sm203_c4

End
--------------------------------tds data --------------------------------------
if @a = 'insert_tdsamt'
begin
	insert into [dbo].[sm203_ctds]([sm203_ct1], [sm203_ct2], [sm203_ct3], [sm203_ct4], [sm203_ct100], [sm203_ct101], [sm203_ct5], [sm203_ct6], [sm203_ct7], [sm203_ct8], [sm203_ct9], [sm203_ct10], [sm203_ct11], [sm203_ct12], [sm203_ct13], [sm203_ct14], [sm203_ct15], [sm203_ct16], [sm203_ct17])
							values(getdate(), '', @SM203_C3, NEWID(), @SM203_C100, @SM203_C101, @SM203_CT5, @SM203_CT6, @SM203_CT7, @SM203_CT8, @SM203_CT9, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM203_CT10), @SM203_CT11, @SM203_CT12, @SM203_CT13, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM203_CT14), @SM203_CT15, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM203_CT16), @SM203_CT17)
end
End

	SELECT  @SM203_4 = REPLACE(@SM203_4,',' , ''',''')

DECLARE @STRR NVARCHAR(MAX)
SET @STRR  ='
IF '''+@a+''' = ''journal_voucherr''
BEGIN 
		SELECT SM203_4 AS UNQID,''JOURNAL VOUCHER'' AS [FORMAT],'''' AS [FORMATNAME],''NO.'' AS [TYPE],SM203_6A AS [POSTEDNO],SM203_11 AS [POSTEDDATE],
		(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where SM1002_5 = sm203_101) as [BRANCH],
		   (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = sm203_14) as [ACCRDR],
		ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00),'''') AS [DEBITAC],
		ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 > 0.00),'''') AS [CREDITAC],
		(CASE WHEN sm203_c10<0.00 THEN (sm203_c10*(-1)) ELSE (0.00) END) AS [DEBITAMOUNT],
		(CASE WHEN sm203_c10>0.00 THEN (sm203_c10) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CREDITAMOUNT],
		 (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm203_3) AS createdby,
    (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 =SM203_12) AS postedby,
		(SELECT isnull(SUM(sm203_c10*(-1)),0) FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203_4 = sm203_c6  WHERE SM203_C10 < 0.00 AND SM203_4 IN ('''+@SM203_4+''')) AS [AMOUNT],
		 dbo.fnNumberToWords((SELECT isnull(SUM(sm203_c10*(-1)),0) FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203_4 = sm203_c6  WHERE SM203_C10 < 0.00 AND SM203_4 IN ('''+@SM203_4+'''))) AS BALANCEINWORDS,
		SM203_8 AS [NARRATION] 
		FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203_4 = sm203_c6 WHERE SM203_4 IN ('''+@SM203_4+''') ORDER BY  CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00), '''') != '''' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    SM203_C.SM203_C13
END'	
PRINT(@STRR)
EXEC(@STRR)



IF @a = 'POSTED_OR_NOT'
BEGIN
	SELECT  (case when sm203_11='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'Unpost' else 'Posted' end) as post_status 
FROM SM203_c
INNER JOIN SM203 ON SM203_c.SM203_c6 = SM203.SM203_4
WHERE SM203_c.SM203_c6 = @sm203_4 
and sm203_c9 =@account 
END

IF @a = 'POSTED_OR_NOTT'
BEGIN
	SELECT  (case when sm203_11='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'Unpost' else 'Posted' end) as post_status 
FROM SM203_c
INNER JOIN SM203 ON SM203_c.SM203_c6 = SM203.SM203_4
WHERE SM203_c.SM203_c6 = @sm203_4  
END

IF @a = 'POST_EDIT'
BEGIN
		SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),SM203_11,103) AS POSTEDDATE FROM SM203 WHERE SM203_4=@sm203_4
END



IF @a = 'SearchGrid'
BEGIN					
													 --Table 0
	    	SELECT 
    SM203.SM203_4 AS [unqid],
    (CASE WHEN SM203.SM203_6A = '0' THEN '' ELSE SM203.SM203_6A END) AS [postedvoucher],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_7, 103) AS [date],
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 SM19.SM19_5 FROM SM19  JOIN SM203_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM203_C.SM203_C9 WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 ORDER BY SM203_C.SM203_C1, SM203_C.SM203_C13
    ) AS [AccountName],
    (
        SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  FROM SM203_C WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4
    ) AS [DebitAmt], SM203.SM203_7 AS DO  
FROM SM203
WHERE  SM203_6 LIKE  @sm203_6 + '%'
ORDER BY 
case when sm203_13='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else 1 end , SM203_11 desc,cast(case when SM203_6A='' then 0 else sm203_6a end as numeric(18,0))desc,SM203_7 desc
--ORDER BY SM203_1 DESC,CAST(SM203_6A AS NUMERIC(18)) DESC


												--No Record Found  Table 1
	   SELECT '' AS [unqid],'No Record Found' AS [postedvoucher],'' AS [date],'' AS [AccountName], 
	   ''  AS [DebitAmt]	
END

IF @a = 'DisplayGrid'
BEGIN  
 --Table 0
	  
SELECT     
    SM203_6 AS VNO,
    SM203.SM203_4 AS [unqid], 
    SM203.SM203_5 as bk,
    (CASE WHEN SM203.SM203_6A = '0' THEN '' ELSE SM203.SM203_6A END) AS [postedvoucher],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_11, 103) AS [date],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_7, 103) AS [vcdate],
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 SM19.SM19_5 
        FROM SM19  
        JOIN SM203_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM203_C.SM203_C9 
        WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 AND SM203_6=SM203_C7 
        ORDER BY SM203_C.SM203_C13
    ) AS [AccountName],
    (
        SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  
        FROM SM203_C 
        WHERE
		SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 
    ) AS [DebitAmt],
 CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM sm203_c 
            INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_15 = sm203_c.sm203_c9
            WHERE sm203_c.sm203_c6 = sm203.sm203_4
        ) 
        THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        ELSE CAST(SUM(ISNULL(cosr.CO_7, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) 
    END AS cosramt,

    ( SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  
        FROM SM203_C join sm19 on unqid = sm203_c9
        WHERE
		SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 and  sm19_11 in ('cust','suppl','trans')) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(CO_7, 0))) AS remainingamt, 
    SM203.SM203_7 AS DO, 
    (CASE WHEN sm203_11='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 'Unpost' ELSE 'Posted' END) AS post_staus
FROM SM203 
LEFT JOIN cosr ON co_6 = sm203_4
WHERE 
    sm203_101 =@sm203_101 AND 
    sm203_5 = @sm203_5 
GROUP BY
    SM203_6,
    SM203.SM203_4,
    SM203.SM203_5,
    SM203.SM203_6A,
    SM203.SM203_11,
    SM203.SM203_7,
    SM203.sm203_13
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN sm203_11='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 
    SM203_11 DESC,
    CAST(CASE WHEN SM203_6A='' THEN 0 ELSE sm203_6a END AS numeric(18,0)) DESC,
    SM203_7 DESC


													--No Record Found  Table 1
SELECT  'No Record Found' AS [postedvoucher],'' AS [unqid],'' AS [date],'' AS [AccountName], 
	   ''  AS [DebitAmt]

IF @a = 'DisplayGriddatewise'
BEGIN					
													 --Table 0 
		
SELECT     
    SM203_6 AS VNO,
    SM203.SM203_4 AS [unqid], 
    SM203.SM203_5 as bk,
    (CASE WHEN SM203.SM203_6A = '0' THEN '' ELSE SM203.SM203_6A END) AS [postedvoucher],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_11, 103) AS [date],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_7, 103) AS [vcdate],
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 SM19.SM19_5 
        FROM SM19  
        JOIN SM203_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM203_C.SM203_C9 
        WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 AND SM203_6=SM203_C7 
        ORDER BY SM203_C.SM203_C13
    ) AS [AccountName],
    (
        SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  
        FROM SM203_C 
        WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4
    ) AS [DebitAmt],
 CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM sm203_c 
            INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_15 = sm203_c.sm203_c9
            WHERE sm203_c.sm203_c6 = sm203.sm203_4
        ) 
        THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        ELSE CAST(SUM(ISNULL(cosr.CO_7, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) 
    END AS cosramt,
   ( SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  
        FROM SM203_C join sm19 on unqid = sm203_c9
        WHERE
		SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 and  sm19_11 in ('cust','suppl','trans')) - ABS(SUM(ISNULL(CO_7, 0))) AS remainingamt, 
    SM203.SM203_7 AS DO, 
    (CASE WHEN sm203_11='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 'Unpost' ELSE 'Posted' END) AS post_staus
FROM SM203 
LEFT JOIN cosr ON co_6 = sm203_4
WHERE  sm203_101 =  @sm203_101 and   SM203_5 =@TYPE
 
AND  SM203_7 BETWEEN [dbo].[getformatteddate](@FROMDATE)  AND  [dbo].[getformatteddate](@TODATE) 
GROUP BY
    SM203_6,
    SM203.SM203_4,
    SM203.SM203_5,
    SM203.SM203_6A,
    SM203.SM203_11,
    SM203.SM203_7,
    SM203.sm203_13
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN sm203_13='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 
    SM203_11 DESC,
    CAST(CASE WHEN SM203_6A='' THEN 0 ELSE sm203_6a END AS numeric(18,0)) DESC,
    SM203_7 DESC

 SELECT  SM203_4 AS [unqid],(CASE WHEN SM203_6A = '0' THEN '' ELSE SM203_6A END) AS [postedvoucher],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(50),SM203_7,103) AS [date],
		(SELECT TOP 1  (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9)  FROM SM203_C WHERE  SM203_C10<0 AND SM203_C6=SM203_4 ORDER BY SM203_C1,SM203_C13 )  AS [AccountName], 
		(SELECT TOP 1  ABS(SM203_C10) FROM SM203_C WHERE   SM203_C6=SM203_4 ORDER BY SM203_C13)  AS [DebitAmt], 
		SM203_7 AS DO  FROM SM203  where sm203_4=@sm203_4 ORDER BY DO DESC,CAST(SM203_6A AS NUMERIC(18)) DESC

end

if @a='Adjustments'
begin
 IF EXISTS (
        SELECT sm203_c9
        FROM sm203_c 
        INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm203_c.sm203_c9 = sm19.unqid
        WHERE sm203_c.sm203_c10 < 0 
          AND sm19.sm19_11 = 'cust' 
		
          AND sm203_c6 = @sm203_c6

          AND sm203_c.sm203_c9 = @sm203_4 
    )
    BEGIN 
        PRINT '1'
        SELECT 'cant update invoice - customer has negative amount in voucher' AS error
    END
    ELSE 
	begin 

    SELECT 
        (SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = 'OO' 
		--AND BA_17 = @branch
		) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = IN_12) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
		IN_12 as ACCUNQID,
        IN_8 AS [DATE], IN_14 AS [DDATE], IN_13 AS [INVOICENO], IN_9 AS [NETAMOUNT], abs(IN_11) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],
      0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
        UNQID AS [UNQID], IN_5 AS [SALESUNQID]
    FROM INVN  WHERE IN_7 ='OO' and in_12 = @sm203_4
	 --IN (
  --           SELECT sm203_c9 
  --          FROM sm203_c 
  --          WHERE sm203_c6 = @sm203_c6
  --      )
    
    AND IN_11 != 0.00 order by IN_8 asc
	
	--WHERE IN_7 ='OO' and 
	--	 IN_5 IN (SELECT UNQID FROM SM1011 
	--	WHERE SM1011_10 IN (@sm203_4) ) AND IN_11 != 0.00 ORDER BY [DATE]

	


------------TABLE 2----------------------------------
    SELECT 
        (SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = 'PP' 
		--AND BA_17 = @branch
		) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = IN_12) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
			IN_12 as ACCUNQID,
        IN_8 AS [DATE], IN_14 AS [DDATE], IN_13 AS [INVOICENO], abs(IN_9) AS [NETAMOUNT], abs(IN_11) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],
    --(SELECT abs(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid) AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
   0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
        UNQID AS [UNQID], IN_5 AS [SALESUNQID]
    FROM INVN



     WHERE IN_7 ='PP'and  IN_5 in (SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005
		WHERE SM1005_11 IN (@sm203_4) ) AND IN_11 != 0.00 order by IN_8 asc
	------------TABLE 3----------------------------------
	 SELECT 
        (SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = 'FF' --AND BA_17 = @branch
		) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = IN_12) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],	IN_12 as ACCUNQID,
        IN_8 AS [DATE], IN_14 AS [DDATE], IN_13 AS [INVOICENO], abs(IN_9) AS [NETAMOUNT], abs(IN_11) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],
    --(SELECT abs(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid) AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
   0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
        UNQID AS [UNQID], IN_5 AS [SALESUNQID]
    FROM INVN
     WHERE IN_7 ='FF' and  IN_5 IN (SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005
		WHERE SM1005_16 IN (@sm203_4)) AND IN_11 != 0.00 AND IN_15=@BRANCH
		order by IN_8 asc

SELECT 
    SUM(cosr.co_7) AS amt_cosr, 
    MAX(ABS(sm203_c10)) AS max_amt_cosr, 
    (ABS(sm203_c.sm203_c10) - SUM(ABS(cosr.co_7))) AS amt_difference 
FROM 
    sm203_c 
INNER JOIN 
    COSR ON sm203_c.sm203_c6 = cosr.co_6 

WHERE 
 sm203_c9 = @sm203_4 
 and co_11 =   @sm203_4 
 and co_6 = @sm203_c6
GROUP BY  
    sm203_c.sm203_c10, 
    sm203_c.sm203_c101, 
    sm203_c.sm203_c1
HAVING   
    (ABS(sm203_c.sm203_c10) - SUM(ABS(cosr.co_7))) >= 0;

END
end

IF @a ='REMAININGAMT'
BEGIN

 SELECT 
    c.co_11 AS account, 
    SUM(ABS(c.co_7)) AS amt_cosr, 
    ABS(sm203_c10) AS amt, 
    (ABS(sm203_c.sm203_c10) - SUM(ABS(c.co_7))) AS amt_difference,
    sm203_c.sm203_c101 AS branch
FROM  
    cosr c
JOIN 
   sm203_c 
ON 
    c.co_11 = sm203_c.sm203_c9 
WHERE 
Co_9 = (select sm203_5 from sm203 where sm203_4 = (select top 1 sm203_c6 from sm203_c where sm203_c9 = @sm203_4) ) and  -----bk(JJ?JL)
 abs(sm203_c.sm203_c10) >= 0 
    AND 
	 sm203_c.sm203_c101 = @branch
    AND co_11 =@sm203_4


    AND  sm203_c.sm203_c9 =@sm203_4
GROUP BY  
    c.co_11, 
    sm203_c.sm203_c10, 
     sm203_c.sm203_c101, 
   sm203_c.sm203_c1
HAVING   (ABS(sm203_c.sm203_c10) - SUM(ABS(c.co_7))) >0 

	
END

        SELECT sm1002_14 AS MAILID
        FROM sm1002
        WHERE sm1002_15 in (SELECT sm203_c9 FROM sm203_c WHERE sm203_c6 = @sm203_4)
		 -- Table1: 
		SELECT (case when sm203_6A = '0' then 'FALSE' else 'TRUE' end ) as posted FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @sm203_4


end

-----new added by ankita
if @a = 'jv'

BEGIN 
    SELECT SM203_4 AS UNQID, (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = sm203_3) AS createdby,
    (SELECT sm63_6 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 =SM203_12) AS postedby,
           'JOURNAL VOUCHER' AS [FORMAT],
           CASE 
               WHEN SM203_5 = 'JL' THEN 'IBTM/JV/' + SM203_6A
               WHEN SM203_5 = 'JJ' THEN 'JV/' + SM203_6A
               ELSE 'JOURNAL VOUCHER' + SM203_6A
           END AS [FORMATNAME],
           'NO.' AS [TYPE],
           SM203_6A AS [POSTEDNO],
           SM203_11 AS [POSTEDDATE],
		   (select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where SM1002_5 = sm203_101) as [BRANCH],
		   (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = sm203_14) as [ACCRDR],
           ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00), '') AS [DEBITAC],
           ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 > 0.00), '') AS [CREDITAC],
           (CASE WHEN SM203_C10 < 0.00 THEN (SM203_C10 * (-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DEBITAMOUNT],
           (CASE WHEN SM203_C10 > 0.00 THEN SM203_C10 ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CREDITAMOUNT],
           (SELECT (case when SUM(SM203_C10)< 0 then SUM(SM203_C10)*-1 else  SUM(SM203_C10) end) 
            FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203_4 = SM203_C6 AND SM203_C7 = SM203_6 
            WHERE SM203_C10 < 0.00 
              AND SM203_4  =@SM203_4  and SM203_4 = SM203_C6 
         
			  )AS [AMOUNT],
			  dbo.fnNumberToWords((SELECT (case when SUM(SM203_C10)< 0 then SUM(SM203_C10)*-1 else  SUM(SM203_C10) end) 
            FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203_4 = SM203_C6 AND SM203_C7 = SM203_6 
            WHERE SM203_C10 < 0.00 
              AND SM203_4  =@SM203_4  and SM203_4 = SM203_C6 
         
			  )) AS BALANCEINWORDS,
           SM203_8 + ' '+ DBO.[COSRNARRATION](SM203_4)  AS [NARRATION]
    FROM SM203 
    INNER JOIN SM203_C ON (SM203_4 = SM203_C6  AND SM203_C7 = SM203_6) 
    WHERE SM203_4 = @SM203_4 --AND SM203_6=@SM203_6
      --AND SM203_6A = @sm203_6A 
    ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9 AND SM203_C10 < 0.00), '') != '' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    SM203_C.SM203_C13;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_JOURNAL_REGISTER_Q]
@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@branchid               AS	NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@sm203_101	            nvarchar(100)='' ,    ----branchid
@sm203_4	          nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----unqid
@branch            AS	NVARCHAR(100) = ''

AS 

IF @what = 'JOURNAL_REGISTER'
BEGIN
		SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))
		+ ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA

		--REPORT CREATED FROM TABLE M3 CHANGE ON 20210625
		--SELECT M3_3 AS [VOUCHER NO], M3_19 AS [DATE],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=M3_4) AS [PARTY NAME],
		--M3_5 AS [NARRATION],
		--(CASE WHEN (M3_6)<0 THEN ((M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DEBIT AMOUNT],
		--(CASE WHEN (M3_6)>0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CREDIT AMOUNT] INTO #T FROM M3 WHERE M3_1='JJ'
		--AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) BETWEEN
		--DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
		--ORDER BY [DATE],[VOUCHER NO]
		--SELECT * FROM #T ORDER BY [DATE],[VOUCHER NO]

		SELECT 'JV/' + SM203_6A AS [VOUCHER NO],
		SM203_11 AS [DATE],
		(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM203_C9) AS [PARTY NAME],
		SM203_8 + ' ' + DBO.COSRNARRATION(SM203.SM203_4) AS [NARRATION],
		(CASE WHEN (SM203_C10)<0 THEN ((SM203_C10)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DEBIT AMOUNT],
		(CASE WHEN (SM203_C10)>0 THEN (SM203_C10) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CREDIT AMOUNT] 
		FROM SM203 INNER JOIN SM203_C ON SM203.SM203_4 = SM203_C.SM203_C6 AND SM203_6=SM203_C7
		WHERE SM203_11 <>'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM203_12 <>'' AND SM203_C10<>0
		AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(SM203_11) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) and sm203_101=@branchid
		ORDER BY SM203_11,
		cast(SM203_6A as numeric(18,0)),  [DEBIT AMOUNT] desc, sm203_c13




END

IF @what = 'DisplayGrid_rep'
BEGIN  
 --Table 0
	  
SELECT     
    SM203.SM203_4 AS [unqid], 
    SM203.SM203_6A AS [postedvoucher],
  
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_7, 103) AS [Voucher date],
	  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), SM203.SM203_11, 103) AS [Posted date],
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 SM19.SM19_5 
        FROM SM19  
        JOIN SM203_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM203_C.SM203_C9 
        WHERE SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 AND SM203_6=SM203_C7 
        ORDER BY SM203_C.SM203_C13
    ) AS [AccountName],
    (
        SELECT MAX(ABS(SM203_C.SM203_C10))  
        FROM SM203_C 
        WHERE
		SM203_C.SM203_C6 = SM203.SM203_4 
    ) AS [DebitAmt]
 

FROM SM203 

   WHERE SM203_11 <>'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND SM203_12 <>''
		AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(SM203_11) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@fromdate) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate) and sm203_101=@Sm203_101

ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN sm203_13='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 
    SM203_11 DESC,
    CAST(CASE WHEN SM203_6A='' THEN 0 ELSE sm203_6a END AS numeric(18,0)) DESC,
    SM203_7 DESC

													--No Record Found  Table 1
SELECT  'No Record Found' AS [postedvoucher],'' AS [unqid],'' AS [date],'' AS [AccountName], 
	   ''  AS [DebitAmt]		
	   
---Table-1-------------------------------------------


--SELECT * FROM (
--	 SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 1 as ord  FROM SM1002  
--	 UNION ALL 
--	 SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 0 as ord  FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5= @Sm203_101
--	 )AS AA ORDER BY ord 

SELECT * FROM (
	 SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH ,1 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 0 as ord  FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5= @Sm203_101
	)AS AA ORDER BY ord 
	  
------------------------bkkk--------------------------------

 select 
 --unqid as [VALUE], 
 BA_1 as BK,   ba_5 as BAA from BA where BA_6 = 'JV'
END


if @what='CHILDDATA_rep'
begin

   select
    SM203_C7 AS VNO,
	Sm203_c6 as [unqid],  (ABS(SM203_C10)) as [DBAMT],
  (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM203_C9) as  [ACCOUNTNAME], SM203_C9 as ACCUNQID,  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), 
  sm203_c.sm203_c8,103) as [DATE],sm203_c13 as orderno ,CASE WHEN SM203_C10>0 THEN 'CR' ELSE 'DR' END AS [DEBITCREDIT]   FROM SM203_C
   where sm203_c6 = @sm203_4  AND SM203_C101=@branch
   order by SM203_C10  
 end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_POSTING]
@what   nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_1  nvarchar(10)  = '',	
@m3_2  nvarchar(30)  = '',
@m3_3  nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_4  nvarchar(36)  = '',
@m3_5  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_6  nvarchar(100)  = '',
@m3_7  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_8  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_9  nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_10 nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_11 nvarchar(10)  = '',	
@m3_12 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_13 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_14 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_15 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_16 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_17 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_18 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_19 nvarchar(30)  = '',
@userid nvarchar(3)  = '',
@outletcode nvarchar(100) = '',
@systemname nvarchar(max) = ''
AS
BEGIN
if @what = 'insert'
begin
	insert into m3
	values(@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@m3_14,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,
	dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname);
end

if @what = 'delete'
begin
	select * into #temp_m3 from m3 where m3_14 = @m3_14
	delete from m3 where m3_14 = @m3_14
end

if @what = 'update'
begin
	update m3 set
	m3_1  = @m3_1, 
	m3_2  = @m3_2, 
	m3_3  = @m3_3,
	m3_4  = @m3_4,
	m3_5  = @m3_5,
	m3_6  = @m3_6,
	m3_7  = @m3_7,
	m3_8  = @m3_8,
	m3_9  = @m3_9,
	m3_10 = @m3_10,
	m3_11 = @m3_11,
	m3_12 = @m3_12,
	m3_13 = @m3_13,
	m3_15 = @m3_15,
	m3_16 = @m3_16,
	m3_17 = @m3_17,
	m3_18 = @m3_18,
	m3_19 = @m3_19,
	--m3_20 = @m3_20,
	--m3_21 = @m3_21,
	m3_22 = @userid,
	m3_23 = @outletcode,
	m3_24 = @systemname
	where m3_14 = @m3_14
end
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_POSTING_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_POSTING_Q]
@what	    nvarchar(30)  = '',
@unqid	    nvarchar(36)  = '',
@gstnature  nvarchar(50)  = '',
@userid	    nvarchar(3)   = '',
@outletcode nvarchar(100)  = '',

@branch nvarchar(100)  = '',
@systemname nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_19		nvarchar(30) = ''
as
Declare @m3_1  nvarchar(10),@m3_2  nvarchar(30),@m3_3  nvarchar(20),@m3_4  nvarchar(36),@m3_5  nvarchar(max),@m3_6  nvarchar(50),@m3_7  nvarchar(max),
@m3_8  nvarchar(max),@m3_9  nvarchar(20),@m3_10 nvarchar(max),@m3_11 nvarchar(10),@m3_12 nvarchar(36),@m3_13 nvarchar(max),@m3_14 nvarchar(36),	
@m3_15 nvarchar(max),@m3_16 nvarchar(max),@m3_17 nvarchar(max),@m3_18 nvarchar(36);

DECLARE @AccountID AS NVARCHAR(50),@Amount AS NUMERIC(18,2);
DECLARE @ProductID AS NVARCHAR(50);

DECLARE @INVN_UNQID AS NVARCHAR(36);
DECLARE @COSR_ADJAMT AS NUMERIC(18,2);

set @m3_18 = newid();	
set @m3_19 = dbo.getformatteddate(@m3_19);
begin
	if @what = 'SALES'
	
	begin
	   --Changes Start -10/01/2022
	   begin 
	      declare @invoiceno numeric(18,0)		  

		 select  @invoiceno=  ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM213_9 AS numeric(18))),0)+1 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_35='OI' AND SM213_8='GIL/SI/25-26/'		 
		 UPDATE SM213  SET SM213_8 = 'GIL/SI/25-26/',sm213_9 = @invoiceno WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
		 
	   end
	   ----Changes End
		select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_2 = sm213_6,@m3_3 = sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
		@m3_4 = UPPER(sm213_10),@m3_5 = (select TOP 1 sm206_10 + ' ' + sm213_c7 + ' @ '+ replace(convert(nvarchar(30),sm213_c9),'.00',' ') + sm213_c8
		from sm213_c inner join sm206 on sm213_c5 = sm206_2 where sm213_c4 = @unqid),	
		@m3_6 = -sm213_23,@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'DR',@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_12 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
		@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @unqid,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',@m3_17 = '' from sm213 where unqid = @unqid;
		
		exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
		@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@branch,@systemname
		
		declare @unqidc as nvarchar(36),@roffac as nvarchar(36);
		declare cur1 cursor for
		select unqid from SM213_c where sm213_c4 = @unqid;
		open cur1
		fetch next from cur1 into @unqidc
		while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
			if (select sm213_14 from sm213 where unqid = @unqid) = 'IGST' 
			begin
				--IGST TAXABLE 
				select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_2 = SM213_6,@m3_3 = sm213_8 + '/' + SM213_9,
				@m3_4 = (select UPPER(sm206_24) from sm206 where SM206_2 = (select sm213_c5 from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc)),
				@m3_5 = (select TOP 1 sm206_10 + ' ' + sm213_c7 + ' @ '+ replace(convert(nvarchar(30),sm213_c9),'.00',' ') + sm213_c8
				from sm213_c inner join sm206 on sm213_c5 = sm206_2 where sm213_c4 = @unqid),
				@m3_6 = (select convert(numeric(18,2),sm213_c14) from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc),@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'CR',@m3_10 = '',
				@m3_11 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_12 = @gstnature,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @unqid,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
				@m3_17 = '' from sm213 where unqid = @unqid;
				set @m3_18 = newid();
				set @m3_19 = dbo.getformatteddate(@m3_19);
				exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
				@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@branch,@systemname

				--IGST 
				select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_2 = sm213_6,@m3_3 = sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
				@m3_4 = (select UPPER(sm210_19) from sm210 where unqid = (select sm213_c15 from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc)),
				@m3_5 = (select TOP 1  sm206_10 + ' ' + sm213_c7 + ' @ '+ replace(convert(nvarchar(30),sm213_c9),'.00',' ') + sm213_c8
				from sm213_c inner join sm206 on sm213_c5 = sm206_2 where sm213_c4 = @unqid),
				@m3_6 = (select convert(numeric(18,2),sm213_c18) from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc),@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'CR',@m3_10 = '',
				@m3_11 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),@m3_12 = @gstnature,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @unqid,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
				@m3_17 = '' from sm213 where unqid = @unqid;
				set @m3_18 = newid();
				set @m3_19 = dbo.getformatteddate(@m3_19);
				exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
				@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@branch,@systemname
			end
			else
			begin
				--tAXABLE
				select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),@m3_2 = sm213_6,@m3_3 = sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
				@m3_4 = (select UPPER(sm210_10) from sm210 where unqid = (select sm213_c15 from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc)),
				@m3_5 = (select TOP 1 sm206_10 + ' ' + sm213_c7 + ' @ '+ replace(convert(nvarchar(30),sm213_c9),'.00',' ') + sm213_c8
				from sm213_c inner join sm206 on sm213_c5 = sm206_2 where sm213_c4 = @unqid),
				@m3_6 = (select convert(numeric(18,2),sm213_c14) from sm213_c where unqid = @unqidc),

    AND IN_11 != 0.00 order by IN_8 ASC;

------------TABLE 2----------------------------------
    SELECT 
        (SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = 'PP' AND BA_17 = @branch) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = IN_12) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
        IN_8 AS [DATE], IN_14 AS [DDATE], IN_13 AS [INVOICENO], abs(IN_9) AS [NETAMOUNT], abs(IN_11) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],
    --(SELECT abs(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid) AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
   0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
       0.00 AS [DIFFERENCE],
        UNQID AS [UNQID], IN_5 AS [SALESUNQID]
    FROM INVN
     WHERE IN_7 ='PP' and IN_5 IN (
        SELECT sm1005_4
        FROM SM1005
        WHERE SM1005_11 IN (
            SELECT sm202_c9 
            FROM sm202_c 
            WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid
        )
    ) 
    AND IN_11 != 0.00 order by IN_8 ASC; 
	------------TABLE 3----------------------------------
	 SELECT 
        (SELECT BA_5 FROM BA WHERE BA_1 = 'FF' 
		--AND BA_17 = @branch
		) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = IN_12) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
        IN_8 AS [DATE], IN_14 AS [DDATE], IN_13 AS [INVOICENO], abs(IN_9) AS [NETAMOUNT], abs(IN_11) AS [BALANCEAMOUNT],
    --(SELECT abs(sm202_c10) FROM sm202_c WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid) AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
   0.00 AS [ADJUSTEDAMOUNT],
       0.00 AS [DIFFERENCE],
        UNQID AS [UNQID], IN_5 AS [SALESUNQID]
    FROM INVN
     WHERE IN_7 ='FF' and IN_5 IN (
        SELECT sm1005_4
        FROM SM1005
        WHERE SM1005_16 IN (
            SELECT sm202_c9 
            FROM sm202_c 
            WHERE sm202_c6 = @unqid
        )
    ) 
    AND IN_11 != 0.00 order by IN_8  ASC;

if @what = 'PURCHASE_P'
begin
		update sm227 set sm227_29 = dbo.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@M3_19) , sm227_30 = @userid where unqid = @unqid

		--update sm202 set SM202_6A = (select (max(SM202_6A) +1) from sm202 where dbo.onlydate(sm202_13) = dbo.onlydate(@m3_19)) where sm202_4 = @unqid
		 
		select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q'),@m3_2 = SM227_6,@m3_3 = (select BA_6 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q') + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),SM227.SM227_7),
		@m3_4 =  (SELECT PA_35 FROM PA),@m3_5 = SM227_27,@m3_6 = (select SUM(SM227_c7) from SM227_C where SM227_c3 = @unqid),
		@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'CR',@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q'),@m3_12 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @unqid,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
		@m3_17 = '' from sm227 where unqid = @unqid;

		set @m3_18 = newid();
		
		exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
		@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
 
		DECLARE CUR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT SM227_C4,SM227_C7 FROM SM227_C WHERE SM227_C3=@UNQID
	    OPEN CUR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CUR1 INTO @ProductID,@Amount 
	    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	    BEGIN 
  
		select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q'),@m3_2 = SM227_6,@m3_3 = (select BA_6 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q') + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),SM227.SM227_7),
		@m3_4 = UPPER(@ProductID),
		@m3_5 = SM227_27,@m3_6 = -@Amount,
		@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'DR',@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' AND BA_17 = 'Q'),@m3_12 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @unqid,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
		@m3_17 = '' from sm227 where unqid = @unqid;
	   
	    set @m3_18 = newid();

		exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
		@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname

	   FETCH NEXT FROM 
	   CUR1 INTO @ACCOUNTID,@AMOUNT;

	END
    CLOSE CUR1  
	DEALLOCATE CUR1  

END
