IF @what = 'jvibtm'
BEGIN
    -- Check if the value in sm203_5 for the given unqid is 'JL'
    IF (SELECT sm203_5 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid) = 'JL'
    BEGIN
        -- Declare and set required variables
        DECLARE @narration AS NVARCHAR(MAX);
        SET @narration = (SELECT sm203_8 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid);

        DECLARE @newid AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        DECLARE @outletcodebranch AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = (SELECT sm1002_5 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_15 IN (SELECT sm203_c9 FROM sm203_c WHERE sm203_c6 = @unqid));
        SELECT @vno = CAST(MAX(sm203_6) + 1 AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM sm203;
        SET @newid = NEWID();
        set @date  = (SELECT sm203_7 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid);
      
        

        -- Insert into sm203 table
        INSERT INTO dbo.sm203 (
            [SM203_1], [SM203_2], [SM203_3], [SM203_4], [SM203_100], [SM203_101],
            [sm203_5], [SM203_6], [SM203_6A], [SM203_7], [SM203_8], [SM203_9],
            [SM203_10], [SM203_11], [SM203_12], [SM203_13], [SM203_14], [SM203_15]
        )
        VALUES (
            GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userid, @newid, @systemname, @outletcodebranch,
            'JJ', @vno, '0', @date, @narration, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
            '', '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @userid, '', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@unqid
        );

        SET @sm203_c13 = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM203_C13), 0) + 1 FROM SM203_c WHERE SM203_C6 = @newid);

		declare  @pmntdrcr as uniqueidentifier;
		

if exists(
SELECT sm203_c9, sm203_c10 
FROM sm203_c
WHERE sm203_c9 IN (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002)
  AND sm203_c6 = @unqid
  AND sm203_c10 > 0
)begin 
SET @pmntdrcr = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 IN (SELECT sm203_101 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid));
declare  @sm203_c10 as numeric(18,2);
set @sm203_c10 = (SELECT TOP 1 ABS(sm203_c10) FROM sm203_c WHERE sm203_c6 = @unqid)

INSERT INTO dbo.SM203_C (
        [SM203_C1], [SM203_C2], [SM203_C3], [SM203_C4], [SM203_C100], [SM203_C101],
        [SM203_C5], [SM203_C6], [SM203_C7], [SM203_C8], [SM203_C9], [SM203_C10],
        [SM203_C11], [SM203_C12], [SM203_C13]
    )
    SELECT 
        GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @userid, NEWID(), @systemname, @outletcodebranch,
        '', @newid, @vno, @date, @pmntdrcr,
        -@sm203_c10,
        '0', '0.00', @sm203_c13;

    -- Get the next SM203_C13 value
    SET @sm203_c13 = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM203_C13), 0) + 1 FROM SM203_c WHERE SM203_C6 = @newid);

    -- Insert the second record with negative value adjustment
    INSERT INTO dbo.SM203_C (
        [SM203_C1], [SM203_C2], [SM203_C3], [SM203_C4], [SM203_C100], [SM203_C101],
        [SM203_C5], [SM203_C6], [SM203_C7], [SM203_C8], [SM203_C9], [SM203_C10],
        [SM203_C11], [SM203_C12], [SM203_C13]
    )
    SELECT 
        GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @userid, NEWID(), @systemname, @outletcodebranch,
        '', @newid, @vno, @date, (SELECT sm203_14 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid),
        @sm203_c10,
        '0', '0.00', @sm203_c13;
end 
else if exists(
SELECT sm203_c9, sm203_c10 
FROM sm203_c
WHERE sm203_c9 IN (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002)
  AND sm203_c6 = @unqid
  AND sm203_c10 < 0)
  begin

  SET @pmntdrcr = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 IN (SELECT sm203_101 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid));
  set @sm203_c10 = (SELECT TOP 1 ABS(sm203_c10) FROM sm203_c WHERE sm203_c6 = @unqid)
  INSERT INTO dbo.SM203_C (
        [SM203_C1], [SM203_C2], [SM203_C3], [SM203_C4], [SM203_C100], [SM203_C101],
        [SM203_C5], [SM203_C6], [SM203_C7], [SM203_C8], [SM203_C9], [SM203_C10],
        [SM203_C11], [SM203_C12], [SM203_C13]
    )
    SELECT 
        GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @userid, NEWID(), @systemname, @outletcodebranch,
        '', @newid, @vno, @date, @pmntdrcr,
        @sm203_c10,
        '0', '0.00', @sm203_c13;

    -- Get the next SM203_C13 value
    SET @sm203_c13 = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM203_C13), 0) + 1 FROM SM203_c WHERE SM203_C6 = @newid);

    -- Insert the second record with negative value adjustment
    INSERT INTO dbo.SM203_C (
        [SM203_C1], [SM203_C2], [SM203_C3], [SM203_C4], [SM203_C100], [SM203_C101],
        [SM203_C5], [SM203_C6], [SM203_C7], [SM203_C8], [SM203_C9], [SM203_C10],
        [SM203_C11], [SM203_C12], [SM203_C13]
    )
    SELECT 
        GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @userid, NEWID(), @systemname, @outletcodebranch,
        '', @newid, @vno, @date, (SELECT sm203_14 FROM sm203 WHERE sm203_4 = @unqid),
        -@sm203_c10,
        '0', '0.00', @sm203_c13;
end

else
BEGIN
print 'error passing values' 
END


END
END 

IF @what = 'bankonly'

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_REPORT_Q]
@TYPE		NVARCHAR(40) = '',	
@unqid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',

@uid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@selected   NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@sm19_7    NVARCHAR(50) = '',

@sm19_5     NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@BRANCH  NVARCHAR(max) = ''
AS
--SET @selected = ''

IF @TYPE = 'LEDGER1'
BEGIN
-----------------------------------LEDGER
SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AS [MDATE],'' AS [VOUCHERNO],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT],
 (select top 1 ba_5 from ba where ba_1 = m3.m3_1) as [BOOKNAME],
 (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [CRAMOUNT],'TO OPENING BALANCE B/F' AS [PARTICULARS],M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
 (CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
 SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY] ,'1' AS [BREAKYN],'1' AS [SHOWBALANCE] FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_11
 WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19)<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND M3_4 IN (select data from dbo.split(@SELECTED,','))
 GROUP BY M3_4,SM19_5,SM19_6,SM44_7,m3_1

UNION ALL

SELECT DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) AS [MDATE],M3_3 AS [VOUCHERNO],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT]
,(select top 1 ba_5 from ba where ba_1 = m3.m3_1) as [BOOKNAME],
(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [CRAMOUNT],M3_5 AS [PARTICULARS],M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
(CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY],'1' AS [BREAKYN],'1' AS [SHOWBALANCE] FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_11 
WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND 
M3_4 IN (select data from dbo.split(@SELECTED,',')) and
M3_6 != 0.00 GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_5,SM19_6,SM44_7,m3_1

) AS AA ORDER BY [MDATE],[VOUCHERNO]
-----------------------------------------------------------------
END
else IF @TYPE = 'LEDGER'
BEGIN



	 SELECT * FROM (
	 SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AS [MDATE],'' AS [VOUCHERNO], (select top 1 ba_5 from ba where ba_1 = m3.m3_1) as [BOOKNAME],
	 (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT], (select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = m3_23)  as BRANCH,
	 (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [CRAMOUNT],'TO OPENING BALANCE B/F' AS [PARTICULARS],M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
	 (CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
	 SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY] ,'1' AS [BREAKYN],'1' AS [SHOWBALANCE],'' AS BK FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44.UNQID = SM19_7
	 WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_2)<DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND M3_4 IN (select data from dbo.split(@SELECTED,','))
	 GROUP BY M3_4,SM19_5,SM19_6,SM44_7, m3_1,m3_23

	UNION ALL

	SELECT DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) AS [MDATE],M3_3 AS [VOUCHERNO],(select top 1 ba_5 from ba where ba_1 = m3.m3_1) as [BOOKNAME],
	(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT],(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = m3_23)  as BRANCH,
	(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [CRAMOUNT],M3_5 + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) AS [PARTICULARS],M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
	(CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
	SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY],'1' AS [BREAKYN],'1' AS [SHOWBALANCE],M3_1 AS BK FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44.UNQID = SM19_7 
	WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND 
	M3_4 IN (select data from dbo.split(@SELECTED,',')) and
	M3_6 != 0.00 GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_5,SM19_6,SM44_7,M3_1,M3_14, m3_1, m3_23
	) AS AA ORDER BY [MDATE] desc
	
END
ELSE  IF @TYPE = 'LEDGERB'
BEGIN


	SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 
        DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AS [MDATE],
        '' AS [VOUCHERNO], 
       '' AS [BOOKNAME],
        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT], 
        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CRAMOUNT],
        'TO OPENING BALANCE B/F' AS [PARTICULARS],
        M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
		(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = m3_23)  as BRANCH,
        (CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
        SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY], 
        '1' AS [BREAKYN],
        '1' AS [SHOWBALANCE],
        '' AS BK 
    FROM M3 
    INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID 

    INNER JOIN SM1002 ON M3_23 = SM1002.sm1002_5
    INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44.UNQID = SM19_7
    WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) < DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND M3_4 In (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SELECTED,','))
    AND M3_23 LIKE '%'+@branch+'%'
    GROUP BY M3_4, SM19_5, SM19_6, SM44_7, m3_23

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) AS [MDATE],
        M3_3 AS [VOUCHERNO],
        (SELECT TOP 1 ba_5 FROM ba WHERE ba_1 = m3.m3_1) AS [BOOKNAME],
        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DRAMOUNT],
        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CRAMOUNT],
        M3_5 + DBO.[COSRNARRATION](M3_14) AS [PARTICULARS],
        M3_4 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],
    	(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = m3_23)  as BRANCH,
        (CASE WHEN SM19_5 = SM19_6 THEN SM19_5 ELSE SM19_5 + ' ' + '(' + SM19_6 +')' END) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],
        SM44_7 AS [CATEGORY],
        '1' AS [BREAKYN],
        '1' AS [SHOWBALANCE],
        M3_1 AS BK 
    FROM M3 
    INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID 
	INNER JOIN SM1002 ON M3_23 = SM1002.sm1002_5
    INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44.UNQID = SM19_7 
    WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
    AND M3_4 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SELECTED,','))
    AND M3_6 != 0.00    AND M3_23 LIKE '%'+@branch+'%'
    GROUP BY M3_19, M3_3, M3_4, M3_5, SM19_5, SM19_6, SM44_7, M3_1, M3_14, m3_1, m3_23
) AS AA 
ORDER BY [MDATE],
CAST(
    RIGHT(
        REPLACE([VOUCHERNO], '-', ''), 
        CASE 
            WHEN CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(REPLACE([VOUCHERNO], '-', ''))) > 0 
            THEN CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(REPLACE([VOUCHERNO], '-', ''))) - 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS INT
) ASC


 
--,(SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT([VOUCHERNO],'/'))DESC


end

 IF @TYPE = 'BINDCATEGORY'
BEGIN
	  SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [SCHEDULE] ,0 as ord

 IF @TYPE = 'BINDBRANCH'

	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;

 IF @TYPE = 'BINDACC'

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LICENCEKEY_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LICENCEKEY_Q]
@WHAT		  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_1	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_2	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_3	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@unqid		  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_100	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_5	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_6	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_7	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@SM226_8	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@FROMDATE	  AS NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@TODATE		  AS NVARCHAR(50) = ''

AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @FY_BEGIN AS NVARCHAR(50),@FY_END AS NVARCHAR(50);
SET @FY_BEGIN = (SELECT PA_1 FROM PA)
SET @FY_END = (SELECT PA_2 FROM PA)

IF @WHAT = 'CUSTOMERNAME'
BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNT NAME] FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5
END

IF @WHAT = 'INSERT'
BEGIN
		SET @unqid = NEWID();
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM226]
        ([SM226_1],[SM226_2],[SM226_3],[unqid],[SM226_100],[SM226_5],[SM226_6],[SM226_7],[SM226_8]) VALUES
		(GETDATE(),'',@SM226_3,@unqid,@SM226_100,'',@SM226_6,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM226_7),@SM226_8)
		SELECT 'Save Suucessfully' AS err

END


IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[SM226] SET [SM226_2] = GETDATE(),[SM226_3] = @SM226_3,[SM226_100] = @SM226_100,
		[SM226_6] = @SM226_6,[SM226_7] = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM226_7),[SM226_8] = @SM226_8 WHERE [unqid] = @unqid
END

IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[SM226]  WHERE [unqid] = @unqid
END

IF @WHAT = 'SELECT'
BEGIN
		SELECT [SM226_6] AS [CUSTOMER NAME],[SM226_7] AS [DATE OF EXPIRY],[SM226_8] AS [REMARK]
	    FROM [dbo].[SM226] WHERE [unqid] = @unqid
END

IF @WHAT = 'LEDGER'
BEGIN
									-------------TABLE 1 LEDGER GRID-----------------
	  SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AS [Date],'' AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	  (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount] INTO #T FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7
	  WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19)<=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND M3_4 IN (@unqid)
	  GROUP BY M3_4,SM19_6,SM44_7

	  IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #T)>0)
	  BEGIN 
	        SELECT * FROM (
	        SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),M3_19,103) AS [Date],M3_3 AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount] FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7 
	        WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_END) AND 
	        M3_4 IN (@unqid) AND
	        M3_6 != 0.00 GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_6,SM44_7,M3_1
	        ) AS AA ORDER BY [DATE],CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL([Voucher No],'')='' then 0 else RIGHT([Voucher No] ,
			 CHARINDEX ('/' ,REVERSE([Voucher No]))-1) END AS NUMERIC(15))
			--CAST(CASE WHEN BK='OO' THEN SUBSTRING([VOUCHER NO],5,20) ELSE 
	        --CASE WHEN ISNULL([VOUCHER NO],'')='' THEN '0' ELSE [VOUCHER NO] END    END  AS NUMERIC(15))
	  END

	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
 	        SELECT * FROM (
	        SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),M3_19,103) AS [Date],M3_3 AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount] FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7
	        WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_END) AND 
	        M3_4 IN (@unqid) AND
	        M3_6 != 0.00 and m3_3 != '' GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_6,SM44_7
	        ) AS AA ORDER BY [DATE],[VOUCHER NO]
	 END

									-------------TABLE 1 LEDGER EMPTY GRID-----------------
	 SELECT 'No Records Found' AS [Date],'' AS [Voucher No],'' AS [Debit Amount],'' AS [Credit Amount]

									-------------TABLE 2 GRID-----------------
	 SELECT TOP 5  CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [Expiry Date] FROM SM226 WHERE SM226_6= @unqid ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC

		----							-------------TABLE 3 FOR SOFTWARE INSTALLATION AND INVOICE DATE -----------------
	 --SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE((SELECT SM19_C5 FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 =SM226_6)) AS [SOFTWARE INSTALLATION DATE],
	 --DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE((SELECT  SM213_6 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6)) AS [INVOICE CREATION DATE]
	 --FROM SM226 WHERE SM226_6 = @unqid 
END

IF @WHAT = 'SEARCH'
BEGIN
		IF @SM226_6= ''
		BEGIN
		SET @SM226_6='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		END

		--IF @FROMDATE > @TODATE
		--BEGIN
		--		SELECT 'From date cannot be greater than To date' AS err
		--END
			  
		  --SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date] , CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [Date] ,(SELECT  SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid = SM226_6) AS [Account Name]  FROM SM226 
		  --WHERE SM226_7 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC
		  ---- [ACCOUNT NAME],SM226_7 DESC

		  --SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date] , CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [Date] ,(SELECT  SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid = SM226_6) AS [Account Name]  FROM SM226 
		  --WHERE SM226_7 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM226_6 = @SM226_6
		  --ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC

         SELECT SM226_6, MAX([SM226_7]) AS SM226_7, [Entry Date],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),MAX([Expiry Date]),103) AS [Expiry Date],[Account Name],
		 [Installtaltion Date],[Last Invoice No],[Last Invoice Date] FROM 
		 (SELECT SM226_6, SM226_7, unqid AS [UNQID], CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date] ,
		 SM226_7 AS [Expiry Date] ,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid = SM226_6) AS [Account Name],
		 (SELECT TOP 1  CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM19_C5,103) FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = SM226_6) AS [Installtaltion Date],
		 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 +'/'+ SM213_9  FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6 ORDER BY SM213_9 DESC),'')  AS [Last Invoice No],
		 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),SM213_6,103) FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6 ORDER BY SM213_9 DESC),'')  AS [Last Invoice Date]  FROM SM226 
		  WHERE SM226_7 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
		 )AS AB GROUP BY SM226_6, [Entry Date],[Account Name],[Installtaltion Date],[Last Invoice No],[Last Invoice Date] ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC

         SELECT SM226_6, MAX([SM226_7]) AS SM226_7, [Entry Date],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),MAX([Expiry Date]),103) AS [Expiry Date],[Account Name],
		 MAX([Installtaltion Date]) AS [Installtaltion Date],MAX([Last Invoice No]) AS [Last Invoice No],MAX([Last Invoice Date]) AS [Last Invoice Date] FROM 
		 (SELECT SM226_6, SM226_7, unqid AS [UNQID], CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date] ,
		 SM226_7 AS [Expiry Date] ,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid = SM226_6) AS [Account Name],
		 (SELECT TOP 1  CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM19_C5,103) FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 = SM226_6) AS [Installtaltion Date],
		 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 +'/'+ SM213_9  FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6 ORDER BY SM213_9 DESC),'')  AS [Last Invoice No],
		 ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),SM213_6,103) FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6 ORDER BY SM213_9 DESC),'')  AS [Last Invoice Date]  FROM SM226 
		  WHERE 
		  --SM226_7 BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND 
		  SM226_6 = @SM226_6
		 )AS AB GROUP BY SM226_6, [Entry Date],[Account Name] ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC
		 --[Installtaltion Date],[Last Invoice No],[Last Invoice Date] ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC
		  
		  SELECT '' AS SM226_6, '' AS SM226_7, 'No Records Found'  AS [Entry Date] ,'' AS [Expiry Date],'' AS [Account Name],
		  ''  AS [Installtaltion Date],'' AS [Last Invoice No],'' AS [Last Invoice Date] 
END


IF @WHAT = 'VIEW'
BEGIN
	   SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [DATE] ,SM226_6 AS [ACCOUNTUNQ],SM226_8 AS [REMARK]
	   --,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE((SELECT SM19_C5 FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2 =SM226_6)) AS [SOFTWARE INSTALLATION DATE],
	   --DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE((SELECT  SM213_6 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10=SM226_6)) AS [INVOICE CREATION DATE]
		FROM SM226 WHERE SM226_6=@unqid
	   
	   
	   --SELECT TOP 5  CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [Expiry Date] FROM SM226 
	   --WHERE SM226_6= (SELECT SM226_6 FROM SM226 WHERE UNQID=@unqid) ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC

	  SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_1,103) AS [Entry Date],CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),SM226_7,103) AS [Expiry Date],SM226_8 AS Remark FROM SM226 
	   WHERE SM226_6= @unqid ORDER BY SM226_7 DESC

	   SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AS [Date],'' AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	  (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount],'' AS BK INTO #T1 FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7
	  WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19)<=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND M3_4 IN (SELECT SM226_6 FROM SM226 WHERE UNQID=@unqid)
	  GROUP BY M3_4,SM19_6,SM44_7

	  IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #T1)>0)
	  BEGIN 
	        SELECT * FROM (
	        SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),M3_19,103) AS [Date],M3_3 AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount],M3_1 AS BK FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7 
	        WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_END) AND 
	        M3_4 IN (SELECT SM226_6 FROM SM226 WHERE UNQID=@unqid) AND
	        M3_6 != 0.00 GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_6,SM44_7,M3_1
	        ) AS AA ORDER BY [DATE],CAST(CASE WHEN BK='OO' THEN SUBSTRING([VOUCHER NO],5,20) ELSE 
	        CASE WHEN ISNULL([VOUCHER NO],'')='' THEN '0' ELSE [VOUCHER NO] END    END  AS NUMERIC(15))
	  END

	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
 	        SELECT * FROM (
	        SELECT CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),M3_19,103) AS [Date],M3_3 AS [Voucher No],(CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)<0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [Debit Amount],
	        (CASE WHEN SUM(M3_6)>0 THEN (SUM(M3_6)) ELSE 0.00 END) As [Credit Amount] FROM M3 INNER JOIN SM19 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM44_5 = SM19_7
	        WHERE DBO.onlydate(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_BEGIN) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FY_END) AND 
	        M3_4 IN (SELECT SM226_6 FROM SM226 WHERE UNQID=@unqid) AND
	        M3_6 != 0.00 and m3_3 != '' GROUP BY M3_19,M3_3,M3_4,M3_5,SM19_6,SM44_7
	        ) AS AA ORDER BY [DATE],[VOUCHER NO]
	END

END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LOGIN_Q]

@outlet NVARCHAR(10)='',

			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				  SELECT 'NOT AUTHENTICATED'
			END
	END

	IF  @outlet='Q' 
	BEGIN
			SELECT [sm60_5], [sm60_33], [sm60_32], [sm60_6] FROM sm60 where sm60_7=@User and sm60_31='True' and sm60_21='Q' order by sm60_32
	END 

	if @WHAT='branch_master'
begin
select sm1002_7 as branchname,sm1002_5 as value from sm1002 order by sm1002_7 asc

select Product , FORMAT([DATE],'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [DATE], Particulars,Unit,cast(sum(RECEIPTS)as numeric(18,3)) as RECEIPTS,cast(sum(ISSUE)as numeric(18,3)) as ISSUE, 
 CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY [DATE], ORD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS Balance,ORD AS ORD from
(
select Product , [DATE] , Particulars,UNIT,cast(sum(RECEIPTS - ISSUE)as numeric(18,3)) as RECEIPTS, 0.000 as ISSUE,ORD AS ORD from
(
---------------------opening for purchase
   select sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) AS [DATE],'Opening Balance' as Particulars,
   sm209_7 as Unit,sm1005_45 AS RECEIPTS,0 AS ISSUE,0 AS ORD
   from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 WHERE SM1005_18 <dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
   group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,sm1005_45 
   union all
   -----OPENING FOR SHORTAGE
   SELECT sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) AS [DATE],
    'Opening Balance' as Particulars,
   sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, -SM1005_59 AS ISSUE,0 AS ORD
   from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 where sm1005_59<>0 AND SM1005_18 <dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
    group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,SM1005_59,sm1005_12
   UNION ALL
   -------OPENIG FOR SALES
   SELECT sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)  AS [DATE],
     'Opening Balance' as Particulars,
    sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, SM1011_42 AS ISSUE,0 AS ORD
 from sm1011 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13  inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23 WHERE sm1011_6 < dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
  group by sm206_7,sm1011_6,sm209_7,SM1011_42
)AS AB GROUP BY Product,[DATE],Particulars,Unit,ORD
UNION ALL
SELECT sm206_7 as Product,SM1005_18 AS [DATE],
 sm1005_12  + ' '+ FORMAT(SM1005_18,'dd/MM/yyyy') + ' ' +  sm1005_8 + ' Goods Receipt' + '('  + sm1005_17 + ')' as Particulars,
 sm209_7 as Unit,sm1005_45 AS RECEIPTS,0 AS ISSUE,1 AS ORD
 from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 
 WHERE SM1005_18 between dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) and dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
  group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,sm1005_45,sm1005_12,sm1005_8,sm1005_17
 union all
 SELECT sm206_7 as Product,SM1005_18 AS [DATE],
 sm1005_12  + ' '+ sm1005_8 + ' Shortage' as Particulars,
 sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, -SM1005_59 AS ISSUE,2 AS ORD
 from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 
 where sm1005_59<>0 AND SM1005_18 between dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) and dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
  group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,SM1005_59,sm1005_12,sm1005_8
 UNION ALL
 SELECT sm206_7 as Product,sm1011_6  AS [DATE],
 sm1011_7  + ' Sales' as Particulars,
 sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, SM1011_42 AS ISSUE,3 AS ORD
 from sm1011 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13  inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23 
 WHERE sm1011_6 between dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) and dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
  group by sm206_7,sm1011_6,sm209_7,SM1011_42,sm1011_7


  union all
  
---------------------Closing for purchase
   select sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) AS [DATE],'Closing Balance' as Particulars,
   sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS,0 AS ISSUE,4 AS ORD
   from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 WHERE SM1005_18 <dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
   group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,sm1005_45 
   union all
   -----Closing FOR SHORTAGE
   SELECT sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) AS [DATE],
    'Closing Balance' as Particulars,
   sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, 0 AS ISSUE,4 AS ORD
   from sm1005 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1005.sm1005_10 inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1005.sm1005_54 where sm1005_59<>0 AND SM1005_18 <dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
    group by sm206_7,SM1005_18,sm209_7,SM1005_59,sm1005_12
   UNION ALL
   -------Closing FOR SALES
   SELECT sm206_7 as Product,dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)  AS [DATE],
     'Closing Balance' as Particulars,
    sm209_7 as Unit,0 AS RECEIPTS, 0 AS ISSUE,4 AS ORD
 from sm1011 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13  inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid=sm1011.sm1011_23 WHERE sm1011_6 < dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
  group by sm206_7,sm1011_6,sm209_7,SM1011_42
 )AS A GROUP BY Product,[DATE],Particulars,Unit,RECEIPTS,ISSUE,ORD order by Product,[DATE],ORD ASC

 --SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),PA_1,103) AS FROMDATE FROM PA

select sm1002_7 as branchname,sm1002_5 as value from sm1002 where sm1002_5=@unqid order by sm1002_7 asc 

end

if @what='INSERT_LOGIN'
begin
INSERT INTO LoginHistory (UnqId,EntryDateTime,UserID, Status, IPAddress,Branch)

end

END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_LRC_Report_Q]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@Month_from nvarchar(50)='',
@Month_to nvarchar(50)=''
as


if @what='Grid_Bind'
begin
declare @month_Less nvarchar(10);
set @Month_from=cast(@Month_from+'-01' AS DATE);
set @Month_to=cast(@Month_to+'-01' AS DATE);
set @Month_to= eomonth(@Month_to);
SET @month_Less= CONVERT(nvarchar(10),(dateadd(month,-2,@Month_from)),126);
--select @month_count;
select @Month_from;
select @Month_to;
select distinct dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) as renewal_date,convert(varchar(5),dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5),110) as renewal_month  ,sm19_5 as Account_Name,sm19_c6 ,sm19_c10 as subcription,sm19_c7 as LRC_Amt,
(select top 1 sm208_5 from sm208 where sm208.unqid=sm19_c4) as software_name
from sm19 inner join sm19_c on unqid=sm19_c2  
where   dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) between   @Month_from and @Month_to
and sm19.unqid not in   (select m3_4 from m3  where m3_2 > @month_Less   and m3_6>0 ) 
order by Account_Name



--select distinct dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) as renewal_date ,sm19_5 as Account_Name,sm19_c6 as LRC_Amt,sm19_c7 from sm19 inner join sm19_c on unqid=sm19_c2  
--where   dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) between   @Month_from and @Month_to 
--and sm19.unqid not in   (select m3_4 from m3  where m3_2 > @month_count   and m3_6>0 ) 
--order by Account_Name




end


if @what='test'
begin


 select dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,'2022-06-01'),sm19_c5) ,sm19_5 as Account_Name,sm19_c5 as install_date ,sm19_c7 as LRC_Amt from sm19 inner join sm19_c on unqid=sm19_c2  
 where   dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,'2022-06-01'),sm19_c5) between   '2022-09-01' and '2022-09-30' 
 and sm19.unqid not in   (select m3_4 from m3  where m3_2 > '2022-05-01'   and m3_6>0 ) 
  order by Account_Name
end


if @what ='Excel_export'
begin

set @Month_from=cast(@Month_from+'-01' AS DATE);
set @Month_to=cast(@Month_to+'-01' AS DATE);
set @Month_to= eomonth(@Month_to);
SET @month_Less= CONVERT(nvarchar(10),(dateadd(month,-2,@Month_from)),126);
select distinct sm19_5 as [Account Name],dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) as [Renewal Date] ,sm19_c7 as [LRC Amount] from sm19 inner join sm19_c on unqid=sm19_c2  
where   dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,@Month_from),sm19_c5) between   @Month_from and @Month_to 
and sm19.unqid not in   (select m3_4 from m3  where m3_2 > @month_Less   and m3_6>0 ) 
order by [Account Name]


end



if @what ='Year'
begin

 select dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,'2022-06-01'),sm19_c5) ,sm19_5 as Account_Name,(select sm208_5 from sm208 where unqid=sm19_c.sm19_c4) as Software,(select top 1 sm1_5 from sm01 where unqid=sm19_15) as city,sm19_20 as mobile_no, sm19_13 as address,sm19_c5 as install_date ,sm19_c7 as LRC_Amt from sm19 inner join sm19_c on unqid=sm19_c2  
 where  -- dateadd(year,DATEdiff(year,sm19_c5,'2022-06-01'),sm19_c5) between   '2022-09-01' and '2022-09-30' 
  sm19.unqid not in   (select m3_4 from m3  where m3_2 > '2022-01-01'   and m3_6>0 ) 
  order by Account_Name
end

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURER_PO_ENTRY]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURER_PO_ENTRY]
@what as nvarchar(max),
@SM1028_3   [nvarchar](max)='',    --USERID
@SM1028_6   [nvarchar](max)='',    --date
@SM1028_7   [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- branch
@SM1028_8   [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- manufacturer
@SM1028_9   [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- category
@SM1028_10  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- customer
@SM1028_11  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- order type
@SM1028_12  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- supplier
@SM1028_13  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- PO number
@SM1028_14  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- customer reference number
@SM1028_15  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- payment term
@SM1028_16  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- shipping details
@SM1028_17  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- uploading point
@SM1028_18  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- receiving point
@SM1028_19  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- transporter
@SM1028_20  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- pincode
@SM1028_21  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- product
@SM1028_22  [nvarchar](max) = '',  -- total qty
@SM1028_23  [nvarchar](max) = '',   -- remarks
@SM1028_24  NUMERIC(18,2)=0,        --GRIDTOTAL
@SM1028_c6  [nvarchar](max) = '',   
@SM1028_c7  [nvarchar](max) = '',   --delivery date
@SM1028_c8  [nvarchar](max) = '',   --order qty child
@unqid      [nvarchar](max)='',
@punqid     [nvarchar](max)='',
@SM1028_c3  [nvarchar](max)='',
@SM1028_c4  [nvarchar](max)='',      
@SM1028_c9  [nvarchar](max)='',       --parent unqid
@type        nvarchar(max)='',
@txtsearch   nvarchar(max)='',
@SM1028_c23  nvarchar(max)='',        --userid
@ip          nvarchar(max)='',        --ipaddress
@SM1028_c25  nvarchar(max)='',        --PUNQID SM1028
@SM1028_c26  nvarchar(max)='',        --date
@SM1028_c27  nvarchar(max)='',        --discount rate labels
@SM1028_c28  numeric(18,2)=0,        --amoount
@SM1028_c29  numeric(18,2)=0,        --amount*qty
@SM1028_c30  nvarchar(max)='',
@category    nvarchar(max)='',
@Manufacturer nvarchar(max)=''       

AS

if @what = 'dropdownbind'
	begin
	     select sm1002_5 as unqid,sm1002_7 as branch from sm1002 --branch

		 select unqid,sm113_6 as manufacture from sm113 order by sm113_6         --manufacturer

		 select unqid, sm17_6 as category from sm17 order by sm17_6           --category

		 select unqid,sm19_5 as custname from sm19 where sm19_11='cust' order by sm19_5  --customer name

		 select unqid,sm19_5 as supplname from sm19 where sm19_11='suppl' order by sm19_5  --supplier name

		 select unqid,sm1_5 as cityname from sm01 order by sm1_5 asc  --city

		 select unqid,sm19_5 as Transname from sm19 where sm19_11='trans' order by sm19_5  --Transporter name

		 select sm206_2 unqid,sm206_7 product from sm206 order by sm206_7 asc
		    --product

		 SELECT ZM38_1 AS UNQID,ZM38_2 AS PAYMENTTERM FROM ZM38   --payment term

		 SELECT ZM39_1 AS UNQID,ZM39_2 AS shipping FROM ZM39      --shipping Details

		 select convert(varchar ,getdate() ,103) as todaydate

		 select convert(varchar ,getdate() ,105) as todaydate
		 
		 
	end

if @what='insert'
    begin  
		 if(@type ='edit')
		 begin
		       delete from sm1028 where unqid=@unqid
			   delete from sm1028_c where sm1028_c9=@unqid
			   delete from sm1028_c2 where sm1028_c25=@unqid
			    set @unqid=newid();
		       insert into sm1028 values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1028_3,@unqid,'','',DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_6),@SM1028_7,@SM1028_8,@SM1028_9,@SM1028_10,@SM1028_11,@SM1028_12,@SM1028_13,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_14)
		       ,@SM1028_15,@SM1028_16,@SM1028_17,@SM1028_18,@SM1028_19,@SM1028_20,@SM1028_21,@SM1028_22,@SM1028_23,@SM1028_24)

		       select @unqid as punqid
		 end
		 else
		 begin
		        set @unqid=newid();
		       insert into sm1028 values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1028_3,@unqid,'','',DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_6),@SM1028_7,@SM1028_8,@SM1028_9,@SM1028_10,@SM1028_11,@SM1028_12,@SM1028_13,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_14)
		       ,@SM1028_15,@SM1028_16,@SM1028_17,@SM1028_18,@SM1028_19,@SM1028_20,@SM1028_21,@SM1028_22,@SM1028_23,@SM1028_24)

		       select @unqid as punqid
		 end
	end

if @what='insert_child'
   begin
       insert into sm1028_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1028_c3,newid(),@SM1028_c4,'',DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_c6),@SM1028_c7,@SM1028_c8,@punqid)
	   
	   
   end

   if @what='insert_sub_child'
   begin
       
	   insert into sm1028_c2 values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1028_c23,newid(),@ip,@punqid,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1028_c26),@SM1028_c27,@SM1028_c28,@SM1028_c29,'0')
	   
   end

IF @WHAT='BINDGRID'
  BEGIN
       SELECT SM1028.UNQID,convert(varchar ,SM1028_6 ,105) AS DDATE,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,SM113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,SM1028_22 AS QTY,SM206_7 AS PRODUCT  FROM SM1028 INNER JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID=SM1028_8 INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1028_21
	   INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1028_7 order by sm1028_6
  END

  IF @WHAT='delete'
  BEGIN
       delete from sm1028 where unqid=@unqid

	   delete from sm1028_c where sm1028_c9=@unqid

	   delete from sm1028_c2 where sm1028_c25=@unqid
  END

  IF @WHAT='BINDDATA'
  BEGIN
       SELECT convert(varchar ,SM1028_6 ,103) AS DDATE,SM1028_7 AS BRANCH,SM1028_8 AS MANUFACTURER,SM1028_9 AS category,SM1028_10 AS customer,SM1028_11 AS ordertype,
	   SM1028_12 AS supplier,SM1028_13 AS PO,convert(varchar ,SM1028_14 ,103) AS CUSTREFDATE,SM1028_15 AS paymentterm,SM1028_16 AS  shippingdetails,SM1028_17 AS CITY1,
	   SM1028_18 AS CITY2,SM1028_19 AS transporter,SM1028_20 AS pincode,  SM1028_22 AS QTY,SM1028_21 AS PRODUCT,SM1028_23 as remarks,sm1028_24 as total  FROM SM1028 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID

	   select sm1028_c7 as deliverydate,sm1028_c8 as qty from sm1028_c where sm1028_c9=@UNQID

	   SELECT SM1028_C28 AS amt,SM1028_C29 AS QTYINTOAMT FROM SM1028_C2   where sm1028_c25=@unqid
  END

   IF @WHAT='search'
  BEGIN
        SELECT SM1028.UNQID,convert(varchar ,SM1028_6 ,105) AS DDATE,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,SM113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,SM1028_22 AS QTY,SM206_7 AS PRODUCT  FROM SM1028 INNER JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID=SM1028_8 INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1028_21
	   INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1028_7 where sm113_6 like '%'+@txtsearch+'%'
  END

  IF @WHAT='OnCategorychanged'
  BEGIN
       select sm206_2 as unqid,sm206_7 as product from sm206 where sm206_13=@category
  END

   IF @WHAT='OnManufacturerchanged'
  BEGIN
	 select sm19_5 as suppli,sm19.unqid as unqid from sm113_c inner join sm19 on sm113_c3=sm19.unqid inner join sm113 on sm113.unqid=sm113_c.sm113_c2 where  sm113.unqid=@Manufacturer
  END
  


  

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURER_UPLFT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURER_UPLFT]
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdate    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',

@todate   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) =''
	
AS
BEGIN
if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN

SELECT 'ALL' AS manufacturer, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [VALUE], 1 as ord 
union all 
SELECT sm113_6 AS manufacturer,unqid AS [VALUE], 2 as ord  FROM SM113 ORDER BY ord asc;

-- Declare date variables and convert them
DECLARE @fromdate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_converted DATE = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columnss NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumnss NVARCHAR(MAX);

---- Print dates for verification
--PRINT @fromdate_converted;
--PRINT @todate_converted;

-- Create a temporary table to store the date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);

-- Populate the date series
DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @fromdate_converted;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @todate_converted
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END;

-- Create temporary table for aggregated data
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedData') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;
SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_45), 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_41), 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_30), 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_70), 0) AS FreightAmount,
   -- ISNULL((SUM(sm1005.sm1005_77)+SUM(sm1005.sm1005_78)), 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,
	 ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sm1005.sm1005_77 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) + CAST(sm1005.sm1005_78 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))), 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_36), 0) AS TotalAmount
INTO #AggregatedData
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_converted AND @todate_converted and sm1005_7 = @branch
and
(@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or  sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER)
--and sm1005_30 > 0
GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7;

-- First result set
SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Veh, 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.BasicAmount, 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.FreightAmount, 0) AS FreightAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.CASHCUSTAmount, 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,

    ISNULL(ad.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
FROM #DateSeriess ds
FULL JOIN #AggregatedData ad 
    ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
ORDER BY ds.Day;

-- Generate dynamic columns without STRING_AGG
SET @columnss = '';
SELECT @columnss = @columnss + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @columnss = STUFF(@columnss, 1, 1, '');

-- Generate pivot columns for all measures
SET @pivotColumnss = '';
SELECT @pivotColumnss = @pivotColumnss + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Veh')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_BasicAmount')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_FreightAmount')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CASHCUSTAmount')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalAmount')
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumnss = STUFF(@pivotColumnss, 1, 1, '');

-- Construct and execute the dynamic pivot query
SET @sql1 = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumnss + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Qty'' as ProductMeasure,
        ad.Qty as Value
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Veh'',
        ad.Veh
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_BasicAmount'',
        ad.BasicAmount
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
	SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_FreightAmount'',
        ad.FreightAmount
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
	SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_CASHCUSTAmount'',
        ad.CASHCUSTAmount
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_TotalAmount'',
        ad.TotalAmount
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedData ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumnss + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';

-- Execute the dynamic SQL query
--PRINT @sql;  -- Uncomment for debugging
EXEC sp_executesql @sql1;

-- Clean up temporary tables
DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;


END


if @aa='ALL_DDD'
BEGIN


-- Declare date variables and convert them
DECLARE @fromdate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);  
DECLARE @todate_convertedd DATE = CONVERT(DATE,  @todate, 103);
DECLARE @columns NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @pivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- Print dates for verification
PRINT @fromdate_convertedd;
PRINT @todate_convertedd;

-- Create a temporary table to store the date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeries') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeries;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeries (Day DATE);

-- Populate the date series
DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = @fromdate_convertedd;
WHILE @CurrentDate <= @todate_convertedd
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeries (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDate);
    SET @CurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate);
END;

-- Create temporary table for aggregated data
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AggregatedDataa') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AggregatedData;
SELECT 
    CONVERT(DATE, sm1005.sm1005_6, 103) AS Dateee,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_45), 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(COUNT(sm1005.sm1005_41), 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_30), 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_70), 0) AS FreightAmount,
  --  ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_77)+SUM(sm1005.sm1005_78), 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,
	 ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sm1005.sm1005_77 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) + CAST(sm1005.sm1005_78 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))), 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,
    ISNULL(SUM(sm1005.sm1005_36), 0) AS TotalAmount
INTO #AggregatedDataa
FROM sm1005
LEFT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
WHERE sm1005.sm1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate_convertedd AND @todate_convertedd 
and sm1005_7 = @branch
and (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or  sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER) 
--and sm1005_30 > 0
GROUP BY sm1005.sm1005_6, sm206.sm206_7;

-- First result set
SELECT 
    ds.Day AS Day,
    ISNULL(ad.Product, '') AS Product,
    ISNULL(ad.Veh, 0) AS Veh,
    ISNULL(ad.Qty, 0) AS Qty,
    ISNULL(ad.BasicAmount, 0) AS BasicAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.FreightAmount, 0) AS FreightAmount,
    ISNULL(ad.CASHCUSTAmount, 0) AS CASHCUSTAmount,

    ISNULL(ad.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
FROM #DateSeries ds
FULL JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad 
    ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
ORDER BY ds.Day;

-- Generate dynamic columns without STRING_AGG
SET @columns = '';
SELECT @columns = @columns + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @columns = STUFF(@columns, 1, 1, '');

-- Generate pivot columns for all measures
SET @pivotColumns = '';
SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Qty')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_Veh')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_BasicAmount')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_FreightAmount')
    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_CASHCUSTAmount')

    + ',' + QUOTENAME(sm206_7 + '_TotalAmount')
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 
      FROM sm206 
      WHERE sm206_2 IN (SELECT DISTINCT sm1005_10 FROM sm1005)) AS Products
ORDER BY sm206_7;

SET @pivotColumns = STUFF(@pivotColumns, 1, 1, '');

-- Construct and execute the dynamic pivot query
SET @sql = N'
SELECT Day, ' + @pivotColumns + '
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Qty'' as ProductMeasure,
        ad.Qty as Value
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_Veh'',
        ad.Veh
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_BasicAmount'',
        ad.BasicAmount
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_FreightAmount'',
        ad.FreightAmount
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)

	    UNION ALL

    	SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_CASHCUSTAmount'',
        ad.CASHCUSTAmount
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
    

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ds.Day,
        ad.Product + ''_TotalAmount'',
        ad.TotalAmount
    FROM #DateSeries ds
    LEFT JOIN #AggregatedDataa ad ON ds.Day = CAST(ad.Dateee AS DATE)
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
(
    SUM(Value)
    FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Day;';

-- Execute the dynamic SQL query
--PRINT @sql;  -- Uncomment for debugging
EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

-- Clean up temporary tables
DROP TABLE #DateSeries;
DROP TABLE #AggregatedDataa;

END
END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MONTHLY_LRC_INVOICE_LIST_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MONTHLY_LRC_INVOICE_LIST_Q] 
@AA			 NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@MONTH		 NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@USERID		 NVARCHAR(3)   = '',
@SERVERNAME  NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DATE		 NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@ACCOUNTNAME NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@PRODUCT	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DESCRIPTION NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@QUANTITY    NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@RATE        NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@AMOUNT      NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TAX		 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@NETAMOUNT   NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@SELECT		 NVARCHAR(5)   = '',
@REMARKS	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM217_UNQID NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@REMARKS2	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
declare @monthno as nvarchar(10),@year as nvarchar(10);
	IF @AA = 'MONTHNAMES'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @TEMP AS TABLE (MONTH_NAME NVARCHAR(30),MONTH_NO NVARCHAR(20))
		DECLARE @I AS INT;
		SET @I = 1
		WHILE @I<=12
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @TEMP
			select datename(Month,dbo.getformatteddate('01/' +CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@I)+ '/1900')),@I
			SET @I = @I + 1
		END
		SELECT MONTH_NO AS [MONTHNO],MONTH_NAME AS [MONTH] FROM @TEMP ORDER BY CAST(MONTH_NO AS NUMERIC(10))
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'MONTHDETAILS'
	BEGIN
		select @year = SUBSTRING(convert(nvarchar(30),getdate(),101),7,10)
	
		SELECT SM19.UNQID,SM19_5 AS [PARTY_NAME],DBO.getformatteddate('01/' +@month + '/' + @year) AS [DATE],'LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES' AS [PRODUCT],
		(SELECT SM208_5 FROM sm208 WHERE unqid= SM19_C4) + ' SOFTWARE FOR FY ' + (SELECT SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),PA_1,101),7,10) 
		+ '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),PA_2,101),9,10) FROM PA) AS [DESCRIPTION],
		'1.00' AS [QUANTITY],SM19_C7 AS [RATE],SM19_C7*(1) AS [AMOUNT],'18.00' AS [TAX],CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),((SM19_C7)+ (SM19_C7*(0.18)))) AS [NET_AMOUNT]
		FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM19_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM19_C2 WHERE MONTH(SM19_C5) = @month ORDER BY SM19_5 
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM217'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO SM217 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,@ACCOUNTNAME,dbo.getformatteddate(@DATE),@PRODUCT,@DESCRIPTION,
		@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@TAX,@NETAMOUNT,@REMARKS,@SELECT,@MONTH)
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'DELETESM217'
	BEGIN
		IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM218 WHERE SM218_19 = @MONTH AND YEAR(SM218_6) BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(PA_1) FROM PA) AND (SELECT YEAR(PA_2) FROM PA))>0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT '1'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM SM217 WHERE SM217_16 = @MONTH AND YEAR(SM217_6) BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(PA_1) FROM PA) AND (SELECT YEAR(PA_2) FROM PA)
			SELECT '2'
		END
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'SELECTFORAPPROVAL'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM217.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM217_5 AS [ACC_UNQID],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM217_5) AS [PARTY_NAME],
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM217_6) AS [DATE],SM217_7 AS [PRODUCT],SM217_8 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM217_9 AS [QUANTITY],SM217_10 AS [RATE],
		SM217_11 AS [AMOUNT],SM217_12 AS [TAX],SM217_13 AS [NET_AMOUNT],SM217_14 AS [REASON],SM217_15 AS [SELECT]
		FROM SM217 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM217_15))) IN('TRUE','1') AND SM217.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM218_18 FROM SM218) ORDER BY SM217_16 ASC--AND SM217_16 = @MONTH
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM218'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @SELECT = CASE WHEN @SELECT = '1' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE (CASE WHEN @SELECT = '0' THEN 'FALSE' ELSE (@SELECT) END) END
		SELECT @MONTH = (SELECT SM217_16 FROM SM217 WHERE UNQID = @SM217_UNQID)
		INSERT INTO SM218 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,@ACCOUNTNAME,dbo.getformatteddate(@DATE),@PRODUCT,@DESCRIPTION,
		@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@TAX,@NETAMOUNT,@SELECT,@REMARKS,@REMARKS2,dbo.getentrydate(),@SM217_UNQID,@MONTH)
		------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		--AUTO INSERT
		IF @SELECT  = '1' OR @SELECT = 'TRUE'
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @what nvarchar(30)='', @sm213_1	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_2	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_3	nvarchar(50)='',@unqid		nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_5	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_100  nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_6    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_7    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_8    nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_9    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_10   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_11   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_12   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_13   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_14   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_15   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_16   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_17   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_18   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_19   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_20   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_21   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_22   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_23   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_24   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_25   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_26   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_27   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_28   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_29   nvarchar(36)='',@sm213_30   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_33	nvarchar(30)='',@sm213_34	nvarchar(30)='',@RCUST		nvarchar(36)='';

			Declare @sm213_c1 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c2 nvarchar(50)='',@unqidC nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c4 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c5 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c6 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c7 nvarchar(MAX)='',@sm213_c8 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c9 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c10 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c11 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c12 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c13 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c14 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c15 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c16 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c17 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c18 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c19 nvarchar(50)='';

			SELECT  @what = 'sale_parent',@sm213_1 = '',@sm213_2 = '',@sm213_3 = @USERID,@unqid = NEWID(),@sm213_5 = '',
			@sm213_100 = @SERVERNAME,@sm213_6 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@DATE),@sm213_7 = 'CREDIT',
			@sm213_8 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_9 = (select isnull(max(Cast([sm213_9] as numeric(18,0))),0) from [sm213] where sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
			@sm213_9 = (select isnull(max(Cast([sm213_9] as numeric(18,0))),0) + 1 from [sm213] where sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
			@sm213_10 = @ACCOUNTNAME,@sm213_11 = '',@sm213_12 = '',@sm213_13 = '',
			@sm213_14 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') THEN
			('CGST + SGST') ELSE ('IGST') END),@sm213_15 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_16 = '0.00',@sm213_17 = @AMOUNT,
			@sm213_18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_19 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_20 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)) END),@sm213_21 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_22 = '0.00',
			@sm213_23 = @NETAMOUNT,@sm213_24 = '',@sm213_25 = '',@sm213_26 = '',@sm213_27 = '',@sm213_28 = '',@sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
			@sm213_30 = (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)),	@sm213_33 = '',@sm213_34 = '',@RCUST = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

			INSERT INTO sm213(sm213_1,sm213_2,sm213_3,unqid,sm213_5,sm213_100,sm213_6,sm213_7,sm213_8,sm213_9,sm213_10,sm213_11,
			sm213_12,sm213_13,sm213_14,sm213_15,sm213_16,sm213_17,sm213_18,sm213_19,sm213_20,sm213_21,sm213_22,sm213_23,sm213_24,
			sm213_25,sm213_26,sm213_27,sm213_28,sm213_29,sm213_30,sm213_31,sm213_32,sm213_33,sm213_34) 
			values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_2,@sm213_3,@unqid ,@sm213_5,@sm213_100,DBO.getformatteddate(@sm213_6),@sm213_7,@sm213_8,
			@sm213_9,@sm213_10,@sm213_11,@sm213_12,@sm213_13,@sm213_14,@sm213_15,@sm213_16,@sm213_17,@sm213_18,@sm213_19,@sm213_20,
			@sm213_21,@sm213_22,@sm213_23,@sm213_24,@sm213_25,@sm213_26,@sm213_27,@sm213_28,@sm213_29,@sm213_30,
			(select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = @sm213_10),'','',''); 

			SELECT @WHAT = 'SALE_CHILD',@sm213_c1 = '',@sm213_c2 = '',@unqidC = NEWID(),@sm213_c4 = @UNQID,@sm213_c5 = (SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT),
			@sm213_c6 = (SELECT SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT),@sm213_c7 = @DESCRIPTION,
			@sm213_c8 = (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE SM209.UNQID = (SELECT SM206_14 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT)),@sm213_c9 = @QUANTITY,@sm213_c10 = @RATE,
			@sm213_c11 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_c12 = '0.00',@sm213_c13 = '0.00',@sm213_c14 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_c15 = (SELECT SM210.UNQID FROM SM210 WHERE SM210_7 = @TAX),
			@sm213_c16 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_c17 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_c18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)) END),
			@sm213_c19 = @NETAMOUNT;

			insert into sm213_c(sm213_c1,sm213_c2,unqid,sm213_c4,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,
			sm213_c14,sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19) 
			values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_c2,newid(),@sm213_c4,@sm213_c5,@sm213_c6,@sm213_c7,@sm213_c8,@sm213_c9,@sm213_c10,@sm213_c11,@sm213_c12,
			@sm213_c13,@sm213_c14,@sm213_c15,@sm213_c16,@sm213_c17,@sm213_c18,@sm213_c19);

			-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			--AUTO POSTING
			DECLARE @GSTNATURE AS NVARCHAR(36),@OUTLETID AS NVARCHAR(10),@M3_19 AS NVARCHAR(30);
			SELECT @what = 'SALES',@GSTNATURE = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@OUTLETID = 'Q',@M3_19 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
			EXEC [DBO].[a_sp_for_ledger_posting_Q] 'SALES',@UNQID,@GSTNATURE,@USERID,@OUTLETID,@SERVERNAME,@M3_19
		END
		------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'APPROVEDLIST'
	BEGIN
			SELECT (SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM218_5) AS [PARTY NAME],
			DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM218_6) AS [DATE],SM218_7 AS [PRODUCT],SM218_8 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM218_9 AS [QUANTITY],SM218_10 AS [RATE],
			SM218_11 AS [AMOUNT],SM218_12 AS [TAX],SM218_13 AS [NET AMOUNT],SM218_16 AS [REMARKS2]
			FROM SM218 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM218_14))) IN('TRUE','1') AND SM218_19 = @MONTH
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'ALLDD'
	BEGIN
		-- TABLE 0 ACCOUNT
		SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM19_5 AS [NAME] FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5

		-- TABLE 1 PRODUCT
		SELECT SM206_2 AS [UNQID],SM206_9 AS [NAME] FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_9

		-- TABLE 2 GST
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM210_7 AS [NAME] FROM SM210 ORDER BY SM210_7
	END
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_MONTHLY_RETURN_INVOICE_LIST_Q] 
@AA				NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@MONTH			NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@USERID			NVARCHAR(3)   = '',
@SERVERNAME		NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DATE			NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@ACCOUNTNAME	NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@PRODUCT		NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DESCRIPTION	NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@QUANTITY		NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@RATE			NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@AMOUNT			NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@CGST			NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@SGST			NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@IGST			NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@TOTALGST		NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@NETAMOUNT		NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@SELECT			NVARCHAR(5)   = '',
@REASON			NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@REMARKS		NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM213_UNQID    NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM213_C_UNQID  NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@INVDATE	    NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@INVOICENO      NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@SM219_UNQID	NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@SM220_UNQID	NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@FROMDATE		NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE			NVARCHAR(30)  = ''
AS
BEGIN
declare @monthno as nvarchar(10),@year as nvarchar(10);
	IF @AA = 'MONTHNAMES'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @TEMP AS TABLE (MONTH_NAME NVARCHAR(30),MONTH_NO NVARCHAR(20))
		DECLARE @I AS INT;
		SET @I = 1
		WHILE @I<=12
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @TEMP
			select datename(Month,dbo.getformatteddate('01/' +CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@I)+ '/1900')),@I
			SET @I = @I + 1
		END
		SELECT MONTH_NO AS [MONTHNO],MONTH_NAME AS [MONTH] FROM @TEMP ORDER BY CAST(MONTH_NO AS NUMERIC(10))

	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'MONTHDETAILS'
	BEGIN
		select sm213.unqid as Punqid,sm213_c.unqid,SM213_10 AS ACC_UNQID,sm213_6 as Date,sm213_9 as InvoiceNo,(select sm19_5 from  sm19 where sm19.unqid= sm213.sm213_10) as CustomerName,
		(select sm206_10 from  sm206 where sm206.sm206_2= sm213_c.sm213_c5) as ProductName,sm213_c9 as Qty,sm213_c10 as Rate,sm213_c11 as Amount,
		sm213_c16 as CGST,sm213_c17 SGST,sm213_c18 IGST,sm213_30 as TotalGst,sm213_c19 as NetAmt 
		from sm213 inner join sm213_c on sm213.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c4 WHERE SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		and sm213.unqid not in (select distinct sm213_29 from sm213) AND SM213.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM219_6 FROM SM219)
		ORDER BY CAST(SM213_9  AS NUMERIC(10))
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM219'
	BEGIN
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM219 WHERE SM219_6 = @SM213_UNQID)>0)
		BEGIN
			PRINT '1'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO SM219 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@DATE),@SM213_UNQID,@SM213_C_UNQID,
			dbo.getformatteddate(@INVDATE),@INVOICENO,@ACCOUNTNAME,@PRODUCT,@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@CGST,@SGST,@IGST,@TOTALGST,@NETAMOUNT,@REMARKS)
		END
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'DELETESM219'
	BEGIN
		IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM220 WHERE SM220_5 = @SM219_UNQID AND DBO.ONLYDATE(SM220_7) = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@DATE))>0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT '1'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID;
			SELECT '2'
		END
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'SELECTFORAPPROVAL'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM219.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM219_10 AS [ACC_UNQID],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM219_10) AS [PARTY_NAME],
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM219_5) AS [DATE],SM219_11 AS [PRODUCT],SM219_12 AS [QUANTITY],SM219_13 AS [RATE],
		SM219_14 AS [AMOUNT],SM219_15 AS [CGST],SM219_16 AS [SGST],SM219_17 AS [IGST],SM219_18 AS [TOTALGST],SM219_19 AS [NETAMOUNT],
		SM219_20 AS [REASON] FROM SM219 WHERE SM219.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT SM220_5 FROM SM220)
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM220'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO SM220 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,@SM219_UNQID,@ACCOUNTNAME,dbo.getformatteddate(@DATE),@PRODUCT,
		(SELECT SM219_8 FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID),@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@CGST,@SGST,@TOTALGST,@IGST,@NETAMOUNT,@REASON,@REMARKS,@SELECT,
		(SELECT SM219_9 FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID))
		
		---------------------INSERT SALES RETURN ENTRY
		DECLARE @UNQSP NVARCHAR(36);
		SELECT @UNQSP = NEWID();
		
		INSERT INTO SM213 
		SELECT DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'',@USERID,@UNQSP,'Q',@SERVERNAME,DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM213_7,(SELECT BA_6 FROM BA WHERE BA_17 = 'Q' AND BA_5 = 'SALES RETURN'),
		(SELECT ISNULL( MAX(SM213_9),0)+1 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),UNQID,SM213_11,SM213_12,SM213_13,sm213_14,
		sm213_15,sm213_16,sm213_17,sm213_18,sm213_19,sm213_20,sm213_21,sm213_22,sm213_23,sm213_24,sm213_25,sm213_26,sm213_27,sm213_28,sm213_29,sm213_30,
		(CASE WHEN SM213_33 = '' THEN (SELECT SM213_31 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM219_6 FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID)) ELSE (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) END),
		'',SM213_33,SM213_34 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM219_6 FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID)

		INSERT INTO SM213_C
		SELECT dbo.getentrydate(),sm213_c2,newid(),@UNQSP,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,sm213_c14,
		sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19 FROM SM213_c WHERE SM213_C4 = (SELECT SM219_6 FROM SM219 WHERE UNQID = @SM219_UNQID)

		---------------------POST SALES RETURN ENTRY
		DECLARE @GSTNATURE AS NVARCHAR(36),@M3_19 AS NVARCHAR(30),@WHAT AS NVARCHAR(30),@OUTLETCODE AS NVARCHAR(10);
		SELECT @GSTNATURE = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
		SELECT @M3_19 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
		SELECT @WHAT = 'SALESRETURN';
		SELECT @OUTLETCODE = 'Q'
		EXEC [DBO].[A_SP_FOR_LEDGER_POSTING_Q] @WHAT,@UNQSP,@GSTNATURE,@USERID,@OUTLETCODE,@SERVERNAME,@M3_19
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'APPROVEDLIST'
	BEGIN
	PRINT '1' 
		SELECT (SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM220_6) AS [PARTY NAME],SM220_21 AS [INVOICE NO],SM220_9 AS [INVOICE DATE],
		SM220_12 AS [AMOUNT],'18%' AS [TAX],SM220_17 AS [NET AMOUNT],SM220_19 AS [REMARKS]
		FROM SM220 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM220_7) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'ALLDD'
	BEGIN
		-- TABLE 0 ACCOUNT
		SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM19_5 AS [NAME] FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5

		-- TABLE 1 PRODUCT
		SELECT SM206_2 AS [UNQID],SM206_9 AS [NAME] FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_9

		-- TABLE 2 GST
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM210_7 AS [NAME] FROM SM210 ORDER BY SM210_7
	END
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_Old_adjustment]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create  procedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_Old_adjustment]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@unqid nvarchar(50)='',
@Search nvarchar(50)='',
@in_9 nvarchar(50)=''
as

if @what='Report'
begin

select IN_12 as unqid,(select top 1 sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=IN_12) as Party_Name, sum(IN_11) as Inv_Amt,(select sum(m3_6) from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 ) as Ledger_amt,
(sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 )) as Diff_Amt from INVN  group by in_12   having (sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 ))<>0
order by Party_Name
end


if @what='testing'
begin
select IN_12,(select top 1 sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=IN_12) as Name, sum(IN_11) as inv_Amt,(select sum(m3_6) from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 )*-1 as Ledger_amt,
(sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 )) as diff from INVN  where in_9>0 group by in_12   having (sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 ))<>0
order by name  
end

if @what='adjst_grid'
begin

select unqid as unqid, IN_5 as sales_unqid,(select top 1 sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=IN_12) as party_name,convert(nvarchar(10),IN_8,105) as dates,IN_9 as net_amount,IN_11 as balance_amount
,0.00 as adjusted_amount, (select sm213_8+'/'+sm213_9 from sm213 where sm213.unqid=IN_5) as invoice from INVN where IN_12=@unqid


end

if @what='Search'
begin

select IN_12 as unqid,(select top 1 sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=IN_12) as Party_Name, sum(IN_11) as Inv_Amt,(select sum(m3_6) from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 ) as Ledger_amt,
(sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 )) as Diff_Amt from INVN inner join sm19 on IN_12=sm19.unqid where sm19_5 like '%'+@Search+'%' 
group by in_12   having (sum(IN_11) + (select  sum(m3_6)  from m3 where m3_4=IN_12 ))<>0
order by Party_Name

end

if @what='adj_Update'
begin

update INVN set in_11=@in_9 where UNQID=@unqid

end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_OS_LEDGER]
@what nvarchar(max) = '',
@uid    AS  NVARCHAR(50)='',
@branchid    as nvarchar(max) =''
AS

begin
if @what='BranchBind'
begin


--declare @branchid as nvarchar(max);
set  @branchid = (select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT SM1002_5 AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH FROM SM1002 
where sm1002_5  in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
ORDER BY BRANCH;

 ----set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	--select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH from SM1002 
	----where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	--ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;
end



IF @what = 'OS_VS_LEDGER'
BEGIN

    -- ================= HEADER DETAILS =================
    SELECT 
        PA_17 AS GSTIN,
        SM205_5 AS [state],
        sm205_7 AS statecode,
        pa_11 AS [AdministrativeAddress],
        PA_14 + ' - 342 003' AS CITY,
        pa_22 AS phoneNo,
        PA_23 AS PHONE,
        pa_18 AS email,
        pa_3 AS FirmName,
        pa_28 AS para1,
        pa_12 AS para2,
        pa_30 AS para3,
        PA_31 AS para4,
        pa_32 AS para5,
        pa_5 AS reg1,
        pa_7 AS reg2,
        pa_4 AS [signature],
        PA_20 AS PanNo,
        pa_25 AS CinNo
    FROM PA
    INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID = PA.PA_10;


    -- ================= CUSTOMER OS VS LEDGER DETAILS =================
    SELECT 
        in_12,
        sm1002_7 AS branch,
        sm19_6 AS customer,
        SUM(invn) AS os,
        SUM(m3) AS ledger,
        SUM(m3) - SUM(invn) AS diff
    FROM
    (
        SELECT in_12, in_15, SUM(in_11) AS invn, 0.00 AS m3
        FROM invn
        GROUP BY in_12, in_15

        UNION ALL

        SELECT m3_4, m3_23, 0.00, SUM(m3_6) * -1
        FROM m3
        GROUP BY m3_4, m3_23
    ) a
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON in_12 = sm19.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON in_15 = sm1002_5
    WHERE sm19_11 = 'cust'
      AND sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
    GROUP BY in_12, in_15, sm19_6, sm1002_7
    HAVING SUM(invn) <> SUM(m3)
    ORDER BY sm1002_7, sm19_6;

    -- ================= VERTICAL BRANCH-WISE TOTAL =================

;WITH base AS
(SELECT 'TOTAL AMOUNT :-' AS branch, SUM(os) AS OS_Total, SUM(ledger) AS Ledger_Total, SUM(diff) AS Diff_Total 
FROM (SELECT a.in_12,sm1002.sm1002_7 AS branch,sm19.sm19_6 AS customer,SUM(a.invn) AS os,SUM(a.m3) AS ledger,
SUM(a.m3) - SUM(a.invn) AS diff FROM (
SELECT in_12,in_15, SUM(in_11) AS invn,0.00 AS m3 FROM invn GROUP BY in_12, in_15
UNION ALL

SELECT m3_4  AS in_12, m3_23 AS in_15, 0.00  AS invn, SUM(m3_6) * -1 AS m3
FROM m3 GROUP BY m3_4, m3_23) a
INNER JOIN sm19 ON a.in_12 = sm19.unqid INNER JOIN sm1002 ON a.in_15 = sm1002.sm1002_5
WHERE sm19.sm19_11 = 'cust' AND sm1002.sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
GROUP BY a.in_12, a.in_15, sm19.sm19_6, sm1002.sm1002_7 HAVING SUM(a.invn) <> SUM(a.m3) ) t)

-- 🔽 Final SELECT from CTE
SELECT * FROM base;

END
IF @what = 'TOS_VS_LEDGER'
BEGIN

    -- ================= HEADER DETAILS =================
    SELECT 
        PA_17 AS GSTIN,
        SM205_5 AS [state],
        sm205_7 AS statecode,
        pa_11 AS [AdministrativeAddress],
        PA_14 + ' - 342 003' AS CITY,
        pa_22 AS phoneNo,
        PA_23 AS PHONE,
        pa_18 AS email,
        pa_3 AS FirmName,
        pa_28 AS para1,
        pa_12 AS para2,
        pa_30 AS para3,
        PA_31 AS para4,
        pa_32 AS para5,
        pa_5 AS reg1,
        pa_7 AS reg2,
        pa_4 AS [signature],
        PA_20 AS PanNo,
        pa_25 AS CinNo
    FROM PA
    INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID = PA.PA_10;


    -- ================= CUSTOMER OS VS LEDGER DETAILS =================
    SELECT 
        in_12,
        sm1002_7 AS branch,
        sm19_6 AS customer,
        SUM(invn) AS os,
        SUM(m3) AS ledger,
        SUM(m3) - SUM(invn) AS diff
    FROM
    (
        SELECT in_12, in_15, SUM(in_11) AS invn, 0.00 AS m3
        FROM invn
        GROUP BY in_12, in_15

        UNION ALL

        SELECT m3_4, m3_23, 0.00, SUM(m3_6) * -1
        FROM m3
        GROUP BY m3_4, m3_23
    ) a
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON in_12 = sm19.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm1002 ON in_15 = sm1002_5
    WHERE sm19_11 = 'trans'
      AND sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
    GROUP BY in_12, in_15, sm19_6, sm1002_7
    HAVING SUM(invn) <> SUM(m3)
    ORDER BY sm1002_7, sm19_6;

    -- ================= VERTICAL BRANCH-WISE TOTAL =================

;WITH base AS
(SELECT 'TOTAL AMOUNT :-' AS branch, SUM(os) AS OS_Total, SUM(ledger) AS Ledger_Total, SUM(diff) AS Diff_Total 
FROM (SELECT a.in_12,sm1002.sm1002_7 AS branch,sm19.sm19_6 AS customer,SUM(a.invn) AS os,SUM(a.m3) AS ledger,
SUM(a.m3) - SUM(a.invn) AS diff FROM (
SELECT in_12,in_15, SUM(in_11) AS invn,0.00 AS m3 FROM invn GROUP BY in_12, in_15
UNION ALL

SELECT m3_4  AS in_12, m3_23 AS in_15, 0.00  AS invn, SUM(m3_6) * -1 AS m3
FROM m3 GROUP BY m3_4, m3_23) a
INNER JOIN sm19 ON a.in_12 = sm19.unqid INNER JOIN sm1002 ON a.in_15 = sm1002.sm1002_5
WHERE sm19.sm19_11 = 'trans' AND sm1002.sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
GROUP BY a.in_12, a.in_15, sm19.sm19_6, sm1002.sm1002_7 HAVING SUM(a.invn) <> SUM(a.m3) ) t)

-- 🔽 Final SELECT from CTE
SELECT * FROM base;

END

end
GO

    -- Company Header Information
    SELECT
