    FROM PA;


	set @todate = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE);

	 -- Create temp table for Ledger Amount calculation
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LedgerAmounts') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #LedgerAmounts;
    
    CREATE TABLE #LedgerAmounts (
        [UNQID] NVARCHAR(max) ,

        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(max) ,
        [ledgeramt] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );
	print 'a'
    -- Calculate Ledger Amounts separately
    INSERT INTO #LedgerAmounts ([UNQID],[BRANCH],[Ledgeramt])
    SELECT 
    m3_4 AS [UNQID], m3_23 as BRANCH, 
        ISNULL(sum(M3.M3_6), 0) AS [Ledgeramt]
    FROM m3  
	--where  m3_23 in (select data from dbo.split(@selectedbranch, ''))
	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON M3.M3_4 =sm19.unqid
	group by m3_4, m3_23;


 
    --  WHERE 
    --    I.IN_8 <= @TODATE
    --    AND I.IN_11 <> 0
    --    AND I.IN_7 = 'OO';
	
--	select * from #LedgerAmounts; 


    -- Main Query Construction with CTEs
    DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
;WITH InvoiceBase AS (
    -- Base invoice data with all joins
    SELECT 
        I.IN_12 AS [UNQID],
        I.UNQID AS [INVUNQID],
        ISNULL(S19.SM19_5, '''') + '','' + ISNULL(S1.SM1_5, '''') AS [Party Name],
        I.IN_13 AS [Invoice No],
        I.IN_8 AS [Invoice Date],
        I.IN_14 AS [Due Date],
        I.IN_9 AS [Invoice Amt],
		-- (sum(m3_6)) AS [Ledgeramt],
        S206.SM206_6 AS [Product],
        S1011.SM1011_13 AS [PROD UNQ],
        S1002.SM1002_7 AS [BRANCH],
        I.IN_15 AS [BRANCHUNQ],
        ABS(CAST(I.IN_11 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS [Due Amt],
        S1011.sm1011_24 AS [TAX],
        S1011.sm1011_6 AS [PROD_SORT],
        S1011.UNQID AS [PROD_UNQID],
        S19.SM19_5 AS [Party_Group]
    FROM INVN I WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN SM19 S19 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S19.UNQID = I.IN_12 
        AND S19.SM19_11 = ''CUST''
    LEFT JOIN SM01 S1 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1.UNQID = S19.SM19_15
    LEFT JOIN SM1011 S1011 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1011.UNQID = I.IN_5
    LEFT JOIN SM206 S206 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S206.SM206_2 = S1011.SM1011_13
    LEFT JOIN SM1002 S1002 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1002.SM1002_5 = I.IN_15
	
    WHERE 
        I.IN_8 <= (''' + @TODATE + ''')
        AND I.IN_11 <> 0
        AND I.IN_7 = ''OO''
';

    -- Party/Customer Filters
    IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDPARTIES, '') <> '' AND @SELECTEDPARTIES <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    BEGIN
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_12 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDPARTIES + ''', '',''))';
    END
    ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSCH, '') <> ''
    BEGIN
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_12 IN (
            SELECT unqid 
            FROM sm19 WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE SM19_11 = ''CUST'' 
                AND SM19_7 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDSCH + ''', '',''))
        )';
    END

    -- Branch Filter
    IF @SELECTEDBRANCH IS NOT NULL 
        AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
        AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> ''
    BEGIN
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_15 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDBRANCH + ''', '',''))';
    END

    -- Day Type Filters (optimized to use raw dates)
    IF @DAYTYPE = '00' -- Above
        SET @sql += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_8, (''' + @TODATE + ''')) > ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @DAYTYPE = '11' -- Equal
        SET @sql += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_8, (''' + @TODATE + ''')) = ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @DAYTYPE = '22' -- Below
        SET @sql += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_8, (''' + @TODATE + ''')) < ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);

    -- Amount Type Filters
    IF @AMTTYPE = '0' -- Above
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_11 > ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '1' -- Equal
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_11 = ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '2' -- Below
        SET @sql += ' AND I.IN_11 < ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);


  
    SET @sql += '
),
CumulativeTax AS (
    -- Calculate cumulative tax amount per party
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM([TAX]) OVER (
            PARTITION BY [Party_Group] 
            ORDER BY [PROD_SORT], [PROD_UNQID]
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS CumulativeAmount
    FROM InvoiceBase
)
SELECT 
    c.[UNQID],
    c.[INVUNQID],
    c.[Party Name],
    ISNULL(l.[Ledgeramt], 0.00) AS [Ledgeramt],
    c.[Invoice No],
    DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(c.[Invoice Date]) AS [Invoice Date],
    DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(c.[Due Date]) AS [Due Date],
    c.[Invoice Amt],
    c.[Product],
    c.[PROD UNQ],
    c.[Due Amt],
    c.[BRANCH],
    DATEDIFF(DAY, c.[Invoice Date], (''' + @TODATE + ''')) AS [Due Days],
    0.00 AS A,
    0.00 AS B,
    0.00 AS C,
    0.00 AS D,
    0.00 AS E,
    0.00 AS [TOTAL AMOUNT],
    c.[TAX],
    c.CumulativeAmount,
    0.00 AS TDS,
    0.00 AS [TDSMDUE]
FROM CumulativeTax c
 left JOIN #LedgerAmounts l ON l.[UNQID] = c.[UNQID]
ORDER BY c.[BRANCH], c.[Party Name], c.[Invoice Date], c.[Due Date], c.[Invoice No]';

   print @sql;

    -- Create temp table for results
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #TempTable;
    
    CREATE TABLE #TempTable (
        [UNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
        [INVUNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Party Name] NVARCHAR(max),
        [ledgeramt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Invoice No] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Invoice Date] DATETIME,
        [Due Date] DATETIME,
        [Invoice Amt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Product] NVARCHAR(255),
        [PROD UNQ] NVARCHAR(max),
        [Due Amt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(max),
        [Due Days] INT,
        A NUMERIC(18,2),
        B NUMERIC(18,2),
        C NUMERIC(18,2),
        D NUMERIC(18,2),
        E NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TAX] NUMERIC(18,2),
        CumulativeAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TDS] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TDSMDUE] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );

    -- Execute dynamic SQL and populate temp table
    INSERT INTO #TempTable (
        [UNQID], [INVUNQID], [Party Name], [ledgeramt], [Invoice No], [Invoice Date], 
        [Due Date], [Invoice Amt], [Product], [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt], [BRANCH], 
        [Due Days], A, B, C, D, E, [TOTAL AMOUNT], [TAX], CumulativeAmount, [TDS], [TDSMDUE]
    )
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql, 
        N'@TODATE NVARCHAR(10), @SELECTEDPARTIES NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDBRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDPRODUCTS NVARCHAR(MAX)', 
        @TODATE = @TODATE, 
        @SELECTEDPARTIES = @SELECTEDPARTIES, 
        @SELECTEDBRANCH = @SELECTEDBRANCH, 
        @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;

    -- Update aging buckets (A, B, C, D, E) based on due days
    UPDATE #TempTable
    SET 
        A = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN 0 AND @TIMEDIFF THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @AGING AND @TIMEDIFF + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        B = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        C = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        D = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        E = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = [Due Amt];

    -- Initialize TDSMDUE with Due Amount
    UPDATE #TempTable
    SET [TDSMDUE] = [Due Amt];

    -- Final result set with TDS calculation and party totals
    ;WITH PartyTotals AS (
        SELECT 
            [Party Name],
            MIN([Invoice Date]) AS ThresholdDate,
            SUM([Due Amt]) AS TotalDueAmt,
            SUM([Due Amt] - (
                CASE 
                    WHEN CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
                    THEN ROUND([TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
                    ELSE 0.00 
                END
            )) AS TOTALMTDS
        FROM #TempTable
        GROUP BY [Party Name]
    )
    SELECT 
        t.[UNQID], 
        t.[INVUNQID], 
        t.[Party Name],
        t.[ledgeramt], 
        t.[Invoice No], 
        t.[Branch], 
        t.[Product], 
        t.[Due Amt], 
        t.[Due Date], 
        t.[Invoice Date], 
        t.[Invoice Amt], 
        t.A, 
        t.B, 
        t.C, 
        t.D, 
        t.E,
        p.TotalDueAmt,
        t.[TAX], 
        t.CumulativeAmount,
        (CASE 
            WHEN t.CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
            THEN ROUND(t.[TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
            ELSE 0.00 
        END) AS TDS,
        (t.[TDSMDUE] - (
            CASE 
                WHEN t.CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
                THEN ROUND(t.[TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
                ELSE 0.00 
            END
        )) AS [TDSMDUE],
        p.TOTALMTDS
    FROM #TempTable t
    INNER JOIN PartyTotals p 
        ON t.[Party Name] = p.[Party Name]  
        AND t.[Invoice Date] >= p.ThresholdDate
    ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'asc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END ASC,
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'desc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END DESC,
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'org' THEN t.[Party Name] END;

    -- Cleanup
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #TempTable;
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LedgerAmounts') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #LedgerAmounts;

END;

IF @AA = 'OUTSTANDINGDUE'
BEGIN
    -- Company Header Information
    SELECT 
        PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
        PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 1)) AS [ADMOFFICE] 
    FROM PA;

   set @todate = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE);

	 -- Create temp table for Ledger Amount calculation
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LedgerAmountss') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #LedgerAmountss;
    
    CREATE TABLE #LedgerAmountss (
        [UNQID] NVARCHAR(max) ,

        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(max) ,
        [ledgeramt] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );

    -- Calculate Ledger Amounts separately
    INSERT INTO #LedgerAmountss ([UNQID],[BRANCH],[Ledgeramt])
    SELECT 
    m3_4 AS [UNQID], m3_23 as BRANCH, 
        ISNULL(sum(M3.M3_6), 0) AS [Ledgeramt]
    FROM m3
	 --where m3_23 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDBRANCH , ','))
	 	LEFT JOIN sm19 ON M3.M3_4 =sm19.unqid

	group by m3_4, m3_23;

    -- Main Query Construction with CTEs
    DECLARE @sqldue NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
;WITH InvoiceBase AS (
    -- Base invoice data with all joins
    SELECT 
        I.IN_12 AS [UNQID],
        I.UNQID AS [INVUNQID],
        ISNULL(S19.SM19_5, '''') + '','' + ISNULL(S1.SM1_5, '''') AS [Party Name],
        I.IN_13 AS [Invoice No],
        I.IN_8 AS [Invoice Date],
        I.IN_14 AS [Due Date],
        I.IN_9 AS [Invoice Amt],
        S206.SM206_6 AS [Product],
        S1011.SM1011_13 AS [PROD UNQ],
        S1002.SM1002_7 AS [BRANCH],
        I.IN_15 AS [BRANCHUNQ],
        ABS(CAST(I.IN_11 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS [Due Amt],
        S1011.sm1011_24 AS [TAX],
        S1011.sm1011_6 AS [PROD_SORT],
        S1011.UNQID AS [PROD_UNQID],
        S19.SM19_5 AS [Party_Group]
    FROM INVN I WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN SM19 S19 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S19.UNQID = I.IN_12 
        AND S19.SM19_11 = ''CUST''
    LEFT JOIN SM01 S1 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1.UNQID = S19.SM19_15
    LEFT JOIN SM1011 S1011 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1011.UNQID = I.IN_5
    LEFT JOIN SM206 S206 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S206.SM206_2 = S1011.SM1011_13
    LEFT JOIN SM1002 S1002 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON S1002.SM1002_5 = I.IN_15
    WHERE 
        I.IN_14 <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(''' + @TODATE + ''')
        AND I.IN_11 <> 0
        AND I.IN_7 = ''OO''
';

    -- Party/Customer Filters
    IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDPARTIES, '') <> '' AND @SELECTEDPARTIES <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    BEGIN
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_12 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDPARTIES + ''', '',''))';
    END
    ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSCH, '') <> ''
    BEGIN
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_12 IN (
            SELECT unqid 
            FROM sm19 WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE SM19_11 = ''CUST'' 
                AND SM19_7 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDSCH + ''', '',''))
        )';
    END

    -- Branch Filter
    IF @SELECTEDBRANCH IS NOT NULL 
        AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
        AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> ''
    BEGIN
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_15 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDBRANCH + ''', '',''))';
    END

    -- Day Type Filters (using Due Date - IN_14)
    IF @DAYTYPE = '00' -- Above
        SET @sqldue += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_14, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(''' + @TODATE + ''')) > ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @DAYTYPE = '11' -- Equal
        SET @sqldue += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_14, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(''' + @TODATE + ''')) = ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @DAYTYPE = '22' -- Below
        SET @sqldue += ' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, I.IN_14, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(''' + @TODATE + ''')) < ' + CAST(@DAYCOUNT AS NVARCHAR);

    -- Amount Type Filters
    IF @AMTTYPE = '0' -- Above
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_11 > ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '1' -- Equal
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_11 = ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '2' -- Below
        SET @sqldue += ' AND I.IN_11 < ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);

    -- Continue with CTE for cumulative calculation
    SET @sqldue += '
),
CumulativeTax AS (
    -- Calculate cumulative tax amount per party
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM([TAX]) OVER (
            PARTITION BY [Party_Group] 
            ORDER BY [PROD_SORT], [PROD_UNQID]
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS CumulativeAmount
    FROM InvoiceBase
)
SELECT 
    c.[UNQID],
    c.[INVUNQID],
    c.[Party Name],
    ISNULL(l.[Ledgeramt], 0.00) AS [Ledgeramt],
    c.[Invoice No],
    DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(c.[Invoice Date]) AS [Invoice Date],
    DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(c.[Due Date]) AS [Due Date],
    c.[Invoice Amt],
    c.[Product],
    c.[PROD UNQ],
    c.[Due Amt],
    c.[BRANCH],
    DATEDIFF(DAY, c.[Invoice Date], DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(''' + @TODATE + ''')) AS [Due Days],
    0.00 AS A,
    0.00 AS B,
    0.00 AS C,
    0.00 AS D,
    0.00 AS E,
    0.00 AS [TOTAL AMOUNT],
    c.[TAX],
    c.CumulativeAmount,
    0.00 AS TDS,
    0.00 AS [TDSMDUE]
FROM CumulativeTax c
LEFT JOIN #LedgerAmountss l ON l.[UNQID] = c.[UNQID]
ORDER BY c.[BRANCH], c.[Party Name], c.[Invoice Date], c.[Due Date], c.[Invoice No]';

    -- Debug prints
    PRINT @sqldue;

    -- Create temp table for results
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable1') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #TempTable1;
    
    CREATE TABLE #TempTable1 (
        [UNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
        [INVUNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Party Name] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Ledgeramt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Invoice No] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Invoice Date] DATETIME,
        [Due Date] DATETIME,
        [Invoice Amt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Product] NVARCHAR(255),
        [PROD UNQ] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Due Amt] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Due Days] INT,
        A NUMERIC(18,2),
        B NUMERIC(18,2),
        C NUMERIC(18,2),
        D NUMERIC(18,2),
        E NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TAX] NUMERIC(18,2),
        CumulativeAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TDS] NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TDSMDUE] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );

    -- Execute dynamic SQL and populate temp table
    INSERT INTO #TempTable1 (
        [UNQID], [INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Ledgeramt], [Invoice No], [Invoice Date], 
        [Due Date], [Invoice Amt], [Product], [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt], [BRANCH], 
        [Due Days], A, B, C, D, E, [TOTAL AMOUNT], [TAX], CumulativeAmount, [TDS], [TDSMDUE]
    )
    EXEC sp_executesql @sqldue, 
        N'@TODATE NVARCHAR(10), @SELECTEDPARTIES NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDBRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDPRODUCTS NVARCHAR(MAX)', 
        @TODATE = @TODATE, 
        @SELECTEDPARTIES = @SELECTEDPARTIES, 
        @SELECTEDBRANCH = @SELECTEDBRANCH, 
        @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;

    -- Update aging buckets (A, B, C, D, E) based on due days
    UPDATE #TempTable1
    SET 
        A = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN 0 AND @TIMEDIFF THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @AGING AND @TIMEDIFF + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        B = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        C = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        D = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        E = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt]
            WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE 0 
        END,
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = [Due Amt];

    -- Initialize TDSMDUE with Due Amount
    UPDATE #TempTable1
    SET [TDSMDUE] = [Due Amt];

    -- Final result set with TDS calculation and party totals
    ;WITH PartyTotals AS (
        SELECT 
            [Party Name],
            MIN([Invoice Date]) AS ThresholdDate,
            SUM([Due Amt]) AS TotalDueAmt,
            SUM([Due Amt] - (
                CASE 
                    WHEN CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
                    THEN ROUND([TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
                    ELSE 0.00 
                END
            )) AS TOTALMTDS
        FROM #TempTable1
        GROUP BY [Party Name]
    )
    SELECT 
        t.[UNQID], 
        t.[INVUNQID], 
        t.[Party Name],
        t.[ledgeramt], 
        t.[Invoice No], 
        t.[Branch], 
        t.[Product], 
        t.[Due Amt], 
        t.[Due Date], 
        t.[Invoice Date], 
        t.[Invoice Amt], 
        t.A, 
        t.B, 
        t.C, 
        t.D, 
        t.E,
        p.TotalDueAmt,
        t.[TAX], 
        t.CumulativeAmount,
        (CASE 
            WHEN t.CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
            THEN ROUND(t.[TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
            ELSE 0.00 
        END) AS TDS,
        (t.[TDSMDUE] - (
            CASE 
                WHEN t.CumulativeAmount > 5000000 
                THEN ROUND(t.[TAX] * 0.1 / 100, 2) 
                ELSE 0.00 
            END
        )) AS [TDSMDUE],
        p.TOTALMTDS
    FROM #TempTable1 t
    INNER JOIN PartyTotals p 
        ON t.[Party Name] = p.[Party Name]  
        AND t.[Invoice Date] >= p.ThresholdDate
    ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'asc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END ASC,
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'desc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END DESC,
        CASE WHEN @sort = 'org' THEN t.[Party Name] END;

    -- Cleanup
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable1') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #TempTable1;
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LedgerAmountss') IS NOT NULL 
        DROP TABLE #LedgerAmountss;

END;




end 








GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_OUTSTANDING_SUPPLIER_REPORT]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@sort                  NVARCHAR(50)  = '',

@unqid               NVARCHAR(max)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SELECTEDSUPPLIER     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SELECTEDSCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SELECTEDPC NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SELECTEDPRODUCTS    NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SELECTEDBRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@FROMAMOUNT          NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TOAMOUNT            NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PURCHASELRCCOMBINED    NVARCHAR(max)  = '',                                              
@uid    NVARCHAR(max)  = '',
@TIMEDIFF            INT           = 0,
@AGING            INT           = 0,
@AMTTYPE    NVARCHAR(20)  = '', -- 'Above', 'Equal', 'Below'
@AMOUNT      NVARCHAR(MAX) = '' -- Comparison amount
AS
BEGIN
 IF @AA = 'BIND'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PARTY DROPDOWN (Changed on 18-06-2024)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'SUPPL' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @SELECTEDBRANCH  +'%' 
             GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
        ) AS AA
       ORDER BY Dname ASC;

        -- TABLE 1: STATE DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM205_5 AS Dname, UNQID AS UNQID 
        FROM SM205 
        ORDER BY SM205_5;

        -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname 
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;

        -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'SUPPL')
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

        -- TABLE 4: BRANCH DROPDOWN
        --SELECT SM1002_5 AS UNQID, SM1002_7 AS [BRANCH] 
        --FROM SM1002 where  SM1002_5  LIKE '%'+ @SELECTEDBRANCH  +'%' 
        --ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;

		
      declare @branch as nvarchar(max)
    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname , 1 as  ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	--union all 
	--select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  as UNQID , 'ALL' as Dname , 0 as  ord  
	--and   SM1002_5  LIKE '%'+ @SELECTEDBRANCH  +'%' 
	ORDER BY Dname ASC, ord desc;

        -- TABLE 5: PRODUCT CATEGORY DROPDOWN
        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY Dname ASC;
    END	


	   IF @AA = 'BINDACC'
    BEGIN
       
            --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'SUPPL' AND SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@unqid,',')) 
			and SM19_63  in (select data from dbo.split(@SELECTEDBRANCH,',')) 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, SM19_5
			ORDER BY Dname 

    END

    IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
    BEGIN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@unqid, ','))  
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
    END


	 IF @AA = 'OUTSTANDING'
    BEGIN
      
      
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

       DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
  SELECT [UNQID],[INVUNQID],[Party Name],[Invoice No], DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Invoice Date]) AS [Invoice Date],  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Due Date]) AS [Due Date],[Invoice Amt], [Ledgeramt],[Product], 
  [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt],[BRANCH], DATEDIFF(DAY, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Invoice Date]), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)) AS [Due Days],0.00 AS A, 0.00 AS B, 0.00 AS C, 0.00 AS D, 0.00 AS E, 0.00 AS [TOTAL AMOUNT]
        FROM (
            SELECT IN_12 AS [UNQID], unqid as [INVUNQID],
			      (SELECT SM19_5 +'',''+( SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=SM19_15) from sm19  WHERE sm19_11 = ''SUPPL'' and SM19.UNQID = IN_12)AS [Party Name],
                 
				   (IN_13) AS [Invoice No], 
                   (IN_8) AS [Invoice Date],(IN_14) AS [Due Date], 
                   abs(IN_9) AS [Invoice Amt],
				   (SELECT (sum(m3_6)) FROM m3 WHERE m3.m3_4 = IN_12 
				  and m3_23 = in_15
				   ) AS [Ledgeramt], 
				 (SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5)) AS [Product],
                   (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5) AS [PROD UNQ],
				   (SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = IN_15) AS [BRANCH],
				   IN_15 AS [BRANCHUNQ],abs(IN_11) AS [Due Amt]
                   FROM INVN WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_8) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
                   AND IN_11 <> 0 AND  IN_7 = ''PP'' ';

print @SELECTEDSUPPLIER;
print @SELECTEDSCH;


				
IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSUPPLIER, '') <> '' and @SELECTEDSUPPLIER <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

BEGIN
    SET @sql += ' AND IN_12 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDSUPPLIER, '',''))';
END
ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSCH, '') <> ''
BEGIN
    SET @sql += ' AND IN_12 IN (
        (
            SELECT unqid 
            FROM sm19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = ''SUPPL'' 
              AND SM19_7 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDSCH + ''', '',''))
        )
    )';
END


  
   

        IF @SELECTEDBRANCH IS NOT NULL AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> ''
		
     SET @sql += ' AND  IN_15 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDBRANCH, '',''))';
    

	 IF @SELECTEDPRODUCTS IS NOT NULL AND @SELECTEDPRODUCTS <> ''
		AND @SELECTEDPRODUCTS <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		begin 
     SET @sql += ' AND IN_5 IN (SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_10 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDPRODUCTS, '','')))';

     
		   end 
		   ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDPC, '') <> ''
BEGIN
    SET @sql += ' AND IN_5 IN (
    SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_10 IN (
        SELECT sm206_2
        FROM sm206
        WHERE sm206_13 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDPC + ''', '',''))
        )
    )';
END
		
				





    IF @AMTTYPE = '0'
        SET @sql += ' AND abs(IN_11) > ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --above--
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '1'
        SET @sql += ' AND abs(IN_11) = ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --equal--
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '2'
        SET @sql += ' AND abs(IN_11) < ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --below--

    SET @sql += '
        ) AS A
        ORDER BY [Party Name], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [BRANCH], [Invoice No]';

    PRINT @sql

 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TempTable;
    CREATE TABLE #TempTable (
        [UNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
		[INVUNQID] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Party Name] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Invoice No] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Invoice Date]datetime,
        [Due Date] datetime , 
        [Invoice Amt] NUMERIC(18,0),
		[Ledgeramt]  NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Product] NVARCHAR(255),
        [PROD UNQ] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Due Amt] NUMERIC(18,0),
        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Due Days] INT,
        A NUMERIC(18,2),
        B NUMERIC(18,2),
        C NUMERIC(18,2),
        D NUMERIC(18,2),
        E NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );

	



    INSERT INTO #TempTable (
        [UNQID],[INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [Invoice Amt], [Ledgeramt],
        [Product], [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt], [BRANCH], [Due Days], A, B, C, D, E, [TOTAL AMOUNT])
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql, 
         N'@TODATE NVARCHAR(10), @SELECTEDSUPPLIER NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDBRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDPRODUCTS NVARCHAR(MAX)', 
         @TODATE = @TODATE, 
         @SELECTEDSUPPLIER = @SELECTEDSUPPLIER, 
         @SELECTEDBRANCH = @SELECTEDBRANCH, 
         @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;

 UPDATE #TempTable
    SET 
        A = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN 0 AND @TIMEDIFF THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @AGING AND @TIMEDIFF + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        B = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        C = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        D = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        E = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE [TOTAL AMOUNT] + [Due Amt]
        END;

    -- Final selection from the temporary table
    --SELECT 
    --    [UNQID], [INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Branch], [Product], [Due Amt], [Due Date], [Invoice Date], [Invoice Amt],[Ledgeramt], A, B, C, D, E
    --FROM #TempTable
    --ORDER BY [Party Name], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [BRANCH], [Invoice No];

	WITH PartyTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        [Party Name],
        SUM([Due Amt]) AS TotalDueAmt
    FROM #TempTable
    GROUP BY [Party Name]
)
SELECT 
    t.[UNQID], 
    t.[INVUNQID], 
    t.[Party Name],
    t.[ledgeramt], 
    t.[Invoice No], 
    t.[Branch], 
    t.[Product], 
    t.[Due Amt], 
    t.[Due Date], 
    t.[Invoice Date], 
    t.[Invoice Amt], 
    t.A, t.B, t.C, t.D, t.E,
    p.TotalDueAmt
FROM #TempTable t
JOIN PartyTotals p ON t.[Party Name] = p.[Party Name]
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'asc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END ASC,
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'desc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END DESC,

    CASE WHEN @sort = 'org' THEN  t.[Party Name] END ;

END;




	 IF @AA = 'OUTSTANDINGDUE'
    BEGIN
          
        SELECT PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], 
               PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9), 0)) 
			 
			   AS [ADMOFFICE] 
        FROM PA;

       DECLARE @sqldue NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
  SELECT [UNQID],[INVUNQID],[Party Name],[Invoice No], DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Invoice Date]) AS [Invoice Date],  DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Due Date]) AS [Due Date],[Invoice Amt], [Ledgeramt], [Product], 
  [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt],[BRANCH], DATEDIFF(DAY, DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE([Invoice Date]), DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)) AS [Due Days],0.00 AS A, 0.00 AS B, 0.00 AS C, 0.00 AS D, 0.00 AS E, 0.00 AS [TOTAL AMOUNT]
        FROM (
            SELECT IN_12 AS [UNQID], unqid as [INVUNQID],
                   (SELECT SM19_5 +'',''+( SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=SM19_15) from sm19  WHERE sm19_11 = ''SUPPL'' and SM19.UNQID = IN_12)AS [Party Name],
				   (IN_13) AS [Invoice No], 
                   (IN_8) AS [Invoice Date],(IN_14) AS [Due Date], 
                   abs(IN_9) AS [Invoice Amt],
				   (SELECT (sum(m3_6)) FROM m3 WHERE m3.m3_4 = IN_12 and m3_23 = in_15
				   ) AS [Ledgeramt],
			  (SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5)) AS [Product],
                   (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5) AS [PROD UNQ],
				   (SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = IN_15) AS [BRANCH],
				   IN_15 AS [BRANCHUNQ],abs(IN_11) AS [Due Amt]
                   FROM INVN WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
                   AND IN_11 <> 0 AND  IN_7 = ''PP'' ';

				
IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSUPPLIER, '') <> '' and @SELECTEDSUPPLIER <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

BEGIN
    SET @sqldue += ' AND IN_12 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDSUPPLIER, '',''))';
END
ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDSCH, '') <> ''
BEGIN
    SET @sqldue += ' AND IN_12 IN (
        (
            SELECT unqid 
            FROM sm19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = ''SUPPL'' 
              AND SM19_7 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDSCH + ''', '',''))
        )
    )';
END


  
   

        IF @SELECTEDBRANCH IS NOT NULL AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @SELECTEDBRANCH <> ''
		
     SET @sqldue += ' AND  IN_15 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDBRANCH, '',''))';
    

    
	 IF @SELECTEDPRODUCTS IS NOT NULL AND @SELECTEDPRODUCTS <> ''
		AND @SELECTEDPRODUCTS <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		begin 
     SET @sqldue += ' AND IN_5 IN (SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_10 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@SELECTEDPRODUCTS, '','')))';

     
		   end 
		   ELSE IF ISNULL(@SELECTEDPC, '') <> ''
BEGIN
    SET @sqldue += ' AND IN_5 IN (
    SELECT sm1005_4 FROM SM1005 WHERE SM1005_10 IN (
        SELECT sm206_2
        FROM sm206
        WHERE sm206_13 IN (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(''' + @SELECTEDPC + ''', '',''))
        )
    )';
END
				


  
    IF @AMTTYPE = '0'
        SET @sqldue += ' AND abs(IN_11) > ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --above--
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '1'
        SET @sqldue += ' AND abs(IN_11) = ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --equal--
    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '2'
        SET @sqldue += ' AND abs(IN_11) < ' + CAST(@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR);   --below--

    SET @sqldue += '
        ) AS A
        ORDER BY [Party Name], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [BRANCH], [Invoice No]';

    PRINT @sqldue

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTable1') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TempTable1;

		[Ledgeramt]  NUMERIC(18,2),
        [Product] NVARCHAR(255),
        [PROD UNQ] NVARCHAR(36),
        [Due Amt] NUMERIC(18,0),
        [BRANCH] NVARCHAR(255),
        [Due Days] INT,
        A NUMERIC(18,2),
        B NUMERIC(18,2),
        C NUMERIC(18,2),
        D NUMERIC(18,2),
        E NUMERIC(18,2),

    --     @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;


	
	
    INSERT INTO #TempTable1 (
        [UNQID],[INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [Invoice Amt], [Ledgeramt],
        [Product], [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt], [BRANCH], [Due Days], A, B, C, D, E, [TOTAL AMOUNT])
    EXEC sp_executesql @sqldue, 
         N'@TODATE NVARCHAR(10), @SELECTEDSUPPLIER NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDBRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDPRODUCTS NVARCHAR(MAX)', 
         @TODATE = @TODATE, 
        @SELECTEDSUPPLIER = @SELECTEDSUPPLIER, 
         @SELECTEDBRANCH = @SELECTEDBRANCH, 
         @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;


		

   		    UPDATE #TempTable1
    SET 
        A = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN 0 AND @TIMEDIFF THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @AGING AND @TIMEDIFF + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        B = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        C = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        D = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        E = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE [TOTAL AMOUNT] + [Due Amt]
        END;

    -- Final selection from the temporary table
    --SELECT 
    --    [UNQID], [INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Branch], [Product], [Due Amt], [Due Date], [Invoice Date], [Invoice Amt],[Ledgeramt], A, B, C, D, E
    --FROM #TempTable1
    --ORDER BY [Party Name], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [BRANCH], [Invoice No];

		WITH PartyTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        [Party Name],
        SUM([Due Amt]) AS TotalDueAmt
    FROM #TempTable1
    GROUP BY [Party Name]
)
SELECT 
    t.[UNQID], 
    t.[INVUNQID], 
    t.[Party Name],
    t.[ledgeramt], 
    t.[Invoice No], 
    t.[Branch], 
    t.[Product], 
    t.[Due Amt], 
    t.[Due Date], 
    t.[Invoice Date], 
    t.[Invoice Amt], 
    t.A, t.B, t.C, t.D, t.E,
    p.TotalDueAmt
FROM #TempTable1 t
JOIN PartyTotals p ON t.[Party Name] = p.[Party Name]
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'asc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END ASC,
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'desc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END DESC,

    CASE WHEN @sort = 'org' THEN  t.[Party Name] END ;
END;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_OUTSTANDING_TRANSPORTER_REPORT]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',

@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',

@SELECTEDPC NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@TOAMOUNT            NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@uid NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TIMEDIFF            INT           = 0,
@AGING            INT           = 0,
@AMTTYPE    NVARCHAR(20)  = '', -- 'Above', 'Equal', 'Below'
@AMOUNT      NVARCHAR(MAX) = '' -- Comparison amount
AS
BEGIN
 IF @AA = 'BIND'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PARTY DROPDOWN (Changed on 18-06-2024)
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [PARTYNAME], 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, RTRIM(LTRIM(SM19_5)) AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM19 
            WHERE SM19_11 = 'TRANS' and SM19_63  LIKE '%'+ @SELECTEDBRANCH  +'%' 
            GROUP BY SM19.UNQID, RTRIM(LTRIM(SM19_5))
        ) AS AA
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

        -- TABLE 1: STATE DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM205_5 AS Dname, UNQID AS UNQID 
        FROM SM205 
        ORDER BY SM205_5;

        -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname 
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC;

        -- TABLE 3: SCHEDULE DROPDOWN
        SELECT * FROM (
            --SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
            --UNION ALL 
            SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS Dname, 1 AS ord 
            FROM SM44 
            WHERE unqid IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'TRANS')
        ) AS AA 
        ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;

        -- TABLE 4: BRANCH DROPDOWN

    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

	--and   SM1002_5  LIKE '%'+ @SELECTEDBRANCH  +'%' 
	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC, ord desc;

        -- TABLE 5: PRODUCT CATEGORY DROPDOWN
        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;
    END	


	     IF @AA = 'BINDACC'
    BEGIN
  

  select data  into #t from dbo.split(@SELECTEDBRANCH,',')



SELECT DISTINCT a.unqid as UNQID, a.sm19_5 as Dname
FROM sm19 A
CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitString(A.sm19_63, ',') AS aSplit
JOIN #t B
CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitString(B.data, ',') AS bSplit
ON aSplit.Value = bSplit.Value
where sm19_11='trans' and 
a.SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@unqid,','))   order by dname 


    END


    IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split( @unqid ,',')) 
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
    END


	 IF @AA = 'OUTSTANDING'

                 (IN_13) AS [Invoice No],
				   (SELECT (sum(m3_6)) FROM m3 WHERE m3.m3_4 = IN_12

                   (IN_8) AS [Invoice Date],

                   (SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5)) AS [Product],
                   (SELECT SM1005_10 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4 = INVN.IN_5) AS [PROD UNQ],
				    (SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = IN_15) AS [BRANCH],
				   IN_15 AS [BRANCHUNQ],
				   abs(IN_11) AS [Due Amt]
                   FROM INVN WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_8) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)

    ELSE IF @AMTTYPE = '2'

        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = CASE

        D NUMERIC(18,2),
        E NUMERIC(18,2),
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] NUMERIC(18,2)
    );

	

    INSERT INTO #TempTable1 (
        [UNQID],[INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [Invoice Amt], [ledgeramt], 
        [Product], [PROD UNQ], [Due Amt], [BRANCH], [Due Days], A, B, C, D, E, [TOTAL AMOUNT])
    EXEC sp_executesql @sqldue, 
         N'@TODATE NVARCHAR(10), @SELECTEDTRANSPORTER NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDBRANCH NVARCHAR(MAX), @SELECTEDPRODUCTS NVARCHAR(MAX)', 
         @TODATE = @TODATE, 
        @SELECTEDTRANSPORTER = @SELECTEDTRANSPORTER, 
         @SELECTEDBRANCH = @SELECTEDBRANCH, 
         @SELECTEDPRODUCTS = @SELECTEDPRODUCTS;


	
  UPDATE #TempTable1
    SET 
        A = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN 0 AND @TIMEDIFF THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @AGING AND @TIMEDIFF + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        B = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        C = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 2 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        D = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] BETWEEN @TIMEDIFF * 3 + @AGING + 1 AND @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        E = CASE WHEN @AGING <= 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 THEN [Due Amt] WHEN @AGING > 0 AND [Due Days] > @TIMEDIFF * 4 + @AGING THEN [Due Amt] ELSE 0 END,
        [TOTAL AMOUNT] = CASE 
            WHEN @AGING <= 0 THEN [Due Amt]
            ELSE [TOTAL AMOUNT] + [Due Amt]
        END;

    -- Final selection from the temporary table
    --SELECT 
    --    [UNQID], [INVUNQID], [Party Name], [Invoice No], [Branch], [Product], [Due Amt], [Due Date], [Invoice Date], [Invoice Amt], [ledgeramt], A, B, C, D, E
    --FROM #TempTable1
    --ORDER BY [Party Name], [Invoice Date], [Due Date], [BRANCH], [Invoice No];

		WITH PartyTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        [Party Name],
        SUM([Due Amt]) AS TotalDueAmt
    FROM #TempTable1
    GROUP BY [Party Name]
)
SELECT 
    t.[UNQID], 
    t.[INVUNQID], 
    t.[Party Name],
    t.[ledgeramt], 
    t.[Invoice No], 
    t.[Branch], 
    t.[Product], 
    t.[Due Amt], 
    t.[Due Date], 
    t.[Invoice Date], 
    t.[Invoice Amt], 
    t.A, t.B, t.C, t.D, t.E,
    p.TotalDueAmt
FROM #TempTable1 t
JOIN PartyTotals p ON t.[Party Name] = p.[Party Name]
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'asc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END ASC,
    CASE WHEN @sort = 'desc' THEN p.TotalDueAmt END DESC,

    CASE WHEN @sort = 'org' THEN  t.[Party Name] END ;
END;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_PA_Q]

@pa_47 nvarchar(20) = '',@pa_48 nvarchar(20) = '',@pa_49 nvarchar(5) = '',@pa_50 nvarchar(max) = '',

@BA_9 nvarchar(50) = '',@BA_10  nvarchar(50) = '',@BA_11 nvarchar(50) = '',@BA_12 nvarchar(50) = '',@BA_15 nvarchar(50) = '',@BA_16 nvarchar(50) = ''

AS
BEGIN

IF @AA = 'update'
BEGIN
		UPDATE PA SET pa_1  = dbo.getformatteddate(@pa_1),pa_2  = dbo.getformatteddate(@pa_2),pa_3  = @pa_3,pa_4  = @pa_4,pa_5  = @pa_5,pa_6  = @pa_6,pa_7  = @pa_7,pa_8  = @pa_8,pa_9  = @pa_9,pa_10 = @pa_10,
		pa_11 = @pa_11,pa_12 = @pa_12,pa_13 = @pa_13,pa_14 = @pa_14,pa_15 = @pa_15,pa_16 = @pa_16,pa_17 = @pa_17,pa_18 = @pa_18,pa_19 = @pa_19,pa_20 = @pa_20,pa_21 = @pa_21,pa_22 = @pa_22,pa_23 = @pa_23,pa_24 = @pa_24,
		pa_25 = @pa_25,pa_26 = @pa_26,pa_27 = @pa_27,pa_28 = @pa_28,pa_29 = @pa_29,pa_30 = @pa_30,pa_31 = @pa_31,pa_32 = @pa_32,pa_33 = @pa_33,pa_34 = @pa_34,pa_35 = @pa_35,pa_36 = @pa_36,pa_37 = @pa_37,pa_38 = @pa_38,
		pa_39 = @pa_39,pa_40 = @pa_40,pa_41 = @pa_41,pa_42 = @pa_42,pa_43 = @pa_43,pa_44 = @pa_44,pa_45 = @pa_45,pa_46 = @pa_46,pa_47 = @pa_47,pa_48 = @pa_48,pa_49 = @pa_49,pa_50 = @pa_50,pa_51 = @pa_51,pa_52 = @pa_52,
		pa_53 = @pa_53,pa_54 = @pa_54,pa_55 = @pa_55,pa_56 = @pa_56

		UPDATE BA SET BA_8 = @BA_8, BA_13 = @BA_13,BA_9 = @BA_9,BA_10 = @BA_10,BA_11 = @BA_11 ,BA_12 = @BA_12,
		BA_15 = dbo.getformatteddate(@pa_1),BA_16 = dbo.getformatteddate(@pa_2) WHERE BA_14 = @pa_35 		
END

IF @AA = 'SELECT'
BEGIN
	--SELECT * FROM PA;
	 SELECT FORMAT([PA_1],'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [PA_1],FORMAT([PA_2],'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [PA_2],[PA_3],[PA_4],[PA_5],[PA_6],[PA_7],[PA_8],[PA_9],[PA_10],[PA_11],[PA_12],[PA_13],[PA_14],[PA_15],[PA_16],[PA_17],[PA_18],[PA_19],[PA_20],[PA_21],[PA_22],
	 [PA_23],[PA_24],[PA_25],[PA_26],[PA_27],[PA_28],[PA_29],[PA_30],[PA_31],[PA_32],[PA_33],[PA_34],[PA_35],[PA_36],[pa_37],[pa_38],[pa_39],[pa_40],[pa_41],[pa_42],[pa_43],[pa_44],
	 [pa_45],[pa_46],[pa_47],[pa_48],[pa_49],[pa_50],[pa_51],[pa_52],[pa_53],[PA_54],[PA_55],[PA_56],(SELECT BA_8 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [BANK ACNAME],
	 (SELECT BA_13 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [BANK ADDRESS],(SELECT BA_9 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [BANK ACCNO],(SELECT BA_10 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [IFSC],
	 (SELECT BA_11 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [MICR],(SELECT BA_12 FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = [PA_35]) AS [BRANCH CODE] FROM [dbo].[PA]
END

IF @AA = 'BANK_BA'
BEGIN
	SELECT * FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'BB'
END

IF @AA = 'ACCOUNT'
BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5
END

IF @AA = 'STATE'
BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM SM205 ORDER BY SM205_5
END

IF @AA = 'CITY'
BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM SM01 ORDER BY SM1_5 
END

IF @AA = 'BANK_DETAILS'
BEGIN
		SELECT BA_8 AS [BANK ACNAME],BA_13 AS [BANK ADDRESS],BA_9 AS [BANK ACCNO],BA_10 AS [IFSC],BA_11 AS [MICR],BA_12 AS [BRANCH CODE],
		BA_1 AS [BOOK NO] FROM BA WHERE BA_14 = @pa_35
END

IF @AA = 'BANK_BOOK_NO'
BEGIN		
		SELECT  'B' + CAST(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(BA_1,2,5) AS NUMERIC(18,0))) +1 AS NVARCHAR(15))  AS [BOOK NO] FROM BA WHERE BA_6 = 'BB'
END

IF @AA = 'BANK_NAME'
BEGIN		
		SELECT UPPER(ZM36_1) AS [BANK NAME] FROM ZM36 ORDER BY ZM36_1
END

IF @AA = 'ADD_BANKBOOK'						--INSERT INTO BA
BEGIN	
			INSERT INTO BA VALUES(NEWID(),@BA_1,'BANK BOOK','A4/4','DEBIT',@BA_5,'BB',@BA_7,'GULJAG INFOTECH',@BA_9,@BA_10,@BA_11,@BA_12,@BA_13,
			@BA_14,'2017-04-01 00:00:00.000','2021-03-31 00:00:00.000','Q')
END

END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_SP_For_PerfomanceReport]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1002_5 nvarchar(100)='',
@groupid nvarchar(150)='',
@staffname nvarchar(100)='',
@branchid nvarchar(50)=''
as
if @what='drop'
begin
--select Account_name from  AccountMas1308 INNER JOIN GroupMas  
--ON Account_GroupId=GROUP_ID  where group_name in ('Sundry Debtors A');
--select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff, '''' + REPLACE(LTRIM(sm502_18),',', ''',''') +'''' as sm502_18
--from  sm502 as b
--inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  
select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  order by staff

end

if @what='groupname'


begin
SELECT STUFF(
    (
        SELECT ',' + sm44_7
        FROM SM44
        WHERE UNQID IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
, 1, 1, '') AS groupname;
end

if @what='branchid'


begin
SELECT sm502_21 as branchid from sm502 where sm502_4=@staffname
end




if @what='Grid_Bind'
begin

WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT  
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],

        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],

        -- Total Qty
        ID.InvDet_ProductQty

    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID with(nolock) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A  with(nolock) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM with(nolock)  ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP with(nolock) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP with(nolock) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G  with(nolock) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID

    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25') and  I.branchid=@branchid
         AND G.Group_Name IN (
    SELECT data
    FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',') 
)
)
        --AND A.Account_Name IN ('A One Dyeing (A)')


SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Product) AS unq,

    Product,
    ISNULL([2021-22], 0) AS [year2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23], 0) AS [year2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24], 0) AS [year2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25], 0) AS [year2024-25]
FROM (
    SELECT 
	
        Product,
        Financial_Year,
       SUM(InvDet_ProductQty) AS TotalQty   -- aggregate before pivot
    FROM BaseData
	 GROUP BY Product, Financial_Year
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT (
    SUM(TotalQty)
    FOR Financial_Year IN ([2021-22], [2022-23], [2023-24], [2024-25])
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY Product;






end

if @what='drop'

select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  order by staff

end

if @what='groupname'


begin
SELECT STUFF(
    (
        SELECT ',' + sm44_7
        FROM SM44
        WHERE UNQID IN (
            SELECT data

        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
, 1, 1, '') AS groupname;
end

if @what='branchid'


begin
SELECT sm502_21 as branchid from sm502 where sm502_4=@staffname
end




if @what='Grid_Bind'
begin




WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT 
        PM.Product_PrintName AS [Product],
        I.invoice_grossamt,
        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],
        ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22','2022-23','2023-24','2024-25')
        AND I.branchid=@branchid
        AND G.Group_Name IN (
            SELECT data
            FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5,',') 
        )
),
AggData AS (
    SELECT 
        Product,
        Financial_Year,
        SUM(invoice_grossamt) AS GrossAmount,
        SUM(InvDet_ProductQty) AS TotalQty
    FROM BaseData
    GROUP BY Product, Financial_Year
)
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Product) AS unq,
    Product,
    ISNULL([2021-22_Qty],0) AS [Qty2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Qty],0) AS [Qty2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Qty],0) AS [Qty2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Qty],0) AS [Qty2024-25],
    ISNULL([2021-22_Amt],0) AS [Amt2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Amt],0) AS [Amt2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Amt],0) AS [Amt2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Amt],0) AS [Amt2024-25]
FROM (
    SELECT 
        Product,
        Financial_Year + '_Qty' AS ColName,
        TotalQty AS Value
    FROM AggData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Product,
        Financial_Year + '_Amt' AS ColName,
        GrossAmount AS Value
    FROM AggData
) d
PIVOT (
    SUM(Value) FOR ColName IN (
        [2021-22_Qty],[2022-23_Qty],[2023-24_Qty],[2024-25_Qty],
        [2021-22_Amt],[2022-23_Amt],[2023-24_Amt],[2024-25_Amt]
    )
) p
ORDER BY Product;


--WITH BaseData AS (

       -- Financial Year Calculation
       CASE 
           WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
               THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
           ELSE 
               CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
       END AS [Financial_Year],

       ID.InvDet_ProductQty
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25','2025-26')
        AND I.branchid = @branchid
        AND G.Group_Name IN (
            SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',')
        )
),
-- First, get total quantity per customer, product, year
CustomerProductYear AS (
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Product,
        Financial_Year,
        SUM(ID.InvDet_ProductQty) AS TotalQty
    FROM BaseData ID
    GROUP BY account_name, Product, Financial_Year
),
-- Then, get Max and Min product quantity per customer per year
CustomerYearSummary AS (
    SELECT
        account_name,
        Financial_Year,
        MAX(TotalQty) AS MaxQty,
        MIN(TotalQty) AS MinQty
    FROM CustomerProductYear
    GROUP BY account_name, Financial_Year
)
-- Finally, pivot the Max and Min values year-wise per customer
SELECT  
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY account_name) AS unq,
    account_name,
    ISNULL([2021-22_Max], 0) AS [Max_2021-22],
    ISNULL([2021-22_Min], 0) AS [Min_2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Max], 0) AS [Max_2022-23],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Min], 0) AS [Min_2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Max], 0) AS [Max_2023-24],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Min], 0) AS [Min_2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Max], 0) AS [Max_2024-25],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Min], 0) AS [Min_2024-25],
	ISNULL([2024-25_Min], 0) AS [Min_2025-26]
FROM (
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Financial_Year + '_Max' AS ColName,
        MaxQty AS Qty
    FROM CustomerYearSummary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Financial_Year + '_Min' AS ColName,
        MinQty AS Qty
    FROM CustomerYearSummary
) AS Source
PIVOT (
    MAX(Qty)
    FOR ColName IN (
        [2021-22_Max],[2021-22_Min],
        [2022-23_Max],[2022-23_Min],
        [2023-24_Max],[2023-24_Min],
        [2024-25_Max],[2024-25_Min],
		 [2025-26_Max],[2025-26_Min]
    )
) AS Pivoted
ORDER BY account_name;







end

Create procedure [dbo].[A_SP_For_PerfomanceReport_withminmaxamount]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1002_5 nvarchar(100)='',
@groupid nvarchar(150)='',
@staffname nvarchar(100)='',
@branchid nvarchar(50)=''
as
if @what='drop'
begin
--select Account_name from  AccountMas1308 INNER JOIN GroupMas  
--ON Account_GroupId=GROUP_ID  where group_name in ('Sundry Debtors A');
--select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff, '''' + REPLACE(LTRIM(sm502_18),',', ''',''') +'''' as sm502_18
--from  sm502 as b
--inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  
select b.unqid,sm1002_7 as branch, sm502_4 as staff,  sm502_18
from  sm502 as b
inner join SM1002 as c  on c.sm1002_5=b.SM502_16  order by staff

end

if @what='groupname'


begin
SELECT STUFF(
    (
        SELECT ',' + sm44_7
        FROM SM44
        WHERE UNQID IN (
            SELECT data 
            FROM dbo.split(@groupid, ',')
        )
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
, 1, 1, '') AS groupname;
end

if @what='branchid'


begin
SELECT sm502_21 as branchid from sm502 where sm502_4=@staffname
end




if @what='Grid_Bind'
begin

WITH BaseData AS ( 
    SELECT  
        A.account_name,
        PM.product_PrintName AS [Product],
        -- Financial Year Calculation
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2)
        END AS [Financial_Year],
        I.invoice_grossamt
    FROM Invoice1308 I
    INNER JOIN InvDet1308 ID WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_Id = ID.InvDet_InvoiceId
    INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 A WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.Invoice_PartyId = A.Account_Id
    INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 PM WITH (NOLOCK) ON ID.InvDet_ProductId = PM.Product_Id
    INNER JOIN oldproductmaster OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON OP.Product_name = PM.Product_name
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 PP WITH (NOLOCK) ON PP.sm206_7 = OP.Newproductmaster
    INNER JOIN GroupMas G WITH (NOLOCK) ON Account_GroupId = G.GROUP_ID
    WHERE 
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(I.Invoice_Date) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2)
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(I.Invoice_Date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2)
            END
        ) IN ('2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24', '2024-25')
        AND I.branchid = @branchid
        AND G.Group_Name IN (
            SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SM1002_5, ',')
        )
),
-- Step 1: Sum of gross amount per customer, product, and financial year
CustomerProductYear AS (
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Product,
        Financial_Year,
        SUM(invoice_grossamt) AS TotalGrossAmt
    FROM BaseData
    GROUP BY account_name, Product, Financial_Year
),
-- Step 2: For each customer and year, find max and min product totals
CustomerYearSummary AS (
    SELECT
        account_name,
        Financial_Year,
        MAX(TotalGrossAmt) AS MaxAmt,
        MIN(TotalGrossAmt) AS MinAmt
    FROM CustomerProductYear
    GROUP BY account_name, Financial_Year
)
-- Step 3: Pivot year-wise min & max per customer
SELECT  
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY account_name) AS unq,
    account_name,
    ISNULL([2021-22_Max], 0) AS [Max_2021-22],
    ISNULL([2021-22_Min], 0) AS [Min_2021-22],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Max], 0) AS [Max_2022-23],
    ISNULL([2022-23_Min], 0) AS [Min_2022-23],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Max], 0) AS [Max_2023-24],
    ISNULL([2023-24_Min], 0) AS [Min_2023-24],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Max], 0) AS [Max_2024-25],
    ISNULL([2024-25_Min], 0) AS [Min_2024-25]
FROM (
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Financial_Year + '_Max' AS ColName,
        MaxAmt AS Amt
    FROM CustomerYearSummary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        account_name,
        Financial_Year + '_Min' AS ColName,
        MinAmt AS Amt
    FROM CustomerYearSummary
) AS Source
PIVOT (
    MAX(Amt)
    FOR ColName IN (
        [2021-22_Max],[2021-22_Min],
        [2022-23_Max],[2022-23_Min],
        [2023-24_Max],[2023-24_Min],
        [2024-25_Max],[2024-25_Min]
    )
) AS Pivoted
ORDER BY account_name;









end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_PRODUCT_OPENING]
    
	--PARENT TABLE [SM1023]

    @WHAT NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@uid nvarchar(50) = '',
	@UNQ NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@name NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@branch nvarchar(50) = '',
    @SM1023_1 DATETIME = '',
	@SM1023_2 DATETIME = '',
	@UNQID NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@SM1023_4 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Branch 
	@SM1023_5 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Date
	@SM1023_6 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Warehouse
	@SM1023_7 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Warehouse Location
    @SM1023_8 NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM1023_9 NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM1023_10 NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM1023_11 NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM1023_12 NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM1023_13 NVARCHAR(100)='',

	--CHILD TABLE [SM1023_C]

	@SM1023_C1 DATETIME = '',
	@SM1023_C2 DATETIME = '',
	--@UNQID NVARCHAR(100) ='',
	@SM1023_C4 NVARCHAR(100) ='',
	@SM1023_C5 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Parent Unqid
	@SM1023_C6 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Product unqid
	@SM1023_C7 NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --Product Name
    @SM1023_C8 NVARCHAR(100)='',     --Opening 1
	@SM1023_C9 NVARCHAR(100)='',     --Opening 2
	@SM1023_C10 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Min Level
	@SM1023_C11 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Max Level
	@SM1023_C12 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Recorder Level
	@SM1023_C13 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Lead Time
	@SM1023_C14 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Sales days
	@SM1023_C15 NVARCHAR(100)='',    --Rate

	@whlocation nvarchar(50) = ''
AS
 
 IF @WHAT = 'BRANCH'
    BEGIN
	select sm1002_5 as unqid, sm1002_7 as branch from sm1002

	select unqid as unqid, sm1006_5 as warehouse from sm1006

    --SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
    --UNION ALL 
    --SELECT sm1002_5 AS [UNQID],sm1002_7 AS [BRANCH],1 as ord  FROM SM1002) 
    --AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[BRANCH] ASC;

    --set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	--select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Branch, 1 as ord  from SM1002 
	--where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	--UNION ALL
	--SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS unqid, 'All' AS Branch ,0 as ord 
	--ORDER BY ORD ASC;
	--ORDER BY SM1002_7
    END

	if @what = 'location'
	begin
		select unqid as unqid, sm1006_c7 as warehouseloc from sm1006_c where sm1006_c5 = @whlocation
	end

	IF @WHAT ='INSERT'
	BEGIN
	set @uid = NEWID();
	      INSERT INTO SM1023(SM1023_1,SM1023_2,UNQID,SM1023_4,SM1023_5,SM1023_6,SM1023_7,SM1023_8,SM1023_9,SM1023_10,SM1023_11,SM1023_12,SM1023_13)
		  VALUES(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@uid,@SM1023_4, @SM1023_5, @SM1023_6, @SM1023_7, @SM1023_8, @SM1023_9, @SM1023_10,@SM1023_11,@SM1023_12,@SM1023_13);

	select @uid as punqid
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM1023 SET
		SM1023_4 = @sm1023_4,
		SM1023_5 = @SM1023_5,
		SM1023_6 = @SM1023_6,
		SM1023_7 = @SM1023_7 WHERE UNQID = @UID
	END

    IF @WHAT ='INSERT_C'
	BEGIN
	 	  INSERT INTO SM1023_C (SM1023_C1, SM1023_C2, UNQID, SM1023_C4,SM1023_C5, SM1023_C6, SM1023_C7, SM1023_C8, SM1023_C9, SM1023_C10, SM1023_C11, SM1023_C12, SM1023_C13, SM1023_C14, SM1023_C15)
		  VALUES(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), NEWID(), @SM1023_C4, @SM1023_C5, @SM1023_C6, @SM1023_C7, @SM1023_C8, @SM1023_C9, @SM1023_C10, @SM1023_C11, @SM1023_C12, @SM1023_C13, @SM1023_C14, @SM1023_C15);

	END

	IF @WHAT ='GRID'
	BEGIN
	      SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS PRODUCT_NAME, '' as Opening1, '' as Opening2, '' as Min_Level, '' as Max_Level, '' as Reorder_Level, '' as Lead_Time, '' as Sales_Days, '' as Rate 
		  FROM SM206 order by sm206_7 asc
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'BINDGRID'
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = SM1023_4) AS BRANCH, FORMAT(CAST(SM1023_5 AS DATETIME), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE], (SELECT SM1006_5 FROM SM1006 WHERE SM1006.UNQID = SM1023_6) AS WAREHOUSE, (SELECT SM1006_c7 FROM SM1006_C WHERE SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7) AS WHLOCATION FROM SM1023
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM1023 WHERE UNQID = @UNQ

		DELETE FROM SM1023_C WHERE SM1023_C5 = @UNQ
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'SEARCH'
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, sm1002_7 AS BRANCH, FORMAT(CAST(SM1023_5 AS DATETIME), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE], (SELECT SM1006_5 FROM SM1006 WHERE SM1006.UNQID = SM1023_6) AS WAREHOUSE, (SELECT SM1006_c7 FROM SM1006_C WHERE SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7) AS WHLOCATION FROM SM1023 INNER JOIN SM1002 ON sm1002_5 = SM1023_6 WHERE sm1002_7 LIKE '%' + @name + '%'
	END

	IF @WHAT = 'BIND'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM1023_4 AS BRANCH, FORMAT(CAST(SM1023_5 AS DATETIME), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE], SM1023_6 AS WAREHOUSE, SM1023_7 AS WHLOCATION FROM SM1023 WHERE UNQID = @UID

	    SELECT SM1023_C6 AS UNQID, SM1023_C7 AS PRODUCT_NAME, SM1023_C8 as Opening1, SM1023_C9 as Opening2, SM1023_C10 as Min_Level, SM1023_C11 as Max_Level, SM1023_C12 as Reorder_Level, SM1023_C14 as Lead_Time, SM1023_C15 as Sales_Days, SM1023_C13 as Rate FROM SM1023_C LEFT JOIN sm206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1023_C.SM1023_C6 where sm1023_c5 = @uid order by SM1023_C7 asc

	END


--alter table sm1023_c add SM1023_c14 numeric(18,2), SM1023_c15 numeric(18,2)
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_PRODUCTMASTER]
@what     nvarchar(15)='',
@e_1  nvarchar(50)='',----EnteyDate
@e_2  nvarchar(50)='',----Unqid
@e_3  nvarchar(50)='',----Userid
@e_4  nvarchar(50)='',----Ipadd
@e_5  nvarchar(50)='',----ModifyDate
@e_6  nvarchar(50)='',----PRODUCT CODE
@e_7  nvarchar(50)='',----PRODUCT NAME
@e_8  nvarchar(50)='',----PRODUCT USE IN INDUSTRIES
@e_9  nvarchar(50)='',----PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
@e_10 nvarchar(50)='',----GST CODE
@e_11 nvarchar(50)='',----PURCHASE UNIT
@e_12 nvarchar(50)='',----SALE UNIT
@e_13 nvarchar(50)='',----CATEGORY
@e_14 nvarchar(50)='',----ACCOUNT HEAD
@e_15 nvarchar(50)='',----HSN/SAC
@e_16 nvarchar(50)='',----CESS
@e_17 nvarchar(50)='',----CONVERSION FACTOR
@e_18 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_19 numeric(18,2)=0,----
@e_20 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_21 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_22 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_23 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_24 nvarchar(50)='',----
@e_25 nvarchar(50)='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' ,----market date



@e_c_1  NVARCHAR(50)='',---ENTRY DATE
@e_c_2  NVARCHAR(50)='',---UNQID
@e_c_3  NVARCHAR(50)='',---USERID
@e_c_4  NVARCHAR(50)='',---IPADDRESS
@e_c_5  NVARCHAR(50)='',---MODIFYDATE
@e_c_6  NVARCHAR(50)='',---PARENT UNQID
@e_c_7  NVARCHAR(50)='', ---MANUFACTURE UNQID
@SM1020_5			NVARCHAR(50)='',					--PRODUCT
@SM1020_6			NVARCHAR(50)=''	,					--SELECTED PRODUCT
@SM1020_4			NVARCHAR(50)='',
@likeclause as nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as nvarchar(50) =''
AS
DECLARE  @UNQID AS NVARCHAR(36)
DECLARE @SM1020 TABLE (
    SM1020_1 datetime,	   -- ENTER DATE
    SM1020_2 datetime,	   -- MODIFY DATE
    SM1020_3 nvarchar(20),   -- USER ID
    UNQID1 nvarchar(50),	   -- PKEY
    SM1020_100 nvarchar(200), -- IP
    SM1020_4 nvarchar(200),
    SM1020_6 nvarchar(100)
);
BEGIN
if @what = 'insert'
BEGIN 
IF @e_19=0
BEGIN
SET @e_19 = '0' 
END
	SET  @UNQID = NEWID()
	INSERT INTO Enq_3 values(dbo.entrydate(),@UNQID,@e_3,@e_4,getdate(),@e_6,@e_7,@e_8,@e_9,@e_10,@e_11,@e_12,@e_13,
	@e_14,@e_15,@e_16,@e_17,@e_18, cast(@e_19 as numeric(18,2)) ,@e_20,@e_21,@e_22,@e_23,@e_24,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@e_25))

	select @UNQID as PUNQID from Enq_3
END

IF @what = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO Enq_3_c VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@e_c_3,@e_c_4,getdate(),@e_c_6,@e_c_7)
END
--START SM1020
IF @what='INSERT_C'
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM1020]
			([SM1020_1],[SM1020_2],[SM1020_3],[UNQID],[SM1020_4],[SM1020_5])VALUES
			(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @e_3, NEWID(), @e_4, @SM1020_5)
END

IF @What = 'DELETEGRIDD'
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM SM1020 WHERE SM1020_4=@SM1020_4
END
IF @What='GRID_UPDATE'   --GRID UPDATE
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM1020]
			([SM1020_1],[SM1020_2],[SM1020_3],[UNQID],[SM1020_4],[SM1020_5])VALUES
			(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @e_3, NEWID(), @e_4, @SM1020_5)
END
--END SM1020
IF @What='GRID_BINDD' --BIND AT EDIT
BEGIN
SELECT sm19.unqid,  SM19_5 AS customer 
FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM1020 ON SM19.unqid=SM1020.SM1020_5 WHERE SM1020_4=@SM1020_4
END

IF @what = 'Update'
BEGIN
IF @e_19=0
BEGIN
SET @e_19 = '0' 
END
		UPDATE Enq_3 SET e_5=DBO.ENTRYDATE(),e_6 =@e_6,
		e_7 =@e_7,e_8 =@e_8 ,e_9 =@e_9 ,e_10=@e_10
		,e_11=@e_11,e_12=@e_12,e_13=@e_13,e_14=@e_14
		,e_15=@e_15,e_16=@e_16,e_17=@e_17,e_18=@e_18,
		e_19=@e_19,e_20=@e_20,e_21=@e_21,e_22=@e_22,
		e_23=@e_23,e_24=@e_24,e_25=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@e_25) 
		WHERE unqid=@e_2;
		select * from Enq_3
END


IF @what = 'SelectById'
BEGIN
		SELECT unqid AS UNQID,e_6 AS [PRODUCT CODE],e_7 AS [PRODUCT NAME],e_8 AS [PRODUCT INDUST],
		e_9 AS [PRODUCT DESC],e_10 AS [GST],
		e_11 AS [PURUNIT],e_12 AS [SALEUNIT] ,e_13 AS [CATEGORY],e_14 AS [PURACCHEAD] ,e_15 AS HSNSAC,
		e_17 AS [CONVERSION],e_18 AS [CHK_QTY],
		e_16 AS [CESS],e_19 AS [TOLERANCE],e_20 AS [EXPIERY],e_21 AS [BATCH], e_22 AS [SEALNO], e_23 AS [PRODUCTTYPE], 
		e_24 AS [SALEACCHEAD] FROM Enq_3 where unqid=@e_2;
END

if @what = 'MANUFGRID'
BEGIN
Select e_c_7 AS MFUNQID,(SELECT SM113_6 FROM SM113 WHERE UNQID=e_c_7) AS 
MANUFACTURING from Enq_3_c WHERE e_c_6=@e_c_6 order by e_c_7; 
END
if @what = 'CUSTOMER'
Begin
  select '' as  unqid, '' as CUSTOMER
End

if @what = 'dropbind'
Begin
  select unqid,sm19_5 from sm19
End


if @what = 'SUPPLIERGRID'
BEGIN
Select '' AS MID,'' AS MNAME,'' AS SUPPLIER
END	

if @what = 'DELETEROW'
BEGIN
DELETE FROM enq_3_c WHERE e_c_7=@e_c_2
END
   
if @what = 'SelectAll'
BEGIN
Select * from Enq_3 order by e_7; 
END

 if @what = 'TaxHead'
BEGIN
	  --Select * from sm19; 
	  SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM210_6 AS GSTDESC,SM210_7 AS GST FROM SM210 ORDER BY SM210_7; 
END

if @what = 'CESS'
BEGIN
	  --Select * from sm19; 
	  --SELECT SM211_4 AS UNQID, SM211_6 AS CESSPER FROM SM211; 
	  SELECT SM211_4 AS UNQID, SM211_7 AS CESSPER FROM SM211 ORDER BY SM211_7
END

if @what = 'CATEGORY'
BEGIN
	  --Select * from sm19; 
	  SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS CATEGORY FROM SM17 ORDER BY SM17_6; 
END

if @what = 'ACCHEAD'
BEGIN
	  --Select * from sm19; 
	  SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_6 AS ACCHEAD FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_6; 
END

if @what = 'MANUFACT'
BEGIN
	Select UNQID AS UNQID, SM113_6  from sm113 ORDER BY SM113_6
END

if @what = 'Unit1'
BEGIN
Select * from sm209; 
END

if @what = 'Unit2'
BEGIN
Select * from sm209; 
END

IF @what = 'DISPLAYGRID'
BEGIN
		SELECT unqid AS UNQID,e_6 AS PRODUCTCODE,e_7 AS PRODUCTNAME,e_9 AS PRODUCTDESC FROM Enq_3
		ORDER BY e_7
END

IF @what = 'SEARCHGRID'
BEGIN
		SELECT unqid AS UNQID,e_6 AS PRODUCTCODE,e_7 AS PRODUCTNAME,e_9 AS PRODUCTDESC FROM enq_3 
		WHERE e_7 LIKE '%' +@e_7+ '%' ORDER BY e_7
END

IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM Enq_3 WHERE unqid=@e_2;
		DELETE FROM enq_3_c WHERE e_c_6=@e_2;
END
IF @what = 'view'
BEGIN
	
		
				--TABLE 0
	DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT
	 
	SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
	SET @RowspPage = 10
	

		SELECT unqid AS UNQID,e_6 AS PRODUCTCODE,e_7 AS PRODUCTNAME,e_9 AS PRODUCTDESC FROM enq_3
		ORDER BY e_7
	
	OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
	FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;
			
			--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS PRODUCTCODE,'' AS PRODUCTNAME,'' AS PRODUCTDESC
END
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @what ='SearchByAlphabet'
BEGIN 
  
	--jeet
		--TABLE 0
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10

	
	    SELECT unqid AS UNQID,e_6 AS PRODUCTCODE,e_7 AS PRODUCTNAME,e_9 AS PRODUCTDESC FROM enq_3 
		WHERE e_7 LIKE'%' +@likeclause+ '%'   ORDER BY e_7 asc

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;	

		--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS PRODUCTCODE,'' AS PRODUCTNAME,'' AS PRODUCTDESC
end

IF @what = 'PageCount'
begin
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM206),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
end

IF @what = 'PageCountLIKE'
begin

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from Enq_3 WHERE e_7 like '%' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
				   SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
end

	if @what='CAT_Droplist'
	Begin
		select unqid, SM19_5 AS Customer from SM19 WHERE SM19_11 ='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5
	End
end


GO

INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM1020]

			(GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @sm206_3, NEWID(), @sm206_4, @SM1020_5)

BEGIN
SELECT sm19.unqid,  SM19_5 AS customer

BEGIN

		--IF (@sm206_19 = ''  OR @sm206_20 = ''  OR @sm206_21 = ''  OR @sm206_22='')

IF @what = 'PageCount'
begin
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM206),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
end

IF @what = 'PageCountLIKE'
begin

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM206 WHERE SM206_7 like '%' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
				   SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
end

	if @what='CAT_Droplist'
	Begin
		select unqid, SM19_5 AS Customer from SM19 WHERE SM19_11 ='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5
	End
	
	if @what='Userdetails'
	begin 
	  select unqid, sm63_6 as [user] from sm63
	end

	if @what='saveUser'
	begin
	  	INSERT INTO SM206_c_c1 VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@sm206_C_3,NEWID(),@sm206_C_100,@sm206_C_4,@sm206_C_5)
	end

	if @what='userbind'
	begin 
		SELECT s.data AS unqid,m.SM63_6 as [user] FROM SM206_c_c1 c
		CROSS APPLY dbo.split(c.SM206_c_5, ',') s
		LEFT JOIN SM63 m ON m.unqid = s.data
		WHERE c.SM206_c_5 = (select SM206_c_5 from SM206_c_c1 where sm206_c_4=@sm206_c_4)

	end
end

	   SM1005_45 AS RECEIPTQTY,
	   (SELECT SM1015_5 FROM SM1015 where UNQID = SM1005_55 ) AS FREIGHT,
	   SM1005_56 AS FREIGHTRATE,
       (select SM19_5 from sm19 where UNQID = SM1005_11 AND SM19_11='SUPPL' )  AS SUPPLIER,
	   (SELECT SM19_6  FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11='TRANS' AND UNQID = sm1005_16 )AS TRANSPORTER
	   FROM sm1005 where  sm1005_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE and  @TODATE AND sm1005_21 = @sm1005_21
	  AND SM1005_74 IS not NULL

	  ----------------------TABLE1----------------------
	 SELECT '' AS [@sm1005_21] ,'No Record Found' AS [CODE]
END		


IF @WHAT = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN 
  --declare @branch as nvarchar(max)
    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Branch from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7
END


if @WHAT='Cesson'
begin
SELECT SM206_16 AS CESSUNQID, sm206_7 AS PRODUCT, SM211_6 AS CESS, sm211_100 AS CESSON FROM SM206
INNER JOIN sm211 ON sm206.sm206_16=SM211.SM211_4 WHERE sm206_2=@PRODUCT

SELECT SM19_69 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=@SM1005_11

end

-----------BRANCH TRANSFER------------
IF @what='BRANCHTRANSFER'
BEGIN
SELECT sm19_23 as GST FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=@sm1005_11

SELECT PA_17 AS COMPGST FROM PA

SELECT upper(UNQID )AS VALUE, SM210_6 AS GSTDESC,SM210_7 AS GSTPER FROM SM210 WHERE SM210_6= 'BRANCH TRANSFER' ; 
END


-------GR NO ON BASIS OF BRANCH---------
IF @WHAT='GETGRNO'
BEGIN

from sm1005 
inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_11

END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @WHAT = 'ALL_DDR'
BEGIN

 SET @branch = (SELECT sm63_12 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT 
SM1002_5 AS VALUE,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH from   SM1002 WHERE  sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
--union all

ORDER BY SM1002_7 ;


	SELECT

	   (SELECT sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = sm1005_21 ) AS BRANCH,

	 
	   (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 =SM1005_10 ) as PRODUCT ,
		  SM1005_45 AS [RPT QTY],

	     SM1005_30  as RATE ,
	   (SELECT SM210_7  from sm210  where UNQID =  sm1005_32)    as GSTPER,
	   sm1005_33    as GSTAMT,
	   sm1005_36  as NETAMT,  
	   sm1005_51  as TAXABLEAMT,
       SM1005_22 AS STRENGTH,
	  
	   (SELECT SM1015_5 FROM SM1015 where UNQID = SM1005_55 ) AS FREIGHT,
	   SM1005_56 AS FREIGHTRATE
      
	   FROM sm1005 where  
	   sm1005_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE and  @TODATE 
	   AND  sm1005_21 = @sm1005_21 and
	  SM1005_74 IS not NULL

end

	  IF @WHAT = 'ALL_DDRR'
BEGIN

 SET @branch = (SELECT sm63_12 FROM sm63 WHERE sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT 
SM1002_5 AS VALUE,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH from   SM1002 WHERE  sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
--union all 
--SELECT 
--SM1002_5 AS VALUE,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 2 AS ord  FROM   SM1002 WHERE  sm1002_5 =@sm1005_21
ORDER BY SM1002_7 ;


	SELECT 
	--sm1005_4 As UNQID,
	  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SM1005_6, 105)  AS [RPT DATE],   
	   SM1005_74 as [RPT NO] ,
	   --(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = SM1005_21) as BRANCH,
	    (select SM19_5 from sm19 where UNQID = SM1005_11 AND SM19_11='SUPPL' )  AS SUPPLIER,
	   (SELECT SM19_6  FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11='TRANS' AND UNQID = sm1005_16 )AS TRANSPORTER,
	   (SELECT sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 = sm1005_21 ) AS BRANCH,

	 
	   (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 =SM1005_10 ) as PRODUCT ,
		  SM1005_45 AS [RPT QTY],

	     SM1005_30  as RATE ,
	   (SELECT SM210_7  from sm210  where UNQID =  sm1005_32)    as GSTPER,
	   sm1005_33    as GSTAMT,
	   sm1005_36  as NETAMT,  
	   sm1005_51  as TAXABLEAMT,
       SM1005_22 AS STRENGTH,
	  
	   (SELECT SM1015_5 FROM SM1015 where UNQID = SM1005_55 ) AS FREIGHT,
	   SM1005_56 AS FREIGHTRATE
      
	   FROM sm1005 
	   where  
	  sm1005_6 BETWEEN @FROMDATE and  @TODATE 
	  AND  sm1005_21 in (SELECT DATA FROM DBO.SPLIT(@sm1005_21, ',')) and
	  SM1005_74 IS not NULL

END
