    WHERE sm206_7 = @sp
	 AND sm1008_24 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
      AND SM1011_6 = @fromdate   and sm1011_74='TAXABLE SALE'
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_2,
        sm1002.sm1002_7,
        sm19.sm19_5,
        sm206_7,
        SM1011_6,
        SM1011_7,
        SM1011_41,
        SM1008_24


    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    UNION ALL
    --------------------------------------------------------------------

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3️⃣ Grouped GR Data + Monthly Discount
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        --sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
		(case when SM1005_42 ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then '' else 
        (SELECT  sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = SM1005_42) end ) AS [GR for CUST],
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        FORMAT(SM1011_6, 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        SUM(CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3))) AS SELLQTY,
        AVG(SM1011_19 * 1000) AS SELLINGRATE,
        SUM(SM1005_57) AS GRQTY,
        SUM(SM1011_24) AS SALEAMT,
		 
		 SM1005_24 as [BASIC],
		  (SM1005_25) as [CASHDISC],
		 SM1005_28 as [FREIGHT] ,
		 SM1005_27 as [PKG CHARGE],
		 SM1005_83 AS  [RAIL FREIGHT],
        (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS COST,
      -- (SM1005_24 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS NCOST,
        (SM1005_25) AS INVNDISC,

        ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(sm_401_c_8)
            FROM sm_401_c
            INNER JOIN sm_401 ON SM_401.SM_401_5 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_6
            WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN sm_401_6 AND sm_401_7
              AND sm1005_42 = sm_401_11
              AND sm1005_10 = sm_401_c_7
        ),0) AS DiscountByMonth,

        ISNULL((
            SELECT  CAST(sm_402_c7 AS NUMERIC(18,2))
            FROM sm_402 
            INNER JOIN sm_402_c ON sm_402.unqid = sm_402_c4
            WHERE sm_402_7 = SM1005_10
              AND SUM(SM1005_57) BETWEEN 
                  CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AND 
                  CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT)
        ), 0) *
        SUM(CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3))) AS DiscountByQuantityRange

    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1011_10
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID = SM206_C.SM206_C7
    JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C1 = SM1008.UNQID
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4

    WHERE sm206_7 = @sp
	 AND sm1008_24 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
      AND SM1011_6 = @fromdate
	    and sm1011_74='TAXABLE SALE'
    GROUP BY 
        sm1005.SM1005_10,
        sm1005.SM1005_42,
        sm1005.SM1005_6,
        SM1011_6,
        sm206.sm206_2,
        sm206.sm206_7,
        sm1002.sm1002_7,
        sm19.sm19_5,
        SM1011.sm1011_6,
        SM1011.sm1011_19,
        sm1005.SM1005_24,
        sm1005.SM1005_25,
        sm1005.SM1005_27,
        sm1005.SM1005_28,
        sm1005.SM1005_83,
        sm1005.SM1005_57,
        SM1011_41,
        SM1005_10,
		sm1011_7
) AS SourceData;



IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#yyyy') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #yyyy;

SELECT
branch,
    CUSTNAME AS [Customer],
	INVNO,
    [GR for CUST] AS [GR For Customer],
    PRODUCT,
    INVDATE,
	SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    CAST(SUM(SELLINGRATE * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [Selling Rate],
    SUM(SALEAMT) AS [Sale Amount],
    SUM([BASIC]) AS [Basic],
    SUM([FREIGHT]) AS [Freight],
    SUM([PKG CHARGE]) AS [Packing Charge],
    SUM([CASHDISC]) AS [Cash Discount],
   -- SUM([INVNDISC]) AS [Invoice Discount],
    SUM([RAIL FREIGHT]) AS [Rail Freight],
    SUM([COST]) AS [Cost],
  --  SUM([NCOST]) AS [NCOST],
    SUM([DiscountByMonth]) AS [Monthly Disc Amt],
    SUM([DiscountByQuantityRange]) AS [Qty Disc Amt],

    -- ✅ Total Discount = Monthly + Qty + Invoice Discount
    (SUM([DiscountByMonth]) + SUM([DiscountByQuantityRange])) AS [TOTAL DISC],

    -- ✅ Cost after Discount (weighted by quantity)
    (SUM([COST] * [SELLQTY]) / NULLIF(SUM([SELLQTY]), 0))
        - ((SUM([DiscountByMonth] * [SELLQTY]) / NULLIF(SUM([SELLQTY]), 0))
        + SUM([DiscountByQuantityRange])) AS [COST Discounted],

    -- ✅ Selling Value & Average Selling Price
    SUM([SELLINGRATE] * [SELLQTY]) AS [SELL VALUE],
    CAST(SUM([SELLINGRATE] * [SELLQTY]) / NULLIF(SUM([SELLQTY]), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [SELL PR]

INTO #yyyy
FROM #SalesCTEE
GROUP BY
    INVDATE,
    PRODUCT,
    CUSTNAME,
    [GR for CUST],branch,INVNO

-- ============================================================
--SELECT * FROM #yyyy ORDER BY [Customer], [GR For Customer], INVDATE;



-- Add columns
ALTER TABLE #yyyy ADD 
   -- DISC NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    CONT_PR NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    CONTRIBUTION NUMERIC(18,0) DEFAULT 0,
    --COSTORIGINAL NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
	PROFIT NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0;

-- Save original cost
--UPDATE yyy 
--SET 
--     DISC = ISNULL(DiscountByMonth, 0),
--    COST = COST - ISNULL(DiscountByMonth, 0)
--FROM #yyy AS yyy;



-- Final calculations
UPDATE #yyyy 
SET 
    CONT_PR = CAST([SELL PR] - [COST Discounted] AS NUMERIC(18,2)),
    CONTRIBUTION = CAST(QTY * ([SELL PR] -  [COST Discounted]) AS NUMERIC(18,0));
	
UPDATE #yyyy
SET 
   
    PROFIT = CAST((CONTRIBUTION /[SELL VALUE]) * 100 AS NUMERIC(18,2));


	SELECT * FROM #yyyy ORDER BY [Customer], [GR For Customer], INVDATE;


end
END

if @aa='ALL_DDD'



BEGIN 
DECLARE @FromDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);
DECLARE @ToDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDatee, 103);
DECLARE @pivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

-- STEP 1: CTE to get core sales data
WITH SalesCTE AS (

--select 
--  sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
--        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
--        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
--        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
--        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
--        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
		
--		CAST(sm1011_42 /1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3))AS SELLQTY,
		  
--       sm1011_19*1000 as sellINGrate,
--	   SM1005_57 AS GRQTY,
--	   sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
--	   (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 ) AS COST

--from sm1011
-- JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
--left join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10
--inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13
--left join sm1008 on sm1011_8=sm1008.unqid
--left join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm1008.sm1008_30
--where sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES' and
--sm1011_41 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
--and 
--sm1008_30<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
--AND SM1011_6 BETWEEN 
--@fromdate AND @todate

--	 and sm1011_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@sp,','))

--UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
        SM1005_57 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
	   (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 ) AS COST

    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1011_10
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID = SM206_C.SM206_C7
    JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C1 = SM1008.UNQID
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4
    WHERE sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES' and SM1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
      AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1011_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@sp,','))


	union all
	


select sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
	
       
        SM1023_c8 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
SUM(SM1023_c13) AS COST

from sm1008 join  sm1008_c on sm1008_c1 = unqid 
join sm1011 on SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1008_24
LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
join  sm1023_c on sm1023_c.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 	
WHERE sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES' and SM1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
      AND sm1008_24 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1008_8 in (select data from dbo.split(@sp,','))
	 group by sm206.sm206_2,sm206.sm206_7,  
	 sm1002.sm1002_7, sm19.sm19_5,SM1011.sm1011_6,SM1011.sm1011_7,
	 SM1008_C.sm1008_C4,SM1011.sm1011_19
	,SM1011.sm1011_24,SM1023_c13,SM1023_c8 
	--ORDER BY INVDATE
)

-- STEP 2: Aggregate detailed sales
SELECT
    PRODUCT,
    PRODUCTUNQ,
    INVDATE,
   -- INVNO,
    SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    sum(SELLINGRATE*SELLQTY)/sum(SELLQTY) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
    SUM(COST*SELLQTY)/ SUM(SELLQTY) AS COST,
    SUM(SELLINGRATE*SELLQTY) AS SELL_VALUE,
    CAST(SUM(SELLINGRATE*SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS SELL_PR,
    CAST(
    (SUM(SELLINGRATE*SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0)) - (SUM(COST*SELLQTY)/ SUM(SELLQTY))
    AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS CONT_PR,
	
    CAST(
        SUM( SELLQTY) *  CAST(
    (SUM(SELLINGRATE*SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0)) - (SUM(COST*SELLQTY)/ SUM(SELLQTY))
    AS NUMERIC(18,2))
    AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS CONTRIBUTION
    
INTO #yyy
FROM SalesCTE
GROUP BY  INVDATE, PRODUCT,PRODUCTUNQ
ORDER BY INVDATE, PRODUCT,PRODUCTUNQ
--CAST(INVNO AS NUMERIC(18,0)), 






-- STEP 3: Daily aggregated values

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DailyTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DailyTotals;
SELECT
    INVDATE AS Day,
    SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    sum(AVG_SELL_RATE)  AS TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE,
    sum(COST) AS TOTAL_COST,
    SUM(SELL_VALUE) AS TOTAL_SELLVALUE,
    SUM(SELL_PR) AS TOTAL_SELLPR,
    SUM(CONT_PR)  AS TOTAL_CONTPR,
    SUM(CONTRIBUTION) AS TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION
INTO #DailyTotals
FROM #yyy
GROUP BY INVDATE;

--select * from #yyy where product = 'ACETIC ACID - 30KG - GNFC'

-- STEP 4: Create date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);
DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @FromDate;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @ToDate
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END


SET @pivotColumns = '';


SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_QTY') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_AVGSELLRATE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_COST') + ','+
     QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLVALUE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTRIBUTION') + ','
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 as PRODUCT FROM sm206 inner join sm1011 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13)  AS Products;
--where sm1011_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@sp,','))) AS Products;
--FROM (SELECT DISTINCT  PRODUCT FROM #yyy) AS Products;

--print  @pivotColumns;
 --Remove trailing comma
if @pivotColumns = ''
begin
print '1';
	 select 'No data for this product' as error;
end
else 
begin 
IF RIGHT(@pivotColumns, 1) = ','
    SET @pivotColumns = LEFT(@pivotColumns, LEN(@pivotColumns) - 1);
end
print @pivotColumns;

if @pivotColumns  is null and @pivotColumns = ','
begin
	 select 'No data for this product' as error;
end

-- STEP 6: Build and execute pivot query
SET @sql = '
SELECT
    PivotTable.Day, ' + @pivotColumns + ',
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE, 0) AS TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_COST, 0) AS TOTAL_COST,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_SELLVALUE, 0) AS TOTAL_SELLVALUE,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_SELLPR, 0) AS TOTAL_SELLPR,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_CONTPR, 0) AS TOTAL_CONTPR,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION, 0) AS TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION
FROM (
    -- Union all measures for pivoting
    SELECT ds.Day,
           ad.PRODUCT + ''_QTY'' AS ProductMeasure, ISNULL(ad.QTY, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_AVGSELLRATE'', ISNULL(ad.AVG_SELL_RATE, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_COST'', ISNULL(ad.COST, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLVALUE'', ISNULL(ad.SELL_VALUE, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLPR'', ISNULL(ad.SELL_PR, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTPR'', ISNULL(ad.CONT_PR, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTRIBUTION'', ISNULL(ad.CONTRIBUTION, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT (
    SUM(Value) FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
) AS PivotTable
LEFT JOIN #DailyTotals dt ON PivotTable.Day = dt.Day
ORDER BY PivotTable.Day;
';

-- Optional: debug
PRINT @sql;

EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

-- Cleanup if needed
-- DROP TABLE #yyy, #DateSeriess, #DailyTotals;

end
END
GO

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_for_rptcontribution_smw]
	
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@sp      AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@sm      AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@Fd      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@Td      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURE    AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@fromdatee    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@todatee   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(max) = '',
@unqidPro as nvarchar(max) = '',
@branchunq as nvarchar(max) = '',
@BRANCH_STOCK       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@detail       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='1'
								  
AS

BEGIN
   IF @AA = 'BIND'
    BEGIN
	if @uid in ('001','shi','adm','ami')
	 begin 
	 print '1'
    

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY Dname ASC,ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname , 1 as  ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC, ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

        SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname , 0 AS ord
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY Dname;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

	   select  unqid as unqid, sm113_6 as Dname from sm113  ORDER BY Dname;
	   ----------------------salesman---------------------------
	 select 
    sm502.unqid AS unqid,
    upper(sm502.SM502_4) AS Dname
from SM502
join sm500 
    on sm500.unqid = sm502.SM502_13
cross apply dbo.split(sm502.SM502_16, ',') ss   -- split SM502_16
where (sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null)
  and upper(sm500.SM500_4) = 'SALES'
  and ss.data in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
order by Dname;
    END
	end 

	IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
    BEGIN
 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split( @unqidPro ,',')) 
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
    END
		IF @AA = 'BINDSM'
    BEGIN
 
        select 
    sm502.unqid AS unqid,
    upper(sm502.SM502_4) AS Dname
from SM502
join sm500 
    on sm500.unqid = sm502.SM502_13
cross apply dbo.split(sm502.SM502_16, ',') ss   -- split SM502_16
where (sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null)
  and upper(sm500.SM500_4) = 'SALES'
  and ss.data in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
order by Dname;


    END
	

	IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCTSALES'
    BEGIN
	--declare @Fd   AS NVARCHAR(50)='';
	--declare @Td   AS NVARCHAR(50)='';

-- declare @FromDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)  = CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103);
--declare @ToDate  AS NVARCHAR(50)  = CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103);

        --SELECT distinct SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        --FROM sm1011  inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13
        --WHERE  sm1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103) AND CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103)
        --ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;


		IF (@Fd <> '' AND @Td <> '' and @BRANCH <>'')
			BEGIN
				 SELECT distinct SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM sm1011 
		inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13
		JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
        WHERE  sm1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, @Fd, 103) AND CONVERT(DATE, @Td, 103)
		AND SM1011_41 in 
		(select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
		AND sm1008_36 in (select data from dbo.split(@sm,','))
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
			END
		
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname 
				FROM SM206 
				ORDER BY Dname ASC;
			END



    END


	if @AA = 'BINDMANU'
begin 

select SM206.sm206_2 as unqid, SM206.sm206_7 AS Dname  from sm206 
 inner join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
inner join sm113 on sm206_c7 = sm113.unqid 
where sm113.unqid  in (select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURE,','))

	end 






if @aa='ALL_DDD'



BEGIN 
DECLARE @FromDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);
DECLARE @ToDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @ToDatee, 103);
DECLARE @pivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);


-- Materialize SalesCTE into a temp table
SELECT *
INTO #SalesCTE
FROM (
    -- GR Data
    SELECT
	--sm502.sm502_4 AS SALESMAN,
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
        SM1005_57 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
        (SM1005_24-  SM1005_25 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS COST,
		(SM1005_24 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS NCOST,
		(SM1005_25) AS INVNDISC,

        'GR' AS SOURCETYPE
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1011_10
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID = SM206_C.SM206_C7
    JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C1 = SM1008.UNQID
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4
	JOIN sm502     ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
 
      AND SM1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
      AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
      AND sm1011_13 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
	   AND sm1008_36 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sm, ','))

    UNION ALL

    -- Opening Data
    SELECT
	--sm502.sm502_4 AS SALESMAN,
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
        SM1023_c8 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
        SUM(SM1023_c13) AS COST,
		0.00 AS NCOST,
		 0.00 AS INVNDISC,
        'OPENING' AS SOURCETYPE
    FROM sm1008
    JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    JOIN sm1011 ON sm1008.unqid = sm1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1008_24
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 
    JOIN SM1023 ON SM1023.UNQID = SM1023_C.SM1023_C5
	JOIN sm502   ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
   -- WHERE sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES'
      AND SM1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
      AND sm1008_24 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
      AND sm1008_8 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
	     AND sm1008_36 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sm, ','))
    GROUP BY sm206.sm206_2, sm206.sm206_7, sm1002.sm1002_7, sm19.sm19_5,
             SM1011.sm1011_6, SM1011.sm1011_7, SM1008_C.sm1008_C4,
             SM1011.sm1011_19, SM1011.sm1011_24, SM1023_c13, SM1023_c8, SM1023_4
) AS SourceData;

-- Build summary into another temp table
SELECT
    PRODUCT,
    PRODUCTUNQ,
    INVDATE,
    SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
    SUM(SELLINGRATE * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
    SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS COST,
	 SUM(NCOST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NCOST,
	Sum(INVNDISC * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) as INVNDISC,
    SUM(SELLINGRATE * SELLQTY) AS SELL_VALUE,
    CAST(SUM(SELLINGRATE * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS SELL_PR
INTO #yyy
FROM #SalesCTE
GROUP BY INVDATE, PRODUCT, PRODUCTUNQ;

--select * From #yyy;



-- Add columns
ALTER TABLE #yyy ADD 
    DISC NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    CONT_PR NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    CONTRIBUTION NUMERIC(18,0) DEFAULT 0,
    --COSTORIGINAL NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
	PROFIT NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0;

-- Save original cost
--UPDATE #yyy SET COSTORIGINAL = COST;

-- Apply discount only to GR records
UPDATE yyy 
SET 
    DISC = ISNULL(discount_data.DISC, 0),
    COST = COST - ISNULL(discount_data.DISC, 0)
FROM #yyy AS yyy
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCTUNQ, PRODUCT, INVDATE
    FROM #SalesCTE
    WHERE SOURCETYPE = 'GR'
) AS gr
  ON gr.PRODUCTUNQ = yyy.PRODUCTUNQ
 AND gr.PRODUCT = yyy.PRODUCT
 AND gr.INVDATE = yyy.INVDATE
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        SaleMonth,
        PRODUCTUNQ,
        SUM(DiscountByQuantityRange + DiscountByMonth) AS DISC
    FROM (
        -- Quantity Range Based Discount
        SELECT
            SM1005.sm1005_10 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
            FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'yyyy-MM') AS SaleMonth,
            SUM(SM1005_57) AS MonthlyQty,
            CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AS FromQty,
            CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT) AS ToQty,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(SM1005_57) BETWEEN CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AND CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT)
                THEN CAST(sm_402_c7 AS NUMERIC(18,2))
                ELSE 0
            END AS DiscountByQuantityRange,
            0 AS DiscountByMonth
        FROM SM1005
        JOIN SM_402 ON SM_402.SM_402_7 = SM1005_10
        JOIN SM_402_C ON SM_402_C.SM_402_C4 = SM_402.unqid
        WHERE SM1005_10 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
          AND SM1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
        GROUP BY SM1005_10, FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'yyyy-MM'), sm_402_c5, sm_402_c6, sm_402_c7

        UNION ALL

        -- Monthly Discount
        SELECT
            SM1005.sm1005_10 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
            FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'yyyy-MM') AS SaleMonth,
            SUM(SM1005_57) AS MonthlyQty,
            0, 0, 0,
            CASE
                WHEN FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'yyyy-MM') BETWEEN FORMAT(SM_401.SM_401_6, 'yyyy-MM') AND FORMAT(SM_401.SM_401_7, 'yyyy-MM')
                THEN TRY_CAST(SM_401_C.SM_401_C_8 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))
                ELSE 0
            END AS DiscountByMonth
        FROM SM1005
        JOIN SM_401_C ON SM1005.SM1005_10 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_7
        JOIN SM_401 ON SM_401.SM_401_5 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_6
        WHERE SM1005_10 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
          AND SM1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate
          AND ((SM1005_42 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') OR (SM1005_42 <> sm_401.sm_401_11))
        GROUP BY SM1005_10, FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'yyyy-MM'), SM_401.SM_401_6, SM_401_C.SM_401_C_8,SM_401_7
    ) AS CombinedResults
    GROUP BY SaleMonth, PRODUCTUNQ
) AS discount_data 
ON FORMAT(yyy.INVDATE, 'yyyy-MM') = discount_data.SaleMonth 
AND yyy.PRODUCTUNQ = discount_data.PRODUCTUNQ;

-- Final calculations
UPDATE #yyy 
SET 
    CONT_PR = CAST(SELL_PR - COST AS NUMERIC(18,2)),
    CONTRIBUTION = CAST(QTY * (SELL_PR - COST) AS NUMERIC(18,0));

UPDATE #yyy 
SET 
   
    PROFIT = CAST((CONTRIBUTION / SELL_VALUE) * 100 AS NUMERIC(18,2));


-- STEP 3: Daily aggregated values

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DailyTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DailyTotals;
SELECT
    INVDATE AS Day,
    SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    sum(AVG_SELL_RATE)  AS TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE,
    --sum(COSTORIGINAL) AS TOTAL_COSTORIGINAL,
	    sum(NCOST) AS TOTAL_NCOST,
    sum(INVNDISC) AS TOTAL_INVNDISC,

    sum(DISC) AS TOTAL_DISC,


    sum(COST) AS TOTAL_COST,
    SUM(SELL_VALUE) AS TOTAL_SELLVALUE,
    SUM(SELL_PR) AS TOTAL_SELLPR,
    SUM(CONT_PR)  AS TOTAL_CONTPR,
    SUM(CONTRIBUTION) AS TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION,
	sum(PROFIT) As TOTAL_PROFIT
INTO #DailyTotals
FROM #yyy
GROUP BY INVDATE;




-- STEP 4: Create date series
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DateSeriess') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DateSeriess;
CREATE TABLE #DateSeriess (Day DATE);
DECLARE @CurrentDatee DATE = @FromDate;
WHILE @CurrentDatee <= @ToDate
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO #DateSeriess (Day) VALUES (@CurrentDatee);
    SET @CurrentDatee = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDatee);
END


SET @pivotColumns = '';


SELECT @pivotColumns = @pivotColumns +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_QTY') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_AVGSELLRATE') + ',' +
  --  QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_COSTORIGINAL') + ','+
  	  QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_NCOST') + ','+
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_INVNDISC') + ','+
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_DISC') + ','+
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_COST') + ','+

     QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLVALUE') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_SELLPR') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTPR') + ',' +
	 QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_CONTRIBUTION') + ',' +
    QUOTENAME(PRODUCT + '_PROFIT') + ','
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sm206_7 as PRODUCT FROM sm206 inner join sm1011 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1011.sm1011_13 where sm1011_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@sp,',')))  AS Products;

 --Remove trailing comma
if @pivotColumns = ''
begin
print '1';
	 select 'No data for this product' as error;
end
else 
begin 
IF RIGHT(@pivotColumns, 1) = ','
    SET @pivotColumns = LEFT(@pivotColumns, LEN(@pivotColumns) - 1);
end
print @pivotColumns;

if @pivotColumns  is null and @pivotColumns = ','
begin
	 select 'No data for this product' as error;
end



-- STEP 6: Build and execute pivot query
SET @sql = '
SELECT
    PivotTable.Day, ' + @pivotColumns + ',
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE, 0) AS TOTAL_AVGSELLRATE,
    --ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_COSTORIGINAL, 0) AS TOTAL_COSTORIGINAL,
	   ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_NCOST, 0) AS TOTAL_NCOST,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_INVNDISC, 0) AS TOTAL_INVNDISC,

    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_DISC, 0) AS TOTAL_DISC,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_COST, 0) AS TOTAL_COST,
 

    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_SELLVALUE, 0) AS TOTAL_SELLVALUE,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_SELLPR, 0) AS TOTAL_SELLPR,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_CONTPR, 0) AS TOTAL_CONTPR,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION, 0) AS TOTAL_CONTRIBUTION,
    ISNULL(dt.TOTAL_PROFIT, 0) AS TOTAL_PROFIT

FROM (
    -- Union all measures for pivoting
    SELECT ds.Day,
           ad.PRODUCT + ''_QTY'' AS ProductMeasure, ISNULL(ad.QTY, 0) AS Value
    FROM #DateSeriess ds
    LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_AVGSELLRATE'', ISNULL(ad.AVG_SELL_RATE, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
	 --SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_COSTORIGINAL'', ISNULL(ad.COSTORIGINAL, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
  --  UNION ALL
      SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_NCOST'', ISNULL(ad.NCOST, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
	 SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_INVNDISC'', ISNULL(ad.INVNDISC, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
		 SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_DISC'', ISNULL(ad.DISC, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_COST'', ISNULL(ad.COST, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLVALUE'', ISNULL(ad.SELL_VALUE, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_SELLPR'', ISNULL(ad.SELL_PR, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTPR'', ISNULL(ad.CONT_PR, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_CONTRIBUTION'', ISNULL(ad.CONTRIBUTION, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
	 UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.Day, ad.PRODUCT + ''_PROFIT'', ISNULL(ad.PROFIT, 0) FROM #DateSeriess ds LEFT JOIN #yyy ad ON ds.Day = ad.INVDATE
) AS SourceTable
PIVOT (
    SUM(Value) FOR ProductMeasure IN (' + @pivotColumns + ')
) AS PivotTable
LEFT JOIN #DailyTotals dt ON PivotTable.Day = dt.Day
ORDER BY PivotTable.Day;
';

-- Optional: debug
PRINT @sql;

EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

end


if @aa='ALL_INV'



BEGIN 
---DECLARE @FromDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);
set @FromDate  = CONVERT(DATE, @FromDatee, 103);




-- Materialize SalesCTE into a temp table
SELECT *
INTO #SalesCTEE
FROM (
    -- GR Data
    SELECT
	    sm502.sm502_4 AS SALESMAN,
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
        SM1005_57 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
        (SM1005_24-  SM1005_25 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS COST,
		(SM1005_24 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS NCOST,
		(SM1005_25) AS INVNDISC,

        'GR' AS SOURCETYPE
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1011_10
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.UNQID = SM206_C.SM206_C7
    JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.UNQID = SM1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C1 = SM1008.UNQID
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4
	JOIN sm502   ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
  WHERE 
  --sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES' AND 
	  SM1011_6 = @fromdate 
      AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
	   AND sm1008_36 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sm, ','))
      --AND sm1011_13 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))

    UNION ALL

    -- Opening Data
    SELECT
	sm502.sm502_4 AS SALESMAN,
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
        sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
        SM1011_19 * 1000 AS SELLINGRATE,
        SM1023_c8 AS GRQTY,
        SM1011_24 AS SALEAMT,
        SUM(SM1023_c13) AS COST,
		0.00 AS NCOST,
		 0.00 AS INVNDISC,
        'OPENING' AS SOURCETYPE
    FROM sm1008
    JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    JOIN sm1011 ON sm1008.unqid = sm1011.SM1011_8
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1008_24
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 
    JOIN SM1023 ON SM1023.UNQID = SM1023_C.SM1023_C5
	JOIN sm502   ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
   -- WHERE sm1011_74 <> 'BRANCH TRANSFER SALES'
      AND SM1011_6 = @fromdate 
      AND sm1008_24 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@branch, ','))
      --AND sm1008_8 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sp, ','))
	   AND sm1008_36 IN (SELECT DATA FROM dbo.split(@sm, ','))
    GROUP BY sm206.sm206_2, sm206.sm206_7, sm1002.sm1002_7, sm19.sm19_5,
             SM1011.sm1011_6, SM1011.sm1011_7, SM1008_C.sm1008_C4,
             SM1011.sm1011_19, SM1011.sm1011_24, SM1023_c13, SM1023_c8, SM1023_4, sm502_4 
) AS SourceData;


Select
SALESMAN AS SALESMAN,
BRANCH as [Branch] ,
CUSTNAME as [Customer],
FORMAT(INVDATE, 'dd-MM-yyyy') as [Date],
INVNO as [Inv No],
SELLQTY as [QTY],
COST as [Original Cost],
SELLINGRATE AS SELLINGRATE,
INVNDISC as [Inv Disc]  from #SalesCTEE where Product =  @sp
order by Branch, INVNO asc ;

end
END
GO

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALE_INVOICE_CHILD_Q] 

@what		 nvarchar(50)='',
@sm213_c1	 nvarchar(50)='',------Entry Date
@sm213_c2	 nvarchar(50)='',------Mdate
@unqid		 nvarchar(50)='',------uniqueidentifier 
@sm213_c4	 nvarchar(50)='',------Punqid
@sm213_c5	 nvarchar(50)='',------Product Code
@sm213_c6    nvarchar(50)='',------HSN/SAC
@sm213_c7    nvarchar(MAX)='',------Description
@sm213_c8    nvarchar(50)='',------Unit
@sm213_c9    nvarchar(50)='',------Quantity
@sm213_c10   nvarchar(50)='',------Rate
@sm213_c11   nvarchar(50)='',------Amount
@sm213_c12   nvarchar(50)='',------Discount%
@sm213_c13   nvarchar(50)='',------Discount Amount
@sm213_c14   nvarchar(50)='',------Taxable Amount
@sm213_c15   nvarchar(50)='',------GST%
@sm213_c16   nvarchar(50)='',------CGST
@sm213_c17   nvarchar(50)='',------SGST
@sm213_c18   nvarchar(50)='',------IGST
@sm213_c19   nvarchar(50)='',------Net Amount
@SM213_C20   nvarchar(50)='',------ORDERING IN VIEW CASE
@SM213_C21   nvarchar(50)='',------CESS%
@SM213_C22   nvarchar(50)='',------CESS AMOUNT
@SM213_C23   nvarchar(max)='',------SM227_C(PURCSASE) CHILD UNQID

@sm19_c1	 nvarchar(50)=''------SM19_C UNQID
AS
BEGIN
--------------
DECLARE @GSTUNQ AS NVARCHAR(36);

if @what = 'sale_child'
BEGIN
	  SET @SM213_C20= (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM213_C20),0)+1 AS ORDERING FROM SM213_c WHERE SM213_C4=@SM213_C4)

	  SET @GSTUNQ = (SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2= @sm213_c5)

	  insert into sm213_c(sm213_c1,sm213_c2,unqid,sm213_c4,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,
	  sm213_c14,sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19,SM213_C20,SM213_C21,SM213_C22,SM213_C23) 
	  values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_c2,newid(),@sm213_c4,@sm213_c5,@sm213_c6,@sm213_c7,@sm213_c8,@sm213_c9,@sm213_c10,@sm213_c11,@sm213_c12,@sm213_c13,
	  @sm213_c14,@GSTUNQ,@sm213_c16,@sm213_c17,@sm213_c18,@sm213_c19,@SM213_C20,@SM213_C21,@SM213_C22,@SM213_C23);
END
-------------  

if @what = 'Reinsert_Grid_For_Update'
BEGIN
	  SET @SM213_C20= (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM213_C20),0)+1 AS ORDERING FROM SM213_c WHERE SM213_C4=@SM213_C4)

select unqid from sm213 as punqid 	
insert into sm213_c(sm213_c1,sm213_c2,unqid,sm213_c4,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,sm213_c14,sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19,SM213_C20) 
values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_c2,newid(),@sm213_c4,@sm213_c5,@sm213_c6,@sm213_c7,@sm213_c8,@sm213_c9,@sm213_c10,@sm213_c11,@sm213_c12,@sm213_c13,@sm213_c14,@sm213_c15,@sm213_c16,@sm213_c17,@sm213_c18,@sm213_c19,@SM213_C20);
END

END

-------
 
if @what = 'UPDATE_CHILD'
BEGIN
	  DELETE FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @sm213_c4
END

if @what = 'UPDATE_CHILD_RETURN'
BEGIN
	  DELETE FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @sm213_c4
	  DELETE FROM M3 WHERE M3_14 = @sm213_c4
	  DELETE FROM COSR WHERE CO_6 = @sm213_c4
END

IF @what = 'BIND_HSN_UNIT'
BEGIN		
		SELECT SM206_15 AS [HSN/SAC], (SELECT SM209_8 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM206_12) AS UNIT,
		(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_10) AS GSTPER  FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@sm213_c5
END

IF @what = 'SOFTWARECOUNT'
BEGIN
SELECT SM19_C1 AS [CHILDUNQID] , SM19_C4 AS [DESCRIPTION]  FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID
END


IF @what = 'BIND_GRID_DATA'
BEGIN	
		IF  (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, SM19_C5, GETDATE()) AS [DateDiff] FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1) > 6
		BEGIN
				SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS [PRODUCT CODE], 
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS [HSN/SAC],		
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE unqid=SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID= SM206_13) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS UNIT, SM19_C7 AS [RATE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_11) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS GSTPER
				FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1
		END
		
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS [PRODUCT CODE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS [HSN/SAC],		
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE unqid=SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID= SM206_13) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS UNIT,SM19_C6 AS [RATE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_11) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS GSTPER
				FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1
		END
END


--alter table sm213_C add SM213_C21 NVARCHAR(50), SM213_C22 NUMERIC(18,2), SM213_C23 nvarchar(50)

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALE_INVOICE_PARENT_Q]

@what		nvarchar(50)='',
@sm213_1	nvarchar(50)='',------Entry Date
@sm213_2	nvarchar(50)='',------Mdate 
@sm213_3	nvarchar(50)='',------Uid
@unqid		nvarchar(MAX)='',------uniqueidentifier
@sm213_5	nvarchar(50)='',------Askrestcode
@sm213_100  nvarchar(50)='',------System Name
@sm213_6    nvarchar(50)='',------Date
@sm213_7    nvarchar(50)='',------Cash/Credit
@sm213_8    nvarchar(50)='',------Invoice Prefix
@sm213_9    nvarchar(50)='',------Invoice No.
@sm213_10   nvarchar(50)='',------Customer Name
@sm213_11   nvarchar(50)='',------PO No
@sm213_12   nvarchar(50)='',------PO Date
@sm213_13   nvarchar(50)='',------Installation Date
@sm213_14   nvarchar(50)='',------Tax Type
@sm213_15   nvarchar(50)='',------Gross Amount
@sm213_16   nvarchar(50)='',------Discount Amount
@sm213_17   nvarchar(50)='',------Taxable Amount
@sm213_18   nvarchar(50)='',------CGST
@sm213_19   nvarchar(50)='',------SGST
@sm213_20   nvarchar(50)='',------IGST
@sm213_21   nvarchar(50)='',------Total Amount
@sm213_22   nvarchar(50)='',------Roundoff
@sm213_23   nvarchar(50)='',------Net Amount
@sm213_24   nvarchar(MAX)='',------Remark
@sm213_25   nvarchar(50)='',------Make Invoice Date
@sm213_26   nvarchar(50)='',------Audited Date
@sm213_27   nvarchar(50)='',------User ID- mi
@sm213_28   nvarchar(50)='',------User ID - Audited By
@sm213_29   nvarchar(36)='',------POSTED UNQID
@sm213_30   nvarchar(50)='',------Total GST
@sm213_33	nvarchar(30)='',------R INVOICE
@sm213_34	nvarchar(30)='',------R DATE
@RCUST		nvarchar(36)='',------R CUSTOMER UNQID
@fromdate	 nvarchar(50)='',
@todate		 nvarchar(50)='',

if @what = 'sale_invoice'
begin 
	SELECT PA_17 AS GSTIN, PA_3 AS COMPANYNAME,PA_4 AS DIVISIONNAME,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=PA_10) AS [STATE],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=PA_10) AS [STATECODE],pa_20 as PanNo,pa_25 as CinNo,
	  (SELECT SM1002_14 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5='9C9E1E38-DF30-4CFA-8311-8432D8F3B700') as email,PA_11 AS [ADMOFFICE],
	  (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9)+ ', 342001' AS [CITY],PA_22 AS [TELNO_IN_ADM],PA_27 AS WEBSITE,
	  PA_5 AS [REGOFFICE],PA_6 AS [REGOFFICE1],PA_23 AS [TELNO_IN_REG], PA_19 AS EMAIL,
	  (SELECT BA_5 from BA where BA_14=PA_35) AS BANKNAME,(SELECT BA_13 FROM BA where BA_14=PA_35) AS BRANCH,
	  (SELECT BA_9 FROM BA where BA_14=PA_35) AS ACCOUNTNO,
      (SELECT BA_10 from BA where BA_14=PA_35) AS IFSCCODE,(SELECT BA_8 from BA where BA_14=PA_35) AS BANKACNAME,PA_57 AS WHATSAPPMSG,
	  PA_58 AS API,PA_59 AS PDFURL,PA_60 AS WHATSAPPURL FROM PA

      SELECT SM213.UNQID AS UNQID,(CASE WHEN (sm213_8 !='' and sm213_9!='') then (sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9) else '' END) as [INVOICENO],(CASE WHEN SM213_25 ='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),sm213_25,103) END) AS [INVOICEDATE],
	  sm213_6 AS [EntryDATE],SM213_33 AS [CREDITNOTENO],convert(nvarchar(10),sm213_1,105) AS [CREDITNOTEDATE],
	  (SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [ACCOUNTNAME],

      ( SELECT SM19_13 + ' ' + isnull(SM19_14,'') + ', ' + 
	  case when (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_10)) is null 
	  then '' else (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_10)) end
	   FROM SM19 WHERE
	  SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [ACCOUNT ADDRESS],
	  
	  (SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_10)) AS [STATENAME],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_10)) AS [STATECODE],(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS 
	  [GSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [ACCPANNO],FORMAT(sm213_62, 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DUE DATE],SM213_22 AS [ROUNDOFF],SM213_18 AS [CGST],SM213_19 AS [SGST],SM213_20 AS [IGST],SM213_30 AS [TOTALGST],

	  
      (select pa_28 from pa) as [SF1],(select pa_29 from pa) as [SF2],(select pa_30 from pa) as [SF3],(select pa_37 from pa) as [SRF1],(select pa_38 from pa) as [SRF2],
	  (select pa_39 from pa) as [SRF3],sm213_42 AS [IRN],CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),sm213_37,103) AS [ACK_DATE],sm213_38 AS [ACK_NO],sm213_49 AS [QR_PATH],SM213_23 AS [NETAMOUNT],SM213_14 AS [TAXTYPE],'INVOICE'AS [FORMAT],'' AS [RINVOICENO],''AS [RINVOICEDATE], sm213_66 as [VEHICLE] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID)
	  
      ORDER BY [INVOICEDATE] DESC,[INVOICENO] DESC;	 

	  
	  select(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCOUNTNAME],
      ( SELECT SM19_13 + '  ' + isnull(SM19_14,'') + ', ' + 
	  case when (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_60)) is null 
	  then '' else (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_60)) end
	   FROM SM19 WHERE
	  SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCOUNT ADDRESS],(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS [STSTATENAME],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS [STSTATECODE],(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS 
	  [STGSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCPANNO],

	  (SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCOUNTNAME],
      ( SELECT SM19_13 + '  ' + isnull(SM19_14,'') + ', ' + 
	  case when (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_59)) is null 
	  then '''' else (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_59)) end
	   FROM SM19 WHERE
	  SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCOUNT ADDRESS],(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_59)) AS [DFSTATENAME],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_59)) AS [DFSTATECODE],(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS 
	  [DFGSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCPANNO] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID);



	  select SM213_C20 as [SNO],(select sm17_6 from sm17 inner join sm206 on sm17.unqid = sm206.sm206_13 where sm206.SM206_2 = sm213_c5) as [CATEGORY],(select sm206_28 from sm206 where sm206_2=sm213_c5) AS [ITEM],SM213_C7 AS [TITLE],((SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=SM213_C5) + '  ' + SM213_C7) AS [TITL],SM213_C6 AS [SAC],
      CAST(SM213_C9 AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [QUANTITY],SM213_C10 AS [RATE],SM213_C11 AS [AMOUNT],SM213_c14 AS [TAXABLE],
	  SM213_c13 AS [DISCOUNT],SM213_C20 AS ORDERING,SM213_C8 AS UNIT
	  INTO #TEMP2 FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID)
	  SELECT * FROM #TEMP2 ORDER BY ORDERING asc;	 

	  select (select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid = sm213_c15) as [IGST%] ,CAST(CAST(ROUND((SELECT sm210_7 FROM sm210 WHERE unqid = sm213_c15) / 2.0, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS FLOAT) as [GST%] from sm213_c where sm213_c4 in (@UNQID)
	  SELECT SUM(SM213_C9) AS [SUMOFQTY] FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @UNQID
end

if @what = 'Purchase_Details'
begin
	if (select count(*) from sm227_c) != '' 
	--	select sm227_c.unqid as UNQID, sm206_9 as PRODUCT, sm227_7 as INVOICENO, sm227_6 as INVOICEDATE, sm227_c6 as QTY, sm227_c6 AS REMQTY from sm227_c 
	--	inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4 inner join sm227 on sm227_c.sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid where sm206_9 like '%'+@search+'%' and sm227_c6 != '0.00'
	--union all
	--select sm213_c23 as unq, (select sm206_9 as Product from sm206), sum(sm213_c9) as qty, (select sm227_7 as invno from sm227), (select sm227_6 as invdate from sm227) from sm213_c group by sm213_c23
	--order by INVOICENO asc
	
		SELECT 
			pc.unqid AS UNQID,
			p.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
			p.sm206_9 AS PRODUCT,
			ph.sm227_7 AS INVOICENO,
			ph.sm227_6 AS INVOICEDATE,
			pc.sm227_c6 AS QTY,
			pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) AS REMQTY
		FROM sm227_c pc
		INNER JOIN sm206 p
			ON p.sm206_2 = pc.sm227_c4
		INNER JOIN sm227 ph
			ON ph.unqid = pc.sm227_c3
		LEFT JOIN sm213_c sc
			ON sc.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid
		WHERE p.sm206_9 LIKE '%'+@search+'%'
		GROUP BY 
			pc.unqid, 
			p.sm206_9, 
			p.sm206_2, 
			ph.sm227_7, 
			ph.sm227_6, 
			pc.sm227_c6
		HAVING pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) != 0
		ORDER BY ph.sm227_7 ASC;

	else
		select '' as UNQID, 'No Record Found' as PRODUCT, '' as INVOICENO, '' as INVOICEDATE, '' as QTY, 0 AS REMQTY 

end

end

    pc.unqid AS UNQID,
	p.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
    p.sm206_9 AS PRODUCT,
    ph.sm227_7 AS INVOICENO,
    ph.sm227_6 AS INVOICEDATE,
    pc.sm227_c6 AS QTY,
    pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) AS REMQTY
FROM sm227_c pc 
INNER JOIN sm206 p
    ON p.sm206_2 = pc.sm227_c4
INNER JOIN sm227 ph
    ON ph.unqid = pc.sm227_c3
LEFT JOIN sm213_c sc
    ON sc.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid   -- ❗ SUM ke liye ALL rows
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sm213_c s
    WHERE s.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid
      AND s.sm213_c4 = @punqid   -- ❗ sirf wahi rows lao
)
GROUP BY 
    pc.unqid, 
    p.sm206_9, 
	p.sm206_2,
    ph.sm227_7, 
    ph.sm227_6, 
    pc.sm227_c6
HAVING pc.sm227_c6 != 0;

	

END

		SM213_10	as CustomerName,SUBSTRING(SM213_33, 10, 5) AS VOUCHERNO,

		ABS(CONVERT (NUMERIC(18),SM213_C9)) AS [QTY],SM213_C10 AS [RATE],SM213_C11 AS [AMOUNT],SM213_C12 AS [DISC%],SM213_C13 AS [DISC AMT],SM213_C14 AS [TAXABLE AMOUNT],

if @what='genEwayNo'
begin
   
	SELECT 1 AS TransMode,SM213_67 AS TransDocNo,
	(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM213_64)+CASE WHEN  LEN(sm213_9)>4 THEN  sm213_9 ELSE DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) END AS INVNO,
	(CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),sm213_6,103)) AS INVDATE,
	FORMAT(sm213_68 ,'dd/MM/yyyy' ) AS TransDocDt,
	(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=sm213_65)AS TransName,
    (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_65) as TransId,sm213_66 as VehNo,
    (SELECT ZM37_2 FROM ZM37 WHERE ZM37_1=(SELECT TOP 1 SM1009_7 FROM SM1009 WHERE SM1009_6=LTRIM(RTRIM(sm213_65))))AS VehType,SM213_42 AS IRN
    FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID =@unqid--'bafa480e-17d0-4828-9fb7-9be47ce5cd4f'
	
	
SELECT @SUPPLIERUNQ=SM213_59 FROM SM213 WHERE unqid=@UNQID

SELECT @BRANCH=SM213_64 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
SELECT @WAREHOUSEUNQ=SM213_71 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
SELECT UPPER(PA_17) as GSTIN, UPPER(PA_3) AS TradeName,UPPER(PA_3) AS Legal_Name , (SELECT SM1002_8 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) AS Add1,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1002_11 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)) AS Location, 
(SELECT SM1002_17 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) as PinCode,
(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=PA_10) as state,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1002_10 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)) as StateCode,
 UPPER(SM19_23) as DISPATCHFROMGSTIN,UPPER(SM19_5) AS DISPATCHFROMLegal_Name ,  SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   ' as DISPATCHFROMAdd1,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID =  SM19_25) as DISPATCHFROMStateCode,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=SM19_25)DISPATCHFROMSTATE,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = sm19_15 ) as DISPATCHFROMLocation,
SM19_35 as DISPATCHFROMPinCode FROM SM19 , PA WHERE UNQID=@SUPPLIERUNQ



SELECT SM213.UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as Buyer,
(SELECT SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   '
FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as add1,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as statename,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as statecode,(SELECT SM19_35 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as PinCode,
(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as B_Gstin,
(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM213_64)+CASE WHEN  LEN(sm213_9)>4 THEN  sm213_9 ELSE DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) END as invno,
(CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),sm213_6,103)) as [date],sm213_18 as cgst  ,sm213_19 as sgst ,
sm213_20 as igst ,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as Location,sm213_17 as taxableamt,(sm213_18+sm213_19+sm213_20) as gstamt ,
0.00 as cessamt,(sm213_23-sm213_22) as Totamt,sm213_23 AS netamt,sm213_22 as roundoff,(sm213_18+sm213_19+sm213_20) as taxamt,'' as othercharges,
SM213_42 as IRN, SM213_37 as AckDate, SM213_38 as AckNo, SM213_49  as QRPath,

(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as shiptoGstin,
(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as shiptoName,
(SELECT SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   'FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as shiptoAddress,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS shiptoCITY,
(SELECT SM19_35 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as shiptoPinCode,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as shiptostatecode
FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @unqid



	SELECT 
		s.sm213_c9  AS qty,
		s.sm213_c10 AS rate,
		s.sm213_c11 AS amt,
		s.sm213_c14 AS taxableamt,

		-- GST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 <> 0 THEN t.sm210_7
			ELSE 18
		END AS gstrper,

		s.sm213_c16 AS CGST,
		s.sm213_c17 AS SGST,
		s.sm213_c18 AS IGST,

		-- CGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 = 0 THEN CASE 
            WHEN (t.sm210_7 / 2) = FLOOR(t.sm210_7 / 2)
                THEN CONVERT(INT, t.sm210_7 / 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(ROUND(t.sm210_7 / 2, 2) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        END
			ELSE 0
		END AS CGSTGST,

		-- SGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 = 0 THEN CASE 
            WHEN (t.sm210_7 / 2) = FLOOR(t.sm210_7 / 2)
                THEN CONVERT(INT, t.sm210_7 / 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(ROUND(t.sm210_7 / 2, 2) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        END
			ELSE 0
		END AS SGSTGST,

		-- IGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 <> 0 THEN t.sm210_7
			ELSE 0
		END AS IGSTGST,

		j.sm211_6 AS cessper,
		s.sm213_c22 AS cessamt,

		s.sm213_c11 AS Itemamt,
		p.SM206_15 AS hsn,
		s.sm213_c8  AS GSTUNIT,
		p.SM206_9  AS prodesc,
		p.SM206_7  AS prodname,
		s.sm213_c19 AS netamt

	FROM SM213_c s
	LEFT JOIN SM210 t ON t.unqid = s.sm213_c15
	LEFT JOIN SM211 j ON j.sm211_4 = s.sm213_c21
	LEFT JOIN SM206 p ON p.SM206_2 = s.sm213_c5
	WHERE s.sm213_c4 = @unqid;
end

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALE_POSTING_Q] 
@WHAT NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@userid NVARCHAR(50)='',
@systemname VARCHAR(50)='',
@unqid	    nvarchar(36)  = '',
@outletcode  nvarchar(100)  = '',
@m3_19		nvarchar(30) = '',
@m3_14 nvarchar(50) =''	,
@m3_20 nvarchar(36) = '',
@branch nvarchar(50)= ''


as

set @m3_19 = dbo.getformatteddate(@m3_19);


if @what = 'SALES_T'
begin
	declare @myval as nvarchar(max)=(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM213_9 as NUMERIC(18))),0) AS [InvoiceNo] FROM SM213 --with (updlock, holdlock)
	 WHERE SM213_35='OI' AND SM213_8='GIL/SI/25-26/' AND SM213_9 IS NOT NULL)
		set @myval=@myval+1;
	UPDATE SM213  SET SM213_25 = @M3_19,SM213_27 = @USERID WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	UPDATE SM213 SET  sm213_31 = (select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = (SELECT SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID)) WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	UPDATE SM213 SET SM213_9 = RIGHT('0000' + CAST(@myval AS VARCHAR),4) WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	 --update sm213 set sm213_9 = (Select right(replicate('0',4) + @myval,4) WHERE UNQID = @UNQID)


	 INSERT INTO  M3  	
	 SELECT (select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch),sm213_6,sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
	 UPPER(sm213_10),'Sale',	
	 -sm213_23, '', '', 'DR','',(select BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 =@branch), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	'',@UNQID , '', '', '',NEWID(),@m3_19,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@branch,@systemname
     From SM213 where UNQID = @UNQID;

		---- PRODUCT taxable amt 

		declare @taxableamt as nvarchar(50), @INB as nvarchar(50), @Cartage as nvarchar(50);
		set @INB = (select sm213_70 from sm213 where unqid = @unqid)
		
		
			set @taxableamt = (select(select sum(sm213_c14) from sm213_c where sm213_c4 = @unqid))
			
			set @Cartage = (select(select sm213_69 from sm213 where unqid = @unqid))

		INSERT INTO M3  
		SELECT 
			(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),
			sm213.sm213_6,
			sm213.sm213_8 + '/' + sm213.sm213_9,
			UPPER(sm206.sm206_24),
			'Sale',
			CAST(@taxableamt AS NUMERIC(10, 2)),
			'', '', 'CR', '',
			(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),
			'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '', @UNQID, '', '', '', NEWID(), 
			@m3_19, dbo.getentrydate(), '', @userid, @branch, @systemname
		FROM sm213_c sm213c
		INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213c.sm213_c5
		INNER JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213c.sm213_c4
		WHERE sm213.unqid = @UNQID
		GROUP BY sm206.sm206_24, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9;

		---- Transporter
		INSERT INTO M3  
		SELECT 
			(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),
			sm213.sm213_6,
			sm213.sm213_8 + '/' + sm213.sm213_9,
			(select UPPER(unqid) from sm19 where unqid = sm213_65),
			'Sale',
			CAST(@Cartage AS NUMERIC(10, 2)),
			'', '', 'CR', '',
			(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),
			'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '', @UNQID, '', '', '', NEWID(), 
			@m3_19, dbo.getentrydate(), '', @userid, @branch, @systemname
		FROM sm213_c sm213c
		INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213c.sm213_c5
		INNER JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213c.sm213_c4
		WHERE sm213.unqid = @UNQID
		GROUP BY sm206.sm206_24, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9, sm213_65;

		if(@INB = 'True')
		begin
		----Cartage Dr amount
		INSERT INTO M3

			(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),

		INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213c.sm213_c5
		INNER JOIN sm213 ON sm213.unqid = sm213c.sm213_c4
		WHERE sm213.unqid = @UNQID
		GROUP BY sm206.sm206_24, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9, sm213_65;
		end
		-----SGST+CGST//IGST
	IF((select sm213_14 from sm213 where unqid = @unqid) = 'IGST' )
	BEGIN
		--IGST
	   INSERT INTO  M3

	   '',@UNQID , '', '', '',NEWID(),@m3_19, dbo.getentrydate(), '', @userid, @branch, @systemname
	   from SM213_c inner join sm213 on sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid where sm213.UNQID = @UNQID
	   group by sm213_c15, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9, sm213.sm213_20;
	
		END
	    ELSE
		BEGIN
		--CGST
		INSERT INTO  M3  	
		SELECT(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),sm213_6,sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,

		sm213_18, '', '', 'CR','',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

		group by sm213_c15, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9, sm213.sm213_18;
		
		--SGST
	   INSERT INTO  M3  	
	   SELECT (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),sm213_6,sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
	   (select UPPER(sm210_11) from sm210 where unqid = sm213_c15),'Sale',
	   sm213_19, '', '', 'CR','', (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	    '',@UNQID , '', '', '',NEWID(),@m3_19, dbo.getentrydate(), '', @userid, @branch, @systemname
		from SM213_c inner join sm213 on sm213_c4 = sm213.unqid where sm213.UNQID = @UNQID
		group by sm213_c15, sm213.sm213_6, sm213.sm213_8, sm213.sm213_9, sm213.sm213_19;

		END


		----CESS AMOUNT
		if((select sum(sm213_c22) from sm213_c where sm213_c4 = @unqid) != 0)
		INSERT INTO  M3  	
	   SELECT (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),sm213_6,sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,

		 sum(sm213_c22), '', '', 'CR','',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

		----ROUNDOFF

		if((isnull((convert(numeric(18,2),(select sm213_22 from sm213 where unqid = @unqid))),0.00))!=0.00)

		INSERT INTO  M3  	
		SELECT (SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),sm213_6,sm213_8 + '/' + sm213_9,
		UPPER(@roffac),
		'Sale',	
		sm213_22, '', '', (case when (sm213_22*-1)>0.00 then 'DR' else 'CR' end),'',
		(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
		'',@UNQID , '', '', '',NEWID(),@m3_19, dbo.getentrydate(), '', @userid, @branch, @systemname from SM213 where UNQID = @UNQID;
		end

				------insert invn--------
		INSERT INTO INVN VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'',@USERID,@systemname,NEWID(),@UNQID,'DR',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'OTHER SALES' AND BA_17 = @branch),
		(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID),
		(SELECT SM213_23 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID),'FALSE',(SELECT SM213_23 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID),
		(SELECT SM213.SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID),(select sm213_8 + sm213_9 from sm213 where unqid=@unqid),(select DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_62) from sm213 where unqid = @unqid),@branch)
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALE_REGISTER_Q]
@a			NVARCHAR(20) = '',	
@unqid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = ''

AS

IF @a = 'SALE_REGISTER'
BEGIN
--set @fromdate = '01/01/2019'
--set @todate = '01/01/2020'

-----------------------------sale register

SELECT  PA_3 AS [COMPANYNAME], PA_11  +', ' +   UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9),2,LEN((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=PA_9))))
+ ', 342001' AS [ADMOFFICE] FROM PA


SELECT * FROM(
SELECT  CONVERT (NVARCHAR(15),sm213_25,103) AS [DATE],SM213_8 +'/'+SM213_9 AS [INVOICE_NO],'' AS [PRODUCT_CODE],SM213_C6 AS [PRODUCT_HSN],
(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) AS [NAME],
--sm213_31 AS [GSTIN],
(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [GSTIN],
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [STATE_CODE],
UPPER(LEFT(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))),1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))),2,LEN(((SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10))))))AS [STATE],
SUM(SM213_C9) AS [PRODUCT_QUANTITY],SM213_17 AS [AMOUNT_CREDITED],'' AS [FRIEGHT_AMOUNT],(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM213_C15)
AS [GST@],SM213_17 AS [TAXABLE_AMOUNT],'' AS [TRANSFER/EXEMPLED],SM213_20 AS [IGST_AMOUNT],SM213_19 AS [SGST_AMOUNT],SM213_18 AS [CGST_AMOUNT],
SM213_23 AS [TOTAL_AMOUNT] FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN
DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM213_35 = 'OO' AND SM213_9 <>''
-- AND SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
GROUP BY SM213_25,SM213_6,SM213_8 +'/'+SM213_9,SM213_C6,SM213_10,SM213_17,SM213_18,SM213_19,SM213_23,sm213_c15,sm213_20,SM213_31

--UNION ALL

--SELECT '' AS [DATE],'00000' AS [INVOICE_NO],'' AS [PRODUCT_CODE],'' AS [PRODUCT_HSN],'' AS [NAME],'' AS [GSTIN],'' AS [STATE_CODE],'' AS [STATE],
--0 AS [PRODUCT QUANTITY],SUM(SM213_17) AS [AMOUNT_CREDITED],0 AS [FRIEGHT_AMOUNT],0 AS [GST@],SUM(SM213_17) AS [TAXABLE_AMOUNT],0 AS [TRANSFER/EXEMPLED],
--SUM(SM213_20) AS [IGST_AMOUNT],SUM(SM213_19) AS [SGST_AMOUNT],SUM(SM213_18) AS [CGST_AMOUNT],SUM(SM213_23) AS [TOTAL_AMOUNT]
--FROM SM213  WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN
--DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM213_35 = 'OO'
----AND SM213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

) AS AA ORDER BY dbo.getformatteddate([DATE]), CAST((SUBSTRING([INVOICE_NO],5,10)) AS numeric(18,0))ASC

END



GO

-- [A_SP_FOR_SALE_REPORT]   'SALEREPORT'
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALE_REPORT]  

@WHAT AS NVARCHAR(50) =''
AS

IF @WHAT ='SALEREPORT'

BEGIN


--drop table #t 
select name,sum(y2017) as y2017,sum(y2018) AS Y2018, SUM(y2019) as y2019 , SUM(y2020) as y2020 into #t from
(
select (select m1_2 from m1 where m1_1=m4_1) as name , 
--case when m4_3 between '20160401'  and '20170331' then m4_46 else 0 end  as y2016,
case when m4_3 between '20170401'  and '20180331' then m4_46 else 0 end  as y2017,
case when m4_3 between '20180401'  and '20190331' then m4_46 else 0 end  as y2018,
case when m4_3 between '20190401'  and '20200331' then m4_46 else 0 end  as y2019,
0.00 as y2020
 from gm4 
 UNION ALL 
 select (select SM19_5 from SM19 where unqid=SM213_10) as name , 00 AS y2017,00 AS Y2018,00 AS Y2019,
 case when SM213_6 between '2020-04-01'  and '2021-03-31' then SM213_23 else 0 end  as y2020  FROM SM213
 ) as a
 group by name order by name

 --drop table #t1
 select * into #t1 from 
 (
select (select m1_2 from m1 where m1_1=m4_1) as name1 , 
case when m4_3 between '20170401'  and '20180331' then m4_3 else '' end  as d2017 
from gm4  where m4_3 between '20170401'  and '20180331'

)  as a right join #t on a.name1=#t.name 

--select * from #t1
------------------------------------
 --drop table #t2
 select * into #t2 from 
 (
select (select m1_2 from m1 where m1_1=m4_1) as name2 , 
case when m4_3 between '20180401'  and '20190331' then m4_3 else '' end  as d2018 
from gm4  where m4_3 between '20180401'  and '20190331'

)  as a right join #t1 on a.name2=#t1.name 


--drop table #t3
 select * into #t3 from 
 (
select (select m1_2 from m1 where m1_1=m4_1) as name3 , 
case when m4_3 between '20190401'  and '20200331' then m4_3 else '' end  as d2019 
from gm4  where m4_3 between '20190401'  and '20200331'

)  as a right join #t2 on a.name3=#t2.name 


--drop table #t4
 select * into #t4 from 
 (
select (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm213_10) as name4 , 
case when sm213_6 between '2020-04-01'  and '2021-03-31'  then sm213_6 else '' end  as d2020 
from sm213  where sm213_6 between '2020-04-01'  and '2021-03-31'

)  as a right join #t3 on a.name4=#t3.name 






select name,isnull(d2017,'') as d2017,y2017, isnull(d2018,'') as d2018 ,y2018,isnull(d2019,'') as d2019,y2019, case when
convert (nvarchar(10),isnull(d2020,''),112)='19000101' then '' else convert (nvarchar(10),isnull(d2020,''),112) end  as d2020,y2020 from #t4 order by name

END
GO

IF @aa = 'PageCount'
BEGIN
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

 
			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1011),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TM VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
END

IF @aa = 'PageCountLIKE'
BEGIN

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1011 WHERE sm1011_8 LIKE '' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
			SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SALES_POSTING]

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SCHEDULE_MASTER_Q]
@a nvarchar(10),@id nvarchar(36) = '',@User nvarchar(3) = '',@unqid nvarchar(7) = '',@ParentNode nvarchar(7) = '',@level nvarchar(3) = ''
,@Description nvarchar(100) = '',@DrCr nvarchar(7) = '',@RChild nvarchar(5) = '',@RScheDesc nvarchar(100) = '',
@Path nvarchar(400) = '',@ScheType nvarchar(7) = '',@Editable nvarchar(5) = '',@System nvarchar(100) = ''

AS
BEGIN
if @a = 'insert'
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm44]([sm44_1],[sm44_2],[sm44_3],[unqid],[sm44_5],[sm44_6],[sm44_7],[sm44_8],[sm44_9],[sm44_10],[sm44_11]
,[sm44_12],[sm44_13],[sm44_100])
     VALUES
(dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),@User,@unqid,@ParentNode,@level,@Description,@DrCr,@RChild,@RScheDesc,@Path,
	@ScheType,@Editable,@System)
END

if @a = 'delete'
BEGIN
DELETE FROM [dbo].[sm44]
WHERE unqid = @id AND NOT Exists(select a.unqid, sm19_6 from sm44 a, sm19
where a.unqid = @id and (sm19_6 = a.unqid))
END

if @a = 'edit'
BEGIN 
UPDATE [dbo].[sm44]
   SET [sm44_2] = dbo.entrydate(),[sm44_3] = @User,[sm44_5] = @ParentNode,[sm44_6] = @level,[sm44_7] = @Description
   ,[sm44_8] = @DrCr,[sm44_9] = @RChild,[sm44_10] = @RScheDesc,[sm44_11] = @Path,[sm44_12] = @ScheType,[sm44_13] = @Editable
   ,[sm44_100] = @System
 WHERE unqid = @id
End

if @a = 'select'
BEGIN 
select * from [dbo].[sm44]
End


IF @a = 'ALL'
BEGIN
            SELECT sm44_12
            FROM sm44
end

      ELSE
	  BEGIN
            SELECT sm44_12
            FROM sm44 WHERE sm44_12=@a 
end


-- if @a = 'unqid'
--BEGIN 
--select MAX (CAST( unqid as nvarchar)) from sm44
-- end
END




GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SMS_EMAIL_Q]
@WHAT			 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@SM222_3         NVARCHAR(3)   = '',
@SM222_4         NVARCHAR(10)  = '',
@SM222_100       NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@SM222_5         NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@SM222_6         NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SM222_7         NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM222_8         NVARCHAR(100) = '',
@SM222_9         NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@SM222_10        NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM222_11        NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@SM222_12        NVARCHAR(5)   = '',
@SM222_13        NVARCHAR(15)  = '',
@SM222_14        NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@FROMDATE        NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE          NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SEB             NVARCHAR(10)  = '',
@IROA	         NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@OAMOUNT		 NVARCHAR(50)  = '', 
@OSMS			 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM217_UNQID	 NVARCHAR(36)  = ''
AS
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'INSERT'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO SM222 VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'',@SM222_3,NEWID(),@SM222_4,@SM222_100,@SM222_5,
		@SM222_6,@SM222_7,@SM222_8,@SM222_9,@SM222_10,@SM222_11,@SM222_12,@SM222_13,@SM222_14)
	END
	IF @WHAT = 'REPORT'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @STR_S AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@STR_U AS NVARCHAR(MAX);
		------------------------ FOR SENT DATA ---------------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT @STR_S = 'SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM222_8 AS [TYPE],SM222_5 AS [TYPE NO],SM222_6 AS [TYPE DATE],
		(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = SM222_11)) AS [SENT TO],
		SM222_1 AS [SEND ON],SM222_14 AS [EMAIL TO],SM222_13 AS [SMS TO],SM222_10 AS [REASON] FROM SM222 
		WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM222_1) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('''+ @FROMDATE +''') AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('''+ @TODATE+''') 
		AND SM222_9 = ''SENT'''
		IF @SEB = 'SMS' OR @SEB = 'EMAIL'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_S = @STR_S + ' AND SM222_12 = ''' + @SEB + ''''
		END
		IF @IROA = 'INVOICE' OR @IROA = 'RETURN' OR @IROA = 'OUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_S = @STR_S + ' AND SM222_8 = ''' + @IROA + ''''
		END
		IF @SELECTEDPARTIES != ''
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_S = @STR_S + ' AND SM222_11 IN (SELECT SM213.UNQID FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10 IN ('''+ @SELECTEDPARTIES + '''))' 
		END
		SELECT @STR_S = @STR_S + ' ORDER BY SM222_1 DESC'
		PRINT @STR_S
		EXEC (@STR_S)
		------------------------ FOR UNSENT DATA ---------------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT @STR_U = 'SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM222_8 AS [TYPE],SM222_5 AS [TYPE NO],SM222_6 AS [TYPE DATE],
		(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = SM222_11)) AS [SENT TO],
		SM222_1 AS [SEND ON],SM222_14 AS [EMAIL TO],SM222_13 AS [SMS TO],SM222_10 AS [REASON] FROM SM222 
		WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(SM222_1) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('''+ @FROMDATE +''') AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE('''+ @TODATE+''') 
		AND SM222_9 != ''SENT'''
		IF @SEB = 'SMS' OR @SEB = 'EMAIL'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_U = @STR_U + ' AND SM222_12 = ''' + @SEB + ''''
		END
		IF @IROA = 'INVOICE' OR @IROA = 'RETURN' OR @IROA = 'OUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_U = @STR_U + ' AND SM222_8 = ''' + @IROA + ''''
		END
		IF @SELECTEDPARTIES != ''
		BEGIN
			SELECT @STR_U = @STR_U + ' AND SM222_11 IN (SELECT SM213.UNQID FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10 IN ('''+ @SELECTEDPARTIES + '''))' 
		END
		SELECT @STR_U = @STR_U + ' ORDER BY SM222_1 DESC'
		PRINT @STR_U
		EXEC (@STR_U)
	END
	IF @WHAT = 'BIND'
	BEGIN
		-------------TABLE 0: PARTY NAME
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID], SM19_5 AS [PARTY NAME] FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5 ASC

		------------TABLE 1: FY DATE
		SELECT PA_1 AS [FROMDATE] FROM PA
	END
	IF @WHAT = 'SMS'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SMSTEXT AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@INVNO AS NVARCHAR(30),@AMOUNT AS NVARCHAR(50),@MOBILENO AS NVARCHAR(15),
		@SMSUID AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@SMSPSWD AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@SMSSENDERID AS NVARCHAR(MAX);
		SELECT @SMSUID = PA_54,@SMSPSWD = PA_55 ,@SMSSENDERID = PA_56 FROM PA;
		IF @IROA = 'INVOICE'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AMOUNT = SM213_23,@INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = PA_41 FROM PA;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = @SMSTEXT + ' INVOICE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'RETURN'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AMOUNT = SM213_23,@INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = PA_43 FROM PA;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = @SMSTEXT + ' CREDIT NOTE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'OUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = PA_42 FROM PA;
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = @SMSTEXT + ' INVOICE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'COUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SMSTEXT = @OSMS + ' . DUE AMOUNT = ' + @OAMOUNT + '.'
		END
		SELECT @MOBILENO = SM19_20 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11)
		SELECT @SMSTEXT AS [SMSTEXT],@MOBILENO AS [MOBILENO],@SMSUID AS [SMSUID],@SMSPSWD AS [SMSPSWD],@SMSSENDERID AS [SMSSENDERID];
	END
	IF @WHAT = 'EMAIL'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @EMAILTEXT AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@EINVNO AS NVARCHAR(30),@EAMOUNT AS NVARCHAR(50),
		@FEMAILID AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@TOCC AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@TOBCC AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@HOST AS NVARCHAR(20),
		@PORT AS NVARCHAR(20),@SSL AS NVARCHAR(5),@EUSERID AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@PSWD AS NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@TEMAILID AS NVARCHAR(MAX);

		SELECT @FEMAILID = PA_44,@TOCC = PA_45,@TOBCC = PA_46 FROM PA;
		IF @IROA = 'INVOICE'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AMOUNT = SM213_23,@INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = PA_41 FROM PA;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = @EMAILTEXT + ' INVOICE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'RETURN'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AMOUNT = SM213_23,@INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = PA_43 FROM PA;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = @EMAILTEXT + ' CREDIT NOTE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'OUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @INVNO = SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = PA_42 FROM PA;
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = @EMAILTEXT + ' INVOICE NO. = ' + @INVNO + ' ,DUE AMOUNT = ' + @AMOUNT + '.'
		END
		IF @IROA = 'COUTSTANDING'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @EMAILTEXT = @OSMS + ' . DUE AMOUNT = ' + @OAMOUNT + '.'
		END
		SELECT @TEMAILID = SM19_17 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM213_10 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @SM222_11);
		SELECT @EMAILTEXT AS [TEXT],@FEMAILID AS [FROM],@TOCC AS [CC],@TOBCC AS [BCC],@HOST AS [HOST],@PORT AS [PORT],@SSL AS [SSL],
		@EUSERID AS [USERID],@PSWD AS [PSWD], @TEMAILID
	END
	IF @WHAT = 'GETDETAILS'
	BEGIN
		SELECT (CASE WHEN PA_52 = '0' THEN 'FALSE' ELSE (CASE WHEN PA_52 = '1' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 
		(CASE WHEN PA_52 IS NULL THEN 'FALSE' ELSE PA_52 END) END) END) AS [SMS],
		(CASE WHEN PA_53 = '0' THEN 'FALSE' ELSE (CASE WHEN pa_53 = '1' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 
		(CASE WHEN PA_53 IS NULL THEN 'FALSE' ELSE PA_53 END) END) END) AS [EMAIL] FROM PA;

		SELECT TOP 1 SM213.UNQID AS [SM222_11] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_10 = (SELECT SM217_5 FROM SM217 WHERE UNQID = @SM217_UNQID) ORDER BY CAST(SM213_9 AS NUMERIC(10,0)) DESC
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SOFTWARE_INVOICE_LIST_Q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
