CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SOFTWARE_INVOICE_LIST_Q] 
@AA			 NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@MONTH		 NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@USERID		 NVARCHAR(3)   = '',
@SERVERNAME  NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DATE		 NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@ACCOUNTNAME NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@PRODUCT	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@DESCRIPTION NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@QUANTITY    NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@RATE        NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@AMOUNT      NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@TAX		 NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@NETAMOUNT   NVARCHAR(50)  = '',
@SELECT		 NVARCHAR(5)   = '',
@REMARKS	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@SM217_UNQID NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@REMARKS2	 NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
declare @monthno as nvarchar(10),@year as nvarchar(10);
	IF @AA = 'GETINVOICES'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM19.UNQID,SM19_5 AS [PARTY_NAME],DBO.GETENTRYDATE() AS [DATE],'SOFTWARE' AS [PRODUCT],
		(SELECT SM208_5 FROM sm208 WHERE unqid= SM19_C4) + ' SOFTWARE ' AS [DESCRIPTION],
		'1.00' AS [QUANTITY],SM19_C7 AS [RATE],SM19_C7*(1) AS [AMOUNT],'18.00' AS [TAX],CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),((SM19_C7)+ (SM19_C7*(0.18)))) AS [NET_AMOUNT]
		FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM19_C ON SM19.UNQID = SM19_C2 
		--INNER JOIN SM221 ON SM221_1 = SM19_5 WHERE SM221_2 = 'APPROVED' AND SM221_3 = 'PENDING'
		ORDER BY SM19_5
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM217'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @MONTH=  SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@DATE),1),0,3)
		INSERT INTO SM217 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,@ACCOUNTNAME,dbo.getformatteddate(@DATE),@PRODUCT,@DESCRIPTION,
		@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@TAX,@NETAMOUNT,@REMARKS,@SELECT,@MONTH)
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'DELETESM217'
	BEGIN
		IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM218 WHERE SM218_19 = @MONTH AND YEAR(SM218_6) BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(PA_1) FROM PA) AND (SELECT YEAR(PA_2) FROM PA))>0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT '1'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM SM217 WHERE SM217_16 = @MONTH AND YEAR(SM217_6) BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(PA_1) FROM PA) AND (SELECT YEAR(PA_2) FROM PA)
			SELECT '2'
		END
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'SELECTFORAPPROVAL'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM217.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM217_5 AS [ACC_UNQID],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM217_5) AS [PARTY_NAME],
		DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM217_6) AS [DATE],SM217_7 AS [PRODUCT],SM217_8 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM217_9 AS [QUANTITY],SM217_10 AS [RATE],
		SM217_11 AS [AMOUNT],SM217_12 AS [TAX],SM217_13 AS [NET_AMOUNT],SM217_14 AS [REASON],SM217_15 AS [SELECT]
		FROM SM217 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM217_15))) IN('TRUE','1') AND SM217.UNQID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SM218_18 FROM SM218) 
		ORDER BY SM217_16 ASC--AND SM217_16 = @MONTH
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'INSERTSM218'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @SELECT = CASE WHEN @SELECT = '1' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE (CASE WHEN @SELECT = '0' THEN 'FALSE' ELSE (@SELECT) END) END
		SELECT @MONTH = (SELECT SM217_16 FROM SM217 WHERE UNQID = @SM217_UNQID)
		INSERT INTO SM218 VALUES(Dbo.getentrydate(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SERVERNAME,@ACCOUNTNAME,dbo.getformatteddate(@DATE),@PRODUCT,@DESCRIPTION,
		@QUANTITY,@RATE,@AMOUNT,@TAX,@NETAMOUNT,@SELECT,@REMARKS,@REMARKS2,dbo.getentrydate(),@SM217_UNQID,@MONTH)
		------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		--AUTO INSERT
		IF @SELECT  = '1' OR @SELECT = 'TRUE'
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @what nvarchar(30)='', @sm213_1	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_2	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_3	nvarchar(50)='',@unqid		nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_5	nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_100  nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_6    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_7    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_8    nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_9    nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_10   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_11   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_12   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_13   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_14   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_15   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_16   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_17   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_18   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_19   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_20   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_21   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_22   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_23   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_24   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_25   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_26   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_27   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_28   nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_29   nvarchar(36)='',@sm213_30   nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_33	nvarchar(30)='',@sm213_34	nvarchar(30)='',@RCUST		nvarchar(36)='';

			Declare @sm213_c1 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c2 nvarchar(50)='',@unqidC nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c4 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c5 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c6 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c7 nvarchar(MAX)='',@sm213_c8 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c9 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c10 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c11 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c12 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c13 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c14 nvarchar(50)='',
			@sm213_c15 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c16 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c17 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c18 nvarchar(50)='',@sm213_c19 nvarchar(50)='';

			SELECT  @what = 'sale_parent',@sm213_1 = '',@sm213_2 = '',@sm213_3 = @USERID,@unqid = NEWID(),@sm213_5 = '',
			@sm213_100 = @SERVERNAME,@sm213_6 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@DATE),@sm213_7 = 'CREDIT',
			@sm213_8 = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_8 FROM SM213 WHERE SM213_9 = (select isnull(max(Cast([sm213_9] as numeric(18,0))),0) from [sm213] where sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
			@sm213_9 = (select isnull(max(Cast([sm213_9] as numeric(18,0))),0) + 1 from [sm213] where sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
			@sm213_10 = @ACCOUNTNAME,@sm213_11 = '',@sm213_12 = '',@sm213_13 = '',
			@sm213_14 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') THEN
			('CGST + SGST') ELSE ('IGST') END),@sm213_15 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_16 = '0.00',@sm213_17 = @AMOUNT,
			@sm213_18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_19 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_20 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)) END),@sm213_21 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_22 = '0.00',
			@sm213_23 = @NETAMOUNT,@sm213_24 = '',@sm213_25 = '',@sm213_26 = '',@sm213_27 = '',@sm213_28 = '',@sm213_29 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
			@sm213_30 = (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)),	@sm213_33 = '',@sm213_34 = '',@RCUST = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

			INSERT INTO sm213(sm213_1,sm213_2,sm213_3,unqid,sm213_5,sm213_100,sm213_6,sm213_7,sm213_8,sm213_9,sm213_10,sm213_11,
			sm213_12,sm213_13,sm213_14,sm213_15,sm213_16,sm213_17,sm213_18,sm213_19,sm213_20,sm213_21,sm213_22,sm213_23,sm213_24,
			sm213_25,sm213_26,sm213_27,sm213_28,sm213_29,sm213_30,sm213_31,sm213_32,sm213_33,sm213_34) 
			values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_2,@sm213_3,@unqid ,@sm213_5,@sm213_100,DBO.getformatteddate(@sm213_6),@sm213_7,@sm213_8,
			@sm213_9,@sm213_10,@sm213_11,@sm213_12,@sm213_13,@sm213_14,@sm213_15,@sm213_16,@sm213_17,@sm213_18,@sm213_19,@sm213_20,
			@sm213_21,@sm213_22,@sm213_23,@sm213_24,@sm213_25,@sm213_26,@sm213_27,@sm213_28,@sm213_29,@sm213_30,
			(select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = @sm213_10),'','',''); 

			SELECT @WHAT = 'SALE_CHILD',@sm213_c1 = '',@sm213_c2 = '',@unqidC = NEWID(),@sm213_c4 = @UNQID,@sm213_c5 = (SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT),
			@sm213_c6 = (SELECT SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT),@sm213_c7 = @DESCRIPTION,
			@sm213_c8 = (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE SM209.UNQID = (SELECT SM206_14 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9 = @PRODUCT)),@sm213_c9 = @QUANTITY,@sm213_c10 = @RATE,
			@sm213_c11 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_c12 = '0.00',@sm213_c13 = '0.00',@sm213_c14 = @AMOUNT,@sm213_c15 = (SELECT SM210.UNQID FROM SM210 WHERE SM210_7 = @TAX),
			@sm213_c16 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_c17 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN ((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT))/2) ELSE '0.00' END),
			@sm213_c18 = (CASE WHEN (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE SM205.UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = @ACCOUNTNAME)) IN ('8','08') 
			THEN '0.00' ELSE (CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@NETAMOUNT) - CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,2),@AMOUNT)) END),
			@sm213_c19 = @NETAMOUNT;

			insert into sm213_c(sm213_c1,sm213_c2,unqid,sm213_c4,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,
			sm213_c14,sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19) 
			values(dbo.getentrydate(),@sm213_c2,newid(),@sm213_c4,@sm213_c5,@sm213_c6,@sm213_c7,@sm213_c8,@sm213_c9,@sm213_c10,@sm213_c11,@sm213_c12,
			@sm213_c13,@sm213_c14,@sm213_c15,@sm213_c16,@sm213_c17,@sm213_c18,@sm213_c19);

			-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			--AUTO POSTING
			DECLARE @GSTNATURE AS NVARCHAR(36),@OUTLETID AS NVARCHAR(10),@M3_19 AS NVARCHAR(30);
			SELECT @what = 'SALES',@GSTNATURE = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',@OUTLETID = 'Q',@M3_19 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE();
			EXEC [DBO].[a_sp_for_ledger_posting_Q] 'SALES',@UNQID,@GSTNATURE,@USERID,@OUTLETID,@SERVERNAME,@M3_19
		END
		------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'APPROVEDLIST'
	BEGIN
			SELECT (SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM218_5) AS [PARTY NAME],
			DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM218_6) AS [DATE],SM218_7 AS [PRODUCT],SM218_8 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM218_9 AS [QUANTITY],SM218_10 AS [RATE],
			SM218_11 AS [AMOUNT],SM218_12 AS [TAX],SM218_13 AS [NET AMOUNT],SM218_16 AS [REMARKS2]
			FROM SM218 WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(LTRIM(SM218_14))) IN('TRUE','1') AND SM218_19 = @MONTH
	END
	ELSE IF @AA = 'ALLDD'
	BEGIN
		-- TABLE 0 ACCOUNT
		SELECT SM19.UNQID AS [UNQID],SM19_5 AS [NAME] FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5

		-- TABLE 1 PRODUCT
		SELECT SM206_2 AS [UNQID],SM206_9 AS [NAME] FROM SM206 ORDER BY SM206_9

		-- TABLE 2 GST
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM210_7 AS [NAME] FROM SM210 ORDER BY SM210_7
	END
END

GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SOFTWARE_MASTER_Q]
@what		   nvarchar(15) ='', 
@SM208_1	   nvarchar(50) ='',		---- entrydate
@SM208_2	   nvarchar(50) ='',		---- modifydate
@SM208_3       nvarchar(50) ='',		---- usrid
@unqid		   nvarchar(50) ='',		---- unqid
@SM208_5       nvarchar(50) ='',		---- Name	 
@SM208_6       nvarchar(MAX)='',		---- Code
@SM208_100     nvarchar(50) =''			---- IP
AS
BEGIN
	if @what = 'insert'
	BEGIN 
		SET @UNQID = NEWID();
		INSERT INTO SM208 VALUES(getutcdate(),getutcdate(),@SM208_3,@UNQID,@SM208_5,@SM208_6,@SM208_100);
	END

	if @what = 'add'
	BEGIN 
		SELECT MAX(CAST(SM208_6 AS INT)) FROM SM208
	END

	If @what = 'update'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM208 SET SM208_2 = getutcdate(), SM208_5 = @SM208_5 WHERE SM208_6 = @SM208_6 
	END

	If @what = 'display'
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID, SM208_5, SM208_6 FROM SM208
	END
END


GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SSR_REPORT_Q] 
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@unqid               NVARCHAR(max)  = '',
@FROMDATE            NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@TODATE              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@warehouse      NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@PRODUCT   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCTUNQ   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@BRANCHID     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@uid        NVARCHAR(MAX)  ='',
@designation			as  nvarchar(50) = '',
@des        nvarchar(50) = ''

	
AS
begin 
	
	IF @AA = 'BINDB'
    BEGIN
       
        -- TABLE 0: BRANCH DROPDOWN
     
        set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	    select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname from SM1002 
	    where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	    ORDER BY SM1002_7

		 -- TABLE 1: PRODUCT CATEGORY DROPDOWN
        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname --[PCATEGORY] 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;
      
	   -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname --[PRODUCT] 
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC;

		 -- TABLE 3: WAREHOUSE DROPDOWN
        select  unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname --[WAREHOUSE]  
		from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
		order by Dname;


    END

	IF @AA = 'warehouse'
	begin

	    -- WAREHOUSE DROPDOWN
        select  unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname --[WAREHOUSE]  
		from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
		order by Dname;

	end
	
	IF @AA = 'BINDC'
    BEGIN
        

        -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT CATEGORY DROPDOWN
        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS Dname --[PCATEGORY]

        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;
    END

        ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC;

     
    END

	begin

	end

       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH

	SELECT
    Product, 
    [DATE], 
    Particulars, 
    Unit,branches , warehouse, 
  CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS RECEIPTS,
  CAST(SUM(ISSUE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS ISSUE, 
  CAST(SUM(OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS OPENI,
  CAST(SUM(EXCESS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS EXCESS, 
  CAST(SUM(SHORTAGE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS SHORTAGE,
  CAST(SUM(closing) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS closing,
  CAST(SUM(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI)) 
  OVER (PARTITION by product order BY product, [DATE], ORD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS Balance,
    ORD into #t
FROM (
    -- Opening Balance Calculation
   SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_7  as Product, 
        @fromdate AS [DATE], 
        'Opening Balance' AS Particulars, 
        sm209.sm209_7 as Unit, branches,  Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        ISSUE, 
		SUM(OPENI) AS OPENI,
        EXCESS, 
        SHORTAGE, 
		0.00 AS closing, 
        0 AS ORD
    FROM (

	 -- Opening for Purchase
        SELECT 
            sm1005.sm1005_10 AS Product, 
            sm1005.sm1005_54 AS Unit,
			(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1005_7) as branches, 
		    sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
          0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE, 
			 --(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,3))/100 ELSE SM1005_45 end )  As OPENI,
		SM1005_57*1000  As OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1005
		  INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
		  INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38

         WHERE SM1005_6 < @fromdate and sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
		 and sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
		  and sm1005_38  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))---------------here---------------
        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Opening
        SELECT 
            sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 

            sm209.unqid  AS Unit, 
						(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1023_4) as branches, 
			 sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
			--line added by garima
			(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as OPENI,
			0 as EXCESS,
			0 as SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1023
		 inner join sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid  = sm1023.sm1023_6
		inner join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
		right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
		left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
          WHERE
		  sm1023_5 < @fromdate and sm1023_c6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ',')) 
		  and sm1023_4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
		  and  sm1023.sm1023_6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))------------here-----------------

        UNION ALL
		
		
		 -- Opening for Shortage/Excess
        SELECT 
            sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
            sm1014.sm1014_11  AS Unit,
		(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1014_9) as branches, 
			sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,  
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
			(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) -
			 (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) as OPENI,
           0 AS EXCESS,
		
		  0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1014
		right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
		left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
		inner JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9

          WHERE
		  --sm1014_14 <> 0 AND 
		  sm1014.sm1014_6 < @fromdate and sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
		  and sm1014.sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
		   and sm1014_9  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))-------------here----------------
        --GROUP BY sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9

        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Sales
        SELECT 
            sm1011.sm1011_13 AS Product, 
            sm1011.sm1011_23 AS Unit,
			(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1011_41) as branches, 
			sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0  AS ISSUE, 
			isnull(SM1011_42,0)*-1 as OPENI,
			-- (CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end )*-1 as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1011
       inner join sm1006 on  sm1006.unqid  =  sm1011.sm1011_39
        WHERE sm1011_6 < @fromdate and  sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
		and sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1011_39  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))--------------here---------------
    ) AS Opening
	right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = product
    left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = unit
    left JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = warehouse

    GROUP BY sm206_7,Product, Unit,sm209.sm209_7,sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE, warehouse, branches

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Receipts
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM1005_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm1005_12 + ' ' + FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'dd/MM/yyyy') + ' ' + sm1005_8 + ' Goods Receipt (' + sm1005_17 + ')' AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit,
					(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1005_7) as brances, 
					sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
          --CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,3))/100 ELSE SM1005_45*SM209_10  END  AS RECEIPTS, 
		 SM1005_57*1000 AS RECEIPTS,
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE,
		0.00 AS closing,  
        1 AS ORD
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
	  INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38
    WHERE SM1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate  and sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	  and sm1005_38  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))--------------here----------------
    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Shortage/Excess
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM1014_6 AS [DATE], 
        CASE 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  sm1014_13 + ' Goods Shortage' 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN   sm1014_13 +' Goods Excess' 
        END AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit,
					(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1014_7) as branches, 
					sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        --SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14*SM209_10  ELSE 0.000 END) AS EXCESS,
		(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS EXCESS,
		
       ( CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS SHORTAGE, 
        0.00 AS closing, 
		2 AS ORD
    FROM sm1014
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
    INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9

    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
    WHERE 
	--sm1014_14 <> 0 AND
	SM1014_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate and  sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	and sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and  sm1014.sm1014_9  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))--------------here------------------
    --GROUP BY sm206_7, SM1014_6, sm209_7, sm1014_17

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Sales
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        sm1011_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm1011_7 + ' Sales' AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit, 
					(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1011_41) as branches, sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        SM1011_42*SM209_10  AS ISSUE, 
		-- (CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end ) AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE, 
		0.00 AS closing, 
        3 AS ORD
    FROM sm1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
	inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid =  sm1011_39 
    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate and  sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	and sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1011_39  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))---------------here-----------------
UNION ALL



SELECT 
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product, 
    @todate AS [DATE], 
    'Closing Balance' AS Particulars, 
    sm209.sm209_7 AS Unit,
				branches, Warehouse,
     0 AS RECEIPTS, 
    0 as ISSUE, 
	0 asOPENI,
    0 asEXCESS, 
    0 as SHORTAGE, 
	isnull(CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18,0)),0) *SM209_10 AS closing, 
    4 AS ORD
FROM (
    -- Closing for Purchase
    SELECT 
        sm1005.sm1005_10 AS Product, 
        sm1005.sm1005_54 AS Unit,
					(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1005_7) as branches, sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse , 
       -- (CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1005_45 end )  AS RECEIPTS, 
		SM1005_57*1000 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0 AS ISSUE, 
		0 as OPENI,
        0 AS EXCESS, 
        0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1005
	INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
	  INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= @todate AND sm1005.sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1005_38  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))-------------here--------------
    UNION ALL

	-- Closing for Opening
    SELECT 
       sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
       sm209.unqid AS Unit,			(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1023_4) as branches, 
	   sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
       0 AS RECEIPTS, 
       0 AS ISSUE,  
	   (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as OPENI,
       0 AS EXCESS,
		
       0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1023
	 inner join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
	 inner join sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid  = sm1023.sm1023_6

	 INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
	 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
    WHERE sm1023.sm1023_5<= @todate AND sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ',')) 
	and sm1023_4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
 and  sm1023.sm1023_6  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))-------------here-----------------
    --GROUP BY sm1014.sm1014_10, sm1014.sm1014_11

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing for Shortage/Excess
    SELECT 
        sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
        sm1014.sm1014_11 AS Unit,			(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1014_7) as branches, 
		sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0 AS ISSUE,  
		0 as OPENI,
       (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS EXCESS,
		
       ( CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1014
	 INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
	 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11

	 INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9
    WHERE sm1014.sm1014_6 <= @todate AND sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	and sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and  sm1014.sm1014_9  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))--------------here----------------
    --GROUP BY sm1014.sm1014_10, sm1014.sm1014_11

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing for Sales (if applicable)
    SELECT 
        sm1011.sm1011_13 AS Product, 
        sm1011.sm1011_23 AS Unit,			(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  sm1011_41) as branches,   sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
       ISNULL(sm1011.sm1011_42, 0)  AS ISSUE, 
	    --(CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end )AS ISSUE,
		0 as OPENI,
        0 AS EXCESS, 
        0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1011
	inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid =  sm1011_39 
    WHERE sm1011.sm1011_6 <= @todate AND sm1011.sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
	 and sm1011_39  IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))---------------here----------------
) AS Closing
RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = Closing.Product
LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = Closing.Unit
LEFT JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = Closing.warehouse

GROUP BY sm206.sm206_7, Closing.Product, Closing.Unit,branches, Closing.warehouse, sm209.sm209_7,sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE

) AS FinalResult
GROUP BY Product, [DATE], Particulars, Unit, branches, warehouse ,  ORD
--having count(product)>2
ORDER BY
--branches, warehouse , 
Product, DATE ASC, ORD ASC;

--select product from #t group by product having count(*)>2
select * from #t where product in(select product from #t group by product having count(*)>2) ORDER BY 
branches, warehouse , Product, DATE ASC, ORD ASC;



	
	END


if @aa='combined'
begin 
if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else   
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;



SELECT 
    branches,
    warehouse,
    Product, 
    [DATE], 
    Particulars, 
    Unit,
    CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS RECEIPTS,
    CAST(SUM(ISSUE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS ISSUE, 
    CAST(SUM(OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS OPENI,
    CAST(SUM(EXCESS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS EXCESS, 
    CAST(SUM(SHORTAGE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS SHORTAGE,
    CAST(SUM(closing) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS closing,
    CAST(SUM(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI)) 
        OVER (PARTITION BY branches, warehouse, product 
              ORDER BY branches, warehouse, product, [DATE], ORD 
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS Balance,
    ORD-- into --#t1
FROM (
    -- Opening Balance Calculation
    SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_7 as Product, 
        @fromdate AS [DATE], 
        'Opening Balance' AS Particulars, 
        sm209.sm209_7 as Unit, 
        branches,  
        Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        ISSUE, 
        SUM(OPENI) AS OPENI,
        EXCESS, 
        SHORTAGE, 
        0.00 AS closing, 
        0 AS ORD
    FROM (
        -- Opening for Purchase
        SELECT 
            sm1005.sm1005_10 AS Product, 
            sm1005.sm1005_54 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_7) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE, 
            SM1005_57*1000 As OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1005
        INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38
        WHERE SM1005_6 < @fromdate 
            AND sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1005_38 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Opening
        SELECT 
            sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
            sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1023_4) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
            (CASE WHEN @des != 'Auditor' THEN (sm1023_c8) ELSE (sm1023_c9) END) as OPENI,
            0 as EXCESS,
            0 as SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1023
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1023.sm1023_6
        INNER JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
        RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
        LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
        WHERE sm1023_5 < @fromdate 
            AND sm1023_c6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ',')) 
            AND sm1023_4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1023.sm1023_6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Shortage/Excess
        SELECT 
            sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
            sm1014.sm1014_11 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1014_9) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,  
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
            (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14 END ELSE 0.00 END) -
            (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14 END ELSE 0.00 END) as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS,
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1014
        RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
        LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9
        WHERE sm1014.sm1014_6 < @fromdate 
            AND sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1014.sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))

        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Sales
        SELECT 
            sm1011.sm1011_13 AS Product, 
            sm1011.sm1011_23 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1011_41) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE, 
            ISNULL(SM1011_42,0)*-1 as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1011
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_39
        WHERE sm1011_6 < @fromdate 
            AND sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1011_39 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))
    ) AS Opening
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = product
    LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = unit
    LEFT JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = warehouse
    GROUP BY sm206_7, Product, Unit, sm209.sm209_7, sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE, warehouse, branches

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Receipts
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM1005_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm1005_12 + ' ' + FORMAT(SM1005_6, 'dd/MM/yyyy') + ' ' + sm1005_8 + ' Goods Receipt (' + sm1005_17 + ')' AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_7) as branches, 
        sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        SM1005_57*1000 AS RECEIPTS,
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
        0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE,
        0.00 AS closing,  
        1 AS ORD
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
    INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38
    WHERE SM1005_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate  
        AND sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
        AND sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
        AND sm1005_38 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Shortage/Excess
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM1014_6 AS [DATE], 
        CASE 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN sm1014_13 + ' Goods Shortage' 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN sm1014_13 +' Goods Excess' 
        END AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit,
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1014_7) as branches, 
        sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
        0.00 as OPENI,
        (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14 END ELSE 0.00 END) AS EXCESS,
        (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14 END ELSE 0.00 END) AS SHORTAGE, 
        0.00 AS closing, 
        2 AS ORD
    FROM sm1014
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
    INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate 
        AND sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
        AND sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
        AND sm1014.sm1014_9 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Sales
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        sm1011_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm1011_7 + ' Sales' AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit, 
        (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1011_41) as branches, 
        sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        SM1011_42*SM209_10 AS ISSUE, 
        0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE, 
        0.00 AS closing, 
        3 AS ORD
    FROM sm1011
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_23
    INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1011_39 
    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate 
        AND sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
        AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
        AND sm1011_39 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing Balance
    SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_7 AS Product, 
        @todate AS [DATE], 
        'Closing Balance' AS Particulars, 
        sm209.sm209_7 AS Unit,
        branches, 
        Warehouse,
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0 as ISSUE, 
        0 as OPENI,
        0 as EXCESS, 
        0 as SHORTAGE, 
        ISNULL(CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18,0)),0) * SM209_10 AS closing, 
        4 AS ORD
    FROM (
        -- Closing for Purchase
        SELECT 
            sm1005.sm1005_10 AS Product, 
            sm1005.sm1005_54 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_7) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse, 
            SM1005_57*1000 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE, 
            0 as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1005
        INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_38
        WHERE sm1005_6 <= @todate 
            AND sm1005.sm1005_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1005_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1005_38 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

        UNION ALL

        -- Closing for Opening
        SELECT 
            sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
            sm209.unqid AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1023_4) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,  
            (CASE WHEN @des != 'Auditor' THEN (sm1023_c8) ELSE (sm1023_c9) END) as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS,
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1023
        INNER JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1023.sm1023_6

            AND sm1023.sm1023_6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 
            sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
            sm1014.sm1014_11 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1014_7) as branches, 
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS,

        FROM sm1014
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
        INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_9
        WHERE sm1014.sm1014_6 <= @todate 
            AND sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1014.sm1014_9 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))

        UNION ALL

        -- Closing for Sales
        SELECT 
            sm1011.sm1011_13 AS Product, 
            sm1011.sm1011_23 AS Unit,
            (SELECT sm1002_7 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1011_41) as branches,   
            sm1006.sm1006_5 as Warehouse,
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            ISNULL(sm1011.sm1011_42, 0) AS ISSUE, 
            0 as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1011
        INNER JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = sm1011_39 
        WHERE sm1011.sm1011_6 <= @todate 
            AND sm1011.sm1011_13 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
            AND sm1011_41 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
            AND sm1011_39 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@WAREHOUSE, ','))
    ) AS Closing
    RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = Closing.Product
    LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = Closing.Unit
    LEFT JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.unqid = Closing.warehouse
    GROUP BY sm206.sm206_7, Closing.Product, Closing.Unit, branches, Closing.warehouse, sm209.sm209_7, sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE
) AS FinalResult
GROUP BY branches, warehouse, Product, [DATE], Particulars, Unit, ORD
ORDER BY branches, warehouse, Product, DATE ASC, ORD ASC;

--select * from #t1 where product in (select product from #t1 group by product having count(*)>2) ORDER BY 
--branches, warehouse , Product, DATE ASC, ORD ASC;

	



	
	END
	
	if @aa = 'demostore'
    begin
	      delete from Sm1024
	      insert into Sm1024 values(@uid,@unqid);
		 -- select * from Stock_Registor
    end

	if @AA ='retrieveunq'
	begin
	
	      select unqid from Sm1024
	end
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STATEMASTER_Q]
@what         nvarchar(15)='', ----
@sm205_1      nvarchar(50)='', ----entrydate
@sm205_2	  nvarchar(50)='', ----modifydate
@sm205_3	  nvarchar(50)='', ----usrid
@sm205_5	  nvarchar(50)='', ----Name
@unqid	      nvarchar(50)='', ----unqid
@sm205_7	  nvarchar(50)='', ----code
@sm205_100    nvarchar(50)='',  ----ip
@sm205_8	  nvarchar(36)=''  ----country unqid

AS
BEGIN
if @what = 'insert'
BEGIN 
 SET  @unqid = NEWID()
INSERT INTO sm205 values(getutcdate(),getutcdate(),@sm205_3,@sm205_5,@unqid,@sm205_7,@sm205_100,@sm205_8);
 end
 
  if @what = 'Update'
BEGIN
Update sm205 set sm205_2=getutcdate(),sm205_5=@sm205_5,sm205_8=@sm205_8  from sm205 where UNQID = @unqid;
			   end
			   
 if @what = 'Delete'
BEGIN
Delete From sm205 where unqid=@unqid;
END
 if @what = 'SelectById'
BEGIN
select unqid as unq
       ,sm205_5 as city
       ,unqid as statecode
       ,sm205_7 as code
	   ,sm205_8 as country from sm205 where unqid=@unqid;
	   end

	    if @what = 'SelectAll'
BEGIN
Select * from sm205 order by sm205_1; 
END

if @what = 'StateCode'
BEGIN 
select MAX (CAST( sm205_7 as INT)) from sm205
 end

if @what = 'CountryDrop'
BEGIN 
select * from sm02
 end

end	



GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STOCK_RECEIPT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE[dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STOCK_RECEIPT]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@what			as nvarchar(50)='',
@unqid		    nvarchar(50)='',
@branch	        nvarchar(max)='',
@uid      nvarchar(50)='',
@pcode			nvarchar(50)='',
@warehouse      nvarchar(50)='',
@location       nvarchar(50)='',
@qty			nvarchar(50)=''

AS

if @what='ALL_DD'
BEGIN

declare @branchid as nvarchar(max);
set  @branchid = (select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,SM1002_5 AS UNQID FROM SM1002 
where sm1002_5  in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
ORDER BY BRANCH;

--select unqid, sm1010_2 as Branch,sm1010_3 as Product, sm1010_6 as Warehouse, sm1010_7 as [Location], sm1010_4 as Qty from sm1010 
select 
--sm1010.unqid AS unqid,
sm1002_7 as Branch,sm206_7 as Product, 
sm1006_5 as Warehouse, sm1006_c7 as [Location], sm1010_4 as Qty,
(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1010_5)AS UNIT from sm1010 
	inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5 =sm1010.sm1010_2 
	inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid=sm1010.sm1010_6
	inner join sm1006_c on SM1006_C.unqid=sm1010.sm1010_7
	inner join SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2=sm1010.sm1010_3
	where sm1010_2 =@branch
	order by sm206_7
END

IF @WHAT='GET_GRID'
BEGIN
select
--sm1010.unqid AS unqid,
sm1002_7 as Branch,sm206_7 as Product, 
sm1006_5 as Warehouse, sm1006_c7 as [Location], sm1010_4 as Qty,
(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1010_5)AS UNIT from sm1010 
	inner join sm1002 on sm1002.sm1002_5 =sm1010.sm1010_2 
	inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid=sm1010.sm1010_6
	inner join sm1006_c on SM1006_C.unqid=sm1010.sm1010_7
	inner join SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2=sm1010.sm1010_3
	where sm1010_2 in (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
	order by sm206_7
END
GO

IF @what = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN

declare  @branchid nvarchar(max) = '';
 
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH, 1 as ord 
	union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as [BRANCH] ,2 as ord from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY ord, branch ASC;


END

IF @what = 'MANU'
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [MANU] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	  	SELECT unqid AS [UNQID],sm113_6 AS [MANU],1 as ord  FROM SM113) 
		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[MANU] ASC;

END

--TABLE 0
	   if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;





WITH OpeningData AS (

    UNION ALL

    -- Opening: Opening

        0.000 AS PURCHASE,

    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4 --SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7 --SM1014_8

),

   ClosingData AS (

 AND (sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,SM1005_57

    UNION ALL

	join sm1023_c on sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c6

    FROM SM1014

    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9

 AND (SM1014.SM1014_7  in  (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
)
SELECT 

    BRANCH, 
    [LOCATION], 
    WAREHOUSE, 
    PRODUCT,
	MANUFACTURER,
    SUM(Opening) AS Opening,
    CAST(SUM(PURCHASE)AS NUMERIC(18,0))AS PURCHASE,
    SUM(SALES) AS SALES,
    CAST(SUM(SHORTAGEEXCESS)AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
    CAST(SUM(Opening + PURCHASE - SALES + SHORTAGEEXCESS) AS numeric(18, 0)) AS Closing,
	isnull((sm1001.sm1001_8),0) as MINLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_9),0) as MAXLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_10),0) as REORDERLEVEL
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
) AS CombinedData
LEFT JOIN sm1001 ON sm1001.sm1001_7= CombinedData.PRODUCT 
    AND sm1001.sm1001_6 = CombinedData.MANUFACTURER
    AND sm1001.sm1001_5 = CombinedData.BRANCH

GROUP BY BRANCH, [LOCATION], WAREHOUSE, PRODUCT, MANUFACTURER,sm1001.sm1001_8, sm1001.sm1001_9, sm1001.sm1001_10
order by BRANCH, PRODUCT;

	 
END


IF @aa = 'GETDATA_REP'

BEGIN
--TABLE 0
	   if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;





WITH OpeningData AS (



    SELECT

        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9 
    WHERE sm1005_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
  --  AND (sm1005.sm1005_9 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
   AND (sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,SM1005_57
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Opening,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )*-1 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
 -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM1011.SM1011_41  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: Opening
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
       -- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
	   (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Opening,
	  -- line comment by garima
		--CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		--WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3))AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1023
	join sm1023_c on sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4 --SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7 --SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6 --SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c6 --SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    --WHERE SM1014_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
	WHERE SM1023_5 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
  -- AND ( SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
 -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (SM1023.SM1023_4 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))--SM1014.SM1014_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9

	union all 
	 -- Opening: S/E
	SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
		CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 0)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
	WHERE SM1014_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
 AND (SM1014.SM1014_7 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
   GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),
TransactionData AS (
    -- PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        SUM(SM1005_57*1000) AS PURCHASE,

		--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9 
    WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND ( sm1005.sm1005_9  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (sm1005.sm1005_7  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,SM1005_22
    UNION ALL
    -- SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        SUM(SM1011_42) AS SALES,
	 --SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )  AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
   --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (SM1011.SM1011_41   in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
       -- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
	    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 0))AS SHORTAGEEXCESS ,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (sm1014.SM1014_7  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),

   ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --SUM(SM1005_45) AS Closing
		--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end )AS Closing
		sum(SM1005_57*1000) AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	   JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	--AND (sm1005.sm1005_9  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
 AND (sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,SM1005_57

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: SALES
    SELECT 

        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS Closing
		  -- SUM(
    --    CASE 
    --        WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
    --            THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
    --        ELSE SM1011_42 
    --    END
    --)*-1 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	 JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	--AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM1011.SM1011_41 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
  
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6


    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
		--line comment by garima
		-- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		--WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3))
		(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Closing
    FROM sm1023
	join sm1023_c on sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c6
	JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE sm1023_5 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	--AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM1023.SM1023_4 in  (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6, sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9


	    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
		 CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 0)) AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	--AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
 AND (SM1014.SM1014_7  in  (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
)
SELECT 

    BRANCH, 
   -- [LOCATION], 
   -- WAREHOUSE, 
    PRODUCT,
	--MANUFACTURER,
  cast( SUM(Opening) as numeric(18,0)) AS Opening,
    CAST(SUM(PURCHASE)AS NUMERIC(18,0))AS PURCHASE,
    cast(SUM(SALES) as numeric(18,0)) AS SALES,
    CAST(SUM(SHORTAGEEXCESS)AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
    CAST(SUM(Opening + PURCHASE - SALES + SHORTAGEEXCESS) AS numeric(18, 0)) AS Closing
	--isnull((sm1001.sm1001_8),0) as MINLEVEL,
   -- isnull((sm1001.sm1001_9),0) as MAXLEVEL,
   -- isnull((sm1001.sm1001_10),0) as REORDERLEVEL
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
) AS CombinedData
LEFT JOIN sm1001 ON sm1001.sm1001_7= CombinedData.PRODUCT 
    --AND sm1001.sm1001_6 = CombinedData.MANUFACTURER
    AND sm1001.sm1001_5 = CombinedData.BRANCH

GROUP BY BRANCH, PRODUCT,sm1001.sm1001_8, sm1001.sm1001_9, sm1001.sm1001_10
order by BRANCH, PRODUCT;

	 
END



END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STOCK_SUMMARY_QQQ] 


@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
 @BRANCH                AS	NVARCHAR(50) = '',
 @MANUFACTURER                AS	NVARCHAR(50) = '',

 @uid               AS	NVARCHAR(50) = ''

AS 


BEGIN 
IF @what = 'GETDATA'
BEGIN
--TABLE 0
	   if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;



print '1';

WITH OpeningData AS (
    -- Opening: PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        SUM(SM1005_45) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9 
    WHERE sm1005_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
    AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER)
    AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        SUM(SM1011_20) * -1 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
   AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
   AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1011.SM1011_41 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
   AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
   AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1014.SM1014_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),
TransactionData AS (
    -- PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        SUM(SM1005_45) AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9 
    WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER)
   AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        SUM(SM1011_20) AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
   AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1011.SM1011_41 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
    AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1014.SM1014_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),

   ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        SUM(SM1005_45) AS Closing
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
	   JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9
    WHERE sm1005_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER)
    AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR sm1005.sm1005_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        SUM(SM1011_20) * -1 AS Closing
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1011_40
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
	 JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1011_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	 AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
    AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1011.SM1011_41 = @Branch)
  
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6


    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	 AND (@MANUFACTURER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM113.sm113_6 = @MANUFACTURER)
    AND (@Branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR SM1014.SM1014_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
)
SELECT 

    BRANCH, 
    [LOCATION], 
    WAREHOUSE, 
    PRODUCT,
	MANUFACTURER,
    SUM(Opening) AS Opening,
    SUM(PURCHASE) AS PURCHASE,
    SUM(SALES) AS SALES,
    SUM(SHORTAGEEXCESS) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
    CAST(SUM(Opening + PURCHASE - SALES + SHORTAGEEXCESS) AS numeric(18, 3)) AS Closing,
	isnull((sm1001.sm1001_8),0) as MINLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_9),0) as MAXLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_10),0) as REORDERLEVEL
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
) AS CombinedData
LEFT JOIN sm1001 ON sm1001.sm1001_7= CombinedData.PRODUCT 
    AND sm1001.sm1001_6 = CombinedData.MANUFACTURER
    AND sm1001.sm1001_5 = CombinedData.BRANCH

GROUP BY BRANCH, [LOCATION], WAREHOUSE, PRODUCT, MANUFACTURER,sm1001.sm1001_8, sm1001.sm1001_9, sm1001.sm1001_10
order by BRANCH, PRODUCT;


	 
END



IF @what = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN


 declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH, 1 as ord 
	union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as [BRANCH] ,2 as ord from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY ord, branch ASC;

--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [BRANCH] ,0 as ord  
--	 UNION ALL

END

IF @what = 'MANU'
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [MANU] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	  	SELECT unqid AS [UNQID],sm113_6 AS [MANU],1 as ord  FROM SM113) 
		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[MANU] ASC;

END
END
