/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STOCK_Valuation_q]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_STOCK_Valuation_q] 
@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@BRANCH					AS	NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@MANUFACTURER			AS	NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@WAREHOUSE			AS	NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@designation			as  nvarchar(50) = '',
@uid					AS	NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@des                    as  nvarchar(50) = ''

AS 


BEGIN 
if @what = 'designation'
begin 
	select sm501_4 as DESIGNATION from sm501 inner join sm502 on sm501.unqid = sm502.sm502_14 inner join sm63 on sm63_13 = sm502.unqid where sm63.sm63_5 = @designation
end





IF @what = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN


 declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

	---table for Branch
	 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname ,2 as ord from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY ord, Dname ASC;
	
	---table 1 for manufature
		SELECT unqid AS UNQID, sm113_6 AS Dname, 1 AS ord  
		FROM SM113
		ORDER BY Dname ASC;

		---table 2 for warehouse
		select  unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
		order by Dname;

END

IF @what = 'BINDWAREHOUSE'
BEGIN


		
     select  unqid  AS UNQID, 
	 sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
		order by Dname;

		end
	 
IF @what = 'new'
BEGIN
	SELECT 
	SM1005_6,
	
    sm19_5 AS PARTY,
    sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
    WAREHOUSE,
    [LOCATION],
    MANUFACTURER,
    ISNULL(
        SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) - 
        (SELECT SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4) FROM sm1008_C WHERE sm1008_c3 = unqid),
        SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0)))
    ) AS Closing,
    CAST(RATE AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS RATE,
    CAST(
        ISNULL(
            SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) - 
            (SELECT SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4) FROM sm1008_C WHERE sm1008_c3 = unqid),
            SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0)))
        ) * RATE AS NUMERIC(18,2)
    ) AS STOCKV,
    BRANCH
FROM (
    -- =========================
    -- From SM1023 (Opening)
    -- =========================
    SELECT 
        SM1023_C.UNQID AS unqid,
        '' AS sm19_5,
        sm1023_c8 AS sm1005_19,
        sm206_7,
        '' AS SM1005_17,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, sm1023_5, 105) AS SM1005_18,
        0 AS remaining_qty,
        sm1023_5 AS sm1005_6,
        SM1023_C13/1000 AS RATE,
        sm1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH
    FROM SM1023
    INNER JOIN sm1023_c ON SM1023.unqid = sm1023_c.sm1023_c5
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 = sm206.sm206_2
    LEFT JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1023_C.UNQID = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4
	 WHERE 
	 sm1023_5 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  AND 
    sm113.UNQID in(select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))
    AND SM1023_4 in(select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	AND sm1006.UNQID in(select data from dbo.split(@WAREHOUSE,','))
    GROUP BY SM1023_C.UNQID, sm1023_c8, SM206.sm206_7, sm1023_5, SM1023_C13,
             SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, SM113.sm113_6, SM1002.sm1002_7

    UNION ALL

 
    -- From SM1005 (Purchases)

    SELECT 
        SM1005.sm1005_4 AS unqid,
        sm19_5,
        CAST(sm1005_57 * 1000 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS sm1005_19,
        sm206_7,
        SM1005_17,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1005_6, 105) AS SM1005_18,
        0 AS remaining_qty,
        SM1005_6,
        SM1005_24/1000 AS RATE,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH
    FROM SM1005
    INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM1005.SM1005_11 = SM19.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON SM1005.sm1005_10 = sm206.sm206_2
    LEFT JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM1005_9
	WHERE 
	sm1005_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)   AND
	sm1005_9 in(select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))
    AND sm1005_7 in(select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
	AND sm1006.UNQID in(select data from dbo.split(@WAREHOUSE,','))
    GROUP BY SM1005.SM1005_4, SM19.sm19_5, SM1005.sm1005_57, SM206.sm206_7,
             SM1005.SM1005_17, SM1005.SM1005_6, sm1005_42, SM1005_24,
             SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, SM113.sm113_6, SM1002.sm1002_7
    HAVING sm1005_42 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

    UNION ALL

    -- =========================
    -- From SM1014 (Adjustments)
    -- =========================
    SELECT 
        SM1014_18 AS unqid,
        sm19_5,
        CAST(
            SUM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 * 
                        (CASE WHEN SM1014_15 <> '' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)
                    WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 * 
                        (CASE WHEN SM1014_15 <> '' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)
                END
            ) AS NUMERIC(15,0)
        ) AS sm1005_19,
        sm206_7,
        SM1005_17,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1005_6, 105) AS SM1005_18,
        0 AS remaining_qty,
        SM1005_6,
        SM1005_24/1000 AS RATE,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH
    FROM SM1014
    INNER JOIN SM1005 ON SM1005_4 = SM1014_18
    INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM1005.SM1005_11 = SM19.unqid
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON SM1005.sm1005_10 = sm206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
	 WHERE 
	 SM1014_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  AND 
	 sm113.UNQID in(select data from dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))
	AND SM1014_9 in(select data from dbo.split(@WAREHOUSE,','))
    AND SM1014_7 in(select data from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
    GROUP BY SM1014_18, SM1005.SM1005_4, SM19.sm19_5, SM1005.sm1005_57,
             SM206.sm206_7, SM1005.SM1005_17, SM1005.SM1005_6, sm1005_42,
             SM1005_24, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7,
             SM113.sm113_6, SM1002.sm1002_7
) AS abc

where SM1005_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)

GROUP BY unqid, sm19_5, sm206_7, SM1005_17, SM1005_18, SM1005_6, RATE,
         WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION], MANUFACTURER, BRANCH
HAVING ISNULL(
    SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0))) - 
    (SELECT SUM(SM1008_C.sm1008_c4) FROM sm1008_C WHERE sm1008_c3 = unqid),
    SUM(CAST(sm1005_19 AS NUMERIC(18,0)))
) <> 0

ORDER BY SM206_7;



  
	

end
end









GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SVSOS] 
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@Warehouse         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@LOC       AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@Wh        AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@whl      AS NVARCHAR(max)='',

@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@fromdate      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@uid    AS  NVARCHAR(50)='',
@des    as nvarchar(50) = '',

@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@fdate    as date='',
 @todate AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
 @pastdate AS NVARCHAR(50)=''


AS

	
BEGIN
if @aa='warehouse'
BEGIN

select  unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 where sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
order by Dname;
end 
if @aa='loc'
BEGIN

select sm1006_c.unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_c.sm1006_c7 as Dname from sm1006_c 
inner join sm1006 on sm1006.unqid  = sm1006_c.sm1006_c5
where sm1006_c5 in (select data from dbo.split(@warehouse,',')) and sm1006_13 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
order by Dname;
end 

if @aa='ALL_DD'
BEGIN

declare @branchid as nvarchar(max);
set  @branchid = (select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5 = @uid);

SELECT sm1002_7 AS Dname,SM1002_5 AS UNQID FROM SM1002 
where sm1002_5  in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
ORDER BY Dname;

select unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_5 as Dname from sm1006 order by Dname;

select unqid  AS UNQID, sm1006_c7 as Dname from sm1006_c order by Dname;




end


if @aa='ALL_DDD'

begin



set @todate =  CONVERT(DATE,'26/08/2025', 103);
set @PASTDATE =   DATEADD(day, -15, CONVERT(DATE,  '26/08/2025', 103));

print @todate;
print @PASTDATE;



 WITH AllStockData AS (
    -- Opening and closing stock from sm1005 (Purchase)
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM1005_6 AS DocumentDate,
        SUM(SM1005_57 * 1000) AS StockChange, 
	  
	   	SUM(SM1005_51*SM1005_57) AS STOCKV,
		ABS(CAST(IN_11 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS [Due Amt],
		ABS(CAST(cosr.Co_7 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS [Adj Amt]
    FROM sm1005
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1005_10
    JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = SM1005_54
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1005_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1005_38
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1005_44
	JOIN invn ON invn.in_5 = SM1005_4 
   join cosr on cosr.co_5 = invn.unqid
    WHERE SM1005_7 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
      AND SM1005_38 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@wh, ','))
      AND SM1005_44 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@whl, ','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7, SM1002.SM1002_7, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, SM1005_6, in_11,Co_7

    UNION ALL

    -- Stock change from sm1011 (Issue)
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM1011_6 AS DocumentDate,
        SUM(SM1011_42) * -1 AS StockChange ,
		
		SUM(sm1011_22*SM1011_42*-1) AS STOCKV,
		
	
		ABS(CAST(IN_11 AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS [Due Amt],
		0.00 AS [Adj Amt]
 
    FROM SM1011
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1011_13
    JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = SM1011_23
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1011_41
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1011_39
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1011_40
    JOIN invn ON invn.in_5 = Sm1011.UNQID 

  WHERE SM1011_41 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
      AND SM1011_39 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@wh, ','))
  -- AND SM1011_40 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@whl, ','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7, SM1002.SM1002_7, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, SM1011_6,in_11

    UNION ALL

    -- Stock change from sm1023 (Adjustments)
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1023_5 AS DocumentDate,
        (CASE WHEN @des <> 'Auditor' THEN sm1023_c8 ELSE sm1023_c9 END) AS StockChange,
		 SUM(SM1023_c13* case when @des != 'Auditor' then
				 isnull(sm1023_c8,0) else  isnull(sm1023_c9,0)  end )/1000 AS STOCKV,
		0.00 AS [Due Amt],
		0.00 AS [Adj Amt]
    FROM SM1023
    JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1023.SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_6
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023.SM1023_7
    WHERE sm1023_4 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
      AND sm1023_6 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@wh, ','))
      AND sm1023_7 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@whl, ','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7, SM1002.SM1002_7, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9, sm1023_5

    UNION ALL

    -- Stock change from sm1014 (S/E)
    SELECT
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006.SM1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        SM1014_6 AS DocumentDate,
  --      CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 * (CASE WHEN SM1014_15 <> '' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)
  --                    WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 * (CASE WHEN SM1014_15 <> '' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS StockChange,
					  
		--   SUM(SM1005_51 * CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		--WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END)/1000 AS STOCKV
        
    

	

	    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) 
		AS StockChange,
		--SUM(sm1005_59) as QTY,
		-- sum(sm1005_51) as RATE,
		   SUM(SM1005_51*sm1005_59) AS STOCKV,
		   0.00 AS [Due Amt],
		   0.00 AS [Adj Amt]
	FROM SM1014

    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid = SM1014_11
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006 ON SM1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.unqid = SM1014_8
JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 = sm1014.SM1014_18
JOIN sm1008 ON sm1008.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c1
--JOIN sm1011 ON sm1011.SM1011_8 = sm1008.unqid
LEFT JOIN sm1005 ON sm1005.SM1005_4 = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3
    WHERE SM1014_7 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@BRANCH, ','))
      AND sm1014_9 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@wh, ','))
      AND sm1014_8 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@whl, ','))
    GROUP BY SM206.SM206_7, SM1002.SM1002_7, SM1006.SM1006_5, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, SM1014_6
),
-- Calculate closing stock for the current date
CurrentStock AS (
    SELECT
        PRODUCT,
        BRANCH,
        WAREHOUSE,
        [LOCATION],
        SUM(StockChange) AS CurrentStockQty,
		SUM(STOCKV) AS CurrentStockv,
		SUM([Due Amt]) AS OS
		--SUM([Adj Amt]) AS ADJ
    FROM AllStockData
    WHERE DocumentDate <= @TODATE
    GROUP BY PRODUCT, BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION]
),
-- Calculate closing stock for the past date
PastStock AS (
    SELECT
        PRODUCT,
        BRANCH,
        WAREHOUSE,
        [LOCATION],
        SUM(StockChange) AS PastStockQty,
		SUM(STOCKV) AS PastStockv,
		SUM([Due Amt]-[Adj Amt]) AS PastOS
		--SUM([Adj Amt]) AS PastADj
    FROM AllStockData
    WHERE DocumentDate <= @PASTDATE
    GROUP BY PRODUCT, BRANCH, WAREHOUSE, [LOCATION]
)
-- Final result: Join the two calculated quantities
SELECT
    C.PRODUCT,
   -- C.BRANCH,
   --C.WAREHOUSE,
   --C.[LOCATION],
    CAST(C.CurrentStockQty AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [SQty-Current],
    CAST(P.PastStockQty AS numeric(18, 3)) AS [SQty(15 Days Ago)],
	CAST(C.CurrentStockv AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [SV-Current],
    CAST(P.PastStockv AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [SV(15 Days Ago)],
	CAST(C.OS AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [Os-Today],
    CAST(P.PastOS AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [Os-15 Days Ago]
		--CAST(C.ADJ AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [ADJ-Today],
  --  CAST(P.PastADj AS numeric(18, 2)) AS [adj-15 Days Ago]
FROM CurrentStock AS C
LEFT JOIN PastStock AS P ON C.PRODUCT = P.PRODUCT
                         AND C.BRANCH = P.BRANCH
                         AND C.WAREHOUSE = P.WAREHOUSE
                         AND C.[LOCATION] = P.[LOCATION]
WHERE C.CurrentStockQty <> 0;




END

END

   --         UNION ALL

  --      FROM SM17 inner join sm206 on sm206_13=sm17.unqid

  --      ORDER BY Dname

    IF @AA = 'BINDACC'
    BEGIN
        select data  into #t from dbo.split(@SELECTEDBRANCH,',')

SELECT DISTINCT a.unqid as UNQID, a.sm19_5 as Dname
FROM sm19 A
CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitString(A.sm19_63, ',') AS aSplit
JOIN #t B
CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitString(B.data, ',') AS bSplit
ON aSplit.Value = bSplit.Value
where sm19_11='CUST' and 
a.SM19_7 in (select data from dbo.split(@unqid,','))   order by Dname ;
   --         SELECT SM19.UNQID AS UNQID, SM19_5 AS Dname

    IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'

	--SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 0 AS ord
 --           UNION ALL 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206  
		--inner join sm206_c on sm206_c6=sm206_2 inner join sm113 on sm113.unqid=sm206_c7
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split( @unqid ,',')) 
		   -- and  sm113_6='TATA CHEMICALS LIMITED'
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;

	
    END

BEGIN

/*=====================================================
  COMPANY HEADER
=====================================================*/
SELECT 
    PA_3 AS COMPANYNAME, 
    PA_11 + ' ' + UPPER(LEFT((SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = PA_9),1)) AS ADMOFFICE
FROM PA;

SET @TODATE = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE);

/*=====================================================
  LEDGER AMOUNT (FIXED – NO DUPLICATES)
=====================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LedgerAmounts') IS NOT NULL 
    DROP TABLE #LedgerAmounts;

CREATE TABLE #LedgerAmounts (
    UNQID NVARCHAR(36),
    Ledgeramt NUMERIC(18,2)
);

INSERT INTO #LedgerAmounts
SELECT 
    m3_4 AS UNQID,
    SUM(M3_6) AS Ledgeramt
FROM m3
GROUP BY m3_4;


/*=====================================================
  MAIN DATA (INVOICE LEVEL – NO DUPLICATES)
=====================================================*/
;WITH InvoiceBase AS (
    SELECT 
        I.IN_12 AS UNQID,
        I.UNQID AS INVUNQID,
        ISNULL(S19.SM19_5,'') + ',' + ISNULL(S1.SM1_5,'') AS [Party Name],
        I.IN_13 AS [Invoice No],
        I.IN_8  AS [Invoice Date],
        I.IN_14 AS [Due Date],
        I.IN_9  AS [Invoice Amt],

        -- 🔴 Invoice level totals
        SUM(ABS(CAST(I.IN_11 AS NUMERIC(18,2)))) AS [Due Amt],
        SUM(ISNULL(S213.SM213_30,0)) AS [TAX],

        '' AS [Product],
        '' AS [PROD UNQ],

        S1002.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        I.IN_15 AS BRANCHUNQ,
        S19.SM19_5 AS Party_Group
    FROM INVN I WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN SM19  S19 ON S19.UNQID = I.IN_12 AND S19.SM19_11 = 'CUST'
    LEFT JOIN SM01  S1  ON S1.UNQID  = S19.SM19_15
    LEFT JOIN SM213 S213 ON S213.UNQID = I.IN_5
    LEFT JOIN SM1002 S1002 ON S1002.SM1002_5 = I.IN_15
    WHERE 
        I.IN_8 <= @TODATE
		AND I.IN_14 IS NOT NULL
    AND I.IN_14 > '1900-01-01'
        AND I.IN_11 <> 0
        AND I.IN_7 = 'OI'
    GROUP BY
        I.IN_12, I.UNQID,
        S19.SM19_5, S1.SM1_5,
        I.IN_13, I.IN_8, I.IN_14, I.IN_9,
        S1002.SM1002_7, I.IN_15
),

/*=====================================================
  CUMULATIVE TAX (SAFE)
=====================================================*/
CumulativeTax AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM([TAX]) OVER (
            PARTITION BY Party_Group 
            ORDER BY [Invoice Date], INVUNQID
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS CumulativeAmount
    FROM InvoiceBase
)

/*=====================================================
  FINAL DATA
=====================================================*/
SELECT 
    c.UNQID,
    c.INVUNQID,
    c.[Party Name],
    ISNULL(l.Ledgeramt,0) AS Ledgeramt,
    c.[Invoice No],
    c.BRANCH,
    c.Product,
    c.[Due Amt],
    c.[Due Date],
    c.[Invoice Date],
    c.[Invoice Amt],
    DATEDIFF(DAY,c.[Invoice Date],@TODATE) AS [Due Days],

    -- Aging buckets (example)
    CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY,c.[Invoice Date],@TODATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN c.[Due Amt] ELSE 0 END AS A,
    CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY,c.[Invoice Date],@TODATE) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN c.[Due Amt] ELSE 0 END AS B,
    CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY,c.[Invoice Date],@TODATE) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN c.[Due Amt] ELSE 0 END AS C,
    CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY,c.[Invoice Date],@TODATE) > 90 THEN c.[Due Amt] ELSE 0 END AS D,

    c.[Due Amt] AS TotalDueAmt,
    c.TAX,
    c.CumulativeAmount,

    CASE WHEN c.CumulativeAmount > 5000000
         THEN ROUND(c.TAX * 0.1 / 100,2)
         ELSE 0 END AS TDS,

    c.[Due Amt] - 
    CASE WHEN c.CumulativeAmount > 5000000
         THEN ROUND(c.TAX * 0.1 / 100,2)
         ELSE 0 END AS TDSMDUE

FROM CumulativeTax c
LEFT JOIN #LedgerAmounts l 
    ON l.UNQID = c.UNQID

ORDER BY c.[Party Name], c.[Invoice Date];


/*=====================================================
  CLEANUP
=====================================================*/
DROP TABLE #LedgerAmounts;

END;

    c.CumulativeAmount,

    CASE WHEN c.CumulativeAmount > 5000000
         THEN ROUND(c.TAX * 0.1 / 100,2)
         ELSE 0 END AS TDS,

    c.[Due Amt] - 
    CASE WHEN c.CumulativeAmount > 5000000
         THEN ROUND(c.TAX * 0.1 / 100,2)
         ELSE 0 END AS TDSMDUE

FROM CumulativeTax c
LEFT JOIN #LedgerAmountss l 
    ON l.UNQID = c.UNQID

ORDER BY c.[Party Name], c.[Invoice Date];

/*=====================================================
  CLEANUP
=====================================================*/
DROP TABLE #LedgerAmountss;

END;



end 








GO

	  SET @GSTUNQ = (SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2= @sm213_c5)

END
-------------  

if @what = 'Reinsert_Grid_For_Update'
BEGIN
	  SET @SM213_C20= (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SM213_C20),0)+1 AS ORDERING FROM SM213_c WHERE SM213_C4=@SM213_C4)

select unqid from sm213 as punqid 	
insert into sm213_c(sm213_c1,sm213_c2,unqid,sm213_c4,sm213_c5,sm213_c6,sm213_c7,sm213_c8,sm213_c9,sm213_c10,sm213_c11,sm213_c12,sm213_c13,sm213_c14,sm213_c15,sm213_c16,sm213_c17,sm213_c18,sm213_c19,SM213_C20)

END

END

-------
 
if @what = 'UPDATE_CHILD'
BEGIN
	  DELETE FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @sm213_c4
END

if @what = 'UPDATE_CHILD_RETURN'
BEGIN
	  DELETE FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @sm213_c4
	  DELETE FROM M3 WHERE M3_14 = @sm213_c4
	  DELETE FROM COSR WHERE CO_6 = @sm213_c4
END

IF @what = 'BIND_HSN_UNIT'
BEGIN		
		SELECT SM206_15 AS [HSN/SAC], (SELECT SM209_8 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM206_12) AS UNIT,
		(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_10) AS GSTPER  FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@sm213_c5
END

IF @what = 'SOFTWARECOUNT'
BEGIN
SELECT SM19_C1 AS [CHILDUNQID] , SM19_C4 AS [DESCRIPTION]  FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID
END


IF @what = 'BIND_GRID_DATA'
BEGIN	
		IF  (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, SM19_C5, GETDATE()) AS [DateDiff] FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1) > 6
		BEGIN
				SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS [PRODUCT CODE], 
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS [HSN/SAC],		
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE unqid=SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID= SM206_13) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS UNIT, SM19_C7 AS [RATE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_11) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='LICENSE RENEWAL CHARGES') AS GSTPER
				FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1
		END
		
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 SM206_2 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS [PRODUCT CODE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM206_16 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS [HSN/SAC],		
				(SELECT TOP 1 SM208_5 FROM SM208 WHERE unqid=SM19_C4) AS [DESCRIPTION],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM209_5 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID= SM206_13) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS UNIT,SM19_C6 AS [RATE],
				(SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM206_11) FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_9='SOFTWARE') AS GSTPER
				FROM SM19_C WHERE SM19_C2=@UNQID AND SM19_C1=@SM19_C1
		END
END


--alter table sm213_C add SM213_C21 NVARCHAR(50), SM213_C22 NUMERIC(18,2), SM213_C23 nvarchar(50)

	  [GSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_10) AS [ACCPANNO],FORMAT(sm213_62, 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DUE DATE],SM213_22 AS [ROUNDOFF],SM213_18 AS [CGST],SM213_19 AS [SGST],SM213_20 AS [IGST],SM213_30 AS [TOTALGST],

	  
      (select pa_28 from pa) as [SF1],(select pa_29 from pa) as [SF2],(select pa_30 from pa) as [SF3],(select pa_37 from pa) as [SRF1],(select pa_38 from pa) as [SRF2],
	  (select pa_39 from pa) as [SRF3],sm213_42 AS [IRN],CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),sm213_37,103) AS [ACK_DATE],sm213_38 AS [ACK_NO],sm213_49 AS [QR_PATH],SM213_23 AS [NETAMOUNT],SM213_14 AS [TAXTYPE],'INVOICE'AS [FORMAT],'' AS [RINVOICENO],''AS [RINVOICEDATE] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID)
	  
      ORDER BY [INVOICEDATE] DESC,[INVOICENO] DESC;	 

	  
	  select(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCOUNTNAME],
      ( SELECT SM19_13 + '  ' + isnull(SM19_14,'') + ', ' + 
	  case when (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_60)) is null 
	  then '' else (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_60)) end
	   FROM SM19 WHERE
	  SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCOUNT ADDRESS],(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS [STSTATENAME],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS [STSTATECODE],(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS 
	  [STGSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_60) AS [STACCPANNO],

	  (SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCOUNTNAME],
      ( SELECT SM19_13 + '  ' + isnull(SM19_14,'') + ', ' + 
	  case when (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_59)) is null 
	  then '''' else (SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE SM01.UNQID = (select sm19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = SM213_59)) end
	   FROM SM19 WHERE
	  SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCOUNT ADDRESS],(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_59)) AS [DFSTATENAME],
	  (SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_59)) AS [DFSTATECODE],(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS 
	  [DFGSTIN], (SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = SM213_59) AS [DFACCPANNO] FROM SM213 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID);



	  select SM213_C20 as [SNO],(select sm17_6 from sm17 inner join sm206 on sm17.unqid = sm206.sm206_13 where sm206.SM206_2 = sm213_c5) as [CATEGORY],(select sm206_28 from sm206 where sm206_2=sm213_c5) AS [ITEM],SM213_C7 AS [TITLE],((SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=SM213_C5) + '  ' + SM213_C7) AS [TITL],SM213_C6 AS [SAC],
      CAST(SM213_C9 AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [QUANTITY],SM213_C10 AS [RATE],SM213_C11 AS [AMOUNT],SM213_c14 AS [TAXABLE],
	  SM213_c13 AS [DISCOUNT],SM213_C20 AS ORDERING,SM213_C8 AS UNIT
	  INTO #TEMP2 FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C4 WHERE SM213.UNQID IN (@UNQID)
	  SELECT * FROM #TEMP2 ORDER BY ORDERING asc;	 

	  select (select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid = sm213_c15) as [IGST%] ,CAST(CAST(ROUND((SELECT sm210_7 FROM sm210 WHERE unqid = sm213_c15) / 2.0, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS FLOAT) as [GST%] from sm213_c where sm213_c4 in (@UNQID)
	  SELECT SUM(SM213_C9) AS [SUMOFQTY] FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = @UNQID
end

if @what = 'Purchase_Details'
begin
	if (select count(*) from sm227_c) != '' 
	--	select sm227_c.unqid as UNQID, sm206_9 as PRODUCT, sm227_7 as INVOICENO, sm227_6 as INVOICEDATE, sm227_c6 as QTY, sm227_c6 AS REMQTY from sm227_c 
	--	inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4 inner join sm227 on sm227_c.sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid where sm206_9 like '%'+@search+'%' and sm227_c6 != '0.00'
	--union all
	--select sm213_c23 as unq, (select sm206_9 as Product from sm206), sum(sm213_c9) as qty, (select sm227_7 as invno from sm227), (select sm227_6 as invdate from sm227) from sm213_c group by sm213_c23
	--order by INVOICENO asc
	
		SELECT 
			pc.unqid AS UNQID,
			p.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
			p.sm206_9 AS PRODUCT,
			ph.sm227_7 AS INVOICENO,
			ph.sm227_6 AS INVOICEDATE,
			pc.sm227_c6 AS QTY,
			pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) AS REMQTY
		FROM sm227_c pc
		INNER JOIN sm206 p
			ON p.sm206_2 = pc.sm227_c4
		INNER JOIN sm227 ph
			ON ph.unqid = pc.sm227_c3
		LEFT JOIN sm213_c sc
			ON sc.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid
		WHERE p.sm206_9 LIKE '%'+@search+'%'
		GROUP BY 
			pc.unqid, 
			p.sm206_9, 
			p.sm206_2, 
			ph.sm227_7, 
			ph.sm227_6, 
			pc.sm227_c6
		HAVING pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) != 0
		ORDER BY ph.sm227_7 ASC;

	else
		select '' as UNQID, 'No Record Found' as PRODUCT, '' as INVOICENO, '' as INVOICEDATE, '' as QTY, 0 AS REMQTY 

end

	SELECT @CN = 'SELECT sm213.unqid as Punqid,'''' AS unqid,CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),sm213_34,103) as [Date],(case when CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),sm213_25,103)=''01/01/1900'' then '''' else CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),sm213_25,103) end) as [Postdate],
		(case when CONVERT (NVARCHAR(20),sm213_25,103)=''01/01/1900'' then '''' else SM213_33 end) as [CreditNoteNo],(select sm19_5 from  sm19 where sm19.unqid= sm213.sm213_10) as CustomerName,
		sm213_17  as Amount, sm213_42 as IRN, sm213_46 as CAN, sm213_18 as CGST,sm213_19 SGST,sm213_20 IGST,sm213_30 as TotalGst,sm213_23 as NetAmt,(CASE WHEN SM213_25!=''1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'' THEN ''APPROVED'' WHEN 
		SM213_36 = ''REJECTED'' THEN ''REJECTED'' ELSE ''UNAPPROVE'' END) AS [STATUS] 
		from sm213 WHERE SM213_35 = ''C#'' '
	if [dbo].[getformatteddate](@fromdate) != ''
	begin
	select @CN = @CN + ' and dbo.onlydate(sm213_34) BETWEEN [dbo].[getformatteddate]('''+@fromdate+''') and [dbo].[getformatteddate]('''+@todate+''')'
	end
	--if @frominvoice != '' AND @frominvoice != '--Select--' AND @frominvoice != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @toinvoice != '' AND @toinvoice != '--Select--' AND @toinvoice != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	--begin

	--BETWEEN CAST (RIGHT('''+@frominvoice +''' , CHARINDEX (''/'' ,REVERSE('''+@frominvoice +'''))-1) AS NUMERIC(18)) AND CAST (RIGHT('''+@toinvoice+''' , CHARINDEX (''/'' ,REVERSE('''+@toinvoice+'''))-1) AS NUMERIC(18))  '

	--end
	--if @name != '' AND @name != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	--begin 
	--select @CN = @CN + ' and sm213_10 = '''+ @name + ''''
	--end
	select @CN = @CN + 'ORDER BY sm213_34 DESC, CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SM213_33,'''')='''' then 0 else RIGHT(SM213_33 , CHARINDEX (''/'' ,REVERSE(SM213_33))-1) END AS NUMERIC(15)) DESC  '
	print @CN
	exec (@CN)


	DECLARE @CN1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX);

if @what = 'SELECTFOREDIT'			
BEGIN 
SELECT 
sm213.unqid as unq,dbo.onlydate1(SM213_6) as [Date],SM213_7	as CaCr,SM213_8	as InvoicePrefix,SM213_9 as invoiceNo,SM213_10	as CustomerName,
SM213_14	as GstNature,SM213_C5 as productCode,SM213_C6 as HsnSac,SM213_C7 as [Description],SM213_C8	as Unit,SM213_C9	as Qty,
SM213_C10 as Rate,SM213_C11	as Amount,SM213_C12	as DiscountPer,SM213_C13 as DiscAmount,SM213_C14 as TaxableAmount,SM213_C15	as GstPer,
SM213_C16 as Cgst,SM213_C17 as Sgst,SM213_C18	as Igst,SM213_C19 as NetAmount,SM213_15	as GrossAmount,SM213_16	as DiscAmt,SM213_17	as TaxAmt,
SM213_18 as CGST1,SM213_19	as SGST1,SM213_20	as IGST1,SM213_21	as TotalAmt,SM213_22	as RoundOff,SM213_23	as NetAmt,
SM213_30 as TotalTax,SM213_24	as Remarks,sm213_59 as Dispatch, sm213_60 as Ship, sm213_61 as CESSAMOUNT, sm213_62 as DueDate, sm213_63 as DueDays, SM213_64 AS BRANCH, sm213_65 as TRANSPORTER, sm213_66 as VEHICLE, sm213_67 as GRNO, sm213_68 as GRDATE, sm213_69 as CARTAGE, sm213_70 as INB, sm213_71 as WAREHOUSE, SM213_72 AS LOCATION FROM SM213 inner join sm213_c on sm213.unqid = sm213_c.sm213_c4 where sm213.unqid = @punqid;


SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY SM213_C5)AS ROWNUMBER, (SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM213_C5) AS [PRODUCT CODE],SM213_C6 AS [HSN/SAC],SM213_C7 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM213_C8 AS [UNIT],
CONVERT (NUMERIC(18),SM213_C9) AS [QTY],SM213_C10 AS [RATE],SM213_C11 AS [AMOUNT],SM213_C12 AS [DISC%],SM213_C13 AS [DISC AMT],SM213_C14 AS [TAXABLE AMOUNT],
(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID =SM213_C15) AS [GST%],SM213_C16 AS [CGST],SM213_C17 AS [SGST],SM213_C18 AS [IGST],SM213_C19 AS [NET AMOUNT], sm213_C.unqid AS UNQID,SM213_C5 [PRODUCT UNQ],SM213_C15 AS [GST UNQ],SM213_C20 AS [ORDERING],(SELECT SM211_6 FROM SM211 WHERE SM211_4 = SM213_C21) AS [CESSUNQ%], SM213_C21 AS [CESS%], SM213_C22 AS [CESS AMT]  FROM SM213 INNER JOIN SM213_C 
ON SM213.UNQID = SM213_C.SM213_C4 where sm213.unqid = @punqid ORDER BY [ORDERING];

--DECLARE @RawUNQIDs NVARCHAR(MAX);
-- set @RawUNQIDs = (SELECT TOP 1 sm213_c23
--    FROM sm213_c
--    WHERE sm213_c4 = @punqid);

--select sm227_c.unqid as UNQID, sm206_9 as PRODUCT, sm227_7 as INVOICENO, sm227_6 as INVOICEDATE, sm227_c6 as QTY from sm227_c
-- inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4
-- inner join sm227 on sm227_c.sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid 
-- INNER JOIN dbo.Split(@RawUNQIDs, ',') AS splitUNQID
--    ON sm227_c.unqid = splitUNQID.data

--select sm227_c.unqid as UNQID, sm206_9 as PRODUCT, sm227_7 as INVOICENO, sm227_6 as INVOICEDATE, sm227_c6 as QTY, sm227_c6 as REMQTY from sm227_c
-- inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4
-- inner join sm227 on sm227_c.sm227_c3 = sm227.unqid 
-- INNER JOIN sm213_c on sm227_c.unqid = sm213_c23
SELECT 
    pc.unqid AS UNQID,
	p.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
    p.sm206_9 AS PRODUCT,
    ph.sm227_7 AS INVOICENO,
    ph.sm227_6 AS INVOICEDATE,
    pc.sm227_c6 AS QTY,
    pc.sm227_c6 - ISNULL(SUM(sc.sm213_c9), 0) AS REMQTY
FROM sm227_c pc 
INNER JOIN sm206 p
    ON p.sm206_2 = pc.sm227_c4
INNER JOIN sm227 ph
    ON ph.unqid = pc.sm227_c3
LEFT JOIN sm213_c sc
    ON sc.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid   -- ❗ SUM ke liye ALL rows
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sm213_c s
    WHERE s.sm213_c23 = pc.unqid
      AND s.sm213_c4 = @punqid   -- ❗ sirf wahi rows lao
)
GROUP BY 
    pc.unqid, 
    p.sm206_9, 
	p.sm206_2,
    ph.sm227_7, 
    ph.sm227_6, 
    pc.sm227_c6
HAVING pc.sm227_c6 != 0;

	

END

if @what='genEwayNo'
begin
   
	SELECT 1 AS TransMode,SM213_67 AS TransDocNo,
	(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM213_64)+CASE WHEN  LEN(sm213_9)>4 THEN  sm213_9 ELSE DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) END AS INVNO,
	(CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),sm213_6,103)) AS INVDATE,
	FORMAT(sm213_68 ,'dd/MM/yyyy' ) AS TransDocDt,
	(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=sm213_65)AS TransName,
    (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_65) as TransId,sm213_66 as VehNo,
    (SELECT ZM37_2 FROM ZM37 WHERE ZM37_1=(SELECT TOP 1 SM1009_7 FROM SM1009 WHERE SM1009_6=LTRIM(RTRIM(sm213_65))))AS VehType,SM213_42 AS IRN
    FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID =@unqid--'bafa480e-17d0-4828-9fb7-9be47ce5cd4f'
	
	
SELECT @SUPPLIERUNQ=SM213_59 FROM SM213 WHERE unqid=@UNQID

SELECT @BRANCH=SM213_64 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
SELECT @WAREHOUSEUNQ=SM213_71 FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
SELECT UPPER(PA_17) as GSTIN, UPPER(PA_3) AS TradeName,UPPER(PA_3) AS Legal_Name , (SELECT SM1002_8 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) AS Add1,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1002_11 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)) AS Location, 
(SELECT SM1002_17 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) as PinCode,
(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=PA_10) as state,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1002_10 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)) as StateCode,
 UPPER(SM19_23) as DISPATCHFROMGSTIN,UPPER(SM19_5) AS DISPATCHFROMLegal_Name ,  SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   ' as DISPATCHFROMAdd1,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID =  SM19_25) as DISPATCHFROMStateCode,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID=SM19_25)DISPATCHFROMSTATE,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = sm19_15 ) as DISPATCHFROMLocation,
SM19_35 as DISPATCHFROMPinCode FROM SM19 , PA WHERE UNQID=@SUPPLIERUNQ



SELECT SM213.UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as Buyer,
(SELECT SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   '
FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as add1,(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as statename,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as statecode,(SELECT SM19_35 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as PinCode,
(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as B_Gstin,
(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM213_64)+CASE WHEN  LEN(sm213_9)>4 THEN  sm213_9 ELSE DBO.LPAD(sm213_9, 4, 0) END as invno,
(CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),sm213_6,103)) as [date],sm213_18 as cgst  ,sm213_19 as sgst ,
sm213_20 as igst ,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as Location,sm213_17 as taxableamt,(sm213_18+sm213_19+sm213_20) as gstamt ,
0.00 as cessamt,(sm213_23-sm213_22) as Totamt,sm213_23 AS netamt,sm213_22 as roundoff,(sm213_18+sm213_19+sm213_20) as taxamt,'' as othercharges,
SM213_42 as IRN, SM213_37 as AckDate, SM213_38 as AckNo, SM213_49  as QRPath,

(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as shiptoGstin,
(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as shiptoName,
(SELECT SM19_13 + '' + SM19_14 + '' +'   'FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60)as shiptoAddress,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_15 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) AS shiptoCITY,
(SELECT SM19_35 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = sm213_60) as shiptoPinCode,
(SELECT SM205_7 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (select SM19_25 from sm19 where sm19.unqid = sm213_60)) as shiptostatecode
FROM SM213 WHERE UNQID = @unqid



	SELECT 
		s.sm213_c9  AS qty,
		s.sm213_c10 AS rate,
		s.sm213_c11 AS amt,
		s.sm213_c14 AS taxableamt,

		-- GST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 <> 0 THEN t.sm210_7
			ELSE 18
		END AS gstrper,

		s.sm213_c16 AS CGST,
		s.sm213_c17 AS SGST,
		s.sm213_c18 AS IGST,

		-- CGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 = 0 THEN CASE 
            WHEN (t.sm210_7 / 2) = FLOOR(t.sm210_7 / 2)
                THEN CONVERT(INT, t.sm210_7 / 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(ROUND(t.sm210_7 / 2, 2) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        END
			ELSE 0
		END AS CGSTGST,

		-- SGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 = 0 THEN CASE 
            WHEN (t.sm210_7 / 2) = FLOOR(t.sm210_7 / 2)
                THEN CONVERT(INT, t.sm210_7 / 2)
            ELSE 
                CAST(ROUND(t.sm210_7 / 2, 2) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        END
			ELSE 0
		END AS SGSTGST,

		-- IGST %
		CASE 
			WHEN s.sm213_c18 <> 0 THEN t.sm210_7
			ELSE 0
		END AS IGSTGST,

		j.sm211_6 AS cessper,
		s.sm213_c22 AS cessamt,

		s.sm213_c11 AS Itemamt,
		p.SM206_15 AS hsn,
		s.sm213_c8  AS GSTUNIT,
		p.SM206_9  AS prodesc,
		p.SM206_7  AS prodname,
		s.sm213_c19 AS netamt

	FROM SM213_c s
	LEFT JOIN SM210 t ON t.unqid = s.sm213_c15
	LEFT JOIN SM211 j ON j.sm211_4 = s.sm213_c21
	LEFT JOIN SM206 p ON p.SM206_2 = s.sm213_c5
	WHERE s.sm213_c4 = @unqid;
end

IF @what='monthwise'
begin
declare @hold datetime=''
declare @hold1 datetime=''
          if @CUSTOMER !='' AND @PRODUCT !='' 
		  begin
		  
         --1month sale quantity
		 SELECT SUM(SM1011_20)as qty FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN  (SELECT DBO.ONLYDATE(DATEADD(month, -1, GETDATE()))) AND DBO.ONLYDATE(GETDATE()) and sm1011_10=@CUSTOMER and sm1011_13=@PRODUCT
		 --3 month sale
		 SELECT SUM(SM1011_20)as qty FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN  (SELECT DBO.ONLYDATE(DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE()))) AND DBO.ONLYDATE(GETDATE()) and sm1011_10=@CUSTOMER and sm1011_13=@PRODUCT
		 --6 month sale
		 SELECT SUM(SM1011_20)as qty FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011_6 BETWEEN  (SELECT DBO.ONLYDATE(DATEADD(month, -6, GETDATE()))) AND DBO.ONLYDATE(GETDATE()) and sm1011_10=@CUSTOMER and sm1011_13=@PRODUCT 
		 end
		 else
		 begin
		-- FOR RATE  PRODUCT AND DATE WISE 
		 select sm1017_c10 as cash,sm1017_c11 as credit from sm1017_c1 where sm1017_c6=@PRODUCT and sm1017_c5=(select sm1017.unqid from sm1017  where sm1017_6=@DATE)
		 
		 end

	--set @hold1=	(select top 1 dbo.onlydate(sm202_13) as rcpt from sm202 where sm202_4  in (select co_6 as unq from cosr where co_1 > (select in_14 as duedate from invn where in_8 in(select sm1011_6 from sm1011 where sm1011_10='AE436A93-7A34-4055-9479-B9F05419EB3A'))) order by sm202_13 desc)

		  --BEGIN

    --       select in_14 as due_date, (select max(co_2) from COSR where CO_5=invn.unqid) as rceiptdate,

    --     )  a  group by unqid

IF @what='delaydays'
BEGIN
select SUM(duedays) as delayday,count(*) as inv,SUM(duedays)/count(*) as Avgdelay,unqid   from (
           select in_14 as due_date, (select max(co_2) from COSR where CO_5=invn.unqid) as rceiptdate,
         datediff(day,in_14,(select max(co_2) from COSR where CO_5=invn.unqid)) as duedays,  @CUSTOMER as unqid from invn WHERE IN_12=@CUSTOMER
         )  a  group by unqid
END

IF @what='Approved'
BEGIN
--select TOP 1 SM19_57 AS CRLIMIT from SM19

SELECT 
        (SELECT SM19_57 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID = IN_12) AS CRLIMIT,    
		(case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()) end)  AS OD

    FROM INVN 
    WHERE IN_7 = 'OO' AND In_11 <> 0 AND IN_12 = @CUSTOMER
END

SELECT CHALLANUNQ,CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,
cast (ORDERVALUE as numeric(18,2))AS ORDERVALUE,SUM(INVOICEAMT) AS PREVIOUSINVAMT,
FORMAT(SUM(DUEAMOUNT), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALDUEAMT,
FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT,'N2','en-IN')as CREDITLIMIT ,
MAX(OVERDUEDAYS) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) > 0 
        THEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS [REQDCL],
QTY,ORDERDATE,
FORMAT(SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
 CASE 
        WHEN (CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)) > 0 
        THEN FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN')
        ELSE '0.00'
    END AS CLavailable,
RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,USERNAME
FROM (

        SELECT sm1008.unqid as CHALLANUNQ,
		ISNULL((case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end),0.00) AS DUEAMT,
		SM1008_24 AS BRANCHUNQ,
		SM1002_7 AS BRANCHNAME,
		SM1008_6 AS CUSTOMERUNQ,SM19_5 AS CUSTOMERNAME,SM1008_8 AS PRODUNQ,SM206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		SM1008_10 AS QTY,
		SM1008_12 AS Rate,
		ISNULL((SM1008_10*SM1008_12)*1.18,0.00) AS ORDERVALUE,
		SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT ,
		ISNULL(IN_9,0) AS INVOICEAMT,
		ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(getdate()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00) AS DUEAMOUNT,
        ISNULL((case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end) ,0) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(SM1008_5 AS DATETIME), 103)AS ORDERDATE,
        --SM1008_5 AS ORDERDATE,
		ISNULL(IN_11,0.00) AS TOTALOUTSTANDING ,
		(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1008_19)AS UNIT,sm1008_15 as challanno,sm1008_35 as REASON,SM1008_5 AS CDATE,
		(SELECT SM63_6 FROM SM63 WHERE SM63_5=SM1008_3)AS USERNAME
		FROM SM1008 INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1008.SM1008_24 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1008.SM1008_6 
		INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1008.SM1008_8 LEFT OUTER JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_12=SM1008.SM1008_6
        WHERE ISNULL(IN_7,'OO') = 'OO'  AND SM1008_34='Pending' AND SM1008_24=@BRANCH --and sm1016_c28 <>''
) a  

GROUP BY CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,PRODUNQ,CREDITLIMIT,CHALLANUNQ,QTY,ORDERDATE,RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,CDATE,USERNAME,ORDERVALUE
ORDER BY CDATE DESC,challanno DESC
--HAVING (SUM(ORDERVALUE)+SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) > 0


 
SELECT IN_13 AS INVNO, IN_12 AS CUSTOMERUNQ,SM19_6 AS CUSTOMERNAME,IN_8 AS INVDATE,IN_9 AS INVOICEAMT,
(SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = INVN.IN_5)) AS PRODUCT,IN_14 AS DUEDATE,
ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(getdate()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00)AS DUEAMOUNT, 
(SELECT TOP 1(case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end)) AS OVERDUEDAYS
FROM INVN INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=INVN.IN_12
WHERE IN_7 = 'OO'  and in_11<>0.00 
end

	SELECT 'Approved Successfully' AS err;
	end

		---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	  if @what='orderbooking'
  begin
		SELECT (SELECT (SM1002_7) FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM1016_C4) AS BRANCH, (SELECT SM1016_5 from sm1016 where unqid=SM1016_C5) AS [Booking Order No],
		(CONVERT(CHAR(11), SM1016_C1, 106)) AS [Order Date],(SELECT (sm19_5) FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = SM1016_7) AS Customer,
		(SELECT (sm206_7) FROM sm206 WHERE sm206_2 = SM1016_C8) AS ProductName,
		 (CONVERT(nvarchar, SM1016_C11) +' '+ (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar, sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE unqid = SM1016_C12)) AS QTY
		 , (SM1016_C34) AS STRENGTH, (CONVERT(nvarchar, SM1016_C35) +' '+ (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar, sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE unqid = SM1016_C12)) AS NetQTY,
		(SM1016_C13) AS Freight, (SM1016_C24) AS [Mode Of Payment], (SM1016_C23) AS [Payment Term], CASE WHEN SM1016_C16 != 0 THEN CONCAT(SM1016_C16, ' (CASH)')
        WHEN SM1016_C17 != 0 THEN CONCAT(SM1016_C17, ' (CREDIT)') ELSE '0 (No Cash or Credit)' END AS CashAndCredit, SM1016_c.SM1016_C33 AS Reason
		FROM SM1016 INNER JOIN  SM1016_c ON SM1016.UNQID = SM1016_c.SM1016_C5 WHERE SM1016_C.UNQID = @UNQID     
   end

	if @what ='WhatappmsgOB'
	begin  
        --SELECT SM502_9 AS SM504_6 FROM SM1016 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM1016_3=SM63_5 INNER JOIN SM502 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63.SM63_13 WHERE SM1016.UNQID=@uqid
		  SELECT SM63_6,SM502_9 AS SM504_6 FROM SM1016_c INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM1016_c3=SM63_5 INNER JOIN SM502 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63.SM63_13 
	  WHERE sm1016_c.unqid=@uqid

	if @what ='Whatappmsg1CA'

    SELECT SM502_9 AS SM504_6 FROM SM1008 INNER JOIN SM63 ON sm1008_3=SM63_5 INNER JOIN SM502 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63.SM63_13 WHERE SM1008.UNQID=@uqid
	
	end

	if @what ='challanA'
	begin
	   SELECT CHALLANUNQ,CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,
cast(ORDERVALUE as numeric(18,2)) AS ORDERVALUE,SUM(INVOICEAMT) AS PREVIOUSINVAMT,
FORMAT(SUM(DUEAMOUNT), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALDUEAMT,
FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT,'N2','en-IN')as CREDITLIMIT ,
MAX(OVERDUEDAYS) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) > 0 
        THEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS [REQDCL],
QTY,ORDERDATE,
FORMAT(SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
 CASE 
        WHEN (CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)) > 0 
        THEN FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN')
        ELSE '0.00'
    END AS CLavailable,
RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,USERNAME
FROM (

        SELECT sm1008.unqid as CHALLANUNQ,
		ISNULL((case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end),0.00) AS DUEAMT,
		SM1008_24 AS BRANCHUNQ,
		SM1002_7 AS BRANCHNAME,
		SM1008_6 AS CUSTOMERUNQ,SM19_5 AS CUSTOMERNAME,SM1008_8 AS PRODUNQ,SM206_7 AS PRODNAME,
		SM1008_10 AS QTY,
		SM1008_12 AS Rate,
		ISNULL((SM1008_10*SM1008_12)*1.18,0.00) AS ORDERVALUE,
		SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT ,
		ISNULL(IN_9,0) AS INVOICEAMT,
		ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(getdate()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00) AS DUEAMOUNT,
        ISNULL((case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end) ,0) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(SM1008_5 AS DATETIME), 103)AS ORDERDATE,
        --SM1008_5 AS ORDERDATE,
		ISNULL(IN_11,0.00) AS TOTALOUTSTANDING ,
		(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1008_19)AS UNIT,sm1008_15 as challanno,sm1008_35 as REASON,SM1008_5 AS CDATE,
		(SELECT SM63_6 FROM SM63 WHERE SM63_5=SM1008_3)AS USERNAME,sm1008_17 as cartage
		FROM SM1008 INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1008.SM1008_24 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1008.SM1008_6 
		INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1008.SM1008_8 LEFT OUTER JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_12=SM1008.SM1008_6
        WHERE ISNULL(IN_7,'OO') = 'OO' AND sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID
) a  

GROUP BY CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,PRODUNQ,CREDITLIMIT,CHALLANUNQ,QTY,ORDERDATE,RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,CDATE,USERNAME,ORDERVALUE
ORDER BY CDATE DESC,challanno DESC


select SM504_6 AS SM504_6  from sm504 where SM504_4='Order Booking' and SM504_5='Save' 



------challan aprroval loss msg----------

select SM504_6 AS SM504_6  from sm504 where SM504_4='Challan Approval Loss' and SM504_5='Approve' 


SELECT *
INTO #SalesCTE
FROM (

    
    -- 2?? Opening Data  (Fixed with GROUP BY)
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
       -- sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
       -- sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
       -- SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        --SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        SUM(SM1008_C4) AS SELLQTY,
        sm1008_14 AS SELLINGRATE,
       -- SUM(SM1023_c8) AS GRQTY,
       -- SUM(SM1011_24) AS SALEAMT,
        SM1023_c13 AS COST,
        0.00 AS NCOST,
        --0.00 AS INVNDISC,
        0 AS DiscountByMonth,
		 0 AS DiscountByQuantityRange
    FROM sm1008
    JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 
    JOIN SM1023 ON SM1023.UNQID = SM1023_C.SM1023_C5
    WHERE 
       sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID
	  
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_2,
    
        sm19.sm19_5,
        sm206_7,

		sm1008_14,
		SM1023_c13

    UNION ALL
  
     SELECT
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
      --  sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
       -- sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
       -- SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
       -- '' AS INVNO,
      SUM(SM1008_C4) AS SELLQTY,
        sm1008_14 AS SELLINGRATE,
     --   SUM(SM1005_57) AS GRQTY,
       -- SUM(SM1011_24) AS SALEAMT,
        (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS COST,
        (SM1005_24 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS NCOST,
       -- (SM1005_25) AS INVNDISC,
        ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(sm_401_c_8)
            FROM sm_401_c
            INNER JOIN sm_401 ON SM_401.SM_401_5 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_6
            WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN sm_401_6 AND sm_401_7
              AND sm1005_42 = sm_401_11
              AND sm1005_10 = sm_401_c_7
        ),0) AS DiscountByMonth
		 -- ?? Discount By Quantity Range
  , ISNULL((
        SELECT  CAST(sm_402_c7 AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        FROM sm_402 
        INNER JOIN sm_402_c ON sm_402.unqid = sm_402_c4
        WHERE sm_402_7 = SM1005_10
          AND sum(SM1005_57) BETWEEN 
                CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AND 
                CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT)
				
    ), 0)  *
	 SUM(CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3))) AS DiscountByQuantityRange 
    FROM SM1008
	  JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4
	
     WHERE 
       sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID
	  

    GROUP BY 
        sm1005.SM1005_10,
        sm1005.SM1005_42,
        sm1005.SM1005_6,

        sm206.sm206_2,
        sm206.sm206_7,

        sm19.sm19_5,


        sm1005.SM1005_24,
        sm1005.SM1005_25,
        sm1005.SM1005_27,
        sm1005.SM1005_28,
        sm1005.SM1005_83,
		   sm1005.SM1005_57,
		   sm1008_14

) AS SourceData;

--select * from #salescte
SELECT
    
    PRODUCTUNQ,
    SELLINGRATE,
	custname,
	cast((COST-(sum(DiscountByMonth) + sum(DiscountByQuantityRange) ))/1000 as numeric(18,2)) AS purchasecost,
	SELLQTY AS Qty,
    cast(( SELLINGRATE-CAST((COST - (SUM(DiscountByMonth) + SUM(DiscountByQuantityRange)))/1000 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ) 
        * SELLQTY as numeric(18,2)) AS LossAmount
INTO #yyy
FROM #SalesCTE
GROUP BY  PRODUCTUNQ ,SELLINGRATE,COST,custname,SELLQTY

select * from #yyy inner join sm1008 on sm1008_8=productunq inner join sm1002 on sm1002_5=sm1008_24 inner join sm206 on sm206_2=sm1008_8 where sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID

	end



	
--select unqid as unqid, sm227_8 as supplier from sm227
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SW_SSR_REPORT_Q] 
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',
@unqid               NVARCHAR(max)  = '',
@FROMDATE            nvarchar(30)  = '',
@TODATE              nvarchar(30)  = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCT   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCTUNQ   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@BRANCHID     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',

@uid        NVARCHAR(MAX)  ='',
@designation			as  nvarchar(50) = '',
@des        nvarchar(50) = ''

	
AS
begin 
	
	IF @AA = 'BINDB'
    BEGIN
       
        -- TABLE 1: BRANCH DROPDOWN
     
        set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	    select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Branch from SM1002 
	    where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	    ORDER BY SM1002_7

        
    END

	IF @AA = 'BINDC'
    BEGIN
        

        -- TABLE 2: PRODUCT CATEGORY DROPDOWN
        SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM17_6 AS [PCATEGORY] 
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY SM17_6 ASC;
    END

	IF @AA = 'BINDA'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS [PRODUCT] 
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC;

        
    END





	IF @AA = 'GETACC'
    BEGIN
        -- TABLE 0: PRODUCT DROPDOWN
        SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS [PRODUCT] 
        FROM SM206 where sm206_13= @unqid
        ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC;

     
    END

	if @AA = 'designation'
	begin 
		select sm501_4 as DESIGNATION from sm501 inner join sm502 on sm501.unqid = sm502.sm502_14 inner join sm63 on sm63_13 = sm502.unqid where sm63.sm63_5 = @designation
	end


	if @AA = 'DATA'

	
	begin 
 --   SET @fromdate = [dbo].[getformatteddate](@fromdate);
 --   SET @todate = [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate);
	--print @fromdate;
	--print @todate;

	--TABLE 0
	if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;


  
	

	SELECT 
    Product, 
    [DATE], 
    Particulars, 
    Unit, 
  CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS RECEIPTS,
  CAST(SUM(ISSUE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS ISSUE, 
  CAST(SUM(OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS OPENI,
  CAST(SUM(EXCESS) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS EXCESS, 
  CAST(SUM(SHORTAGE) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS SHORTAGE,
  CAST(SUM(closing) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS closing,
  CAST(SUM(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI)) 
  OVER (PARTITION by product order BY product, [DATE], ORD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) AS Balance,
    ORD
FROM (
    -- Opening Balance Calculation
   SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_7  as Product, 
        @fromdate AS [DATE], 
        'Opening Balance' AS Particulars, 
        sm209.sm209_7 as Unit, 
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        ISSUE, 
		SUM(OPENI) AS OPENI,
        EXCESS, 
        SHORTAGE, 
		0.00 AS closing, 
        0 AS ORD
    FROM (

	 -- Opening for Purchase
        SELECT 
			sm227_c.sm227_c4 AS Product, 
			sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
			0 AS RECEIPTS, 
			0 AS ISSUE, 
			--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,3))/100 ELSE SM1005_45 end )  As OPENI,
			SM227_c.sm227_c6 As OPENI,
			0 AS EXCESS, 
			0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm227_c
		inner join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c.sm227_c3
		inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4
		INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.sm209_5 = sm206_12
        WHERE SM227_6 < @fromdate and sm227_c4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
		and sm227_32 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Opening
        SELECT 
            sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
            sm209.unqid  AS Unit,  
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
			--line added by garima
			(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as OPENI,
			0 as EXCESS,
			0 as SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1023
		inner join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
		right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
		left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
          WHERE
		  sm1023_5 < @fromdate and sm1023_c6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ',')) and sm1023_4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))

        UNION ALL
		
		
		 -- Opening for Shortage/Excess
        SELECT 
            sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
            sm1014.sm1014_11  AS Unit,  
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0 AS ISSUE,
			(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) -
			 (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) as OPENI,
           0 AS EXCESS,
		
		  0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm1014
		right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
		left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
          WHERE
		  --sm1014_14 <> 0 AND 
		  sm1014.sm1014_6 < @fromdate and sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ',')) and sm1014.sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
        --GROUP BY sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9

        UNION ALL

        -- Opening for Sales
        SELECT 
            sm213_c.sm213_c5 AS Product, 
            sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
            0 AS RECEIPTS, 
            0  AS ISSUE, 
			isnull(SM213_c19,0)*-1 as OPENI,
			-- (CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end )*-1 as OPENI,
            0 AS EXCESS, 
            0 AS SHORTAGE
        FROM sm213_c
        inner join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
		inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm213_c5
		inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid = sm206_12
        WHERE sm213_6 < @fromdate and  sm213_c5 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
		and sm213_64 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    ) AS Opening
	right JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = product
    left JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = unit
    GROUP BY sm206_7,Product, Unit,sm209.sm209_7,sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Receipts
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM227_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm227_7 + ' ' + FORMAT(SM227_6, 'dd/MM/yyyy') + ' ' + ' Goods Receipt (' + CAST(sm227_25 AS varchar) + ')' AS Particulars, 
        sm227_c5 AS Unit, 
        --CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,3))/100 ELSE SM1005_45*SM209_10  END  AS RECEIPTS, 
		sm227_c.SM227_c6 AS RECEIPTS,
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE,
		0.00 AS closing,  
        1 AS ORD
    FROM sm227_c
	inner join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c.sm227_c3
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm227_c4
    WHERE SM227_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate  and sm227_c4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm227_32 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Goods Shortage/Excess
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        SM1014_6 AS [DATE], 
        CASE 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  sm1014_13 + ' Goods Shortage' 
            WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN   sm1014_13 +' Goods Excess' 
        END AS Particulars, 
        sm209_7 AS Unit, 
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0.00 AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        --SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14*SM209_10  ELSE 0.000 END) AS EXCESS,
		(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS EXCESS,
		
       ( CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS SHORTAGE, 
        0.00 AS closing, 
		2 AS ORD
    FROM sm1014
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
    WHERE 
	--sm1014_14 <> 0 AND
	SM1014_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate and  sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))  and sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    --GROUP BY sm206_7, SM1014_6, sm209_7, sm1014_17

    UNION ALL

    -- Transaction Data: Sales
    SELECT 
        sm206_7 AS Product, 
        sm213_6 AS [DATE], 
        sm213_8 + sm213_9 + ' Sales' AS Particulars, 
        sm209_8 AS Unit, 
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        SM213_c19*SM209_10  AS ISSUE, 
		-- (CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end ) AS ISSUE, 
		0.00 as OPENI,
        0.00 AS EXCESS, 
        0.00 AS SHORTAGE, 
		0.00 AS closing, 
        3 AS ORD
    FROM sm213_c
	inner join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm213_c5
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206_12
    WHERE sm213_6 BETWEEN @fromdate AND @todate and  sm213_c5 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	and sm213_64 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
UNION ALL



SELECT 
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product, 
    @todate AS [DATE], 
    'Closing Balance' AS Particulars, 
    sm209.sm209_7 AS Unit, 
     0 AS RECEIPTS, 
    0 as ISSUE, 
	0 asOPENI,
    0 asEXCESS, 
    0 as SHORTAGE, 
	isnull(CAST(SUM(RECEIPTS - ISSUE + EXCESS - SHORTAGE + OPENI) AS NUMERIC(18,0)),0) *SM209_10 AS closing, 
    4 AS ORD
FROM (
    -- Closing for Purchase
    SELECT 
        sm227_c.sm227_c4 AS Product, 
        sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
       -- (CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SM1005_45*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1005_45 end )  AS RECEIPTS, 
		SM227_c6 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0 AS ISSUE, 
		0 as OPENI,
        0 AS EXCESS, 
        0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm227_c   
	inner join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
	inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm227_c4
	INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.sm209_5 = sm206_12
    WHERE sm227_6 <= @todate AND sm227_c.sm227_c4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm227_32 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    UNION ALL

	-- Closing for Opening
    SELECT 
       sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 AS Product, 
       sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
       0 AS RECEIPTS, 
       0 AS ISSUE,  
	   (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) as OPENI,
       0 AS EXCESS,
		
       0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1023
	 inner join sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
	 INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c.sm1023_c6
	 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm206.sm206_11
    WHERE sm1023.sm1023_5<= @todate AND sm1023_c.sm1023_c6 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))  and sm1023_4 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    --GROUP BY sm1014.sm1014_10, sm1014.sm1014_11

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing for Shortage/Excess
    SELECT 
        sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product, 
        sm1014.sm1014_11 AS Unit, 
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
        0 AS ISSUE,  
		0 as OPENI,
       (CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS EXCESS,
		
       ( CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN  CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN SM1014_14*CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1014_14  END ELSE 0.00 END) AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm1014
	 INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
	 INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
    WHERE sm1014.sm1014_6 <= @todate AND sm1014.sm1014_10 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))  and sm1014_7 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
    --GROUP BY sm1014.sm1014_10, sm1014.sm1014_11

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing for Sales (if applicable)
    SELECT 
        sm213_c.sm213_c5 AS Product, 
        sm209.unqid AS Unit, 
        0 AS RECEIPTS, 
       ISNULL(sm213_c.sm213_c19, 0)  AS ISSUE, 
	    --(CASE WHEN SM1011_18<>'' THEN SM1011_20*CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE SM1011_42 end )AS ISSUE,
		0 as OPENI,
        0 AS EXCESS, 
        0 AS SHORTAGE
    FROM sm213_c
	inner join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
	inner join sm206 on sm206_2 = sm213_c5 
	inner join sm209 on sm209.unqid = sm206_12
    WHERE sm213.sm213_6 <= @todate AND sm213_c.sm213_c5 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@PRODUCT, ','))
	 and sm213_64 IN (SELECT Data FROM DBO.SPLIT(@branch, ','))
) AS Closing
RIGHT JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = Closing.Product
LEFT JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = Closing.Unit
GROUP BY sm206.sm206_7, Closing.Product, Closing.Unit, sm209.sm209_7,sm209.sm209_10, ISSUE, OPENI, EXCESS, SHORTAGE

) AS FinalResult
GROUP BY Product, [DATE], Particulars, Unit, ORD
ORDER BY Product, DATE ASC, ORD ASC



	
	END



	
	if @aa = 'demostore'
    begin
	      delete from Sm1024
	      insert into Sm1024 values(@uid,@unqid);
		 -- select * from Stock_Registor
    end

	if @AA ='retrieveunq'
	begin
	
	      select unqid from Sm1024
	end
END
GO
