-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_SW_STOCK_SUMMARY_Q] 


@what					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',	
@fromdate				AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate					AS	NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@BRANCH					AS	NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@MANUFACTURER			AS	NVARCHAR(max) = '',
@designation			as  nvarchar(50) = '',
@uid					AS	NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@des                    as  nvarchar(50) = ''

AS 


BEGIN 
if @what = 'designation'
begin 
	select sm501_4 as DESIGNATION from sm501 inner join sm502 on sm501.unqid = sm502.sm502_14 inner join sm63 on sm63_13 = sm502.unqid where sm63.sm63_5 = @designation
end

IF @what = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN

declare  @branchid nvarchar(max) = '';
 
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH, 1 as ord 
	union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as [BRANCH] ,2 as ord from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY ord, branch ASC;


END

IF @what = 'MANU'
BEGIN
SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [MANU] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	  	SELECT unqid AS [UNQID],sm113_6 AS [MANU],1 as ord  FROM SM113) 
		AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[MANU] ASC;

END

IF @what = 'BIND'
BEGIN


 
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	--SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname, 1 as ord 
	--union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as Dname ,2 as ord from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY Dname ASC;

	--SELECT * FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS Dname ,0 as ord  
	-- UNION ALL 
	  	SELECT unqid AS [UNQID],sm113_6 AS Dname  FROM SM113 
		 ORDER BY Dname ASC;


END


IF @what = 'GETDATA'
BEGIN
--TABLE 0
	   if @branch = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @BRANCH
	    end;





WITH OpeningData AS (



    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        --SUM(SM1005_45) AS Opening,
		--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS Opening,
		sum(SM227_c6)  AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm227_c
	join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM227_32
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM227_34
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = sm227_33
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM227_c4
	join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE sm227_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
    AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
   AND (sm227.sm227_32 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        isnull(SM213_c19,0)*-1 AS Opening,
		--SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )*-1 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM213_c
	join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM213_64
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM213_72
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM213_71
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM213_c5
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM213_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM213_64  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,SM213_c19
    UNION ALL
    -- Opening: Opening
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
       -- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
	   (case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Opening,
	  -- line comment by garima
		--CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		--WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3))AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1023
	join sm1023_c on sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4 --SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7 --SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6 --SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c6 --SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    --WHERE SM1014_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
	WHERE SM1023_5 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
  -- AND ( SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (SM1023.SM1023_4 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))--SM1014.SM1014_7 = @Branch)
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6,sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9

	union all 
	 -- Opening: S/E
	SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
		CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
	WHERE SM1014_6 < CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103)  
  -- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
  AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
 AND (SM1014.SM1014_7 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
   GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),
TransactionData AS (
    -- PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        SUM(sm227_c6) AS PURCHASE,

		--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end ) AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM sm227_c
    join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM227_32
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM227_34
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = sm227_33
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM227_c4
	join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE sm227_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND ( sm1005.sm1005_9  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
   AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (sm227_32  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        SUM(SM213_c19) AS SALES,
	 --SUM(
  --      CASE 
  --          WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
  --              THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
  --          ELSE SM1011_42 
  --      END
  --  )  AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM213_c
    join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM213_64
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM213_72
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM213_71
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM213_c5
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM213_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
   AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (SM213_64 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
    UNION ALL
    -- S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
        SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
       -- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
	    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3))AS SHORTAGEEXCESS ,
        0.000 AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 BETWEEN CONVERT(datetime, @FROMDATE, 103) AND CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)
   --AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
   AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND (sm1014.SM1014_7  in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
),

   ClosingData AS (
    -- Closing: PURCHASE
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --SUM(SM1005_45) AS Closing
		--(CASE WHEN SM1005_22<>'' THEN SUM(SM1005_45)*CAST(SM1005_22 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE sum(SM1005_45) end )AS Closing
		sum(sm227_c6) AS Closing
    FROM sm227_c
	join sm227 on sm227.unqid = sm227_c3
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM227_32
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM227_34
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = sm227_33
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM227_c4
	join sm206_c on sm206_c6 = sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE sm227_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
	AND (sm227_32 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6

    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: SALES
    SELECT 
        sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        SUM(SM213_c19) * -1 AS Closing
		  -- SUM(
    --    CASE 
    --        WHEN SM1011_18 <> '' 
    --            THEN SM1011_20 * CAST(SM1011_18 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) / 100 
    --        ELSE SM1011_42 
    --    END
    --)*-1 AS Closing
    FROM SM213_c
    join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4
    JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = SM213_64
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM213_72
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM213_71
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM213_c5
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM213_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM213_64 in (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
  
    GROUP BY sm1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6


    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
		--line comment by garima
		-- CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		--WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3))
		(case when @des != 'Auditor' then(sm1023_c8) else(sm1023_c9)end) AS Closing
    FROM sm1023
	join sm1023_c on sm1023_c5 = sm1023.unqid
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1023_4
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1023_7
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1023_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = sm1023_c6
	JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE sm1023_5 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6  in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
  AND ( SM1023.SM1023_4 in  (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')))
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6, sm1023_c8, sm1023_c9


	    UNION ALL

    -- Closing: S/E
    SELECT 
        SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        SM1006_C.SM1006_C7 AS [LOCATION],
        sm1006.sm1006_5 AS WAREHOUSE,
        SM206.SM206_7 AS PRODUCT,
		  SM113.sm113_6 AS MANUFACTURER, 
        0.000 AS Opening,
        0.000 AS PURCHASE,
        0.000 AS SALES,
        0.000 AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
        --CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
		 CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GS' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) 
		WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)   END) AS numeric(15, 3)) AS Closing
    FROM SM1014
    JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM1014_7
    JOIN SM1006_C ON SM1006_C.UNQID = SM1014_8
    JOIN sm1006 ON sm1006.UNQID = SM1014_9
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM1014_10
	JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.sm206_c6 = SM206.sm206_2
    JOIN SM113 ON SM113.unqid = SM206_C.sm206_c7
    WHERE SM1014_6 <= CONVERT(datetime, @TODATE, 103)  
	-- AND (SM113.sm113_6 in (select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,',')))
	AND (SM113.sm113_6  in ( select sm113_6 from sm113 where unqid in(select data from  dbo.split(@MANUFACTURER,','))))
 AND (SM1014.SM1014_7  in  (select data from  dbo.split(@branch,',')) )
    GROUP BY SM1002.sm1002_7, SM1006_C.SM1006_C7, sm1006.sm1006_5, SM206.SM206_7, SM113.sm113_6
)
SELECT 

    BRANCH, 
    [LOCATION], 
    WAREHOUSE, 
    PRODUCT,
	MANUFACTURER,
    SUM(Opening) AS Opening,
    CAST(SUM(PURCHASE)AS NUMERIC(18,0))AS PURCHASE,
    SUM(SALES) AS SALES,
    CAST(SUM(SHORTAGEEXCESS)AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS SHORTAGEEXCESS,
    CAST(SUM(Opening + PURCHASE - SALES + SHORTAGEEXCESS) AS numeric(18, 0)) AS Closing,
	isnull((sm1001.sm1001_8),0) as MINLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_9),0) as MAXLEVEL,
    isnull((sm1001.sm1001_10),0) as REORDERLEVEL
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM OpeningData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM TransactionData
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ClosingData
) AS CombinedData
LEFT JOIN sm1001 ON sm1001.sm1001_7= CombinedData.PRODUCT 
    AND sm1001.sm1001_6 = CombinedData.MANUFACTURER
    AND sm1001.sm1001_5 = CombinedData.BRANCH

GROUP BY BRANCH, [LOCATION], WAREHOUSE, PRODUCT, MANUFACTURER,sm1001.sm1001_8, sm1001.sm1001_9, sm1001.sm1001_10
order by BRANCH, PRODUCT;

	 
END



END
GO

	IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE'

		SM1030_6 = @sm1030_6,
		SM1030_7 = @SM1030_7,
		SM1030_8 = @SM1030_8,
		SM1030_9 = @SM1030_9,

		SM1030_12 = @SM1030_12,
		SM1030_13 = @SM1030_13 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	END


IF @WHAT = 'REPORT'
BEGIN 
SELECT TableName,ColumnName,DataType,[MaxLength] FROM Table$
END

IF @WHAT = 'REPORT2'
BEGIN
select StoredProcedure as sp_name, ReferencedTable as t_name from [Table_Q$]  order by t_name
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_TDS_REPORT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_TDS_REPORT]
@a			 as nvarchar(20) = '',
@branchid    as nvarchar(max) ='',
@formdate    as nvarchar(20) = '',
@todate      as nvarchar(20) = '' 

AS
BEGIN
if @a = 'tdsdata'
begin
SELECT 
	sm1002.sm1002_7 as [Branch],
	sm1030.sm1030_10 as [PAN],
	sm1030.sm1030_7 AS [NAME],
	sm1030.sm1030_9 AS [ADDRESS], 
	'' AS[STATE],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct9 AS [AMOUNT], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct11 AS [RATE], 
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct12 AS [TDS],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct12 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
	CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime) AS SortDate
FROM 
	sm203_ctds 
	LEFT JOIN sm203 ON sm203_4 = sm203_ctds.sm203_ct5
	JOIN sm1030 ON sm1030.unqid = sm203_ctds.sm203_ct7
	INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm203.sm203_101 = sm1002.sm1002_5
	where sm203.sm203_11 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

UNION

SELECT 
	sm1002.sm1002_7 as [Branch],
	sm1030.sm1030_10 as [PAN],
	sm1030.sm1030_7 AS [NAME],
	sm1030.sm1030_9 AS [ADDRESS], 
	'' AS[STATE],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct9 AS [AMOUNT], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct11 AS [RATE], 
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct12 AS [TDS],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct12 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
	CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime ) AS SortDate
FROM 
	sm202_ctds 
	LEFT JOIN sm202 ON sm202_4 = sm202_ctds.sm202_ct5
	JOIN sm1030 ON sm1030.unqid = sm202_ctds.sm202_ct7 
	INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm202.sm202_101 = sm1002.sm1002_5
	where sm202.sm202_13 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

UNION

SELECT 
	branch,
	sm19_46 AS [PAN],
	sm19_5 AS [NAME],
	sm19_13 AS [ADDRESS],
	sm19_24 AS[STATE],
	SUM(amount) AS [AMOUNT],
	[DATE],
	sm19_68 AS [RATE],
	SUM(tds) AS [TDS],
	SUM(TTAMOUNTOFTD) AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD],
	[DATEOFTD],
	SortDate
FROM (
	SELECT  
		[Branch],
		[PAN],
		[NAME],
		[ADDRESS],
		[STATE],
		[AMOUNT],
		[DATE],
		0 AS [RATE], 
		[TDS],
	    [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
		[DATEOFTD],
		sm203_c6,
		SortDate
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			sm1002_7 AS [Branch],
			'' AS [PAN],
			'' AS [NAME],
			'' AS [ADDRESS], 
			'' as [STATE],
			sm203_c.sm203_c10 * -1 AS [AMOUNT], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
			0 AS [RATE], 
			0 AS [TDS],
			0 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
			sm203_C6,
			CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime) as sortdate
		FROM sm203 
		INNER JOIN sm203_c ON sm203_c6 = sm203_4
		INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002_5 = SM203_101
		inner join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm203_15
		WHERE sm203_c6 IN (
			SELECT sm203_c6 
			FROM sm203_c 
			WHERE sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'
		) 
		AND sm203_c10 <> 0 
		AND sm203_c9 = '39118950-94DB-433A-AA20-19DBFB07A033' 
		AND sm203_13 = 'ff'
	and sm1005_84 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

		UNION ALL

		SELECT 
			sm1002_7 AS [Branch],
			'' AS [PAN],
			'' AS [NAME],
			'' AS [ADDRESS], 
			'' as [state],
			0 AS [AMOUNT], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
			0 AS [RATE], 
			sm203_c10 AS [TDS],
			sm203_c10 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
			sm203_C6,
			CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime) as sortdate

		FROM sm203 
		INNER JOIN sm203_c ON sm203_c6 = sm203_4 
		INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002_5 = SM203_101
			inner join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm203_15
		WHERE sm203_c6 IN (
			SELECT sm203_c6 
			FROM sm203_c 
			WHERE sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'
		) 
		AND sm203_c10 <> 0 
		AND sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'  
		AND sm203_13 = 'ff'
        and sm1005_84 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	   AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

	) AS aAA
) AS bbb 
INNER JOIN sm203_c AS b ON b.sm203_c6 = bbb.sm203_c6
INNER JOIN sm19 ON b.sm203_c9 = sm19.unqid 
WHERE sm19_11 = 'trans'
GROUP BY branch, bbb.sm203_c6, sm19_5, sm19_46, sm19_13, sm19_24, [DATE], sm19_68, [DATEOFTD], sortdate,sm19_24

ORDER BY [NAME], sortdate;

end


if @a='BranchBind'
begin
 --set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH from SM1002 
	--where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;
end

if @a = 'allbranch'
begin

SELECT 
	sm1002.sm1002_7 as [Branch],
	sm1030.sm1030_10 as [PAN],
	sm1030.sm1030_7 AS [NAME],
	sm1030.sm1030_9 AS [ADDRESS], 
	'' AS[STATE],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct9 AS [AMOUNT], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct11 AS [RATE], 
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct12 AS [TDS],
	sm203_ctds.sm203_ct12 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
	CAST(sm203_ctds.sm203_ct10 as datetime) AS SortDate
FROM 
	sm203_ctds 
	LEFT JOIN sm203 ON sm203_4 = sm203_ctds.sm203_ct5
	JOIN sm1030 ON sm1030.unqid = sm203_ctds.sm203_ct7
	INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm203.sm203_101 = sm1002.sm1002_5
	where sm203.sm203_11 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	--AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

UNION

SELECT 
	sm1002.sm1002_7 as [Branch],
	sm1030.sm1030_10 as [PAN],
	sm1030.sm1030_7 AS [NAME],
	sm1030.sm1030_9 AS [ADDRESS], 
	'' AS[STATE],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct9 AS [AMOUNT], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct11 AS [RATE], 
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct12 AS [TDS],
	sm202_ctds.sm202_ct12 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
	FORMAT(CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
	CAST(sm202_ctds.sm202_ct10 as datetime ) AS SortDate
FROM 
	sm202_ctds 
	LEFT JOIN sm202 ON sm202_4 = sm202_ctds.sm202_ct5
	JOIN sm1030 ON sm1030.unqid = sm202_ctds.sm202_ct7 
	INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm202.sm202_101 = sm1002.sm1002_5
	where sm202.sm202_13 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	--AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

UNION

SELECT 
	branch,
	sm19_46 AS [PAN],
	sm19_5 AS [NAME],
	sm19_13 AS [ADDRESS],
	sm19_24 AS[STATE],
	SUM(amount) AS [AMOUNT],
	[DATE],
	sm19_68 AS [RATE],
	SUM(tds) AS [TDS],
	SUM(TTAMOUNTOFTD) AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD],
	[DATEOFTD],
	SortDate
FROM (
	SELECT  
		[Branch],
		[PAN],
		[NAME],
		[ADDRESS],
		[STATE],
		[AMOUNT],
		[DATE],
		0 AS [RATE], 
		[TDS],
	    [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
		[DATEOFTD],
		sm203_c6,
		SortDate
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			sm1002_7 AS [Branch],
			'' AS [PAN],
			'' AS [NAME],
			'' AS [ADDRESS], 
			'' as [STATE],
			sm203_c.sm203_c10 * -1 AS [AMOUNT], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
			0 AS [RATE], 
			0 AS [TDS],
			0 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
			sm203_C6,
			CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime) as sortdate
		FROM sm203 
		INNER JOIN sm203_c ON sm203_c6 = sm203_4
		INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002_5 = SM203_101
		inner join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm203_15
		WHERE sm203_c6 IN (
			SELECT sm203_c6 
			FROM sm203_c 
			WHERE sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'
		) 
		AND sm203_c10 <> 0 
		AND sm203_c9 = '39118950-94DB-433A-AA20-19DBFB07A033' 
		AND sm203_13 = 'ff'
	and sm1005_84 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	--AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

		UNION ALL

		SELECT 
			sm1002_7 AS [Branch],
			'' AS [PAN],
			'' AS [NAME],
			'' AS [ADDRESS], 
			'' as [state],
			0 AS [AMOUNT], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATE],
			0 AS [RATE], 
			sm203_c10 AS [TDS],
			sm203_c10 AS [TTAMOUNTOFTD], 
			FORMAT(CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS [DATEOFTD],
			sm203_C6,
			CAST(sm1005_84 as datetime) as sortdate

		FROM sm203 
		INNER JOIN sm203_c ON sm203_c6 = sm203_4 
		INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1002_5 = SM203_101
			inner join sm1005 on sm1005_4=sm203_15
		WHERE sm203_c6 IN (
			SELECT sm203_c6 
			FROM sm203_c 
			WHERE sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'
		) 
		AND sm203_c10 <> 0 
		AND sm203_c9 = '9934C659-F4EA-498F-85CF-EC18E4DA31B8'  
		AND sm203_13 = 'ff'
        and sm1005_84 between [dbo].[getformatteddate](@formdate) and [dbo].[getformatteddate](@todate)
	   -- AND sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))

	) AS aAA
) AS bbb 
INNER JOIN sm203_c AS b ON b.sm203_c6 = bbb.sm203_c6
INNER JOIN sm19 ON b.sm203_c9 = sm19.unqid 
WHERE sm19_11 = 'trans'
GROUP BY branch, bbb.sm203_c6, sm19_5, sm19_46, sm19_13, sm19_24, [DATE], sm19_68, [DATEOFTD], sortdate,sm19_24

ORDER BY [NAME], sortdate;

end

End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_TRIAL_BALANCE_Q]
@TYPE		NVARCHAR(20) = '',	
@unqid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@radio      NVARCHAR(10) = '',
@schedule   NVARCHAR(100)= '',
@BRANCH      NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
AS


IF @TYPE = 'TRIAL_BALANCE'
BEGIN
	IF @SCHEDULE = 'ALL'
	BEGIN
		-----------------------------trial balance
		if @radio = 'S'
		Begin
			--SELECT MAX(M3_19) AS [M3_19],CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND M3_9='CR' THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND M3_9='DR' THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME],
			--SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			--SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			--(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@TODATE as [Type],
			--(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH
			-- INTO #T
			--FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID 
			----WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
			--WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			--AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			--GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_23,SM44_10,M3_9
			--HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			--SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T 
			--GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			--HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			----ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			--ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME

			--------------NEW QUERY FOR TB--------------
			SELECT SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(M3_6,0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)>0 THEN ISNULL(M3_6,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@todate as [Type],
			CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)>=0 THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)<=0 THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME], SM1002_7  as BRANCH
            INTO #T FROM 
			(SELECT M3_4 AS M3_4,SUM(M3_6) AS M3_6,M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 WHERE M3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			GROUP BY M3_4,M3_23) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME

			SELECT * FROM #T

		end
		else if @radio = 'O'
		Begin
			SELECT MIN(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],M3_1 AS [CODE] ,'OPENING TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@fromdate as [Type],
			(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH INTO #T1
			FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
			--AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
			AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			 GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_1,M3_23
			HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T1 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= dbo.getformatteddate(@todate) AND [CODE] = 'AA' 
			GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
		End
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-----------------------------trial balance
		if @radio = 'S'
		Begin
			SELECT MAX(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT] ,'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@TODATE as [Type]  ,
			(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH INTO #T111
			FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44_5 INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE SM44.unqid = @SCHEDULE 
			--AND DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			AND DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			--AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
			AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_23
			HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T111
			GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			--ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME
		end
		else if @radio = 'O'
		Begin
			--SELECT MIN(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			--SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			--(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],M3_1 AS [CODE] ,'OPENING TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@fromdate as [Type], 
			--(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH
			-- INTO #T11
			--FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44_5 INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE SM44_5 = @SCHEDULE
	  -- --AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
	  -- AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			--GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_1,M3_23
			--HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			--SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T11 
			--WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= dbo.getformatteddate(@todate) AND [CODE] = 'AA' 
			----AND M3_23='FEF8D467-6AB9-4B89-B121-C77D888A5740'
			--GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			--HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			--ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			SELECT SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(M3_6,0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)>0 THEN ISNULL(M3_6,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@todate as [Type],
			CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)>=0 THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)<=0 THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
            INTO #T11 FROM 
			(SELECT M3_4 AS M3_4,SUM(M3_6) AS M3_6 FROM M3 WHERE M3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			GROUP BY M3_4) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME
		End
	END
END


IF @TYPE = 'BINDCATEGORY'
BEGIN
		
		  SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [SCHEDULE] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT unqid AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULE], 1 as ord  FROM SM44 
	  WHERE SM44.UNQID IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19)) AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[SCHEDULE] ASC;
END

IF @TYPE = 'BINDCATEGORY2'
BEGIN
		


	 SELECT SM44_5 AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULE], 1 as ord  FROM SM44 
	 -- WHERE SM44.UNQID IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19) AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[SCHEDULE] ASC;
END


IF @TYPE = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN
	 SELECT * FROM (
	 SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH ,1 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 0 as ord  FROM SM1002 --WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH
	 )AS AA ORDER BY ord DESC
	  
END


IF @TYPE = 'BINDBRANCH'
BEGIN
		
	 SELECT * FROM (
	 SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH ,1 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 0 as ord  FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH
	 )AS AA ORDER BY ord 
	  
END

IF @TYPE='SCHEDULEWISETB'
BEGIN
--IF EXISTS(SELECT UNQID FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_5=@schedule) 
IF EXISTS(SELECT SM1002_5 from sm1002 where SM1002_5 = @BRANCH  )
BEGIN
SELECT  SUM(DAMOUNT)*-1 AS [DAMOUNT],SUM(CAMOUNT)AS [CAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID AS [SCHEDULECODE],
			'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+ @todate as [Type],
			SM44_7  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
			--INTO #TS 
			FROM 
			(		
			SELECT M3_4,CASE WHEN (M3_6)>0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [CAMOUNT],
			CASE WHEN (M3_6)<0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [DAMOUNT],
			M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH 
			--WHERE SM44.UNQID IN (SELECT UNQID FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_5=@schedule )
			GROUP BY SM44.UNQID,SM44_7
			ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME]

END
ELSE
BEGIN
            SELECT SUM(DAMOUNT)*-1 AS [DAMOUNT],SUM(CAMOUNT)AS [CAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],
			'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+ @todate as [Type],
			SM44_7  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
			--INTO #TS 
			FROM 
			(			
			SELECT M3_4,CASE WHEN (M3_6)>0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [CAMOUNT],
			CASE WHEN (M3_6)<0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [DAMOUNT],
			M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 
			--WHERE SM1002_5 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'-- WHERE SM44.UNQID IN( SELECT UNQID  FROM SM44 WHERE SM44.UNQID=@schedule )
			GROUP BY SM44.UNQID,SM44_7
			ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME]
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_TRIAL_BALANCE_QQ]

@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@radio      NVARCHAR(10) = '',
@schedule   NVARCHAR(100)= '',
@BRANCH      NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
AS


IF @TYPE = 'TRIAL_BALANCE'
BEGIN
	IF @SCHEDULE = 'ALL'
	BEGIN
		-----------------------------trial balance
		if @radio = 'S'
		Begin
			--SELECT MAX(M3_19) AS [M3_19],CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND M3_9='CR' THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND M3_9='DR' THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME],
			--SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			--SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			--(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@TODATE as [Type],
			--(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH
			-- INTO #T
			--FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID 
			----WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) 
			--WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			--AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			--GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_23,SM44_10,M3_9
			--HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			--SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T 
			--GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			--HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			----ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			--ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME

			--------------NEW QUERY FOR TB--------------
			SELECT SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(M3_6,0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)>0 THEN ISNULL(M3_6,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@todate as [Type],
			CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)>=0 THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)<=0 THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME], SM1002_7  as BRANCH
            INTO #T FROM 
			(SELECT M3_4 AS M3_4,SUM(M3_6) AS M3_6,M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 WHERE M3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			GROUP BY M3_4,M3_23) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME

			SELECT * FROM #T

		end
		else if @radio = 'O'
		Begin
			SELECT MIN(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],M3_1 AS [CODE] ,'OPENING TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@fromdate as [Type],
			(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH INTO #T1
			FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID
			--AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
			AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			 GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_1,M3_23
			HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T1 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= dbo.getformatteddate(@todate) AND [CODE] = 'AA' 
			GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
		End
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-----------------------------trial balance
		if @radio = 'S'
		Begin
			SELECT MAX(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT] ,'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@TODATE as [Type]  ,
			(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH INTO #T111
			FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44_5 INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE SM44_5 = @SCHEDULE 
			--AND DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			AND DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
			--AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
			AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_23
			HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T111
			GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			--ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME
			
		end
		else if @radio = 'O'
		Begin
			--SELECT MIN(M3_19) AS [M3_19],SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULENAME],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTNAME],SM19_5 AS [ACCOUNTCODE],SM44_8 AS [BK],
			--SUBSTRING(SM44_11,1,len(SM44_11)) As [TORDER],(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)<0.00 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			--(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)>0 THEN (ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],M3_1 AS [CODE] ,'OPENING TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@fromdate as [Type], 
			--(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=m3_23) as BRANCH
			-- INTO #T11
			--FROM SM44 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19_7 = SM44_5 INNER JOIN M3 ON M3_4 = SM19.UNQID WHERE SM44_5 = @SCHEDULE
	  -- --AND  M3_23= CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @BRANCH else m3_23 END
	  -- AND  (select top 1 data from dbo.split(m3_23,','))in (CASE WHEN @BRANCH<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN @branch else m3_23 END)
			--GROUP BY SM44_7,SM44_8,SM44.UNQID,SM44_11,SM19_5,SM19_5,M3_1,M3_23
			--HAVING ISNULL(SUM(M3_6),0.00) != 0.00 OR SM19_5 IS NOT NULL AND SM19_5 IS NOT NULL

			--SELECT [SCHEDULENAME],[SCHEDULECODE],[ACCOUNTNAME],[ACCOUNTCODE],[BK], [TORDER], SUM([DAMOUNT]) AS [DAMOUNT],SUM([CAMOUNT]) AS [CAMOUNT],[Type],BRANCH FROM #T11 
			--WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= dbo.getformatteddate(@todate) AND [CODE] = 'AA' 
			----AND M3_23='FEF8D467-6AB9-4B89-B121-C77D888A5740'
			--GROUP BY SCHEDULENAME,SCHEDULECODE,ACCOUNTNAME,ACCOUNTCODE,BK,TORDER ,[Type],BRANCH
			--HAVING SUM([DAMOUNT]) - SUM([CAMOUNT]) != 0.00
			--ORDER BY TORDER,ACCOUNTNAME
			SELECT SM19_5 AS ACCOUNTNAME,(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)<0 THEN (ISNULL(M3_6,0.00)*(-1)) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [DAMOUNT],
			(CASE WHEN ISNULL(M3_6,0)>0 THEN ISNULL(M3_6,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END) AS [CAMOUNT],'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+@todate as [Type],
			CASE WHEN SM44_8='C' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)>=0 THEN SM44_7 WHEN SM44_8='D' AND ISNULL(M3_6,0)<=0 THEN SM44_7 ELSE SM44_10 END  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
            INTO #T11 FROM 
			(SELECT M3_4 AS M3_4,SUM(M3_6) AS M3_6 FROM M3 WHERE M3_23 LIKE '%'+@BRANCH+'%'AND  DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			GROUP BY M3_4) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME],ACCOUNTNAME
		End
	END
END


IF @TYPE = 'BINDCATEGORY'
BEGIN
		
		  SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [SCHEDULE] ,0 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT SM44.UNQID AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULE], 1 as ord  FROM SM44 
	 WHERE SM44_5 IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19)) AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[SCHEDULE] ASC;

		--  SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'All' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS [SCHEDULE] ,0 as ord  
	 --UNION ALL 
	 --SELECT SM44.UNQID AS [UNQID], SM44_7 AS [SCHEDULE], 1 as ord  FROM SM44 
	 -- WHERE SM44.UNQID IN (SELECT SM19_7 FROM SM19)) AS AA ORDER BY ord ,[SCHEDULE] ASC;
END

IF @TYPE = 'BINDBRANCH'
BEGIN
		
	 SELECT * FROM (
	 SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH ,1 as ord  
	 UNION ALL 
	 SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID], SM1002_7 AS BRANCH, 0 as ord  FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH
	 )AS AA ORDER BY ord 
	  
END

IF @TYPE='SCHEDULEWISETB'
BEGIN
IF EXISTS(SELECT UNQID FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_5=@schedule) 
BEGIN
SELECT  SUM(DAMOUNT)*-1 AS [DAMOUNT],SUM(CAMOUNT)AS [CAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],
			'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+ @todate as [Type],
			 SM44_7  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
			--INTO #TS 
			FROM 
			(
			
			SELECT M3_4,CASE WHEN (M3_6)>0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [CAMOUNT],
			CASE WHEN (M3_6)<0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [DAMOUNT],
			M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 WHERE SM44.UNQID IN (SELECT UNQID FROM SM44 WHERE SM44_5=@schedule )
			GROUP BY SM44.UNQID,SM44_7
			 ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME]

END
ELSE
BEGIN
SELECT  SUM(DAMOUNT)*-1 AS [DAMOUNT],SUM(CAMOUNT)AS [CAMOUNT],SM44.UNQID  As [SCHEDULECODE],
			'TRIAL BALANCE AS ON '+ @todate as [Type],
			 SM44_7  AS [SCHEDULENAME]
			--INTO #TS 
			FROM 
			(
			
			SELECT M3_4,CASE WHEN (M3_6)>0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [CAMOUNT],
			CASE WHEN (M3_6)<0 THEN (M3_6) ELSE 0.00 END AS [DAMOUNT],
			M3_23 AS M3_23 FROM M3 
			WHERE DBO.ONLYDATE(M3_19) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@todate)
			) AS A INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=A.M3_4 INNER JOIN SM44 ON SM19_7 = SM44.UNQID  
			INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=A.M3_23 WHERE SM44.UNQID IN( SELECT UNQID  FROM SM44 WHERE SM44.UNQID=@schedule )
			GROUP BY SM44.UNQID,SM44_7
			 ORDER BY [SCHEDULENAME]

END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_UNIT_MASTER_Q]

@what          nvarchar(15)='', 
@sm209_1	   nvarchar(50)='',     ----entrydate
@sm209_2	   nvarchar(50)='',     ----modifydate
@sm209_3       nvarchar(50)='',	   ----usrid
@unqid		   nvarchar(50)='',     ----unqid
@sm209_5       nvarchar(50)='',	   ----DefineUnit
@sm209_6       nvarchar(50)='',	   ----Number of Decimal Places
@sm209_100     nvarchar(50)=''	   ----IP

AS
BEGIN
	if @what = 'insert'
BEGIN 
 SET  @unqid = NEWID()
INSERT INTO sm209 values(getutcdate(),getutcdate(),@sm209_3,@unqid,@sm209_5,@sm209_6,@sm209_100);
 end

 if @what = 'delete'
BEGIN 
  DELETE FROM sm209 WHERE unqid=@unqid
 end

 
 if @what = 'SelectById'
BEGIN

select unqid as unq
	   , sm209_5  as DefineUnit
	   ,sm209_6  as NDP
	  from sm209 where unqid=@unqid;
	   end


 if @what = 'Update'
BEGIN
Update sm209 set sm209_2=getutcdate(),
 sm209_5 =@sm209_5 
,sm209_6 =@sm209_6 
 where unqid=@unqid;
end

END





GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_UPLIFTMENT_RPT]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_UPLIFTMENT_RPT]

	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@AA				 AS NVARCHAR(50),
@BRANCH         AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@uid        AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@NumberOfYears INT = 3,
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) =''


AS
BEGIN

if @aa='MANU'
BEGIN

SELECT SM113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,UNQID AS [VALUE] FROM SM113 ORDER BY SM113_6
END

if @aa='period'
BEGIN

SELECT 'Yearly' AS Period, 1 AS ord 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Quarterly' AS Period, 2 AS ord 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Half yearly' AS Period, 3 AS ord
ORDER BY ord ASC;

END


IF @aa ='BRANCH'
BEGIN


    declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	--SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH, 1 as ord 
	--union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as [BRANCH]  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY  branch ASC;

	--SELECT SM1002_5 AS UNQID ,SM1002_7 AS BRANCH FROM SM1002
END

if @aa='YEAR'
BEGIN

WITH YearSequence AS (
    SELECT CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) AS [YEARS], 
           YEAR(GETDATE()) AS start_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CAST(start_year - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(start_year AS VARCHAR(4)), 
           start_year - 1
    FROM YearSequence
    WHERE start_year > 2019
)
SELECT  [YEARS] 
FROM YearSequence
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

end

if @aa='getall'
BEGIN


----------------table 0 branch
    --declare @branchid as nvarchar(max)
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)


	--SELECT  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [UNQID], 'All' AS BRANCH, 1 as ord 
	--union all 
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as [BRANCH]  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	
	ORDER BY  branch ASC;

----------------table 1 manu

SELECT 'All' AS MANUFACTURER,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS [VALUE], 0 as ord 
	union all 
SELECT SM113_6 AS MANUFACTURER,UNQID AS [VALUE], 1 as ord FROM SM113 ORDER BY ord asc
-------------table 1 
SELECT 'Yearly' AS [PERIOD], 1 AS ORD 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Quarterly' AS  [PERIOD], 2 AS ORD 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Half yearly' AS  [PERIOD], 3 AS ORD
ORDER BY ord ASC;

------------------------table 3


WITH YearSequence AS (
    SELECT CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) AS [YEARS], 
           YEAR(GETDATE()) AS start_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CAST(start_year - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(start_year AS VARCHAR(4)), 
           start_year - 1
    FROM YearSequence
    WHERE start_year > 2019
)
SELECT  [YEARS] 
FROM YearSequence
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);


END



if @aa='DATA'
BEGIN
DECLARE @StartDate DATE = CAST(CAST(@Year AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-04-01' AS DATE);

DECLARE @EndDate DATE = EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()));

DECLARE @NumOfMonths INT = DATEDIFF(MONTH, @StartDate, @EndDate)+1;


PRINT @StartDate
PRINT @EndDate
PRINT @NumOfMonths

SELECT 
    sm206.sm206_2 AS Unq,
    sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 4 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Apr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 5 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS May,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 6 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jun,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 7 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jul,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 8 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Aug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 9 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Sep,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 10 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Oct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 11 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Nov,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 12 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Dec,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 1 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jan,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 2 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Feb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 3 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Mar,
     SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) AS Total,
    -- Calculate the dynamic average for sales per month
	ROUND(SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) / NULLIF(@NumOfMonths, 0), 3) AS Avg

FROM 
    sm1005
INNER JOIN 
    sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
INNER JOIN 
    sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
LEFT JOIN 
    sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_32
WHERE 
    sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select DATA from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
   and  (@MANUFACTURER  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER )
	
    AND (
        (MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) >= 4 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year) OR 
        (MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) <= 3 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1)
    )
GROUP BY 
    sm206.sm206_7,  sm206.sm206_2
ORDER BY 
    Product;


END

IF @aa = 'CHILDDATA'
BEGIN
    WITH Years AS (
        -- Defining the previous years for sales (3 years back)
        SELECT @Year - 1 AS SalesYear
        UNION ALL
        SELECT @Year - 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT @Year - 3
    ),
    ProductInfo AS (
        -- Getting the product information for the provided product unique ID
        SELECT
            sm206_2 AS UNQID,
            sm206_7 AS Product
        FROM sm206
        WHERE sm206_2 = @PRODUNQ
    ),
    AllCombinations AS (
        -- Getting all combinations of product and sales years (cross join to get all year/product combinations)
        SELECT
            PI.UNQID,
            PI.Product,
            Y.SalesYear
        FROM ProductInfo PI
        CROSS JOIN Years Y
    ),
    YearlyData AS (
        -- Getting the actual sales data for each month in the given range (April to March)
        SELECT
            sm206.sm206_2 AS UNQID,
            sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
            YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) AS SalesYear,
            MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) AS SalesMonth,
            SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) AS MonthlySales
        FROM
            sm1005
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
        WHERE
             (@MANUFACTURER  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER )
	
            AND
			 sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select DATA from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
            AND sm206.sm206_2 = @PRODUNQ -- Filter by the specific product
           -- AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) BETWEEN @Year - 3 AND @Year - 1
        GROUP BY
            sm206.sm206_7,
            sm206.sm206_2,
            YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13),
            MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13)
    )
    SELECT
        AC.UNQID,
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear AS [CYEAR],
        -- Summing up monthly sales for each month (April to March)
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 4 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CApr,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 5 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CMay,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 6 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJun,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 7 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJul,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 8 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CAug,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 9 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CSep,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 10 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS COct,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 11 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CNov,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 12 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CDec,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 1 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJan,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 2 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CFeb,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 3 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CMar,
        -- Calculating the total sales for the year
        COALESCE(SUM(YD.MonthlySales), 0) AS CTotal,
        -- Calculating the average sales per month (12 months)
        COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(YD.MonthlySales) / 12.0, 3), 0) AS CAvg
    FROM
        AllCombinations AC
    LEFT JOIN YearlyData YD ON AC.UNQID = YD.UNQID 
        AND AC.SalesYear = YD.SalesYear
    GROUP BY
        AC.UNQID,
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear
    ORDER BY
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear DESC;
END


IF @aa = 'QDATA'
BEGIN
    --DECLARE @StartDate DATE = CAST(CAST(@Year AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-04-01' AS DATE);
    --DECLARE @EndDate DATE = EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()));
   set  @NumOfMonths  = DATEDIFF(MONTH, @StartDate, @EndDate) + 1;

    PRINT @StartDate
    PRINT @EndDate
    PRINT @NumOfMonths

    SELECT 
        sm206.sm206_2 AS Unq,
        sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 4 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Apr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 5 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS May,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 6 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jun,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (4,5,6) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(3, 0), 3) AS Q1_Avg,

    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 7 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jul,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 8 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Aug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 9 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Sep,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (7,8,9) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(3, 0), 3) AS Q2_Avg,

    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 10 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Oct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 11 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Nov,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 12 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Dec,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (10,11,12) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(3, 0), 3) AS Q3_Avg,

    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 1 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Jan,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 2 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Feb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) = 3 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Mar,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (1,2,3) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(3, 0), 3) AS Q4_Avg,

     SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) AS Total,
    -- Calculate the dynamic average for sales per month
	
        ---- Quarterly Columns: Sum of Sales per Quarter
        --SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (4,5,6) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Q1_Sales,
        --SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (7,8,9) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Q2_Sales,
        --SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (10,11,12) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Q3_Sales,
        --SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) IN (1,2,3) AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1 THEN sm1005.SM1005_57 ELSE 0 END) AS Q4_Sales,
        
        ROUND(SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) / NULLIF(@NumOfMonths, 0), 3) AS Year_Avg

    FROM 
        sm1005
    INNER JOIN 
        sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN 
        sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
    LEFT JOIN 
        sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_32
    WHERE 
        sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select DATA from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
        AND  (@MANUFACTURER  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER)
        AND (
            (MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) >= 4 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year) OR 
            (MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) <= 3 AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) = @Year + 1)
        )
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_7,  sm206.sm206_2
    ORDER BY 
        Product;
END


IF @aa = 'CHILDDATAQ'
BEGIN
    WITH Years AS (
        -- Defining the previous years for sales (3 years back)
        SELECT @Year - 1 AS SalesYear
        UNION ALL
        SELECT @Year - 2
        UNION ALL
        SELECT @Year - 3
    ),
    ProductInfo AS (
        -- Getting the product information for the provided product unique ID
        SELECT
            sm206_2 AS UNQID,
            sm206_7 AS Product
        FROM sm206
        WHERE sm206_2 = @PRODUNQ
    ),
    AllCombinations AS (
        -- Getting all combinations of product and sales years (cross join to get all year/product combinations)
        SELECT
            PI.UNQID,
            PI.Product,
            Y.SalesYear
        FROM ProductInfo PI
        CROSS JOIN Years Y
    ),
    YearlyData AS (
        -- Getting the actual sales data for each month in the given range (April to March)
        SELECT
            sm206.sm206_2 AS UNQID,
            sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
            YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) AS SalesYear,
            MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13) AS SalesMonth,
            SUM(sm1005.SM1005_57) AS MonthlySales
        FROM
            sm1005
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
        WHERE
             (@MANUFACTURER  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  OR sm1005.sm1005_9 = @MANUFACTURER )
	
            AND
			 sm1005.sm1005_7 in (select DATA from dbo.split(@BRANCH,','))
            AND sm206.sm206_2 = @PRODUNQ -- Filter by the specific product
            AND YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13) BETWEEN @Year - 3 AND @Year - 1
        GROUP BY
            sm206.sm206_7,
            sm206.sm206_2,
            YEAR(sm1005.SM1005_13),
            MONTH(sm1005.SM1005_13)
    )
    SELECT
        AC.UNQID,
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear AS [CYEAR],
        -- Summing up monthly sales for each month (April to March)
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 4 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CApr,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 5 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CMay,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 6 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJun,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 7 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJul,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 8 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CAug,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 9 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CSep,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 10 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS COct,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 11 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CNov,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 12 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CDec,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 1 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CJan,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 2 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CFeb,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YD.SalesMonth = 3 THEN YD.MonthlySales END), 0) AS CMar,
        -- Calculating the total sales for the year
        COALESCE(SUM(YD.MonthlySales), 0) AS CTotal,
        -- Calculating the average sales per month (12 months)
        COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(YD.MonthlySales) / 12.0, 3), 0) AS CAvg
    FROM
        AllCombinations AC
    LEFT JOIN YearlyData YD ON AC.UNQID = YD.UNQID 
        AND AC.SalesYear = YD.SalesYear
    GROUP BY
        AC.UNQID,
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear
    ORDER BY
        AC.Product,
        AC.SalesYear DESC;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_UR_REPORT_Q]
@TYPE		NVARCHAR(20) = '',	
@unqid		NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(30) = '',
@todate     NVARCHAR(30) = ''
AS

----------------------------------------for registered parties
IF @TYPE = 'REGISTERED'
BEGIN
--SELECT * FROM (
SELECT SM213_31 AS [GSTIN],(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) AS [PARTY],
(SELECT A.SM213_8+'/'+ A.SM213_9 FROM SM213 AS A WHERE A.UNQID = B.SM213_29) AS [INVOICE NO],(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(A.SM213_6) FROM SM213 
AS A WHERE A.UNQID = B.SM213_29) AS [INVOICE DATE],SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 AS [SLIP NO],DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) AS [DATE],'R' AS [DOCUMENT TYPE],
(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [STATE],SM213_23 AS [VOUCHER VALUE],
(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_C15 FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = B.UNQID)) AS [TAX RATE],SM213_17 AS [TAXABLE VALUE],0.00 AS [CESS],'' AS [PREGST] 
FROM SM213 AS B WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
AND SM213_29 IS NOT NULL AND SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) != ''

--UNION ALL

SELECT 'NO. OF RECIPIENTS' AS [GSTIN],COUNT(SM213_10) AS [PARTY],'NO. OF INVOICES' AS [INVOICE NO],COUNT(SM213_10)AS [INVOICE DATE],
'NO. OF NOTES/VOUCHER' AS [SLIP NO],COUNT(SM213_10) AS [DATE], '' AS [DOCUMENT TYPE],'TOTAL NOTE/VOUCHER REFUND VALUE' AS [STATE],
SUM(SM213_23) AS [VOUCHER VALUE],'TOTAL TAXABLE VALUE' AS [TAX RATE],SUM(SM213_17) AS [TAXABLE VALUE],'' AS [CESS],'' AS [PREGST] 
FROM SM213 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE)
AND SM213_29 IS NOT NULL AND SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
--AND (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) != ''

--) AS AA --ORDER BY PARTY

END
----------------------------------------for unregistered parties
ELSE IF @TYPE = 'UNREGISTERED'
BEGIN

SELECT 
'UR' AS [GSTIN],
(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) AS [PARTY],
(SELECT C.SM213_8+'/'+ C.SM213_9 FROM SM213 AS C WHERE C.UNQID = D.SM213_29) AS [INVOICE NO],
(SELECT DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(C.SM213_6) FROM SM213 AS C WHERE C.UNQID = D.SM213_29) AS [INVOICE DATE],
SM213_8 + '/' + SM213_9 AS [SLIP NO],
DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) AS [DATE],
'R' AS [DOCUMENT TYPE],
(SELECT SM205_5 FROM SM205 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10)) AS [STATE],
SM213_23 AS [VOUCHER VALUE],
(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT TOP 1 SM213_C15 FROM SM213_C WHERE SM213_C4 = D.UNQID)) AS [TAXRATE],
SM213_17 AS [TAXABLE VALUE],0.00 AS [CESS],
'' AS [PREGST] 
FROM SM213 AS D WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM213_29 IS NOT NULL AND 
SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
--AND (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) = ''

--UNION ALL

SELECT 
'NO. OF NOTES/VOUCHER' AS [GSTIN],
COUNT(SM213_10) AS [PARTY],
'NO. OF INVOICES' AS [INVOICE NO],
COUNT(SM213_10) AS [INVOICE DATE],
'NO. OF NOTES/VOUCHER' AS [SLIP NO],
COUNT(SM213_10) AS [DATE],
'' AS [DOCUMENT TYPE],
'TOTAL NOTES VALUE' AS [STATE],
SUM(SM213_23) AS [VOUCHER VALUE],
'TOTAL TAXABLE VALUE' AS [TAXRATE],
SUM(SM213_17) AS [TAXABLE VALUE],
'' AS [CESS],
'' AS [PREGST]
FROM SM213 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(SM213_6) 
BETWEEN DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@FROMDATE) AND DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@TODATE) AND SM213_29 IS NOT NULL AND 
SM213_29 != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND (SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID = SM213_10) = ''
END





GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- ALTER date: <ALTER Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_FOR_USER_CREATION_Q]
@what	    nvarchar(30) ='',
@USERID		NVARCHAR(3)  ='',
@SYSTEMNAME NVARCHAR(100)='',
@UNQID		NVARCHAR(36) ='',--SM63 UNQID
@SM63_5		NVARCHAR(3)  ='',--USER ID
@SM63_6		NVARCHAR(50) ='',--USERNAME
@SM63_7		NVARCHAR(100)='',--PASSWORD
@sm63_8		nvarchar(36) ='',--GROUP UNQID
@sm63_9		nvarchar(50) ='',--NOT IN USE
@sm63_10	nvarchar(50) ='', --EMAIL ID
@sm63_12	nvarchar(max) ='', --Branch ID
@sm63_13	nvarchar(50) ='', --STAFF ID
@OLDPASSWORD nvarchar(50) ='' 
AS
BEGIN
	IF @WHAT = 'USERVIEW'	
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM63_6 AS [USER] FROM SM63 ORDER BY SM63_6
	END

		IF @WHAT = 'STAFF'	
	BEGIN
	   SELECT UNQID , SM502_4 AS STAFF FROM SM502 WHERE SM502_4	IS NOT NULL ;
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'USERADD'
	BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM61_6 AS [GROUP] FROM SM61 ORDER BY SM61_6
	END
		ELSE IF @WHAT = 'BRANCH'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM1002_5 AS [UNQID],SM1002_7 AS [BRANCH] FROM SM1002 --where SM1002_5 like '%'+ @sm63_12 +'%'
		ORDER BY SM1002_7
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'USEREDIT'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM63_5 AS [USERID],SM63_6 AS [USERNAME],SM63_7 AS [PASSWORD],SM63_7 AS [CPASSWORD],SM63_8 AS [GROUPUNQID] ,SM63_12 AS [BRANCH],
		(SELECT SM61_6 FROM SM61 WHERE SM61.UNQID = SM63_8) AS [GROUPNAME],SM63_10 AS [EMAILID], SM63_13 AS [STAFF] FROM SM63 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'USERINSERT'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO SM63 VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),'',@USERID,NEWID(),@SM63_5,@SYSTEMNAME,@SM63_6,@SM63_7,@SM63_8,@SM63_9,@SM63_10,'FALSE' ,@SM63_12,@SM63_13)
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'USERUPDATE'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM63 SET SM63_2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM63_100 = @SYSTEMNAME,SM63_5 = @SM63_5,SM63_6 = @SM63_6,SM63_7 = @SM63_7,SM63_8 = @SM63_8,
		SM63_10 = @SM63_10, SM63_12 = @SM63_12,SM63_13 =@SM63_13 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'USERDELETE'
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM63 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
	END

	ELSE IF @WHAT = 'CHANGEPSWD'
	BEGIN
		--UPDATE SM63 SET SM63_2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM63_100 = @SYSTEMNAME,SM63_7 = @SM63_7 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM63 WHERE SM63_5= @SM63_5 AND SM63_7 = @OLDPASSWORD COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS)>0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE SM63 SET SM63_7=@SM63_7 WHERE SM63_5= @SM63_5 AND SM63_7 = @OLDPASSWORD COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS
			SELECT '1'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT '0'
		END
	END

	IF @what='User_details'
	begin 
	    SELECT sm63.sm63_5 AS [USER_ID], sm63.sm63_6 AS [USER_NAME],(SELECT SM61_6 FROM SM61 where unqid = sm63.sm63_8) AS [GROUP_NAME],
        STUFF((SELECT ',' + SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(sm63.sm63_12, ','))FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS [BRANCH],
        STUFF((SELECT ',' + SM44_7 FROM SM44 WHERE unqid IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split((SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 WHERE UNQID = sm63.sm63_13), ',')) FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS [CUSTTYPE],
		STUFF((SELECT ',' + upper(SM1006_5) FROM SM1006 WHERE SM1006_13 IN  (SELECT data FROM dbo.split((sm63.sm63_12), ',')) FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS [Warehouse]
        FROM sm60 INNER JOIN sm63 ON sm60_7 = sm63.sm63_8 WHERE sm60_6 LIKE '%' + @UNQID + '%' AND sm60_31 = 'true';
	end
END

GO

@what 			NVARCHAR(50)='',

		UPDATE SM1009 SET SM1009_5=DBO.ENTRYDATE(),SM1009_6 =@SM1009_6 ,SM1009_7=@SM1009_7

		select * from sm1009

--IF @what = 'SelectById'

	SELECT * FROM SM1009 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
END

		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=SM1009.SM1009_6) AS TRANSPORTERNAME FROM SM1009
		--ORDER BY SM206_7
END

BEGIN
		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=SM1009.SM1009_6) AS TRANSPORTERNAME FROM SM1009
		WHERE (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=SM1009.SM1009_6) LIKE '%' +@UNQID+ '%' --ORDER BY SM206_7
END

IF @WHAT = 'DELETE'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM1009 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID;
END
IF @what = 'view'
BEGIN
	
		
				--TABLE 0
	DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT
	 
	SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
	SET @RowspPage = 10
	

		SELECT UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM1009_6) AS TRANSPORTERNAME FROM SM1009
		ORDER BY UNQID
	
	OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
	FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;
			
			--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS TRANSPORTERNAME
END
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @what ='SearchByAlphabet'
BEGIN 

	
		--TABLE 0
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10

	
	    SELECT UNQID AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM1009_6) AS TRANSPORTERNAME FROM SM1009
		WHERE (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM1009_6) LIKE '%' +@UNQID+ '%'
		ORDER BY UNQID 

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;	

		--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS PRODUCTCODE,'' AS TRANSPORTERNAME--,'' AS PRODUCTDESC
end

IF @what = 'PageCount'
begin
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM1009),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
end

IF @what = 'PageCountLIKE'
begin

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM1009 WHERE (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=SM1009.SM1009_6) like '%' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
				   SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
end
