CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_SP_SW_ewaybill]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@what nvarchar(50)='',
	@UNQID NVARCHAR(50)=''
	
	
AS
if(@what ='aa')
BEGIN
--E-Way bill & Address details
select sm213_40 as ebillno, FORMAT(
        CONVERT(datetime, sm213_39, 103),
        'dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm tt'
    ) as ebilldate, (select pa_17 from pa) as generatedby, FORMAT(
        CONVERT(datetime, sm213_41, 103),
        'dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm tt'
    ) as ebillvaliddate, 'Road' as Mode, 'Outward - Supply' as [Type],
'Tax Invoice - '+sm213_8+sm213_9+' - '+FORMAT(SM213_6 ,'dd/MM/yyyy') as docdetails, 'Bill From - Dispatch From' as transtype, '1' as portal,
 (select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_59) as FGSTIN, (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_59) as FName, (select sm19_24 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_59) as FState,
 (select sm19_13 + ' ' + sm19_14 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_59) as FAddress,(select sm19_23 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_60) as TGSTIN, 
 (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_60) as TName, (select sm19_24 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_60) as TState, 
 (select sm19_13 + ' ' + sm19_14 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_60) as TAddress from sm213 where unqid = @unqid

--Address Details
--Dispatch From
--select sm19_23 as FGSTIN, sm19_5 as FName, sm19_24 as FState, sm19_13 + ' ' + sm19_14 as FAddress from sm213 inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid = sm213_59 where sm213.unqid = @unqid
----ship to
--select sm19_23 as TGSTIN, sm19_5 as TName, sm19_24 as TState, sm19_13 + ' ' + sm19_14 as TAddress from sm213 inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid = sm213_60 where sm213.unqid = @unqid

--Product Details
select sm213_c6 as HSNCODE, (select sm206_28 from sm206 where sm206_2 = sm213_c5) as PRODUCTNAME, CONCAT(SM213_C9, sm213_c8) AS QTY, SM213_C14 AS TAXABLEAMT, 
CONCAT(SM213_C16, ' + ',SM213_C17, ' + ',SM213_C18, ' + ',SM213_C22) AS TAXRATE from sm213_c where sm213_c4 = @unqid

-- Total Amount
select sum(sm213_c14) as TOTTAXABLE, sum(sm213_c16) as TOTCGST, sum(sm213_c17) as TOTSGST, sum(sm213_c18) as TOTIGST, sum(sm213_c22) as TOTCESS, sm213_22 as OTHERAMT,
 sm213_23 as TOTINVAMT from sm213_c inner join sm213 on sm213.unqid = sm213_c4 where sm213_c4 = @unqid
group by sm213_22, sm213_23

--Transportation or vehicle details

select (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_65) as transname, concat(sm213_67,' & ',format(sm213_68, 'dd/MM/yyyy')) as TransDocnoDate, 'Road' as Mode, sm213_66 as VehicleNO, 
(select sm19_24 from sm19 where unqid = sm213_59) as FLOCATION, format(sm213_6, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as ENTERDATE, (select pa_17 from pa) as ENTERBY, '-' as CEWBNO, '-' as MULTIVINFO, 
'1' as PORTAL from sm213 where unqid = @unqid
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[cont]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cont]
    @aa NVARCHAR(50),

    @fromdate NVARCHAR(50),
    @todate NVARCHAR(50),
    @branchid NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
   


   if @aa = 'ALL_DD'
   BEGIN

    DECLARE @StartDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate, 103);
    DECLARE @EndDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @todate, 103);

    -- Create temporary tables for initial data and for updates
   -- DROP TABLE #t;
    --DROP TABLE  #t1;

    DECLARE @SQL_CreateT NVARCHAR(MAX);
    SET @SQL_CreateT = '
    SELECT *, CAST(0.00 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS cost
    INTO #t
    FROM sm1011
    WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND sm1011_41 = @branchid;';

    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL_CreateT,
        N'@StartDate DATE, @EndDate DATE, @branchid NVARCHAR(50)',
        @StartDate = @StartDate,
        @EndDate = @EndDate,
        @branchid = @branchid;

    SELECT * INTO #t1 FROM #t;

    DECLARE @PRODUCTUNQ NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @unqid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    DECLARE @salesqty NUMERIC(18,3);
    DECLARE @BRANCH NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @PRODUCT NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @recieptDATE DATE;
    DECLARE @RECEIPTQTY NUMERIC(15,3);
    DECLARE @COST NUMERIC(18,2);
    DECLARE @tqty NUMERIC(18,3);

    -- Cursor for products
    DECLARE PRODUCT_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT SM206_2 FROM SM206;

    OPEN PRODUCT_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO @PRODUCTUNQ;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

        -- Dynamic SQL for sales_cursor declaration and opening
        DECLARE @SQL_SalesCursorDeclareOpen NVARCHAR(MAX);
        SET @SQL_SalesCursorDeclareOpen = '
        DECLARE sales_cursor_inner CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT
            #t.unqid,
            CAST(sm1011_42 / 1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS salesqty
        FROM #t
        LEFT JOIN sm1008 ON sm1011_8 = sm1008.unqid
        LEFT JOIN sm1005 ON sm1005_4 = sm1008.sm1008_30
        WHERE sm1011_6 BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
          AND sm1011_41 = @branchid
          AND sm1008_30 = ''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000''
          AND sm1011_13 = @PRODUCTUNQ
        ORDER BY sm1011_6, CAST(sm1011_7 AS NUMERIC(18,0));

        OPEN sales_cursor_inner;';

        EXEC sp_executesql @SQL_SalesCursorDeclareOpen,
            N'@StartDate DATE, @EndDate DATE, @branchid NVARCHAR(50), @PRODUCTUNQ NVARCHAR(100)',
            @StartDate = @StartDate,
            @EndDate = @EndDate,
            @branchid = @branchid,
            @PRODUCTUNQ = @PRODUCTUNQ;

        -- Fetch the first sales record for the current product
        FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor_inner INTO @unqid, @salesqty;

        -- Dynamic SQL for stock_cursor declaration and opening
        DECLARE @SQL_StockCursorDeclareOpen NVARCHAR(MAX);
        SET @SQL_StockCursorDeclareOpen = '
        DECLARE stock_cursor_inner CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT
            SM1005_7 AS BRANCH,
            SM1005_10 AS PRODUCT,
            SM1005_6 AS [recieptDATE],
            sm1005_57 AS RECEIPTQTY,
            (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28) AS COST
        FROM sm1005
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
        LEFT JOIN sm1008 ON sm1005.sm1005_4 = sm1008.sm1008_30
        WHERE SM1005_6 BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
          AND sm1005_7 = @branchid
          AND sm1008_30 IS NULL
          AND SM1005_10 = @PRODUCTUNQ

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            sm1014_7 AS branch,
            sm1014.sm1014_10 AS Product,
            SM1014_6 AS [date],
            CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SM1014_17 = ''GS'' THEN SM1014_14 * -1 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'''' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END)
                      WHEN SM1014_17 = ''GE'' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'''' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) END) AS NUMERIC(15, 3)) / 1000 AS RECEIPTQTY,
            0 AS COST
        FROM sm1014
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1014.sm1014_10
        INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1014.sm1014_11
        WHERE SM1014_6 = ''2025-03-31'' -- Hardcoded, consider dynamic if needed
          AND sm1014_7 = @branchid
          AND sm1014_10 = @PRODUCTUNQ
        GROUP BY sm1014_10, sm1014_11, SM1014_6, sm1014_7
        ORDER BY Product, [recieptDATE];

        OPEN stock_cursor_inner;';

        EXEC sp_executesql @SQL_StockCursorDeclareOpen,
            N'@StartDate DATE, @EndDate DATE, @branchid NVARCHAR(50), @PRODUCTUNQ NVARCHAR(100)',
            @StartDate = @StartDate,
            @EndDate = @EndDate,
            @branchid = @branchid,
            @PRODUCTUNQ = @PRODUCTUNQ;

        -- Fetch the first stock record for the current product
        FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor_inner INTO @BRANCH, @PRODUCT, @recieptDATE, @RECEIPTQTY, @COST;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 -- Loop through stock receipts
        BEGIN
            SET @tqty = @RECEIPTQTY;

            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @tqty >= 0 -- Loop through sales for current stock
            BEGIN
                SET @tqty = @tqty - @salesqty;

                -- Update the cost in #t1 for the current sales record
                UPDATE #t1 SET cost = @COST WHERE unqid = @unqid;

                IF @tqty <= 0
                BEGIN
                    -- Move to the next stock receipt if current one is exhausted
                    FETCH NEXT FROM stock_cursor_inner INTO @BRANCH, @PRODUCT, @recieptDATE, @RECEIPTQTY, @COST;
                    SET @tqty = @RECEIPTQTY; -- Reset tqty for the new stock receipt
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    -- Fetch next sales record if current stock is not exhausted
                    FETCH NEXT FROM sales_cursor_inner INTO @unqid, @salesqty;
                END;
            END;

            -- If sales_cursor is exhausted but stock_cursor still has records, break the inner loop
            IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 BREAK;
        END;

        CLOSE sales_cursor_inner;
        DEALLOCATE sales_cursor_inner;

        CLOSE stock_cursor_inner;
        DEALLOCATE stock_cursor_inner;

        FETCH NEXT FROM PRODUCT_cursor INTO @PRODUCTUNQ;
    END;

    CLOSE PRODUCT_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE PRODUCT_cursor;

    ---
  --  ### Final Calculation and Result Set

   -- This section performs the aggregations and calculations you outlined, using the `cost` values updated in `#t1`.

    ---

    SELECT
        PRODUCT,
        INVDATE,
        SUM(SELLQTY) AS QTY,
        AVG(sellINGrate) AS AVG_SELL_RATE,
        CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS COST,
        SUM(SALEAMT) AS [SELL VALUE],
        CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)) AS [SELL PR],
        (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2))
         - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2))) AS contpr,
        (CAST(SUM(SALEAMT) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2))
         - CAST(SUM(COST * SELLQTY) / NULLIF(SUM(SELLQTY), 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 2)))
         * SUM(SELLQTY) AS CONTRIBUTION
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            sm19_5 AS custname,
            sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
            sm1011_6 AS INVdate,
            sm1011_7 AS INVNO,
            CAST(sm1011_42 / 1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
            sm1011_19 * 1000 AS sellINGrate,
            (cost) AS cost, -- This 'cost' comes from #t1, which was updated by the cursor logic
            sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
        FROM #t1 -- Use #t1 here to get the updated cost
        LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = #t1.sm1011_13
        LEFT JOIN sm1008 ON sm1011_8 = sm1008.unqid
        LEFT JOIN sm1005 ON sm1005_4 = sm1008.sm1008_30
        WHERE sm1011_41 = @branchid
          AND sm1008_30 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            sm19_5 AS custname,
            sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
            sm1011_6 AS INVdate,
            sm1011_7 AS INVNO,
            CAST(sm1011_42 / 1000 AS NUMERIC(18,3)) AS SELLQTY,
            sm1011_19 * 1000 AS sellINGrate,
            (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 - SM1005_26 + SM1005_28) AS cost, -- This cost is direct from sm1005 for specific cases
            sm1011_24 AS SALEAMT
        FROM sm1011
        LEFT JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1011_10
        INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011_13
        LEFT JOIN sm1008 ON sm1011_8 = sm1008.unqid
        LEFT JOIN sm1005 ON sm1005_4 = sm1008.sm1008_30
        WHERE sm1011_41 = @branchid
          AND sm1008_30 <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    ) AS AA
    GROUP BY INVDATE, PRODUCT
    ORDER BY INVDATE, PRODUCT;

    DROP TABLE  #t;
    DROP TABLE #t1;
end
END;
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CREDIT_WORTHINESS_MASTER]

@WHAT				NVARCHAR(50)='', 
--@UNQID				NVARCHAR(50)='',    --sm19 unqid
@SM1019_1			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--ENTRY DATE
@SM1019_2			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--MODIFY DATE
@SM1019_3			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--USER
@unqid				NVARCHAR(50)='',		--UNQID
@SM1019_100			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--SERVER IP	
@SM1019_4			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--GROUP HEAD
@SM1019_5			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--GROUP CREDIT LIMIT
@SM1019_6			NVARCHAR(50)='',		--CUSTOMER

--------- CHILD TABLE -------------

@SM1019_C5				NVARCHAR(50)=''	,	--CUSTOMER
@SM1019_C6 				NVARCHAR(50)=''		--CREDIT LIMIT
AS

IF @WHAT='GROUP_BIND'
BEGIN
SELECT UNQID, SM19_5 AS GROUPHEAD FROM SM19 ORDER BY SM19_5
END

--IF @WHAT='EMPTY_GRID'
--BEGIN

END

--IF @WHAT='CUST_BIND'
--BEGIN
--SELECT UNQID, SM19_5 AS CUSTOMER FROM SM19 WHERE sm19_11='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5
--END

IF @WHAT='INSERT'
BEGIN
SELECT @unqid = NEWID();
INSERT INTO SM1019 (SM1019_1, SM1019_2, SM1019_3, unqid, SM1019_100, SM1019_4, SM1019_5, SM1019_6, SM1019_7) 
VALUES(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1019_3, @unqid, @SM1019_100, @SM1019_4, @SM1019_5, @SM1019_6, @SM1019_7)

SELECT @unqid AS punqid
END

IF @WHAT='INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN
IF @SM1019_C5 !=''
BEGIN
SET @SM1019_C5=(SELECT UNQID FROM sm19 WHERE sm19_5=@SM1019_C5)
END

INSERT INTO SM1019_C(SM1019_C1, SM1019_C2, SM1019_C3, unqid, SM1019_C100, SM1019_C4, SM1019_C5, SM1019_C6) 
VALUES(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1019_C3, NEWID(), @SM1019_C100, @SM1019_C4, @SM1019_C5, @SM1019_C6)

UPDATE sm19 SET SM19_57= @SM1019_C6 WHERE UNQID=@SM1019_C5
END

IF @WHAT='VIEW_GRID'
BEGIN
SELECT SM1019.UNQID AS UNQID, sm19_5 AS [GROUP], SM1019_5 AS CREDIT, SM19_5 AS CUSTOMER, SM1019_C6 AS CUSTCREDIT FROM SM1019
INNER JOIN SM1019_C ON SM1019.unqid=SM1019_c.SM1019_C4  
INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=SM1019_C.SM1019_C5
--SELECT SM1019.unqid AS UNQID,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid=SM1019_C5)AS [GROUP],(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid=SM1019_4)AS CUSTOMER,

--INNER JOIN SM1019_C ON SM1019.unqid=SM1019_c.SM1019_C4 
END

IF @WHAT='SEARCH_GRID'
BEGIN
SELECT SM1019.UNQID AS UNQID, sm19_5 AS [GROUP], SM1019_5 AS CREDIT, SM19_5 AS CUSTOMER, SM1019_C6 AS CUSTCREDIT FROM SM1019
INNER JOIN SM1019_C ON SM1019.unqid=SM1019_c.SM1019_C4  
INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=SM1019_C.SM1019_C5 WHERE sm19_5 LIKE '%'+ @SM1019_4 + '%' 
END

IF @WHAT='EDIT_BIND'
BEGIN
SELECT SM1019.UNQID AS UNQID, SM1019_4 AS [GROUP], SM1019_5 AS CREDIT,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid=SM1019_C5) AS CUSTOMER, SM1019_C6 AS CUSTCREDIT FROM SM1019
INNER JOIN SM1019_C ON SM1019.unqid=SM1019_c.SM1019_C4  
--INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=SM1019_C.SM1019_C5
WHERE SM1019.unqid=@unqid
--SELECT SM1019.UNQID AS UNQID, SM1019_4 AS [GROUP], SM1019_5 AS CREDIT, SM19_5 AS CUSTOMER, SM1019_C6 AS CUSTCREDIT FROM SM1019
--INNER JOIN SM1019_C ON SM1019.unqid=SM1019_c.SM1019_C4  
--INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid=SM1019_C.SM1019_C5 WHERE SM1019.unqid=@unqid
END

IF @WHAT='DELETE'
BEGIN
DELETE FROM SM1019 WHERE unqid=@unqid
DELETE FROM SM1019_C WHERE SM1019_C4=@unqid
END

IF @WHAT='UPDATE'
BEGIN
UPDATE SM1019 SET SM1019_4 = @SM1019_4, SM1019_5=@SM1019_5 WHERE unqid=@unqid
SELECT @unqid AS punqid
END

IF @WHAT='CHILD_UPDATE'
BEGIN
IF @SM1019_C5 !=''
BEGIN
SET @SM1019_C5=(SELECT UNQID FROM sm19 WHERE sm19_5=@SM1019_C5)
END
---UPDATE SM1019_C SET SM1019_C5=@SM1019_C5, SM1019_C6=@SM1019_C6 WHERE unqid=@unqid_c AND SM1019_C4=@SM1019_C4
INSERT INTO SM1019_C(SM1019_C1, SM1019_C2, SM1019_C3, unqid, SM1019_C100, SM1019_C4, SM1019_C5, SM1019_C6) 
VALUES(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1019_C3,NEWID(),@SM1019_C100, @SM1019_C4, @SM1019_C5, @SM1019_C6)
END

IF @WHAT='DELETE_CHILD'--AT UPDATE
BEGIN
DELETE FROM SM1019_C WHERE SM1019_C4=@unqid_c
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[EXCEL_ITC_REGISTER]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[EXCEL_ITC_REGISTER]
@AA                  NVARCHAR(20)  = '',   
@unqid               NVARCHAR(36)  = '',
@year           NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@month              NVARCHAR(30)  = '',
@SELECTEDPARTIES     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@PRODUCT   NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@BRANCH     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@uid        nvarchar(50) =''

	
AS

begin 
	
	IF @AA = 'BRANCH'
BEGIN

	    set @branch=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH, 1 as ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branch,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7
	--bhanunew

END
if @aa='YEAR'
BEGIN

    WITH YearSequence AS (
        SELECT 
            CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) AS [YEARS],
            YEAR(GETDATE()) AS start_year
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            CAST(start_year - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(start_year AS VARCHAR(4)),
            start_year - 1
        FROM YearSequence
        WHERE start_year > 2019
    )
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_year DESC) AS UNQID,
        [YEARS]
    FROM YearSequence
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);
end





IF @aa = 'month'
BEGIN
    SELECT 1  AS UNQID, 'January'   AS MonthName UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'February' UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'March'    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'April'    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'May'      UNION ALL
    SELECT 6, 'June'     UNION ALL
    SELECT 7, 'July'     UNION ALL
    SELECT 8, 'August'   UNION ALL
    SELECT 9, 'September' UNION ALL
    SELECT 10, 'October' UNION ALL
    SELECT 11, 'November' UNION ALL
    SELECT 12, 'December';
ENd

IF @AA = 'DATA'
BEGIN

    SELECT  
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(SM1005_13) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4))
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4))
        END AS FinancialYear,

        DATENAME(MONTH, SM1005_13) AS TaxMonth,

        ISNULL(
            (SELECT sm19_23 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = sm1005_11),
            ''
        ) AS SupplierGSTIN,

        sm19_5 AS SupplierName,
        sm1005_12 AS InvoiceNo,
        FORMAT(SM1005_13, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS InvoiceDate,
        'Purchase' AS InvoiceType,

        SUBSTRING(
            (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 
             WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_21)),
            CHARINDEX(',', 
                (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 
                 WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_21))
            ) + 2,
            LEN(
                (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 
                 WHERE unqid = (SELECT sm1002_15 FROM sm1002 WHERE sm1002_5 = sm1005_21))
            )
        ) AS PlaceOfSupply,

        FORMAT(sm1005_6, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS [Date Of Receipt],

        sm1005_51 AS TaxableValue,
        sm1005_33 AS IGST,
        sm1005_34 AS CGST,
        sm1005_35 AS SGST,
        0 AS Cess,
        sm1005_36 AS InvoiceValue,  
        'YES' AS ITCEligible, 
        'NONE' AS IneligibleReason

    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm206 ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1005.sm1005_10
    INNER JOIN sm19  ON sm19.unqid  = sm1005.sm1005_11
    INNER JOIN sm209 ON sm209.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_54
    LEFT  JOIN sm210 ON sm210.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_32

    WHERE SM1005_74 IS NOT NULL
      AND sm1005.sm1005_21 = @BRANCH
      AND DATENAME(MONTH, SM1005_13) = @month
      AND (
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(SM1005_13) >= 4 
                    THEN CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4))
                ELSE 
                    CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4))
            END
          ) = @year

    ORDER BY CAST(sm1005_74 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ASC
	;




	WITH SYSTEM_DATA AS (
    SELECT  
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(SM1005_13) >= 4 
                THEN CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4))
            ELSE 
                CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) - 1 AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(YEAR(SM1005_13) AS VARCHAR(4))
        END AS FinancialYear,

        DATENAME(MONTH, SM1005_13) AS TaxMonth,
        sm19_23 AS SupplierGSTIN,
        sm19_5  AS SupplierName,
        sm1005_12 AS InvoiceNo,
        FORMAT(SM1005_13, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS InvoiceDate,
        'Purchase' AS InvoiceType,
        sm1005_51 AS TaxableValue,
        sm1005_34 AS CGST,
        sm1005_35 AS SGST,
        sm1005_33 AS IGST,
        0 AS CESS,
        sm1005_36 AS InvoiceValue,
        'YES' AS ITCEligible,
        'NONE' AS IneligibleReason
    FROM sm1005
    INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm19.unqid = sm1005.sm1005_11
    WHERE SM1005_74 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT  
    s.*,

    -- 👉 PORTAL DATA (Q → U)
    p.portal_CGST,
    p.Portal_SGST,
   p.portal_IGST,
    p.Portal_CESS,
    p.portal_TotalITC

    

FROM SYSTEM_DATA s
LEFT JOIN itc_portal_data p
    ON s.InvoiceNo = p.InvoiceNo
   AND s.SupplierGSTIN = p.SupplierGSTIN

ORDER BY s.InvoiceNo;
END
END

	

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetDistributionMonthlySumm]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER OFF
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDistributionMonthlySumm] (
	@FinYrFrom	As DateTime = '1-Apr-2004',
	@AsOn		As DateTime = '15-Oct-2004',
	@BranchID	As Int = 1,
	@PrdCatLngID	As Varchar(255)='1',
	@GrpLngID	As Varchar(255)='10001%',	--Aj:#14-02-07#
	@Qty_AmtW	As Bit=0,
	@Order		SmallInt=0
	)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @PrevFinYrFrom	As DateTime
	DECLARE @NoOfMonth		As Int

	SET @PrevFinYrFrom = DATEADD(Year,-1,@FinYrFrom)
	SET @NoOfMonth = Month(@AsOn)
	If @NoOfMonth < 4
		SET @NoOfMonth = @NoOfMonth + 9
	Else
		SET @NoOfMonth = @NoOfMonth - 3
	
	--Drop the table (if present).
	IF (Object_Id('tempdb.dbo.##TMP','U') IS NOT NULL) DROP TABLE ##TMP

	CREATE TABLE ##TMP
	(
		Product_Name	VarChar(100),
		Account_Name	VarChar(100),
		Account_Id	VarChar(32),
		fLYA		Money,
		fCYT		Money,
		fCYA		Money,
		fApr		Money,
		fMay		Money,
		fJun		Money,
		fJul		Money,
		fAug		Money,
		fSep		Money,
		fOct		Money,
		fNov		Money,
		fDec		Money,
		fJan		Money,
		fFeb		Money,
		fMar		Money,
	
		fLYA1		Money,
		fCYT1		Money,
		fCYA1		Money,
		fApr1		Money,
		fMay1		Money,
		fJun1		Money,
		fJul1		Money,
		fAug1		Money,
		fSep1		Money,
		fOct1		Money,
		fNov1		Money,
		fDec1		Money,
		fJan1		Money,
		fFeb1		Money,
		fMar1		Money,
		Unit		VarChar(20)
	)
	INSERT INTO ##TMP
	SELECT Category_Name As Product_Name, Account_Name, Account_Id,
		SUM(fLYA)  As fLYA, 
		SUM(fCYT) As fCYT, 
		SUM(fCYT) / @NoOfMonth As fCYA,
		SUM(fApr) As fApr,
		SUM(fMay) As fMay,
		SUM(fJun) As fJun,
		SUM(fJul) As fJul,
		SUM(fAug) As fAug,
		SUM(fSep) As fSep,
		SUM(fOct) As fOct,
		SUM(fNov) As fNov,
		SUM(fDec) As fDec,
		SUM(fJan) As fJan,
		SUM(fFeb) As fFeb,
		SUM(fMar) As fMar
	
		,SUM(fLYA1)  As fLYA1, 
		SUM(fCYT1) As fCYT1, 
		SUM(fCYT1) / @NoOfMonth As fCYA1,
		SUM(fApr1) As fApr1,
		SUM(fMay1) As fMay1,
		SUM(fJun1) As fJun1,
		SUM(fJul1) As fJul1,
		SUM(fAug1) As fAug1,
		SUM(fSep1) As fSep1,
		SUM(fOct1) As fOct1,
		SUM(fNov1) As fNov1,
		SUM(fDec1) As fDec1,
		SUM(fJan1) As fJan1,
		SUM(fFeb1) As fFeb1,
		SUM(fMar1) As fMar1
	
		,[Unit]
	FROM 
	(SELECT Product_CategoryID, Product_Name,  Account_Name, Account_Id,
	/*
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 0 THEN TotQty/12 ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fLYA,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo <> 0 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fCYT,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 4 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fApr,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 5 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fMay,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 6 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fJun,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 7 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fJul,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 8 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fAug,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 9 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fSep,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 10 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fOct,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 11 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fNov,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 12 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fDec,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 1 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fJan,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 2 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fFeb,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 3 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) * Unit_ConvFactor As fMar
	*/
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 0 THEN TotQty/12 ELSE 0 END) As fLYA,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo <> 0 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END)  As fCYT,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 4 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fApr,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 5 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fMay,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 6 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fJun,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 7 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fJul,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 8 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fAug,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 9 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fSep,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 10 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fOct,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 11 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fNov,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 12 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fDec,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 1 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fJan,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 2 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fFeb,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 3 THEN TotQty ELSE 0 END) As fMar
	
		,SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 0 THEN TotAmt/12 ELSE 0 END) As fLYA1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo <> 0 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fCYT1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 4 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fApr1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 5 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fMay1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 6 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fJun1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 7 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fJul1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 8 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fAug1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 9 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fSep1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 10 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fOct1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 11 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fNov1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 12 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fDec1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 1 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fJan1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 2 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fFeb1,
		SUM(CASE WHEN MonthNo = 3 THEN TotAmt ELSE 0 END) As fMar1
	
		, Unit_Name As [Unit]
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT Product_CategoryID, Product_Name, Account_PrintName + (Case When IsNull(City_Name,'')='' Then '' Else ', '+City_Name End) As Account_Name, Account_Id,
		(CASE WHEN Invoice_Date < @FinYrFrom THEN 0 ELSE Year(Invoice_Date) END) as YearNo, 
		(CASE WHEN Invoice_Date <@FinYrFrom THEN 0 ELSE Month(Invoice_Date) END) as MonthNo , 
		--Aj:S #14-02-07#
		Sum((CASE WHEN [InvDet_Strength]>0 THEN Cast(STR(InvDet1308.[InvDet_ProductQty]*InvDet1308.[InvDet_Strength]*0.01+0.00001,14,Unit_PrintDecimal) AS Money) ELSE InvDet_ProductQty END)) as TotQty, Unit_ConvFactor	
		,Sum(Invoice_GrossAmt) as TotAmt, Unit_Name
		--Sum(CASE WHEN @Qty_AmtW=0 THEN InvDet_ProductQty ELSE Invoice_NetAmt END) as TotQty, (CASE WHEN @Qty_AmtW=0 THEN Unit_ConvFactor ELSE 1 END) AS Unit_ConvFactor
		--Aj:E #14-02-07#
		FROM ((((((Invoice1308 LEFT JOIN InvDet1308 on Invoice_Id= InvDet_InvoiceID)
		LEFT JOIN AccountMas1308 on Invoice_PartyId= Account_Id)
		LEFT JOIN CityMas On Account_CityID=City_Id)
		LEFT JOIN GroupMas on Account_GroupID=Group_Id)
		LEFT JOIN ProductMas1308 on InvDet_ProductId = Product_Id)
		LEFT JOIN UnitMas on Unit_Id = Product_UnitId)
		WHERE IsNull(Invoice_Iscancelled,0) = 0 And (Invoice_Date BETWEEN @PrevFinYrFrom And @AsOn) And (Group_LongId Like @GrpLngID)
		AND Invoice_TotMid IN (4,14) AND (BranchID = @BranchID OR @BranchID = 0)	--and product_id not in (13,14,102,103)
		GROUP BY Product_Name, Product_CategoryID, (CASE WHEN Invoice_Date < @FinYrFrom THEN 0 ELSE Year(Invoice_Date) END),
		(CASE WHEN Invoice_Date < @FinYrFrom THEN 0 ELSE Month(Invoice_Date) END), Account_PrintName, Account_Id, Unit_ConvFactor, Unit_Name,City_Name) As PADet
		GROUP BY Product_Name, Account_Name, Account_Id, Product_CategoryID, Unit_ConvFactor, Unit_Name
	) As PAFinal
	INNER JOIN CategoryMas On Product_CategoryID = Category_ID AND Category_LongID Like @PrdCatLngID
	GROUP BY Category_Name, Account_Name, Account_Id, [Unit]

	DECLARE @sSql AS VarChar(8000)

	SET @sSql = 'SELECT * FROM ##TMP WHERE (1=1)'
	IF(@Order=1)
		SET @sSql = @sSql + ' ORDER BY fCYA DESC'

	EXEC(@sSql)
	
	DROP TABLE ##TMP

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_BANK_BOOK_MASTER]
    @what                NVARCHAR(50) = '',		
    @outletcode			 NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@unqid			     NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@branchid            NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_5                NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_14			     NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_6				 NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_1			     NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_21				 NVARCHAR(50) ='',
	@BA_22				 NVARCHAR(50) =''
AS
BEGIN 
    IF @what = 'grid_R'
    BEGIN
      SELECT unqid,BA_5 AS BankName, (SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid = BA_14) AS BankAccount, BA_6 AS Prefix, BA_1 AS BankCode FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK';
	END

	if @what ='EDEdit_box'
	BEGIN
	   SELECT unqid,BA_5 AS BankName, (select unqid from sm19 where unqid= BA_14) AS BankAccount, BA_6 AS Prefix, BA_1 AS BankCode FROM BA WHERE BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK' and unqid =@unqid
	END
	if @what ='BankBook'
	begin 
	  SELECT SM19.unqid, SM19.sm19_6 AS BankAccount FROM SM19 JOIN BA ON SM19.unqid = BA.BA_14 WHERE BA.BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK'

	end
	if @what='Update_Data'
	BEGIN
	UPDATE BA SET BA_5 = @BA_5, BA_14 =@BA_14, BA_6 = @BA_6, BA_1 = @BA_1, BA_19 = @BA_21, BA_18 = @BA_22 WHERE unqid = @unqid  and  BA_2 = 'BANK BOOK' 
	END
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_BOOKING_ORDER]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@Name nvarchar(20)='',
@SM1017_6		datetime='',
@SM1016_1		datetime='',												-- ENTER DATE
@SM1016_2		datetime='',												-- MODIFY DATE
@SM1016_3		nvarchar(20)='',										    -- USER ID

SELECT
--sm1016.unqid as unqid,
SM1016_5 AS [BOOKING NO], convert(varchar ,SM1016_6 ,105)  AS [BOOKING DATE],SM1016_35 AS ORDERQTY, (SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=SM1016_8)AS PRODUCT,ISNULL(SUM(SM1008_10),0) AS CHALLANQTY,(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=SM1016_7) AS CUSTOMER,
(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1016_12) UNIT,(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=SM1016_4 )as BRANCHNAME,sm1016_34 as STRENGTH ,
(SM1016_35-ISNULL(SUM(SM1008_10),0))AS PENDINGQTY FROM SM1016 LEFT JOIN SM1008 ON SM1008.SM1008_31=SM1016.UNQID 
WHERE  
SM1016.SM1016_4 in (select data from dbo.split(@SM1016_4,','))
----and sm1016_6 between @FDate and @TDate
GROUP BY SM1016_5,SM1016_35,SM1016_34,SM1016_6,SM1016_8,SM1016_7,SM1016_12,SM1016.unqid, SM1016_4 HAVING(SM1016_35-ISNULL(SUM(SM1008_10),0))>0
ORDER BY CAST(SM1016_5 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) asc ;



 if @SM1016_4 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	   begin 
	   select 'ALL ' as [COMPANYNAME], 'BRANCHES' as [ADMOFFICE]  
	   end
	   else
	   begin
	   Select CASE 
       WHEN PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) > 0 
       THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sm1002_7, 1, PATINDEX('%(%', sm1002_7) - 1)))
       ELSE sm1002_7 
       END  as [COMPANYNAME],
       (select sm1_5    from sm01 where unqid =  sm1002_11) AS [ADMOFFICE]  from sm1002 where sm1002_5 =  @SM1016_4
	    end;
  end

  IF @WHAT='EMPTY_GRID'
  BEGIN
  SELECT '' AS unqid, 'NO RECORD FOUND' AS BOOKNO, '' AS BOOKDATE, '' AS CUSTOMER, '' AS PRODUCT, '' AS UNIT, '' AS PENDINGQTY
  END
END

begin
 --Select SM1002_5 AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7
 -- select convert (nvarchar,GETDATE(),105) as unq 
   declare @branch1 as nvarchar(max)
    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

   (select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=SM1016_4 )as BRANCHNAME,
(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1016_8) as PRODUCTNAME  ,sm1016_11 as QTY ,sm1016_34 as STRENGTH ,
(select sm209_7 from sm209 where unqid=sm1016_12) as UNIT,
sm1016_35 as NETQTY, sm1016_23 AS PAYMENTTERM from sm1016 WHERE
 SM1016.SM1016_4  IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SM1016_4, ',')) AND
sm1016_6 between @FDate and @TDate and sm1016_3=@sm1016_3
 ORDER BY CAST(sm1016_5 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) asc;

  --if @SM1016_4 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

		(SELECT (sm19_5) FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = SM1016_7) AS Customer,
		(SELECT (sm206_7) FROM sm206 WHERE sm206_2 = SM1016_8) AS ProductName,
		 (CONVERT(nvarchar, SM1016_11) +' '+ (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar, sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE unqid = SM1016_12)) AS QTY
		 , (SM1016_34) AS STRENGTH, (CONVERT(nvarchar, SM1016_35) +' '+ (SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar, sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE unqid = SM1016_12)) AS NetQTY,
		(SM1016_14) AS cashrate,sm1016_15 as creditrate, (SM1016_24) AS [Mode Of Payment], (SM1016_23) AS [Payment Term], CASE WHEN SM1016_16 != 0 THEN CONCAT(SM1016_16, ' (CASH)')
        WHEN SM1016_17 != 0 THEN CONCAT(SM1016_17, ' (CREDIT)') ELSE '0 (No Cash or Credit)' END AS CashAndCredit, SM1016_c.SM1016_C33 AS Reason,
		sm63_6 as username,sm1016_13 as freight
		FROM SM1016 INNER JOIN  SM1016_c ON SM1016.UNQID = SM1016_c.SM1016_C5 inner join sm63 on sm63_5=sm1016_3 WHERE SM1016.UNQID = @UNQID

       select SM504_6 from sm504 where SM504_4='Order Booking' and SM504_5='Save' 
   end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_BOOKING_ORDER_sw]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@Name nvarchar(20)='',
@SM1016_1		datetime='',												-- ENTER DATE
@SM1016_2		datetime='',												-- MODIFY DATE
@SM1016_3		nvarchar(20)='',
@cat		nvarchar(20)='',										    -- USER ID
-- USER ID
@UNQID			uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM1016_100		nvarchar(200)='',											----IP
@SM1016_4		nvarchar(max)='',											----Branch name
@SM1016_5		nvarchar(50)='',											----Booking Oder No
@SM1016_6  		nvarchar(50)='',											----DATE
@SM1016_7  	    nvarchar(50)='',											----Customer Name 
@SM1016_8       nvarchar(50)='',											----BRANCH Name  
@SM1016_9       nvarchar(50)='',											----STAFF
@SM1016_10  	nvarchar(50)='',											----PAYMENT TERM
@SM1016_11  	nvarchar(50)='',											----MODE OF PAYMENT 
@SM1016_12 	    nvarchar(50)='',											----CR LIMIT
@SM1016_13  	nvarchar(50)='',											----VALID TILL
@SM1016_14      nvarchar(50)='',											----DELIVERY DATE



@SM1016_C3		nvarchar(100)='',   ---USER
@SM1016_C100     nvarchar(100)='',			--IP									
@SM1016_C5		nvarchar(100)='',--PARENT
@SM1016_C6		nvarchar(100)='',	   ---									

@SM1016_C7     nvarchar(100)='',											----CATEGORY
@SM1016_C8     nvarchar(100)='',											----PRODUCT
@SM1016_C9    nvarchar(100)='',											----MANU
@SM1016_C10     nvarchar(100)='',											----QTY
@SM1016_C11     nvarchar(100)='',											----RATE

@unqid_c        nvarchar(max)='',
@UNIT			nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1002_5   NVARCHAR(50)='' ,
@fromdate   NVARCHAR(50)='',
@todate     NVARCHAR(50)='',
@gsttext    nvarchar(50)='',
@branchid	nvarchar(max)='',
@uid        nvarchar(50)='',	
--@Reason		nvarchar(max)
@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@TDate       nvarchar(50)='',
@FDate        nvarchar(50)='',
@email       nvarchar(50)=''




AS		
BEGIN

IF @WHAT = 'GETCONVERSIONVALUE'
BEGIN
SELECT SM209_10 AS CONVERSIONFACTOR FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=@UNIT
END

IF @WHAT = 'INSERT_P'
BEGIN 

	   SET  @unqid = NEWID()
	   
	  
	   INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1016_SW] VALUES
	   (dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),UPPER(@SM1016_3),@UNQID,@SM1016_100,@SM1016_5,@SM1016_6,@SM1016_7,@SM1016_8,
	   @SM1016_9,@SM1016_10,@SM1016_11,@SM1016_12,DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1016_13),DBO.getformatteddate(@SM1016_14) )
	   
	   SELECT @UNQID AS [PUNQID] 
END


IF @WHAT = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN 
	   SET  @unqid = NEWID()
	  -- SET @SM202_C12='0.00'

	   INSERT INTO [dbo].[sm1016_C_SW]
	   VALUES
	   (dbo.entrydate(),dbo.entrydate(),UPPER(@SM1016_c3),@unqid,@SM1016_c100,@SM1016_c5, @SM1016_c6,@SM1016_C7,
	   @SM1016_C8,@SM1016_C9,@SM1016_C10,@SM1016_C11)
	   
	
END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------END---SLR----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	
	IF @what ='ObookingMaster'
	begin 
       --Customer Name	
	   DECLARE @CUSTTYPE NVARCHAR(MAX)
        SET @CUSTTYPE= (SELECT SM502_18 FROM SM502 INNER JOIN SM63 ON SM502.UNQID=SM63_13 WHERE SM63_5=@uid)
		
	     SELECT     '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS unqid, 
         '---Select---' AS Customer, 0 AS ord union all
		select unqid, sm19_5 AS Customer, 1 as ord  from sm19 where sm19_11='CUST' and 
		sm19_63 like '%'+@branchid+'%' AND SM19_7 IN (select data from dbo.split  (@CUSTTYPE,','))
		 order by ord, Customer
       --Product Name

	   select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS sm206_2, 
         '---Select---' AS ProductN, 0 AS ord union all
		select sm206_2 , sm206_7 as ProductN, 1 as ord  from sm206 ORDER BY ord, ProductN
       --Manufacture


	    select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS unqid, 
         '---Select---' AS Manufacture, 0 AS ord union all
		select  unqid ,sm113_6 as Manufacture , 1 as ord from sm113 ORDER BY ord , Manufacture


	   --Category
	    select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS unqid, 
         '---Select---' AS Category, 0 AS ord union all
		select unqid , sm17_6 as Category, 1 as ord  from sm17 order by ord, Category
       --unit  
	      select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS unqid, 
         '---Select---' AS unit, 0 AS ord union all
		select unqid ,  sm209_7 as unit, 1 as unit  from sm209 ORDER BY ord, unit 
	   --IGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS IGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7
	   --CGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS CGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7
	   --SGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS SGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7  
	   --date
		select convert (nvarchar,GETDATE(),105) as unq 
	   --Payable at
		SELECT unqid, SM1_5 AS CITY FROM SM01 ORDER BY SM1_5
	   --Branch Master
		 select upper(SM1002_5) AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7

		  select unqid , sm502_4 as staff from sm502 ORDER BY SM502_4
	   -- staff master 
	   	select upper(sm63_13) as staff from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid  
	 
	end
	if @what='GST_text'
	begin
	select sm210_7 AS IGST from sm210 where unqid= @gsttext
	end





		IF @what='CAT'
	BEGIN

	select Sm206_2  , sm206_7 as productN from sm206
	inner join sm17 on sm17.unqid=sm206.sm206_13 where  sm17.unqid=@cat
	END


		IF @what='manu'
	BEGIN

	
	select  sm113.unqid ,sm113_6 as Manufacture from sm113 
				inner join sm113_c on sm113.unqid  = sm113_c2
				inner join sm206_c on sm206_c7 = sm113.unqid
				where sm206_c6 = @unqid
	END
	
	IF @what='GET_GRNO'
	BEGIN
		select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(sm1016_sw.SM1016_5 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1 as GRNo,newid() as parentunq from dbo.SM1016_sw where sm1016_8=@branchid
	END


		IF @what ='grid_R'
	begin
	IF(@SM1016_3 IN('SHI','ADM'))

		Select sm1016_sw.unqid as unqid , SM1016_5 ,convert (varchar ,SM1016_6 ,105) as SM1016_6,
		(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=SM1016_7 )as SM1016_7 
		---(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1016_8) as SM1016_8 
		from sm1016_sw WHERE SM1016_8 LIKE '%'+@BRANCHID+'%' ORDER BY SM1016_1 DESC,SM1016_5 DESC	
ELSE
		Select sm1016_sw.unqid as unqid , SM1016_5 ,convert (varchar ,SM1016_6 ,105) as SM1016_6,
		(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=SM1016_7 )as SM1016_7 
		--(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1016_8) as SM1016_8 
		from sm1016_sw WHERE SM1016_8 LIKE '%'+@BRANCHID+'%' AND SM1016_3=@SM1016_3	ORDER BY SM1016_1 DESC,SM1016_5 DESC	
	end




  IF @WHAT='EMPTY_GRID'
  BEGIN
  SELECT '' AS unqid, 'NO RECORD FOUND' AS BOOKNO, '' AS BOOKDATE, '' AS CUSTOMER, '' AS PRODUCT, '' AS UNIT, '' AS PENDINGQTY
  END

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



 if @what='ObookingMasterR'
begin
 --Select SM1002_5 AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7
 -- select convert (nvarchar,GETDATE(),105) as unq

    set @branch1=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)

sm1016_c7 as product, sm1016_c8 as manu, sm1016_c9 as unit, sm1016_c10 as qty, sm1016_c11 as rate
from sm1016_c_sw where sm1016_c5 = @unqid
	END

IF @what ='delete'
	BEGIN
	delete 
FROM SM1016_sw WHERE unqid =@unqid


delete 
from sm1016_c_sw where sm1016_c5 = @unqid
	END

IF @WHAT = 'UPDATE_P'
BEGIN

UPDATE sm1016_SW
SET


SM1016_6 = @SM1016_6,
SM1016_7 = @SM1016_7,
SM1016_8 = @SM1016_8,
SM1016_9 = @SM1016_9,
SM1016_10 = @SM1016_10,
SM1016_11 = @SM1016_11,
SM1016_12 = @SM1016_12,
SM1016_13 = dbo.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1016_13)

WHERE unqid = @unqid

END


end

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_BRANCHMASTER]
@what			nvarchar(50)='',
@Name			nvarchar(20)='',
@SM1002_1       datetime='',		  ----enter date
@SM1002_2       datetime='',          ----modify date
@SM1002_3 		nvarchar(100)='',      ----ip
@SM1002_4 		nvarchar(20)='',      ----user id
@SM1002_5		uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM1002_6  		nvarchar(20)='',      ----Code
@SM1002_7  	    nvarchar(200)='',      ----Name of branch
@SM1002_8       nvarchar(max)='',     ----Address
@SM1002_9  	    nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----Country
@SM1002_10  	nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----State   
@SM1002_11 	    nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----City
@SM1002_12      nvarchar(50)='',      ----Contact person
@SM1002_13      nvarchar(20)='',      ----Contact number
@SM1002_14      nvarchar(40)='',      ----Contact Email
@SM1002_15      nvarchar(MAX)='',      ----A/c head
@SM1002_17    nvarchar(20)='',      ----PinCode 

@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@sm205_8        nvarchar(50) =''

AS
Begin
  if @what='insert'
  Begin
	insert into sm1002(SM1002_1,SM1002_2,SM1002_3,SM1002_4,SM1002_5,SM1002_6,SM1002_7,SM1002_8,SM1002_9,SM1002_10,SM1002_11,SM1002_12,SM1002_13,SM1002_14,SM1002_15,SM1002_17)
	values(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@SM1002_3,@SM1002_4,NEWID(),@SM1002_6,@SM1002_7,@SM1002_8,@SM1002_9,@SM1002_10,@SM1002_11,@SM1002_12,@SM1002_13,@SM1002_14,@SM1002_15,@SM1002_17);
  End 

  if @what='Table_Bind'
  Begin
   select unqid as unqid, sm19_5 as AccountingHead from sm19 where sm19_11 = 'BRAN'ORDER BY sm19_5
  End

  if @what='Table_Bind1'
  Begin
   select unqid as unqid, sm205_5 as State from sm205 where sm205_8 = @sm205_8 ORDER BY sm205_5
  End

  if @what='Table_Bind2'
  Begin
	select unqid as unqid, sm2_5 as country from sm02 ORDER BY sm2_5
  End
  if @what='citybind'
  Begin
	select sm1_5 as City, unqid  from sm01 where sm1_7 = @SM1002_10 ORDER BY sm1_5
  End

  if @what='getone'
  Begin
	select SM1002_6 as code ,SM1002_7 as Name ,SM1002_8 as Address ,lower(SM1002_9) as Country ,SM1002_10 as State ,lower(SM1002_11) as city ,SM1002_12 as ContactP,SM1002_13 as ContactN
	,SM1002_14 as ContactE,(select unqid from sm19 where unqid=SM1002_15 ) as AChead,SM1002_17 as PinCode from SM1002 where SM1002_5=@SM1002_5
  End

  if @what ='branch_v'
  Begin
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_6, SM1002_7,(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=SM1002_15) AS SM1002_15 from SM1002
  End

  if @what ='delete_data'
  Begin
	DELETE from SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5= @SM1002_5 
  End

  if @what ='Update_Data'
  Begin
	UPDATE SM1002 set  SM1002_7= @SM1002_7, SM1002_8= @SM1002_8,SM1002_9= @SM1002_9, SM1002_10= @SM1002_10, SM1002_11= @SM1002_11,SM1002_12= @SM1002_12,
	SM1002_13= @SM1002_13,SM1002_14= @SM1002_14,SM1002_15= @SM1002_15,SM1002_17 = @SM1002_17 where SM1002_5= @SM1002_5       
  End
  IF @what='GET_GRNO'
	BEGIN
		select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(SM1002.SM1002_6 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1 as GRNo,newid() as parentunq from dbo.SM1002;
	END
End

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_CESSMASTER] 
@what       nvarchar(15)='', 
@sm211_4    nvarchar(50)='',    ---unique
@sm19_5     nvarchar(50)='',    ---Account Head (sm19_5)
@sm211_1    datetime='',		---Entry Date
@sm211_2    datetime='',	    ---modify date
@sm211_3	nvarchar(50)='',    ---userid
@sm211_5    nvarchar(50)='',    ---ip address
@sm211_6    nvarchar(50)='',     ---cess
@sm211_7    nvarchar(50)='',    ---description
@sm211_8	nvarchar(50)='',    ---account head
@sm211_100  nvarchar(50)='',	--cess on(Amount/ Qty) 
@user       nvarchar(50)=''
as

if @what='Table_Bind'
BEGIN
select unqid AS unqid , sm19_5 as AccountingHead from sm19 ORDER BY sm19_5
END

if @what='Insert_Data'
BEGIN
insert into sm211 (sm211_1, sm211_2, sm211_3, sm211_4, sm211_5, sm211_6, sm211_7, sm211_8, sm211_100) 
values(GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000',@user , NEWID(),@sm211_5, @sm211_6, @sm211_7, @sm211_8, @sm211_100);
END

if @what='Cess_View'
BEGIN
select sm211_4 as unqid , sm211_6 , sm211_7, (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE unqid=SM211_8) AS sm211_8 from sm211  
END

if @what='Cess_Bind'
BEGIN
select sm211_6, sm211_7, sm211_8, sm211_100 from sm211 where sm211_4 =@sm211_4
END

if @what='Update_Data'
BEGIN
update sm211 set sm211_6 = @sm211_6, sm211_7=@sm211_7, sm211_8=@sm211_8, SM211_100=@SM211_100 where sm211_4=@sm211_4
END

if @what='Delete_Data'
BEGIN
delete from sm211 where sm211_4= @sm211_4
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_Debit_Note]	
    @what                NVARCHAR(50) = '',		
    
    @unqid               UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',	--UNQID
   
    @outletcode			 NVARCHAR(100) = '',
    @gstnature			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@branchid            nvarchar(50) ='',
	@WAREHOUSEUNQ        nvarchar(max)='',
	@BRANCH              nvarchar(max)='',
	
	@fromdate			nvarchar(50)='',
	@todate				nvarchar(50)='',
	@branchunq			nvarchar(max)=''
									 
AS
BEGIN
   
if @WHAT='DNR'
	begin
		
		

	SELECT  pa_11 as [Adm], 
	 pa_3 as CName FROM PA   
	 
SELECT  
    sm19.sm19_5              AS Party,
    sm1002.sm1002_7          AS Branch,
    CONVERT(nvarchar(10), sm403.sm403_4, 105) AS [Date],
    sm403.sm403_8            AS [VNO],
    sm403.sm403_10           AS [Type],
	sm403.sm403_13 as Rate ,
	sm403.sm403_14          AS [Invoice Value],

    sm403.sm403_15           AS [Taxable Value],

    sm403.sm403_17           AS IGST,
    sm403.sm403_18           AS CGST,
    sm403.sm403_19           AS SGST,
    sm403.sm403_20           AS Total

FROM SM403 sm403
INNER JOIN SM19 sm19 
    ON sm19.UNQID = sm403.sm403_9
INNER JOIN SM1002 sm1002 
    ON sm403.sm403_6 = sm1002.sm1002_5

WHERE sm403.sm403_5 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate)
                        AND dbo.getformatteddate(@todate)
AND sm1002.sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchunq, ','))

ORDER BY 
    sm1002.sm1002_7,
    sm403.sm403_4;

	end

	if @WHAT='BranchBind'
	begin
	 --set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
		select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH from SM1002 
		--where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
		ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;
	end
end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_DEBIT_NOTE_APPROVAL]	
    @what                NVARCHAR(50) = '',		
    @outletcode			 NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@unqid			     NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@SM1018_6			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @SM1018_23			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @SM1018_24			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@SM1018_25			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',   
	@SM1018_26			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@SM1018_27			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@branchid            NVARCHAR(50) ='',

	@CRNDATE             NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
	@BRANCH              nvarchar(max)='',
	@userid              nvarchar(max)='',
	@punqid              nvarchar(max)='',
	@ordering            nvarchar(max)='',
	@acname              nvarchar(max)='',
	@AccountID           nvarchar(max)='',
	@Amount              nvarchar(max)='',
	@naration            nvarchar(max)='',
	@invoice             nvarchar(max)='',
	@invnid              nvarchar(max)='',
	@invvoiceamt         nvarchar(max)='',
	@invnbalance         numeric(18,2)=0.00,
	@co_9                nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN 
    DECLARE @m3_1 NVARCHAR(10), @m3_2 NVARCHAR(30), @m3_3 NVARCHAR(20), @m3_4 NVARCHAR(36), @m3_5 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_6 NVARCHAR(50), @m3_7 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_8 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @m3_9 NVARCHAR(20), @m3_10 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_11 NVARCHAR(10), @m3_12 NVARCHAR(36), @m3_13 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_14 NVARCHAR(50), @m3_15 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_16 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @m3_17 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_18 NVARCHAR(36), @m3_19 NVARCHAR(30), @m3_20 NVARCHAR(36);

   
    IF @what = 'grid_R'
    BEGIN
	print '1'
         SELECT SM1018.unqid AS unqid, (SELECT sm19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid = SM1018_6) AS SM1018_6, SM1018_5, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 105) AS SM1018_7,
		 SM1018_8, SM1018_18, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_4, 105) AS SM1018_4,SM1018_20,
		 (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM M3 WHERE M3_14 = SM1018.unqid) THEN 'APPROVE' ELSE 'PENDING'	END ) AS APPROVALSTATUS,
		 SM1018_10 as rate,sm1018_21 AS QTY,SM1018_11 AS TAXABLE,SM1018_15 AS IGSTAmount,SM1018_16 AS SGSTAmount,SM1018_17 AS CGSTAmount,SM1018_18 AS TOTAL,
		 (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_12) AS IGST,(SELECT CAST(SM210_7/2 AS NUMERIC(18,2))FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_13) AS SGST,
		 (SELECT  CAST(SM210_7/2  AS NUMERIC(18,2)) FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_14) AS CGST,
		 (SELECT CAST(SM1011_35 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_23) AS INVOICEAMT  FROM SM1018 
		 WHERE sm1018_19 IN (SELECT data FROM [dbo].[Split](@BRANCH, ','))
		 ORDER BY CAST(SM1018_20 AS NUMERIC(18,0))DESC,SM1018_4 DESC,SM1018_19
		print '2'
    END

     IF @what = 'Gridview'
	   IF EXISTS (SELECT  1 FROM m3 WHERE M3_14 = @unqid)
		BEGIN
		 print'0';
		END 
	ELSE
  		BEGIN		
		SET @SM1018_24=DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1018_24);
	    UPDATE SM1018 SET SM1018_24 = dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24), SM1018_25 = @SM1018_25,SM1018_26 = @SM1018_26, SM1018_27 = @SM1018_27 WHERE unqid = @unqid

		SET @CRNDATE=(SELECT SM1018_24 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID)
		set @BRANCH=(select sm1018_19 from sm1018 where unqid=@UNQID)
		print '1'
		set @punqid=newid();

		set @naration= 
		(SELECT(
  CASE UPPER(SM1018_8)
        WHEN 'GOODS RETURN' THEN
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' QTY ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

        WHEN 'CASH DISCOUNT' THEN
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') +' @ ' +ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

        WHEN 'RATE DIFFERENCE' THEN
             'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
             ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
	        ' Rs ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') +' PER KG '+
             ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') 
			 + ' SUPPLIED ' +    'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
            ' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

  WHEN 'SHORTAGE' THEN
             'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
             ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			 ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			 ' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '')+
	        ' @' + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') +' PER KG '+
            -- ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') 
			 + ' SUPPLIED ' +    'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
            ' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

			WHEN 'DEDUCTION' THEN
             'BEING CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST MATERIAL '

			WHEN 'INCENTIVE SCHEME' THEN
			upper('Incentive Scheme Credit Note for ' +
			       + DATENAME(MONTH, sm1018_4) 
				   +' '+
				   + CAST(YEAR(sm1018_4) AS VARCHAR(4))
				   +' - credited to ' 
				   +(SELECT SM19_5 FROM sm19 WHERE unqid =sm1018_6 )
				   + ' (Qty: ' + CAST(sm1018_21 AS VARCHAR(20))
                   + ', Rate: ' + CAST(sm1018_10 AS VARCHAR(20)) + ')')

        ELSE
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') 
		    + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DT ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)
    END)
FROM SM1018 
WHERE UNQID = @UNQID)
print '2'

		INSERT INTO SM203 VALUES (GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@SM1018_25,@punqid,@SM1018_26,@BRANCH,(SELECT TOP 1 BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'JOURNAL'),(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM203_6 AS NUMERIC(10))), 0) + 1 FROM SM203
     WHERE SM203_101 = @BRANCH AND SM203_11 = @CRNDATE),(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SM203_6a AS NUMERIC(10))), 0) + 1 FROM SM203
     WHERE SM203_101 = @BRANCH AND SM203_11 = @CRNDATE),dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),@naration,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),@SM1018_25,(SELECT TOP 1 BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'CREDIT NOTE'),'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    @UNQID,'','','' 
);
print '3'
set @acname=(select sm1018_6 from sm1018 where unqid=@unqid)

		INSERT INTO m3
		SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4,SM1018_20, SM1018_6,
	    @naration,
		SM1018_18,'', '', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID, '', '', '', newid(), dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24), dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100 
		FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid), dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),(select SM1018_6 FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid),(select SM1018_18 FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid),'0','0','1');
		
		-- Insert into m3 table for taxable
		INSERT INTO m3
		SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4, SM1018_20,(select sm206_24 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1018_38) as sm1018_6,
		@naration, -cast(SM1018_11 as numeric(18,3)), '', '', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID, '', '', '', newid(),dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24), dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19,SM1018_100
		FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

		
		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid), dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),
		(SELECT SM206_24 FROM SM206 INNER JOIN SM1018 ON SM1018_38=SM206_2 WHERE UNQID=@unqid),
		-cast((select SM1018_11 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid) as numeric(18,3)),'0','0','2');

		-- Conditional insertion for IGST, SGST, and CGST
	
		IF((SELECT SM1018_12 FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid =@unqid ) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')	
		BEGIN

		-- IGST
		INSERT INTO m3
		SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4, SM1018_20, (SELECT top 1 SM210_19 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM1018_12), 
		@naration, -cast(SM1018_15 as numeric(18,3)),  '','', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID,'', '', '',newid(), dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24),dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100
		FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

			
		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid), dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),(SELECT top 1 SM210_19 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = (select SM1018_12 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid)),-cast(((select SM1018_15 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid)) as numeric(18,3)),'0','0','3');
		
		END
			ELSE
		BEGIN

		-- SGST
		INSERT INTO m3
		SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4,SM1018_20, (SELECT top 1 SM210_11 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM1018_13),
		@naration, -cast(SM1018_16 as numeric(18,3)), '',  '', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID,'', '', '',newid(), dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24),dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100
		FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

			
		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid), dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),(SELECT top 1 SM210_11 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID =(select SM1018_13 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid) ),-cast( (select SM1018_16 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid) as numeric(18,3)),'0','0','2');

		-- CGST
		INSERT INTO m3 SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4,SM1018_20, (SELECT top 1 SM210_15 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID = SM1018_14),
		@naration, -cast(SM1018_17 as numeric(18,3)), '','', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID,'', '', '',newid(), dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24),dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100
		FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

			
		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid),dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),(SELECT top 1 SM210_15 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID =(select SM1018_14 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid)),-cast((select SM1018_17 from sm1018 where unqid =@unqid) as numeric(18,3)),'0','0','2');

	

		END
			-- round
		INSERT INTO m3 SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4,SM1018_20,(select unqid from sm19 where sm19_5='ROUND OFF'),
		@naration, -cast(SM1018_37 as numeric(18,3)), '','', 'CR', '', '', '', '', @UNQID,'', '', '',newid(), dbo.onlydate(@SM1018_24),dbo.getentrydate(),
		'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100 FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = @unqid;

	
		insert into sm203_c values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,newid(),@SM1018_26,@branch,'',
        @punqid,(select sm203_6 from sm203 where sm203_4=@punqid),dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE),
		(select unqid from sm19 where sm19_5='ROUND OFF'),-cast((select SM1018_37 from sm1018
		where unqid =@unqid) as numeric(18,3)),'0','0','2');

	set @invoice=(select sm1018_23 from sm1018 where unqid=@unqid)
	set @invnid =(select unqid from invn where in_5=@invoice)
	set @invvoiceamt=(select in_9 from invn where in_5=@invoice)
	set @invnbalance=(select in_11 from invn where in_5=@invoice)
	set @co_9=(SELECT SM203_5 FROM SM203 WHERE SM203_4 = @punqid)
	 

	insert into cosr values(getdate(),getdate(),@SM1018_25,@SM1018_26,newid(),@invnid,@punqid,(select sm1018_18 from sm1018 where unqid=@unqid),@invvoiceamt,@co_9,@invnbalance,@acname, dbo.onlydate(@CRNDATE))

	update invn set in_11=@invnbalance-(select sm1018_18 from sm1018 where unqid=@unqid) where in_5=@invoice

	IF(SELECT SM1018_8 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID)='Goods Return'
	BEGIN
	
	INSERT INTO SM1014 
       SELECT GETDATE() AS SM1014_1,GETDATE() AS SM1014_2,SM1018_3 AS SM1014_3,NEWID() AS SM1014_4,
       SM1018_26 AS SM1014_5 ,SM1018_24 AS SM1014_6,SM1018_19  AS SM1014_7,SM1011_40 AS SM1014_8,SM1011_39 AS SM1014_9,SM1011_13 AS SM1014_10,SM1011_21 AS SM1014_11,
       SM1018_5 AS SM1014_12,(select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(sm1014.sM1014_13 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1  from dbo.SM1014 WHERE SM1014_7=SM1018_19),
       CAST(SM1018_21 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) AS SM1014_14,'' AS SM1014_15,SM1018_8 AS SM1014_16,'GE' AS SM1014_17,SM1008_C3 AS SM1014_18
       FROM SM1018 INNER JOIN SM1011 ON SM1011.UNQID=SM1018_23 INNER JOIN SM1008_C ON SM1008_C1=SM1011_8 WHERE SM1018.UNQID=@UNQID
    END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	RETURN
	END

	END

	if @what ='Branch'
	begin
	select sm1002_5 as data,sm1002_7 as value from sm1002
	end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_DebitCreditNote]

    @SM1018_3            NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--USER 
    @unqid               UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',	--UNQID
    @SM1018_100          NVARCHAR(200) = '',	--SERVER IP
    @SM1018_4            DATETIME= '',			-- date
    @SM1018_5            NVARCHAR(50) = '',     -- INVOICE NUMBER
    @SM1018_6            NVARCHAR(50) = '',     -- CUSTOMER

    @SM1018_8			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		-- CASH DISCOUNT
    @SM1018_9			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',     --INCLUDE GST

    @SM1018_13			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--SGST
    @SM1018_14			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--CGST
    @SM1018_15			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--IGSTAmount
    @SM1018_16			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--SGSTAmount
    @SM1018_17			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--CGSTAmount
    @SM1018_18			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',		--TOTAL
	@sm1018_19			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',     -- Branch Id
	@sm1018_20			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',     --Vno
	@sm1018_21			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',     --qty
	@sm1018_22			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',     --Invoice Amount
	@sm1018_23           nvarchar(50) = '',     --parent id of 1011
    @outletcode			 NVARCHAR(100) = '',
    @gstnature			 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@branchid            nvarchar(50) ='',
	@WAREHOUSEUNQ        nvarchar(max)='',
	@BRANCH              nvarchar(max)='',
	@sm1018_28           NVARCHAR(MAX)='', -- IRN
    @sm1018_29           NVARCHAR(MAX)='',  --QR
    @sm1018_30           NVARCHAR(MAX)='',  --ACKNO
	@sm1018_31           NVARCHAR(MAX)='',  --ACKDATE
	@sm1018_32          NVARCHAR(MAX)='',   --JWTISSUIER
	@SM1018_33          nvarchar(max)='',   --SignedInv Einv
	@SM1018_34          nvarchar(max)='',   --Status Einv
	@SM1018_35          nvarchar(MAX) ='',  --QRPAth
	@fromdate			nvarchar(50)='',
	@todate				nvarchar(50)='',
	@branchunq			nvarchar(max)='',
	@sm1018_36          numeric(18,2)=0,       --cartage/freight
	@sm1018_37          numeric(18,2)=0 ,       --roundoff
	@sm1018_38          NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
									 
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @m3_1 NVARCHAR(10), @m3_2 NVARCHAR(30), @m3_3 NVARCHAR(20), @m3_4 NVARCHAR(36),
            @m3_5 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_6 NVARCHAR(50), @m3_7 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_8 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @m3_9 NVARCHAR(20), @m3_10 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_11 NVARCHAR(10), @m3_12 NVARCHAR(36),
            @m3_13 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_14 NVARCHAR(50), @m3_15 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_16 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @m3_17 NVARCHAR(MAX), @m3_18 NVARCHAR(36), @m3_19 NVARCHAR(30), @m3_20 NVARCHAR(36);

    IF @what = 'insert_data'
    BEGIN
	declare @uid as nvarchar(max)=newid();
	--declare @uid2 as nvarchar(max)='';
        -- Insert into SM1018 table
          INSERT INTO SM1018 (SM1018_1, SM1018_2, SM1018_3, UNQID, SM1018_100, SM1018_4, SM1018_5, SM1018_6, SM1018_7, SM1018_8, SM1018_9, SM1018_10, SM1018_11, SM1018_12, SM1018_13, SM1018_14, SM1018_15, SM1018_16, SM1018_17, SM1018_18,SM1018_19,SM1018_20,SM1018_21, SM1018_22, SM1018_23,sm1018_36,sm1018_37,sm1018_38)
        VALUES (GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM1018_3, @uid, @SM1018_100, @SM1018_4, @SM1018_5, @SM1018_6, @SM1018_7, @SM1018_8, @SM1018_9, @SM1018_10, @SM1018_11, @SM1018_12, @SM1018_13, @SM1018_14, @SM1018_15, @SM1018_16, @SM1018_17, @SM1018_18,@SM1018_19,@SM1018_20,@SM1018_21, @SM1018_22, @SM1018_23,@sm1018_36,@sm1018_37,@sm1018_38);
		--select unqid from sm1018 where sm1018_6=@SM1018_6
  --      -- Insert into m3 table for customer
		--set @uid2=newid();
  --      INSERT INTO m3
  --      SELECT (select ba_1 from Ba where ba_5='CREDIT NOTE'), SM1018_4,SM1018_20, SM1018_6,
		--('CREDIT NOTE') + ' ISSUED AGAINST ' + ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' @ ' + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') + ' AG SUPPLY OF ' + ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206  
  --       WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = @SM1018_23)), '') + ' VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + ' ' + 
  --       ' DT '+ ' ' + FORMAT(SM1018_7, 'dd/MM/yyyy'),
		--SM1018_18,'', '', 'CR', '', '', '', '', UNQID, '', '', '', @uid2, SM1018_4, dbo.getentrydate(),'', SM1018_3, SM1018_19, SM1018_100 
		--FROM SM1018 WHERE unqid = (select unqid from sm1018 where sm1018_6=@SM1018_6);

		 SELECT 
		    sm1018.sm1018_2 AS [Date],
			sm1002.sm1002_7 AS [Branch],
		    sm19.sm19_5 AS CustomerName,
		    sm1018.sm1018_8 AS CrNote,
		    sm1018.sm1018_5 AS [Prefix/InvNo],
		    sm1002.sm1002_18 + sm1018.sm1018_20 AS [Prefix/Vno],
		    sm1018.sm1018_10 AS Rate,
		    sm1018.sm1018_11 AS Taxable,
		    sm1018.sm1018_15 AS IGST,
		    sm1018.sm1018_17 AS SGST,
		    sm1018.sm1018_16 AS CGST,
		    sm1018.sm1018_21 AS Qty,
			--sm1002.sm1002_18 as Prefix,
		    sm1018.SM1018_18 AS Total
		FROM sm1018
		INNER JOIN sm19 ON sm1018.sm1018_6 = sm19.unqid
		INNER JOIN sm1002 ON sm1018.sm1018_19 = sm1002.sm1002_5
		--INNER JOIN sm1011 ON sm1018.sm1018_23 = sm1011.unqid 
		WHERE sm1018.sm1018_2 BETWEEN dbo.getformatteddate(@fromdate) AND dbo.getformatteddate(@todate)
		and sm1002_5 in(select data from dbo.split(@branchunq,',')) and sm1018_24 is not null
		order by [Branch],[DATE]
		 
	end

	if @WHAT='BranchBind'

	 --set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
		select SM1002_5 as UNQID, SM1002_7 as BRANCH from SM1002 
		--where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
		ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC;
	end
end

declare @unp nvarchar(50)=newid();
SELECT @OS= isnull(sum(in_11),0) from invn where in_12=@SM1008_6

SELECT @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT=sm19_57 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=@SM1008_6

SET @OD= (SELECT isnull(sum(in_11),0) from invn where in_12=@SM1008_6 AND IN_14<=GETDATE())

SET @BOD=(SELECT SM1016_35 AS QTY FROM SM1016 WHERE UNQID=@SM1008_31)-(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(SM1008_10),0.00) + @SM1008_10 FROM SM1008 WHERE SM1008_31=@SM1008_31) 

SET @TEMPCL= (SELECT isnull(sum(SM1021_7),0) from SM1021 where SM1021_5=@SM1008_6 AND SM1021_9>=dbo.onlydate(GETDATE()))
--SELECT @ORDERVALUE=(@SM1008_10 * (CASE WHEN @SM1008_12 = 0.00 THEN sm1016_17 ELSE SM1016_16 END) )FROM SM1016 WHERE UNQID=@uid
SET @ORDERVALUE=cast(@SM1008_10 as numeric(18,2)) * cast(@SM1008_12 as numeric(18,2))

SET @SM1008_15=(select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(SM1008.SM1008_15 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1 as GRNo from dbo.SM1008 WHERE SM1008_24=@SM1008_24 AND SM1008_26=@SM1008_26)
--IF @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT+@TEMPCL-@ORDERVALUE-@OS > 0 AND @OD<0 AND @BOD >= 0 
DECLARE @REASON NVARCHAR(MAX)=''

BEGIN

 IF @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT+@TEMPCL-@ORDERVALUE-@OS  < 0 AND @OD>0 AND @BOD < 0 

 BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO CL,DUE TO OVER DUE,DUE TO QTY'
  END
  ELSE IF  @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT+@TEMPCL-@ORDERVALUE-@OS  < 0 AND @OD>0 
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO CL,DUE TO OVER DUE'
  END
    ELSE IF  @OD>0 AND @BOD < 0 
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO OVER DUE,DUE TO QTY'
  END
   ELSE IF  @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT+@TEMPCL-@ORDERVALUE-@OS  < 0 AND @BOD < 0 
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO CL,DUE TO QTY'
  END

   ELSE IF  @PERMANENTCREDITLIMIT+@TEMPCL-@ORDERVALUE-@OS  < 0
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO CL'
  END

   ELSE IF  @BOD < 0 
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO QTY'
  END

   ELSE IF @OD > 0  
  BEGIN
   SET @REASON='DUE TO OVER DUE'
  END

  if @SM1008_30='0'
		begin
		 set @SM1008_30='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		 end

 INSERT INTO SM1008(SM1008_1, SM1008_2, SM1008_3, unqid, SM1008_100, SM1008_5, SM1008_6,SM1008_8, SM1008_10, SM1008_11, SM1008_12, SM1008_13, SM1008_17, SM1008_15, SM1008_14, SM1008_18,SM1008_19, SM1008_25, SM1008_22, SM1008_23, SM1008_24,SM1008_26,SM1008_27,SM1008_28,Sm1008_29,sm1008_30, SM1008_31, SM1008_32, SM1008_33,SM1008_34,SM1008_35)
VALUES (GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM1008_3,@unp, @SM1008_100, @SM1008_5,@SM1008_6,@SM1008_8, @SM1008_10, @SM1008_11, @SM1008_12,@SM1008_13, @SM1008_17, @SM1008_15, @SM1008_14, @SM1008_18,@SM1008_19, @SM1008_25, @SM1008_22, @SM1008_23, @SM1008_24,@SM1008_26,@SM1008_27,@SM1008_28,@sm1008_29,@SM1008_30,@SM1008_31, @SM1008_32, GETDATE(),'Pending',@REASON);

select @unp as ERR
END

END

	WITH SaleSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        sm1008_c3,
        SUM(sm1008_c4) AS total_saleqty
    FROM SM1008_C
    GROUP BY sm1008_c3
)

SELECT 
    SM1005.SM1005_4 AS unqid,
    SM19.sm19_5,
    CAST(SM1005.sm1005_57 * 1000 AS numeric(18, 0)) AS sm1005_19,
    SM206.sm206_7,
    SM1005.SM1005_17,
    CONVERT(varchar, SM1005.SM1005_6, 105) AS SM1005_18,
    ISNULL(SaleSummary.total_saleqty, 0) AS saleqty,
    ISNULL(
        CAST(SM1005.sm1005_57 * 1000 AS numeric(18, 0)) - ISNULL(SaleSummary.total_saleqty, 0),
        CAST(SM1005.sm1005_57 * 1000 AS numeric(18, 0))
    ) AS remaining_qty,
    SM1008_C.sm1008_c4 AS challanqty
FROM 
    SM1005
INNER JOIN 
    SM19 ON SM1005.SM1005_11 = SM19.unqid
INNER JOIN 
    SM206 ON SM1005.SM1005_10 = SM206.SM206_2
INNER JOIN 
    SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3
    AND SM1008_C.sm1008_c1 = @unqid
LEFT JOIN 
    SaleSummary ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SaleSummary.sm1008_c3
ORDER BY 
    SM1005.SM1005_6 ASC, SM1008_C.sm1008_c4
	
	
   --select unqid, sm1016_5 as bookingorder from sm1016 ORDER BY SM1016_5

    FROM SM1005 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM1005.SM1005_11 = SM19.unqid INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM1005.SM1005_10 = SM206.SM206_2 left JOIN 
    SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3

	union all

    Select SM1005.sm1005_4 as unqid ,sm19_5,cast(sm1005_57*1000 as numeric(18,0))  as sm1005_19 ,sm206_7,SM1005_17,convert (varchar ,SM1005_6 ,105) as SM1005_18, 
    0 AS remaining_qty,SM1005_6 from SM1005 inner join SM19 
	on SM1005.SM1005_11=SM19.unqid inner join sm206 on sm1005.sm1005_10=sm206.sm206_2 left JOIN 
    SM1008_C ON SM1005.SM1005_4 = SM1008_C.sm1008_c3

    WHEN SM1014_17 = 'GE' THEN SM1014_14 *(CASE WHEN SM1014_15<>'' THEN CAST(SM1014_15 AS NUMERIC(18,2))/100 ELSE 1 END) END) AS numeric(15, 0)) as sm1005_19 ,

begin


SELECT CUSTOMERUNQ,
--FORMAT(cast(SUM(ORDERVALUE)as numeric(18,2)),'N2','en-IN')AS ORDERVALUE,
FORMAT(SUM(DUEAMOUNT), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALDUEAMT,
FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT,'N2','en-IN')as CREDITLIMIT ,
MAX(OVERDUEDAYS) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
--FORMAT(SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
--FORMAT((CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)),'N2','en-IN') AS CLavailable
FORMAT(SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
 CASE 
        WHEN (CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)) > 0 
        THEN FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN')
        ELSE '0.00'
    END AS CLavailable

FROM (

        SELECT SM19.UNQID AS CUSTOMERUNQ,  ISNULL((case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end),0.00) AS DUEAMT,
		SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT ,
		
		ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(GETDATE()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00) AS DUEAMOUNT,
        ISNULL((case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()) end) ,0) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
		ISNULL(IN_11,0.00) AS TOTALOUTSTANDING 
		FROM SM19 LEFT OUTER JOIN INVN ON SM19.UNQID=INVN.IN_12
        WHERE ISNULL(IN_7,'OO') = 'OO' and  ISNULL(in_11,1)<>0  and SM19.UNQID=@sm1008_6   --and sm1016_c28 <>''
) a  

GROUP BY CUSTOMERUNQ,CREDITLIMIT
end
ELSE

		 BEGIN
		SELECT SM19.UNQID AS CUSTOMERUNQ,
0 AS TOTALDUEAMT,
SM19_57 as CREDITLIMIT ,
0 AS OVERDUEDAYS,
0 AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
FORMAT((SM19_57),'N2','en-IN') AS CLavailable
		FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.UNQID=@sm1008_6
		 END

IN_11 AS DUEAMOUNT, (SELECT TOP 1(case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, GETDATE()) end)) AS OVERDUEDAYS
FROM INVN INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=INVN.IN_12
WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(GETDATE()) and IN_7 = 'OO'  and in_11<>0.00


end

		BEGIN
			--DELETE FROM SM206_C WHERE SM206_C6=@sm206_C6
			DECLARE @CHECK NVARCHAR(50)='';
			--DECLARE @UNQID NVARCHAR(50)='';
	
			SET @CHECK=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM1009 WHERE sm1009_6=@sm1009_6)
			IF(@CHECK>0)
			BEGIN
	     			PRINT '0'
					--SET  @UNQID = NEWID()
					--INSERT INTO sm1009 values(dbo.entrydate(),@UNQID,@sm1009_3,@sm1009_4,getdate(),@sm1009_6,@SM1009_7)

					--select @UNQID as PUNQID from sm1009

				INSERT INTO SM1009_C VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@sm1009_C3,@sm1009_C4,getdate(),(SELECT top 1 unqid FROM SM1009 WHERE sm1009_6=@sm1009_6),@sm1009_C7,@SM1009_C8,@SM1009_C9)
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN 
			PRINT '1'

			SET  @UNQID = NEWID()
					INSERT INTO sm1009 values(dbo.entrydate(),@UNQID,@sm1009_3,@sm1009_4,getdate(),@sm1009_6,@SM1009_7)

			 INSERT INTO SM1009_C VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@sm1009_C3,@sm1009_C4,getdate(),@UNQID,@sm1009_C7,@SM1009_C8,@sm1009_C9)
			 select @UNQID as PUNQID from sm1009
			END
	
		END

		IF @AA='INSERT_CHILD'
		BEGIN
		if @SM1008_C4=''
		begin
		 set @SM1008_C4=0
		 end
		  INSERT INTO dbo.SM1008_C(SM1008_c1,SM1008_c2,SM1008_c3,SM1008_c4,SM1008_C5)
		  VALUES(@SM1008_C1,newid(),@SM1008_C3,@SM1008_C4,@SM1008_C5)
		   SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
		   
		END



END

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_DISCOUNT_BASE_ON_QTY]
@what		    nvarchar(50)='',
@Name		    nvarchar(20)='',
@SM_402_1       datetime='',		  ----enter date
@SM_402_2       datetime='',          ----modify date
@SM_402_3		nvarchar(20)='',      ----ip
@unqid		    uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM_402_100		nvarchar(20)='',      ----user id
@SM_402_4       datetime='',          ----FORMDATE
@SM_402_5       datetime='',          ----TODATE
@SM_402_6		nvarchar(max)='',     ----DISCOUNT
@SM_402_7		nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----PRODUCT
@SM_402_8		nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----Customer
@SM_402_9       nvarchar(max)='',     ----supplier name
@SM_402_10      nvarchar(max)='',     ----discount in
@SM_402_C1        datetime='',		  ----enter date
@SM_402_C2        datetime='',          ----modify date
@SM_402_C3		  nvarchar(20)='',      ----ip
@unqid_C		  uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM_402_C100	  nvarchar(20)='',      ----user id
@SM_402_C4        nvarchar(100)='',		----PARENT UNQID
@SM_402_C5        nvarchar(100)='',		----FORM QTY
@SM_402_C6		  nvarchar(100)='',		----TO QTY
@SM_402_C7		  nvarchar(MAX)='',     ----AMOUNT/PER		
@SM_402_C8		  nvarchar(MAX)='',		----AMOUNT OR RATE
@UNQID1			  nvarchar(40)='',
@txtsearch        nvarchar(max)=''
AS
begin
	IF @what = 'BIND'
	begin 
		--Product TABLE0
		select SM206_2 as unqid, SM206_7 as Product from SM206 ORDER BY SM206_7 ASC
		-- Customer TABLE 1
		select UNQID,SM19_5 AS CUSTNAME from sm19 where sm19_11='CUST' ORDER BY  SM19_5 ASC		  
		-- Supplier Name TABLE 2
		select UNQID,SM19_5 AS SUPPLNAME from sm19 where sm19_11='SUPPL' ORDER BY  SM19_5 ASC
		--Todate TABLE 3
		select convert(varchar ,getdate() ,105) as todate
		--Discount Name TABLE 4
		SELECT  SM1025_2 AS DId, SM1025_6 AS DName FROM sm1025 ORDER BY SM1025_6 asc
	end

	IF @what = 'insert'
	BEGIN
	set @unqid = newid();
        INSERT INTO SM_402 
		VALUES (dbo.entrydate(), dbo.entrydate(), @SM_402_3, @unqid, @SM_402_100,  @SM_402_4, @SM_402_5, @SM_402_6, @SM_402_7, @SM_402_8, @SM_402_9, @SM_402_10);
		select @unqid as err;
		
	END

	IF @what = 'INSERT_CHILD'
	BEGIN
		SET @UNQID1 = NEWID()
		INSERT INTO SM_402_C 
		VALUES (dbo.entrydate(), dbo.entrydate(), @SM_402_C3, @UNQID1, @SM_402_C100, @SM_402_C4, @SM_402_C5, @SM_402_C6, @SM_402_C7, @SM_402_C8);
	END

	if @what='grid_R'
	Begin
		select unqid, convert (varchar ,SM_402_4,105) AS SM_402_4, convert (varchar ,SM_402_5,105) AS SM_402_5,
		(select sm1025_6 from sm1025 where sm1025_2=SM_402_6) as SM_402_6,
		(SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=SM_402_7) AS SM_402_7,
		(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm_402_8)as custname,(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm_402_9)as suppliname 
		from SM_402
	end
				
	iF @what ='delete_data'
	Begin
	   -- insert into sm_402_log select * from sm_402 WHERE unqid= @unqid
		DELETE from SM_402 WHERE unqid= @unqid
	--	insert into sm_402_c_log select * from sm_402_c WHERE SM_402_C4= @unqid
		DELETE from SM_402_C where SM_402_C4 = @unqid
	End

	iF @what ='delete'
	Begin
	--insert into sm_402_c_log select * from sm_402_c WHERE SM_402_C4= @unqid
		DELETE from SM_402_C where SM_402_C4 = @unqid
	End

	IF @what = 'Edit_box'
		begin
		SELECT convert(varchar ,SM_402_4, 105)  as SM_402_4, convert(varchar ,SM_402_5, 105) as SM_402_5 ,SM_402_6,SM_402_7,sm_402_8 AS CUSTNAME,SM_402_9 as SUPPLINAME,SM_402_10 FROM sm_402 WHERE unqid = @unqid;	
		SELECT unqid ,SM_402_C5,SM_402_C6 ,SM_402_C7,SM_402_C8 FROM sm_402_c WHERE SM_402_C4 = @unqid;		
	end
	    
	IF @what = 'UpdataMM'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM_402 SET SM_402_4 = @SM_402_4, SM_402_5 = @SM_402_5, SM_402_6 = @SM_402_6, SM_402_7 = @SM_402_7, SM_402_8 = @SM_402_8, SM_402_9 = @SM_402_9, SM_402_10 = @SM_402_10 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
	END

	if @what ='Updata_Child'
	begin		
		INSERT INTO SM_402_C 
		VALUES (dbo.entrydate(), dbo.entrydate(), @SM_402_C3, @UNQID, @SM_402_C100, @SM_402_C4, @SM_402_C5, @SM_402_C6, @SM_402_C7, @SM_402_C8);
	end

	IF @WHAT='search'
    BEGIN
		select sm_402.unqid, convert (varchar ,SM_402_4,105) AS SM_402_4, convert (varchar ,SM_402_5,105) AS SM_402_5,SM206_7  AS SM_402_7,cust.sm19_5 as custname,suppl.sm19_5 as suppliname,sm1025_6 as SM_402_6 from sm_402 inner join sm206 
		on sm206.sm206_2=SM_402_7 inner join sm19 as cust on cust.unqid=sm_402.SM_402_8  inner join sm19 as suppl on suppl.unqid=sm_402.SM_402_9 inner join sm1025 on sm_402.SM_402_6=sm1025.sm1025_2  where sm206_7 like '%'+@txtsearch+'%'
		   
    END			
END

---------------

GO
