CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_DISCOUNTMASTER_AMT]
@what			nvarchar(50)='',
@Name			nvarchar(20)='',
@sm_401_1      datetime='',		  ----enter date
@sm_401_2       datetime='',          ----modify date
@sm_401_3 		nvarchar(100)='',      ----ip
@sm_401_4 		nvarchar(20)='',      ----user id
@sm_401_5		uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@sm_401_6  		nvarchar(40)='',      ----fromdate
@sm_401_7  	    nvarchar(40)='',      ----todate
@sm_401_8       nvarchar(50)='',     ----Mfg
@sm_401_9  	    nvarchar(50)='',     ----Discounttype
@sm_401_10  	nvarchar(50)='',     ----State 
@sm_401_12      nvarchar(50)='',     ---discount in
---------------------------------child--------------------------------------------
@sm_401_c_1		nvarchar(max)='',			--ENTRY DATE
@sm_401_c_2		NVARCHAR(50)='',	    --UNQID CHILD
@sm_401_c_3		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--USERID
@sm_401_c_4		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--IPADDRESS
@sm_401_c_5		DATETIME='',			--MODIFYDATE
@sm_401_c_6		NVARCHAR(max)='',		--PARENT UNQID
@sm_401_c_7		NVARCHAR(max)='',		--product
@sm_401_c_8      NVARCHAR(max)='',			--ammount  
@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@sm205_8        nvarchar(50) ='',
@SM206_C7			NVARCHAR(50)='',
@sm_401_11      nvarchar(max)='' ,      --customer name	
@unqid          nvarchar(max)=''
AS
Begin
DECLARE @new_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();

IF @what = 'insert'
BEGIN
if  @sm_401_10='0'
begin
set @sm_401_10='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
end
if  @sm_401_11='' or @sm_401_11='0'
begin
set @sm_401_11='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
end
    INSERT INTO sm_401(sm_401_1, sm_401_2, sm_401_3, sm_401_4, sm_401_5, sm_401_6, sm_401_7, sm_401_8, sm_401_9, sm_401_10,sm_401_11,sm_401_12)
    VALUES (GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @sm_401_3, @sm_401_4, @new_id, @sm_401_6, @sm_401_7, @sm_401_8, @sm_401_9, @sm_401_10,@sm_401_11,@sm_401_12);
    SELECT @new_id AS ParentID; 
END



IF @what = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN
    IF @sm_401_c_8 = ''
        SET @sm_401_c_8 = '0';

    INSERT INTO sm_401_C (sm_401_c_1,sm_401_c_2,sm_401_c_3,sm_401_c_4,sm_401_c_5,sm_401_c_6,sm_401_c_7,sm_401_c_8  
)
    VALUES (dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@sm_401_c_3,@sm_401_c_4,GETDATE(),@sm_401_c_6, @sm_401_c_7,@sm_401_c_8
    );
END




  if @what='Manufacure'
  begin
 select UNQID as data,SM113_6 as value from SM113 order by SM113_6 asc
  end

IF @what = 'state'
BEGIN
    SELECT  UNQID AS SId, SM205_5 AS SName FROM SM205 ORDER BY SM205_5

	 select UNQID,SM19_5 AS CUSTNAME from sm19 where sm19_11='CUST' ORDER BY  SM19_5 ASC
END

IF @what = 'discount'
BEGIN
    SELECT  SM1025_2 AS DId, SM1025_6 AS DName FROM sm1025 ORDER BY SM1025_6 asc
END

IF @what = 'productamt'
BEGIN
select sm206_2 as pid, sm206_7 as product from sm206 inner join sm206_c on sm206_2 =SM206_C6 where SM206_C7=@SM206_C7 ORDER BY sm206_7 ASC
END
end
 
 if @what='grid_R'
Begin
select sm_401_5,(select SM113_6 from sm113 where unqid=sm_401_8) as MFG,
(select sm1025_6 from sm1025 where sm1025_2=sm_401_9) as discountype,
(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm_401_11)as custname from sm_401
end

if @what = 'Search'
begin
select sm_401_5,(select SM113_6 from sm113 where unqid=sm_401_8) as MFG,sm_401_9 as discountype from sm_401 where sm_401_8 like '%'+@sm_401_8+'%'
end

iF @what ='DELETEDATA'
Begin		
drop table sm_401_log
drop table sm_401_c_log
select  * into sm_401_log from sm_401 WHERE sm_401_5= @sm_401_5
DELETE from sm_401 WHERE sm_401_5= @sm_401_5
select  * into sm_401_c_log from sm_401_c where sm_401_c_6 = @sm_401_5
DELETE from sm_401_c where sm_401_c_6 = @sm_401_5

select 'deleted successfully' as err
End

IF @what = 'Edit_box'
begin
SELECT CONVERT(varchar, sm_401_6, 105) as sm_401_6 ,CONVERT(varchar, sm_401_7, 105) as sm_401_7,sm_401_8,(select sm1025_6 from sm1025 where sm1025_2=sm_401_9) as sm_401_9,sm_401_10,sm_401_11 as custname,sm_401_12 as dicount FROM sm_401 WHERE sm_401_5 = @sm_401_5;	
--SELECT sm_401_c_7 as pid,(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=sm_401_c_7) as product,sm_401_c_8 as sm_401_c_8  FROM sm_401_c WHERE sm_401_c_6 = @sm_401_5 ORDER BY product ASC;		
set @sm_401_8 = (select sm_401_8 from sm_401 where sm_401_5=@sm_401_5)
 SELECT 
  a.pid,
  a.product,
  isnull(sm_401_c.sm_401_c_8,0) as sm_401_c_8
FROM (
  SELECT 
    sm206_2 AS pid, 
    sm206_7 AS product 
  FROM 
    sm206 
    INNER JOIN sm206_c ON sm206_2 = sm206_c6 
  WHERE 
    sm206_c7 = @sm_401_8
) AS a
LEFT JOIN sm_401_c ON sm_401_c_7 = a.pid AND sm_401_c_6 = @sm_401_5
LEFT JOIN sm_401 ON sm_401_5 = sm_401_c_6
order by product;

end
		
IF @what = 'delete'
BEGIN
	delete from SM_401_C where sm_401_c_6 = @unqid
END


IF @what = 'UpdataMM'
BEGIN
UPDATE SM_401 
SET 
  sm_401_6 = dbo.getformatteddate(@sm_401_6),
  sm_401_7 = dbo.getformatteddate(@sm_401_7),
  SM_401_8 = @sm_401_8,
  sm_401_9 = @sm_401_9,
  sm_401_10 = @sm_401_10,
  sm_401_11 = @sm_401_11 ,
  sm_401_12 = @sm_401_12 
WHERE SM_401_5 = @unqid;

END

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_FREIGHT_RATE_MASTER]
@what			nvarchar(50)='',
@Name			nvarchar(20)='',
@sm_400_1       datetime='',		  ----enter date
@sm_400_2       datetime='',          ----modify date
@sm_400_3 		nvarchar(50)='',      ----ip
@sm_400_4 		nvarchar(50)='',      ----user id
@sm_400_5		NVARCHAR(50)='',   ----unqid
@sm_400_6		datetime='',       ----FROMDATE
@sm_400_7 	    datetime='',       ----TODATE
@sm_400_8       nvarchar(50)='',     ----NAME OF TRANSPORTER
@sm_400_9  	    nvarchar(50)='',     ----VEHICLE TYPE
@sm_400_10	    nvarchar(50)='',     ----WHEEL TYPE   
@sm_400_11	    nvarchar(50)='',     ----PRODUCT
@sm_400_12      nvarchar(50)='',      ----QTY 
@sm_400_13      nvarchar(20)='',      ----FUEL TYPE
@sm_400_14      nvarchar(50)='',     ----FUEL RATE 
---------------------------------child--------------------------------------------
@sm_400_c_1		nvarchar(max)='',			--ENTRY DATE
@sm_400_c_2		NVARCHAR(50)='',	    --UNQID CHILD
@sm_400_c_3		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--USERID
@sm_400_c_4		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--IPADDRESS
@sm_400_c_5		DATETIME='',			--MODIFYDATE
@sm_400_c_6		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--PARENT UNQID
@sm_400_c_7		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--from destination
@sm_400_c_8      NVARCHAR(50)='',			--to destination
@sm_400_c_9      NVARCHAR(50)='',			--Fuel use
@sm_400_c_10      NVARCHAR(50)='',			--Rate per mt single 
@sm_400_c_11    NVARCHAR(50)='',			--Rate per mt multi
@punqid nvarchar(50)='',
@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@custid as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(50) ='',
@suppid as nvarchar(max)='',
@sm1005_6 as nvarchar(50)='',
@sm1005_73 AS NVARCHAR(50)=''  
AS
                                               
if @what = 'insert'
BEGIN 

set @punqid=newid();
			
INSERT INTO sm_400 values(getdate(),getdate(),@sm_400_3,@sm_400_4,@punqid,CONVERT(DATETIME, @sm_400_6, 103),CONVERT(DATETIME, @sm_400_7, 103),@sm_400_8,@sm_400_9,@sm_400_10,@sm_400_11,@sm_400_12,@sm_400_13,@sm_400_14)

select @punqid as err;
		
END

if @what='FreightAmt'

begin
if @custid<>'0'
begin
set @sm_400_c_8=(select sm19_15 from sm19 where unqid=@custid)
end                                                
else
begin
set @sm_400_c_8=(select sm1002_11 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=@branchid)
end
set @sm_400_c_7=@suppid
select sm_400_c_10 from sm_400_C inner join sm_400 on sm_400_c_6=sm_400_5 where dbo.getformatteddate(@sm1005_6) between sm_400_6 and case when sm_400_7='' then sm_400_6 else sm_400_7 end 
and sm_400_c_7=@sm_400_c_7 and sm_400_c_8=@sm_400_c_8
end

if @what='FreightAmtMULTI'
begin
if @custid<>'0'
begin
set @sm_400_c_8=(select sm19_15 from sm19 where unqid=@custid)
end                                                
else
begin
set @sm_400_c_8=(select sm1002_11 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=@branchid)
end
set @sm_400_c_7=@suppid
select sm_400_c_11 from sm_400_C inner join sm_400 on sm_400_c_6=sm_400_5 where dbo.getformatteddate(@sm1005_6) between sm_400_6 and case when sm_400_7='' then sm_400_6 else sm_400_7 end 
and sm_400_c_7=@sm_400_c_7 and sm_400_c_8=@sm_400_c_8
end

IF @what = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN	
if @sm_400_c_9 =''
begin
set @sm_400_c_9='0'
end

if @sm_400_c_10 =''
begin
set @sm_400_c_10='0'
end

if @sm_400_c_11 =''
begin
set @sm_400_c_11='0'
end
INSERT INTO sm_400_C VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@sm_400_c_3,@sm_400_c_4,getdate(),@sm_400_c_6,(select top 1 unqid from sm01 where sm1_5=@sm_400_c_7),(select top 1 unqid from sm01 where sm1_5=@sm_400_c_8),@sm_400_c_9,@sm_400_c_10,@sm_400_c_11)
END

IF @what ='TRANSPORTER'
begin
SELECT UNQID AS DATA,SM19_5 AS VALUE FROM SM19 where sm19_11='TRANS' order by SM19_5 asc
end

IF @WHAT ='PRODUCT'
BEGIN
SELECT SM206_2 AS DATA ,SM206_7 AS VALUE FROM SM206 order by SM206_7 asc
END


IF @what = 'destination'
begin    
select unqid AS DATA, sm1_5 as VALUE from sm01  order by sm1_5
end

if @what='grid_R'
Begin
select sm_400_5,(select SM19_5 FROM SM19 where UNQID=sm_400_8) as Transporter,(select SM206_7 from SM206 where SM206_2=sm_400_11) as Product,
sm_400_12 as Qty from sm_400
end

IF @what = 'Edit_box'
begin
SELECT CONVERT(varchar, sm_400_6, 105) as sm_400_6 ,CONVERT(varchar, sm_400_7, 105) as sm_400_7,sm_400_8,sm_400_9,sm_400_10,sm_400_11,sm_400_12,sm_400_13,sm_400_14 FROM sm_400 WHERE sm_400_5 = @sm_400_5;	
SELECT(select sm1_5 from sm01 where unqid=sm_400_c_7) as sm_400_c_7,(select sm1_5 from sm01 where unqid=sm_400_c_8)as sm_400_c_8 ,sm_400_c_9,sm_400_c_10,sm_400_c_11 FROM sm_400_c WHERE sm_400_c_6 = @sm_400_5;		
end


iF @what ='DELETEDATA'
Begin		
DELETE from sm_400 WHERE sm_400_5= @sm_400_5
DELETE from sm_400_c where sm_400_c_6 = @sm_400_5 

select 'deleted successfully' as err
End

if @what = 'Search'
begin
 select sm_400_5,(select SM19_5 FROM SM19 where UNQID=sm_400_8) as Transporter,(select SM206_7 from SM206 where SM206_2=sm_400_11) as Product,
sm_400_12 as Qty from sm_400 where sm_400_12 like '%'+@sm_400_12+'%'
end

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_FreightCartageMaster]	
    @what            NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @SM1015_1        DATETIME = '',
    @SM1015_2        DATETIME = '',
    @SM1015_3        NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @unqid           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    @SM1015_100      NVARCHAR(200) = '',
    @SM1015_5        NVARCHAR(50) = '',         -- Description
    @SM1015_6        NVARCHAR(50) = '',         -- A/C head
    @SM1015_7        NVARCHAR(50) = '',         -- GST Master
    @SM1015_8        NVARCHAR(50) = '',         -- Rate
    @SM1015_9		 NVARCHAR(50) = ''			-- Ward


AS
BEGIN
	IF @what ='grid_R'
	begin
	    SELECT SM1015.unqid as unqid, sm1015_5, (select sm19_6 from sm19 where unqid=SM1015_6) as SM1015_6,(select sm210_7 from sm210 where unqid=SM1015_7) as SM1015_7,SM1015_8 from SM1015	
	end
	
	if @what ='delete_data'
	Begin
	    DELETE from sm1015 WHERE unqid= @unqid 
	End

	if @what ='FC_Droplist'
	Begin
		--A/c Head Name
		select unqid, sm19_6 as ACHead from sm19 
		--GST(good serives tax)
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS GST from sm210
	End
	IF @what = 'FCSava_data'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM1015]( SM1015_1, SM1015_2, SM1015_3, UNQID, SM1015_100, SM1015_5, SM1015_6, SM1015_7, SM1015_8, SM1015_9)
		VALUES ( GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM1015_3, NEWID(), @SM1015_100, @SM1015_5, @SM1015_6, @SM1015_7, @SM1015_8, @SM1015_9);
	END

	IF @what ='FCEdit_box'
	BEGIN
	SELECT SM1015_5, SM1015_6, SM1015_7, SM1015_8, SM1015_9 FROM SM1015 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
	END

	IF @what = 'FCUpdate_Data'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM1015 SET SM1015_5 = @SM1015_5, SM1015_6 = @SM1015_6, SM1015_7 = @SM1015_7, SM1015_8 = @SM1015_8,SM1015_9 = @SM1015_9 WHERE unqid =  @unqid
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_GITB]

@what           	Nvarchar(50)='',       
@SM1012_1     		datetime='',											---enter date
@SM1012_2     		datetime='',											----modify date
@SM1012_3 		nvarchar(20)='',											----used ip
@unqid 			uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----user id
@SM1012_100		nvarchar(50)='',											----server ip	
@SM1012_5		nvarchar(50)='',										    ----Date of Recept
@SM1012_6		nvarchar(50)='',										    ----Number
@SM1012_7		nvarchar(50)='',											----GITB(Good issue to branch addMOde)
@SM1012_8		uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',   	----unqid
@SM1012_9		nvarchar(50)='',											----Debit to
@SM1012_10		nvarchar(50)='',											----Name Branch
@SM1012_11		nvarchar(50)='',											----Challan Date
@SM1012_12		nvarchar(50)='',											----Challan Number
@SM1012_13		nvarchar(50)='',											----Challen OTY
@SM1012_14		nvarchar(50)='',											----unit
@SM1012_15		nvarchar(50)='',											----GR no
@SM1012_16		nvarchar(50)='',											----GR Date
@SM1012_17		Numeric(18,2)='0',											----GR QTY
@SM1012_18		nvarchar(50)='',											----Strength
@SM1012_19		Numeric(18,2)='0',											----Issue Quantity
@SM1012_20		nvarchar(50)='',											----Unit
@SM1012_21		nvarchar(50)='',											----Remarks
@SM1012_22		nvarchar(50)='', 										   	----Warehouse
@SM1012_23      nvarchar(50)='',											----Loction
@branchid        nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1012_24           NVARCHAR(50)=''
AS
BEGIN

	if @what='PBU2_droplist'
	Begin
	--Product Name
	 	 select sm206_2 , sm206_7 as ProductN from sm206 
	--Name Branch
     		 select sm1002_5, sm1002_7 AS Nbranch from sm1002 ORDER BY sm1002_7
	--unit1 CODE  
	 	 select unqid ,  sm209_7 as unit from sm209
	--unit2
	  	select unqid ,  sm209_7 as unit2 from sm209
	--Warehouse 
	 	 select unqid , SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from sm1006 where sm1006_13=@branchid ORDER BY sm1006_5 desc
	--location
	 	select sm1006_c7 as loction,unqid as VALUE FROM SM1006_c
	END

	IF @what = 'Sava_data'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM1012]( SM1012_1, SM1012_2, SM1012_3, UNQID, SM1012_100, SM1012_5, SM1012_6, SM1012_7, SM1012_8, SM1012_9, SM1012_10, 		SM1012_11, SM1012_12, SM1012_13, SM1012_14, SM1012_15, SM1012_16, SM1012_17, SM1012_18, SM1012_19, SM1012_20,  SM1012_21,SM1012_22,SM1012_23,SM1012_24)
		VALUES ( GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM1012_3, NEWID(), @SM1012_100, CAST(@SM1012_5 AS DATETIME), @SM1012_6, @SM1012_7, @SM1012_8, @SM1012_9, 		@SM1012_10, CAST(@SM1012_11 AS DATETIME), @SM1012_12, @SM1012_13, @SM1012_14, @SM1012_15, CAST(@SM1012_16 AS DATETIME), @SM1012_17, 		@SM1012_18, @SM1012_19, @SM1012_20, @SM1012_21,@SM1012_22,@SM1012_23,@SM1012_24);
		SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
		exec dbo.A_SP_FOR_GSTOCK 'goodsissuetobranch', '', @SM1012_10, @SM1012_8, @SM1012_19, @SM1012_20, @SM1012_22, @SM1012_23,'','','','0.00'
	END

	if @what ='delete_data'
	Begin
	   DELETE from sm1012 WHERE unqid= @unqid 
	End
	
	IF @what ='grid_R'
	begin
 		Select  SM1012.unqid as unqid ,convert (varchar ,sm1012_5 ,105) as sm1012_5,sm1012_6,(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1012_8) as SM1012_8,(select sm1002_7 from sm1002 where sm1002_5=SM1012_10) as sm1012_10,sm1012_13 from sm1012
	end

	IF @what='BWLoction'
	BEGIN
		select sm1006_c7 as loction,unqid as VALUE FROM SM1006_c Where SM1006_C5=(select unqid from sm1006 where unqid=@SM1012_23)
	END

	
	IF @what ='Edit_box'
	BEGIN
	SELECT SM1012_5, SM1012_6, SM1012_7, SM1012_8, SM1012_9, SM1012_10,SM1012_11, SM1012_12, SM1012_13, SM1012_14, SM1012_15, SM1012_16, SM1012_17,
	SM1012_18, SM1012_19, SM1012_20, SM1012_22, SM1012_23, SM1012_21 FROM SM1012 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
	SELECT SM206_18 AS PRODSTRENGTH FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=(select SM1012_8  from sm1012 where unqid=@unqid)
	END

	IF @what = 'GITBUpdate_Data'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM1012 SET SM1012_5 = @SM1012_5, SM1012_6 = @SM1012_6, SM1012_7 = @SM1012_7, SM1012_8 = @SM1012_8,SM1012_9 = @SM1012_9, SM1012_10 = @SM1012_10 ,
		SM1012_11 = @SM1012_11, SM1012_14 = @SM1012_14, SM1012_12 = @SM1012_12,	SM1012_13 = @SM1012_13, SM1012_15 = @SM1012_15, SM1012_16 = @SM1012_16, SM1012_17 = @SM1012_17,
		SM1012_18 = @SM1012_18, SM1012_19 = @SM1012_19, SM1012_20 = @SM1012_20, SM1012_21 = @SM1012_21,	SM1012_22 = @SM1012_22, SM1012_23 = @SM1012_23 WHERE unqid =  @unqid
	END

	if @what='Product_Selection'
	BEGIN
		SELECT SM206_18 AS PRODSTRENGTH FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
		SELECT SM206_11 AS unqid, sm209_7 AS Unit FROM SM206 INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid=SM206.SM206_11 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
		SELECT SM206_11 AS unqid, sm209_7 AS Unit1 FROM SM206 INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid=SM206.SM206_11 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
		Select SM206_2 AS unqid, SM19_5 AS Debit from SM206 INNER JOIN sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm206.sm206_14 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
	END
	  IF @what='GET_GRNO'
	BEGIN
		select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(SM1012.SM1012_6 as numeric(18))),0)  + 1 as GRNo from dbo.SM1012 where sm1012_24=@branchid
	END	
END



GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_GOODS_RECEIPT_FROM_BRANCH]
@what				nvarchar(50)='',
@SM1013_1			DATETIME='',			---ENTRY DATE
@SM1013_2			DATETIME='',			---MODIFY DATE
@SM1013_3			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---USER
--@unqid		   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',	---UNIQUE ID
@unqid              nvarchar(50)='',		---UNIQUE ID
@SM1013_100			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---IP ADDRESS	
@SM1013_5			DATETIME='',		    ---DATE OF RECEIPT
@SM1013_6           NVARCHAR(50)='',        ---NUMBER
@SM1013_7           NVARCHAR(50)='',		---GRFB
---@SM1013_8	  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',	---PRODUCT NAME
@SM1013_8		    NVARCHAR(50)='',       --PRODUCT NAME
@SM1013_9			NVARCHAR(50)='',	    ---DEBIT NO
@SM1013_10			NVARCHAR(50)='', 		---BRANCH NAME
@SM1013_11			DATETIME='',			---CHALLAN DATE
@SM1013_12			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---CHALLAN NO
@SM1013_13			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---CHALLAN QUANTITY
@SM1013_14			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---UNIT
@SM1013_15			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---GR NO
@SM1013_16			DATETIME='',			---GR DATE
@SM1013_17			NUMERIC(18,3)='0',		---GR QTY
--@SM1013_18			NUMERIC(18,2)='0',		---STRENGTH
@SM1013_18          NVARCHAR(50)='',		---STRENGTH
@SM1013_19			NUMERIC(18,3)='0',		---RECEIPT QUANTITY
@SM1013_20			NVARCHAR(50)='',		---UNIT
@SM1013_21			NVARCHAR(MAX)='',		---REMARKS
@SM1013_22          NVARCHAR(50)='',		---WAREHOUSE 
@SM1013_23		    NVARCHAR(50)=''	,	    ---LOCATION
@branchid           NVARCHAR(50)='',
@SM1013_24           NVARCHAR(50)=''
AS
if @what='ALLBIND'
BEGIN
--Product Bind
select SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Productname from sm206 ORDER BY SM206_7
--Unit
select unqid , sm209_7 as Unit from sm209 ORDER BY sm209_7
select unqid , sm209_7 as Unit1 from sm209 ORDER BY sm209_7
--Branch
select sm1002_5 as unqid, sm1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 ORDER BY sm1002_7
--Warehouse 
select unqid, sm1006_5 as warehouse from SM1006 where sm1006_13 = @branchid ORDER BY sm1006_5 desc
--LOCATION
select unqid, SM1006_C7 as location from SM1006_C ORDER BY SM1006_C7
--Date
if (@unqid='')
BEGIN
SELECT CONVERT( NVARCHAR, GETDATE(),105) AS UNQ 
END
END

if @what='Warehouse_Selection'
BEGIN
select sm1006_c7 as location,unqid as VALUE FROM SM1006_c Where SM1006_C5=(select unqid from sm1006 where unqid=@SM1013_23)	
END

if @what='Product_Selection'
BEGIN
SELECT SM206_18 AS PRODSTRENGTH FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
--unit
SELECT sm206_11 AS unqid, sm209_7 AS Unit FROM SM206
INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid=SM206.SM206_11
WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
--unit1
SELECT SM206_11 AS unqid, sm209_7 AS Unit1 FROM SM206
INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.unqid=SM206.SM206_11
WHERE SM206_2=@unqid

--Select SM206_2 AS unqid, sm206_14 AS Debit from SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
Select SM206_2 AS unqid, SM19_5 AS Debit from SM206
INNER JOIN sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm206.sm206_14
 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
END

if @what='Save_Data'
BEGIN
insert into SM1013(SM1013_1, SM1013_2, SM1013_3, SM1013_100, unqid , SM1013_5, SM1013_6, SM1013_7, SM1013_8, SM1013_9, SM1013_10, SM1013_11, SM1013_12, SM1013_13, SM1013_14, SM1013_15,SM1013_16,
SM1013_17, SM1013_18, SM1013_19,SM1013_20, SM1013_21, SM1013_22, SM1013_23,SM1013_24)Values(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1013_3, @SM1013_100, NEWID(), @SM1013_5, @SM1013_6, @SM1013_7, @SM1013_8, @SM1013_9, @SM1013_10, @SM1013_11, 
@SM1013_12, @SM1013_13, @SM1013_14, @SM1013_15, @SM1013_16, @SM1013_17, @SM1013_18, @SM1013_19, @SM1013_20, @SM1013_21,@SM1013_22, @SM1013_23,@SM1013_24) 

SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;

exec dbo.A_SP_FOR_GSTOCK 'goodsreceiptfrombranch', '', @SM1013_10, @SM1013_8, @SM1013_19, @SM1013_20, @SM1013_22, @SM1013_23,'','','','0.00'
END

if @what='Grid_Bind'  
BEGIN
select unqid, CONVERT( VARCHAR, SM1013_5,105) AS SM1013_5, SM1013_6, SM206_7 AS PRODUCT, SM1002_7 AS BRANCH , sm1013_13 from sm1013 
INNER JOIN sm206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1013.SM1013_8
INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1013.SM1013_10
END

if @what='Get_Data'  ----Edit time Bind
BEGIN
select unqid, SM1013_5, SM1013_6, SM1013_7, SM1013_8, SM1013_9, SM1013_10, SM1013_11, SM1013_12, SM1013_13, SM1013_14, 
SM1013_15, SM1013_16, SM1013_17, SM1013_18, SM1013_19, SM1013_20, SM1013_21, SM1013_22, SM1013_23 from sm1013 where unqid=@unqid

SELECT SM206_18 AS PRODSTRENGTH FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=(select SM1013_8  from sm1013 where unqid=@unqid)
END

if @what='Update_Data'
BEGIN
update SM1013 set SM1013_5=@SM1013_5, SM1013_6=@SM1013_6, SM1013_7=@SM1013_7, sm1013_8=@SM1013_8, sm1013_9=@SM1013_9,sm1013_10=@SM1013_10,sm1013_11=@SM1013_11,SM1013_12=@SM1013_12,
SM1013_13=@SM1013_13,sm1013_14=@SM1013_14, sm1013_15=@SM1013_15,sm1013_16=@SM1013_16, sm1013_17=@SM1013_17, sm1013_18=@SM1013_18, SM1013_19=@SM1013_19, sm1013_20=@SM1013_20, sm1013_21=@SM1013_21, 
SM1013_22=@SM1013_22, SM1013_23=@SM1013_23 where unqid =@unqid
END

if @what='Delete_Data'
BEGIN
delete from sm1013 where unqid=@unqid
END

IF @what='GET_GRNO'
BEGIN
	select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(SM1013.SM1013_6 as numeric(18))),0)  + 1 as GRNo from dbo.SM1013 where sm1013_24=@branchid
END

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_INSURANCE_MASTER]
@what			nvarchar(50)='',
@Name			nvarchar(20)='',
@sm407_1       datetime='',		  ----enter date
@sm407_2       datetime='',          ----modify date
@sm407_3 		nvarchar(50)='',      ----ip
@sm407_4 		nvarchar(50)='',      ----user id
@sm407_5		NVARCHAR(50)='',   ----unqid
@sm407_6		NVARCHAR(50)='',     ----NAME OF COMPANY
@sm407_7 	   	NVARCHAR(50)='',      ----POLICY NO
@sm407_8       nvarchar(50)='',     ----DATE OF ISSUE
@sm407_9  	   nvarchar(50)='',    ----DATE OF RENEW
@sm407_10	    nvarchar(50)='',     ----INSURANCE AMT   
@sm407_11	    nvarchar(50)='0',     ----USED AMT IN POLICY
@sm407_12      nvarchar(50)='0',      ----REMAINING POLICY  
---------------------------------child--------------------------------------------
@sm407_C1 	   nvarchar(max)='',			--ENTRY DATE
@sm407_C2		NVARCHAR(50)='',	    --UNQID CHILD
@sm407_C3		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--USERID
@sm407_C4		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--IPADDRESS
@sm407_C5		DATETIME='',			--MODIFYDATE
@sm407_C6		NVARCHAR(50)='',		--PARENT UNQID
@sm407_C7      NVARCHAR(50)='',			--Product
@punqid nvarchar(50)='',
@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@custid as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(50) ='',
@suppid as nvarchar(max)='',
@sm1005_6 as nvarchar(50)='',
@sm1005_73 AS NVARCHAR(50)=''  
AS

                                               
if @what = 'insert'
BEGIN 
set @punqid=newid();		
INSERT INTO sm407 values(getdate(),getdate(),@sm407_3,@sm407_4,@punqid,@sm407_6,@sm407_7,CAST(@sm407_8 AS datetime),CAST(@sm407_9 AS datetime),@sm407_10,case when @sm407_11='' then '0' else @sm407_11 end,case when @sm407_12='' then '0' else @sm407_12 end)
select @punqid as err;		
END


IF @what = 'INSERT_CHILD'
BEGIN	
INSERT INTO sm407_C VALUES(dbo.entrydate(),NEWID(),@sm407_C3,@sm407_C4,getdate(),@sm407_C6,(select SM206_2 from SM206 where SM206_7=@sm407_C7))
END
                                                                                          
IF @what ='PRODUCT'
BEGIN
SELECT SM206_2 AS DATA ,SM206_7 AS VALUE FROM SM206 order by SM206_7 asc
END

if @what='grid_R'
Begin
select sm407_5,sm407_6 as Nameofcompany,sm407_7 as Policyno,sm407_10 as insuranceamt from sm407
end

if @what = 'Search'
begin
select sm407_5,sm407_6 as Nameofcompany,sm407_7  as Policyno,sm407_8 as Dateofissue,sm407_9 as Dateofrenew,sm407_10 as insuranceamt from sm407
where sm407_7 like '%'+@sm407_7+'%'
end

iF @what ='DELETEDATA'
Begin		
DELETE from sm407 WHERE sm407_5= @sm407_5
DELETE from sm407_c where sm407_c6 = @sm407_5 
select 'deleted successfully' as err
End

IF @what = 'Edit_box'
BEGIN
SELECT sm407_6,sm407_7,CAST(sm407_8 AS datetime) AS sm407_8,CAST(sm407_9 AS datetime) AS sm407_9,sm407_10,sm407_11,sm407_12 FROM sm407 WHERE sm407_5 = @sm407_5;
SELECT (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=sm407_C7) as sm407_C7 FROM sm407_c WHERE sm407_c6 = @sm407_5;		
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURING_MASTER]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_MANUFACTURING_MASTER]
@AA				AS NVARCHAR(50),
@SM113_1		AS NVARCHAR(50)='',			--ENTRY DATE 
@SM113_2		AS NVARCHAR(50)='',			--MODIFY DATE 
@SM113_3		AS NVARCHAR(3)='',			--USERID
@UNQID			AS NVARCHAR(36)='',			--UNQID
@SM113_100		AS NVARCHAR(30)='',			--IPADD
@SM113_5		AS NVARCHAR(4)='',			--CODE
@SM113_6		AS NVARCHAR(60)='',			--DESC
@SM113_7        AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',	    --ADDRESS
@SM113_8        AS NVARCHAR(50)='',         --COUNTRY
@SM113_9        AS NVARCHAR(50)='',         --STATE
@SM113_10       AS NVARCHAR(50)='',         --CITY
@likeclause		AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@pageno			AS  NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@SUPPL          AS NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@SM113_C2       AS  NVARCHAR(50) ='',        -- SM113_UNQID
@SM113_C3       AS  NVARCHAR(50) ='',        --SUPPLIER NAME
@COUNTRYUNQ     AS  NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@STATEUNQ       AS  NVARCHAR(50) =''

AS
 

IF @AA = 'IN'
BEGIN
SET @UNQID=NEWID();
	
	BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO DBO.SM113 VALUES(GETDATE(),'',@SM113_3,@UNQID,@SM113_100,@SM113_5,@SM113_6,@SM113_7,@SM113_8,@SM113_9,@SM113_10);
		  SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
		  SELECT @UNQID AS PUNQID
	END

	--ELSE
	--BEGIN
	--		SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
	--END
END

IF @AA = 'INSERTCHILD'
BEGIN
	
	BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO DBO.SM113_C VALUES(NEWID(),@SM113_C2,@SM113_C3);
		  SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
	END
	
END

IF @AA = 'UP'
BEGIN
		IF((SELECT COUNT(SM113_5) FROM SM113 WHERE SM113_5 = @SM113_5 AND UNQID=@UNQID)= 1)
		BEGIN
			  UPDATE DBO.SM113 SET 
			  SM113_2 = GETDATE(),SM113_3 = @SM113_3,SM113_100 = @SM113_100,SM113_5 = @SM113_5,
			  SM113_6 = @SM113_6,SM113_7=@SM113_7,SM113_8=@SM113_8,SM113_9=@SM113_9,SM113_10=@SM113_10 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
			  SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;		 
		END

		ELSE IF((SELECT COUNT(SM113_5) FROM SM113 WHERE SM113_5 = @SM113_5) >= 1) 
		BEGIN
			 SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
	    END

	    ELSE
	    BEGIN
			 UPDATE DBO.SM113 SET 
			  SM113_2 = GETDATE(),SM113_3 = @SM113_3,SM113_100 = @SM113_100,SM113_5 = @SM113_5,
			  SM113_6 = @SM113_6,SM113_7=@SM113_7,SM113_8=@SM113_8,SM113_9=@SM113_9,SM113_10=@SM113_10 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
	   		  SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;
	    END
END

IF @AA='DELETECHILD'
BEGIN
DELETE FROM SM113_C WHERE SM113_C2=@UNQID
PRINT '1'
END

IF @AA='UPDATE_CHILD'
BEGIN


 INSERT INTO DBO.SM113_C VALUES(NEWID(),@SM113_C2,@SM113_C3);
		  SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;

END


 
IF @AA = 'DEL'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM DBO.SM113 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
		SELECT 'Delete Successfully' AS err;	
END

 
IF @AA = 'GETONE'
BEGIN
	SELECT UNQID AS UNQID, SM113_5 AS [CODE], SM113_6 AS [DESCRIPTION],SM113_7 AS ADDRESSNAME,SM113_8 AS COUNTRY,SM113_9 AS STATENAME,SM113_10 AS CITY
	 FROM DBO.SM113 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;

	 SELECT (SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19.unqid=SM113_C.SM113_C3) AS SUPPLIERNAME,sm113_c3 as suppliervalue FROM SM113_C WHERE SM113_C2=@UNQID
END


------------------------------------------------ STATE MASTER
IF @AA = 'VIEW'
BEGIN
									--TABLE 0
		DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT		 
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10
		SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],SM113_5 AS [CODE],SM113_6 AS [DESCRIPTION] FROM SM113 ORDER BY SM113_6

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_MenuCategoryMaster]
@aa as nvarchar(20),
@sm17_1 as nvarchar(25)='',--entry date 
@sm17_2 as nvarchar(25)='',--modifydate
@sm17_3 as nvarchar(3)='',--user id
@unqid as nvarchar(20)='',--unqid
@sm17_5 as nvarchar(100)='',--Sub Unqid
@sm17_6 as nvarchar(MAX)='',--description
@sm17_7 as nvarchar(20) = '',--forecolor
@sm17_8 as nvarchar(20) = '',--backcolor
@sm17_9 as nvarchar(50) = '',--imagepath
@sm17_100 as nvarchar(100)='',--system name 
@sm17_10 as nvarchar(5) = '', -- askrestcode
@sm17_11 as nvarchar(50)='', -- order of category
@likeclause as nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as nvarchar(50) =''
as

if @aa = 'in'
BEGIN  
  
	  IF((SELECT COUNT(SM17_6) FROM SM17 WHERE SM17_6=@sm17_6) = 0)
	  BEGIN
			SELECT @UNQID = ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,0), UNQID)) ,0) + 1 FROM SM17;	
			INSERT INTO DBO.SM17(SM17_1,SM17_2,SM17_3,UNQID,SM17_5,SM17_6,SM17_7,SM17_8,SM17_9,SM17_100,SM17_10,sm17_11) 
			VALUES(DBO.GETENTRYDATE(), '', @SM17_3,@UNQID,@SM17_5,@SM17_6,@SM17_7,@SM17_8,@SM17_9,@SM17_100,'',@sm17_11);  
			SELECT 'Save Successfully' as err;
	  END

	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
				SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
	  END

END

if @aa = 'up'
BEGIN   
		IF((SELECT COUNT(SM17_6) FROM SM17 WHERE SM17_6=@sm17_6 AND unqid=@unqid) = 1) 
		BEGIN
			  UPDATE DBO.SM17 SET
			  SM17_2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM17_3 = @SM17_3,SM17_5 = @SM17_5,SM17_6 = @SM17_6,SM17_7 = @SM17_7,SM17_8 = @SM17_8,
			  SM17_9 = @SM17_9,SM17_100 = @SM17_100,sm17_11=@sm17_11 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
			  SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;
	    END

		ELSE IF((SELECT COUNT(SM17_6) FROM SM17 WHERE SM17_6=@sm17_6) >= 1) 
		BEGIN
			 SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
	    END

	    ELSE
	    BEGIN
	   		 UPDATE DBO.SM17 SET
	   		 SM17_2 = DBO.GETENTRYDATE(),SM17_3 = @SM17_3,SM17_5 = @SM17_5,SM17_6 = @SM17_6,SM17_7 = @SM17_7,SM17_8 = @SM17_8,
	   		 SM17_9 = @SM17_9,SM17_100 = @SM17_100,sm17_11=@sm17_11 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
	   		 SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;
	    END
END

IF @aa = 'del'
BEGIN
			DELETE FROM DBO.SM17 WHERE UNQID = @UNQID;
			SELECT 'Delete Successfully' AS err;
END


if @aa = 'del_check'
	begin
		if(select count (*) from dbo.sm17 where sm17_5 = @unqid) > 0
			begin
				select 'constraint1';
			end
		else if(select count (*) from dbo.sm28 where sm28_7 = @unqid) > 0
			begin
				select 'constraint2';
			end
		else
			begin			
				select '0';
			end
	end

if @aa = 'undo'
	begin
		select @unqid =(select top 1 unqid from dbo.sm17 where sm17_10 = @sm17_10 order by sm17_1 desc);
		select unqid,sm17_5,isnull((select sm17_6 from sm17 as aa where aa.unqid = @unqid),'') as subcat,
		(select sm17_6 from sm17 where unqid = (select sm17_5 from sm17 where unqid = @unqid)) as maincat,
		sm17_7 as fcolor, sm17_8 as bcolor, sm17_9 as [ipath], sm17_11 as [ordercat] from sm17	where unqid = @unqid;	
		
		select count(*) recordnum from sm17;
	end

if @aa = 'np'
	begin
		declare @total as int,@row as int;
		set @total = 1;
		set @row = convert(int,@sm17_1);
		select @unqid = unqid from 
		(select unqid, row_number() over(order by sm17_1) AS [rownum] from dbo.sm17 where sm17_10 = @sm17_10)
		AS tbl where rownum between( (@row -1) * @total + 1) and (@row * @total);
		select unqid,sm17_5,isnull((select sm17_6 from sm17 as aa where aa.unqid = @unqid),'') as subcat,
		(select sm17_6 from sm17 where unqid = (select sm17_5 from sm17 where unqid = @unqid)) as maincat,
		sm17_7 as fcolor, sm17_8 as bcolor, sm17_9 as [ipath], sm17_11 as [ordercat] from sm17	where unqid = @unqid;
	end

begin

	sm17_5 as maincat,

		order by sm17_6
	end

if @aa = 'chk_desc'
	begin
		if(select count(sm17_6)	from dbo.sm17 where sm17_6 = @sm17_6) > 0
			begin
				select 'maincat';
			end	
	end

if @aa = 'search'
	begin
		select unqid, sm17_5 as [Description],(case when sm17_5 = '0' then '' else sm17_6 end) as subcat,
		(case when sm17_5 = '0' then sm17_6 else (select sm17_6 from sm17 where unqid = a.sm17_5) end)as maincat, sm17_11 as [ordercat]
		from sm17 as a where sm17_6 like '%' + @sm17_6 + '%'
	end

if @aa = 'tree'
	begin
		select (case when sm17_5 = '0' then '' else sm17_6 end) as subcat,
		(case when sm17_5 = '0' then sm17_6 else (select sm17_6 from sm17 where unqid = a.sm17_5) end)as maincat
		from sm17 as a where sm17_5 != '0' and sm17_10 = @sm17_10 order by sm17_6 asc
	
		select sm17_6 as maincat from sm17 where sm17.sm17_5 = '0' and sm17_6 != ''  order by sm17_6 asc;
	end

if @aa = 'pr'
	begin
		select (case when sm17_5 = '0' then '-' else sm17_6 end) as 'SubCategory',
		(case when sm17_5 = '0' then sm17_6 else (select sm17_6 from sm17 where unqid = a.sm17_5) end) as 'MainCategory'
		from sm17 as a where sm17_6 != '' order by MainCategory asc
	end

		SELECT A.UNQID AS [UNQID],A.SM17_6 AS [DESCRIPTION],(CASE WHEN A.SM17_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE (SELECT B.SM17_6 FROM SM17 AS B WHERE B.UNQID =A.SM17_5) END) 
		AS [MAIN CATEGORY] FROM SM17 AS A   ORDER BY sm17_11 asc
	
	OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
	FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;

	begin
		select (case when sm1022_5 = '0' then '' else sm1022_6 end) as subcat,
		(case when sm1022_5 = '0' then sm1022_6 else (select sm1022_6 from sm1022 where unqid = a.sm1022_5) end)as maincat
		from sm1022 as a where sm1022_5 != '0' and sm1022_10 = @sm1022_10 order by sm1022_6 asc
	
		select sm1022_6 as maincat from sm1022 where sm1022.sm1022_5 = '0' and sm1022_6 != ''  order by sm1022_6 asc;
	end

if @aa = 'pr'
	begin
		select (case when sm1022_5 = '0' then '-' else sm1022_6 end) as 'SubCategory',
		(case when sm1022_5 = '0' then sm1022_6 else (select sm1022_6 from sm1022 where unqid = a.sm1022_5) end) as 'MainCategory'
		from sm1022 as a where sm1022_6 != '' order by MainCategory asc
	end

------------------------------------------------ 22 CATEGORY MASTER
IF @aa = 'view'
BEGIN
	--SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN sm1022_6 ELSE (SELECT sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 WHERE UNQID = A.sm1022_5) END)
	--AS [MAIN CATEGORY],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE sm1022_6 END) AS [SUB CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A ORDER BY sm1022_6 ASC
		
				--TABLE 0
	DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT
	 
	SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
	SET @RowspPage = 10
		--SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN sm1022_6 ELSE (SELECT sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 WHERE UNQID = A.sm1022_5) END)
		--AS [DESCRIPTION],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE sm1022_6 END) AS [MAIN CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A ORDER BY sm1022_6 ASC

		SELECT A.UNQID AS [UNQID],A.sm1022_6 AS [DESCRIPTION],(CASE WHEN A.sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE (SELECT B.sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 AS B WHERE B.UNQID =A.sm1022_5) END) 
		AS [MAIN CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A   ORDER BY sm1022_11 asc
	
	OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
	FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;
			
			--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS [DESCRIPTION],'' AS [MAIN CATEGORY]
END
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @aa ='SearchByAlphabet'
BEGIN 
--SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN sm1022_6 ELSE (SELECT sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 WHERE UNQID = A.sm1022_5) END)
--AS [MAIN CATEGORY],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE sm1022_6 END) AS [SUB CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A
--where sm1022_6 like '' +@likeclause+ '%'
--ORDER BY sm1022_6 ASC
	
		--TABLE 0
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10

		--SELECT UNQID AS [UNQID],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN sm1022_6 ELSE (SELECT sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 WHERE UNQID = A.sm1022_5) END)
		--AS [MAIN CATEGORY],(CASE WHEN sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE sm1022_6 END) AS [MAIN CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A
		--where sm1022_6 like '' +@likeclause+ '%'	ORDER BY sm1022_6 ASC

		SELECT A.UNQID AS [UNQID],A.sm1022_6 AS [DESCRIPTION],(CASE WHEN A.sm1022_5 = '0' THEN '' ELSE (SELECT B.sm1022_6 FROM sm1022 AS B WHERE B.UNQID =A.sm1022_5) END) 
		AS [MAIN CATEGORY],sm1022_11 as [ORDER OF CATEGORY] FROM sm1022 AS A WHERE sm1022_6 like '%' +@likeclause+ '%' AND sm1022_10=@sm1022_10  ORDER BY sm1022_11 asc

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;	

		--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS [UNQID],'No Record Found' AS [DESCRIPTION],'' AS [MAIN CATEGORY]
end

IF @aa = 'PageCount'
begin
		 --IF OBJECT_ID('#TM', 'U') IS  NULL
	  --   DROP TABLE #TM;
	     CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));

			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from sm1022 WHERE sm1022_10=@sm1022_10),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )
			--select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount]

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   SELECT * FROM #TM
end

IF @aa = 'PageCountLIKE'
begin

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from sm1022 WHERE sm1022_6 like '%' +@likeclause+ '%' AND sm1022_10=@sm1022_10),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
				   SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
end


GO

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_UNITMASTER]
@aa            nvarchar(20)='',
@sm209_1       datetime='',          ----entry date
@sm209_2	   datetime='',          ----modify date
@sm209_3	   nvarchar(50)='',      ----user id
@unqid	       uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',   ----unqid
@sm209_5	   nvarchar(50)='',      ----Description
@sm209_6	   nvarchar(50)='',  
@sm209_100     nvarchar(50)='',       ----server ip
@sm209_7	   nvarchar(50)='',      ----conversion unit
@sm209_8	   nvarchar(50)='',      ----converted unit
@sm209_9	   numeric(18,2)='0.00',     ----conversion factor
@sm209_10      numeric(18,2)='0.00',     ----converted value
@likeclause as nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as  nvarchar(50) =''

AS


IF @aa = 'in'
BEGIN
set @unqid= newid();
		IF(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sm209 WHERE sm209_7 = @sm209_7)=0
		BEGIN
		
insert into sm209(sm209_1  ,sm209_2	 ,sm209_3,unqid	 ,sm209_5 ,
sm209_6	 ,sm209_100,sm209_7	,sm209_8,sm209_9	 ,
sm209_10)
values(GETDATE()  ,GETDATE()	 ,@sm209_3	 ,@unqid	 ,@sm209_5	 ,
@sm209_6,@sm209_100,@sm209_7	 ,@sm209_8	 ,@sm209_9	 ,
@sm209_10 )
				SELECT 'Save Successfully' AS err;
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
		END
END
IF @aa = 'up'
BEGIN
	  IF(SELECT COUNT(sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE sm209_7 = @sm209_7) = 1			
	  BEGIN
			UPDATE sm209 SET 
			sm209_7 = @sm209_7 ,sm209_8 = @sm209_8, sm209_9 = @sm209_9, sm209_10 = @sm209_10, sm209_5 = @sm209_5 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
			SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;
	  END

	  ELSE IF((SELECT COUNT(sm209_7) FROM sm209 WHERE sm209_7 = @sm209_7) >= 1) 
	  BEGIN
			SELECT 'Already Exist' as err;
	  END

	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
			UPDATE sm209 SET 
			sm209_7 = @sm209_7 ,sm209_8 = @sm209_8, sm209_9 = @sm209_9, sm209_10 = @sm209_10, sm209_5 = @sm209_5 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
			SELECT 'Update Successfully' AS err;
	  END

END
	
IF @aa = 'del'
BEGIN
		DELETE FROM sm209 WHERE unqid = @unqid;
		SELECT 'Delete Successfully' AS err
END

IF @aa = 'getone'
BEGIN


	SELECT SM209.UNQID AS [UNQID] , sm209_5 as [description], sm209_7 as [conversion unit], sm209_8 as [converted unit], 
	sm209_9 as [conversion factor], sm209_10 as [converted value] FROM SM209 WHERE unqid=@unqid
END

--else if @aa = 'np'
--	begin
--		declare @total as int,@row as int;
--		set @total = 1;
--		set @row = convert(int,@zm08_1);
--		select @zm08_1 = zm08_1 from

--		AS tbl where rownum between( (@row -1) * @total + 1) and (@row * @total);
--		select * from dbo.zm08 where zm08_1 = @zm08_1;
--	end
--else if @aa = 'undo'
--	begin
--		select @zm08_1 = (select top 1 zm08_1 from dbo.zm08);
--		select * from dbo.zm08 where zm08_1 = @zm08_1;
--		select count(*) recordnum from dbo.zm08; 
--	end

else if @aa='fillcombo'
    begin
        
        select  sm209_7 as unitmaster from sm209
    end
--else if @aa = 'search'
--	begin
--		declare @str as nvarchar(max);
--		select @str = 'select * from dbo.zm08 where 1 = 1 '
		
--		if @zm08_1 != '' and @zm08_1 != 'select'
--			select @str = @str + ' and zm08_1 = ''' +@zm08_1+ ''''
--		select @str = @str 
--		exec(@str);
--	end
--else if @aa= 'print'
--    begin
--     select zm08_1 as unitmaster from zm08  order by zm08_1
--    end

--------------------------------------------------UNIT MASTER--------------
IF @aa = 'view'
BEGIN
						--TABLE 0
		DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT		 
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10
		SELECT unqid AS unqid,SM209_7 AS [CONVERSION UNIT],SM209_8 AS [CONVERTED UNIT],SM209_10 AS [CONVERSION FACTOR] FROM SM209 ORDER BY SM209_7 ASC

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;

									--TABLE 1			
		SELECT '' AS unqid,'No Record Found' AS [UNIT] 
END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @aa ='SearchByAlphabet'
BEGIN	  
		SET @PageNumber = convert(int ,@pageno)
		SET @RowspPage = 10
									--TABLE 0
		SELECT unqid AS unqid,SM209_7  AS [UNIT] FROM sm209
		WHERE SM209_7 like '' +@likeclause+ '%'   ORDER BY SM209_7 ASC

		OFFSET ((@PageNumber - 1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;	

									--TABLE 1
		SELECT '' AS unqid,'No Record Found' AS [UNIT] 
END

IF @aa = 'PageCount'
BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #TM ([PageCount]  nvarchar(50));

			DECLARE @tot NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM209),@Page float = 10;
			DECLARE @totvalue NUMERIC(18,2)
			declare @A int 
			set @totvalue = (select @tot / @Page )

			set @A =1
			declare @PageValue int 
			set @PageValue =(select CEILING(@totvalue) as [PageCount])
			while (@A <=@PageValue)
		BEGIN
			insert into #TM values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A))
			SET @A = @A + 1;
		END
 
	   select * from #TM
END

IF @aa = 'PageCountLIKE'
BEGIN

		CREATE TABLE #TM_LIKE ([PageCount]  NVARCHAR(50));
			
		DECLARE @totLIKE NUMERIC(18,2) = (select count(*) from SM209 where SM209_7 like '' +@likeclause+ '%'),@PageLIKE float = 10;
		DECLARE @totvalueLIKE NUMERIC(18,2)
		declare @A_LIKE int 
		set @totvalueLIKE = (select @totLIKE / @PageLIKE )
		--select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount]

		set @A_LIKE =1
		declare @PageValue_LIKE int 
		set @PageValue_LIKE =(select CEILING(@totvalueLIKE) as [PageCount])
		while (@A_LIKE <=@PageValue_LIKE)
			BEGIN
				insert into #TM_LIKE values (CONVERT(VARCHAR,@A_LIKE))
				SET @A_LIKE = @A_LIKE + 1;
			END
			SELECT * FROM #TM_LIKE
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_UnLoading_Master]

    @WHAT       NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@uid        nvarchar(50) = '',
	@UNQ        NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@name       NVARCHAR(100) = '',
	@branch     nvarchar(50) = '',
    @SM505_1    DATETIME = '',        -- ENTER DATE
	@SM505_2    DATETIME = '',        -- MODIFY DATE
	@SM505_3    NVARCHAR(20) ='',     -- USER ID
	@UNQID      NVARCHAR(max) ='',    -- PKEY
	@SM505_100  NVARCHAR(100) ='',    -- IP
	@SM505_4    DATETIME ='',         --EFFETIVE DATE
	@SM505_5    DATETIME ='',         --CLOSING DATE
	@SM505_6    NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --BRANCH
	@SM505_7    NVARCHAR(100) ='',    --
    @SM505_8    NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM505_9    NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM505_10   NVARCHAR(100)='',
	@SM505_c1   DATETIME ='',
	@SM505_c2   DATETIME ='',
	@SM505_c3   NVARCHAR(20) ='',      -- USER ID
	@CUNQID     NVARCHAR(max) ='',     -- PKEY
	@SM505_c100 NVARCHAR(20) ='',      -- IP
	@SM505_c4   NVARCHAR(max) ='',     -- PARENT UNIQID
	@SM505_c5   NVARCHAR(max) ='',     -- PRODUCT NAME
	@SM505_c6   NVARCHAR(max) ='',     -- PRODUCT UNID
	@SM505_c7  NVARCHAR(max) ='',      -- RATE
	@SERVER     NVARCHAR(max) ='' ,
	@TEXT       NVARCHAR(max) ='' 
 AS

  
	 IF @WHAT = 'BRANCH'
	 BEGIN
	   select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as branch from SM1002
	 END

	IF @WHAT ='GRID'
	BEGIN
	      SELECT SM206_2 AS UNQID, SM206_7 AS PRODUCT_NAME, '' as Rate  FROM SM206 order by SM206_7 asc
	END

	IF @WHAT ='INSERT'
	BEGIN
	 set @uid = NEWID();
		  INSERT INTO SM505(SM505_1,SM505_2,SM505_3,UNQID,SM505_100,SM505_4,SM505_5,SM505_6,SM505_7)
		  VALUES(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@SM505_3,@uid,@SM505_100,@SM505_4, @SM505_5, @SM505_6, @SM505_7);
	 select @uid as punqid
	END

	IF @WHAT ='INSERT_C'
	BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO SM505_C(SM505_C1,SM505_C2,SM505_C3,CUNQID,SM505_C100,SM505_C4,SM505_C5,SM505_C6,SM505_C7)
		  VALUES(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@SM505_C3,NEWID(),@SM505_C100,@SM505_C4, @SM505_C5, @SM505_C6,@SM505_C7);
	END

	if @what='grid_R'
	begin
      SELECT UNQID,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_4, 105) AS SM505_4, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_5, 105) AS SM505_5, (SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM505.SM505_6) AS SM505_6,
	 CASE WHEN (SM505.SM505_8 IS NULL OR SM505.SM505_8 = ''  OR SM505.SM505_9 IS NULL OR SM505.SM505_9 = '' OR SM505.SM505_10 IS NULL OR SM505.SM505_10 = '') 
    THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'APPROVE' END AS [Status] FROM SM505;
	end

	IF @WHAT='Approved'
	BEGIN 
	  UPDATE SM505 SET SM505_9='APPROVE' ,SM505_8= GETDATE(), SM505_10=@SERVER WHERE UNQID=@UNQID

	END

	IF @WHAT='SEARCH'
	BEGIN
	 SELECT  UNQID,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_4, 105) AS SM505_4, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_5, 105) AS SM505_5,(SELECT SM1002_7 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5 = SM505.SM505_6) AS SM505_6 FROM SM505 WHERE SM505_4 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'  AND SM505_5 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM SM1002  WHERE SM1002_5 = SM505.SM505_6  AND SM1002_7 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'  )
	END

	
	if @what='EDEdit_box'
	begin
     select CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_4, 105) AS SM505_4, CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM505_5, 105) AS SM505_5,SM505_6 from SM505 where UNQID=@UNQID
	end

   if @what='CEdit_box'
	begin
	 SELECT SM505_C6 AS UNQID,SM505_c5 AS PRODUCT_NAME, sm505_c7 AS Rate FROM sm505_c  where SM505_C4=@UNQID ORDER BY SM505_C5 ASC
	end

	IF @WHAT='UPDATE'
	BEGIN 
	  UPDATE SM505 SET SM505_4=@SM505_4, SM505_5= @SM505_5, SM505_6 =@SM505_6 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
	END 

    IF @WHAT='UPDATE_C'
	BEGIN 
	  UPDATE SM505_c SET SM505_c5= @SM505_c5, SM505_c6 =@SM505_c6,SM505_C7=@SM505_C7 WHERE SM505_C4=@UNQID
	END 

	IF @WHAT='DELETE_C'
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM SM505_c WHERE SM505_c4= @uid 
	END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_WAREHOUSE_MASTER]
@what				nvarchar(15)='',
@SM1006_1			DATETIME='',											 --ENTRY DATE
@SM1006_2			DATETIME='',											 --MODIFY DATE
@SM1006_3			nvarchar(50)='',										 --user 
@unqid				UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', --UNIQUE ID
@SM1006_100			nvarchar(50)='',										 --IP
@SM1006_5			nvarchar(50)='',										 --WAREHOUSENAME 
@SM1006_6			nvarchar(max)='',										 --ADDRESS
@SM1006_7			UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  --CITY
@SM1006_8			UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  --STATE
@SM1006_9			UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', --COUNTRY
@SM1006_10			nvarchar(50)='',										 ---ZIP CODE
@sm1006_11          nvarchar(30)='',									    ---LATITUDE
@SM1006_12			nvarchar(30)='',										---LONGITUDE
@SM1006_13    NVARCHAR(50)='',                                              ---BRANCH SESSION

--CHILD TABLE SM1006_C
@SM1006_C5		    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',       ---PARENT UNQID
@SM1006_C6          nvarchar(50)='',												--RACK/TANK
@SM1006_C7		     nvarchar(50)='',												--LOCATION
@SM1006_C3           nvarchar(20)='',												--USER
@sm205_8			nvarchar(50)='',												--COUNTRY ID
@SM1006_C100		nvarchar(50)=''	,												--IP
@unqid_c nvarchar(max)=''															--CHILD UNQID
AS

if @what='City_Bind'
BEGIN
--Table 0--
select unqid ,sm1_5 as city from sm01  where sm1_7= @SM1006_7 ORDER BY SM1_5 ASC
END

if @what ='State_Bind'
BEGIN
select unqid ,sm205_5 as [state] from sm205 where sm205_8 = @sm205_8 ORDER BY SM205_5 ASC
END

if @what='Country_Bind'
Begin
select unqid, sm2_5 as country from sm02 ORDER BY sm2_5
--state at pageload
select unqid ,sm205_5 as [state] from sm205 ORDER BY sm205_5
--city
select unqid ,sm1_5 as city from sm01 ORDER BY sm1_5
END

if @what='Save_Data' ---SAVE PARENT DATA
BEGIN
set @unqid=NEWID();
insert into SM1006(SM1006_1, SM1006_2, SM1006_3, unqid, SM1006_100, SM1006_5, SM1006_6, SM1006_7, SM1006_8, SM1006_9, SM1006_10, sm1006_11, SM1006_12,SM1006_13) Values(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1006_3, @unqid, @SM1006_100, @SM1006_5, @SM1006_6, @SM1006_7, @SM1006_8, @SM1006_9, @SM1006_10, @sm1006_11, @SM1006_12,@SM1006_13)
select @unqid as punqid
END

if @what='Child_Data'---SAVE CHILD DATA
BEGIN
insert into SM1006_C(SM1006_C1, SM1006_C2, SM1006_C3, unqid,SM1006_C100, SM1006_C5 ,SM1006_C6,SM1006_C7 ) Values(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1006_C3, NEWID(), @SM1006_C100, @SM1006_C5, @SM1006_C6, @SM1006_C7)
END

if @what='Grid_Bind' --VIEWPAGE GRID BIND
BEGIN
select SM1006.unqid as unqid, SM1006_5, SM1006_6, sm01.sm1_5 as city, sm205.sm205_5 as [state], sm02.sm2_5 as country from SM1006 
INNER JOIN sm01 ON sm01.unqid = sm1006.sm1006_7
INNER JOIN sm205 ON sm205.unqid = sm1006.sm1006_8
INNER JOIN sm02 ON sm02.UnqID = sm1006.sm1006_9
END

if @what='Ware_Bind'----at edit time
BEGIN
select SM1006_5, SM1006_6, SM1006_7, SM1006_8, SM1006_9, SM1006_10, SM1006_11, SM1006_12 from SM1006 where unqid=@unqid
END

if @what='Child_Bind'
BEGIN
select UNQID, SM1006_C6, SM1006_C7 from SM1006_C where SM1006_C5=@SM1006_C5
END

if @what='Delete_child' --AT UPDATE
BEGIN
delete from SM1006_C where unqid=@unqid_c
END

if @what='Delete_Data'
BEGIN
delete from SM1006 where unqid=@unqid
delete from SM1006_C where SM1006_C5=@unqid
END

if @what='Update_Data'
BEGIN
update SM1006 set SM1006_5=@SM1006_5, SM1006_6=@SM1006_6, SM1006_7=@SM1006_7, SM1006_8=@SM1006_8, SM1006_9=@SM1006_9, SM1006_10=@SM1006_10, sm1006_11=@sm1006_11, SM1006_12=@SM1006_12 where unqid=@unqid
select @unqid as punqid 
END

if @what='child_update'
BEGIN
IF @unqid_c=''
begin
insert into SM1006_C(SM1006_C1, SM1006_C2, SM1006_C3, unqid, SM1006_C100, SM1006_C5 ,SM1006_C6,SM1006_C7 ) Values(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1006_C3, newid(), @SM1006_C100, @SM1006_C5, @SM1006_C6, @SM1006_C7)
end
else
begin
UPDATE SM1006_C SET SM1006_C6=@SM1006_C6, SM1006_C7=@SM1006_C7 WHERE SM1006_C5=@SM1006_C5 AND unqid=@unqid_c 
end
END







GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_WHATSAPP_MSG]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[M_SP_FOR_WHATSAPP_MSG]
@what		nvarchar(50)='',
@Name		nvarchar(20)='',
@SM504_1        datetime='',		  ----enter date
@SM504_2        datetime='',          ----modify date
@SM504_3		nvarchar(20)='',      ----ip
@unqid		uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM504_100		nvarchar(20)='',      ----user id
@SM504_4		nvarchar(100)='',      ----PAGE
@SM504_5  		nvarchar(100)='',      ----EVENT
@SM504_6 	    nvarchar(100)='',      ----MOBILE
@SM504_7        nvarchar(max)='',      ----Branch
@TEXT            nvarchar(100)=''

AS

begin
	
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		IF @what = 'insert_data'
		BEGIN
		set @unqid = newid();
         INSERT INTO SM504 
         VALUES (dbo.entrydate(), dbo.entrydate(), @SM504_3,  @unqid,@SM504_100, @SM504_4, @SM504_5, @SM504_6,@SM504_7);
		end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


		IF @what = 'Updata'
	    BEGIN
			UPDATE SM504 SET SM504_4 = @SM504_4, SM504_5 = @SM504_5,SM504_6 = @SM504_6,SM504_7 =@SM504_7 WHERE unqid = @unqid		
	    END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		


		if @what='grid_R'
		Begin
		   select unqid, SM504_4, SM504_5 , SM504_6 from SM504
		end

	   iF @what ='delete_data'
		Begin
			DELETE from SM504 where unqid= @unqid
		End

		-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
		IF @what = 'EDEdit_box'
		begin
		   SELECT  SM504_4, SM504_5 , SM504_6, SM504_7 from SM504 WHERE unqid = @unqid;		
		end

		IF @WHAT = 'SERACH'
		BEGIN
	    	SELECT * FROM SM504 WHERE SM504_4 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'  AND SM504_5 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'   AND SM504_6 LIKE '%' + @TEXT + '%'
		END

	    if @what='all_branch'
	    begin 
		   select SM1002_5 AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7
	    end
end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_CHQ_RETURN]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@aa            nvarchar(20)='',
@bankid        nvarchar(50)='',
@chqid         nvarchar(50)='',
@sm202_cr4     nvarchar(50)='', --bank name
@sm202_cr5     nvarchar(50)='', --chq no.
@sm202_cr6     nvarchar(50)='', --extra feild
@sm202_r7      nvarchar(50)='', --Voucher No
@sm202_cr8     nvarchar(50)='', --Reason
@unqid         nvarchar(50)='',
@sm201_23      nvarchar(200)='', --Reason Of Return
@type          nvarchar(100)='',
@textsearch    nvarchar(100)='',
@what   nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_1  nvarchar(10)  = '',	
@m3_2  nvarchar(30)  = '',
@m3_3  nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_4  nvarchar(36)  = '',
@m3_5  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_6  numeric(18,2)  = 0,
@m3_7  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_8  nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_9  nvarchar(20)  = '',
@m3_10 nvarchar(max) = '',
@m3_11 nvarchar(10)  = '',	
@m3_12 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_13 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_14 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_15 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_16 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_17 nvarchar(max) = '',	
@m3_18 nvarchar(36)  = '',	
@m3_19 nvarchar(30)  = '',
@userid nvarchar(3)  = '',
@outletcode nvarchar(100) = '',
@systemname nvarchar(max) = '',
@AccountID  nvarchar(max)='',
@Amount     nvarchar(max)='',
@vno        nvarchar(max)='',
@invnunq    nvarchar(max)='',
@date       nvarchar(max)='',
@sgst       nvarchar(max)='',
@cgst       nvarchar(max)='',
@igst       nvarchar(max)='',
@Amoun      numeric(18,2)=0,
@custcharges nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	IF @aa='bind'
	begin
	select ba_14 unqid, ba_5 bank from ba where ba_2 ='bank book'
		  
    ----SELECT '' as unqid,'Select Cheque No' as chqno
	  select lower(sm202_4) as unqid,sm202_15 as chqno,sm202_6a as vno from sm202 where sm202_21 = 'CHEQUE'

	select sm19_5 as partyname,unqid as unq from sm19

	 select
	 CONVERT(varchar,  getdate() , 105) as todaydate

--select *, sm202_15 as chqno, sm202_6a as vno, sm202_20 as bank from sm202 where sm202_21 = 'CHEQUE'
	end
	

	if @aa='chqbind'
	begin	 
	      select sm202_4 as unqid,sm202_15 as chqno from sm202 where sm202_21 = 'CHEQUE' and sm202_20=@bankid  	  
	end

	if @aa='onchq'
	begin
	      select lower(sm202_4) as vunqid,sm202_c9 as partyname from sm202 inner join sm202_c on sm202.sm202_4=sm202_c.sm202_c6 where sm202_4=@chqid
		
		  select (select top 1 sm202_c10  from sm202_c where sm202_c6=sm202_4) as amount,
		  (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm202_c9) accountName,(select sm19_10 from sm19
		   where unqid=sm202_c9)AS  [desc] from sm202 inner join sm202_c on sm202.sm202_4=sm202_c.sm202_c6 where sm202_4=@chqid

		   IF(select sm202_19 from sm202 where sm202_4=@chqid)='IBTM'
              BEGIN
                  SELECT SM19_5 AS AC FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID= (select sm202_22 from sm202 where sm202_4=@chqid)
              END
            ELSE
			   BEGIN
			      SELECT '' AS AC
			   END
	end

	if @aa='insert'
	begin
	     

		set @unqid=newid(); 
		
		
		if @type !='add'
		begin
		     --delete from sm202_return where unqid=@type
			 delete from  sm202_return where unqid=@type
		     delete from  sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@type
		end

		if(select count(*) from sm202_return where sm202_r7=@sm202_cr5)>0
		begin
		     select 'This Cheque is Already Return' as err;
		end
		else
		begin
		select 'yes' as err
		insert into sm202_return
		select getdate(),getdate(),@userid,@unqid,@systemname,@date,@sm202_cr4,@sm202_cr5,(isnull((select max(sm202_r8) from sm202_return),0)+1),* from sm202 where sm202_4=@sm202_cr5
		insert into sm202_c_return select getdate(),getdate(),@userid,newid(),@systemname,getdate(),@sm202_cr8,*,@unqid from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5
		print '1'
		--jeet edits
		--sp_help sm202_return
		set @M3_19=getdate();
	    set	@vno=(select sm202_r8 from sm202_return where sm202_4=@sm202_cr5)
		print 'err'
		set @AccountID=(select sm202_c9 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)
		set @Amount =(select sm202_c10 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)
		--set @Amount =(select sm202_11 from sm202 where sm202_4=@sm202_cr5)
		print 'next'
     --edited
       -- receipt
	   if(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount) > 0)
		   begin
					update sm202_return set sm202_13 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@M3_19) , sm202_14 = @userid where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5;
		
			   IF (SELECT sm202_19 FROM sm202_return WHERE sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5) = 'IBTM'
				  BEGIN
					update sm202_return set SM202_6A = (select max(cast(case when SM202_6A='' then 0 else sm202_6a end as numeric(18)))+1
					from sm202_return where sm202_19 = 'IBTM' and sm202_101 = @outletcode) where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5 
				 end
			   else begin 
					update sm202_return set SM202_6A = (select max(cast(case when SM202_6A='' then 0 else sm202_6a end as numeric(18)))+1 from sm202_return 
					where dbo.onlydate(sm202_13) = dbo.onlydate(@m3_19) AND  sm202_19 <> 'IBTM'  and sm202_101 = @outletcode) where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5 
			   end
					--update sm202 set SM202_6A = (select max(cast(SM202_6A as numeric(18)))+1 from sm202 where dbo.onlydate(sm202_13) = dbo.onlydate(@m3_19)) 
				   print '2'
					select @what = 'insert',
					@m3_1 = (select top 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)),--CHANGE ON 20210823
					@m3_2 = sm202_7,

					@m3_3 = (select top 1 BA_6 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)) +
					'/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),@vno),--CHANGE ON 20210823
		
					@m3_4 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5),
					@m3_5 =  @sm202_cr8,
					@m3_6 = (select SUM(sm202_c10) from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6 = @sm202_cr5),
					@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'CR',@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = SM202_5,@m3_12 = SM202_10,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @sm202_cr5,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
					@m3_17 = '' from sm202_return where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5;

					set @m3_18 = newid();
					print '3'
					exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
					@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname


				DECLARE CUR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT SM202_C9,SM202_C10 FROM sm202_c_return WHERE SM202_C6=@sm202_cr5
				OPEN CUR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CUR1 INTO @AccountID,@Amount 
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN 
					print 'a'
					select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select top 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT top 1 SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)),--CHANGE ON 20210823
					@m3_2 = sm202_7,
					@m3_3 = (select top 1  BA_6 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT top 1 SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5))  + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),@vno),--CHANGE ON 20210823
					@m3_4 = @AccountID,
					@m3_5 = @sm202_cr8,
					@m3_6 =CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount)*-1,
					@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = case when  CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount)*-1 > 0 then 'CR' else 'DR' end,@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = SM202_5,@m3_12 = SM202_10,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @sm202_cr5,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
					@m3_17 = '' from sm202_return where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5;
					print '4'
					set @m3_18 = newid();
		
					exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
					@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname

					FETCH NEXT FROM 
					CUR1 INTO @AccountID,@Amount;

				END
				CLOSE CUR1  
				DEALLOCATE CUR1  
				print '5'

				if (select count(*) from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)) > 0
				 begin
					   print 'yes';
					  -- set @invnunq=(select unqid from invn where unqid in(select co_5 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)))
					   print @unqid;
					   update invn set in_11=(select co_7 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)) + (select in_11 from invn where unqid=@invnunq)
					   where unqid=(select unqid from invn where unqid in(select co_5 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid))))
					   print 'yes1'
					   select @@ROWCOUNT
					   delete from cosr where co_5 in(select unqid from invn where unqid in(select co_5 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid))))
					   print 'yes2'
					   select @@ROWCOUNT

				 end
       end
	   else
	   begin
		--purchase
			update sm202_return set sm202_13 = dbo.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@M3_19) , sm202_14 = @userid where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5
			--update sm202 set sm202_13 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@M3_19) , sm202_14 = @userid where sm202_4 = @unqid;
		
	  IF (SELECT sm202_19 FROM sm202_return WHERE sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5) = 'IBTM'
		  BEGIN
			update sm202_return set SM202_6A = (select max(cast(case when SM202_6A='' then 0 else sm202_6a end as numeric(18)))+1
			from sm202_return where sm202_19 = 'IBTM' and sm202_101 = @outletcode) where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5 
		 end
		else begin 
			update sm202_return set SM202_6A = (select max(cast(case when SM202_6A='' then 0 else sm202_6a end as numeric(18)))+1 from sm202 
			where dbo.onlydate(sm202_13) = dbo.onlydate(@m3_19) AND  sm202_19 <> 'IBTM' and sm202_101 = @outletcode) where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5 
		 end
		 
			select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)),--CHANGE ON 20210823
			@m3_2 = sm202_7,
			@m3_3 = (select top 1  BA_6 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)) + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),@vno),	--CHANGE ON 20210823
			--@m3_4 = (SELECT PA_35 FROM PA),										--CHANGE ON 20210823
			@m3_4 = (SELECT SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5),			--CHANGE ON 20210823
			@m3_5 = SM202_12,
			@m3_6 = ABS((select SUM(sm202_c10) from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6 = @sm202_cr5)),
			@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = 'CR',@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = SM202_5,@m3_12 = SM202_10,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @sm202_cr5,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
			@m3_17 = '' from sm202_return where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5;

			set @m3_18 = newid();

		
			exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
			@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
 
			DECLARE CUR1 CURSOR FOR SELECT SM202_C9,SM202_C10 FROM sm202_c_return WHERE SM202_C6=@sm202_cr5
			OPEN CUR1 FETCH NEXT FROM CUR1 INTO @AccountID,@Amount 
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN 
         
			 print '6'
			select @what = 'insert',@m3_1 = (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT top 1 SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)),--CHANGE ON 20210823
			@m3_2 = sm202_7,
			@m3_3 = (select top 1 BA_6 from BA where BA_14 = (SELECT top 1 SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5)) + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),@vno),
			@m3_4 = @AccountID,
			@m3_5 =  SM202_12,
			@m3_6 = CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount)*-1,
			@m3_7 = '',@m3_8 = '',@m3_9 = case when   CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount)*-1 <0 then 'DR' else 'CR' end,
			@m3_10 = '',@m3_11 = SM202_5,@m3_12 = SM202_10,@m3_13 = '',@m3_14 = @sm202_cr5,@m3_15 = '',@m3_16 = '',
			@m3_17 = '' from sm202_return where sm202_4 = @sm202_cr5;
	   
			set @m3_18 = newid();

			exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
			@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname

		   FETCH NEXT FROM 
		   CUR1 INTO @AccountID,@Amount;

		END
		CLOSE CUR1  
		DEALLOCATE CUR1  

		if (select count(*) from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)) > 0
				 begin
					   print 'yes'
					   set @invnunq=(select unqid from invn where unqid in(select co_5 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)))

					   update invn set in_11=(select co_7 from cosr where co_6=(select sm202_c4 from sm202_c where sm202_c6=@sm202_cr5)) + (select in_11 from invn where unqid=@invnunq)
					   where unqid=@invnunq

					   delete from cosr where co_5=@invnunq

				 end
	end	
	--edited for bank chan

           -- set @bankstate=select count(*) from sm205 where unqid in(select sm19_25 from sm19 where unqid in(select sm202_c9 from sm202_c_return))-- state of bank 
	        
	-- new for chq return

	if(select pa_10 from PA INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID=PA.PA_10)=(select unqid from sm205 where unqid in(select sm19_25 from sm19 where unqid =(select top 1 sm202_c9 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid)))
	begin 
	    print 'gst'
	
		 declare @counter int =1;
		set @Amoun= (SELECT top 1 ba_19 FROM BA WHERE BA_14=(SELECT top 1 SM202_20 FROM sm202_return WHERE SM202_4 = @sm202_cr5));

		while @counter <=8
		begin
		   
		    if @counter=1
			begin
			    set @m3_4 = (select top 1 pa_69 from pa) -- unqid of pa
			    set @m3_6=-1*CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun);--(select ba_19 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)-- to add bank charge want to include not 18% tax	
				print @m3_6
		    end
			 if @counter=2
			begin
			    set @m3_4 = (select top 1 sm202_r6 from sm202_return where unqid=@unqid)
			   set @m3_6=-1*(@m3_6*18/100)+@Amoun; --    include  18% tax	
			   print @m3_6
			end
			 if @counter=3
			begin
			   set @m3_4 = (select sm210_13 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			    -- cgst amt
			   set @m3_6=(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun)*18/100)/2*-1;
			   print @m3_6
			end
			 if @counter=4
			begin
			       set @m3_4 = (select sm210_9 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			       set @m3_6=(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun)*18/100)/2*-1;
				   print @m3_6--sgst amount
            end
			 if @counter=5
			begin
			        set @m3_4 = (select sm202_c9 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid)
				set  @custcharges=(select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)
			       -- for customer charges with gst  --customer unqid
				  set @m3_6=((select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)+(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@custcharges)*18/100))*-1;
				  print @m3_6
            end
			 if @counter=6
			begin  
			      --set @m3_6=CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amount); -- customer chq amount
				   set @m3_4 = (select top 1 pa_69 from pa) -- unqid of pa
				   set @m3_6=(select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4);
				  print @m3_6
            end
			 if @counter=7
			begin  
			         set @m3_4 = (select sm210_13 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			       set @m3_6= ((select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)*18/100);
				    --- cgst amount
					 set @m3_6= @m3_6/2;
				   print @m3_6
            end
		    if @counter=8
			begin  
			        set @m3_4 = (select sm210_9 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			       set @m3_6= ((select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)*18/100);
				    --- sgst amount
					 set @m3_6= @m3_6/2;
			       
				   print @m3_6 --- sgst amount
				  
            end

			print @counter

		  set @m3_18 = newid();
		     
			exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
			@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
			 set @counter=@counter+1;
		  
		end 

	end
	else 
	begin
	   print 'igst'
	   --CUSOTMER ACCOUNT ID OF IGST 
    
	
	     set @counter =1;
		while @counter <=7
		begin
		   
		    if @counter=1
			begin
			     set @m3_4 = (select top 1 pa_69 from pa) -- unqid of pa
			    set @m3_6=-1*CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun);--(select ba_19 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)-- to add bank charge want to include not 18% tax	
				print @m3_6
		    end
			 if @counter=2
			begin
			   set @m3_4 = (select top 1 sm202_r6 from sm202_return where unqid=@unqid)
			   set @m3_6=-1*(@m3_6*18/100)+@Amoun; --    include  18% tax	
			   print @m3_6
			end
			 if @counter=3
			begin
			     set @m3_4 = (select sm210_13 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			    -- cgst amt
			   set @m3_6=(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun)*18/100)/2*-1;
			   print @m3_6
			end
			 if @counter=4
			begin
			       set @m3_4 = (select sm210_9 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
			       set @m3_6=(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@Amoun)*18/100)/2*-1;
				   print @m3_6
            end
			 if @counter=5
			begin
			      set @m3_4 = (select sm202_c9 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid)
				set  @custcharges=(select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)
			       -- for customer charges with gst  --customer unqid
				  set @m3_6=((select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)+(CONVERT(Numeric(18,2),@custcharges)*18/100))*-1;
			                                -- for customer charges with gst 
				  print @m3_6
            end
			 if @counter=6
			begin  
			      set @m3_4 = (select top 1 pa_69 from pa) -- unqid of pa
				   set @m3_6=(select ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4);
				  print @m3_6
            end
			 if @counter=7
			begin  
			         
			       set @m3_6= ((select top 1 ba_18 from ba where ba_14=@sm202_cr4)*18/100);
			        set @m3_4 = (select sm210_17 from sm210 where unqid=(select pa_68 from pa))
				    --- Igst amount
				   print @m3_6
            end
		   

			print @counter

		  set @m3_18 = newid();
		     
			exec a_sp_for_ledger_posting @what,@m3_1,@m3_2,@m3_3,@m3_4,@m3_5,@m3_6,@m3_7,@m3_8,@m3_9,@m3_10,
			@m3_11,@m3_12,@m3_13,@unqid,@m3_15,@m3_16,@m3_17,@m3_18,@m3_19,@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
			 set @counter=@counter+1;
         end
	   end
	end

	--testing
	   
   -- testing

		--jeet edits	     
end

	if @aa='GridBind'
	begin
	     select sm202_return.unqid,sm202_r8,(select sm202_15 as chqno from sm202 where sm202_4=sm202_r7)as sm202_r5, 
		 (select sm202_c10 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6=sm202_4) as amount,
		 (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm202_c9) as  accountName
		  from sm202_return inner join sm202_c_return on sm202_return.unqid=sm202_c_return.sm202_c12
	    --(select sm202_6a as vno from sm202 where sm202_4=sm202_r6) as sm202_r6, sm202_r7,sm202_r8,
	    --(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm202_22) accountName    from sm202_return
		-- (select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm202_c9) as  accountName
	
	end

	if @aa='DeleteRecord'
	begin
	     delete from  sm202_return where unqid=@unqid
		 delete from  sm202_c_return where sm202_c12=@unqid
		 	
	end

	if @aa = 'Editbind'
	begin
	 select sm202_cr6 as reason,sm202_4 as chqno,sm202_r6 as bankid,sm202_c9 as partyname, CONVERT(varchar, sm202_r5, 105) as [da_te],(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=sm202_22) as accr  from sm202_return
	 inner join sm202_c_return on sm202_return.unqid=sm202_c_return.sm202_c12 where sm202_return.unqid=@unqid 

	   select lower(sm202_4) as unqid,sm202_15 as chqno,sm202_6a as vno from sm202 where sm202_21 = 'CHEQUE'
	 
	end

	if @aa = 'Search'
	begin
	     select sm202_return.unqid,sm202_r8,(select sm202_15 as chqno from sm202 where sm202_4=sm202_r7)as sm202_r5, 
		 (select sm202_c10 from sm202_c_return where sm202_c6=sm202_4) as amount,
		 (select sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=sm202_c_return.sm202_c9) as  accountName
		  from sm202_return inner join sm202_c_return on sm202_return.unqid=sm202_c_return.sm202_c12
		     where (select sm19_5 from sm19 where sm19.unqid=sm202_c_return.sm202_c9) like'%'+@textsearch+'%' or
		  (select sm202_15 as chqno from sm202 where sm202_4=sm202_r7) like '%'+@textsearch+'%' 	 
		  	
	end

	if @aa = 'chqReturn'
	begin
	        update ba set ba_20=(select top 1 unqid from sm210)
	        update pa set pa_68=(select top 1 unqid from sm19)
	end
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_COUNTRY_MASTER] 
	
	@what nvarchar(20)='',
	@Name nvarchar(20)='',
	@Nationality nvarchar(20)='',
	@Currency nvarchar(20)='',
	@C_code nvarchar(20)='',
	@Continent nvarchar(25)='',
	@unqid nvarchar(50)='',
	@user nvarchar(50)=''




AS	


	
	if @what ='insert'
     IF(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SM02 WHERE SM2_5=@Name)=0
	begin
	     insert into sm02(SM2_1,SM2_2,SM2_3,sm2_5,UnqID,SM2_9,SM2_11,SM2_6,SM2_12) VALUES(GETDATE(),'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000',@user,@Name,NEWID(),@Currency,@C_code,@Nationality,@Continent)
		 SELECT 'Save Successfully' as err;
	end
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	SELECT 'Country Already Exist' as err;
	END


	IF @what ='WG_VIEW'
	begin

	select UnqID , sm2_5 as [CountryName],sm2_11 as [Ccode] from sm02
	end
	
	IF @what ='getone'
	begin
	
	select sm2_5 as [country], sm2_6 as [Nationality] , SM2_12 AS [Continent], sm2_9 as [Currency], sm2_11 as [Code] from sm02 where UnqID=@unqid
	end
	if @what = 'update'
	begin
	DECLARE @DATE NVARCHAR(100)
	
	SET @DATE=(SELECT SM2_1 FROM SM02 WHERE UnqID=@unqid)
	delete from sm02 where UnqID=@unqid

	 insert into sm02(SM2_1,SM2_2,SM2_3,sm2_5,UnqID,SM2_9,SM2_11,SM2_6,SM2_12) VALUES(@DATE,GETDATE(),@user,@Name,NEWID(),@Currency,@C_code,@Nationality,@Continent)
	end

	IF @what ='delete'
	begin
            delete from sm02 where UnqID=@unqid
	end
	select * from sm02
	


	

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_CREDIT_NOTE]
@what nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid nvarchar(100) = '',
@BRANCH              nvarchar(max)='',
@naration            nvarchar(max)=''
AS

if @what = 'CREDIT'
begin
SELECT @BRANCH=SM1018_19 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID=@unqid

set @naration= 
		(SELECT(
  CASE UPPER(SM1018_8)
        WHEN 'GOODS RETURN' THEN
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' QTY ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

        WHEN 'CASH DISCOUNT' THEN
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

        WHEN 'RATE DIFFERENCE' THEN
             'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
             ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
	        ' Rs ' + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') +' PER KG '+
             ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') 
			 + ' SUPPLIED ' +    'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
            ' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)
	    WHEN 'SHORTAGE' THEN
             'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
             ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			 ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			 ' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '')+
	        ' @' + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') +' PER KG '+
            -- ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') 
			 + ' SUPPLIED ' +    'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
            ' DATED ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)

			WHEN 'DEDUCTION' THEN
             'BEING CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST MATERIAL '
            

        ELSE
	    	'CREDIT NOTE ISSUED AGAINST ' +
			ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') + ' ' +
			ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (SELECT SM1018_23 FROM SM1018 WHERE UNQID =@UNQID))), '') + 
			' ,Qty ' + ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') 
		    + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '') + ' SUPPLIED ' +
			'VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + 
			' DT ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, SM1018_7, 103)
    END)
FROM SM1018 
WHERE UNQID = @UNQID)
		SELECT PA_17 AS GSTIN,SM205_5 AS [state],sm205_7 as statecode,pa_11 as [AdministrativeAddress],PA_14 + (' - 342 003') AS CITY,pa_22 as phoneNo,PA_23 AS PHONE,pa_18 as email,pa_3 as FirmName,
		pa_28 as para1,pa_12 as para2,pa_30 as para3,PA_31 AS para4,pa_32 as para5,pa_5 as reg1,pa_7 as reg2,pa_4 as [signature],PA_20 AS PanNo,
        pa_25 as CinNo FROM PA INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID=PA.PA_10

		select top 1 sm19_5 as account,sm19_13 as add1, SM1018_15 as igst, sm19_23 as gstin, sm19_24 as state1,sm1018_27 as approvedby,sm19_46 as pan,
		SM1018_28 AS IRNNO,sm1018_35  AS QR,(select sm205_7 from sm205 where unqid=sm19_25) as statecode, 
        --('CREDIT NOTE') + ' ISSUED AGAINST ' + ISNULL(UPPER(SM1018_8), '') +' '+ISNULL((SELECT SM206_9 FROM SM206  
        --WHERE SM206_2 = (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = (select SM1018_23 from sm1018 where unqid =@UNQID))), '') + 
        --' ,Qty'++ ISNULL(SM1018_21, '') + +' KG @ ' + ISNULL(SM1018_10, '')  + '% AG SUPPLY ' + + 
        --' VIDE OUR INVOICE NO. ' + ISNULL(SM1018_5, '') + ' ' + ' DT '+ ' ' + FORMAT(SM1018_7, 'dd/MM/yyyy') + 'AMT. Rs. '+sm1018_22 as narration,
		@naration
		as narration,

		dbo.getformatteddate((dbo.onlydate(SM1018_2))) as date,(dbo.onlydate(SM1018_7)) as date2,sm1018_15 as igst_amount,sm1018_16 as sgst_amount,sm1018_17 as cgst_amount,sm1018_11 as amount,
		sm1018_5 as Invoice_no, ((SELECT SM1002_18 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)+SM1018_20) as credit_note,sm1018_18 AS net_amount,
	    --(CASE WHEN sm1011_28 LIKE '%F35776A1-DCF6-4AFB-A5C1-AF1B720F54B2%' THEN CAST(sm1018_18 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) + (CAST(sm1018_17 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) + CAST(sm1018_17 AS DECIMAL(10, 2))) 
        --ELSE CAST(sm1018_18 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) + CAST(sm1018_15 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) END) AS net_amount,		
	    --FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7/2 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1011_28)) AS cgstper,FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7/2 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1011_28)) as sgstper,
        --FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_26)) AS igstper,
	 	FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7/2 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_14)) AS cgstper,FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7/2 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1018_13)) as sgstper,
        FLOOR((SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1018_12)) AS igstper,
		'' as NET ,sm1018_30 as ackno,sm1018_31 as ackdate,cast(sm1018_24 as nvarchar(50)) as appdate,sm1018_36 as cartage,sm1018_37 as [round] from sm1018 
		left join m3 ON m3.m3_14=sm1018.UNQID 
		inner join sm19 on sm19.unqid=sm1018_6  
		--inner join sm1011 on sm19.unqid=sm1011_10 
		where sm1018.unqid = @unqid
end
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SP_FOR_INVN_QTRADING]    Script Date: 11-03-2026 17:12:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
