CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_INVN_QTRADING]
@what	    nvarchar(30)  = '',
@unqid	    nvarchar(36)  = '',
@userid	    nvarchar(100)   = '',
@outletcode nvarchar(100)  = '',
@systemname nvarchar(max) = '',
@INVNUNQID nvarchar(20) =''


as
Declare @IN_1 nvarchar(20),@IN_2  nvarchar(20),@IN_3  nvarchar(10),@IN_4 nvarchar(10), @INVNUNQ  nvarchar(36), @IN_5 nvarchar(36), @IN_6  nvarchar(10),
@IN_7 nvarchar(20),@IN_8  nvarchar(20),@IN_9 nvarchar(20),@IN_10 nvarchar(10),@IN_11 nvarchar(10),@IN_12 nvarchar(36),@IN_13 nvarchar(10), @IN_14 nvarchar(20);

BEGIN


IF @WHAT='INVN_SALES'
begin 
INSERT INTO INVN
SELECT
    dbo.getentrydate(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000',@userid,@systemname,  NEWID(), 
	@unqid,'DR',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'sales' ),
	sm1011_6, sm1011_35, 'FALSE', sm1011_35,  (sm1011_10) ,sm1011_7,
	DATEADD(day, CAST(sm1011_61 AS int), sm1011_6) AS DueDate,sm1011_41
FROM SM1011
WHERE unqid = @unqid;
END    


IF @WHAT='DELETESALE'
begin 
Delete from INVN where in_5= @unqid and IN_7 = 'OO';
END 
IF @WHAT='DELETEPURCHASE'
begin 
Delete from INVN where in_5= @unqid and IN_7 = 'PP';
END 
IF @WHAT='DELETEFREIGHT'
begin 
Delete from INVN where in_5= @unqid and IN_7 = 'FF';
END 

IF @WHAT='INVN_PURCHASE'
begin 
INSERT INTO INVN
SELECT
    dbo.getentrydate(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000',@userid,@systemname,  NEWID(), 
	@unqid,'CR',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'PURCHASE' ),
	sm1005_13, -(sm1005_36), 'FALSE', -(sm1005_36),  sm1005_11,sm1005_12,
	DATEADD(day, CAST(sm1005_47 AS int), sm1005_13) AS DueDate,sm1005_7
FROM SM1005
WHERE SM1005_4 = @unqid;
END    

IF @WHAT='INVN_TRANSPORTER'
begin 
INSERT INTO INVN
SELECT
    dbo.getentrydate(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000',@userid,@systemname,  NEWID(), 
	@unqid,'CR',(SELECT BA_1 FROM BA WHERE BA_5 = 'FREIGHT' ),
	sm1005_13, -(sm1005_70-SM1005_72), 'FALSE', -(sm1005_70-SM1005_72),  sm1005_16 ,sm1005_17,
	DATEADD(day, CAST((select sm19_56 from sm19 where unqid   = sm1005_16) AS int), sm1005_13) AS DueDate,sm1005_7
FROM SM1005
WHERE SM1005_4 = @unqid;
END  


END




GO

		   --INNER JOIN sm1009_c ON sm1009_c.unqid = sm1008_log.sm1008_23

		     SELECT sm1008_log_1 AS Editdate,(select sm63_6 from sm63 where sm63_5=sm1008_log_2) AS Username,

	  if @unqid ='sm202_log'

		    sm202_2 AS Modify_Date,

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_for_login]


@what nvarchar(100) ='',
@Username nvarchar(50) = '',
@Password nvarchar(50) = ''
AS

if @what = 'insert_data'
begin

insert into userinfo (Username, PASS_WORD) values (@Username, @Password)

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_PURCHASE_APPROVAL]
@what			nvarchar(30)  = '',
@unqid			nvarchar(36)  = '',
@userid			nvarchar(100)   = '',
@outletcode		nvarchar(100)  = '',
@systemname		nvarchar(max) = '',
@INVNUNQID		nvarchar(20) ='',
@sm1005_4		NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@BRANCHNAME		NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@BRANCH			NVARCHAR(50) ='',
@VOUCHERNO		NVARCHAR(50)='',
@SM1005_21		NVARCHAR(50)='',
@SM1005_80		NVARCHAR(50) = '',			----DATE
@SM1005_81		NVARCHAR(50) ='',		----USERID
@SM1005_82		NVARCHAR(50)='' ,        ----IP
@SM203_NEWUNQID NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
AS
BEGIN

	IF @WHAT = 'FETCH'
	BEGIN 
		SELECT SM1005_4 AS UNQID, --1
			SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,--2
			SM1005_6 AS [DATE],--3
			SM1005_13 AS INVOICEDATE,--4
			SM1005_31 AS INVNUM,--5
			SM1005_74 AS [NUM],--6
			(SELECT SM19_5 FROM SM19 WHERE SM19_11 = 'SUPPL' AND UNQID = SM1005_11) AS SUPPLNAME,--7
			(SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 = SM1005_10) AS PRODUCTNAME,--8
			SM1005_30 AS PRODUCTRATE,--9
			----------------------
			SM1005_24 AS [BASIC],--10
			SM1005_77 AS CASHDIS,--11
			SM1005_25 AS CASHDISAMOUNT,--11
			SM1005_26 AS CUSTOMDIS,--12
			SM1005_27 AS PKGCHARGE,--13
			SM1005_83 AS RAILFRIGHT,--14
			(SM1005_33 + SM1005_34 + SM1005_35) AS GSTAMOUNT,--15
			(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID = SM1005_20) AS UNIT,--16
			SM1005_36 AS INVAMT,--17
			SM1005_51 AS TAXAMT,--18
			SM1005_57 AS MTQ,--19
			SM1005_47 AS CRDAYS,--20
			CASE 
				WHEN SM1005_80 IS NOT NULL AND SM1005_81 IS NOT NULL AND SM1005_82 IS NOT NULL 
				THEN 'APPROVED' 
				ELSE 'PENDING' 
			END AS APPROVALSTATUS  --21

		FROM SM1005
		INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002_5 = SM1005_7

		WHERE SM1005_74 IS NOT NULL

		ORDER BY CAST(SM1005_74 AS NUMERIC(18, 0)) DESC;
		END

	IF @WHAT ='APPROVALSTATUS'
		BEGIN 
			UPDATE SM1005 SET SM1005_80 = DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(@SM1005_80), SM1005_81 = @SM1005_81, SM1005_82 = @SM1005_82 WHERE SM1005_4 = @unqid;
		END

	IF @WHAT='PURCHASE'
BEGIN 
      --------SUPPLIER NAME
	 INSERT INTO  M3  	
	 SELECT (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'),sm1005_48,SM1005_74,
	 UPPER(sm1005_11),(select  'Product: ' + ( select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=(select sm1005_10 from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@sm1005_4)) +
  '  Supp Inv No ' + sm1005_31 + ' Dt '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(sm1005_13 AS DATETIME), 103)),	
	 sm1005_36, '', '', 'CR','',(select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'), '',
	'',@sm1005_4 , '', '', '',NEWID(),sm1005_48,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname 
     From SM1005 where sm1005_4 =@sm1005_4;

		----DEBIT TO(PURCHASE)
	  INSERT INTO  M3  	
	  SELECT (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'),sm1005_48,SM1005_74,
	  UPPER(sm1005_15),(select  'Product: ' + ( select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=(select sm1005_10 from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@sm1005_4)) +
  '  Supp Inv No ' + sm1005_31 + ' Dt '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(sm1005_13 AS DATETIME), 103)),	
	 -sm1005_51, '', '', 'DR','',(select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'), '',
	  '',@sm1005_4 , '', '', '',NEWID(),sm1005_48,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname 
	  from SM1005 where sm1005_4 =@sm1005_4;
		


		-----SGST+CGST//IGST
	IF((SELECT SM1005_32 FROM SM1005 WHERE sm1005_4=@sm1005_4) <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	BEGIN

	   INSERT INTO  M3  	
	   SELECT (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'),sm1005_48,SM1005_74,
	   (SELECT UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM210_17 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1005_32)),(select  'Product: ' + ( select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=(select sm1005_10 from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@sm1005_4)) +
  '  Supp Inv No ' + sm1005_31 + ' Dt '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(sm1005_13 AS DATETIME), 103)),	
	   -cast(sm1005_33 as numeric(18,3)), '', '', 'DR','',(select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'), '',
	   '',@sm1005_4 , '', '', '',NEWID(),sm1005_48,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
	   from SM1005 where sm1005_4 =@sm1005_4;
	
		END
	    ELSE
		BEGIN
	  INSERT INTO  M3  	
	   SELECT (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'),sm1005_48,SM1005_74,
	    (SELECT UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM210_13 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1005_52)),(select  'Product: ' + ( select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=(select sm1005_10 from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@sm1005_4)) +
  '  Supp Inv No ' + sm1005_31 + ' Dt '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(sm1005_13 AS DATETIME), 103)),	
	  -sm1005_34, '', '', 'DR','',(select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'), '',
	   '',@sm1005_4 , '', '', '',NEWID(),sm1005_48,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname
	   from SM1005 where sm1005_4 =@sm1005_4;
		

	   INSERT INTO  M3  	
	   SELECT (select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'),sm1005_48,SM1005_74,
	   (SELECT UNQID FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM210_9 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1005_53)),(select  'Product: ' + ( select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=(select sm1005_10 from sm1005 where sm1005_4=@sm1005_4)) +
  '  Supp Inv No ' + sm1005_31 + ' Dt '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(sm1005_13 AS DATETIME), 103)),	
	   -sm1005_35, '', '', 'DR','',(select TOP 1 BA_1 from BA where BA_5 = 'PURCHASE'), '',
	    '',@sm1005_4 , '', '', '',NEWID(),sm1005_48,dbo.getentrydate(),'',@userid,@outletcode,@systemname

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_RATE_MASTER]

@what nvarchar(50)='',          
@unqid NVARCHAR(50)='',

@SM1017_12 nvarchar(50)='',		---Old Rate /Credit
@SM1017_13 nvarchar(50)='',		---New Rate /Cash
@SM1017_14 nvarchar(50)='',		---New Rate /Credit

@oldcash   numeric(18,2)=0,
@oldcredit numeric(18,2)=0,

AS

LEFT JOIN SM209 ON SM209.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C12

SM1017_6=@OLDDATE

SM209.UNQID AS UNIT_UNQID,  
SM209_7 AS UNIT,
0 AS oldcash, 0 AS oldcredit, 0 AS newcash,0 AS newcredit FROM SM206

 INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.UNQID=SM206.SM206_12

  SELECT SM1017_C6 AS unqid,  sm206_7 AS Product,

SM209_7 AS UNIT,

 INNER JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID=SM206.SM206_13

WHERE SM206_2 NOT IN (SELECT SM1017_C6 FROM SM1017_c1 WHERE SM1017_C5 IN(SELECT UNQID FROM SM1017 WHERE SM1017_7=@BRANCH) )
 ORDER BY Product ASC


END

end

if @what = 'Edit_child_Data2'
begin
insert into sm1017_c1_log (sm1017_c1, SM1017_c2, SM1017_c3, unqid, SM1017_c100, SM1017_c5, SM1017_c6, SM1017_c7, SM1017_c8, SM1017_c9, SM1017_c10, SM1017_c11,SM1017_C12)values(GETDATE(), '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000', @SM1017_3, NEWID(), @SM1017_100, @SM1017_5, @SM1017_6, @SM1017_7, @oldcash, @oldcredit, @newcash, @newcredit,@SM1017_C12)
end

IF @WHAT='ALL_BIND'
BEGIN


SET @OLDDATE=(SELECT TOP 1 SM1017_6 FROM SM1017 WHERE SM1017_7=@BRANCH ORDER BY SM1017_1 DESC)
--SELECT SM1017_C6 AS unqid, (select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2 = SM1017_C6) AS Product, (SELECT SM17_6 FROM SM17 WHERE UNQID=SM1017_C7) AS Category, SM1017_C7 AS unqid1, SM1017_C12 AS UNIT_UNQID, (SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1017_C12) AS UNIT,
--SM1017_C8 AS oldcash, SM1017_C9 AS oldcredit, SM1017_C10 AS newcash,SM1017_C11 AS newcredit FROM SM1017_C1 
--LEFT JOIN SM1017 ON SM1017.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C5 WHERE SM1017_7=@branch AND SM1017_6=@OLDDATE ORDER BY Product ASC
SELECT SM1017_C6 AS unqid,  sm206_7 AS Product, 
SM17_6 AS Category, 
SM1017_C7 AS unqid1, 
SM1017_C12 AS UNIT_UNQID,  
SM209_7 AS UNIT,
SM1017_C8 AS oldcash, SM1017_C9 AS oldcredit, SM1017_C10 AS newcash,SM1017_C11 AS newcredit FROM SM206 
LEFT JOIN SM1017_C1 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C6 
LEFT JOIN SM1017 ON SM1017.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C5 
LEFT JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C7 
LEFT JOIN SM209 ON SM209.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C12 
WHERE SM1017_7=@branch AND
SM1017_6=@OLDDATE
UNION ALL
SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid,  sm206_7 AS Product, 
SM17_6 AS Category, 
SM17.UNQID AS unqid1, 
SM209.UNQID AS UNIT_UNQID,  
SM209_7 AS UNIT,
0 AS oldcash, 0 AS oldcredit, 0 AS newcash,0 AS newcredit FROM SM206 
 INNER JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID=SM206.SM206_13
 INNER JOIN SM209 ON SM209.UNQID=SM206.SM206_12
WHERE SM206_2 NOT IN (SELECT SM1017_C6 FROM SM1017_c1 WHERE SM1017_C5 IN(SELECT UNQID FROM SM1017 WHERE SM1017_7=@BRANCH) )
 ORDER BY Product ASC




SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid ,SM206_7 AS Product, unqid AS UNQID1, SM17_6 as Category, SM206_12 AS UNIT_UNQID, (SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM206_12) AS UNIT , '' AS oldcash, '' AS oldcredit, '' AS newcash,'' AS newcredit 
FROM SM206 LEFT JOIN SM206_C ON SM206.SM206_2=SM206_C.SM206_C6  INNER JOIN SM17 ON SM17.UNQID=SM206.SM206_13 order by sm206_7


END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_SALES_AUTHORISATION]
	
 @what nvarchar(20)='', 
 @manufacture nvarchar(50)='',
 @supplier nvarchar(50)='',
 @product nvarchar(50)='',
 @Qty nvarchar(20)='',
 @strength nvarchar(20)='',
 @Rate nvarchar(20)='',
 @netamt nvarchar(20)='',
 @category nvarchar(20)='',
 @DATE NVARCHAR(50)='',
 @Authorise nvarchar(20)='',
 @unqid nvarchar(50)='',
 @Tax nvarchar(50)='',
 @text nvarchar(50)='',
 @pageno nvarchar(50)='',
 @Mode nvarchar(50)='',
 @user nvarchar(50)='',
 @ip nvarchar(50)=''


as
BEGIN

	if @what = 'bind'
	begin
	--table 0
	select SM19_5, unqid from sm19 where sm19_11='CUST' ORDER BY SM19_5
	-- table 1 
    select unqid , sm17_6 as category from sm17 ORDER BY SM17_6
	--table 2
	select sm206_2 as unqid,sm206_7 as [product_name] from sm206 ORDER BY SM206_7
	
	--table 3 
	select sm113_6 as manufacture , unqid from sm113 ORDER BY SM113_6

	--table 4 
	 if(@unqid !='')
      select CONVERT(varchar, sm1007_5, 105) as [date],sm1007_6 as [CustomerName], sm1007_7 as [Manufacture], sm1007_8 as [product],sm1007_10 as [Qty],sm1007_11 as [Strength],sm1007_12 as [Rate],(select sm210_7 from sm206 inner join sm210 on sm210.unqid=sm206.sm206_10 where sm206_2=sm1007_13) as TAX, sm1007_13 as [Tax],sm1007_14 as [NetAmt],sm1007_15 as [Authorisation], sm1007_20 as [Category],SM1007_9 AS [PaymentMode] from sm1007 where unqid=@unqid

	  if(@unqid ='')
	  SELECT CONVERT(varchar, GETDATE(), 105) AS UNQ
	end

	if @what ='insert'
	begin
	
	insert into sm1007 (sm1007_5,unqid,sm1007_7,sm1007_6,sm1007_8,sm1007_10,sm1007_11,sm1007_12,sm1007_13,sm1007_14,sm1007_15,SM1007_19,sm1007_20,sm1007_9,SM1007_3,sm1007_100) values(@DATE,newid(),@manufacture,@supplier,@product,@Qty,@strength,@Rate,@Tax,@netamt,@Authorise,NEWID(),@category,@Mode,@user,@ip)
	end

	if @what = 'Update'
	begin

	delete from sm1007 where unqid=@unqid

	insert into sm1007 (sm1007_5,unqid,sm1007_7,sm1007_6,sm1007_8,sm1007_10,sm1007_11,sm1007_12,sm1007_13,sm1007_14,sm1007_15,SM1007_19,sm1007_20,sm1007_9,SM1007_3,sm1007_100) values(@DATE,newid(),@manufacture,@supplier,@product,@Qty,@strength,@Rate,@Tax,@netamt,@Authorise,NEWID(),@category,@Mode,@user,@ip)
	end

	IF @what = 'taxbind'
	begin
	--SELECT SM210_7 AS TAX, unqid FROM SM210 INNER JOIN SM206 ON sm210.unqid=SM206.SM206_10 WHERE unqid=@unqid
	
	SELECT (SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210  WHERE UNQID=SM206_10) AS TAX FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@unqid
	end
	
	if @what = 'taxStrength'
	begin
	select sm206_18 as strength from sm206 where sm206_2=@unqid
	end
	
	IF @what='GV1BIND'
	BEGIN

	SELECT sm1007.unqid as [unqid],CONVERT(varchar, sm1007_5, 105) as Da_te, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER,sm206_9 as product,SM1007_15 AS [Authorise],sm1007_14 as [netAmt] FROM SM1007 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.unqid=SM1007.SM1007_6 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1007.sm1007_8

	--SELECT '' AS [unqid],'' AS Da_te,'No Record Found' AS SUPPLIER,'' AS product,'' as Authorise,'' as netAmt 
	
	
	--create table #j ([PageCount] nvarchar(50),[color] nvarchar(50));
	--  declare @total numeric(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM SM1007), @Page float = 10;
	--  declare @totalvalue numeric(18,2)
	--  declare @a int
	--  declare @c nvarchar(50)
	--  set @a=1

	--     set @totalvalue = (select CEILING(@total/@Page) as pagec) 
		 
	--	 while(@a<=@totalvalue)
	--	 begin

	--	 if(@a/2) = 0
	--	 BEGIN
	--	 set @c = '#E2E2E2'
	--	 end

	--	 ELSE
	--	 begin

	--	 SET @c = 'white'

	--	 end

		

	--	 insert into #j values (convert(varchar, @a),@c)
		 
	--	 SET @a = @a + 1;

	--	 end
	--	 select * from #j
	
	END
	
	if @what='retrieve'
	begin

	select sm1007_1 as [date],sm1007_6 as [CustomerName], sm1007_7 as [Manufacture], sm1007_8 as [product],sm1007_10 as [Qty],sm1007_11 as [Strength],sm1007_12 as [Rate],(select sm210_7 from sm206 inner join sm210 on sm210.unqid=sm206.sm206_10 where sm206_2=sm1007_13) as TAX, sm1007_13 as [Tax],sm1007_14 as [NetAmt],sm1007_15 as [Authorisation], sm1007_20 as [Category] from sm1007 where unqid='9502b22f-eb03-4057-b452-8fc6916d7784'

	end

	if @what ='delete'
	begin
	delete from sm1007 where unqid=@unqid
	end

	if @what = 'Search'
	begin
	 --SELECT sm1007.unqid as [unqid],CONVERT(varchar, sm1007_1, 105) as Da_te, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER,sm206_9 as product,SM1007_15 AS [Authorise],sm1007_14 as [netAmt] FROM SM1007 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.unqid=SM1007.SM1007_6 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1007.sm1007_8 where sm1007_15=@text
	  SELECT sm1007.unqid as [unqid],CONVERT(varchar, sm1007_5, 105) as Da_te, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER,sm206_9 as product,SM1007_15 AS [Authorise],sm1007_14 as [netAmt] FROM SM1007 INNER JOIN SM19
	   ON SM19.unqid=SM1007.SM1007_6 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1007.sm1007_8 where (SM206_7 LIKE ('%'+@text+'%') OR SM19_5 LIKE ('%'+@text+'%')) OR SM1007_15=@text
	end

	if @what = 'Paging'
	begin
	DECLARE @PageNumber AS INT, @RowspPage AS INT

	     SET @PageNumber = convert(int , @pageno)
		 SET @RowspPage = 10
		 SELECT  sm1007.unqid as [unqid],CONVERT(varchar, sm1007_1, 105) as Da_te, SM19_5 AS SUPPLIER,sm206_9 as product,SM1007_15 AS [Authorise],sm1007_14 as [netAmt] FROM SM1007 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.unqid=SM1007.SM1007_6 inner join sm206 on sm206.sm206_2=sm1007.sm1007_8 ORDER BY SM1007_15
		 OFFSET((@PageNumber-1) * @RowspPage) ROWS
		 FETCH NEXT @RowspPage ROWS ONLY;


		 
	create table #jp ([PageCount] nvarchar(50));
	  declare @tot numeric(18,2) = (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM SM1007), @Pag float = 10;
	  declare @totalval numeric(18,2)
	  declare @aa int
	  set @aa=1

	     set @totalval = (select CEILING(@tot/@Pag) as pagec) 
		 
		 while(@aa<=@totalval)
		 begin
		 insert into #jp values (convert(varchar, @aa))
		 
		 SET @aa = @aa + 1;

		 end
		 select * from #jp


	end
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_SRL]
@what nvarchar(50)='',
@Name nvarchar(20)='',
@SM1017_6		datetime='',
@SM1016_1		datetime='',												-- ENTER DATE
@SM1016_2		datetime='',												-- MODIFY DATE
@SM1016_3		nvarchar(20)='',										    -- USER ID
@UNQID			uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',    ----unqid
@SM1016_100		nvarchar(200)='',											---- IP
@SM1016_4		nvarchar(50)='',											----Branch name
@SM1016_5		nvarchar(50)='',											----Booking Oder No
@SM1016_6  		nvarchar(50)='',											----DATE
@SM1016_7  	    nvarchar(50)='',											----Customer Name 
@SM1016_8       nvarchar(50)='',											----Product Name
@SM1016_9       nvarchar(50)='',											----Manufacture
@SM1016_10  	nvarchar(50)='',											----Cartage
@SM1016_11  	nvarchar(50)='',											----QTY   
@SM1016_12 	    nvarchar(50)='',											----Unit
@SM1016_13  	nvarchar(50)='',											----Cartage
@SM1016_14      nvarchar(50)='',											----Feright
@SM1016_15      nvarchar(50)='',											----Credit
@SM1016_16      nvarchar(50)='',											----Cash1
@SM1016_17      nvarchar(50)='',											----Credit1
@SM1016_18		nvarchar(50)='',											----Cash2
@SM1016_19 		nvarchar(50)='',											----Credit2
@SM1016_20      nvarchar(50)='',											----IGST
@SM1016_21      nvarchar(50)='',											----CGST
@SM1016_22  	nvarchar(50)='',											---SGST
@SM1016_23  	nvarchar(50)='',											----Payment Term   
@SM1016_24 	    nvarchar(50)='',											----Mode Of Payment
@SM1016_25      nvarchar(50)='',											----Payment AT
@SM1016_26      nvarchar(50)='',											----null
@SM1016_27      nvarchar(50)='',	                                        --valid till date
@SM1016_28      nvarchar(50)='',                                            --approved by user id
@SM1016_29      nvarchar(50)='',                                            ----approved datetime
@SM1016_30      nvarchar(100)='',                                           ---approved by ip
@SM1016_31      nvarchar(100)='',                                           --approved by remarks

@likeclause as  nvarchar(50)='',
@pageno as      nvarchar(50) ='',
@value         nvarchar(50)='',
@sm1016_c32    nvarchar(50)='',
@PRODUCT       NVARCHAR(50)='',
@CUSTOMER      NVARCHAR(50)='',
@DATE          NVARCHAR(50)='',
@LISTOFUNQID	nvarchar(MAX)='',
@SM1008_32      NVARCHAR(20)='',
@BRANCH    nvarchar(MAX)='',
@uqid      nvarchar(MAX)=''
	
AS


	IF @what='insert_data'
	begin
		declare @uid as nvarchar(max)=newid();
		declare @uid2 as nvarchar(max)='';
		declare @mx as numeric(18,0)=0;
		set @mx= cast((select max(sm1016_5)+1 from sm1016) as numeric(18,0))
		--print @mx
		INSERT INTO SM1016_C (SM1016_C1, SM1016_C2, SM1016_C3, UNQID, SM1016_C100, SM1016_C4, SM1016_C5, SM1016_C6, SM1016_C7, SM1016_C8, SM1016_C9, SM1016_C10, SM1016_C11, SM1016_C12, SM1016_C13, SM1016_C14, SM1016_C15, SM1016_C16, SM1016_C17, SM1016_C18, SM1016_C19, SM1016_C20, SM1016_C21, SM1016_C22, SM1016_C23, SM1016_C24, SM1016_C25, SM1016_C26,sm1016_C27,sm1016_c32)	
		VALUES (GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM1016_3, @uid, @SM1016_100, @SM1016_4, @SM1016_5, @SM1016_6, @SM1016_7, @SM1016_8, @SM1016_9, @SM1016_10, @SM1016_11, @SM1016_12, @SM1016_13, @SM1016_14, @SM1016_15, @SM1016_16, @SM1016_17, @SM1016_18, @SM1016_19, @SM1016_20, @SM1016_21, @SM1016_22, @SM1016_23, @SM1016_24, @SM1016_25, @SM1016_26,@SM1016_27,@sm1016_c32);

		set @uid2=newid();
		print @uid2;
		INSERT INTO SM1004
		SELECT GETDATE(), GETDATE(), 'ADM', @uid2, '::1', SM1016_C6, @mx,sm1016_C.sm1016_C4, @uid
		FROM SM1016_C where unqid=@uid;
		
		INSERT INTO SM1004_C( SM1004_C1, SM1004_C2, SM1004_C3, unqid, SM1004_C5, SM1004_C6, SM1004_C7, SM1004_C8, SM1004_C9, SM1004_C10, SM1004_C11)
		SELECT GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @uid2,newid(),SM1016_C.SM1016_C8, SM1016_C.SM1016_C9, SM1016_C.SM1016_C7, @UNQID, SM1016_C.SM1016_C11, '', SM1016_C.SM1016_C6
		FROM SM1016_C where unqid=@uid;
	end

	IF @what ='delete_data'
	Begin
		DELETE from sm1016_C WHERE unqid= @unqid 
	End

IF @what ='ObookingMaster'
	begin 
       --Customer Name		
		select unqid, sm19_5 AS Customer from sm19 where sm19_11='CUST' order by sm19_5
       --Product Name
		select sm206_2 , sm206_7 as ProductN from sm206 ORDER BY sm206_7
       --Manufacture
		select  unqid ,sm113_6 as Manufacture from sm113 ORDER BY sm113_6
	   --Category
		select unqid , sm17_6 as Category from sm17 order by sm17_6
       --unit  
		select unqid ,  sm209_7 as unit from sm209 ORDER BY sm209_7
	   --IGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS IGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7
	   --CGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS CGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7
	   --SGST
		select unqid, sm210_7 AS
		SGST from sm210 ORDER BY sm210_7  
	   --date
		select convert (nvarchar,GETDATE(),105) as unq 
	   --Payable at
		SELECT unqid, SM1_5 AS CITY FROM SM01 ORDER BY SM1_5
	   --Branch Master
		 select SM1002_5 AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7

		 select unqid, sm1016_5 as brno from sm1016 ORDER BY SM1016_5
	
		

	  
	end
		IF @what ='EDEdit_box'
	BEGIN
	   
	   
		SELECT UPPER(SM1016_C4) AS BRANCH,SM1016_C5,SM1016_C6,SM1016_C7,SM1016_C8,SM1016_C9 AS MANU,SM1016_C10,SM1016_C11,SM1016_C12,SM1016_C13,SM1016_C14,
		SM1016_C15,SM1016_C16,SM1016_C17,SM1016_C18,SM1016_C19,SM1016_C20,SM1016_C21,SM1016_C22,SM1016_C23,SM1016_C24,SM1016_C25,SM1016_C32 FROM SM1016_C WHERE unqid = @unqid;
		
	END

	IF @what = 'UpdataOB'
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SM1016_C SET SM1016_C4 = @SM1016_4, SM1016_C5 = @SM1016_5,SM1016_C6 = @SM1016_6, SM1016_C7 = @SM1016_7,SM1016_C8 = @SM1016_8, SM1016_C9 = @SM1016_9, SM1016_C10 = @SM1016_10,
		SM1016_C11 = @SM1016_11,SM1016_C12 = @SM1016_12, SM1016_C13 = @SM1016_13, SM1016_C14 = @SM1016_14, SM1016_C15 = @SM1016_15,SM1016_C16 = @SM1016_16, 
		SM1016_C17 = @SM1016_17, SM1016_C18 = @SM1016_18, SM1016_C19 = @SM1016_19, SM1016_C20 = @SM1016_20, SM1016_C21 = @SM1016_21, SM1016_C22 = @SM1016_22,
		SM1016_C23 = @SM1016_23, SM1016_C24 = @SM1016_24, SM1016_C25 = @SM1016_25, SM1016_C32=@SM1016_C32 WHERE unqid = @unqid
	END

	if @what='BOselectingC'
	BEGIN
		select sm206_c7 as Manufacture from sm206_c where sm206_c6=@unqid 
		select unqid as Category from sm206 inner join sm17 on sm17.unqid=sm206.sm206_13 where  sm206_2=@unqid
		select sm206_12 as unit from sm206 where sm206_2=@unqid
		SELECT SM1017_C1.SM1017_C10 AS cash FROM SM1017_C1 INNER JOIN SM1017 ON SM1017.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C5 where sm1017_c6=@UNQID AND SM1017_6 = @SM1017_6
		SELECT SM1017_C1.SM1017_c11 AS Credit FROM SM1017_C1 INNER JOIN SM1017 ON SM1017.UNQID=SM1017_C1.SM1017_C5 where sm1017_c6=@UNQID AND SM1017_6 = @SM1017_6

		if @PRODUCT != ''
		begin
		
		 SELECT TOP 1(SM1011_22)as cost FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011_13=@PRODUCT  ORDER BY SM1011_6 DESC

		 select sm1010_11 as pcost from sm1010 where sm1010_3=@PRODUCT

		 SELECT UNQID AS TAX FROM SM210 WHERE unqid= (SELECT SM206_10 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2=@PRODUCT)

		 end
		 -- total number of days 
		 --select sm202_13 as rcptdate from sm202 where sm202_4=(select co_6 as unq from cosr where co_1 > (select in_14 as duedate from invn where in_8 =(select top 1 sm1011_6 from sm1011 where sm1011_10='308ED0CB-89E2-4EC9-9285-63F3DF1B5406')))
		 --due days particular invoice=rcptdate - duedate
		 --due days of 1 invoice + due days of 2nd invoice /no of invoice
	END
	if @what='Selection_gst'
	BEGIN
		select SM205_5 as State from sm205 where unqid=(select sm19_25 from sm19 where unqid=@unqid)
	END
	
	IF @what='GET_GRNO'
	BEGIN
		select isnull(max(TRY_CAST(sm1016_C.SM1016_C5 as numeric(10))),0)  + 1 as GRNo,newid() as parentunq from dbo.SM1016_C;
	END

	

IF @what ='grid_R'
begin
		Select sm1016_C.unqid as unqid ,  SM1016_5  AS BOOKINGNO,convert (varchar ,SM1016_C6 ,105) as SM1016_C6,(select sm19_5 from sm19 where unqid=SM1016_C7 )as SM1016_C7 ,
		(select sm206_7 from sm206 where sm206_2=SM1016_C8) as SM1016_C8 ,(CASE WHEN SM1016_C28 <>'' THEN 'Approved' ELSE '' END) AS [STATUS]
		from sm1016_C	INNER JOIN SM1016 ON SM1016_C.SM1016_C5=SM1016.UNQID ORDER BY SM1016_C6
end

if @what='orderapproval'
begin
	update sm1016_C set sm1016_C28=@SM1016_28,sm1016_C29=getdate(),sm1016_C30=@SM1016_30,sm1016_C31=@sm1016_31 where unqid = @unqid

SELECT 'Approved Successfully' AS err;
end

IF @what = 'getdata'

IF @what='delaydays'
BEGIN
select SUM(duedays) as delayday,count(*) as inv,SUM(duedays)/count(*) as Avgdelay,unqid   from (
           select in_14 as due_date, (select max(co_2) from COSR where CO_5=invn.unqid) as rceiptdate,
         datediff(day,in_14,(select max(co_2) from COSR where CO_5=invn.unqid)) as duedays,  @CUSTOMER as unqid from invn WHERE IN_12=@CUSTOMER
         )  a  group by unqid
END

if @what='PENDING_SRL'
BEGIN
SELECT ORDERNO,SRLUNQ,CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,
cast(ORDERVALUE as numeric(18,2))AS ORDERVALUE,SUM(INVOICEAMT) AS PREVIOUSINVAMT,
FORMAT(SUM(DUEAMOUNT), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALDUEAMT,
FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT,'N2','en-IN')as CREDITLIMIT ,
MAX(OVERDUEDAYS) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
--CASE 
--        WHEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING) - CREDITLIMIT) > 0 
--        THEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) 
--        ELSE 0 
--    END AS [REQDCL],
[REQDCL] AS [REQDCL],
QTY,ORDERDATE,
FORMAT(SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN') AS TOTALOUTSTANDING,
 CASE 
        WHEN (CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)) > 0 
        THEN FORMAT(CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING), 'N2', 'en-IN')
        ELSE '0.00'
    END AS CLavailable,
--FORMAT((CREDITLIMIT - SUM(TOTALOUTSTANDING)),'N2','en-IN') AS CLavailable,
RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,REASON,validtill,ActualRate,USERNAME
FROM (

        SELECT SM1016.SM1016_5 AS ORDERNO,sm1016_C.unqid as SRLUNQ,ISNULL((case when IN_11 < 0 then 0.00 else IN_11 end),0.00) AS DUEAMT,
		SM1016_c4 AS BRANCHUNQ,SM1002_7 AS BRANCHNAME,SM1016_c7 AS CUSTOMERUNQ,SM19_5 AS CUSTOMERNAME,SM1016_c8 AS PRODUNQ,SM206_7 AS PRODNAME,SM1016_C11 AS QTY,
		CASE WHEN SM1016_C16='0.00' THEN SM1016_C17 ELSE SM1016_C16 END AS Rate,
		ISNULL((SM1016_C11*CASE WHEN SM1016_C16='0.00' THEN SM1016_C17 ELSE SM1016_C16 END)* 1.18,0.00) AS ORDERVALUE,
		SM19_57 AS CREDITLIMIT ,ISNULL(IN_9,0) AS INVOICEAMT,
		ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(getdate()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00) AS DUEAMOUNT,
        ISNULL((case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end) ,0) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(SM1016_C6 AS DATETIME), 103)AS ORDERDATE,
		ISNULL(IN_11,0.00) AS TOTALOUTSTANDING ,(SELECT SM209_7 FROM SM209 WHERE UNQID=SM1016_C12)AS UNIT,dbo.srl_reason(sm1016_c.sm1016_c7,sm1016_c.sm1016_c5) as REASON,
		SM1016_C32 AS [REQDCL],
		CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(SM1016_C27 AS DATETIME), 103) as validtill,CASE WHEN SM1016_C17='0.00' THEN SM1016_C14 ELSE SM1016_C15 END AS ActualRate,SM1016_C6 AS ODATE,
		(SELECT SM63_6 FROM SM63 WHERE SM63_5=SM1016_3)AS USERNAME
		FROM SM1016_c INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1016_c.SM1016_c4 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1016_c.SM1016_c7 
		INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1016_c.SM1016_c8 LEFT OUTER JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_12=SM1016_c.SM1016_c7
		INNER JOIN SM1016 ON SM1016.UNQID=SM1016_C.SM1016_C5
        WHERE ISNULL(IN_7,'OO') = 'OO'  and sm1016_c31='Pending' AND SM1016_C4=@BRANCH --and sm1016_c28 <>''
) a  

GROUP BY CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,PRODUNQ,CREDITLIMIT,SRLUNQ,QTY,ORDERDATE,RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,REASON,[REQDCL],validtill,ActualRate,ORDERNO,ODATE,USERNAME,ORDERVALUE
ORDER BY ODATE DESC ,cast(ORDERNO as numeric(18,0)) DESC


SELECT IN_13 AS INVNO, IN_12 AS CUSTOMERUNQ,SM19_6 AS CUSTOMERNAME,IN_8 AS INVDATE,IN_9 AS INVOICEAMT,
(SELECT SM206_7 FROM SM206 WHERE SM206_2 IN (SELECT SM1011_13 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID = INVN.IN_5)) AS PRODUCT,IN_14 AS DUEDATE,
ISNULL( (select IN_11 WHERE DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(IN_14) <= DBO.GETFORMATTEDDATE(getdate()) and IN_7 = 'OO' and in_11<>0) ,0.00)AS DUEAMOUNT, 
(SELECT TOP 1(case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end)) AS OVERDUEDAYS
FROM INVN INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=INVN.IN_12
WHERE IN_7 = 'OO'  and in_11<>0.00
END

        WHEN (SUM(ORDERVALUE) + SUM(DUEAMT) - CREDITLIMIT) > 0

 CASE

        ELSE '0.00'
    END AS CLavailable,
RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,USERNAME

        ISNULL((case when (DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()))  < = 0 then 0 else  DATEDIFF(day,  IN_14, getdate()) end) ,0) AS OVERDUEDAYS,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(SM1008_5 AS DATETIME), 103)AS ORDERDATE,
        --SM1008_5 AS ORDERDATE,

		FROM SM1008 INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1008.SM1008_24 INNER JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID=SM1008.SM1008_6 
		INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2=SM1008.SM1008_8 LEFT OUTER JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_12=SM1008.SM1008_6
        WHERE ISNULL(IN_7,'OO') = 'OO'  AND SM1008_34='Pending' AND SM1008_24=@BRANCH --and sm1016_c28 <>''
) a  

GROUP BY CUSTOMERUNQ,BRANCHNAME,CUSTOMERNAME,PRODNAME,PRODUNQ,CREDITLIMIT,CHALLANUNQ,QTY,ORDERDATE,RATE,BRANCHUNQ,UNIT,challanno,REASON,CDATE,USERNAME,ORDERVALUE
ORDER BY CDATE DESC,challanno DESC

SELECT *
INTO #SalesCTE
FROM (

    
    -- 2?? Opening Data  (Fixed with GROUP BY)
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
       -- sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
       -- sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
       -- SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
        --SM1011_7 AS INVNO,
        SUM(SM1008_C4) AS SELLQTY,
        sm1008_14 AS SELLINGRATE,
       -- SUM(SM1023_c8) AS GRQTY,
       -- SUM(SM1011_24) AS SALEAMT,
        SM1023_c13 AS COST,
        0.00 AS NCOST,
        --0.00 AS INVNDISC,
        0 AS DiscountByMonth,
		 0 AS DiscountByQuantityRange
    FROM sm1008
    JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN sm1023_c ON sm1023_c.unqid = sm1008_c.sm1008_c3 
    JOIN SM1023 ON SM1023.UNQID = SM1023_C.SM1023_C5
    WHERE 
       sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID
	  
    GROUP BY 
        sm206.sm206_2,
    
        sm19.sm19_5,
        sm206_7,

		sm1008_14,
		SM1023_c13

    UNION ALL
  
     SELECT
        sm206.sm206_2 AS PRODUCTUNQ,
      --  sm1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        sm19_5 AS CUSTNAME,
       -- sm206_7 AS PRODUCT,
       -- SM1011_6 AS INVDATE,
       -- '' AS INVNO,
      SUM(SM1008_C4) AS SELLQTY,
        sm1008_14 AS SELLINGRATE,
     --   SUM(SM1005_57) AS GRQTY,
       -- SUM(SM1011_24) AS SALEAMT,
        (SM1005_24 - SM1005_25 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS COST,
        (SM1005_24 + SM1005_28 + SM1005_27 + SM1005_83) AS NCOST,
       -- (SM1005_25) AS INVNDISC,
        ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(sm_401_c_8)
            FROM sm_401_c
            INNER JOIN sm_401 ON SM_401.SM_401_5 = SM_401_C.SM_401_C_6
            WHERE sm1005_6 BETWEEN sm_401_6 AND sm_401_7
              AND sm1005_42 = sm_401_11
              AND sm1005_10 = sm_401_c_7
        ),0) AS DiscountByMonth
		 -- ?? Discount By Quantity Range
  , ISNULL((
        SELECT  CAST(sm_402_c7 AS NUMERIC(18,2))
        FROM sm_402 
        INNER JOIN sm_402_c ON sm_402.unqid = sm_402_c4
        WHERE sm_402_7 = SM1005_10
          AND sum(SM1005_57) BETWEEN 
                CAST(sm_402_c5 AS INT) AND 
                CAST(NULLIF(sm_402_c6, '') AS INT)
				
    ), 0)  *
	 SUM(CAST(SM1008_C4 / 1000.0 AS NUMERIC(18,3))) AS DiscountByQuantityRange 
    FROM SM1008
	  JOIN sm1008_c ON sm1008_c1 = sm1008.unqid
    LEFT JOIN SM19 ON SM19.UNQID = SM1008_6
    JOIN SM206 ON SM206.SM206_2 = SM1008_8
    JOIN SM206_C ON SM206_C.SM206_C6 = SM206.SM206_2
    JOIN SM1005 ON SM1008_C.SM1008_C3 = SM1005.SM1005_4
	
     WHERE 
       sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID
	  

    GROUP BY 
        sm1005.SM1005_10,
        sm1005.SM1005_42,
        sm1005.SM1005_6,

        sm206.sm206_2,
        sm206.sm206_7,

        sm19.sm19_5,


        sm1005.SM1005_24,
        sm1005.SM1005_25,
        sm1005.SM1005_27,
        sm1005.SM1005_28,
        sm1005.SM1005_83,
		   sm1005.SM1005_57,
		   sm1008_14

) AS SourceData;

--select * from #salescte
SELECT
    
    PRODUCTUNQ,
    SELLINGRATE,
	custname,
	cast((COST-(sum(DiscountByMonth) + sum(DiscountByQuantityRange) ))/1000 as numeric(18,2)) AS purchasecost,
	SELLQTY AS Qty,
    cast(( SELLINGRATE-CAST((COST - (SUM(DiscountByMonth) + SUM(DiscountByQuantityRange)))/1000 AS NUMERIC(18,2)) ) 
        * SELLQTY as numeric(18,2)) AS LossAmount
INTO #yyy
FROM #SalesCTE
GROUP BY  PRODUCTUNQ ,SELLINGRATE,COST,custname,SELLQTY

select * from #yyy inner join sm1008 on sm1008_8=productunq inner join sm1002 on sm1002_5=sm1008_24 inner join sm206 on sm206_2=sm1008_8 where sm1008.unqid=@LISTOFUNQID

	end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_STAFF_MASTER]
@what nvarchar(100) = '',
@userid nvarchar(100) = '',
@ip  nvarchar(100) = '',
@dep nvarchar(100) = '',
@design nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 
@Branch nvarchar(100) = '',
@SM502_100 nvarchar(100) = '',     ---server ip
@SM502_1 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---datetime
@SM502_2 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---modifiy atetime
@SM502_3 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---userid
@SM502_4 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---NAME	
@SM502_5 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---ADDRESS
@SM502_6 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---STATE
@SM502_7 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---CITY
@SM502_8 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---AADHAR NUMBER
@SM502_9 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---COMPANY MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_10 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---PERSONAL MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_11 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OF JOINING
@SM502_12 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OF RESIGNATION
@SM502_13 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---DEPONTMNET
@SM502_14 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DESIGNATION
@SM502_15 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---HEAD
@SM502_16 nvarchar(max) = '',	   ---BRANCH
@SM502_18 nvarchar(max) ='',
@SM502_19 nvarchar(max) ='',       ---PRODUCT NAME
@SM502_20 nvarchar(max)='',--warehouse
@SearchText nvarchar(100) = '',
@sm1_7  nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid nvarchar(max)='',
@sm1006_13 nvarchar(max)='',
@warehouse nvarchar(max)=''

AS

BEGIN
	if @what ='insert_data'
	begin

	   INSERT INTO [dbo].[SM502]( SM502_1, SM502_2, SM502_3, UNQID, SM502_100, SM502_4, SM502_5, SM502_6, SM502_7, SM502_8, SM502_9, SM502_10, SM502_11, SM502_12, SM502_13, SM502_14, SM502_15, SM502_16, sm502_18, sm502_19, sm502_20)
	   VALUES (GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @SM502_3, NEWID(), @SM502_100, @SM502_4, @SM502_5, @SM502_6, @SM502_7, @SM502_8, @SM502_9, @SM502_10, @SM502_11, @SM502_12, @SM502_13, @SM502_14, @SM502_15, @SM502_16, @sm502_18, @sm502_19, @sm502_20);
	
	end
	IF @WHAT ='DEPONTMENT'
	BEGIN

	   insert into [dbo].[sm500] VALUES(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@userid,newid(),@ip,@dep,@Branch)
	   select unqid, SM500_4 as deportment from SM500
	   
	END

	IF @WHAT ='DESIGNATION'
	BEGIN

	   insert into [dbo].[sm501] VALUES(GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@userid,newid(),@ip,@design,@Branch)
	   select unqid , SM501_4 as designation from SM501
	    
	END

	if @what ='SMDropDowm'
	begin

	  --city
	  select unqid, SM1_5 as city from sm01 
	  --state
	  select  unqid, SM205_5 as [State] from SM205 ORDER BY SM205_5
	  --depontment
      select unqid, SM500_4 as deportment from SM500 ORDER BY SM500_4
	  --designation 
	  select unqid , SM501_4 as designation from SM501 ORDER BY SM501_4
	  --head
	  select  unqid , sm502_4 as head from sm502  ORDER BY SM502_17;	
	  --time
	  select convert(varchar ,getdate() ,105) as todate

	end

	if @what ='Grid_v'
	begin

	 select unqid,upper(SM502_4) AS NAME ,(select upper(sm1_5) from sm01 where unqid = SM502_7 )AS CITY ,
	 (select upper(SM502_4) from SM502 a  where a.unqid=SM502.SM502_15) AS HEAD ,
	 (select upper(SM501_4) from SM501 where unqid=SM502_14) AS DESIGNATION ,
	 (select upper(SM500_4) from SM500 where unqid= SM502_13) AS DEPONTMENT ,
	 STUFF((SELECT ',' + upper(sm1002_7) FROM SM1002 WHERE sm1002_5 IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split((sm502.sm502_16), ','))FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS [BRANCH], 
     STUFF((SELECT ',' + upper(SM1006_5) FROM SM1006 WHERE unqid IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split((sm502.sm502_20), ','))FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS [Warehouse]  
	 FROM SM502 where sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null ;

    end
	if @what='Updata_data'
	begin

		update sm502 set sm502_4 = @sm502_4,sm502_5 = @sm502_5,sm502_6 = @sm502_6,sm502_7 = @sm502_7,sm502_8 = @sm502_8,sm502_9 = @sm502_9,sm502_10 = @sm502_10,sm502_11 = @sm502_11,sm502_12 = @sm502_12,
		sm502_13 = @sm502_13,sm502_14 = @sm502_14,sm502_15 = @sm502_15,sm502_16 = @sm502_16,sm502_18 = @sm502_18,sm502_19=@sm502_19, sm502_20 =@sm502_20 where unqid = @unqid

	end
	if @what='Edit_box'
	begin 

		select SM502_4,SM502_5, SM502_6, SM502_7, SM502_8, SM502_9, SM502_10, SM502_11, SM502_12, SM502_13, SM502_14, SM502_15, SM502_16,SM502_18,sm502_19,sm502_20 from sm502 where unqid =@unqid;

	end
	if  @what = 'delete_data'
	begin 

	  delete from sm502 where unqid=@unqid;

	end

	if  @what = 'search'
	begin

	 SELECT SM502.UNQID, SM502.SM502_4 AS NAME,  SM01.sm1_5 AS CITY, SM502.SM502_4 AS HEAD,  SM501.SM501_4 AS DESIGNATION,  SM500.SM500_4 AS DEPONTMENT,SM1002.sm1002_7 AS BRANCH, 
	 STUFF((SELECT ',' + upper(SM1006_5) FROM SM1006 WHERE unqid IN (SELECT data FROM dbo.split((sm502.sm502_20), ','))FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS Warehouse
	 FROM SM502 
	 LEFT JOIN SM01 ON SM01.unqid = SM502.SM502_7 LEFT JOIN SM206 ON SM206.sm206_2 = SM502.SM502_15 LEFT JOIN SM501 ON SM501.unqid = SM502.SM502_14 LEFT JOIN SM500 ON SM500.unqid = SM502.SM502_13 
	 LEFT JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.sm1002_5 = SM502.SM502_16 WHERE( SM500.sm500_4 LIKE '%'+@SearchText+'%' OR SM501.SM501_4 LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%'  OR SM206.sm206_9 LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%' 									
	 OR SM01.sm1_5 LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%'  OR SM502.SM502_4 LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%'  OR SM1002.sm1002_7 LIKE '%' + @SearchText + '%' )

	end

	if @what ='GETcity'
	begin

		--city 
		select  unqid, sm1_5 as city from sm01 where sm1_7=@sm1_7 order by sm1_5
		
	end

	if @what ='GETWHREHOUSE'
	begin

	--select unqid , SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 order by  SM1006_5

	--select unqid , SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 where sm1006_13=@sm1006_13  order by  SM1006_5
	select unqid, SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 WHERE SM1006_13 in(SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@sm1006_13, ',')) order by  SM1006_5
	--select * from SM1006

	end

	if @what='all_branch'
	begin 
        select SM1002_5 AS unqid,SM1002_7 as Branch from sm1002 order by SM1002_7
       
        select unqid , SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 order by  SM1006_5
	end

	if @what='all_branch1'
	begin 
	  --CUSTOMER TYPE
	  SELECT unqid, SM44_7 AS CUSTTYPE FROM SM44 WHERE  SM44_12='CUST' ORDER BY SM44_7
	end

	
	if @what='Product'
	begin
	    select distinct sm206_2 as unqid, sm206_7 as product from sm206 order by sm206_7
	end

		if @what ='Warehouse2'
	begin
	select unqid, SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 order by  SM1006_5
	--select unqid, SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 WHERE SM1006_13 in(SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@branchid, ',')) order by  SM1006_5

	--select unqid, SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 WHERE SM1006_13 = @branchid order by  SM1006_5
	end

	if @what ='Warehouse'
	begin
	 	--Warehouse 
		 
		 select unqid, SM1006_5 as Warehouse  from SM1006 WHERE SM1006_13 in(SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@sm1006_13, ',')) order by  SM1006_5
		 
	end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_STAFFMASTERWISE_CUSTOMER_OS]
@what nvarchar(100) = '',
@userid nvarchar(100) = '',
@ip  nvarchar(100) = '',
@dep nvarchar(100) = '',
@design nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 
@Branch nvarchar(100) = '',
@SM502_100 nvarchar(100) = '',     ---server ip
@SM502_1 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---datetime
@SM502_2 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---modifiy atetime
@SM502_3 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---userid
@SM502_4 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---NAME	
@SM502_5 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---ADDRESS
@SM502_6 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---STATE
@SM502_7 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---CITY
@SM502_8 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---AADHAR NUMBER
@SM502_9 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---COMPANY MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_10 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---PERSONAL MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_11 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OFJOINING
@SM502_12 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OF RESIGNATION
@SM502_13 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---DEPONTMNET
@SM502_14 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DESIGNATION
@SM502_15 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---HEAD
@SM502_16 nvarchar(max) = '',	   ---BRANCH
@SM502_18 nvarchar(max) ='',
@SM502_19 nvarchar(max) ='',       ---PRODUCT NAME
@SM502_20 nvarchar(max)='',--warehouse
@SearchText nvarchar(100) = '',
@sm1_7  nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid nvarchar(max)=''

AS

BEGIN
	
	if @what ='Grid_v'
	begin
	  select unqid,upper(SM502_4) AS NAME ,(select upper(sm1_5) from sm01 where unqid = SM502_7 )AS CITY ,
	 (select upper(SM502_4) from SM502 a  where a.unqid=SM502.SM502_15) AS HEAD ,
	 (select upper(SM501_4) from SM501 where unqid=SM502_14) AS DESIGNATION ,
	 (select upper(SM500_4) from SM500 where unqid= SM502_13) AS DEPONTMENT ,
	 (select upper(sm1002_7) from SM1002 where sm1002_5=SM502_16) AS BRANCH
	 FROM SM502 where sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null ;
    end
	

	if @what ='GETDATA'
	begin


	WITH CustomerDue AS
(
        SELECT  
		sm1002.sm1002_7 as Branch,
        UPPER(sm502.SM502_4) AS STAFFNAME,
		sm502.sm502_9 as [mobile_No],
        UPPER(head.SM502_4) AS HEAD,
        sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTOMERNAME,
		sm206.sm206_7 as Product,
		in_13 as [invoice No],
        SUM(invn.in_11) AS TOTALDUE,
        --dbo.onlydate(invn.in_14) AS [due_date],
		CAST(invn.in_14 AS DATE) AS due_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY head.SM502_4, sm502.SM502_4 
            ORDER BY SUM(invn.in_11) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM invn
    JOIN sm19      ON sm19.unqid   = invn.in_12
    JOIN sm1002    ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = invn.in_15
    JOIN sm1011    ON sm1011.unqid = invn.in_5
	join sm206     on sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
    JOIN sm1008    ON sm1008.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_8
    JOIN sm502     ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
    LEFT JOIN sm502 head   ON head.unqid   = sm502.SM502_15
    --WHERE invn.in_14 BETWEEN dbo.onlydate(DATEADD(DAY,-3,GETDATE())) AND dbo.onlydate(GETDATE())----for last 3 days
	 WHERE invn.in_14 BETWEEN dbo.onlydate(GETDATE()) AND dbo.onlydate(DATEADD(DAY, 3, GETDATE()))----for next 3 days
    GROUP BY sm19.sm19_5, sm502.SM502_4, head.SM502_4, invn.in_14,in_13,sm502.sm502_9,sm1002.sm1002_7,sm206.sm206_7

)
SELECT *
FROM CustomerDue
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY HEAD, STAFFNAME, TOTALDUE DESC;

	end 


IF @what = 'DueData'
BEGIN
    WITH CustomerDue AS (
        SELECT
            sm1002.sm1002_7 AS Branch,
            UPPER(sm502.SM502_4) AS STAFFNAME,
            sm502.sm502_9 AS [mobile_No],
            UPPER(head.SM502_4) AS HEAD,
            sm19.sm19_5 AS CUSTOMERNAME,
            sm206.sm206_7 AS Product,
            in_13 AS [invoice No],
            SUM(invn.in_11) AS TOTALDUE,
            CAST(invn.in_14 AS DATE) AS due_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY head.SM502_4, sm502.SM502_4 
                ORDER BY SUM(invn.in_11) DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM invn
        JOIN sm19      ON sm19.unqid   = invn.in_12
        JOIN sm1002    ON sm1002.sm1002_5 = invn.in_15
        JOIN sm1011    ON sm1011.unqid = invn.in_5
        JOIN sm206     ON sm206.sm206_2 = sm1011.sm1011_13
        JOIN sm1008    ON sm1008.unqid = sm1011.sm1011_8
        JOIN sm502     ON sm502.unqid  = sm1008.sm1008_36
        LEFT JOIN sm502 head ON head.unqid = sm502.SM502_15
        WHERE invn.in_14 BETWEEN dbo.onlydate(DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE())) 
                            AND dbo.onlydate(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()))
        GROUP BY sm19.sm19_5,sm502.SM502_4,head.SM502_4,invn.in_14,in_13,sm502.sm502_9,sm1002.sm1002_7,sm206.sm206_7
    )

    -- Insert all rows 
    INSERT INTO DueInvData (
        Branch,
        STAFFNAME,
        mobile_No,
        HEAD,
        CUSTOMERNAME,
        Product,
        [invoice No],
        TOTALDUE,
        due_date,
        rn
    )
    SELECT 
        Branch,
        STAFFNAME,
        mobile_No,
        HEAD,
        CUSTOMERNAME,
        Product,
        [invoice No],
        TOTALDUE,
        due_date,
        rn
    FROM CustomerDue
    ORDER BY HEAD, STAFFNAME, TOTALDUE DESC;

    -- Optional: view inserted data
    SELECT DISTINCT *
	FROM DueInvData
	WHERE TOTALDUE <> '0'
    AND [invoice No] NOT IN (SELECT InvoiceNo FROM DueInvNo)

	  
	ORDER BY   STAFFNAME, TOTALDUE DESC;

	--note:- it is not updated sp...
END




END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_STAFFMASTERWISE_CUSTOMEROS_OYD]
@aa nvarchar(100) = '',
@uid nvarchar(100) = '',
@ip  nvarchar(100) = '',
@dep nvarchar(100) = '',
@design nvarchar(100) = '',
@unqid uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 

@SM502_100 nvarchar(100) = '',     ---server ip
@SM502_1 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---datetime
@SM502_2 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---modifiy atetime
@SM502_3 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---userid
@SM502_4 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---NAME	
@SM502_5 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---ADDRESS
@SM502_6 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---STATE
@SM502_7 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---CITY
@SM502_8 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---AADHAR NUMBER
@SM502_9 nvarchar(100) = '',       ---COMPANY MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_10 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---PERSONAL MOBILE NUMBER
@SM502_11 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OFJOINING
@SM502_12 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DATE OF RESIGNATION
@SM502_13 nvarchar(100) = '',	   ---DEPONTMNET
@SM502_14 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---DESIGNATION
@SM502_15 nvarchar(100) = '',      ---HEAD
@SM502_16 nvarchar(max) = '',	   ---BRANCH
@SM502_18 nvarchar(max) ='',
@SM502_19 nvarchar(max) ='',       ---PRODUCT NAME
@SM502_20 nvarchar(max)='',--warehouse
@SearchText nvarchar(100) = '',
@sm1_7  nvarchar(50) ='',
@BRANCH       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@sp      AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@sm      AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@Fd      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@Td      AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@PRODUNQ         AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURER    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@MANUFACTURE    AS NVARCHAR(max)='',
@fromdatee    AS NVARCHAR(50)='',

@todatee   AS NVARCHAR(50)='',
@year as nvarchar(50) ='',
@branchid as nvarchar(max) = '',
@GNAME as nvarchar(max) = '',

@unqidPro as nvarchar(max) = '',
@branchunq as nvarchar(max) = '',
@BRANCH_STOCK       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='',
@detail       AS NVARCHAR(MAX)='1'
AS

BEGIN
	 IF @AA = 'BIND'
    BEGIN
	if @uid in ('001','shi','adm','ami')
	 begin 
	 print '1'
    

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        ORDER BY Dname ASC,ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------
    set @branchid=(select sm63_12 from sm63 where sm63_5=@uid)
	select SM1002_5 as unqid, SM1002_7 as Dname , 1 as  ord  from SM1002 
	where sm1002_5 in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid,','))
	ORDER BY SM1002_7 ASC, ord asc;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

        SELECT UNQID AS unqid, SM17_6 AS Dname , 0 AS ord
        FROM SM17 
        ORDER BY Dname;
--------------------DROPDOWN------------------

	   select  unqid as unqid, sm113_6 as Dname from sm113  ORDER BY Dname;
	   ----------------------salesman---------------------------
	 select 
    sm502.unqid AS unqid,
    upper(sm502.SM502_4) AS Dname
from SM502
join sm500 
    on sm500.unqid = sm502.SM502_13
cross apply dbo.split(sm502.SM502_16, ',') ss   -- split SM502_16
where (sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null)
  and upper(sm500.SM500_4) = 'SALES'
  and ss.data in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
order by Dname;
    END
	end 

	IF @AA = 'BINDPRODUCT'
    BEGIN
 

        SELECT SM206_2 AS unqid, SM206_7 AS Dname , 1 AS ord
        FROM SM206 
        WHERE SM206_13 in (select data from dbo.split( @unqidPro ,',')) 
        ORDER BY Dname , ord asc;
    END
		IF @AA = 'BINDSM'
    BEGIN
 
        select 
    sm502.unqid AS unqid,
    upper(sm502.SM502_4) AS Dname
from SM502
join sm500 
    on sm500.unqid = sm502.SM502_13
cross apply dbo.split(sm502.SM502_16, ',') ss   -- split SM502_16
where (sm502_12 is not null or sm502_10 is not null)
 -- and --upper(sm500.SM500_4) = 'SALES'
  and ss.data in (select data from dbo.split(@branchid, ','))
order by Dname;


    END
	
if @aa='sales'


begin

         SELECT 
        S.SM502_4 AS EMP,
        S.SM502_5 AS CITY,
        S.SM502_21 AS BRANCHID,
        B.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        -- Concatenate all SM44_7 (schedule names) for each employee
        STUFF((
            SELECT ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(M.SM44_7))
            FROM SM44 AS M
            WHERE M.UNQID IN (
                SELECT data FROM dbo.split(S.SM502_18, ',')
            )
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
        ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS GNAME
    FROM SM502 AS S
    INNER JOIN SM1002 AS B 
        ON B.SM1002_5 = S.SM502_16 
WHERE S.UNQID IN 
(SELECT data FROM dbo.split(@SP, ','));

end



IF @AA ='DATA'
	BEGIN
	
-- Step 1: Insert main query output into temp table
SELECT *
INTO #TempOutstanding
FROM (
    -- your full existing query (unchanged)
    SELECT group_name, CITY, branchname, account_groupid, account_brid, sFld00, sFld01, sFld02, sFld03, 
    dbo.fn_FORMATAMT(nFld00) AS sFld04, dbo.fn_FORMATAMT(nFld01) AS sFld05, dbo.fn_FORMATAMT(nFld02) AS sFld06, 
    dbo.fn_FORMATAMT(nFld03) AS sFld07, dbo.fn_FORMATAMT(nFld04) AS sFld08, nFld00, nFld01, nFld02, nFld03, nFld04, nFld05, 
    IsNull(nFld06,0) As nFld06, sFld09, sFld10, sFld11, sFld12, sFld13, sFld14, sFld15, sFld16, sFld17, sFld18, sFld19, sFld20, 
    sFld21, sFld22, sFld23, sFld24, sFld25, sFld26, sFld27, sFld28, sFld29, nFld07, nFld08, nFld09, nFld10, nFld11, nFld12, 
    nFld13, nFld14, nFld15, nFld16, nFld17, nFld18, nFld19, dFld00, dFld01, dFld02, dFld03, dFld04, gFld00, gFld01, gFld02, 
    gFld03, gFld04, pFld00, pFld01, pFld02, pFld03, pFld04, [Invoice_NetAmt], BRANCHID
    FROM (
        SELECT group_name, CITY, branchname, account_groupid, account_brid, Account_ID, 
               A.[Account_Name] AS pFld00,   
               A.[Account_Code] AS sFld00, 
               P.[Product_Code] AS sFld01, 
               OS.[OS_VrNo] AS sFld02, 
               A.[Account_OSCategory] AS sFld03, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,OS.[OS_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 <= 15) THEN OS.[OS_OSAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld00, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,OS.[OS_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 16 AND 30) THEN OS.[OS_OSAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld01, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,OS.[OS_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 31 AND 45) THEN OS.[OS_OSAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld02, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,OS.[OS_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 46 AND 60) THEN OS.[OS_OSAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld03, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,OS.[OS_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 > 60) THEN OS.[OS_OSAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld04, 
               (CASE WHEN (OS.[OS_OSAmt] <> OS.[OS_NetAmt]) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nFld05, 
               OS.[OS_OSAmt] AS gFld00, 
               CONVERT(VarChar(11),OS.[OS_Date],103) AS dFld00, 
               '' As sFld04, '' As sFld05, '' As sFld06, '' As sFld07, '' As sFld08, '' As sFld09, '' As sFld10, '' As sFld11, 
               '' As sFld12, '' As sFld13, '' As sFld14, '' As sFld15, '' As sFld16, '' As sFld17, '' As sFld18, '' As sFld19, 
               '' As sFld20, '' As sFld21, '' As sFld22, '' As sFld23, '' As sFld24, '' As sFld25, '' As sFld26, '' As sFld27, 
               '' As sFld28, '' As sFld29, 0 As nFld07, 0 As nFld08, 0 As nFld09, 0 As nFld10, 0 As nFld11, 0 As nFld12, 
               0 As nFld13, 0 As nFld14, 0 As nFld15, 0 As nFld16, 0 As nFld17, 0 As nFld18, 0 As nFld19, '' As dFld01, 
               '' As dFld02, '' As dFld03, '' As dFld04, 0 As gFld01, 0 As gFld02, 0 As gFld03, 0 As gFld04, '' As pFld01, 
               '' As pFld02, '' As pFld03, '' As pFld04, 0 as [Invoice_NetAmt], '' as BRANCHID
        FROM (
            (Outstandings1308 AS OS 
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT group_name, City_Name AS CITY, branch_name+' ('+ City_Name +')' as branchname, account_groupid, account_brid, 
                [Account_ID], [Account_Name] + IsNull(', ' + City_Name,'') As Account_Name, [Account_Code], [Account_OSCategory] 
                FROM (
                    (GroupMas INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 ON Group_ID = Account_GroupID AND Group_LongID Like '10001%') 
                    LEFT JOIN CityMas On Account_CityID = City_ID
                    LEFT JOIN branchinfo on Branch_CityID = City_Id
                )
            ) AS A ON OS.[OS_PartyId] = A.[Account_ID]) 
            INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 AS P ON OS.[OS_ProductId] = P.[Product_ID]
        )
        WHERE OS.[OS_Date] <= '2025-10-29' AND OS.[OS_OSAmt]>0

        UNION  

        -- FIX: Use DISTINCT to prevent duplicate rows from InvDet1308 join
        SELECT DISTINCT
               group_name, CITY, branchname, account_groupid, account_brid, Account_ID, 
               A.[Account_Name] AS pFld00, 
               A.[Account_Code] AS sFld00, 
               '' AS sFld01,  -- Removed product join to avoid duplication
               Invoice1308.[Invoice_VrNo] AS sFld02, 
               A.[Account_OSCategory] AS sFld03, 
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 <= 15) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld00,
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 16 AND 30) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld01,
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 31 AND 45) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld02,
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 46 AND 60) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld03,
               (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 > 60) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld04,
               (CASE WHEN (Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] <> Invoice1308.[Invoice_NetAmt]) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nFld05,
               Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] AS gFld00,
               CONVERT(VarChar(11),Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],103) AS dFld00,
               '' As sFld04, '' As sFld05, '' As sFld06, '' As sFld07, '' As sFld08, '' As sFld09, '' As sFld10, 
               '' As sFld11, '' As sFld12, '' As sFld13, '' As sFld14, '' As sFld15, '' As sFld16, '' As sFld17, 
               '' As sFld18, '' As sFld19, '' As sFld20, '' As sFld21, '' As sFld22, '' As sFld23, '' As sFld24, 
               '' As sFld25, '' As sFld26, '' As sFld27, '' As sFld28, '' As sFld29, 0 As nFld07, 0 As nFld08, 
               0 As nFld09, 0 As nFld10, 0 As nFld11, 0 As nFld12, 0 As nFld13, 0 As nFld14, 0 As nFld15, 
               0 As nFld16, 0 As nFld17, 0 As nFld18, 0 As nFld19, '' As dFld01, '' As dFld02, '' As dFld03, '' As dFld04, 
               0 As gFld01, 0 As gFld02, 0 As gFld03, 0 As gFld04, '' As pFld01, '' As pFld02, '' As pFld03, '' As pFld04,
               Invoice1308.[Invoice_NetAmt], Invoice1308.[BranchID] 
        FROM (
            Invoice1308 
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT group_name, City_Name AS CITY, branch_name+' ('+ City_Name +')' as branchname, account_groupid, account_brid,
                [Account_ID], [Account_Name] + IsNull(', ' + City_Name,'') As Account_Name, 
                [Account_Code], [Account_OSCategory] 
                FROM (
                    (GroupMas INNER JOIN AccountMas1308 ON Group_ID = Account_GroupID AND Group_LongID Like '10001%') 
                    LEFT JOIN CityMas On Account_CityID = City_ID
                    LEFT JOIN branchinfo on Branch_CityID = City_Id
                )
            ) AS A ON Invoice1308.[Invoice_PartyId] = A.[Account_ID]
        )
        WHERE Invoice1308.[Invoice_TotMid] IN (4,14,29) 
          AND Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date] <= '2025-10-29' 
          AND Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt]>0
    ) AS VIRTUALTABLE
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SUM(AdjAmt) As nFld06, AdjPartyID 
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(Adjust_Amount) As AdjAmt, AI.Invoice_PartyID As AdjPartyID 
            FROM ((AdjustTran1308 INNER JOIN Invoice1308 As AI On Adjust_InvoiceID = AI.Invoice_ID) 
                  INNER JOIN InvTranMas1308 As AV On Adjust_ReferenceID = AV.InvMas_ID)
            WHERE AV.InvMas_Date > '2025-10-14' AND AI.Invoice_DAte <= '2025-10-14'
            GROUP BY AI.Invoice_PartyID
            UNION
            SELECT SUM(Adjust_Amount) As AdjAmt, AI.OS_PartyID As AdjPartyID 
            FROM ((AdjustTran1308 Inner Join Outstandings1308 As AI On Adjust_OpOSID = AI.OS_ID)
                  INNER JOIN InvTranMas1308 As AV On Adjust_ReferenceID = AV.InvMas_ID)
            WHERE AV.InvMas_Date > '2025-10-14' AND AI.OS_DAte <= '2025-10-14'
            GROUP BY AI.OS_PartyID
        ) As AjdUTot
        GROUP BY AdjPartyID
    ) As AjdTot 
    ON Account_ID = AdjPartyID
    WHERE (nFld00 + nFld01 + nFld02 + nFld03 + nFld04)> 0
) AS FinalData;


-- Step 2: Build Employee + Schedule mapping (GNAME is comma-separated string)
;WITH EmployeeData AS (
    SELECT 
        S.SM502_4 AS EMP,
        S.SM502_5 AS CITY,
        S.SM502_21 AS BRANCHID,
        B.SM1002_7 AS BRANCH,
        STUFF((
            SELECT ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(M.SM44_7))
            FROM SM44 AS M
            WHERE M.UNQID IN (
                SELECT data FROM dbo.split(S.SM502_18, ',')
            )
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
        ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS GNAME
    FROM SM502 AS S
    INNER JOIN SM1002 AS B 
        ON B.SM1002_5 = S.SM502_16 
),
-- Expand EmployeeData.GNAME into one row per schedule
EmployeeSchedule AS (
    SELECT
        ED.EMP,
        ED.CITY,
        ED.BRANCHID,
        ED.BRANCH,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DATA)) AS SCHEDULE
    FROM EmployeeData ED
    CROSS APPLY dbo.split(ED.GNAME, ',') s
)

-- Step 3: Match Outstanding with Employee by Branch + Schedule
SELECT 
    X.EMP,
    X.BRANCH,
    X.PARTY,
    X.CITYY,
    SUM(X.[DUE AMT]) AS [TOTAL DUE AMT],
    SUM(X.[Invoice_NetAmt]) AS [TOTAL INVOICE AMT]
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ES.EMP,
        ES.CITY,
        T.branchname AS BRANCH,
        T.sFld00 AS SFID00,
        T.sFld01 AS PRODUCT,
        T.sFld02 AS INVOICE,
        T.sFld03 AS SCHEDULE,
        T.gFld00 AS [DUE AMT],
        T.pFld00 AS PARTY,
        T.dFld00 AS [DUE DATE],
        T.CITY AS CITYY,
        T.[Invoice_NetAmt],
        ES.SCHEDULE AS EMP_SCHEDULE
    FROM #TempOutstanding AS T
    INNER JOIN EmployeeSchedule AS ES
        ON T.BRANCHID = ES.BRANCHID
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(T.group_name)) = ES.SCHEDULE
) AS X
WHERE 
    X.EMP = @SP
    AND X.EMP_SCHEDULE IN (
        SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(DATA)) FROM dbo.split(@GNAME,',')
    )
GROUP BY 
    X.EMP, X.BRANCH, X.PARTY, X.CITYY
ORDER BY 
    X.EMP, X.BRANCH, X.PARTY;

-- Step 4: Cleanup
DROP TABLE #TempOutstanding;

END;

           '' As sFld24, '' As sFld25, '' As sFld26, '' As sFld27, '' As sFld28, '' As sFld29, 0 As nFld07, 0 As nFld08, 0 As nFld09, 0 As nFld10,

        INNER JOIN ProductMas1308 AS P ON OS.[OS_ProductId] = P.[Product_ID]

           Invoice1308.[Invoice_VrNo] AS sFld02, A.[Account_OSCategory] AS sFld03, 
           (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 <= 15) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld00,
           (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 16 AND 30) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld01,
           (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 31 AND 45) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld02,
           (CASE WHEN (DATEDIFF(Day,Invoice1308.[Invoice_Date],'2025-10-29')+ 1 BETWEEN 46 AND 60) THEN Invoice1308.[Invoice_RemainingAmt] ELSE 0 END) AS nFld03,

           '' As sFld18, '' As sFld19, '' As sFld20, '' As sFld21, '' As sFld22, '' As sFld23, '' As sFld24, 
           '' As sFld25, '' As sFld26, '' As sFld27, '' As sFld28, '' As sFld29, 0 As nFld07, 0 As nFld08,

              INNER JOIN InvTranMas1308 As AV On Adjust_ReferenceID = AV.InvMas_ID)

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_FOR_TAX_INVOICE]
@what     nvarchar(15)='',
@UNQID    NVARCHAR(50)=''
AS


if (@what = 'gridbind')
begin
   select unqid from sm1011
end
if @what='tax_invoice'
begin
declare @hold nvarchar(50)=''
set @hold=(select sm1011_9 from sm1011 inner join sm1003 on sm1011.sm1011_9=sm1003.sm1003_4 where unqid=@UNQID)
declare @BRANCH nvarchar(MAX)=''
declare @WAREHOUSEUNQ nvarchar(MAX)=''
 SELECT @BRANCH=SM1011_41 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID
SELECT @WAREHOUSEUNQ=SM1011_39 FROM SM1011 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID

SELECT PA_17 AS GSTIN,SM205_5 AS [state],sm205_7 as statecode,(SELECT SM1002_8 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) as [AdministrativeAddress],
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1002_11 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)) AS location,(SELECT SM1002_17 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH)AS PINCODE,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=(SELECT SM1006_7 FROM SM1006 WHERE UNQID=@warehouseunq)) AS DISPATCHlocation,
(SELECT SM1006_10 FROM SM1006 WHERE UNQID=@warehouseunq)AS DISPATCHPINCODE,
(SELECT SM1002_13 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) as phoneNo,(SELECT SM1002_14 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=@BRANCH) as email,pa_3 as FirmName,pa_28 as para1,
(select sm1006_6 from sm1006 where unqid=@warehouseunq) as para2,
pa_5 as reg1,pa_7 as reg2,pa_4 as [signature],PA_20 AS PanNo,
--(SELECT SM19_45 from sm19 where unqid=pa_35) as CinNo 
pa_25 as CinNo
FROM PA INNER JOIN SM205 ON SM205.UNQID=PA.PA_10



SELECT '' AS NET,SM1011_15 AS Particular, SM206_9 AS ProductName,sm206_15 as HSN,(SELECT SM1008_15 FROM SM1008 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_8) as challan,
(select SM19_5 from sm19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_16) as transporter,sm1011_20 as qty,sm1011_22 as Rate,(select sm209_5 from sm209 where unqid=sm1011_21) as Unit,
--sm1011_24 as amount,
CASE WHEN (SELECT SM1011_62 FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID) = 'FALSE' THEN (SELECT (sm1011_24-SM1011_37) FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID) ELSE sm1011_24  END as amount,
(SELECT SM210_7 FROM SM210 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_26) as igstper,sm1011_35 as netamt,(SELECT SM1002_16 FROM SM1002 WHERE SM1002_5=SM1011_41)+CASE WHEN  LEN(sm1011_7)>4 THEN  sm1011_7 ELSE DBO.LPAD(sm1011_7, 4, 0) END as InvoiceNo,
CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11),sm1011_6,103) as [InvoiceDate],(SELECT SM1009_C7 FROM SM1009_C WHERE unqid=SM1011_17)AS VehicleNo,SM1011_46 as EwayBill,(SELECT SM19_6 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_10) as customerName,
(SELECT SM19_23 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_10) as GSTINCust,(SELECT SM19_46 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_10) as PANNOCust,
(SELECT SM19_13 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_10)AS CustAddress ,(select sm205_7 from sm205 where unqid=(SELECT SM19_25 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_10)) as StatecodeCust,
(select sm19_24 from sm19 where unqid=sm1011_10) as [StateCust] , (select sm1003_7 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=(@hold))as consigneeName,
(select sm1003_12 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=@hold)as Gstinconsignee,(select sm205_7 from sm205 where unqid=(select sm1003_10 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=@hold))
as Statecodeconsignee,(select sm205_5 from sm205 where unqid=(select sm1003_10 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=@hold))as Stateconsignee,
(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 WHERE UNQID=(select sm19_15 from sm19 where unqid=sm1011_10))AS CITY,(SELECT SM1_5 FROM SM01 
WHERE UNQID=(select sm1003_9 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=(@hold))) AS CONSIGNEECITY,
(SELECT SM1003_8 FROM SM1003 WHERE SM1003_4=@hold)as Addressconsignee,SM1011_18 AS Strength,sm1011_27 as IgstAmt,SM1011_42 AS Netqty,sm1011_34 RoundOff,SM1011_43 AS ACK_DATE,
SM1011_44 AS ACK_NO,SM1011_48 AS IRNNO,SM1011_55 AS QR, SM1011_61 AS creditday,(SELECT SM210_7/2 FROM  SM210 WHERE UNQID=SM1011_28)AS Gstper,
sm1011_29 as CGstAmt,SM1011_31 AS SGstAmt, dbo.onlydate(IN_14) AS duedate,(select sm1003_16 from sm1003 where sm1003_4=(@hold)) as consigneePan,
(SELECT SM1002_8 FROM SM1011 INNER JOIN SM1002 ON SM1002.SM1002_5=SM1011.SM1011_41 WHERE UNQID=@UNQID) AS Branch,
CASE WHEN (SELECT SM1011_62 FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID) = 'FALSE' THEN (SELECT SM1011_37 FROM SM1011 WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID) ELSE 0  END AS CartageRate,
--convert(date,in_14,103) as duedate,
CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11),IN_14,103) as duedate,sm1011_33 as tcsamt,(SELECT SM19_54 FROM SM19 WHERE UNQID=sm1011_11) as drivernumber
 FROM SM1011
 INNER JOIN SM206 ON SM1011.SM1011_13=SM206.SM206_2 INNER JOIN INVN ON INVN.IN_5=SM1011.UNQID
WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID



SELECT BA_7 AS BankName,BA_9 AS AccountNo, BA_10 AS IFSC, BA_13 AS BranchName FROM BA INNER JOIN PA ON PA.PA_35=BA.BA_14

SELECT SM19_64 AS EMAIL FROM SM19 INNER JOIN SM1011 ON SM1011.SM1011_10=SM19.UNQID WHERE SM1011.unqid=@UNQID

 
end

 
 


GO

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertDeliveryChallan_PG]
    @ChallanNo VARCHAR(20),
    @ChallanDate DATE,
    @CustomerName VARCHAR(100),
    @ProductName VARCHAR(100),
    @Quantity INT
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO DeliveryChallan_PGDeliveryChallan_PG(ChallanNo, ChallanDate, CustomerName, ProductName, Quantity, Status)
    VALUES (@ChallanNo, @ChallanDate, @CustomerName, @ProductName, @Quantity, 'Pending');

    PRINT 'Delivery Challan inserted successfully.';
END;
GO
